These results demonstrate that explicit region-aware visual representations reduce object hallucination and improve the factual grounding of MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出ReVA模型，通过双桥接架构将冻结的CLIP ViT和Qwen2.5 LLM连接，融合整图与区域级视觉表征，有效减少多模态大模型在VQA任务中的对象幻觉并提升事实性视觉定位能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在视觉问答中虽取得显著进展，但在需要精确空间推理和细粒度视觉理解的问题上仍表现不佳，常产生对象、属性和空间幻觉——模型给出自信但缺乏视觉依据的答案，原因是缺乏区域级和细粒度的视觉定位能力。
AI.method: ReVA采用冻结的CLIP ViT-L/14视觉编码器和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct大语言模型，通过双桥接进行对齐：图像桥将最终Transformer块特征映射为图像token；区域桥将ViT各层增强的中间特征裁剪后映射为每个边界框的K个区域token。检测器堆栈（RAM++、spaCy、Grounding DINO）生成零样本的与问题无关及相关边界框，图像token与区域token拼接作为LLM提示前缀以联合编码场景级上下文和细粒度区域证据。
AI.result: 在VQAv2、MMBench、POPE和SEED-Bench上评估，ReVA在POPE上达到82.85%的平均F1，优于不含区域token的图像token基线（81.14%）。
AI.conclusion: 显式的区域感知视觉表征能够减少对象幻觉并改善多模态大语言模型的事实性视觉定位能力。

title: Projection-Aware End-to-End Learned Video Compression for 360-Degree Video
summary:
360-degree video supports immersive applications such as virtual reality, autonomous driving, and education. Because spherical content cannot be processed directly by conventional video codecs, it must first be mapped to a two-dimensional projection. Projection choice affects spatial continuity, sampling uniformity, motion estimation, and compression efficiency.
  This thesis investigates how projection format influences end-to-end neural compression of 360-degree video. Seven formats supported by JVET 360Lib are evaluated using the scale-space flow model, JVET test sequences, and common test conditions. Each sequence is converted from its source equirectangular projection to a coding projection, compressed at multiple rate points, reconstructed, and converted back. Performance is assessed using PSNR, spherical PSNR, weighted spherical PSNR, and Bjøntegaard delta rate. A differentiable pipeline combining projection conversion, neural compression, and inverse projection is also compared with 360Lib.
  Results show that equirectangular and padded equirectangular projections provide the highest compression efficiency with the scale-space flow model, while cubemap-based and rhombic dodecahedron projections are less effective. This differs from the conventional HM-16.16 codec, for which cubemap-based formats, particularly equi-angular and adjusted cubemap projections, outperform equirectangular formats. Neural models based on optical flow benefit from the spatial continuity of single-face projections, whereas block-based hybrid codecs better accommodate multi-face layouts. These findings show that projection efficiency is codec-dependent and provide guidance for selecting projections for learning-based 360-degree video compression.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了投影格式对360度视频端到端神经压缩的影响。使用scale-space flow模型评估了JVET 360Lib支持的七种投影格式，结果发现equirectangular和padded equirectangular投影对神经压缩最有效，而cubemap-based投影对传统HM-16.16编码器更优。
AI.motivation: 360度视频需先投影到二维平面才能进行编码，投影格式的选择会影响压缩效率，但目前缺乏投影格式对学习型神经压缩方法影响的研究。
AI.method: 使用scale-space flow神经压缩模型，对JVET测试序列的七种投影格式（equirectangular、padded equirectangular、cubemap-based及rhombic dodecahedron等）在不同码率点进行压缩，采用PSNR、spherical PSNR、weighted spherical PSNR和BD-rate评估性能，并与传统HM-16.16编码器对比。
AI.result: equirectangular和padded equirectangular投影在scale-space flow模型下压缩效率最高；cubemap-based和rhombic dodecahedron投影效率较低。这与传统HM-16.16编码器的结论相反，后者中cubemap-based格式表现更好。基于光流的神经模型受益于单面投影的空间连续性。
AI.conclusion: 投影格式的效率是编码器相关的，不能将传统编码器的投影选择经验直接迁移到学习型压缩方法中。该研究为基于学习的360度视频压缩的投影格式选择提供指导。

title: Evaluating Multilingual Sentence Embeddings for Translation Error Detection:An English--Greek Contrastive Study
summary:
Multilingual sentence embeddings are increasingly used to estimate semantic similarity across languages, yet their sensitivity to fine-grained translation errors remains insufficiently understood. This study investigates whether general-purpose multilingual embedding models can distinguish correct English-Greek translations from minimally modified erroneous alternatives. A contrastive dataset was developed from FLORES+ sentence-aligned reference translations and reviewed by two translation experts. It contains 1,850 examples across ten core and five exploratory error categories, covering factual, lexical-semantic, grammatical, relational, referential, and discourse-level phenomena.
  Five multilingual sentence-embedding models (BGE-M3, Multilingual E5, Multilingual MPNet, LaBSE, and Jina Embeddings v3) were evaluated using cosine similarity between each English source sentence and its correct and erroneous Greek translations. A reference-free COMETKiwi model was also evaluated as an MT quality-estimation baseline. Performance was assessed through contrastive accuracy and score margins for category-specific sensitivity. BGE-M3 achieved the highest accuracy among embedding models at 89.30 percent, while COMETKiwi achieved 94.49 percent. Embedding models detected explicit factual and lexical changes more reliably than tense-and-aspect and pronoun-coreference errors. COMETKiwi improved performance on several difficult categories, including tense and aspect, pronoun and coreference, and semantic-role errors, but showed lower sensitivity to date-and-time errors and underperformed the embedding models on numbers. The results show complementary error-sensitivity profiles: multilingual sentence embeddings provide useful semantic adequacy signals but are better suited as components of broader translation-evaluation frameworks than as standalone metrics.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了一个包含1,850个英语-希腊语翻译错误对比样本的数据集，评估了五种多语言句子嵌入模型和COMETKiwi在区分正确翻译与细微错误翻译方面的能力。BGE-M3以89.30%的准确率领先嵌入模型，而COMETKiwi达到94.49%。嵌入模型擅长检测事实性和词汇变化，但在时态体和代词共指错误上表现较弱，两种方法在错误敏感性方面呈现互补特性。
AI.motivation: 多语言句子嵌入被广泛用于跨语言语义相似度估计，但其对细粒度翻译错误的敏感性尚未得到充分理解，需要系统性地评估其区分正确与错误翻译的能力。
AI.method: 基于FLORES+平行语料开发对比数据集（由两位翻译专家审核，含1,850个样本、15个错误类别），使用余弦相似度评估五种多语言句子嵌入模型（BGE-M3、Multilingual E5、Multilingual MPNet、LaBSE、Jina Embeddings v3）及COMETKiwi基准模型，通过对比准确率和分数边际衡量类别敏感性。
AI.result: BGE-M3在嵌入模型中准确率最高（89.30%），COMETKiwi达到94.49%。嵌入模型对显性事实和词汇变化检测更可靠，对时态体和代词共指错误较弱；COMETKiwi在多个困难类别上表现更好，但对日期时间错误和数字错误敏感性较低。
AI.conclusion: 多语言句子嵌入和MT质量评估模型具有互补的错误敏感性特征，嵌入模型可提供有用的语义充分性信号，但更适合作为更广泛的翻译评估框架的组成部分，而非独立的评估指标。

title: Defending Wearable VLMs Against Private Attribute Inference
summary: Wearable VLM pipelines promise continuous multimodal assistance from egocentric visual capture: a user asks a task-driven question about the surrounding scene, and the system uses compact visual tokens to support language reasoning. The challenge motivating this work is that the same egocentric evidence needed for useful assistance can also reveal private attributes about the wearer or nearby bystanders. We investigate this as a joint privacy-utility problem for split VLM inference, where visual encoding occurs within a trusted device boundary but intermediate visual tokens may be transmitted to downstream reasoning components. This exposes an understudied leakage surface: even when final textual responses are benign, external attackers or untrusted downstream components can recover private attributes from transmitted visual tokens. To evaluate this tension, we construct a paired privacy-utility benchmark with 3,221 image-question records, each paired with a utility question and privacy labels covering location, income, sex, and interests. We further propose Token-Guided Attribute Privacy (TGAP), a pre-LLM token disentangler that learns a residual transformation of visual tokens before they leave the trusted boundary. TGAP combines utility preservation, identity regularization, semantic privacy suppression, and image-driven representation suppression, avoiding the utility loss caused by coarse hard or attention masking. On the benchmark used for source-model evaluation, TGAP reduces privacy accuracy from 56.7\% to 7.4\%, a 49.3\% absolute drop, while maintaining relaxed utility at 74.4\%. These results suggest that securing the compact token interface is a practical path toward privacy-preserving wearable multimodal AI.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了可穿戴VLM流水线中的隐私-效用权衡问题，指出中间视觉token在离开可信设备边界后可能泄露穿戴者及旁观者的隐私属性。作者构建了包含3,221条图像-问题记录的配对隐私-效用基准，并提出Token-Guided Attribute Privacy (TGAP)方法，通过在LLM前对视觉token进行残差变换来解耦隐私与效用，将隐私识别准确率从56.7%降至7.4%，同时保持74.4%的放松效用。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴视觉语言模型（VLM）流水线有望提供持续的多模态辅助，但同样的第一人称视觉证据既能用于有用的任务驱动回答，也可能泄露穿戴者或旁观者的隐私属性。现有工作忽视了中间视觉token这一潜在泄漏面——即使最终文本回复是无害的，外部攻击者或不可信的下游组件仍可从传输的视觉token中恢复隐私属性。
AI.method: 提出Token-Guided Attribute Privacy (TGAP)，一个置于LLM之前的token解缠器，在视觉token离开可信边界之前学习其残差变换。TGAP结合了效用保持、身份正则化、语义隐私抑制和图像驱动表示抑制四种目标，避免粗糙的硬掩码或注意力掩码带来的效用损失。同时构建了一个包含3,221条记录的配对隐私-效用基准，覆盖位置、收入、性别和兴趣四类隐私属性。
AI.result: 在源模型评估基准上，TGAP将隐私属性识别准确率从56.7%降至7.4%（绝对下降49.3%），同时将放松效用维持在74.4%。结果表明该方法能在保持任务效用的前提下有效抑制令牌层面的隐私泄漏。
AI.conclusion: 守护紧凑的token接口是迈向隐私保护型可穿戴多模态AI的实际可行路径。通过在设计层面解决token层面的隐私泄漏，可以在不牺牲实用性的情况下实现隐私保护，为可穿戴AI系统的隐私安全设计提供了新方向。

title: A rigor-matched audit of periodic-step layer skipping for efficient llm inference: conflayers versus swift, with a supplemental analysis of trained routing alternatives
summary: Layer-skipping methods for efficient LLM inference decide, at some granularity, which transformer layers to execute for a given input. We present a rigor-matched, three-seed audit of two periodic-step, search-based methods that make this decision online at inference time and re-evaluate it every few generation steps: a confidence-gated early-exit baseline (ConfLayers) and genuine self-speculative decoding (SWIFT, Xia et al. 2024), together with vanilla autoregressive decoding, across two model scales (Qwen2.5-0.5B and Qwen2.5-1.5B) and two tasks (GSM8K reasoning and CNN/DailyMail summarization). SWIFT is the strongest method on accuracy in three of four cells; ConfLayers is dominated everywhere, with particularly large deficits on GSM8K at 1.5B. Once online-search overhead is separated from pure inference cost, SWIFT's true inference speed is faster than ConfLayers's in all four cells (5-21%), reversing the naive wall-clock ranking in three of them. ConfLayers's search overhead is small and stable (1-2% of cost), while SWIFT's is larger and more variable (up to 28.7%). We additionally examine two trained-routing methods, LayerRoute (Sikdar, 2026) and LayerDrop (Fan et al. 2020), as a supplemental analysis because they operate at coarser decision granularities. Under a verified protocol with genuine per-input gating, a genuine full-model baseline, and genuine inference-time compute skipping, both show modest speedups (1.08-1.33x) but accuracy well below the periodic-step methods, including a near-total collapse for LayerRoute on GSM8K at 1.5B (0.003 mean exact-match across three seeds). We release the full audit protocol as a template for rigor-matched efficiency comparisons.

AI.tldr: 本文对两种在线层跳过高斯方法（置信门控提前退出ConfLayers和自投机解码SWIFT）及两种训练路由方法（LayerRoute和LayerDrop）进行严格匹配的三种子审计，评估它们在两个模型规模（Qwen2.5-0.5B/1.5B）和两个任务（GSM8K推理、CNN/DailyMail摘要）上的速度与精度表现。SWIFT在大多数场景下精度最佳，真实推理速度比ConfLayers快5-21%；ConfLayers在所有场景中被全面压制；两种训练路由方法速度提升有限（1.08-1.33x）但精度大幅下降，其中LayerRoute在GSM8K 1.5B上几乎完全崩溃（均值精确匹配0.003）。
AI.motivation: 层跳过高斯方法被广泛用于提升LLM推理效率，但现有研究缺乏严格匹配、可复现的审计框架，导致不同方法之间的对比结果可能受制于测量协议不一致、基线设置不公正等因素，难以可靠判断哪种方法真正更优。
AI.method: 采用三种子、严格匹配协议的审计方法，对比四种层跳过高斯方法：两种在线周期步进搜索方法（ConfLayers和SWIFT）以原生自回归解码为基�线，在两个模型规模和两个任务上进行评估；另补充两种训练路由方法（LayerRoute和LayerDrop）作为粗粒度决策的对照分析。关键改进在于分离在线搜索开销与纯推理成本，并采用真实的按输入门控、真实全模型基线和真实推理时计算跳过的验证协议。
AI.result: SWIFT在四个场景中的三个取得最佳精度；ConfLayers在所有场景均被压制，在GSM8K 1.5B上性能显著下降。分离搜索开销后，SWIFT的真实推理速度在所有四个场景中均快于ConfLayers（5-21%），在三个场景中逆转了朴素墙钟时间排名。ConfLayers的搜索开销小且稳定（占成本1-2%），而SWIFT的开销更大且波动明显（最高达28.7%）。训练路由方法LayerRoute和LayerDrop仅带来1.08-1.33x的适度加速，但精度远低于周期步进方法，LayerRoute在GSM8K 1.5B上近乎完全崩溃。
AI.conclusion: SWIFT是当前在线层跳过高斯方法中综合最优的选择，尤其在实际推理吞吐上优于ConfLayers；ConfLayers在精度与效率上均不具备竞争力。训练路由方法虽架构简单，但在精度上不可接受，尤其是LayerRoute在小规模模型上的推理任务表现出灾难性失败。作者发布了完整的审计协议，作为效率对比的标准模板。

title: Growing a Stand, Not a Tree: Joint Canopy Generation Reproduces Crown Shyness
summary: In closed forests, neighboring tree crowns often stop short of touching, leaving a network of narrow gaps known as crown shyness. The pattern belongs to the stand rather than to any single tree, which makes it a natural probe of a question in generative modeling: can a learned model produce a set of objects whose defining structure exists only between them? We formulate stand-level canopy generation as set generation with a flow-matching model, in which attention between trees is the only channel through which coupling can arise. Trained on stands grown by a resource-competition simulation that is provably not reducible to per-tree geometry, the joint model halves the clearance distribution error of an identical-capacity model that generates each tree alone, and the advantage persists at stem densities outside the training range. Against field measurements of a tropical oak forest, a single calibrated scalar yields held-out agreement in gap magnitude and crown asymmetry. The directional statistics of the gaps are controlled by stem placement rather than by the growth rule, and match the field once stem jitter is calibrated. Crown shyness, in both the simulation and the learned model, is a property of the stand and not of the tree.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用flow-matching集合生成模型来建模林冠羞避（crown shyness）现象，通过树间注意力机制实现树冠间的耦合，在模拟数据和真实热带栎林数据上均验证了模型的生成优势。
AI.motivation: 林冠羞避是林分层面的集体涌现结构，而非单棵树的属性。这引出一个生成建模的核心问题：学习模型能否生成一组对象，其定义性结构仅存在于对象之间？该问题挑战了传统的逐对象独立生成范式。
AI.method: 将林分冠层生成建模为集合生成任务，采用flow-matching模型，树与树之间的注意力机制是耦合产生的唯一通道。模型在资源竞争模拟生长的林分上训练，该模拟被证明不可约简为单树几何。用单一校准标量对照热带栎林实地测量数据进行验证。
AI.result: 联合模型将树冠间距（clearance）分布误差比相同容量但逐树独立生成的模型减半，且在训练范围外的茎密度下优势依然保持。对热带栎林的实地数据，单一校准标量即可获得间隙幅度和冠不对称性的留出集一致性；间隙方向统计由茎的位置决定而非生长规则，在校准茎抖动后与实地数据匹配。
AI.conclusion: 林冠羞避在模拟和学到的模型中都是林分层面的属性而非单树属性。间隙的方向统计由茎的放置控制，这揭示了集体结构涌现中对象间耦合与外部条件的作用，也为集合生成模型提供了有力的验证案例。

title: Latent-Space Intervention for Cross-Lingual Factual Consistency: Consistency Improvements without Accuracy Drops
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often answer the same factual question differently across languages. We study whether cross-lingual latent-space intervention can reduce this inconsistency. We train layer-specific autoencoders on parallel multilingual representations and apply inference-time corrections to factual QA prompts. We find that latent intervention improves geometric alignment between languages, and that this improvement translates into consistent gains in cross-lingual consistency with English across both open-ended and multiple-choice QA formats, without degrading factual accuracy. In open-ended QA, Spearman's rank correlation between English and non-English languages improves substantially, with gains of 0.16 for English-Arabic and 0.20 for English-Russian pairs. In multiple-choice QA, answer agreement with English improves consistently across both KLAR and mParaRel. Ablations show that AE reconstruction yields consistent gains at no accuracy cost, while PCA projection contributes marginally, and mean-shift produces substantially larger consistency gains in open-ended QA at the cost of some accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究通过跨语言潜在空间干预来减少大语言模型（LLM）在不同语言间回答同一事实性问题时的不一致性。作者训练层特定的自编码器对多语言并行表征进行干预，在推理时对事实问答提示进行修正。实验发现，潜在干预能改善语言间的几何对齐，并在开放式和多项选择问答中均显著提升与英语的跨语言一致性，且不损失事实准确性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在回答相同事实性问题时，不同语言版本往往给出不一致的答案，这种跨语言不一致性会削弱模型的可信度和实用性。现有研究缺乏对跨语言潜在空间干预是否能够有效缓解这一问题的系统性探索。
AI.method: 训练层特定的自编码器（autoencoders）处理多语言并行表征，并在推理时对事实问答提示施加干预修正。通过消融实验对比了自编码器重建（AE reconstruction）、PCA投影（PCA projection）和均值偏移（mean-shift）三种干预方式的效果。
AI.result: 潜在干预改善了语言间的几何对齐，并转化为跨语言一致性的持续提升。开放式中，英语-阿拉伯语的Spearman秩相关系数提升0.16，英语-俄语提升0.20；多项选择中，KLAR和mParaRel的答案一致性均持续改善。消融显示AE重建在无准确率损失下带来一致性收益，PCA投影贡献甚微，均值偏移在开放式中一致性增益更大但以部分准确率为代价。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言潜在空间干预是一种有效的缓解LLM跨语言回答不一致的方法，其中自编码器重建方法能在保持事实准确性的前提下实现一致性的显著提升，为未来跨语言对齐研究提供了可行的技术路径。

title: SNF-Bench: Separating Static Drift from Natural Flow in Long-Horizon Fixed-Camera Video Generation
summary: Long-horizon video generation is evaluated with whole-frame metrics that reward motion and temporal consistency. For fixed-camera nature scenes this creates an ambiguity: motion of water, fire, smoke, or rain is desirable, whereas motion of the background is an error. A system can therefore score well on motion while its scene drifts, or on consistency while its flow stagnates. We introduce SNF-Bench, an evaluation framework for long-horizon fixed-camera generation that partitions each scene into static support and dynamic flow and reports static fidelity, flow persistence with absolute magnitude, and drift leakage separately, never as one score. Drift leakage is interpretive context rather than a headline measurement. Each factor is validated mechanistically rather than by correlation with preference: we inject global translation, rotation, and scale drift and progressive late freezing at known severity into real generations, and require each factor to respond in its stated direction and to remain selective against corruptions it does not target. Auditing publicly released long-horizon text-conditioned checkpoints under one recorded common inference configuration, plus an image-conditioned track with released-pipeline references and a deployment-sensitivity panel, we find that whole-frame motion and static-region drift induce near-opposite orderings of the same outputs. At maximum controlled translation, fBD and NBF rise to $1.86\times$ and $1.32\times$ baseline, but whole-frame Dynamic Degree reaches only $1.07\times$---rewarding the corruption. SNF-Bench measures where motion occurs and whether it persists; it does not measure physical realism. Project page: https://minar09.github.io/snfbench/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SNF-Bench，一个面向固定相机长时程视频生成的评估框架，将场景划分为静态支撑和动态流，分别报告静态保真度、流持久性（含绝对幅度）和漂移泄漏，而非单一分数。通过机械性验证而非偏好相关性来校验各指标的响应方向性和选择性。
AI.motivation: 现有长时程视频生成评估使用整帧指标，在固定相机自然场景中存在歧义：水、火、烟、雨等动态元素的运动是期望的，而背景运动是错误。这导致系统可以在运动评分上表现良好但场景漂移，或在一致性评分上表现良好但运动停滞，传统指标无法区分这两种情况。
AI.method: SNF-Bench将场景分解为静态支撑和动态流，分别报告三个独立指标：静态保真度、流持久性（含绝对幅度）和漂移泄漏（作为解释性上下文而非头条指标）。每个指标通过机械性验证：向真实生成结果注入已知严重程度的全局平移/旋转/缩放漂移和渐进式晚期冻结，要求各指标响应方向正确且对不针对的损坏保持选择性。
AI.result: 审计公开发布的长时程文本条件模型（同一推理配置）及图像条件赛道后发现：整帧运动和静态区域漂移对同一输出产生几乎相反的排序。在最大控制平移下，fBD和NBF上升到基线的1.86倍和1.32倍，但整帧Dynamic Degree仅达1.07倍——即传统指标反而奖励了损坏。
AI.conclusion: SNF-Bench通过分离测量运动发生位置及其持久性来弥补传统整帧指标的不足；但需注意它衡量的是运动的位置与持久性，而非物理真实性。

title: No Detectable Change in Side-Level WER from Prompt-Level Context: A Preregistered Ablation on a Production Oral-History Corpus
comment: 31 pages, 1 figure. Preregistered on OSF (https://osf.io/ns49b, DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/NS49B); release materials and dated provider-documentation snapshots in the study component (https://osf.io/9nsvr)
summary: Supplying context at inference time to a large multimodal model is an inexpensive lever for adapting speech transcription to a domain, and earlier results on smaller models reported large gains. This work tested that mechanism where it ships, in the prompt-conditioning layer of a production oral-history transcription tool, on a sample from its own production corpus. Full prompt-level context did not detectably change side-level word error rate (WER), and none of the four preregistered hypotheses was supported. The design was a within-item paired ablation, preregistered with the analysis code frozen by hash before the confirmatory batch was scored; two disclosed gpt-4o pilot sides had been scored earlier, during scorer development. Nineteen cassette sides, about 10.6 hours of degraded 1970s-80s interview audio, were reprocessed through the production code path under three prompt arms, crossed with two deployed commercial configurations, gpt-4o-transcribe and gemini-2.5-flash, and scored against operator-corrected verbatim references. For gpt-4o-transcribe the median paired difference between the full-context and no-context arms was +0.6 WER points, with a side-resampled interval of [-1.1, +1.0]; the Gemini estimates were too unstable to support a comparable negative inference. A post-hoc rerun found run-to-run pipeline variability larger than the confirmatory differences, so effects of that size cannot be resolved from one transcription per cell. An implementation audit verified the manipulation was live, and sequence-alignment analysis found a small improvement on complete context-listed phrases, too small to materially change side-level WER, and for Gemini coexisting with worsened unlisted-token error. Evaluating context mechanisms therefore requires sequence-aligned term-level, insertion, and speaker-label measures alongside aggregate accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本研究在生产级口述历史转录工具中测试了推理时提示词上下文对多模态大模型转录性能的影响，结果发现完整的提示词上下文并未显著改变词错误率（WER），四个预注册假设均未得到支持。
AI.motivation: 过往研究在较小模型上报告了提示词上下文对语音转录的显著改进，但该机制在生产环境中的实际效果尚未得到验证。本研究旨在检测该机制在真实生产流水线中的表现。
AI.method: 采用项目内配对消融设计，对19盘磁带（约10.6小时1970-80年代劣质访谈音频）进行重处理，在三种提示词条件下交叉两种商业配置（gpt-4o-transcribe和gemini-2.5-flash），与操作员校正的逐字参考进行评分。分析代码预设并用哈希冻结，并进行了实施审计和序列比对分析。
AI.result: gpt-4o-transcribe的全上下文与无上下文配对中位差为+0.6 WER点（区间[-1.1, +1.0]），未达显著水平；Gemini估计不稳定。事后重跑发现管道运行间变异性大于确认性差异，序列比对发现对完整上下文列出短语仅有小幅改进。
AI.conclusion: 在生产规模下，提示词上下文机制对整体WER无可检测的改善，评估上下文机制需要结合序列对齐的术语级、插入和说话人标签指标，而非仅依赖聚合准确率。

title: Weaving Visual Narratives: Agentic Image Bundle Composition Beyond Atomic Visual Matching
summary: Image retrieval has traditionally been formulated as a point-wise matching problem, where each candidate image is scored in isolation. However, this atomic paradigm fails to capture the complexity of human search intent within personal photo collections, where users often seek compact visual stories bound by structural relations rather than isolated snapshots. To address this limitation, we introduce **Image Bundle Composition (IBC)**, a novel paradigm that shifts the objective from ranking individual images to dynamically composing cohesive image bundles from a massive, unstructured photo pool. Since target bundles are not predefined, IBC presents a severe combinatorial explosion challenge and demands modeling non-decomposable joint relevance. To establish this paradigm, we construct **IBCBench**, the first IBC benchmark dataset containing 109,467 images and 667 verified queries, built via a semi-automated verification pipeline. Furthermore, we propose **BundleWeaver**, an agentic framework that reformulates IBC as query-conditioned incremental hyperedge discovery. By employing a Large Language Model to adaptively search for missing relational roles and utilizing a Vision-Language Model for whole-bundle verification, BundleWeaver effectively navigates the combinatorial space. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while state-of-the-art embedding models and static decompose-and-rerank paradigms suffer from relational blindness, BundleWeaver achieves substantial performance gains, highlighting the necessity of shifting from atomic scoring to dynamic relational composition. Our dataset and code are available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出图像捆绑组合（IBC）这一新范式，将图像检索从逐点匹配转向动态组合连贯的图像捆绑，并构建了首个IBC基准数据集IBCBench以及代理式框架BundleWeaver，实验证明其在处理关系驱动的视觉故事检索中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统图像检索以逐点匹配方式对每个候选图像独立评分，但这种原子化范式无法捕捉个人照片库中用户搜索意图的复杂性——用户往往寻找由结构关系约束的紧凑视觉故事，而非孤立快照。现有方法存在关系盲区，无法建模非可分解的联合相关性。
AI.method: 论文提出BundleWeaver代理框架，将IBC重新表述为查询条件下的增量超边发现问题。具体而言，利用大型语言模型（LLM）自适应搜索缺失的关系角色，并采用视觉-语言模型（VLM）进行整体捆绑验证，从而有效导航组合爆炸空间。同时构建IBCBench数据集，包含109,467张图片和667个经过验证的查询，采用半自动验证流水线建立。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，最先进的嵌入模型和静态分解-重排范式存在关系盲区，而BundleWeaver取得了显著的性能提升，证明了从原子评分向动态关系组合转变的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 从逐点匹配到动态关系组合的范式转变对图像检索至关重要，BundleWeaver的成功验证了代理式方法在处理组合爆炸和联合相关性建模方面的有效性，数据集和代码已公开以供后续研究。

title: Moving the Mean Toward the Known Good, Not Beyond It: What Inference-Time Interventions and Weight Consolidation Buy in Open-Ended Generation
summary: What does a generation loop gain from learning on its own verified successes? In cycles of generate, verify, select and LoRA-consolidate on online bin packing, training on value-filtered candidates shifts what the model writes on held-out variants toward value (-1.7 points of excess, p=0.008; -3.1 against a random-consolidation control, p=0.004) while the best observed candidate converges to the classic heuristic's level and no further. A confirmation battery replicates the whole procedure three times, with fresh seeds and a never-consulted held-out set read exactly once: the mean was nearly identical in all three lineages (-2.0, -1.8, -1.9), and after aggregating within held-out variant all seven evaluable variants favored consolidation (p=0.008). The best observed candidate moved to the classic heuristic's level, exactly (0.021028 in all three lineages, for attract and for the random control alike), and never beyond it. A matched SFT-only control shows the supervised anchor, not repulsion from bad candidates, does the concentrating (96% of candidates land exactly at the classic heuristic's level). The tails cut both ways: consolidation lowers the per-candidate rate of better-than-classic candidates (10% to 3.9%) while its larger production yields more such candidates absolutely (5 against 1, on few events). As motivation we report the inference-time ledger that led here: a model-written schematic recap buys judged document integration and nothing buys development; a verifier written into the stream is imitated, 16.4 fabricated verdict lines per notebook. Mean quality among valid candidates can be bought and replicated; the observed best goes to the classic and, so far, never beyond it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"生成-验证-选择-LoRA整合"这一自我改进循环在在线装箱问题上的效果。结果显示：基于价值过滤的候选训练能显著提升模型在保留集变体上的表现（超额值下降1.7点，p=0.008），但最佳观测候选收敛到经典启发式水平后不再突破。三次重复实验确认了可复现性，而配对SFT对照表明是监督锚定而非对坏样本的排斥驱动了收敛。压缩后每候选更好-于-经典的比例下降（10%至3.9%），但绝对数量因产量增大而增加。
AI.motivation: 探索生成循环通过自身验证成功的样本进行学习能获得什么收益，检验自我改进循环在组合优化任务中是否有效、可复现，以及其改进的边界在哪里。
AI.method: 采用"生成-验证-选择-LoRA整合"循环：模型生成候选解，用价值函数过滤（value-filtered），选择高质量候选进行LoRA微调整合，如此迭代。对照条件包括随机整合控制（random-consolidation control）、配对SFT-only控制，并执行三次独立种子重复验证实验，使用从未查阅的保留集评估。
AI.result: 价值过滤训练在保留集变体上显著优于随机对照（超额降3.1点，p=0.004），三次重复均值几乎一致（-2.0, -1.8, -1.9）。七个可评估变体全部偏向整合（p=0.008）。最佳观测候选精确收敛到经典启发式水平（0.021028），不再超越。SFT对照表明监督锚定起主要作用（96%候选恰好落在经典启发式水平）。更好-于-经典候选比例从10%降至3.9%，但绝对数量从1增至5。
AI.conclusion: 自我改进循环能可靠地买到并复制平均质量提升，但最佳观测候选只能到达经典启发式水平，尚未突破其上限。改进机制主要来自监督锚定而非排斥坏候选。

title: Instruction Distillation: Text Instructions as Visual Examples
summary: Visual in-context learning (ICL) with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is effective for fine-grained visual classification, but each retrieved image example consumes several hundred context tokens, making large-$K$ settings prohibitively expensive at inference scale. We propose Instruction Distillation: an offline procedure in which the MLLM itself generates, for each individual training image, a structured identification instruction encoding general appearance cues, features that differentiate the class from visually similar ones, and a common confusion point. Unlike prior work that produces a single description per class, our instructions are generated per training image, preserving the intra-class visual diversity that per-class descriptions collapse. At inference time, we study five configurations sharing a single CLIP retrieval index: zero-shot, image ICL, instruction-only ICL, and two hybrid variants in which retrieved neighbors are split between images and instructions. Across seven fine-grained benchmarks and two MLLM backbones, instruction based pipelines match, or exceeds image ICL at $K{=}1$ and reduces per-query tokens by $2.9\times$ and inference latency by $3.3\times$ at $K{=}5$. Hybrid configurations further show that visual and textual ICL signals are complementary, images give visual patterns to learn and see, while instructions give explicit rules and logic. When both of these are provided, the quality of context improves, which is noticeable in the performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出指令蒸馏（Instruction Distillation）方法，通过让多模态大语言模型（MLLM）为每张训练图片生成结构化的识别指令，在推理时用文本指令替代图像示例进行上下文学习，在保持或超越图像ICL性能的同时，大幅降低token消耗和推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型的视觉上下文学习虽然对细粒度图像分类有效，但每张检索到的图像示例会消耗数百个上下文token，在大K设置下推理成本过高，亟需一种更高效的方式来传递上下文信息。
AI.method: 提出指令蒸馏：一个离线流程，让MLLM为每张训练图像生成结构化识别指令，包含通用外观线索、与相似类别的区分特征以及常见混淆点。指令按训练图像逐一生成，保留类内视觉多样性。推理时研究五种配置：零样本、图像ICL、仅指令ICL、以及两种图像和指令混合的变体，共享单一CLIP检索索引。
AI.result: 在7个细粒度基准和2个MLLM骨干网络上，指令管道在K=1时匹配或超越图像ICL，在K=5时每查询token减少2.9倍，推理延迟降低3.3倍。混合配置进一步证明视觉和文本ICL信号具有互补性。
AI.conclusion: 视觉和文本ICL信号是互补的：图像提供视觉模式和可观察的特征，指令提供显式的规则和逻辑。当两者同时提供时，上下文质量提升，在性能上表现明显。

title: VoiceCodeBench: Evaluating Exact Structured-Token Recovery in Automatic Speech Recognition
summary:
Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems are commonly evaluated with word error rate (WER), yet many voice workflows depend on exact written values for identifiers, paths, and measured quantities. A transcript can appear fluent and achieve low WER while corrupting a value that a downstream system must parse, store, or execute.
  We introduce VoiceCodeBench, a benchmark for evaluating exact structured-token recovery in English ASR. It contains 300 human-recorded workplace segments spanning eight workflow domains and 1,482 audited target entities across 26 entity types, each with a canonical written form recoverable from the audio. Under a raw-audio-only protocol, systems receive audio bytes without additional context or metadata. Alongside WER, we evaluate Canonical Token/Entity Match (CTEM), Task Success Rate (TSR), and per-type exact recovery.
  Across 12 baseline ASR systems, lower WER generally corresponded to better structured-token recovery but did not fully determine it: Spearman correlations were -0.73 for both WER versus CTEM and WER versus TSR. The strongest baseline by TSR reached only 68.7%, leaving nearly one third of recordings with at least one unrecovered workflow-critical value. These results show that entity-sensitive metrics are needed to assess whether ASR output preserves exact values that production systems must parse, route, store, compare, or execute.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了VoiceCodeBench基准，用于评估英语ASR系统在精确结构化token恢复方面的能力。该基准包含300段人类录音、1482个经审计的目标实体，涵盖26种实体类型。实验表明，WER与结构化token恢复存在相关性（Spearman相关系数为-0.73），但最强的基线系统TSR仅达68.7%，说明需要实体敏感的评估指标来确保ASR输出保留下游系统所需的精确值。
AI.motivation: 传统ASR评估主要依赖WER，但许多语音工作流依赖对标识符、路径和测量量等精确书面值的解析。一个看起来流畅的转录可能在下游系统中破坏关键值，因此需要评估精确结构化token恢复能力的基准。
AI.method: 构建VoiceCodeBench基准，包含300段工作场景录音、1482个目标实体、26种实体类型。采用raw-audio-only协议，系统仅接收音频字节而无额外上下文。评估指标包括WER、CTEM、TSR及按类型的精确恢复率。
AI.result: 对12个基线ASR系统的评估显示，WER与CTEM和TSR的Spearman相关系数均为-0.73，WER越低通常对应更好的结构化token恢复，但并非完全决定。最强基线TSR仅68.7%，近三分之一录音存在至少一个未恢复的工作流关键值。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，仅依赖WER不足以评估ASR在生产场景中的实际可用性，需要引入实体敏感的评估指标来衡量ASR输出是否能保留下游系统必须解析、路由、存储、比较或执行的精确值。

title: State-Conditioned Visual Evidence Retrieval for Fine-Grained Perception in Document Vision-Language Models
summary: Compared with typical vision-language tasks, document parsing places stronger demands on fine-grained visual perception. Existing vision-language model (VLM)-based parsing approaches rely on globally compressed visual tokens, where fine-grained details are entangled within a single representation and repeatedly accessed during decoding. However, we observe that the visual evidence for each prediction is typically localized and conditioned on the current decoding state, whereas such representations must be accessed in full at every decoding step, resulting in inefficient computation. To address this mismatch, we formulate perception as state-conditioned visual evidence retrieval (SCVER) during autoregressive decoding. The model operates on a compact global representation for coarse structure and retrieves a small set of relevant high-resolution regions conditioned on the current token state. This coarse-to-fine design enables on-demand access to fine-grained visual cues, relieving globally shared representations from encoding all fine-grained details. We further find that learning such state-conditioned retrieval in VLMs is challenging and unstable. To stabilize this process, we introduce a Spatially-Guided Learning Objective (SGLO) to guide the retrieval process. Experiments on document parsing benchmarks show that SCVER improves robustness under reduced input resolution and achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off, demonstrating the effectiveness of on-demand visual evidence retrieval for fine-grained perception.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCVER方法，将文档解析中的视觉感知建模为状态条件化的视觉证据检索，在自回归解码过程中按需获取细粒度高分辨率区域，并通过SGLO稳定训练过程，在降低输入分辨率的情况下仍能提升解析鲁棒性和精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 文档解析相比常规视觉-语言任务对细粒度视觉感知要求更高。现有的基于VLM的解析方法依赖全局压缩的视觉token，细粒度细节被纠缠在单一表示中并在解码时被反复访问，导致计算效率低下。作者观察到每次预测的视觉证据实际上是局部化的且取决于当前解码状态，而现有表示必须在每个解码步骤中完整访问，存在计算不匹配的问题。
AI.method: 提出SCVER（状态条件化视觉证据检索）框架：模型在紧凑的全局表示上处理粗粒度结构，根据当前token状态检索少量相关的高分辨率区域。采用粗到细的设计，按需访问细粒度视觉线索，避免全局表示编码所有细粒度细节。为应对状态条件化检索学习的不稳定性，引入空间引导学习目标（SGLO）来指导检索过程。
AI.result: 在文档解析基准上的实验表明，SCVER在降低输入分辨率的情况下依然提升了鲁棒性，并取得了更好的精度-效率权衡，验证了按需视觉证据检索对细粒度感知的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 按需检索式视觉证据获取相比全局压缩表示的反复访问更具效率和鲁棒性，为VLM在细粒度文档解析任务上提供了更优的范式。

title: Causal Interventions Reveal Typologically Organized Syntactic Mechanisms in Multilingual Language Models
summary: Linguistic theory has long recognized cross-linguistic syntactic regularities, leading to claims that these similar structures are processed by similar mechanisms. However, this hypothesis has been difficult to test empirically due to our lack of fine-grained, manipulable access of human processing mechanisms. In this work, we take advantage of techniques from mechanistic interpretability to study such a question in multilingual LMs. We first isolate language-internal mechanisms before attempting to transfer them cross-lingually. Across four models and three well-studied constructions (subject--verb number agreement, anaphoric pronoun gender agreement, and filler--gap object extraction) we find consistent cross-lingual mechanism transfer. We further find transfer to be graded, with more transfer between more typologically similar languages. We believe our work provides novel hypotheses about cross-linguistic syntactic structures and multilingual processing, and more broadly shows how the study of language models can help inform linguistic theory.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用机械可解释性技术，在多种多语言语言模型中研究跨语言句法处理机制是否一致。研究发现四种模型和三种句法结构中存在一致的跨语言机制迁移，且迁移程度与语言类型学相似性呈梯度关系。
AI.motivation: 语言学理论长期认为跨语言存在句法规则性，相似结构由相似机制处理。但该假说因缺乏对人工处理机制的细粒度操控手段而难以实证检验。作者希望利用机械可解释性方法在多语言语言模型中检验此假说。
AI.method: 首先在单个语言内部隔离出语言内部的处理机制，然后尝试跨语言迁移这些机制。研究覆盖四种模型和三种经典句法结构：主谓数一致、代词性别一致、填充词—空位宾语提取。通过比较跨语言间的机制相似性来测试迁移。
AI.result: 在四种模型和三种句法结构中均发现一致的跨语言机制迁移；进一步发现迁移是梯度性的，类型学上更相似的语言之间机制迁移更多。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为跨语言句法结构和多语言处理提供了新假说，并展示了语言模型研究可为语言学理论提供实证支持。

title: Beyond Visual Boundaries: Rethinking Scene Segmentation for Movie RAG
summary: Understanding long-form video remains a fundamental challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Sparse frame sampling fails to capture fine-grained visual details, while dense sampling quickly exceeds context length limits. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) offers a promising middle ground by selectively retrieving relevant video segments for grounded generation, yet its effectiveness critically depends on the quality of the video segments used as retrieval units. In this paper, we investigate RAG for movie understanding, which demands story-level reasoning over characters, events, and narrative arcs spanning hours of content. Scene segmentation, a long-studied problem that partitions movies into semantically coherent units, is a natural candidate for defining such retrieval units. We reexamine whether existing methods actually serve this role through comprehensive evaluation on downstream movie understanding tasks, and find that they consistently fail to outperform naive uniform temporal chunking. Our audit of the most standard scene segmentation benchmarks reveals why: current annotations prioritize visually salient transitions over narrative event structure. Motivated by this mismatch, we introduce NarraScene, a narrative-centric scene segmentation dataset annotated with a three-level cognitive taxonomy spanning physical, character, and narrative change, where every valid boundary requires a narrative-level shift. When used as retrieval units, these narrative-grounded segments outperform uniform chunking on downstream movie understanding tasks, suggesting that the central challenge for scene segmentation in movie RAG is not detecting boundaries, but identifying the narrative event units that matter for movie understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文研究电影理解中的检索增强生成（RAG）问题，发现现有场景分割方法在作为检索单元时无法优于朴素均匀时间分块，原因是现有基准偏向视觉显著过渡而非叙事事件结构。作者提出NarraScene数据集，基于三层认知分类法（物理、角色、叙事变化）标注叙事中心的场景分割，将其用作检索单元后在下游电影理解任务上表现优于均匀分块。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解对多模态大语言模型仍具挑战，稀疏采样丢失细节、密集采样超出上下文限制。RAG通过检索相关视频片段提供折中方案，但其效果取决于检索单元的质量。电影理解需要跨数小时的叙事级推理，而场景分割作为自然候选检索单元，其有效性尚未被系统验证。
AI.method: 首先对现有场景分割方法在下游电影理解任务上进行全面评估，发现其均未能超越均匀时间分块。进一步审计标准场景分割基准，揭示其标注优先考虑视觉显著性过渡而非叙事事件结构。基于此发现，构建NarraScene数据集，采用三层次认知分类法（物理变化、角色变化、叙事变化），要求每个有效边界必须包含叙事层面的转变。
AI.result: 以叙事为导向的场景分割单元在作为检索单元时，在下游电影理解任务上优于均匀分块方法，证明其检索单元质量确实影响RAG性能。
AI.conclusion: 电影RAG中场景分割的核心挑战不在于边界检测，而在于识别对电影理解真正重要的叙事事件单元。

title: Leveraging Turn-taking Dynamics for Intent Recognition in Multi-party Conversations
comment: Accepted for publication at EMNLP Industry Track 2026
summary: We propose a multi-task learning approach for multi-party dialogue intent recognition that leverages an auxiliary task that models turn-taking dynamics. Specifically, we introduce turn-transition entropy, a self-supervised target computed from the sequence of speaker transitions, which quantifies the predictability of interaction patterns. Experiments on multiple pre-trained models demonstrate that incorporating this auxiliary task improves intent recognition performance, outperforming existing approaches which ignore multi-party interaction dynamics. We find that our proposed continuous target can be learned as a single-task objective, suggesting that it is an actual signal carrying useful information.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种多任务学习方法，通过辅助任务建模多轮对话中的话轮转换动态（引入话轮转换熵作为自监督目标），来提升多参与方对话意图识别的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的多参与方对话意图识别方法忽略了对话中的交互动态信息，即说话者之间的转换模式，而这些模式可能蕴含着有助于意图识别的有用信号。
AI.method: 采用多任务学习框架，在主要意图识别任务之外引入辅助任务。辅助任务使用话轮转换熵作为自监督学习目标，该指标从说话者转换序列中计算得出，用于量化交互模式的可预测性。
AI.result: 在多个预训练模型上的实验表明，加入该辅助任务能够提升意图识别性能，优于忽略多参与方交互动态的现有方法。此外，话轮转换熵可以作为单任务目标独立学习，说明它确实携带有效信息。
AI.conclusion: 话轮转换动态（交互模式可预测性）是一个有价值的信号，通过多任务学习引入该辅助任务可以有效提升多参与方对话意图识别的准确率。

title: TopoAgent: A Structure-Aware Perception-to-Reasoning Framework for Diagram-to-Graph Topology Extraction with Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Diagram-to-graph topology extraction aims to extract a graph of entities and their connections from a structural diagram. This task remains challenging for current vision-language models because it requires both fine-grained perceptual grounding and topology-aware reasoning with global consistency. We present TopoBench-180, a human-verified benchmark for diagram-to-graph topology extraction, and TopoAgent, a structure-aware perception-to-reasoning framework for reliable topology extraction using large vision-language models. TopoBench-180 contains 180 structural diagrams spanning Web-style and Network-style categories, paired with canonical graph annotations. TopoAgent progressively extracts the target graph by combining grounded perception, global structural priors, canonical node inventory construction, node-centric local-to-global relation reasoning, and topological consistency enforcement. Experiments on TopoBench-180 show that TopoAgent outperforms strong vision-language model baselines and recent visual reasoning frameworks, especially on edge extraction. More broadly, this work fills an important gap in multimodal structured understanding by establishing a benchmark and framework for diagram-to-graph topology extraction. The benchmark and associated resources will be publicly released at https://huggingface.co/datasets/WayneGuo0011/TopoBench-180.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TopoBench-180基准数据集和TopoAgent框架，用于解决从结构图中提取实体及连接关系的拓扑图提取任务。TopoAgent通过融合接地感知、全局结构先验、标准节点库构建和局部到全局的关系推理，显著提升了边提取的准确性。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型在图表到图谱的拓扑提取任务中面临双重挑战：既需要细粒度的感知定位能力，又需要具备全局一致性的拓扑感知推理能力，而现有方法难以同时满足这两个要求。
AI.method: 提出TopoAgent框架，采用渐进式提取策略，整合以下模块：接地感知、全局结构先验、标准节点库构建、以节点为中心的局部到全局关系推理，以及拓扑一致性约束，并构建了包含180个结构图的TopoBench-180人工验证基准。
AI.result: 在TopoBench-180上的实验表明，TopoAgent在边提取任务上显著优于强视觉语言模型基线和现有视觉推理框架。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了多模态结构化理解领域的空白，为图表到图谱的拓扑提取任务提供了标准化基准和有效框架，相关资源将公开发布。

title: The Hallucination Signal Is a Mean Shift: Why Simple Probes Suffice
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 20 tables. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). Code: https://github.com/js-lee-AI/LayerMix
summary: Hidden-state probes effectively detect LLM hallucinations, but the geometry of the signal remains poorly characterized, driving increasingly complex probe architectures. Across three 7B-scale models and three datasets in a paired-example paradigm, we find the signal overwhelmingly dominated by a single mean-shift component, and removing this direction collapses detection to chance. Shrinkage linear discriminant analysis closes about 73% of the gap between 1D and full-dimensional classifiers, so apparent architectural complexity largely reflects high-dimensional covariance estimation difficulty rather than exploitable non-linearity. A simple L2-regularized logistic regression (0.952 AUROC) bounds or outperforms twelve controlled architectural alternatives, and our multi-layer aggregation exceeds CLAP cross-layer attention probing under matched paradigm. Because the signal spans a contiguous layer band, LayerMix aggregates it to match oracle-layer performance without oracle access. Our claims characterize the geometry within the controlled paired-example paradigm. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/LayerMix.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLM幻觉检测的隐状态信号主要由单一均值偏移分量主导，去除该方向后检测能力崩溃。在配对样本范式下，简单L2正则化逻辑回归的性能优于或持平12种受控架构，多层级聚合方法LayerMix无需oracle即可达到oracle层性能。
AI.motivation: 隐状态探针能有效检测LLM幻觉，但信号的几何结构尚未被充分刻画，这导致探针架构越来越复杂。作者希望弄清幻觉检测信号的几何本质，以判断复杂架构是否真的必要。
AI.method: 在三个7B规模模型和三个数据集上采用配对样本范式，使用收缩线性判别分析、L2正则化逻辑回归与12种受控架构对比，并引入LayerMix多层级聚合方法。
AI.result: 幻觉检测信号由单一均值偏移方向主导；移除该方向后检测降至随机水平；收缩LDA可缩小约73%的1D与全维分类器差距；简单L2逻辑回归达到0.952 AUROC，优于或持平12种架构；LayerMix达到oracle层性能。
AI.conclusion: 幻觉检测信号的表观架构复杂性主要源于高维协方差估计困难而非可利用的非线性结构，简单线性和正则化方法即可高效检测幻觉。

title: Stochastic Liquid Deformation Fields: An SDE Generalisation of Closed-Form Continuous-Time Cells for Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting (D-3DGS) reconstructs dynamic scenes by deforming a canonical set of 3D Gaussians through a deformation field of frame time. Replacing its MLP with a stack of Closed-form Continuous-time (CfC) cells-a Liquid Neural Network that solves the Liquid Timeconstant ODE in closed form-gives the field continuous-time behaviour at feed-forward cost. That closed form, however, is only the deterministic limit of a noise-driven system, and drops the stochastic term usually credited for the robustness of liquid networks. We put it back: a small Gaussian perturbation is added to the time gate of every CfC cell, turning the deterministic field into a simple stochastic (SDE) one. The noise is used only during training, needs no solver, and reduces exactly to the CfC when switched off. On the synthetic D-NeRF scenes the stochastic field is on par with the deterministic CfC and beats the MLP baseline on most scenes; on the real-world NeRF-DS scenes the deterministic limit is already best and adding noise does not help. The study thus gives both a clean way to read the CfC field as an SDE and an honest account of when a plain noise term helps and when it does not.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将可变形3D高斯泼溅（D-3DGS）中的MLP替换为基于闭式连续时间（CfC）液体神经网络的结构，并在其时间门控中加入高斯随机扰动，将确定性场转化为简单的随机微分方程（SDE）场。噪声仅在训练时使用，关闭后精确还原为CfC。实验表明：在合成D-NeRF场景中，随机场与确定性CfC相当且优于MLP；在真实世界NeRF-DS场景中，确定性CfC已是最优，噪声无额外帮助。
AI.motivation: 现有D-3DGS使用MLP作为形变场，缺乏连续时间行为；而CfC虽具备闭式解并可前馈计算，但其闭式解仅是噪声驱动系统的确定性极限，丢弃了液体网络鲁棒性所依赖的随机项。作者希望恢复该随机项以提升性能。
AI.method: 将D-3DGS中的MLP替换为CfC细胞堆栈；在每个CfC细胞的时间门控上添加小幅度高斯扰动，将确定性形变场转变为随机微分方程（SDE）形式。噪声仅在训练阶段使用，无需额外求解器，关闭后精确退化为标准CfC。
AI.result: 在合成D-NeRF场景中，随机CfC场与确定性CfC性能相当，且在多数场景上优于MLP基线；在真实世界NeRF-DS场景中，确定性CfC已取得最佳效果，添加噪声并未带来提升。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为CfC形变场提供了清晰的SDE解释框架，并诚实评估了噪声项的应用边界——在部分场景中有效，在其他场景中无效，为后续动态场景重建中液体网络的设计提供了参考。

title: VocalAffectBench: Evaluating Vocal Emotion Recognition in AI Audio Models
comment: 6 pages, 6 tables. Benchmark, baseline predictions, and aggregate results are publicly available
summary: Voice products increasingly need affective cues that are present in speech but absent from transcripts. We introduce VocalAffectBench, a public, test-only benchmark for evaluating whether AI audio models can identify expressed vocal emotion from raw audio. The benchmark contains 273 human-recorded English WAV clips from 51 speaker accounts totaling 1.95 hours across seven labels: angry, disgusted, fearful, happy, neutral, sad, and surprised, with 39 clips per class. All baselines are evaluated from audio alone, without transcripts or contextual metadata. Across six released baselines, average accuracy is 35.5%. The strongest baseline, gemini_3_5_flash, reaches 46.5% on the seven-way task, above the 14.3% random baseline but far from robust emotion recognition. A secondary valence-bucket analysis maps labels into positive, neutral, and negative classes, excluding surprised because its valence is ambiguous. Aggregate accuracy under this coarser view is 50.9%. Performance is highly uneven across classes. By recall, neutral is identified most reliably at 75.6% averaged across baselines, while surprised and fearful reach only 10.7% and 15.4%, respectively. These results show that the evaluated baselines can extract some affective signal from speech, but discrete expressed-emotion recognition remains fragile, especially for non-neutral emotions that are often most important in voice agent workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了VocalAffectBench，一个公开的仅测试用基准数据集，用于评估AI音频模型从原始音频中识别语音情感的能力。包含273个人声录制的英语WAV片段，覆盖7种情感标签。评估显示最强基线模型仅达到46.5%的准确率（随机基线14.3%），表明离散情感识别仍然脆弱。
AI.motivation: 语音产品越来越需要音频中存在的但转录文本中缺失的情感线索，而现有评估缺乏专门的基准来检验AI音频模型从原始音频中识别表达性语音情感的能力。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含273个人声录制的英语WAV片段的测试专用基准，来自51个说话者账户，总计1.95小时，覆盖7种情感标签（愤怒、厌恶、恐惧、快乐、中性、悲伤、惊讶），每类39个片段。所有基线仅从音频评估，无转录或上下文元数据，另设计了一个二级效价桶分析将标签映射为积极、中性和消极三类。
AI.result: 六个基线的平均准确率为35.5%，最强基线gemini_3_5_flash达到46.5%的七分类准确率。效价桶分析下聚合准确率为50.9%。召回率方面，中性的识别最可靠（75.6%），而惊讶（10.7%）和恐惧（15.4%）的召回率极低。
AI.conclusion: 评估的基线能够从语音中提取一定的情感信号，但离散表达性情感识别仍然脆弱，尤其是非中性情感——而这些情感在语音智能体工作流中往往是最重要的。

title: Variable-Granularity Tokenization for High-Resolution Object Detection
summary: ViT detectors fix a uniform token grid before any learned stage. A native-resolution aerial detector must then choose between resolving few-pixel objects and staying inside compute and memory limits. We introduce VGTok, a training-free tokenizer that sets patch granularity per region from pixels, ahead of the encoder. VGTok scores each region by multi-scale morphological top-hat separability from its surround, then thresholds those scores at a per-image percentile, which fixes the token budget. A structure-tensor gate ($λ_{\min}$) refines only where two-dimensional object structure supports it, leaving one-dimensional clutter coarse. The resulting token set is a strict partition of the image. In a Co-DETR detector with an EVA-02 ViT-L encoder, VGTok clears every published VisDrone-val AP and AP$_S$ at every budget from 40\% to 100\% of tokens. At 40\% it records 44.22 AP with three fifths of the sequence discarded before the first transformer block; dense, it reaches 48.38 AP, $6.08$ above the strongest published entry. VGTok transfers to AI-TOD-v2 untouched, same scorer and same rank, and sets a new state of the art at 37.27 AP and 19.51 AP$_{vt}$. As a pure drop-in into a frozen checkpoint it reaches 36.29 AP at 78.5\% of tokens, above every published entry, where our 376.3M-parameter detector clears a 3.0B multi-expert model. We show that a token budget fixed before the backbone, from local separability and structure geometry alone, holds accuracy on the tiny-object regimes that dominate aerial detection, at $3.1\times$ less encoder compute and $1.9\times$ less encoder memory. Code and models are available at \href{https://github.com/khayrulbuet13/vgtok}{\texttt{github.com/khayrulbuet13/vgtok}} and \href{https://huggingface.co/khayrulbuet13/vgtok}{\texttt{huggingface.co/khayrulbuet13/vgtok}}.

AI.tldr: VGTok是一种无需训练的令牌生成器，通过多尺度形态学顶帽分离度对图像区域打分，并结合结构张量门控，在编码器之前按区域自适应地设定补丁粒度，以固定令牌预算。在Co-DETR和EVA-02 ViT-L框架下，VGTok在VisDrone和AI-TOD-v2数据集上均刷新了SOTA，在仅40%令牌下达到44.22 AP，全密度下达到48.38 AP，同时降低3.1倍编码器计算和1.9倍内存。
AI.motivation: 现有的ViT检测器在训练前固定统一的令牌网格，而原生分辨率的航拍检测必须在"解析小目标"和"控制计算/内存开销"之间做出取舍。作者希望通过在编码器之前根据像素局部特征自适应调整补丁粒度来解决这一矛盾。
AI.method: VGTok包含两个核心组件：(1) 多尺度形态学顶帽分离度评分——对每个区域评估与其背景的分离度，然后在每张图像的百分位数上做阈值化以固定令牌预算；(2) 结构张量门控（λ_min）——仅对具有二维物体结构的区域进行细化，同时将一维杂波区域保持粗粒度。生成的令牌集合是图像的严格划分。
AI.result: 在Co-DETR + EVA-02 ViT-L检测器中，VGTok在所有令牌预算（40%-100%）下均超越所有已发表的VisDrone-val AP和AP_S结果。40%预算时达到44.22 AP（丢弃五分之三的序列），全密度时达到48.38 AP，比最强已发表结果高6.08。在AI-TOD-v2上无需修改即可迁移，达到37.27 AP和19.51 AP_vt的新SOTA。作为冻结检查点的即插即用模块，在78.5%令牌下达到36.29 AP，超过所有已发表结果，且376.3M参数模型优于3.0B多专家模型。
AI.conclusion: 仅基于局部分离度和结构几何，在骨干网络之前固定令牌预算，就能够在航拍检测中占主导的小目标场景下保持精度，同时实现3.1倍编码器计算减少和1.9倍编码器内存减少。该方法是训练无关的、可迁移的即插即用方案。

title: CoVA-SFT: A Large-Scale Dataset for Chain of Visual Abstractions
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has dramatically improved large language models (LLMs) by allowing them to decompose problems into intermediate steps. While CoT is widely effective for linguistic tasks, text-only CoT forces models to serialize visual problems into awkward prose. Although architectural solutions exist to process visual inputs, the community lacks a massive, multi-step, self-corrected dataset to teach models how to build and maintain internal visual workspaces when solving purely textual reasoning problems. To address this limitation, we introduce CoVA-SFT, a highly structured corpus of 51.9K samples containing over 222K multimodal reasoning steps across 5 distinct layout families and 17 complex tasks, and CoVA-Bench, a companion benchmark of 1,700 held-out test samples spanning the same tasks for reproducible evaluation. By providing explicit rationale formulations, agentic renderings, and verification loops, CoVA-SFT teaches multimodal language models to interleave text and visual abstractions. We validate the dataset by demonstrating that models fine-tuned on CoVA-SFT outperform all interleaved CoT baselines by more than 2x on average on CoVA-Bench, though they still fall short of strong text-only CoT baselines, highlighting open challenges for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CoVA-SFT，一个包含51.9K样本、超过222K多模态推理步骤的大规模数据集，以及配套的CoVA-Bench基准测试集，旨在教多模态语言模型在解决纯文本推理问题时构建和维持内部视觉工作区。微调后的模型在CoVA-Bench上平均超过其他交错式CoT基线2倍以上，但仍不如强文本CoT基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本CoT方法迫使模型将视觉问题序列化为笨拙的散文，而社区缺乏大规模、多步骤、自纠正的数据集来教导模型在纯文本推理问题中构建和维持内部视觉工作区。
AI.method: 构建CoVA-SFT数据集（51.9K样本、222K+多模态推理步骤、覆盖5种布局族和17个复杂任务），包含显式原理表述、代理渲染和验证循环，并通过CoVA-Bench（1,700个留出测试样本）进行可复现评估。
AI.result: 在CoVA-SFT上微调的模型在CoVA-Bench上平均比所有交错式CoT基线高出2倍以上，但仍不及强文本CoT基线，揭示了开放的挑战。
AI.conclusion: CoVA-SFT验证了交错文本与视觉抽象学习的可行性，但当前模型仍有较大提升空间，为未来工作指明了方向。

title: MANTLE: A Framework for Adaptive In-Situ Planetary Perception Using a Modular Uplink Principle
summary: Planetary surface exploration missions rely increasingly on autonomous robotic platforms capable of interpreting complex terrain to ensure safe navigation, enable targeted science, and improve operational efficiency, as demonstrated across past Mars missions from Viking through Perseverance. Among the key perception capabilities, landform classification provides contextual information for landing site selection and scientific analysis, while boulder segmentation supports hazard assessment and path planning. This paper presents MANTLE, a multi-task adaptive network for terrain and landform extraction. The model uses a shared DINOv2 backbone for high-level feature extraction with task-specific heads: a classification head for large-scale landform classification, and a segmentation head for pixel-wise boulder localization, each trained on curated datasets built respectively from HiRISE orbital imagery and MSL surface-level imagery. The classification head achieved a test accuracy of 92.56% across seven Martian terrain classes, while the segmentation head achieved a validation IoU of 0.753 and showed strong cross-sol generalization on a held-out test set from previously unseen rover traverses. A key advantage of MANTLE is its modular, extensible design, formalized here as the Modular Uplink Principle: only a shared, frozen backbone needs to remain onboard, while subsequent perception capabilities are trained on Earth as lightweight task-specific heads and uplinked without retraining the full model. This work demonstrates two such high-impact capabilities, terrain classification and boulder segmentation, as an initial realization of a framework built to support many more over a mission's lifetime. With this foundation, future explorers need not arrive on Mars fully formed, but can continue to learn, adapt, and grow more capable with every uplink.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MANTLE，一个用于行星地形与地貌提取的多任务自适应网络，采用共享DINOv2骨干网络加任务特定头（分类头和分割头），分别实现火星地形分类（测试准确率92.56%）和巨石分割（验证IoU 0.753），并提出了模块化上行链路原则（Modular Uplink Principle），使未来探测器可通过上行轻量级任务头持续学习进化。
AI.motivation: 行星表面探测任务日益依赖自主机器人进行复杂地形解释以确保安全导航和科学目标。现有的地形成分类和巨石分割等感知能力对着陆点选择和路径规划至关重要，但传统方法需要完整的模型更新和重训练，缺乏灵活、可扩展的模块化框架来支持任务生命周期内的持续能力演进。
AI.method: MANTLE采用共享的DINOv2骨干网络提取高层特征，配备两个任务特定头：一个用于大规模地形成分类的分类头，一个用于像素级巨石定位的分割头。两个头分别在HiRISE轨道影像和MSL地面影像构建的数据集上训练。其核心设计理念是模块化上行链路原则：仅需共享的冻结骨干留在航天器上，新的感知能力在地球上训练为轻量级任务头后上行部署，无需重新训练整个模型。
AI.result: 分类头在七个火星地形类别上的测试准确率达到92.56%；分割头验证IoU为0.753，且在来自未见过的火星车穿越路径的保留测试集上展现出强跨sol泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: MANTLE展示了地形分类和巨石分割两大能力，验证了模块化、可扩展的多任务网络框架的可行性。该框架支持任务生命周期内持续上行新增能力，使未来探测器无需以最终形态到达火星，而是可以通过每次上行不断学习、适应和增强能力。

title: The Illusion of Replacement: Rethinking Specialized Machine Learning Models in the Foundation Model Era
summary: Can the specialized architectures that machine learning has traditionally built for structured data be replaced by language-based models? This question is examined through a review of 159 papers (2016--2026) across nine modalities, with predictive accuracy considered alongside structural representation and computation. A distinction is made between performing a task and preserving and computing the structure that makes the task tractable, and existing approaches are organized into eight representational regimes, ranging from language-only systems to fully specialized architectures. Language-mediated models are found to be highly competitive in specific settings, including extreme few-shot prediction, discretized symbolic tasks, textually annotated knowledge graphs, and large-scale single-modality pretraining. However, whenever structural representation or computation is directly evaluated rather than accuracy alone, no evidence of general architectural replacement is found. Instead, a recurring pattern is observed across independent research communities: when language alone is insufficient, the missing structure is reintroduced through a graph module, structural tokens, specialized attention, or another non-linguistic component. In this sense, specialization more often relocates than disappears. Moreover, although performance of language-based models is improved by scaling, whether the gap to a structure-aware architecture can eventually be eliminated remains untested.

AI.tldr: 本文通过综述2016至2026年间159篇论文、覆盖九种模态，系统评估了语言模型是否能够取代传统机器学习为结构化数据构建的专门架构。结论是：语言介导模型在特定场景（极端少样本预测、离散符号任务、文本标注知识图谱、大规模单模态预训练）中具有竞争力，但每当结构表征或计算被直接评估时，未发现架构替代的证据，专门化更多是"重新定位"而非"消失"。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型能力不断增强，一个重要问题浮现：能否用语言模型取代针对结构化数据（如图、序列、表格等）专门设计的架构？这个问题不仅关乎预测精度，更关乎结构表征与计算的本质，但此前缺乏系统性研究来回答这一核心争议。
AI.method: 作者综述了2016至2026年间159篇论文，覆盖九种模态。关键方法论创新在于：将"执行任务"与"保留并计算使任务可行的结构"区分开来，并据此将现有方法组织为八种表征体制（regimes），从纯语言系统到完全专门化架构连续排列。评估维度包括预测精度、结构表征和结构计算。
AI.result: 语言介导模型在四类特定场景中高度有竞争力：极端少样本预测、离散化符号任务、带文本标注的知识图谱、大规模单模态预训练。但当直接评估结构表征或计算时，未发现架构替代证据。反复出现的模式是：当语言不足时，研究者通过图模块、结构令牌、专门注意力或其他非语言组件重新引入缺失的结构——专门化更多是重新定位而非消失。此外，扩展规模虽能提升语言模型性能，但能否消除与结构感知架构的差距仍未经过验证。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型无法全面取代专门化架构；结构与计算在语言模型中并未真正消失，而是被重新定位到其他组件中。未来需要更多研究来测试规模扩展是否能最终弥合语言模型与结构感知架构之间的差距。

title: Inter-3D VQA: A Roadside Multimodal Benchmark for 3D Spatiotemporally Grounded Visual Question Answering
summary: Recent advances in visual question answering (VQA) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled natural-language reasoning over traffic scenes. However, existing benchmarks are largely built from ego-vehicle views or 2D roadside videos, limiting their ability to evaluate 3D-grounded reasoning over real-world distances, trajectories, infrastructure topology, and safety-critical interactions. We introduce Inter-3D VQA, a large-scale roadside multimodal benchmark for 3D spatiotemporally grounded VQA at intersections. Built from synchronized point clouds and multi-view images, Inter-3D VQA contains 407K QA pairs covering lane-level positions, object relationships, motion patterns, and near-miss-oriented interaction reasoning. We further propose Inter-Geo, an MLLM baseline that integrates object- and scene-level aligned LiDAR representations, and Inter-Metrics, a unified evaluation framework for textual consistency, numerical accuracy, and semantic correctness. Experiments show that Inter-Geo outperforms image-based VLMs, especially on grounded spatial and temporal reasoning tasks. Our benchmark and codes are available at https://github.com/ASU-Suo-Lab/Inter-3D-VQA .

AI.tldr: 本文提出Inter-3D VQA，一个大规模的路侧多模态3D时空视觉问答基准，基于同步点云和多视角图像，包含40.7万QA对，并配套提出Inter-Geo基线模型和Inter-Metrics统一评估框架，实验证明其优于基于图像的视觉语言模型。
AI.motivation: 现有VQA和MLLM基准大多基于自车视角或2D路侧视频构建，难以评估模型在真实世界距离、轨迹、基础设施拓扑和安全关键交互方面的3D接地推理能力。
AI.method: 构建了大规模路侧多模态基准Inter-3D VQA（含40.7万QA对，覆盖车道级位置、物体关系、运动模式及近碰撞交互推理）；提出Inter-Geo基线模型，整合物体级和场景级对齐的LiDAR表示；提出Inter-Metrics统一评估框架，涵盖文本一致性、数值准确性和语义正确性三个维度。
AI.result: 实验表明Inter-Geo在接地空间和时间推理任务上优于基于图像的视觉语言模型。
AI.conclusion: Inter-3D VQA为交叉路口的3D接地VQA提供了大规模基准和评估体系，验证了引入LiDAR对齐表示的有效性，代码和基准已开源。

title: Detecting and Guiding LLM-Generated Korean Poetry with Interpretable Form-level Features
summary: LLMs often struggle with modern Korean poetry, producing outputs that resemble "line-broken prose." We address two coupled tasks: detecting whether a Korean poem is human- or LLM-authored, and guiding LLMs to generate poetry closer in form to human writing. We quantify the human-LLM gap along four form-level linguistic dimensions: output length (Volume), the diversity and connective use of line-final forms (Structure Variation), the irregularity of line lengths (Rhythmic Irregularity), and adherence to standard orthography (Normative Adherence). We operationalize these dimensions as five interpretable features. For detection, a logistic regression classifier over these five features attains an average AUC-ROC of 83.60 in zero-shot out-of-distribution detection across seven unseen LLMs, versus 75.84 for the strongest baseline in our comparison, KatFishNet, an absolute gain of 7.76 AUC points and a 10.23% relative improvement; one generator-specific punctuation pattern outside our taxonomy remains a boundary case. For generation, expert evaluation on GPT-5.2 prefers feature-guided poems over the unconstrained baseline, and analyses across GPT-5.2 and Gemini-3 show that targeted length, rhythm, and ending statistics move toward the human distribution. These results suggest that interpretable, language-specific features can bridge the diagnosis and guidance of LLM-generated poetry.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM在现代韩语诗歌生成中表现不佳的问题，提出了四个形式层面的语言学维度（篇幅、结构变化、节奏不规则性、规范性）并操作化为五个可解释特征，同时用于人类/LLM诗歌检测和引导LLM生成更接近人类形式的诗歌。检测任务中逻辑回归分类器在零样本跨模型检测中达到83.60 AUC-ROC，比最强基线KatFishNet提升7.76个百分点；生成任务中专家评估偏好特征引导的诗歌，且目标统计量向人类分布靠拢。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的现代韩语诗歌常被批评为"断行散文"，与人类诗歌在形式层面存在显著差距。作者希望解决两个耦合任务：检测诗歌是否由LLM生成，以及引导LLM生成更接近人类诗歌形式的作品。现有方法缺乏可解释的、语言特异的特征来桥接诊断与生成两个方向。
AI.method: 提出四个形式层面的语言学维度：输出长度（Volume）、行末形式的多样性与连接使用（Structure Variation）、行长不规则性（Rhythmic Irregularity）、标准正字法依从性（Normative Adherence）。将这些维度操作化为五个可解释特征。检测任务使用基于这五个特征的逻辑回归分类器进行零样本跨LLM检测；生成任务则利用这些特征引导LLM（GPT-5.2和Gemini-3）进行诗歌生成。
AI.result: 检测方面，五特征逻辑回归在七个未见LLM的零样本分布外检测中平均AUC-ROC达83.60，优于最强基线KatFishNet（75.84），绝对提升7.76点、相对提升10.23%；仅有一个属于生成器特有点标模式的边界案例超出特征体系。生成方面，专家评估倾向选择特征引导的诗歌而非无约束基线，GPT-5.2和Gemini-3在长度、节奏、行末统计量上均向人类分布移动。
AI.conclusion: 可解释的、语言特异的特征能够有效桥接LLM诗歌的诊断与引导，在检测性能上超越了现有基线，同时能引导生成向人类形式靠拢。该方法验证了可解释特征在诗歌质量评估与生成控制中的双重价值。

title: FairReL: Deepfake Detection using Fairness-Aware Representation Learning
comment: 26 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at BMVC 2026. Code: https://github.com/xiaoman89/FairReL
summary: Although recent deepfake detectors achieve high overall accuracy, their errors remain unevenly distributed across demographic subgroups, with real faces from certain groups more often misclassified as fake. Existing fairness-aware detectors typically regularise the entire feature representation, without identifying or controlling the specific components that drive unfair predictions. Such coarse intervention can over-suppress useful forgery cues while leaving demographic structure in component-specific subspaces. To address this, we identify two subgroup-sensitive components: multi-scale spatial features, which encode local facial and forgery patterns, and fine-tuning-induced residual features, which adapt the backbone to the unfair training distribution. We propose FairReL, a fairness-aware representation-learning framework that targets both components with dedicated demographic supervision. FairReL uses an SVD-decomposed foundation-model backbone to isolate the fine-tuning-induced residual representation, and introduces two complementary losses. Group-Conditional Wavelet Decorrelation (GCWD) suppresses subgroup-imbalanced structure across spatial wavelet sub-bands, while Subspace-Localised Mean Alignment (SLMA) aligns subgroup means within each real/fake class in the residual representation. Experiments on FF++, Celeb-DF, DFD and DFDC show that, against the state-of-the-art fairness-aware detector, FairReL improves unseen-dataset AUC by 3.9% while reducing subgroup FPR disparity by 10.2%. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaoman89/FairReL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出FairReL框架，通过识别并针对性干预两类子群体敏感的特征成分（多尺度空间特征和微调残差特征），分别使用GCWD和SLMA损失进行人口统计公平性校正，在保持伪造检测性能的同时显著减少不同族群间的误报率差异。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测器在不同人口统计子群体上的错误分布不均，而现有公平性感知方法对整个特征表示进行粗粒度正则化，缺乏对驱动不公平预测的具体特征成分的识别和控制，可能导致过度压制有效的伪造线索。
AI.method: FairReL框架包含两个关键组件：1) 利用SVD分解的foundation-model骨干网络隔离微调诱导的残差表示；2) 引入两种互补损失函数——Group-Conditional Wavelet Decorrelation (GCWD)抑制空间小波子带中群体不平衡的结构，以及Subspace-Localised Mean Alignment (SLMA)在残差表示中对每个真实/伪造类别内对齐子群体均值。
AI.result: 在FF++、Celeb-DF、DFD和DFDC数据集上，与最先进的公平性感知检测器相比，FairReL将未见数据集的AUC提高了3.9%，同时将子群体FPR差异降低了10.2%。
AI.conclusion: 通过定位和针对性校正子群体敏感的特征成分（而非对整个特征空间进行粗粒度干预），可以在保持甚至提升伪造检测精度的同时实现更公平的跨群体表现，为公平性感知的深度伪造检测提供了更精细化的解决方案。

title: A Unifying Perspective on Language Model Representations: From Filler-Role Structure to Mechanistic Interpretability
summary: A wide range of methods have been proposed for interpreting language models, delivering important insights into their inner workings. However, different methods and their resulting insights stand in relative isolation: what could the underlying structure of language models be, such that they give rise to all our interpretations? In this work, we propose using Tensor Product Representations (TPRs) as a unifying hypothesis. TPRs give a concrete proposal for how compositional structure could be represented in vector space --- as filler-role bindings. We show, both mathematically and empirically, that TPRs can unify several prior interpretability methods: additive analogies, linear probing, sparse autoencoders, and activation patching. Mathematically, we show that these methods can all be derived from TPRs. Empirically, we apply the derivations to a range of different models --- from small toy models to LLMs --- to construct instances of each of the above interpretability methods; these constructed variants perform comparably to their standard variants. We view this work as a step toward what interpretability will ideally provide: a unified account of the nature of neural networks, corroborated not just by individual observations but also by an explanation of the connections between them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用张量积表示（TPRs）作为统一假设，从数学和实证两个层面证明TPRs可以统一多种可解释性方法（加法类比、线性探针、稀疏自编码器、激活修补），并通过在不同模型上的实验验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的语言模型可解释性方法多种多样，但各种方法及其产生的见解彼此孤立，缺乏一个统一的底层理论框架来解释为什么这些方法都能揭示模型的内在结构。
AI.method: 提出以TPRs（张量积表示）作为统一框架，将组合结构表示为填充符-角色绑定（filler-role bindings）。在数学上推导出TPRs可以衍生出加法类比、线性探针、稀疏自编码器和激活修补等方法；在实证上将这些推导应用于从玩具模型到大型语言模型的各种模型，构建每种可解释性方法的变体并进行对比验证。
AI.result: 数学上证明了多种可解释性方法都可以从TPRs推导出来；实证上构建的这些变体方法在性能上与各自的标准变体相当，验证了TPRs作为统一框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为可解释性研究提供了一个统一的理论视角，表明神经网络的本质可以通过TPRs来解释，不仅通过个别观察验证，还通过解释它们之间的内在联系来加以佐证，是朝着统一理解神经网络性质迈出的一步。

title: ClearText-Video: A Large-Scale Text-Centric Video Dataset Bridging Video Restoration and Scene-Text Enhancement
comment: This paper is accepted by 2026 Proceedings of the European Conference on Computer Vision
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have recently made strong progress in visual--linguistic understanding. However, their performance on text-centric video reasoning remains highly sensitive to input quality. Real-world user-provided videos often contain motion blur, compression artifacts, noise, and low-resolution text, which impair reliable text reading and downstream reasoning. Whether MLLMs can robustly read and reason about real-world scene text under diverse quality conditions remains a fundamental open question. We introduce ClearText-Video (CTVid), a large-scale, scene-text-aware benchmark for studying text-centric video understanding under controlled quality variation. CTVid contains 4,639 real-world text-rich egocentric videos, 550K+ frames, 1.6M human-verified scene-text annotations, and 220K+ spatial/temporal question--answer pairs in Chinese and English. For each high-quality video, CTVid provides content-matched Degraded-Quality and Restored-Quality variants, supporting two task families: Text-Centric Video Restoration and Multi-Quality VideoQA. We evaluate 18 representative restoration methods and 16 state-of-the-art MLLMs on CTVid. The results show that visual enhancement does not guarantee textual fidelity or downstream reasoning gains: blur is more damaging than low resolution, restored videos can alter the textual evidence used by MLLMs, and OCR-only pipelines remain far below direct multimodal reasoning. CTVid exposes the gap between video restoration and text-grounded understanding, providing a rigorous foundation for restoration-aware, quality-robust text-centric video systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ClearText-Video（CTVid），一个大规模场景文本感知视频基准，包含4,639个真实世界文本密集的自我中心视频、550K+帧、160万人工验证的场景文本标注及22万+中英文空间/时间问答对。每个高质量视频配有内容匹配的降质和复原变体，支持文本中心视频复原和多质量VideoQA两个任务族。实验发现：视觉增强不保证文本保真或推理提升，模糊比低分辨率更具破坏性，复原可能改变MLLM使用的文本证据，OCR-only流水线远低于直接多模态推理。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中用户提供的视频常含运动模糊、压缩伪影、噪声和低分辨率文本，这些会影响多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的文本阅读和下游推理能力。但目前缺乏大规模基准来系统研究MLLMs在不同质量条件下对真实场景文本的鲁棒阅读与推理能力。
AI.method: 构建CTVid基准：(1) 收集4,639个真实文本密集的自我中心视频并人工验证160万场景文本标注；(2) 为每个高质量视频生成内容匹配的降质和复原变体；(3) 设计两个任务族——文本中心视频复原和多质量VideoQA；(4) 使用中英文双语生成22万+空间/时间问答对；(5) 系统评估18种复原方法和16种SOTA MLLMs。
AI.result: 实验结果显示：视觉复原并不保证文本保真度或下游推理性能的提升；运动模糊比低分辨率对MLLM性能的损害更大；复原视频可能改变MLLM所依赖的文本证据；纯OCR流水线的性能远低于直接多模态推理方法。
AI.conclusion: CTVid揭示了视频复原与文本接地理解之间的差距，为开发复原感知、质量鲁棒的文本中心视频系统提供了严谨的基础。

title: RouteSparse: Input-Conditional Pattern Routing for Budgeted Long-Context Prefilling
summary: Dynamic sparse attention can reduce the quadratic cost of long-context prefilling without changing model weights. MInference assigns each attention head one pattern offline and estimates that pattern's sparse indices for every prompt. This design is efficient, but it assumes that a head's preferred pattern and sparsity budget remain suitable across inputs. We introduce RouteSparse, which routes each head and prompt segment among a small library of GPU-efficient sparse patterns. A low-cost probe estimates pattern utility and uncertainty; a latency-aware router then selects a pattern and budget, while uncertain cases fall back to a denser mask. We formulate routing as constrained risk minimization, derive an attention-output error certificate from omitted probability mass, and evaluate the method on long-context retrieval, question answering, summarization, and language modeling. On Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct with 128K-token prompts, RouteSparse achieves $6.5\times$ dense prefill speed with a 0.2-point RULER drop relative to dense attention, compared with $7.3\times$ speed and a 1.6-point drop for fixed per-head routing. Ablations confirm that input-conditional routing, hardware profiling, and selective dense fallback each contribute to the quality--latency tradeoff.

AI.tldr: RouteSparse提出了一种动态稀疏注意力方法，通过小型稀疏模式库、低成本探针估计模式效用与不确定性，以及延迟感知路由器来为每个头和提示段选择最优的稀疏模式和预算，在长上下文预填充中实现了6.5倍加速且质量损失极小。
AI.motivation: 现有的动态稀疏注意力方法（如MInference）为每个注意力头离线分配单一模式并固定稀疏预算，假设头的偏好模式和预算在不同输入间保持适用，这忽略了输入的多样性，导致质量-延迟权衡不理想。
AI.method: 将路由问题形式化为约束风险最小化；使用低成本探针估计每种稀疏模式的效用和不确定性；延迟感知路由器根据探针结果选择模式和预算，对不确定情况回退到更密集的掩码；对每个头和提示段进行路由。
AI.result: 在Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct的128K token提示上，RouteSparse实现6.5倍密集预填充加速，RULER仅下降0.2点（对比固定逐头路由的7.3倍加速但1.6点下降）。来自注意力输出误差证书的验证以及消融实验确认输入条件路由、硬件配置文件和选择性密集回退均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: RouteSparse通过输入条件路由和不确定性感知的密集回退，显著改善了动态稀疏注意力在质量与延迟之间的权衡，优于固定模式分配的方法。

title: Beyond Representation Learning: A Systematic Study of Joint-Embedding Predictive Generation for 3D Brain MRI
comment: Preprint, code will be released after review
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) have primarily been developed for self-supervised representation learning. Denoising JEPA (D-JEPA) recently demonstrated strong generative capabilities on natural images, yet the applicability to 3D medical imaging remains unexplored. Building on the D-JEPA framework, we present Med-D-JEPA, a systematic adaptation and evaluation of joint-embedding predictive generation for 3D brain MRI. Med-D-JEPA operates on continuous latent tokens produced by a 3D KL-regularized adversarial variational autoencoder, and combines masked context prediction, representation-level alignment, per-token diffusion, and iterative next-set-of-token sampling. We evaluate unconditional and class-conditional generation quality on BraTS2019 and OASIS-1 datasets; downstream classification utility; and preliminary whole-tumor segmentation on BraTS2020. Across different generation settings, Med-D-JEPA achieves superior or competitive performance compared to several strong baselines on fidelity and diversity metrics. Compared to training with real samples, Med-D-JEPA-based synthetic pretraining improves classification AUC from 0.63 to 0.85 on BraTS2019 and from 0.78 to 0.87 on OASIS-1. In the segmentation study, pretraining on Med-D-JEPA samples improves Dice from 0.74 to 0.80 and reduces HD95 from 13.40 to 9.56 mm. These findings establish joint-embedding predictive generation as a promising direction for 3D medical image synthesis and encourage further research in this direction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Med-D-JEPA，将联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）从自然图像生成扩展到3D脑部MRI领域。该系统基于3D KL正则化对抗变分自编码器产生的连续潜变量token，结合掩码上下文预测、表征级对齐、逐token扩散和迭代式token集合采样。在BraTS2019和OASIS-1数据集上的实验表明，Med-D-JEPA在无条件与类别条件生成、下游分类以及全肿瘤分割任务中均取得了优于或匹敌多个强基线模型的表现。
AI.motivation: 虽然去噪JEPA（D-JEPA）已在自然图像生成上展现出强大的生成能力，但其在3D医学影像领域尚未被探索。作者希望填补这一空白，系统性地评估联合嵌入预测生成框架在3D脑MRI上的适用性和有效性，为医学图像合成开辟新的方向。
AI.method: Med-D-JEPA基于D-JEPA框架，核心包括：1）使用3D KL正则化对抗变分自编码器将输入编码为连续潜变量token；2）进行掩码上下文预测，即从可见token预测被掩码token；3）引入表征级对齐机制；4）采用逐token扩散进行生成；5）通过迭代式下一组token采样完成完整的图像生成过程。
AI.result: 在多种生成设置下，Med-D-JEPA在保真度和多样性指标上优于或匹敌多个强基线。在分类任务中，基于Med-D-JEPA合成数据的预训练将BraTS2019的AUC从0.63提升至0.85，OASIS-1的AUC从0.78提升至0.87。在分割任务中，预训练将Dice从0.74提升至0.80，并将HD95从13.40mm降低至9.56mm。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，联合嵌入预测生成是3D医学图像合成的一个有前景的方向，Med-D-JEPA展现了在医学影像生成、下游分类和分割任务中的潜力，值得在该方向上进行更深入的研究。

title: Not All or None: Dynamic Construction of Target-aware Memory Graph for Conversational Stance Detection
summary: Stance detection is crucial for understanding the underlying attitude of an expression towards a target. Conversational stance detection is a more challenging stance detection task in real-world social media scenarios, as it involves detecting the user's stance by leveraging the target-related historical statements across conversational sessions. In this paper, we propose target-aware Memory Graph TamGraph, a novel method that dynamically leverages target-related statements for conversational stance detection. Instead of considering all preceding historical conversations or using no prior conversation information for stance detection, our TamGraph employs a stepwise, entropy-guided backtracking mechanism to selectively activate memory from historical conversations and dynamically constructs a target-aware graph to model the stance relations among utterances. This allows the exploitation of target-related information from the conversation history for stance detection while preventing the introduction of noise. Experimental results on both English and Chinese benchmarks demonstrate that our TamGraph substantially improves LLM performance on conversational stance detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为TamGraph的靶向感知记忆图方法，用于对话立场检测。该方法通过逐步熵引导回溯机制，从历史对话中选择性激活与目标相关的记忆，动态构建靶向感知图来建模话语间的立场关系，在英文和中文基准上显著提升了LLM的对话立场检测性能。
AI.motivation: 对话立场检测是社交媒体场景中更具挑战性的任务，需要在不同会话会话中利用与目标相关的历史陈述来检测用户立场。现有方法要么考虑所有历史对话引入噪声，要么完全不利用历史对话信息，缺乏有效的靶向信息利用策略。
AI.method: 提出TamGraph方法，采用逐步熵引导回溯机制，选择性激活历史对话中的记忆，并动态构建靶向感知图来建模话语间的立场关系，从而有效利用对话历史中与目标相关的信息，同时避免引入噪声。
AI.result: 在英文和中文基准数据集上的实验结果表明，TamGraph显著提升了大型语言模型在对话立场检测任务上的性能。
AI.conclusion: TamGraph通过选择性地利用目标相关的历史对话记忆并构建靶向感知图，有效提升了对话立场检测的准确性和鲁棒性，验证了选择性记忆激活策略在对话立场检测中的有效性。

title: Blind Stereoscopic Omnidirectional Image Quality Assessment Using Predictive Coding Hierarchy
summary: Stereoscopic omnidirectional images (SOIs) have provided users with newly immersive quality of experience in virtual reality environments. However, developing efficient and accurate perceptual quality assessment metrics for SOIs remains challenging due to many factors such as freely changeable field of views and binocular vision. In this paper, based on the characteristics of the human visual system (HVS), we propose a Predictive Coding Hierarchy-inspired metric (PCH) for blind/no-reference stereoscopic omnidirectional image quality assessment. Motivated by the viewing process of SOIs, the proposed PCH includes a local cyclopean perception module, a global predictive perception module, and a visual quality regressor. First, observers browse different spherical sceneries from viewports, and aggregate the local visual information to infer the perceptual quality of SOIs. Therefore, we extract various viewports, followed by cyclopean conversion and saliency detection to approach the perception and attention of the human brain. After the local aggregation, viewers then infer the global scene in their minds. Based on the binocular mechanism, we fuse left and right views to perform predictive coding hierarchy modelling. Finally, the visual quality regressor is exploited to obtain the ultimate quality score related to both local and global perceptual cues. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed PCH achieves competitive and consistently improved performance compared with state-of-the-art quality assessment methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于预测编码层级启发的无参考立体全景图像质量评估指标（PCH），通过局部双眼竞争感知模块和全局预测感知模块模拟人类视觉系统对立体全景图像的感知过程，实验中相比现有方法取得更优性能。
AI.motivation: 立体全景图像（SOIs）在虚拟现实中提供沉浸式体验，但由于视场可自由变化和双眼视觉等因素，开发高效准确的无参考质量评估指标仍具挑战性。
AI.method: PCH包含三个模块：1）局部双眼竞争感知模块，通过提取多种视口、进行双眼竞争转换和显著性检测来模拟人脑的感知与注意力；2）全局预测感知模块，基于双眼机制融合左右视图进行预测编码层级建模，以推断全局场景；3）视觉质量回归器，结合局部和全局感知线索预测最终质量分数。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，PCH相比现有最先进的质量评估方法取得了具有竞争力且持续改进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于人类视觉系统特性设计的分层预测编码框架能够有效捕捉立体全景图像的空间感知和双眼融合机制，为SOIs的无参考质量评估提供了可行方案。

title: Recognition-Refusal Misalignment in LLMs: Why Models Answer Structurally Unanswerable Questions
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. 29 pages, 6 figures
summary: Large language models often answer structurally unanswerable questions, such as computing cot(-540°) or evaluating (1).startswith("1"), instead of abstaining. We ask whether this failure reflects missing recognition or failed routing from recognition to abstention. Across instruction-tuned models from 1.7B to 70B parameters, a single linear direction in the hidden state separates answerable from structurally impossible math and code prompts, showing that models represent impossibility before generation. Yet this recognition direction is nearly orthogonal to the canonical safety-refusal direction that mediates trained harmful-content refusal. An in-domain behavior-defined invalidity-aware direction is closer to recognition, but only partially aligned with it, and remains near-orthogonal to safety refusal. Generation-time steering along the recognition direction changes invalidity-aware behavior bidirectionally and dose-responsively on structural math and code cells, while random directions do not. Base/instruct comparisons further show that the low-cosine geometry is already present at the pretraining endpoint. The confident-on-impossible failure is therefore better explained as a routing failure than as an encoding failure: the model has a usable "no admissible answer" signal, but the safety-refusal pathway is not aligned to use it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型在回答结构上不可回答的问题（如计算cot(-540°)）时，为何不拒绝而自信作答。研究发现这一失败源于"路由失败"而非"识别失败"：模型内部存在可用的识别信号，但该信号与安全拒绝通路未对齐。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型经常对结构上无解的问题给出自信答案而非拒答，作者希望探究这种失败究竟是模型没有识别出问题不可回答，还是识别出了但未能将该识别结果路由到拒绝行为上。
AI.method: 在1.7B到70B参数的指令微调模型上，通过线性探测识别隐状态中分离"可回答/不可回答"问题的单一线性方向；将该方向与安全拒绝方向、无效性感知方向进行几何分析（正交性、余弦相似度）；并通过生成时沿识别方向进行干预，观察对无效性感知行为的影响。
AI.result: 模型隐状态中存在能区分可回答与结构不可回答问题的单一线性方向（证明识别存在）；但该方向与安全拒绝方向几乎正交；行为定义的无效性感知方向与识别方向部分对齐但与安全拒绝仍近正交；沿识别方向干预可双向、剂量依赖地改变无效性感知行为；该低余弦几何在预训练结束时已存在。
AI.conclusion: 模型对结构不可回答问题自信作答的失败是路由失败而非编码失败：模型已有"无有效答案"的可使用信号，但安全拒绝通路未与之对齐，导致该信号无法被利用来触发拒答行为。

title: A Large-scale Evaluation of Text-guided Models for Facial Editing
summary: Facial appearance editing powers popular applications like FaceApp and Photoshop. Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and 3D Morphable Models (3DMMs) have been widely used for facial editing. GANs can perform varied facial edits (e.g., changing hair color, hairstyle), but often produce unstable edits. 3DMMs produce stable edits, but can only alter pose and facial expression. Recently, text-guided diffusion models like Nano Banana have become popular for image editing. Text-guided models are a compelling alternative to GANs and 3DMMs since they can produce both stable and varied image edits. While text-guided models have been widely tested for whole-scene edits (e.g., ``make the woman play a guitar''), they have not been comprehensively tested for facial editing. We conducted the first large-scale evaluation ($\sim1$M images evaluated) of six popular text-guided models on a sequential facial editing task. We present Face-Edit-Attributes, the largest collection of $169$ facial editing attributes focused on hair, accessories, and pose edits. We compared model performance using two popular celebrity face datasets: CelebA and CelebSET. Our results show that most models performed hair and accessory edits well, but struggled with editing pose. All models over-edit (e.g., changing hair color when asked only to change the hairstyle). We also evaluated demographic biases in each model. Our results show surprising biases in overediting: almost all models created more overedits for dark-skinned male faces and old faces. The code and data for our results (including our repository of $\sim 1$M images) can be accessed \href{https://github.com/rahul1801/Face-Edit-Bench}{\textcolor{blue}{here}}.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对六种主流文本引导的扩散模型进行了大规模面部编辑评估（约100万张图像），提出了包含169种面部编辑属性的最大数据集Face-Edit-Attributes。结果表明大多数模型在头发和配饰编辑上表现良好，但在姿态编辑上存在困难；所有模型都存在过度编辑问题，且对深肤色男性和老年人面孔存在显著的过度编辑偏见。
AI.motivation: 虽然文本引导的扩散模型在整场景编辑中已被广泛测试，但尚未在面部编辑任务中进行全面评估。GAN和3DMM分别在编辑多样性和稳定性上存在不足，文本引导模型被认为是有前景的替代方案，但其面部编辑能力缺乏系统性的评估。
AI.method: 作者进行了首次大规模评估（约100万张图像），测试六种流行的文本引导扩散模型在序列面部编辑任务上的表现。建立了Face-Edit-Attributes数据集（169种面部编辑属性，聚焦头发、配饰和姿态编辑），并使用CelebA和CelebSET两个流行名人面孔数据集比较模型性能，同时评估了各模型的人口统计偏见。
AI.result: 大多数模型在头发和配饰编辑方面表现良好，但在姿态编辑上表现不佳。所有模型都存在过度编辑问题（如仅要求改变发型却同时改变了发色）。在人口统计偏见方面，几乎所有模型对深肤色男性和老年人面孔产生更多过度编辑。
AI.conclusion: 文本引导的扩散模型在面部编辑中具备潜力，但在编辑精确性和公平性方面仍需改进，特别是姿态编辑和过度编辑偏见问题需要进一步研究。研究代码、数据和约100万张图像资源已公开。

title: HEAR Who Said What: Unlocking Speaker-Attributed Reasoning via Counterfactual Voice Grounding
