summary: Speech Language Models (SLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-speaker environments, yet their ability to attribute speech to the correct speaker and reason over speaker identities remains unclear. Hence, we introduce HEAR, a conceptually hierarchical benchmark diagnosing the foundational capabilities of speaker-attributed reasoning, comprising 2.4K human-verified samples from 887 diverse multi-party audio clips. Evaluating 20 leading SLMs on HEAR reveals they struggle with these foundational tasks, often relying on semantic priors rather than actual vocal cues. To address this, we present A2R, a 30B model optimized on Counterfactual Audio with Speaker-level Hard negatives (CASH), a dataset designed to guide the model to prioritize acoustic vocal cues over linguistic signals. A2R achieves strong performance on HEAR and exhibits zero-shot generalization to diverse multi-speaker downstream tasks, demonstrating that learned speaker attribution unlocks the model's latent capacity for speaker-aware reasoning. All resources are available at https://attributetoreason.github.io/AttributeToReason/

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了HEAR基准和A2R模型：HEAR是一个包含2.4K人工验证样本的分层基准，用于评测语音语言模型（SLM）的说话人归属推理能力；评估20个领先SLM发现它们在此基础任务上表现不佳，常依赖语义先验而非真实声音线索。为解决该问题，作者提出A2R（30B模型），通过CASH数据集训练，引导模型优先关注声学语音线索而非语言信号，在HEAR上表现优异，并展现出对多说话人下游任务的零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 语音语言模型在多说话人环境中被广泛部署，但其正确归属语音到说话人并基于说话人身份进行推理的能力尚不明确，缺乏系统性的评测基准来诊断和提升这一能力。
AI.method: 1) 构建HEAR分层基准（2.4K人工验证样本，来自887个多说话人音频片段）；2) 评估20个领先SLM；3) 提出A2R（30B模型），使用CASH数据集（说话人级硬负样本的反事实音频）进行优化训练，使模型优先利用声学语音线索。
AI.result: A2R在HEAR上取得优异表现，并实现对多种多说话人下游任务的零样本泛化，证明学习到的说话人归属能力能解锁模型潜在的说话人感知推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 当前SLM在说话人归属推理上存在显著缺陷，通过专门设计的训练数据（CASH）和模型优化（A2R），可以有效提升模型对声学语音线索的重视程度，从而增强说话人感知推理能力并泛化到下游任务。

title: FigMirror: Ground It, Code It, Plot It
comment: Code and data available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/FigMirror
summary: Converting scientific figures into executable code has gained increasing attention, yet existing methods primarily focus on reproducing the reference figure itself. A more practical setting is to plot new data while preserving the visual style of a reference figure (e.g., color scheme and typography). Prior approaches mimic the reference through pixel-level optimization and struggle to carry its style to new data. We show that the key to this task lies in the coordinate grounding and coding capabilities present in modern computer-use models. We propose FigMirror, an agentic framework that unlocks these capabilities through Grounded Measurement, which locates visual elements by coordinates and measures their properties through executable code. We further introduce PlotTwin-Bench, an expert-curated benchmark with fine-grained code and image-level style metrics. Experiments show that FigMirror consistently outperforms existing methods on reference-conditioned style transfer. All plots in this paper are generated by FigMirror, except those produced by other methods for comparison. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/VILA-Lab/FigMirror.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FigMirror框架，利用现代计算机使用模型的坐标定位和编码能力，将参考图的视觉风格（如配色和排版）迁移到新数据的绘图任务中，并引入PlotTwin-Bench基准评估，实验显示其在风格迁移上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仅关注复现参考图本身，无法将参考图的视觉风格迁移到新数据上；像素级优化的方法难以保留风格特征。
AI.method: 提出FigMirror智能体框架，通过Grounded Measurement（坐标定位视觉元素并通过可执行代码测量属性）来解锁计算机使用模型的坐标定位与编码能力，实现参考图到新数据的风格迁移。
AI.result: 在PlotTwin-Bench基准上，FigMirror在参考条件风格迁移任务中一致优于现有方法。论文中所有图表均由FigMirror生成。
AI.conclusion: 坐标定位和编码能力是解决图形到代码风格迁移任务的关键，FigMirror验证了该方向的有效性，代码和数据已开源。

title: AI Historian: Helping historians organize and verify person-centred temporal clues from dispersed historical narratives
summary: History is not preserved in complete, continuous form. Accounts of a person's activities, relationships and historical contexts are scattered across texts, chapters and narrative perspectives; historians must retrieve, identify and compare these materials to reconstruct temporal sequences and verify them against sources. Here we present AI Historian (AIH), an AI agent system that helps historians organize person-time evidence from dispersed biographical narratives. It takes source sentences as evidence units, identifies people and temporal cues, verifies candidate cross-text associations and infers comparable temporal ranges while preserving traceable source-text evidence. We evaluated AIH on six Shiji cases concerning Liu Bang, Xiang Yu and Xiao He. AIH Agent achieved a temporal-localization MicroIoU of 86.2%, compared with 81.3% for human-only annotation and 17.1% for direct large-language-model prompting; it required about 14 min, versus 1 h 32 min for human-only annotation. We further applied AIH to the Twenty-Four Histories and other ancient Chinese histories, ancient Japanese and Korean histories, and modern and contemporary historical materials, and released the results through Westlake Historian. These results indicate that AIH can reduce the cost of organizing historical materials at scale while turning connections obscured by chapter-based narration into traceable, revisable research questions for collaborative testing.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了AI Historian (AIH)，一个AI智能体系统，用于帮助历史学家从分散的传记叙述中组织人物-时间证据。系统将源句作为证据单元，识别人物和时间线索，验证跨文本关联并推断可比较的时间范围，同时保留可追溯的源文本证据。在《史记》六个案例（刘邦、项羽、萧何）上，AIH实现了86.2%的时间定位MicroIoU，远超直接大语言模型提示的17.1%和人类标注的81.3%，且耗时仅14分钟（人类为1小时32分）。系统已应用于二十四史及其他中外历史材料。
AI.motivation: 历史记录并非以完整连续的形式保存，人物活动、关系和历史背景分散在不同文本、章节和叙事视角中。历史学家需要从分散的传记叙述中检索、识别和比较材料，以重建时间序列并对照原始来源进行验证。这一过程费时费力，亟需自动化工具来降低组织历史材料的成本。
AI.method: AIH以源句为证据单元，通过以下流程工作：识别人物及时间线索，验证跨文本候选关联，推断可比较的时间范围，同时保留可追溯的源文本证据。系统设计为智能体（Agent）架构，可对来自不同章节和文本的历史叙述进行交叉验证和时间对齐。
AI.result: 在《史记》关于刘邦、项羽、萧何的六个案例上，AIH的时间定位MicroIoU达86.2%，高于人类标注的81.3%和直接大语言模型提示的17.1%；处理时间约14分钟，远低于人类的1小时32分。系统还成功应用于二十四史及其他古代中国历史、古代日本和韩国历史、近现代历史材料，成果通过Westlake Historian平台发布。
AI.conclusion: AIH能在大规模上降低历史材料组织的成本，将因章节叙事而遮蔽的关联转化为可追溯、可修改的研究问题，供协作验证。这表明AI智能体系统在历史研究领域具有显著的应用价值，可以在效率和数据质量上同时超越纯人工标注和直接LLM提示。

title: Text-Driven Artistic Staging: Pose, Lighting, and Camera References from Paintings
summary: Artists coordinate human pose, illumination, and camera placement to convey narrative and emotion, but existing generative methods typically model these elements independently. We introduce text-to-editable 3D staging, a task that jointly generates human poses, a dominant light, and a camera configuration from an affective description. We construct 11,911 text--staging pairs from 2,328 figurative paintings by reconstructing SMPL bodies, estimating low-frequency illumination, recovering camera parameters, and pairing each scene with ArtEmis descriptions. We train a flow-matching transformer that supports variable numbers of figures and produces multiple staging alternatives for each prompt. On held-out descriptions, the model achieves 32.2\% retrieval R@1, compared with 16.6\% for CLIP-based nearest-neighbor retrieval, while approximately preserving corpus-level diversity. These results demonstrate the feasibility of generating editable, emotionally conditioned 3D staging references from text.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"文本到可编辑3D场景布置"任务，从情感描述中联合生成人体姿势、主光和相机配置。作者从2,328幅具象绘画中构建了11,911个文本-场景配对数据集，并训练了一个流匹配Transformer模型。实验表明该方法在检索R@1上达到32.2%，远超基于CLIP的最近邻检索（16.6%），同时保持语料库级多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有生成方法通常独立建模人体姿势、光照和相机位置，而艺术家在实际创作中是协同调配这些元素来传达叙事和情感的。缺乏从文本情感描述出发、联合生成可编辑3D场景布置的方法。
AI.method: 1) 从2,328幅具象绘画中重建SMPL人体模型、估计低频光照、恢复相机参数，并与ArtEmis描述配对，构建11,911个文本-场景对。2) 训练一个支持可变人数、可生成多个场景布置备选方案的流匹配（flow-matching）Transformer模型。
AI.result: 在留出描述上，模型实现32.2%的检索R@1，对比CLIP为基础的最近邻检索仅16.6%，同时大致保持语料库级多样性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了从文本生成可编辑、情感条件下的3D场景布置参考是可行的，为艺术创作辅助和3D内容生成提供了新的方向。

title: Quantifying Error Tolerance in Synthetic Data: An Atomic-level Operand vs. Operator Perturbation Study
summary: Synthetic data generation has become a cornerstone for advancing large language models. However, the lack of the quantitative analysis for error tolerance became a critical bottleneck. Consequently, current filtering strategies fluctuate between two extremes: they are either overly aggressive, risking the exclusion of potentially valuable samples, or overly permissive, failing to eliminate erroneous samples effectively. To bridge this gap, this paper introduces Atomic Tree Operation Modeling (ATOM), a framework that decomposes data into functional units ($f(x)\rightarrow y$). ATOM distinguishes benign Operand $x$ perturbations from fatal Operator $f$ perturbations. The former are needlessly discarded by aggressive filtering, while the latter slip through permissive filtering. Our experiments reveal a double dissociation: models are robust to operand perturbations but collapse under operator perturbations. By prioritizing operator over aggressive operand precision, our ATOM-synthesized data outperforms rigorous baselines (e.g., +3.1% gain over LIMA), suggesting that operator diversity matters more than operand precision. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lut-hub/ATOM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出原子树操作建模（ATOM）框架，将合成数据分解为功能性单元（f(x)→y），区分良性操作数（x）扰动与致命操作符（f）扰动，通过优先提升操作符多样性而非操作数精度，使合成数据在多个基准上超越严格过滤的方法。
AI.motivation: 合成数据生成是大语言模型进步的关键，但缺乏对错误容忍度的定量分析成为瓶颈。现有过滤策略要么过于激进（误删有价值样本），要么过于宽松（无法有效清除错误样本），亟需一种更精细的数据分解与过滤框架。
AI.method: 提出ATOM框架，将数据分解为功能单元（f(x)→y），区分操作数（x）扰动与操作符（f）扰动。实验揭示双重分离现象：模型对操作数扰动鲁棒，但对操作符扰动会崩溃。基于此，优先进行操作符精度过滤而非操作数精度过滤。
AI.result: ATOM合成的数据在多个基准上优于严格过滤的基线方法，例如相比LIMA提升了3.1%的性能，证明操作符多样性比操作数精度对模型训练更重要。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据的过滤应优先关注操作符层面的错误与多样性，而非过度追求操作数的精确性，这为合成数据生成与过滤策略提供了新的理论框架和实用指导。

title: BlobBoards: Robust Markers for Accurate Pose
summary: We propose BlobBoards, a fiducial marker system comprising a dense, multi-scale field of Gaussian blobs and a feature-based pipeline for joint detection, identification, and pose estimation. Each board is registered from hundreds of blob features whose dense spatial coverage constrains pose, while multiple scales preserve detectability across large changes in focal length, distance, and obliquity. Learned local descriptors are matched to the reference pattern and spatially verified, so the correspondences determine pose and certify identity. Against motion-capture ground truth, BlobBoards achieve median translation errors of 3.6-5.0 mm, reducing AprilTag's median translation error by 89% on small boards and 70% on large ones. They also produce far fewer large-rotation failures than state-of-the-art tag systems. BlobBoards achieve the highest detection rate, 80% versus 74% for AprilTag and 58% for ArUco, with the largest margin on the smallest markers. Under 50% occlusion, they still detect 69% of boards with essentially unchanged median translation error, while AprilTag and ArUco detect none. In experiments BlobBoards give state-of-the-art detection rate, pose accuracy and occlusion robustness.

AI.tldr: BlobBoards是一种由密集多尺度高斯斑点场构成的基准标记系统，通过基于特征的方法实现联合检测、识别和姿态估计。在实验中，其在检测率、位姿精度和遮挡鲁棒性方面均达到最先进水平。
AI.motivation: 现有的基准标记系统（如AprilTag和ArUco）在检测率、位姿精度和遮挡鲁棒性方面存在不足，尤其是在小尺寸标记、大幅姿态变化和遮挡场景下性能不佳，因此需要一种更鲁棒的标记系统。
AI.method: BlobBoards由数百个高斯斑点特征构成密集多尺度标记场。通过学习型局部描述子将特征与参考模式匹配并进行空间验证，从而获得对应关系以确定位姿和验证身份。多尺度设计保证在不同焦距、距离和倾斜角度下都能保持可检测性。
AI.result: BlobBoards在动作捕捉地面真值下实现3.6-5.0mm的中位平移误差，较AprilTag在小板上降低89%、大板上降低70%的误差；检测率达80%（优于AprilTag的74%和ArUco的58%）；在50%遮挡下仍能检测69%的板且精度基本不变，而AprilTag和ArUco完全无法检测。
AI.conclusion: BlobBoards在检测率、位姿精度和遮挡鲁棒性方面均达到最先进水平，是现有基于标签的视觉标记系统（如AprilTag、ArUco）的强有力替代方案。

title: Toward a Cross-Lingual Romanization Ecosystem for Sinitic Languages: A Paired Mandarin-Cantonese Case Study
comment: Accepted to ISCSLP 2026. Tan Lee and Benyou Wang are co-corresponding authors
summary: This paper proposes the Sinitic Romanization Ecosystem, a cross-lingual Sinitic romanization design framework with supporting digital infrastructure and a community-driven open-source workflow. The design framework addresses the lack of systematic cross-lingual romanization alignment among Sinitic languages through four design principles: phonetic correspondence for representing similar sounds with similar romanized symbols, historical-phonological correspondence for aligning cognate romanization strings, one-phoneme-one-symbol, and basic Latin-letter use, with a balancing consideration recognizing trade-offs among these principles. For the main paired case study, we devel-op CantRomZJ1 and MandRomZJ1, Cantonese and Manda-rin romanization schemes following the design framework, respectively. We also develop schemes for several other Sinitic languages, including Meixian Hakka, Shanghai Wu, and Nanjing Jianghuai Mandarin, following the same de-sign framework. To bring the romanization schemes into practical use, we develop open-source infrastructure for structured romanization storage, conversion, parsing, dic-tionary construction, and input-method generation. Finally, we evaluate the design framework through speech-to-romanization experiments based on Meta's Massively Mul-tilingual Speech (MMS) fine-tuning. Compared with the Pinyin+Jyutping baseline, our Man-dRomZJ1+CantRomZJ1 condition reduces Cantonese WER and CER by 7.80% and 10.61%, respectively. These results suggest that cross-lingual romanization alignment can improve transfer in low-resource Sinitic speech technology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Sinitic罗马化生态系统，一个跨语言的汉语罗马化设计框架，包含四个设计原则（语音对应、历史音韵对应、一音一符、基本拉丁字母），并开发了粤语和普通话的罗马化方案（CantRomZJ1和MandRomZJ1）以及其他多种汉语方言方案，配套开源基础设施和社区驱动工作流。通过基于MMS微调的语音转罗马化实验，该方案相比Pinyin+Jyutping基线将粤语WER和CER分别降低了7.80%和10.61%。
AI.motivation: 现有汉语方言罗马化系统缺乏系统性的跨语言对齐，导致低资源汉语语音技术难以利用跨语言迁移。作者旨在建立一个统一的跨语言罗马化设计框架，使不同汉语方言的罗马化方案能够相互对应和关联。
AI.method: 提出包含四个设计原则的罗马化框架：语音对应（相似音用相似符号）、历史音韵对应（同源词罗马化字符串对齐）、一音一符、基本拉丁字母使用，并综合考虑这些原则的权衡。基于此框架开发了粤语（CantRomZJ1）和普通话（MandRomZJ1）方案，以及客家话、上海吴语、南京江淮官话等方言方案。同时搭建了结构化罗马化存储、转换、解析、词典构建和输入法生成的开源基础设施，并通过Meta的MMS模型微调进行语音转罗马化评估。
AI.result: 在语音转罗马化实验中，MandRomZJ1+CantRomZJ1组合相比Pinyin+Jyutping基线，粤语的词错误率（WER）降低了7.80%，字符错误率（CER）降低了10.61%，表明跨语言罗马化对齐能有效改善低资源汉语语音技术的迁移效果。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言罗马化对齐可以显著提升低资源汉语语音技术中的迁移学习效果，该框架和配套基础设施为多种汉语方言的罗马化方案提供了统一设计和实践的可行路径。

title: MWIR-4-Plastic: The Identification of Complex End-of-Life Industrial Plastic using Mid-wave Infrared Hyperspectral Imaging and Machine Learning
summary: The automated sorting of shredded black plastics from end-of-life (EOF) industrial waste presents a significant challenge in recycling facilities, primarily due to the limitations of current sensing and analytical approaches. Existing studies predominantly rely on single-point contact-based mid-infrared spectroscopy or laboratory hyperspectral imaging (HSI) setups, which fail to provide the spatially resolved analysis necessary for fast, bulk processing. Moreover, available datasets are laboratory-controlled and focus on intact rather than shredded plastics, hindering further recycling refinement. Black industrial plastics, in particular, are underrepresented, while most classification pipelines depend on manual region selection and rule-based spectral matching, neglecting spatial information and modern deep learning (DL) methods. To address these gaps, we introduce the first publicly available HSI dataset of shredded black plastics from EOF vehicle, comprising four industrial polymers across 13 co-registered RGB, VNIR, SWIR, and MWIR scenes and their segmentation pipeline. We developed a multi-modal spectral-spatial framework that integrates foreground isolation, pixel-wise classification, and object-level majority voting. By adapting advanced hyperspectral transformers from earth observation and incorporating chemometric band selection, we achieve accurate classification of complex black plastics. The study establishes the first comprehensive benchmark using nine processing methods, including chemometric, machine learning, and DL architectures. To ensure reproducibility, the complete dataset and methodologies are publicly released, establishing a benchmark for a hyperspectral object-analysis pipeline in industrial inspection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了第一个针对报废车辆黑色碎塑料的高光谱成像（HSI）公开数据集，包含四种工业聚合物在13个共配准的RGB、VNIR、SWIR和MWIR场景下的数据，并开发了多模态光谱-空间分类框架，集成了前景隔离、像素级分类和对象级多数投票，建立了包含九种处理方法的综合基准。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多依赖单点接触式红外光谱或实验室HSI设置，缺乏空间分辨分析能力；数据集多为实验室控制条件且聚焦完整塑料而非碎塑料，黑色工业塑料代表性不足；分类管线依赖人工区域选择和基于规则的谱匹配，忽视了空间信息和现代深度学习方法。
AI.method: 提出了多模态光谱-空间框架，包括：(1)前景隔离以分离塑料对象；(2)利用适应地球观测领域的高光谱transformer进行像素级分类；(3)引入化学计量学波段选择方法；(4)对象级多数投票聚合结果。建立了包含九种方法（化学计量学、机器学习、深度学习架构）的全面基准，数据集涵盖RGB、VNIR、SWIR和MWIR四种模态。
AI.result: 通过集成先进的高光谱transformer和化学计量学波段选择，实现了复杂黑色塑料的准确分类，并建立了使用九种处理方法的首个综合基准，验证了该框架在该任务上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了首个公开的黑色碎塑料HSI数据集和分析基准，证明了多模态光谱-空间深度学习框架在工业回收场景中黑色塑料自动分类的可行性，为推进回收精炼和工业检测提供了可复现的基准资源。

title: Toward Cultural Alignment: Human-Centered Evaluation of Multimodal AI Stories Across Five African Communities
summary: In this paper, we examine how well AI-generated multimodal stories align with the lived practices, relationships, language, values, and visual expectations of the communities they represent. We conduct a community-grounded mixed-methods evaluation with 19 culture representatives across five African communities, combining quantitative annotations with qualitative focus group discussions. We find that cultural alignment depends not simply on recognizable cultural markers, but on how those markers fit social, linguistic, procedural, and visual context. From these evaluations, we develop a taxonomy of cultural alignment comprising five broader cultural marker categories and eight recurring mechanisms of misalignment. We additionally evaluate five multimodal LLM judges to examine whether automated evaluation can approximate community-grounded judgments at scale. Judge reliability and score calibration vary substantially across communities, with no single judge performing consistently across all five settings. These findings motivate community-calibrated evaluation pipelines in which automated judges are validated against community judgments to determine where they can be trusted and where human review remains necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文通过19位文化代表和焦点小组讨论，评估AI生成的多模态故事与五个非洲社区文化实践的契合度，提出了包含五个文化标记类别和八种错位机制的文化对齐分类体系，并发现多模态LLM自动评估器在不同社区间可靠性差异显著。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成内容评估往往忽略文化对齐这一维度，缺乏对生成内容是否真正符合目标社区生活实践、关系、语言、价值观和视觉期望的系统性检验。
AI.method: 采用社区扎根的混合方法评估，对19名来自五个非洲社区的文化代表同时进行定量标注和定性焦点小组讨论，并额外评估五种多模态LLM判断器的自动评估能力。
AI.result: 文化对齐不仅依赖可识别的文化标记，更取决于这些标记如何嵌入社会、语言、程序和视觉语境。开发了包含五类文化标记和八种错位机制的分类体系。五种LLM判断器在不同社区间的可靠性和评分校准差异显著，没有单一判断器能在所有五个场景中一致表现。
AI.conclusion: 需要构建社区校准的评估管道，将自动判断器与社区判断进行交叉验证，以确定自动评估可被信任的领域以及必须保留人工审查的环节。

title: Pixel-wise Geo-registration of Drone and Satellite Images
summary: Pixel-level cross-view geo-registration aims to align a query image (e.g., drone) to a geo-referenced satellite map so that every query pixel can be mapped to real-world GPS coordinates. Despite strong progress in cross-view geo-localization, existing benchmarks largely provide only GPS labels, limiting evaluation to a single coordinate per image and leaving dense geodetic alignment underexplored. We introduce SkyReg, a dataset and standardized benchmark for pixel-level drone-to-satellite geo-registration, providing dense per-pixel geo-location supervision across diverse settings (orthographic and perspective), scene types (urban, landmark-centric, suburban/rural), and camera configurations. Using SkyReg, we evaluate a broad set of baselines spanning retrieval, feature matching, homography-based alignment, and feed-forward 3D reconstruction. Finally, cross-view pairs from SkyReg, we train a geometry-aware reconstruction pipeline that achieves state-of-the-art results,improving performance by a significant margin.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkyReg，一个用于像素级无人机到卫星图像地理配准的数据集和标准化基准，提供密集的逐像素地理定位监督，覆盖多种场景和相机配置，并训练了几何感知重建流程，达到了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位基准大多只提供GPS标签，只能评估每个图像单个坐标，导致密集大地测量对齐（逐像素级）未被充分探索。需要一个新的基准来推动像素级无人机到卫星地理配准的研究。
AI.method: 构建SkyReg数据集，提供密集逐像素地理定位监督，覆盖正交投影和透视投影、多种场景类型（城市、地标中心、郊区/乡村）及不同相机配置。在该基准上评估多种基线方法（检索、特征匹配、单应性对齐、前馈3D重建），并训练了几何感知的重建流程。
AI.result: 所提出的几何感知重建流程在SkyReg基准上取得了最先进的性能，相较于现有方法有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: SkyReg作为首个像素级无人机到卫星地理配准的标准化基准，填补了该领域缺乏密集标注数据集的空白，验证了几何感知重建方法在该任务上的有效性。

title: Attribute-Based Activation Steering of LLMs for Group-Specific Explanation Generation
summary: To effectively enable people to understand new topics, explanations should be tailored to their backgrounds and abilities. So far, prompting alone has been shown to be insufficient for creating such explanations and other computational methods are missing. Therefore, this paper investigates whether LLMs can be steered to generate explanations that are tailored to a specific group of people. To this end, we propose an approach that first identifies group-specific attributes in terms of explanatory style and knowledge of a specific target group. Building on activation engineering, it then computes attribute-based steering vectors and adds them to the internal activations of an LLM during inference to enable a fine-grained steering. In our experiments, we assess the steering effectiveness of our approach in terms of specificity and factuality of the generated explanations. Additionally, we evaluate the explanations in a study with human experts from different target groups. Compared to prompting and state-of-the-art steering baselines, our approach tailors the explanations significantly better to the target group while largely maintaining factuality.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于激活工程（activation engineering）的LLM引导方法，通过识别特定目标群体的解释风格和知识特征，计算基于属性的引导向量并注入LLM内部激活中，从而在推理时实现细粒度的群体定制化解释生成。实验表明该方法在定制化程度和事实准确性方面均优于提示词方法及现有引导基线。
AI.motivation: 为了让人们有效理解新主题，解释需要根据受众的背景和能力进行定制。然而，仅靠提示词（prompting）不足以生成这种定制化解释，且目前缺乏其他计算方法。
AI.method: 首先识别特定目标群体在解释风格和知识方面的群体特有属性，然后基于激活工程技术计算属性引导向量，并在LLM推理过程中将其添加到内部激活中以实现细粒度引导。
AI.result: 实验从特异性（specificity）和事实性（factuality）两方面评估引导效果，并邀请不同目标群体的人类专家对解释进行评估。结果表明，与提示词方法及最先进的引导基线相比，该方法能显著更好地将解释定制到目标群体，同时基本保持事实准确性。
AI.conclusion: 基于激活工程的属性引导方法能够有效提升LLM生成解释的群体定制化能力，在保持事实性的前提下实现比提示词更好的定制效果，为个性化解释生成提供了可行的计算路径。

title: ReconSplat: Generalizable 3D Scene Reconstruction Beyond Observed Views
comment: ECCV 2026. Code and additional visual results are available on our project page: https://visinf.github.io/reconsplat
summary: We introduce ReconSplat, a feed-forward model for 3D scene reconstruction that aims to address the longstanding trade-off between plausible view generation for unobserved regions and geometric consistency, providing both geometrically aligned novel views and sharp depth estimates. Our approach builds on 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) as an intermediate differentiable scene representation and integrates it with a multi-view latent diffusion model (MV-LDM) trained to act simultaneously as a refiner and an inpainter for appearance and scene geometry. We enforce geometric consistency by guiding the diffusion process with variational 3D latent features for appearance and geometry, encoded by the feed-forward 3DGS representation and rasterized to 2D latent space. ReconSplat produces both photorealistic novel views and accurate depth maps on real-world benchmarks, RealEstate10K and DL3DV-10K, outperforming existing methods in challenging extrapolation setups. Notably, ReconSplat allows the extrapolation of unseen and challenging viewpoints jointly with coherent and precise scene geometry.

AI.tldr: ReconSplat是一种前馈式3D场景重建模型，基于3D高斯泼溅和条件多视角潜在扩散模型，在保证几何一致性的同时实现逼真的未观察区域视图生成，并在RealEstate10K和DL3DV-10K基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有3D重建方法长期面临两难困境：一方面要生成未观察区域的合理视图，另一方面又要保持几何一致性。这两者往往难以兼顾，作者希望同时获得几何对齐的新视图和精确的深度估计。
AI.method: 以3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）作为中间可微场景表示，集成一个多视角潜在扩散模型（MV-LDM），同时充当精炼器和修补器。通过前馈3DGS编码的外观和几何变分3D潜在特征引导扩散过程，并将其栅格化到2D潜在空间以强制几何一致性。
AI.result: 在真实世界基准RealEstate10K和DL3DV-10K上，ReconSplat同时生成逼真的新视角和准确的深度图，在具有挑战性的外推设置下优于现有方法，能够外推未见且困难的视角并获得连贯精确的场景几何。
AI.conclusion: ReconSplat成功解决了新视图生成与几何一致性之间的权衡问题，证明了结合3DGS表示与条件潜在扩散模型可以同时获得高质量的视觉外观和精确的场景几何，特别适合视角外推场景。

title: Anchoring Speech with Semantics: A Multimodal Adapter Mechanism for Automatic Speech Recognition in Low-Resource Languages
summary: Low-resource ASR remains difficult because scarce transcripts provide limited supervised evidence for target-side generation. To address this gap, we propose SAMA-ASR, a lightweight adapter mechanism that augments the decoder with semantic anchors from auxiliary translations and an acoustic anchor from speech; in principle, the mechanism can be applied to similar encoder--decoder multitask speech models. Through cross-modal adaptation, SAMA-ASR conditions decoder states on translation-derived semantic embeddings and a speech embedding, combining utterance-level meaning with speech-grounded evidence before token prediction. At evaluation time, these semantic anchors can be generated automatically by an upstream speech-to-text translator rather than supplied as oracle translations. Experiments on two 30-hour datasets covering the low-resource Sinitic varieties Taiwanese Hokkien and Hakka show that SAMA-ASR improves over acoustic, prior prompt-based, and semantic-only translation-guided baselines and remains effective in practical automatic semantic-anchor settings; translator-capacity analyses show that useful semantic anchors can be produced by a compact ST model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAMA-ASR，一种轻量级适配器机制，通过引入来自辅助翻译的语义锚点和来自语音的声学锚点来增强解码器，以解决低资源ASR中监督信号不足的问题。在台湾闽南语和客家话两个30小时数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于多种基线方法，且紧凑的语音翻译模型即可生成有效的语义锚点。
AI.motivation: 低资源语音识别（ASR）面临的一个核心难题是：稀缺的转录文本只能为解码端生成提供有限的监督信号，导致模型难以充分学习目标侧的语义与词汇映射关系，性能受限。
AI.method: SAMA-ASR采用轻量级适配器机制，通过跨模态适配，将来自辅助机器翻译的语义嵌入（语义锚点）和语音嵌入（声学锚点）注入解码器状态，在词预测前融合话语级语义信息与语音证据。训练时使用oracle翻译，推理时由上游语音到文本翻译模型自动生成语义锚点。该机制可应用于类似的编码器-解码器多任务语音模型。
AI.result: 在两个30小时的低资源汉语方言（台湾闽南语、客家话）数据集上，SAMA-ASR优于纯声学基线、基于提示词的方法以及纯语义翻译引导的基线；在实用的自动语义锚点设定下依然有效；翻译器容量分析表明，紧凑的ST模型即可产生有用的语义锚点。
AI.conclusion: SAMA-ASR通过结合语义锚点与声学锚点的跨模态适配，有效缓解了低资源ASR中监督信号不足的问题，并且在实际推理场景（自动生成语义锚点而非oracle翻译）下仍能保持鲁棒性能，为低资源语音识别提供了一种轻量且可迁移的解决方案。

title: Coarse to Fine: Iterative Adversarial Neural Cellular Automata for Medical Image Synthesis
summary: Large-scale, publicly available datasets have driven advances in deep learning, but privacy and legal restrictions often limit data sharing in medical imaging. Synthetic data generation offers a privacy-friendly alternative to enable the training of high-performance models on health data. While most state-of-the-art generative models produce high-quality images, they remain computationally expensive, which limits their applicability on resource-constrained hardware. We propose StyleGANCA, the first lightweight general-purpose NCA-based generative adversarial network. The architecture integrates a StyleGAN-inspired mapping network and adaptive style modulation into a multi-scale NCA synthesis process, enabling latent-controlled image generation through iterative local interactions. We evaluate StyleGANCA on BloodMNIST and PathMNIST against adversarial, variational, diffusion, and NCA-based baselines. Experimental results demonstrate that StyleGANCA achieves competitive image quality with substantially fewer parameters than baseline architectures, achieving the best FID and KID scores on PathMNIST with only 617k parameters. Furthermore, downstream experiments show that the generated images preserve class-specific information and effectively support the training of multi-class classifiers. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/MECLabTUDA/StyleGANCA

AI.tldr: 本文提出StyleGANCA，第一个轻量级通用NCA（神经细胞自动机）生成对抗网络，通过结合StyleGAN风格映射网络和自适应风格调制到多尺度NCA合成过程中，实现潜变量控制的图像生成。在BloodMNIST和PathMNIST上，StyleGANCA仅用617k参数即在PathMNIST上取得最佳FID和KID分数，且生成图像能保留类别信息并有效支持多类分类器训练。
AI.motivation: 医学影像领域因隐私和法律限制难以共享数据，合成数据生成是隐私友好的替代方案。现有最先进的生成模型虽然能产生高质量图像，但计算成本高昂，难以在资源受限的硬件上部署，因此需要一种轻量级且高质量的图像生成模型。
AI.method: StyleGANCA将StyleGAN启发的映射网络和自适应风格调制集成到多尺度NCA合成过程中，通过迭代局部交互实现潜变量控制的图像生成。该方法融合了StyleGAN的风格控制能力与NCA的轻量级局部计算特性，是一种多尺度的NCA-based GAN架构。
AI.result: 在BloodMNIST和PathMNIST上与对抗、变分、扩散及NCA基线对比，StyleGANCA以远少于基线架构的参数取得具有竞争力的图像质量，在PathMNIST上以仅617k参数获得最佳FID和KID分数。下游实验表明生成图像保留了类别特定信息并能有效支持多类分类器训练。
AI.conclusion: StyleGANCA证明了NCA-based轻量级生成模型能够在不牺牲图像质量的前提下大幅降低参数规模，为资源受限环境下的医学图像合成提供了可行的隐私友好方案，并具备良好的下游分类任务适用性。

title: When Patients Cut In: Extending Clinical Conversational AI Safety to Interruptions
summary: Clinical voice agents are now deployed in routine care, where real patients do not wait their turn: they interrupt. These systems typically use a cascaded architecture (speech-to-text -> LLM -> text-to-speech), so when a patient cuts the agent off mid-utterance, clinically required content can be lost even when the model handles cooperative transcripts well. Yet clinical conversational-AI benchmarks almost universally assume patients wait for the agent to finish, missing interruption-induced loss of required content. We present a transcript-based evaluation of interruption recovery, adapting conversation-analytic overlap categories into three operational types (recognitional, competitive, transitional sub-unit) and testing four deployment-oriented, non-reasoning LLM configurations across four cells spanning history-taking (information gathering) and FAQ (information provision), scored on whether the agent preserves the clinically required content. In the gathering cells, target-question failure varied across models; in the provision cells, where arms are directly comparable, failure rose for every model. Rankings differ across cells, and competitive FAQ interruption produced 30/30 provision-coverage failures for all four models (Wilson 95% CI: 88.6-100.0%; baseline 0/30 for three, 4/30 for Llama). A brief apology marker ("sorry to interrupt") shifts recovery by tens of percentage points, inconsistently across models, and for one it reduces recovery. Interruption robustness therefore cannot be a single score: evaluation must be content-grounded, reported per cell, and matched to the deployment's interruption profile.

AI.tldr: 本文指出临床语音智能体在真实场景中常被患者打断，导致临床必需内容丢失，而现有临床对话AI基准几乎都假设患者等待说完。作者将对话分析中的重叠类别改编为三种操作性打断类型，测试四种部署导向的LLM配置在病史采集和FAQ两类任务中的打断恢复能力，发现不同场景下模型表现排名不同，竞争性FAQ打断导致所有模型100%失败，且道歉标记的影响因模型而异。
AI.motivation: 真实临床环境中患者会打断智能体的发言，打断会导致临床必需信息丢失，但现有临床对话AI基准普遍假设患者按顺序等待，未能评估打断带来的内容丢失问题，缺乏针对性的评估框架。
AI.method: 将对话分析中的重叠类别改编为三种操作性打断类型（认知识别型、竞争型、转换子单元型），在病史采集（信息收集）和FAQ（信息提供）四个单元格中，测试四种非推理LLM配置的打断恢复能力，并引入"对不起打断一下"道歉标记，以是否保留临床必需内容为评分标准。
AI.result: 在信息收集单元格中目标问题失败率因模型而异；在信息提供单元格中所有模型的失败率均上升。竞争型FAQ打断导致四种模型全部30/30提供覆盖失败（Wilson 95% CI: 88.6-100.0%；基线0/30对三种模型，Llama为4/30）。道歉标记的作用不一致，对一种模型反而降低了恢复效果。
AI.conclusion: 打断鲁棒性不能用一个单一分数衡量：评估必须基于内容、按单元格分报告，并与部署场景的打断特征相匹配。

title: mmIR: Frequency-Space Inverse Rendering for 3D Millimeter-Wave Radar ADC Synthesis
comment: Accepted to the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026. Project page: https://mmwave-inverse-rendering.github.io/
summary: High-resolution 3D radar data is scarce. Commodity mmWave sensors use small antenna arrays that limit angular resolution to several degrees, and existing datasets provide only 2D range-azimuth maps or sparse point clouds rather than raw analog-to-digital converter (ADC) signals. Hardware scaling is expensive, synthetic-aperture scanning is impractical at fleet scale, and learned synthesis methods are bottlenecked by the very data shortage they aim to address. We present mmIR, an open-source differentiable frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radar inverse renderer that fits a physics-based forward model to real captures and re-renders from dense virtual apertures to synthesize high-resolution 3D radar data. Because radar resolution is too coarse to recover geometry directly, mmIR performs LiDAR-assisted inverse rendering: using LiDAR-derived meshes as a geometric scaffold, mmIR optimizes per-vertex International Telecommunication Union (ITU) physics materials, vertex normals, and antenna beam patterns through end-to-end automatic differentiation of a phase-coherent multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) forward model with multi-bounce propagation, polarization, and free-space diffraction. On seven outdoor and six indoor ColoRadar scenes, mmIR achieves 0.914 mean Pearson correlation on range-azimuth maps versus 0.307 for Sionna-RT. Scenes trained on a cascaded imaging radar transfer to a co-located single-chip radar without re-training (0.554 correlation), and dense virtual arrays (100x100 elements) produce single-frame 3D occupancy validated against LiDAR. Project page: https://mmwave-inverse-rendering.github.io/

AI.tldr: mmIR是一个开源的、基于物理的可微分FMCW雷达逆渲染器，通过LiDAR辅助逆向渲染将真实雷达采集拟合为物理前向模型，再从密集虚拟孔径重新渲染，合成高分辨率3D雷达数据，解决了毫米波雷达原始数据稀缺的问题。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率3D雷达数据稀缺，商品级毫米波传感器天线阵列小导致角度分辨率低，现有数据集仅提供2D距离-方位图或稀疏点云而非原始ADC信号；硬件扩展昂贵、机械扫描不实用、学习方法受数据短缺制约，亟需一种能从有限真实数据合成高分辨率3D雷达数据的方法。
AI.method: mmIR采用LiDAR辅助逆渲染：以LiDAR导出的网格作为几何骨架，通过端到端自动微分优化顶点级ITU物理材质、顶点法线和天线波束模式；使用包含多路径传播、极化和自由空间衍射的相位相干MIMO前向模型，将物理模型拟合到真实FMCW雷达采集数据，再从密集虚拟孔径重新渲染生成高分辨率3D雷达数据。
AI.result: 在7个室外和6个室内ColoRadar场景上，mmIR在距离-方位图上达到0.914的平均Pearson相关系数（对比Sionna-RT的0.307）；在级联成像雷达上训练的场景无需重新训练即可迁移到共置单芯片雷达（0.554相关性）；密集虚拟阵列（100x100个单元）生成的单帧3D占用经LiDAR验证有效。
AI.conclusion: mmIR证明了基于物理的逆渲染方法能够有效合成高分辨率3D雷达数据，显著优于现有仿真工具，且具备跨硬件平台的迁移能力，为雷达数据稀缺问题提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Large Language Models Systematically Favor Popular Options: Evidence and Mitigation Across MCQs
summary: Multiple-choice questions (MCQs) are a standard format for evaluating large language models (LLMs), yet the popularity of answer options can confound evaluation. Modern LLMs systematically prefer popular but incorrect options over less popular correct ones, a vulnerability we call \textbf{popularity bias}. This pattern aligns with confidence miscalibration: model confidence remains high even as accuracy collapses for popular options. To systematically isolate this phenomenon, we introduce \textbf{PopMCQ}, a benchmark with six controlled strategies that vary option popularity while keeping the correct answer fixed. In our most adversarial setting, where all distractors are more popular than the correct option, models choose popular but wrong answers 66\% of the time. To mitigate this bias, we propose \textbf{PopDebias}, a lightweight inference-time correction that estimates and removes a popularity prior from model predictions. It requires no fine-tuning, is label-free at test time (using only a small calibration split for parameter fitting), and adds negligible computational cost. Experiments on 22 open-source LLMs (0.5B to 32B parameters) show consistent improvements, with accuracy gains up to 54.1 percentage points under strong popularity pressure. The code and data are available https://github.com/DataScienceUIBK/PopMCQ

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了大规模语言模型在多项选择题中存在"流行度偏置"——模型系统性地偏好热门但不正确的选项，并提出了PopMCQ基准和PopDebias轻量级推理时校正方法，在22个开源LLM上最高提升54.1个百分点的准确率。
AI.motivation: 多项选择题是评估LLM的标准格式，但选项的流行度会混淆评估结果。现代LLM存在"流行度偏置"：即使热门选项是错误的，模型仍倾向于选择它们，这一现象与置信度校准失调相关，亟需系统性地研究和解决。
AI.method: 提出PopMCQ基准，包含六种控制策略来改变选项流行度同时保持正确答案不变；提出PopDebias，一种轻量级推理时校正方法，通过估计并从模型预测中移除流行度先验，无需微调，测试时无需标签，仅需少量校准集拟合参数。
AI.result: 在最对抗性设置（所有干扰项都比正确答案更流行）下，模型66%的时间选择热门但错误的答案。在22个开源LLM（0.5B到32B参数）上的实验显示一致性改进，在强流行度压力下准确率最高提升54.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 流行度偏置是LLM评估中一个重要的混淆因素，PopDebias作为轻量级、无微调、计算开销极小的校正方法能有效缓解该偏置，为更可靠的LLM评估提供了实用方案。

title: ActiveAugment: Online Active Learning for Augmentation Selection in Deep Learning
summary: Data augmentation is a cornerstone of deep learning pipelines, yet existing strategies treat it as a static, model-agnostic preprocessing step, either relying on expensive dataset-specific policy search or applying transformations uniformly at random, regardless of what the model has already learned. We introduce ActiveAugment, a unified framework that treats augmentation selection as an online active learning problem. For each training minibatch, ActiveAugment generates a pool of candidate augmented views and scores each candidate using a combination of the model's predictive uncertainty and the feature discrepancy induced by the augmentation. The augmentation under which the current model is most fragile is selected per sample, and the model is then trained with a joint supervised classification and supervised contrastive objective that enforces intra-class invariance to the selected augmentations while maintaining inter-class separation. We evaluate ActiveAugment on eight benchmark datasets spanning natural and medical imaging, using CNN and transformer architectures across three training regimes (training from scratch, full fine-tuning, and linear probing), and comparing eight active selection strategies for augmentation scoring. ActiveAugment outperforms AutoAugment, RandAugment, and TrivialAugment under controlled augmentation shifts across all domains and budgets, with the most pronounced gains at low labelling budgets. On medical imaging datasets, where data is scarce and domain shift relative to natural-image pretrained models is large, ActiveAugment achieves higher test F1 than all baselines, demonstrating strong cross-domain adaptability. Our analysis reveals that the augmentation selection policy evolves meaningfully during training and that strategy choice has a direct impact on generalisation. Code is available at: https://github.com/noahvide/ActiveAugment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ActiveAugment框架，将数据增强选择建模为在线主动学习问题，根据模型当前的不确定性和特征差异动态选择最具挑战性的增强方式，并在八个基准数据集上超越了AutoAugment、RandAugment和TrivialAugment等现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有数据增强策略是静态且与模型无关的，要么依赖昂贵的数据集特定策略搜索，要么随机均匀应用变换而不考虑模型已学到的内容，缺乏根据模型当前状态动态调整增强的能力。
AI.method: ActiveAugment将增强选择视为在线主动学习问题：对每个训练小批量生成候选增强视图池，基于模型预测不确定性和增强引起的特征差异对每个候选进行评分，为每个样本选择当前模型最脆弱的增强方式，并以联合监督分类和监督对比学习目标进行训练，强制类内不变性同时保持类间分离。
AI.result: 在八个覆盖自然图像和医学影像的基准数据集上，使用CNN和Transformer架构，在三种训练模式（从零训练、全微调、线性探测）下超过AutoAugment、RandAugment和TrivialAugment，在低标注预算下增益最显著；在医学影像数据集中相比所有基线取得更高的测试F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 增强选择策略在训练过程中会有意义地演化，策略选择对泛化性能有直接影响，ActiveAugment在数据稀缺和域偏移大的场景下表现出强大的跨域适应性。

title: SHADOWBENCH: Toward Reliable Automatic Evaluation of Semantic Alignment in Autoformalization
summary: Autoformalization translates informal mathematical theorems into code for proof assistants such as Lean. A central challenge is that current evaluation metrics can accept type-correct but misaligned statements or reject correct statements written in a different formulation. Inspired by Pass@$k$, we propose SA-Pass (*Semantic Alignment Pass*), which tests formal statements using auxiliary statements called *shadows* that characterize the intended statement. A generated statement receives full credit only when it compiles, implies each shadow (forward check), and is implied by their conjunction (backward check). We instantiate SA-Pass in ShadowBench, a Lean 4 full autoformalization benchmark of 178 postgraduate- to research-level problems spanning eight mathematical areas. Claude Code (Opus 4.8) with Numina-Lean-Agent reaches $61.8\%$ compile rate and $11.2\%$ SA-Pass. Across outputs generated by six agentic configurations, SA-Pass achieves $98.8\%$ binary agreement with expert judgments. An early version of ShadowBench served as the benchmark for Track 4 of the ICML 2026 AI4Math Challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SA-Pass（语义对齐通过率）指标，通过引入称为"阴影"的辅助声明来测试形式化语句的语义对齐性，并构建了ShadowBench（包含178个研究生到研究级数学问题的Lean 4全自动形式化基准），实验表明SA-Pass与专家判断达到98.8%的一致性。
AI.motivation: 自动形式化（将非正式数学定理翻译成Lean等证明助手代码）面临的核心挑战是：现有评估指标要么接受类型正确但语义不对齐的语句，要么拒绝用不同表述书写但语义正确的语句。需要更可靠的语义对齐评估方法。
AI.method: 受Pass@k启发，提出SA-Pass指标：生成的语句仅在以下条件下获得满分——能编译、蕴含每个阴影声明（前向检查）、且被阴影声明的合取所蕴含（后向检查）。基于此构建ShadowBench基准，包含178个涵盖八个数学领域的研究生到研究级问题。
AI.result: Claude Code（Opus 4.8）配合Numina-Lean-Agent在ShadowBench上达到61.8%的编译率和11.2%的SA-Pass。在六个智能体配置生成的输出上，SA-Pass与专家判断的二元一致性达98.8%。早期版本ShadowBench已用作ICML 2026 AI4Math挑战赛Track 4的基准。
AI.conclusion: SA-Pass通过前向和后向双向检查有效解决形式化语句的语义对齐评估难题，ShadowBench为全自动形式化提供了更严谨的基准，且SA-Pass指标与人类专家判断高度一致。

title: NBS: No Bias Stereo
summary: Stereo reconstruction is one of the last remaining Computer Vision tasks where all state-of-the-art methods employ a heavy architectural inductive bias. Even though it has been demonstrated that the task can be solved using general-purpose methods, it is widely believed that inductive biases in stereo are strictly necessary for both high-quality results and computational efficiency. We challenge this paradigm. In this paper, we demonstrate that both state-of-the-art accuracy and superior runtime efficiency are achievable with a model completely devoid of architectural inductive biases, relying instead on a simple, end-to-end Vision Transformer. By training on massive synthetic datasets, we show that pure data-driven learning can surpass explicitly engineered geometry. This work proves that explicit inductive biases are no longer a prerequisite for stereo matching, ultimately unlocking true scaling laws for continuous improvement in 3D reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了立体匹配中必须依赖归纳偏置的传统观念，证明一个完全无架构归纳偏置的端到端Vision Transformer模型，仅通过在海量合成数据上训练，就能达到最先进的精度和更优的运行时效率。
AI.motivation: 立体重建是计算机视觉中最后一个所有最先进方法都依赖重型架构归纳偏置的任务。尽管已有研究表明该任务可以用通用方法解决，但业界普遍认为归纳偏置对高质量结果和计算效率是严格必要的。本文旨在挑战这一范式。
AI.method: 提出一个完全去除架构归纳偏置的简单端到端Vision Transformer模型，并在大规模合成数据集上进行纯数据驱动的训练，不依赖任何显式几何先验或手工设计的匹配结构。
AI.result: 该模型在无归纳偏置的情况下同时实现了最先进的精度和更优的运行时效率，证明了纯数据驱动学习可以超越显式设计的几何方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式归纳偏置不再是立体匹配的先决条件，这为3D重建领域的连续改进解锁了真正的缩放定律（scaling laws）。

title: Modality Fault Lines: Structural Corruptions Reveal Fragile Omni-Modal Reasoning
summary: Omni-modal large language models are increasingly evaluated on clean text--vision--audio inputs, where every channel is present, synchronized, and readily interpretable. Such scores are often taken as evidence of robust cross-modal fusion, but clean evaluation cannot tell whether success depends on stable cross-modal structure or on cues sufficient only in intact inputs. To address this gap, we define a modality fault line: a boundary at which model behavior becomes unstable when a modality remains present and human-interpretable, but its internal evidence structure is perturbed. We introduce SCEval (Structure-Corruption Evaluation) a diagnostic evaluation protocol that keeps the question, answer space, and modality channels fixed while applying controlled structural corruptions to text, vision, and audio individually and jointly. Built from $273$ human-verified tri-modal examples from Social-IQ, OmniBench, and VALOR, SCEval evaluates $15$ proprietary and open-source omni-modal systems. The results show that structural corruption lowers clean accuracy, text--vision damage forms the most stable shared fault line, and multi-modal degradation is non-additive rather than a simple function of the number of corrupted modalities. Clean omni-modal accuracy therefore does not establish that a model will remain reliable when cross-modal evidence becomes structurally unreliable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCEval（结构破坏评估）诊断协议，通过对文本、视觉、音频模态施加受控的结构性损坏，评估15个全模态大语言模型的跨模态鲁棒性。实验发现：结构化损坏会降低干净准确率，文本-视觉破坏是最稳定的共享故障线，多模态退化呈现非加性特征。干净的跨模态准确率并不能保证结构失真情况下的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有omn-modal大语言模型评估多基于干净、同步、可解释的文本-视觉-音频输入，其高分常被误解为模型具备稳健的跨模态融合能力。然而干净评估无法区分模型表现是依赖稳定的跨模态结构，还是仅依靠完整输入下的充足线索。
AI.method: 定义"模态断层线"（modality fault line）概念，即当模态保持存在且人类可解释但内部证据结构被扰动时模型行为变得不稳定的边界。构建SCEval诊断评估协议，固定问题、答案空间和模态通道不变，对文本、视觉、音频单独及联合施加受控结构损坏。数据集包含Social-IQ、OmniBench和VALOR中273个经人工验证的三模态样例，评估15个专有和开源omni-modal系统。
AI.result: 结构化损坏会降低干净准确率；文本-视觉损坏构成最稳定的共享故障线；多模态退化呈非加性，并非简单随损坏模态数量增加而线性降低。
AI.conclusion: 干净的跨模态准确率不能证明模型在跨模态证据结构变得不可靠时仍能保持可靠性。SCEval揭示了当前评估范式的盲区，为omni-modal模型的结构鲁棒性诊断提供了新的方法论框架。

title: FractureFields: Contact-Aware Binary Multi-Field Transfer for Fractured 3D Gaussian Simulation
summary: Physics-integrated 3D Gaussian representations make it possible to simulate image-reconstructed assets directly as particles, but current Gaussia-MPM pipelines keep a single Eulerian velocity field even after fracture. When disconnected fragments share interpolation support, they still write to and read from the same grid nodes, producing cross-fragment momentum leakage that appears as residual adhesion and non-physical stretching. We present FractureFields, a topology-adaptive transfer for fractured 3D Gaussian objects. After a structural event assigns persistent fragment identities, FractureFields builds fragment-specific mass and momentum fields in a single P2G pass, advances each field independently, and performs a field-aware G2P update so particles only sample their own fragment's grid state. To handle re-contact, we add a momentum-conserving contact projection that applies equal and opposite normal impulses only when two fragment fields are approaching, preserving free separation otherwise. Experiments on reconstructed scenes and a controlled re-contact benchmark show that fragment-conditioned routing eliminates realized cross-fragment mixing by construction, while contact projection reduces interpenetration during collision without reintroducing residual coupling. Overall, we argue that post-fracture simulation should treat structural disconnection as a change in local dynamical state, not merely a change in constitutive stress.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FractureFields，一种面向断裂3D高斯物体的拓扑自适应传输方法。该方法在结构事件发生后为每个碎片构建独立的质点-网格质量与动量场，实现碎片条件化路由，从构造上消除交叉碎片动量泄漏；同时引入动量守恒的接触投影处理碎片重新接触，避免非物理粘连和拉伸。
AI.motivation: 现有的Gaussia-MPM管线在物体断裂后仍保持单一欧拉速度场。当断裂的碎片共享插值支撑时，它们仍会读写相同的网格节点，产生交叉碎片动量泄漏，表现为残余粘连和非物理拉伸。文章认为断裂后的模拟应将结构断裂视为局部动力学状态的改变，而非仅仅在连续本构应力上做修改。
AI.method: 1) 结构事件后为每个片段分配持久身份标识；2) 在单次P2G传递中构建碎片特定的质量和动量场；3) 独立推进每个碎片场；4) 执行场感知的G2P更新，使粒子仅采样其所属碎片的网格状态；5) 加入动量守恒的接触投影，仅在两个碎片场相互接近时施加等大反向法向冲量。
AI.result: 在重建场景和受控再接触基准上的实验表明：碎片条件化路由从构造上消除了实际出现的交叉碎片混合，接触投影在碰撞过程中减少了相互穿透，且不会重新引入残余耦合。
AI.conclusion: 断裂后的模拟应将结构断开视为局部动力学状态的改变，而非仅仅是本构应力的变化。FractureFields通过拓扑自适应的场传输策略，有效消除了碎片间的动量泄漏，同时保持了物理合理的接触行为。

title: Cloud and On-Premises Deployment of Uzbek Legal RAG via Targeted Retriever Fine-Tuning
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Industry Track). Project home: [https://metric-ai-lab.github.io/Uzbek-Legal-RAG/](https://metric-ai-lab.github.io/Uzbek-Legal-RAG/)
summary: Deploying large language models for legal question answering raises challenges that general-purpose leaderboards do not capture, particularly for low-resource languages and under hard operational constraints. We report on building and operating a retrieval-augmented (RAG) legal assistant for Uzbek that must run in two regimes: a managed cloud service that maximizes answer quality within a per-token cost ceiling, and an on-premises deployment for clients whose legal data may not leave their infrastructure, restricting us to open-weight models on limited local hardware under latency constraints. Because no evaluation existed for this setting, we build two domain benchmarks: a retrieval benchmark of 178 expert-annotated legal queries with gold provision spans, and an end-to-end benchmark of 504 expert-curated question--answer pairs scored by an LLM judge whose ratings we validate against human judgments and against an independent-family judge. Applying these benchmarks under each regime, we find the open-versus-proprietary gap is small and cheaply closed by fine-tuning. Therefore, we train UTE-1, which is a state-of-the-art text embedder among open models for Uzbek. We also demonstrate that closing the performance gap via fine-tuning is both impractical due to the intensive hardware demands of long-context legal Q\&A and unnecessary, given that legal acts change frequently. We support this by reporting a negative result from a QLoRA experiment. We distill practical guidance for similar deployments, drawn from a system serving real users in production. We release our benchmarks, evaluation code and the fine-tuned embedder (UTE-1) \href{https://metric-ai-lab.github.io/Uzbek-Legal-RAG/}{at this https URL} to support future work on low-resource legal NLP.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了为乌兹别克语构建和部署检索增强（RAG）法律助手的实践，该助手需在云端服务和本地部署两种模式下运行。作者构建了检索基准（178个专家标注查询）和端到端基准（504个专家策划问答对），发现开源与专有模型差距很小且可通过微调低成本弥补，据此训练了开源SOTA文本嵌入器UTE-1，并通过QLoRA实验的负面结果论证了面向长上下文法律问答的微调既不可行也无必要。论文发布了基准、评估代码和微调嵌入器。
AI.motivation: 通用排行榜无法反映低资源语言法律问答在硬性运营约束下的真实挑战，且该场景缺乏现成评估基准，因此需要构建专用基准并系统评估不同部署模式下的性能差距。
AI.method: 构建两个领域基准（检索基准与端到端基准），使用LLM裁判并结合人类判断及独立家族裁判进行验证；在云服务和本地部署两种模式下对比开源与专有模型；训练微调嵌入器UTE-1；通过QLoRA实验验证微调长上下文法律问答的不可行性。
AI.result: 发现开源与专有模型性能差距很小且可通过微调廉价弥补；UTE-1成为乌兹别克语开源模型中SOTA的文本嵌入器；QLoRA实验显示性能差距的弥补在长上下文法律问答场景下因硬件需求高和实践成本大而不可行也无必要。
AI.conclusion: 对于低资源语言的法律RAG部署，采用微调嵌入器比微调长上下文LLM更实用，由于法律条文频繁变动，轻量级持续更新策略优于昂贵的全量微调。基准与工具已开源以支持后续研究。

title: RoSe-SLAM: Robust Semantic-Aware Gaussian Splatting SLAM from Dynamic Monocular Videos
comment: Accepted by IEEE/RSJ INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCE ON INTELLIGENT ROBOTS & SYSTEMS (IROS), 2026
summary: In dynamic and unstructured environments, conventional SLAM systems generally suffer from significant accuracy degeneration due to their static assumptions. In this work, we propose Robust Semantic-aware Gaussian Splatting SLAM (RoSe-SLAM), to address the dynamic challenge by a holistic semantic scene understanding from uncalibrated monocular inputs, achieving accurate camera tracking and high-quality geometry reconstruction. Unlike conventional semantic SLAM using handcrafted semantic labels, our RoSe-SLAM exploits the semantic feature from 2D foundation model to enhance the dynamic tracking and mapping performance. By distilling the rich semantic features to our Gaussian fields, our method effectively identifies dynamic distractors and achieves semantic-aware multi-view consistency, significantly enhancing the geometric reconstruction and scene inpainting. Specifically, we propose a spatial-temporal motion mask generation module, enabling both long-term motion monitoring and short-term transient dynamics capturing, achieving robust and effective disentanglement of dynamic objects and static backgrounds. During global bundle adjustment, we propose an occlusion-aware keyframe selection mechanism to prioritize the occlusion as metric to pick the keyframes, and a multi-view semantic consistency module to improve the mapping quality in dynamic environments. By combining geometric motion cues with semantic priors, our system dynamically filters unreliable observations and reconstructs accurate static scene geometry. Extensive experiments conducted on benchmark datasets including dynamic TUM, Bonn and Wild-Mocap datasets, demonstrate that our method achieves superior performance in both trajectory estimation and static scene mapping, outperforming existing dynamic RGB SLAM baselines in long-term dynamic indoor environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RoSe-SLAM，一种鲁棒的语义感知高斯溅射SLAM系统，通过利用2D基础模型的语义特征、空间-时间运动掩码生成和遮挡感知关键帧选择，从单目输入实现对动态环境的准确相机跟踪和高质量静态场景重建，在多个动态基准数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统SLAM系统基于静态环境假设，在动态非结构化环境中会因动态物体的干扰而出现显著的精度退化，亟需一种能够处理动态场景的鲁棒SLAM方法。
AI.method: 1) 利用2D基础模型提取语义特征并蒸馏到高斯场中，实现动态干扰物识别和语义感知多视图一致性；2) 提出空间-时间运动掩码生成模块，同时捕捉长期运动监测和短期瞬态动态；3) 在全局束调整中提出遮挡感知关键帧选择机制和多视图语义一致性模块，结合几何运动线索与语义先验动态过滤不可靠观测。
AI.result: 在动态TUM、Bonn和Wild-Mocap基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在轨迹估计和静态场景建图方面均优于现有的动态RGB SLAM基线，在长期动态室内环境中表现尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 通过语义先验与几何运动线索的有机结合，RoSe-SLAM有效实现了动态物体与静态背景的解耦，在动态环境中取得了卓越的追踪精度和建图质量，为动态SLAM提供了新的解决思路。

title: Learning Simple Test-Time Environments for LLM Web Agents
comment: Code and data are released at https://github.com/THUNLP-MT/TTED
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in manually constructed environments, yet their performance frequently collapses when transitioned to complex real-world settings. Existing research largely attribute this degradation to the compositional generalization gaps in LLMs on combinations of multiple simple, well-structured environments. In this work, we propose that LLM web agents can learn simple environment observations at test time. Specifically, we introduce trial steps for agents to decompose a complex environment observation into sub-modules, and implement a label-free learning method, Test-Time Environment Decomposition (TTED), to adapt agent behaviors with experience during inference. Our empirical evaluations demonstrate the framework's efficacy across both synthetic and realistic benchmarks, showing (1) experience gains acquired within simpler sub-environments can be effectively composed to improve performance in the full one, and (2) test-time training on sub-environments can significantly enhance the compositional generalization of agents in real-world web automation tasks. We also provide key insights in the design of the label-free learning algorithm. As more complex environments are accessed by LLM agents, we believe learning environment decomposition skills at test time will be critical for robust real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出测试时环境分解（TTED）方法，让LLM网页代理在推理阶段将复杂环境观测分解为子模块，并通过无标签学习方式积累经验，以提升其在真实世界组合泛化任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: LLM代理在手工构建的环境中表现出色，但迁移到复杂真实场景时性能大幅下降。现有研究将此归因于LLM在多个简单环境组合上的组合泛化差距，需要寻找更有效的解决方案。
AI.method: 引入"试验步骤"让代理将复杂环境观测分解为子模块，实现无标签学习方法TTED，在推理阶段通过经验调整代理行为。该方法允许代理在较简单的子环境中获取经验，再组合用于完整环境。
AI.result: 在合成和真实基准上的实验表明：(1)子环境中获得的经验可以有效组合以提升完整环境的表现；(2)对子环境的测试时训练能显著增强代理在真实网页自动化任务中的组合泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 随着LLM代理接触更复杂的环境，在测试时学习环境分解技能对于真实世界的稳健部署至关重要。

title: Towards Fully Automated Medical Imaging Code Generation via Validation-based Context Engineering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated considerable promise in program generation for small-scale and conventional application development; however, they remain limited when applied to complex, domain-specific tasks such as medical image processing. General-purpose models lack explicit domain knowledge and robust validation mechanisms to ensure correctness, often requiring substantial human intervention to produce reliable processing pipelines. To address these limitations, we propose AutoMedImg, a multi-agent framework for fully automated medical image processing code generation. AutoMedImg orchestrates specialised agents across two phases: a Planning Phase that performs dataset analysis and architecture design with semantic and formal verification, and a Coding Phase that generates modules in parallel with static checking, execution testing, and assembly validation. This multi-stage validation mitigates error propagation throughout generation, while comprehensive auto-context engineering combining domain-specific knowledge bases, shared memory, and validation feedback automates context construction without manual prompting. A cross-project adaptive pipeline synthesis mechanism further accumulates validated pipelines and retrieves proven components for new tasks based on project similarity, enhancing generation efficiency through cross-project learning. Extensive evaluation across six diverse and well-established medical imaging datasets with five backbone LLMs demonstrates that AutoMedImg achieves zero human intervention, with Dice scores of up to 0.90 for segmentation tasks and 99% accuracy for classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoMedImg，一个多智能体框架，用于全自动医学图像处理代码生成。该框架通过规划和编码两个阶段的专业智能体协作，结合多阶段验证、自动上下文工程和跨项目自适应管线合成机制，实现了零人工干预的医学图像分割和分类任务，Dice分数最高达0.90，分类准确率达99%。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在通用程序生成方面表现出色，但在医学图像处理等复杂领域任务中，由于缺乏领域知识和验证机制，往往需要大量人工干预才能生成可靠的流水线，限制了其实际应用效果。
AI.method: AutoMedImg采用两阶段多智能体框架：规划阶段负责数据集分析和架构设计，并进行语义和形式化验证；编码阶段并行生成模块，同时进行静态检查、执行测试和组装验证。通过多阶段验证减少错误传播，利用领域知识库、共享记忆和验证反馈实现自动上下文工程，并通过跨项目相似的管线合成机制实现经验积累与复用。
AI.result: 在六个多样的医学影像数据集和五种基础LLM上的广泛评估表明，AutoMedImg实现了零人工干预，分割任务的Dice分数最高达0.90，分类任务准确率达99%。
AI.conclusion: AutoMedImg通过系统化的多智能体协作和多阶段验证机制，有效解决了LLM在医学图像处理代码生成中缺乏领域知识和验证能力的问题，实现了完全自动化的高性能管线生成。

title: Detecting and Repairing Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to BNAIC/BeNeLearn 2026 as a Type A paper
summary: Language models increasingly answer questions by consulting retrieved documents rather than memory alone, a design now common in search assistants and enterprise knowledge tools. Grounding a model in retrieved text reduces unsupported statements but does not eliminate them, and a reader cannot tell a grounded sentence from an invented one. Most research on this problem stops at detection, yet flagging a faulty answer changes nothing for the person reading it, and little is known about which action should follow. Using RAGTruth, a benchmark whose unsupported passages are annotated by hand, we split each flagged answer into individual factual claims, check each against the retrieved source, and compare leaving the answer untouched with three repair strategies of increasing richness: deleting an unsupported claim, replacing it with source text, and rewriting it. Three language models from different families judge the 916 repaired answers. Every strategy reduces the proportion of answers judged to contain unsupported content, and all three judges agree on the ordering. Deletion achieves the largest reduction while retaining least of the original answer, at 64.3% of the text, whereas rewriting retains 80.1% and reduces least. Repair is not confined to faulty answers: 83.5% of answers annotated clean are edited too. The strategies occupy different points on a grounding preservation trade-off rather than forming a quality ranking, and choosing between them needs evidence about answer usefulness that automatic metrics cannot supply.

AI.tldr: 本文研究检索增强语言模型生成答案的"修复"问题。使用RAGTruth基准将标记的错误答案拆分为事实声明，逐一对照检索源核查，比较三种修复策略（删除、替换、重写），由三个不同家族的LM对916个修复答案进行评判。所有策略均降低了包含无支撑内容的答案比例，其中删除策略降幅最大（保留原文64.3%），重写策略保留最多内容（80.1%）但降幅最小。修复不限于错误答案，83.5%的干净答案也被编辑。各策略处于"接地性-保留性"权衡的不同位置而非质量优劣排序。
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多止步于"检测"答案中的无支撑内容，但仅标记错误并不能帮助读者。对于检测到错误后应该采取何种修复行动，目前知之甚少，缺乏对下游修复策略的系统比较。
AI.method: 使用RAGTruth基准（人工标注无支撑段落），将每个被标记的答案拆分为独立事实声明，逐一与检索来源比对，比较三种修复策略：删除无支撑声明、用源文本替换、改写。由三个不同模型家族对916个修复后的答案进行评判。
AI.result: 所有三种修复策略均降低了被判定含有无支撑内容的答案比例，三个评判模型对策略排序一致。删除策略降幅最大但保留内容最少（64.3%），重写保留最多（80.1%）但降幅最小。修复不仅作用于错误答案，83.5%的干净答案也被编辑。修复策略占据"接地性-保留性"权衡的不同位置，而非形成明确的质量排序。
AI.conclusion: 修复策略之间不存在单一最优解，而是构成了"接地性"与"内容保留"之间的权衡光谱。选择哪种策略需要结合实际应用中对答案有用性的证据，而这类证据无法由自动指标提供。

title: Explainable Multi-Loss Distillation Framework for Efficient and Interpretable Shrimp Disease Text Classification
comment: Accepted at Journal of King Saud University Computer and Information Sciences
summary: Shrimp disease classification has become an urgent issue due to its significant impact on the import-export output of producing countries, particularly Vietnam. Most existing studies focus on image-based classification, which typically operates at the late stage of disease manifestation. Therefore, text-based classification has the potential to enable early and timely disease detection. To address this limitation, we introduce the SALT (Shrimp disease text Analysis with multi-Loss disTillation) framework, which incorporates explainability analysis using Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to evaluate model predictions and interpret the learned linguistic features. Experimental results demonstrate that SALT achieves competitive performance across multiple distillation objectives, outperforming supervised baselines while providing a favorable trade-off between predictive performance and computational efficiency. Moreover, it exhibits strong explainability, accurately identifying key linguistic features and semantic patterns relevant to disease descriptions. These findings highlight the potential of knowledge distillation-based text classification for future applications in early shrimp disease diagnosis and related research directions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SALT框架，利用多损失知识蒸馏进行虾病文本分类，并结合LIME和SHAP进行可解释性分析，实现了优于监督基线的性能与良好的计算效率。
AI.motivation: 虾病对越南等生产国的进出口造成重大影响，现有研究主要基于图像分类，只能在疾病显现晚期发挥作用，需要基于文本的早期疾病检测方法。
AI.method: 提出SALT（Shrimp disease text Analysis with multi-Loss disTillation）框架，采用多损失知识蒸馏进行文本分类，并集成LIME和SHAP两种可解释性分析方法来评估模型预测和解读学习到的语言特征。
AI.result: SALT在多个蒸馏目标下达到竞争性性能，优于监督基线，同时实现了预测性能与计算效率的良好平衡；在可解释性方面能够准确识别与疾病描述相关的关键语言特征和语义模式。
AI.conclusion: 知识蒸馏的文本分类方法在早期虾病诊断中具有广阔的应用潜力，为相关领域研究提供了新方向。

title: All You Need Is Non-Commutative Words
summary: We represent lexical tokens as unitary matrices and encode each sentence as their ordered product. The noncommutativity of matrix product captures word order without positional encodings (PEs). The same algebra yields several capabilities, including antisymmetric self-attention with no query, key, or value projections, and parallel composition of variable-length text chunks at a reduced attention cost. Furthermore, it provides a canonical-coset readout layer that encodes all true unitary degrees of freedom compactly, while supporting continual learning through nested group extensions that enlarge the operator space with each new task preserving prior representations exactly. Across standard text-classification benchmarks, the method matches or exceeds bag-of-words baselines. Achieving higher accuracy on IMDB and comparable performance on AG News. Notably, this is accomplished by replacing the conventional $\sim$30,000-dimensional vocabulary space with a dense, 64-parameter real-valued encoding, highlighting the expressive efficiency of our parameterization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用幺正矩阵表示词汇token，将句子编码为词的矩阵乘积，利用矩阵乘法的非交换性捕捉词序而无需位置编码。该方法还实现了无投影的反对称自注意力、变长文本块的并行组合、以及支持持续学习的规范陪集读出层。在标准文本分类基准上达到或超过词袋基线，用64参数的稠密实数编码替代约30,000维词汇空间，在IMDB上取得更高精度，在AG News上性能相当。
AI.motivation: 传统文本表示依赖高维词汇空间和位置编码，参数效率低且难以捕捉词序信息。作者希望找到一种更紧凑且能自然编码词序的文本表示方法，同时支持高效的持续学习。
AI.method: 将每个词汇token表示为幺正矩阵，句子编码为这些矩阵的有序乘积，利用矩阵乘积的非交换性自然捕捉词序。基于该代数框架，设计了无query/key/value投影的反对称自注意力机制，支持变长文本块的并行组合（降低注意力成本），并通过规范陪集读出层编码全部幺正自由度，利用嵌套群扩展实现持续学习。
AI.result: 在标准文本分类基准上，该方法达到或超过词袋基线：在IMDB上取得更高精度，在AG News上表现相当。值得注意的是，仅用64参数的真实稠密编码就替代了约30,000维的词汇空间，展示了参数化的表达能力。
AI.conclusion: 幺正矩阵乘积提供了一种紧凑、表达力强的文本表示框架，能自然捕捉词序，同时支持高效的自注意力和持续学习，为文本分类提供了一个不同于传统词嵌入和Transformer的新范式。

title: DocIntent: Answerability-Guided Agentic Restoration for Real-World Document Visual Question Answering
summary: Real-world degradations such as blur, shadow, distortion, and moire patterns severely impair the document question-answering capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Applying restoration tools before Visual Question Answering (VQA) is an intuitive solution. However, existing restoration approaches remain limited, as manually designing and executing restoration strategies is labor-intensive and requires domain expertise. Agentic restoration offers new possibilities for automation, yet existing frameworks primarily target natural images and pursue perceptual quality, overlooking that restoration should serve downstream tasks rather than optimize generic image quality metrics. To this end, we explore the value of agentic restoration for real-world degraded document VQA and propose DocIntent, a training-free Answerability-Guided Agentic Restoration framework. DocIntent first assesses question answerability, then identifies task-relevant degradations and selectively invokes restoration tools. A Comparison-Based Rollback mechanism validates each restoration step and reverts it when question-relevant evidence becomes less decipherable. The entire process requires no additional pretrained degradation classifier or image quality assessment model. Extensive experiments on the WildDoc benchmark show that DocIntent consistently improves the average score and consistency of different open- and closed-source MLLMs. The code and experimental data will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DocIntent，一个无需训练的、以可回答性为指导的智能体感知恢复框架，用于提升多模态大语言模型在真实退化文档上的视觉问答能力。该框架先评估问题可回答性，识别与任务相关的退化并选择性调用恢复工具，通过基于比较的回滚机制验证每个恢复步骤。实验表明该方法在WildDoc基准上显著提升不同MLLM的平均得分和一致性。
AI.motivation: 真实世界中的文档退化（模糊、阴影、失真、摩尔纹等）严重损害了多模态大语言模型的文档问答能力。虽然直觉上可以先用恢复工具进行预处理，但现有恢复方法需要人工设计策略且依赖领域专业知识，而现有的智能体恢复框架主要针对自然图像且追求感知质量，忽略了恢复应为下游任务服务而非优化通用图像质量指标这一核心需求。
AI.method: DocIntent包含三个核心步骤：首先评估问题的可回答性；然后识别与任务相关的退化并选择性地调用恢复工具；最后通过基于比较的回滚机制验证每个恢复步骤，当问题相关证据变得难以辨认时进行回退。整个过程无需额外的预训练退化分类器或图像质量评估模型。
AI.result: 在WildDoc基准上的大量实验表明，DocIntent一致性地提升了不同开源和闭源多模态大语言模型的平均得分和一致性。
AI.conclusion: 智能体恢复应以服务于下游问答任务为导向而非追求通用图像质量，DocIntent通过任务感知的恢复策略和回滚验证机制，有效提升了真实退化文档场景下的MLLM问答能力，且无需额外训练。

title: Padārtha: Ontology-Grounded Fine-Grained NER Benchmark for Classical Sanskrit
summary: Annotation schemas are not neutral. When applied to classical literature, tag sets developed for modern journalistic texts impose source-culture definitions on texts they were never designed to describe. We instead ground a schema in the tradition of the text itself introducing \textit{Padārtha}, the first ontology-grounded fine-grained Named Entity Recognition (NER) benchmark for Sanskrit, built on the \textit{Mahābhārata} epic. Our tag set derives from \textit{Nyāya-Vaiśesika}, a classical Indian ontological system, yielding 18 fine-grained categories organized under 10 ontological nodes and mapped onto five standard coarse tags, ensuring interoperability with existing benchmarks. Expert annotators label over 12.6K entries from a scholarly index of named entities, linked to corresponding mentions in the \textit{Mahānāma} corpus, producing fine-grained annotations for 108,335 entity mentions across 73,632 verses, along with a 5,000-verse expert-verified test set sampled to stress rare mentions. We present the first systematic benchmarking of generative NER against traditional architectures for Sanskrit, finding that fine-tuned generative models perform comparably to task-specific systems. However, all systems show a sharp decline from coarse to fine granularity and struggle with out-of-entity mentions unseen during training. The limitation is not due to data scarcity alone, as fine-tuned models recall unseen entities far worse than seen ones and tend to default to the majority sense under lexical ambiguity.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Padārtha，首个基于本体论的梵语细粒度命名实体识别（NER）基准，它基于《摩诃婆罗多》史诗构建，从古典印度本体论系统Nyāya-Vaiśesika派生标签体系，包含10个本体节点下的18个细粒度类别。研究者标注了超过12.6K个命名实体条目，在73,632节诗句中产生108,335个实体提及的细粒度标注，并提供了5,000节经专家验证的测试集。研究发现微调生成式模型与任务特定系统的性能相当，但所有系统在从粗粒度到细粒度时性能急剧下降，且在训练中未见过的实体上表现挣扎。
AI.motivation: 现有的注释模式并非中性——应用于古典文学时，为现代新闻文本开发的标签体系会将源文化定义强加于文本之上。作者主张应将注释模式扎根于文本自身的传统，因此需要为梵语古典文学开发一个基于其本土本体论传统的NER基准，而非照搬现代标签体系。
AI.method: 作者基于《摩诃婆罗多》史诗构建NER基准，标签集源自Nyāya-Vaiśesika古典印度本体论系统，形成18个细粒度类别组织在10个本体节点下，并映射到5个标准粗粒度标签以保持可互操作性。专家标注者从学术索引中标注超过12.6K个命名实体条目，在73,632节诗句中产生108,335个实体提及的细粒度标注，并构建5,000节经专家验证的测试集专门采样以应对稀有提及。同时首次系统性地对比了生成式NER与传统架构在梵语上的表现。
AI.result: 实验表明，微调生成式模型与传统任务特定系统在梵语NER上表现相当。然而，所有系统在从粗粒度到细粒度的过渡中性能显著下降，并且在处理训练中未见的实体时表现不佳。进一步分析发现，这一限制并非仅因数据稀缺——微调模型对未见实体的召回率远低于已见实体，且在词汇歧义存在时倾向于默认选择多数义项。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证实了注释模式应扎根于文本自身传统的必要性，并揭示了当前NER系统在细粒度分类和未见实体泛化方面的系统性局限。这为古典文本的自然语言处理研究提供了重要基准，同时指出了未来需要解决的关键挑战。

title: sRGB Real Noise Modeling via Noise-Aware Sampling with Normalizing Flows
summary: Noise poses a widespread challenge in signal processing, particularly when it comes to denoising images. Although convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have exhibited remarkable success in this field, they are predicated upon the belief that noise follows established distributions, which restricts their practicality when dealing with real-world noise. To overcome this limitation, several efforts have been taken to collect noisy image datasets from the real world. Generative methods, employing techniques such as generative adversarial networks (GANs) and normalizing flows (NFs), have emerged as a solution for generating realistic noisy images. Recent works model noise using camera metadata, however requiring metadata even for sampling phase. In contrast, in this work, we aim to estimate the underlying camera settings, enabling us to improve noise modeling and generate diverse noise distributions. To this end, we introduce a new NF framework that allows us to both classify noise based on camera settings and generate various noisy images. Through experimental results, our model demonstrates exceptional noise quality and leads in denoising performance on benchmark datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的基于归一化流（NF）的框架，能够根据相机设置对噪声进行分类并生成多样化的真实噪声图像，从而无需相机元数据即可提升图像去噪性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的CNN去噪方法假设噪声服从已知分布，限制了其在真实噪声场景中的实用性。虽然已有生成方法（如GAN和NF）能生成真实噪声图像，但现有工作依赖相机元数据，且采样阶段也需要这些信息，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 提出一个新的归一化流（NF）框架，能够估计底层相机设置，从而改善噪声建模并生成多样化的噪声分布。该框架同时支持基于相机设置的噪声分类以及多种噪声图像的生成。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该模型在噪声质量和去噪性能方面均优于现有方法，在基准数据集上取得了领先的去噪表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过估计相机设置来建模噪声，无需依赖采样阶段的相机元数据，是一种更实用且有效的真实噪声建模与图像去噪方案。

title: StageWell: A Process-Aligned Chinese Corpus for Positive-Psychology Support Dialogue
summary: Positive psychology dialogue aims to support emotional distress and positive resource building, requiring models to produce not only empathetic replies but also coherent progression through a multi-turn support process. Existing resources often reduce supervision to turn-level strategies or holistic preference labels, leaving process position, support function, and local repair targets implicit. We introduce StageWell, a process-aligned Chinese corpus for positive psychology dialogue, together with HQS, a structured protocol for data construction and evaluation. StageWell organizes support into a six-stage support process and uses a multi-agent whole-dialogue rewriting workflow to construct 12,445 SFT instances, 1,849 DPO preference pairs, and a GroundTruth subset of 120 expert-revised dialogues and 977 QA pairs. Guided by HQS, DPO pairs are built as process-localized repairs: flawed model outputs are used as rejected responses, and targeted rewrites under the same context and stage constraint are used as chosen responses. Across four 9B-14B open-source LLMs, this supervision yields robust gains in process control, response quality, and safety. Averaged across models, BERTScore improves by 0.037, Q-Overall increases by 1.32 points, S-exact increases by 0.236, and the H-critical rate decreases by 0.167. These results highlight the value of modeling supportive dialogue as a structured multi-turn support process rather than as single-turn response generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StageWell，一个面向积极心理学对话的过程对齐中文语料库，以及HQS结构化协议。StageWell将支持对话组织为六阶段支持过程，通过多智能体全对话重写流程构建了12,445条SFT实例、1,849条DPO偏好对和120条专家修订对话的GoldenTruth子集。基于HQS，DPO对被构建为过程局部化修复。在四个9B-14B开源LLM上验证了该方法在过程控制、响应质量和安全性方面的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有积极心理学对话资源要么将监督简化为单轮策略标签，要么使用整体偏好标签，导致过程位置、支持功能和局部修复目标等信息被隐含而非明确建模，缺乏对多轮支持过程的显式结构监督。
AI.method: 提出StageWell语料库和HQS协议：1）将支持对话组织为六阶段支持过程；2）采用多智能体全对话重写工作流构建数据；3）DPO偏好对通过过程局部化修复构建——以有缺陷的模型输出为拒绝响应，在相同上下文和阶段约束下进行针对性改写作为选择响应。
AI.result: 在四个9B-14B开源LLM上取得了稳健提升：BERTScore平均提高0.037，Q-Overall平均提高1.32分，S-exact平均提高0.236，H-critical率平均下降0.167。
AI.conclusion: 将支持性对话建模为结构化的多轮支持过程（而非单轮响应生成）能显著提升模型在过程控制、响应质量和安全性方面的表现，验证了过程级结构化监督的价值。

title: Di$^2$CycleSB: Towards High-Quality Unsupervised Nighttime Visibility Enhancement via Schrödinger Bridge Transformer
summary: Light-effect contamination poses a significant challenge to nighttime visibility enhancement. Most methods suppress light effects by estimating and decomposing them through prior-driven regularization, yet they are often limited by hand-crafted priors and ill-posed nature of decomposition. This work proposes Di$^2$CycleSB, a unsupervised Cycle Schrödinger Bridge Transformer framework guided by dynamic integral image priors, for high-quality unsupervised nighttime visibility enhancement. Specifically, a novel light-effect estimator is introduced to parameterize Gaussian-like adaptive priors by aggregating dynamic integral image representations for non-uniform glow estimation. Then, we propose a prior-informed Generator that exploits light-effect representations to guide long-range dependency modeling within our specific Transformer blocks. We formulate light-effect suppression as a Schrödinger bridge problem and construct forward and backward bridges with cycle consistency constraints to achieve visually pleasing enhancement. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate the remarkable effectiveness of our Di$^2$CycleSB in enhancing nighttime visibility. In particular, it achieves effective end-to-end light-effect suppression without any regularization constraints and image decomposition. The code and models are available at https://github.com/LHTcode/Di2CycleSB.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Di²CycleSB，一个基于Cycle Schrödinger Bridge Transformer框架的无监督夜间可见度增强方法，通过动态积分图像先验引导，无需正则化约束和图像分解即可实现端到端的光效应抑制，在真实数据集上取得了显著效果。
AI.motivation: 夜间可见度增强中光效应污染是重大挑战，现有方法依赖手工先验和分解估计来抑制光效应，但受限于先验的人为设计缺陷和分解问题的病态性，亟需更鲁棒有效的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出新型光效应估计器，通过聚合动态积分图像表示来参数化高斯类自适应先验以估计非均匀光晕；设计先验通知的生成器，利用光效应表示引导Transformer块内的长距离依赖建模；将光效应抑制形式化为Schrödinger桥问题，构建带有循环一致性约束的前向和后向桥实现增强。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集上的大量实验证明了Di²CycleSB在增强夜间可见度方面的显著有效性，实现了无需任何正则化约束和图像分解的端到端光效应抑制。
AI.conclusion: Di²CycleSB通过将光效应抑制建模为Schrödinger桥问题并结合动态积分图像先验，成功突破传统方法对先验设计和分解的依赖，为无监督夜间可见度增强提供了高质量、高效的新范式。

title: When to Adapt: Conditional Memory Adapters for Retention-Preserving Domain Specialization
summary: Large language models deployed in specialized domains must improve in-domain performance without sacrificing general capabilities. Existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods are typically always on: their learned perturbations are applied to every input, which can degrade out-of-domain (OOD) performance. We propose Engram Adapter, a framework that repurposes pretraining-time conditional memory as a post-hoc adapter for frozen LLMs. It uses multi-channel matching over local n-gram patterns with explicit occupancy tracking as a lightweight selectivity prior, making residual injection more likely on in-domain inputs while a learned scalar gate suppresses incoherent OOD retrievals. We evaluate on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B with AG-News and MedMCQA as adaptation tasks and OOD benchmarks spanning reasoning, translation, code generation, and legal reasoning. Engram Adapter improves in-domain accuracy while preserving 99.4%--100.1% of average OOD performance; on LegalBench it slightly exceeds the frozen base model on average, whereas comparable always-on baselines degrade sharply. Mechanistic analyses show that although OOD activations are non-zero, gate and projection attenuation reduce residuals to approximately 0.08% of hidden-state norm, yielding small KL drift and negligible accuracy change. These results suggest conditional activation is a promising route toward modular, retention-preserving domain specialization over frozen backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Engram Adapter框架，通过将预训练时的条件记忆重塑为后置适配器，利用多通道n-gram模式匹配和标签门控实现领域自适应，在Qwen3-4B/8B上提升领域准确性同时保留99.4%-100.1%的OOD性能。
AI.motivation: 现有参数高效微调方法通常是"始终开启"的，其学习到的扰动作用于所有输入，导致领域外（OOD）性能退化。作者希望在不牺牲通用能力的前提下提升专业领域性能。
AI.method: 提出Engram Adapter框架：1）复用预训练时期条件记忆作为后置适配器；2）使用多通道局部n-gram模式匹配并显式跟踪占用率作为轻量级选择性先验；3）对领域内输入更可能进行残差注入，同时用学习的标量门抑制不连贯的OOD检索。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上，以AG-News和MedMCQA作为适应任务，在推理、翻译、代码生成和法律推理等OOD基准上评估。Engram Adapter提升领域内准确性，同时保留99.4%-100.1%的平均OOD性能；在LegalBench上平均略超冻结基座模型，而始终开启的基线方法严重退化。机制分析显示OOD激活虽非零，但门控和投影衰减将残差降至隐藏状态范数的约0.08%，产生极小的KL漂移和可忽略的准确率变化。
AI.conclusion: 条件激活是实现在冻结骨干上模块化、保留性领域特化的有前景路径。

title: DReSG: Diffusion Residuals for Stylized Gaussian Splatting
summary: Reference-guided stylization of scenes represented by 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is important for efficient and controllable 3D content creation. Existing VGG-feature-based 3D stylization methods provide stable rendered-view optimization, but often under-represent expressive reference style cues; diffusion models offer stronger image priors, yet direct per-view or score-based diffusion guidance can lead to view drift, local artifacts, and hard-to-control appearance updates. We present DReSG, a 3D-grounded residual-feedback framework for stylized Gaussian splatting. DReSG represents attention-guided diffusion proposals as residual targets relative to the current render, and progressively absorbs these residuals into a shared Gaussian scene through multi-view Gaussian feedback. To make this feedback stable and controllable, DReSG modulates residual strength during target construction and combines coverage-aware view selection with conflict-filtered color updates during multi-view fitting. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DReSG achieves competitive reference-guided stylization while better preserving scene structure and cross-view stability. Our project page is available at https://vpx-ecnu.github.io/DReSG-website/.

AI.tldr: DReSG是一个基于3D高斯基元泼溅的残差反馈框架，通过将注意力引导的扩散模型提议表示为相对当前渲染的残差目标，并逐步将其吸收到共享高斯场景中，实现参考引导的风格化，同时保持场景结构和跨视角稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于VGG特征的3D风格化方法在渲染视图优化上稳定，但难以充分表达参考风格线索；基于扩散模型的方法虽有更强的图像先验，但直接逐视图或基于评分的扩散引导会导致视图漂移、局部伪影和外观更新难以控制。
AI.method: DReSG将注意力引导的扩散提议表示为相对当前渲染的残差目标，通过多视图高斯反馈逐步将残差吸收进共享的3D高斯基元场景中。在目标构建阶段调制残差强度，在多视图拟合阶段结合覆盖率感知的视图选择和冲突过滤的颜色更新，以保证反馈的稳定性和可控性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，DReSG在参考引导风格化上达到有竞争力的效果，同时更好地保持了场景结构和跨视图稳定性。
AI.conclusion: DReSG通过3D接地残差反馈机制有效解决了扩散引导风格化的视图漂移和可控性问题，为高斯基元场景的参考引导风格化提供了可行且稳定的新方案。

title: Arabic Safety Alignment as Selective Refusal: An Empirical Study of SFT, DPO, and Guard Calibration
comment: The Fourth Arabic Natural Language Processing Conference(ArabicNLP 2026)
summary: Arabic large language models must refuse harmful prompts without over-refusing benign or sensitive prompts, yet a single refusal rate hides this trade-off. We evaluate it using benign refusal B and harmful-prompt refusal H, where H measures refusal rather than harmful compliance. Across five Arabic-capable models and 130 runs on the full human-written AraSafe set, refusal-only supervised fine-tuning (SFT) collapses toward blanket refusal, whereas selected mixed-SFT configurations reach H = 90% to 93% at B = 14% to 23%; four selected configurations exceed the H = 90% target in all three runs, while Fanar does so in two of three. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and inference guards change B and H differently across models rather than acting as uniform upgrades. In a blinded 300-response audit, annotator binary-refusal agreement is 89.0% (kappa = 0.78); Qwen3Guard and Aya Expanse 32B reach 88.7% and 91.0% accuracy, respectively, with no conclusive paired difference. Selected SFT raises H on Arabizi for all five models, but none reaches 90%, showing only partial transfer from Modern Standard Arabic. Overall, the results support model-specific operating-point selection: set a deployment target and retain only interventions that improve it.

AI.tldr: 本文针对阿拉伯语大语言模型在拒绝有害提示与过度拒绝良性/敏感提示之间的权衡问题，提出采用良性拒绝率B和有害提示拒绝率H双指标评估。实验显示仅用拒绝监督微调（SFT）会导致全面拒绝崩溃，而选定的混合SFT配置可达到H=90%-93%、B=14%-23%的良好平衡。研究还发现DPO和推理护栏并非统一升级，并在人工审计中验证了标注一致性。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语大语言模型需要在拒绝有害提示和不过度拒绝良性/敏感提示之间取得平衡，但单一的拒绝率指标无法揭示这种权衡，需要更精细的双维度评估框架。
AI.method: 使用良性拒绝率B和有害提示拒绝率H两个指标，在AraSafe数据集上对五个阿拉伯语模型进行130次运行测试，比较仅拒绝SFT与混合SFT、DPO和推理护栏等不同干预策略的效果，并进行300条响应的盲审。
AI.result: 仅拒绝SFT会导致全面拒绝崩溃；选定的混合SFT配置达到H=90%-93%、B=14%-23%；四个选定配置在三次运行中均超过H=90%目标；DPO和推理护栏对不同模型产生不同影响；标注者一致性达89.0%（kappa=0.78）；SFT对Arabizi的提升有限，无模型达到90%有害拒绝率。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持针对具体模型选择操作点：设定部署目标并仅保留能改善该目标的干预措施。阿拉伯语模型的有害提示拒绝能力需要模型特定的校准，而非通用的统一升级方案。

title: AdapToPASS: Ambiguity-aware Adaptive Spherical Transformer for Panoramic Semantic Segmentation
summary: Spherical Transformers have emerged as a promising framework for panoramic semantic segmentation (PASS) by operating directly on spherical geometry and alleviating projection-induced distortions. However, existing architectures often assume canonical spherical structure and stable viewpoints, which are frequently violated in real-world imagery due to unconstrained camera motion, introducing contextual and geometric ambiguity. Consequently, they lack adaptive mechanisms to handle such ambiguity, limiting robustness to unseen spherical transformations. In contrast, biological perception is inherently ambiguity-aware, adapting to fluctuations in cue reliability caused by geometric and contextual variations to maintain stable interpretation under complex transformations. Motivated by this, we first systematically analyze existing PASS architectures under various unseen spherical transformations. We then introduce AdapToPASS, a novel bio-inspired Spherical Transformer that adaptively models contextual and geometric ambiguities for robust PASS. At its core, Adaptive Spherical Attention (AdaSpA) blocks dynamically modulate attention according to local contextual ambiguity, mimicking adaptive, context-driven biological perception. To address geometric ambiguity, AdapToPASS employs Bifocal Spherical Representation to balance field of view and spatial resolution, together with boundary supervision inspired by the boundary-sensitive nature of biological vision. Across indoor and outdoor semantic segmentation, AdapToPASS consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods. Under unseen spherical transformations, it surpasses the next-best method by +13.38% relative mIoU on Stanford2D3D and +18.77% on WildPASS. We further introduce AdapToPASS-Swift, a lightweight variant with fewer than 2M parameters, which surpasses compact baselines while retaining robustness to spherical transformations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdapToPASS，一种受生物感知启发的球形Transformer，通过自适应建模上下文和几何歧义来提升全景语义分割的鲁棒性，在未见球形变换下显著优于现有方法，并引入轻量级变体AdapToPASS-Swift。
