AI.motivation: 现有球形Transformer假设规范球形结构和稳定视点，在真实世界中因相机自由运动常被违反，导致上下文和几何歧义，缺乏自适应处理机制，鲁棒性受限。而生物感知天然具有歧义感知能力，可适应线索可靠性的波动以维持稳定解读。
AI.method: 首先系统分析现有PASS架构在各种未见球形变换下的表现；然后提出AdapToPASS，核心是自适应球形注意力（AdaSpA）块，根据局部上下文歧义动态调制注意力；采用双焦球形表示平衡视场与空间分辨率；结合边界监督模拟生物视觉的边界敏感性。
AI.result: AdapToPASS在室内外语义分割任务中一致优于现有SOTA方法；在未见球形变换下，相对mIoU在Stanford2D3D上超出次优方法+13.38%，在WildPASS上超出+18.77%；轻量级变体AdapToPASS-Swift参数少于2M，超越紧凑基线且保持球形变换鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 生物启发的自适应歧义建模策略能有效提升球形Transformer对真实世界变换的鲁棒性，为PASS领域提供了新的建模思路和高性能轻量级方案。

title: AlgoWorlds: Benchmarking Tool Use for Global Optimization in Algorithmic Worlds
summary: Tool-use benchmarks generally evaluate whether an agent completes a workflow using appropriate tools and valid arguments. However, feasibility alone is insufficient in real-world decision settings such as route planning and fleet dispatch. Individual choices interact through shared constraints and costs, so a feasible solution may still be substantially suboptimal. This raises a harder question: can an agent turn information gathered through tools into a globally optimal decision? We introduce AlgoWorlds, a benchmark that transforms formally specified combinatorial optimization problems into partially observed decision environments with verifiable global optima. Each environment contains a hidden instance observed only through task-specific information tools, after which the agent commits to one structured decision evaluated for feasibility and optimality. AlgoWorlds contains 240 environments covering ten combinatorial optimization families and four workload levels. Family-specific deterministic programs generate the instances, exact algorithms certify their optima and determine workload levels, and two structurally different tool interfaces present each underlying instance. We evaluate seven leading LLMs, including Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.6 Sol. Achieving global optimality remains highly challenging: although leading models produce feasible decisions in most cases, the best-performing model reaches exact optimality in only 38.61% of cases. Even when agents collect sufficient information to reconstruct the hidden instance, most failures end in feasible but suboptimal decisions. The challenge therefore extends beyond information acquisition to information integration, global constraint reasoning, and decision verification. The project homepage is available at https://xzx34.github.io/AlgoWorlds/, and the code is available at https://github.com/xzx34/AlgoWorlds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AlgoWorlds基准，将形式化的组合优化问题转化为部分可观测的决策环境，用于评估LLM agent能否将工具获取的信息转化为全局最优决策。实验发现七个领先LLM中最好的模型仅能达到38.61%的精确最优率，揭示挑战不仅在于信息获取，更在于信息整合与全局约束推理。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用基准只评估agent能否用合适的工具完成工作流程（即可行性），但在路径规划、车队调度等真实决策场景中，个体选择通过共享约束和成本相互影响，可行解可能远非最优解。因此需要提出一个更难的评测问题：agent能否将工具收集的信息转化为全局最优决策。
AI.method: AlgoWorlds将形式化定义的单目标组合优化问题转化为部分可观测的决策环境，每个环境包含一个隐藏实例，只能通过特定任务的信息工具观测，agent随后提交一个结构化决策并评估其可行性和最优性。基准包含240个环境，覆盖十个组合优化家族和四个工作负载级别，使用家族特定的确定性程序生成实例，精确算法验证最优解并确定工作负载级别，还提供两种结构不同的工具接口。
AI.result: 评估了七个领先LLM（包括Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-5.6 Sol）。尽管领先模型在大多数情况下能生成可行决策，但最佳模型的精确最优率仅为38.61%。即使agent收集了足够信息重建隐藏实例，多数失败仍是可行但次优的决策。
AI.conclusion: 实现全局最优对LLM agent仍然极具挑战性。挑战不仅在于信息获取，更延伸至信息整合、全局约束推理和决策验证。该基准揭示了可行性评测与最优性评测之间的差距，为未来agent决策能力研究提供了新的方向。

title: Elastic Triangle Splatting
summary: While neural rendering methods such as 3D Gaussian Splatting achieve remarkable visual fidelity, traditional polygonal meshes remain the backbone of established graphics pipelines. Triangle splatting bridges this gap by optimizing triangle primitives as differentiable splats, producing representations that are closer to mesh-based workflows. Central to these methods is the kernel function that softens triangle boundaries to propagate gradients to vertex positions. Existing triangle splatting methods make inconsistent choices of kernel functions, and analysis of these kernels' optimization behavior has been limited to unstructured triangle soups for novel-view synthesis. In this work, we consider triangle splatting as a generic tool for photometric optimization, comparing kernel properties through two complementary tasks: mesh optimization for shape reconstruction and triangle soup optimization for novel-view synthesis. Along with the analysis, we introduce an elastic kernel function that features bilateral gradient support across the boundary and an adaptive boundary value, which are shown to be essential for robust optimization. Under isolated comparison, our elastic kernel outperforms existing kernels on shape reconstruction and in the majority of novel-view synthesis benchmarks, demonstrating the importance of kernel design in the effectiveness and versatility of triangle splatting.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了三角形光栅化（triangle splatting）中不同核函数的设计选择，并提出了一种新的弹性核函数（elastic kernel），该核函数具有双边梯度支持和自适应边界值，在形状重建和新视角合成两类任务中均优于现有核函数。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯光栅化等神经渲染方法虽然视觉保真度高，但传统多边形网格仍是成熟图形管线的核心。三角形光栅化通过将三角形图元作为可微光栅化模型来弥合这一差距，然而现有方法对核函数的选择不一致，且对其优化行为的分析仅限于无结构三角形网格的新视角合成任务，缺乏对核函数设计影响的系统性理解。
AI.method: 本文将三角形光栅化视为通用的光度优化工具，通过两个互补任务比较核函数性能：（1）网格优化用于形状重建；（2）无结构三角形网格优化用于新视角合成。在此基础上，提出了弹性核函数（elastic kernel），其核函数设计包含跨边界的双边梯度支持特性，以及自适应边界值机制，这两项设计对于鲁棒优化至关重要。
AI.result: 在隔离对比实验中，弹性核函数在形状重建任务中优于所有现有核函数，在新视角合成的大多数基准测试中也表现最佳，验证了核函数设计在三角形光栅化有效性和通用性中的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 核函数的设计选择对三角形光栅化的优化行为有显著影响，弹性核函数通过双边梯度支持和自适应边界值实现了更鲁棒的优化，展示了精心设计核函数对提升三角形光栅化在不同任务中通用性的重要性。

title: Evaluating the Semantic Specificity of Representation Steering in Language Models
summary: Localized Representation Steering (LRS) is widely used to correct reasoning pathologies in large language models. However, standard benchmark evaluations can easily be fooled by superficial label overrides, creating a false impression of reasoning circuit repairs. In this work, we propose Cross-Rule Transfer (CRT), a diagnostic framework that audits representational interventions by evaluating them on rule families where the model is natively competent. Evaluating late-layer LRS for a widespread logical failure, contradiction blindness, reveals that the intervention merely injects a global label bias: applying the steering vector to rules the model already handles correctly (99.6% baseline) degrades performance to 40.4% by forcing false contradiction predictions. We support this diagnosis with four complementary controls (direct logit bias equivalence, control vector label-flipping, cross-model grafting, and early-layer steering checks), providing a rigorous methodology to distinguish genuine reasoning repairs from superficial label overrides.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Cross-Rule Transfer (CRT)诊断框架，用于审计大型语言模型中的表征干预（如局部表征引导LRS）。研究发现，晚层LRS修复"矛盾盲区"时并非真正修复了推理回路，而是注入了全局标签偏置——将干预向量应用于模型本身已擅长的规则时，性能从99.6%骤降至40.4%。
AI.motivation: 标准基准评估容易被表面的标签覆盖所欺骗，造成推理回路得到修复的虚假印象。现有评估方法无法区分真正的推理修复与浅层标签偏置，需要更严格的诊断工具。
AI.method: 提出Cross-Rule Transfer (CRT)诊断框架，通过在模型本来擅长的规则族上评估干预效果来审计表征干预。结合四种互补控制实验：直接logit偏置等价性、控制向量标签翻转、跨模型移植、早期层干预检查。
AI.result: 晚层LRS干预对"矛盾盲区"的修复实际上是全局标签偏置的注入：将干预向量应用于模型已正确处理的规则时，性能从99.6%退化为40.4%，强制产生错误的矛盾预测。
AI.conclusion: CRT框架为区分真正的推理修复与表面标签覆盖提供了严格方法论，揭示了现有LRS干预评估的局限性和潜在误导性。

title: NFAD: Nuisance-Filtered Anomaly Detection Under Distribution Shift
summary: Recent advances in anomaly detection (AD) for industrial inspection have pushed performance on standard benchmarks toward saturation. However, strong benchmark performance does not necessarily translate to real-world deployment, as these benchmarks are primarily collected under controlled acquisition conditions. Changes in illumination, background, viewpoint, and other environmental factors can shift normal samples away from the learned normal distribution and cause false anomaly responses. We address AD under such distribution shifts by explicitly modeling nuisance variation from changing imaging conditions in feature space. Without anomaly labels or target-domain data, our Nuisance-Filtered Anomaly Detection (NFAD) framework estimates a nuisance subspace from matched feature displacements induced by content-preserving perturbations and suppresses its contribution to anomaly residuals at inference. The same subspace supports two complementary branches: full projection for image-level detection and selective suppression for pixel-level localization, preserving evidence of localized defects. On AeBAD-S, a benchmark specifically designed for AD under acquisition shifts, NFAD achieves 91.0\% image-level AUROC, establishing a new state of the art. Notably, this robustness does not come at the expense of conventional AD performance: NFAD remains competitive on standard benchmarks that do not explicitly evaluate distribution shift, including VisA, Real-IAD, and MVTec AD. These results show that explicitly suppressing such nuisance variation improves AD under distribution shift while preserving strong performance in standard settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NFAD框架，通过显式建模成像条件变化引起的扰动子空间来提升工业异常检测在分布偏移下的鲁棒性。NFAD从内容保持扰动诱导的特征位移中估计扰动子空间，并在推理时抑制其对异常残差的贡献，同时支持图像级检测和像素级定位两个分支。在AeBAD-S基准上达到91.0%的图像级AUROC，且不影响标准基准上的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有工业异常检测基准在受控采集条件下已达到饱和，但真实部署中光照、背景、视角等环境因素变化会导致正常样本偏离所学分布，引发虚假异常响应。现有方法忽视了这一分布偏移问题。
AI.method: NFAD框架：在特征空间中估计由内容保持扰动诱发的特征位移，构建扰动子空间；推理时通过全投影进行图像级检测，通过选择性抑制进行像素级定位，从而抑制扰动对异常残差的贡献。
AI.result: 在AeBAD-S基准上达到91.0%图像级AUROC，创下新纪录；在VisA、Real-IAD和MVTec AD等标准基准上保持竞争力，表明鲁棒性不牺牲常规性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式抑制扰动变化可以显著提高分布偏移下的异常检测性能，同时保持标准场景下的强泛化能力。

title: Whose Assessment of Distress? Community Perspectives and LLM Alignment on Well-Being Posts
summary: Judgments about psychological distress are socially situated: what counts as concerning hinges on community norms around emotional expression, vulnerability, and help-seeking. Yet large language models (LLMs) used for distress detection are typically aligned to a single, undifferentiated standard. How well do these models capture the perspectives of the communities whose language they assess? We address this question through a perspectivist annotation study in which 321 participants provided 9,587 judgments on 1,198 Reddit posts spanning six identity-based communities, yielding community-specific labels. Raters in the contextualized in-group condition show a modest tendency to agree more with their community than uncontextualized out-group raters (OR = 1.18), an effect varying significantly across communities. We then evaluate nine open-weight LLM configurations and four frontier configurations against these labels. Open-weight LLMs systematically over-estimate distress: when communities perceive none-to-mild distress, these models achieve only 31-44% accuracy, predominantly producing false positives. GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro show the same none-to-mild inflation even when their full-sample over/under rates are mixed, while Claude Opus 4 is more conservative. This pattern does not simply mirror an outsider reading position: uncontextualized out-group human aggregates were nearly symmetric, with 18% over-estimation versus 19% under-estimation. Instead, the models that inflate none-to-mild cases exhibit a distress prior that exceeds both contextualized in-group and uncontextualized out-group human judgments. These findings have implications for equitable AI deployment in mental health contexts, where miscalibrated distress detection may unevenly affect the communities being assessed.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一项包含321名参与者、9,587条判断、覆盖1,198条Reddit帖子、涉及六个身份社群的透视主义标注研究，评估了九种开源和四种前沿大语言模型在心理困扰检测中是否捕捉了不同社群的视角。研究发现，上下文内群体标注者更倾向于同意其社群标签（OR=1.18），而开源LLM系统性高估困扰（无到轻度困扰时准确率仅31-44%），Claude Opus 4相对保守，这一模式源于模型存在超过人类判断的"困扰先验"，对精神健康领域的公平AI部署具有重要启示。
AI.motivation: 心理困扰的判断具有社会情境性，取决于社群关于情绪表达、脆弱性和求助的规范。然而用于检测困扰的LLM通常对齐到单一无差别的标准，很少考察这些模型是否能捕捉被评估社群的观点视角，这可能导致检测偏差在精神健康评估中不均匀地影响不同社群。
AI.method: 采用透视主义标注研究设计：招募321名参与者对来自六个基于身份社群的1,198条Reddit帖子提供9,587条判断，生成社群特异性标签。设置情境化内群体（in-group）与非情境化外群体（out-group）两组人工标注条件进行对比，并评估九种开源LLM配置和四种前沿模型（包括GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Pro、Claude Opus 4）对同一任务的检测表现，通过比值比（OR）和准确率等指标进行系统性比较。
AI.result: 内群体标注者与外群体标注者相比，仅表现出微弱的同意社群倾向（OR=1.18），且该效应在不同社群间差异显著。开源LLM系统性地过度估计困扰：当社群认为无到轻度困扰时，模型准确率仅为31-44%，主要是误报。GPT-5和Gemini 2.5 Pro在无到轻度困扰案例中同样存在膨胀现象，而Claude Opus 4更保守。人工外群体的过度估计率（18%）与低估率（19%）几乎对称，但膨胀困扰的模型的先验明显超过了两类人类判断。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在心理困扰检测中过度依赖"困扰先验"，导致对无到轻度困扰案例的高估，这种失调的检测模式超出简单的外群体解读，可能对精神健康领域的平等AI部署产生不利影响，需要开发更能对齐社群多样化视角的检测模型。

title: GramLoop: Training-Free Gram-Gated Replay for Robust Dense Prediction
summary: We aim to improve frozen DINOv3 dense-prediction models under distribution shift by adding inference computation inside the visual backbone, without changing model weights, task adapters, or prediction heads. The challenge is that repeated transformer-block computation must refine dense features without disrupting the pairwise patch relations that DINOv3 uses to preserve spatial structure. We introduce GramLoop, a training-free framework that replays a short transformer window and controls each replay through final-layer cosine-Gram consistency. Each proposal is propagated through the frozen suffix, measured against the standard DINOv3 trajectory, and accepted through a patchwise gate at the replay-window endpoint. Across object detection and semantic segmentation under corruptions, perturbations, and natural shifts, GramLoop improves all five shifted benchmarks over the paired DINOv3 baseline. On COCO-O, it improves mAP by +0.252 and Effective Robustness by +0.250, while preserving clean ADE20K performance. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GramLoop，一种无需训练的推理时方法，通过在冻结的DINOv3视觉骨干内部重放短transformer窗口并利用最终层余弦Gram一致性进行控制，来提升分布偏移下的密集预测性能，在五个偏移基准上均超越基线。
AI.motivation: 已有的DINOv3密集预测模型在分布偏移下性能下降，而现有的鲁棒性方法通常需要改变模型权重或任务适配器。作者希望在保持模型完全冻结的前提下，仅在推理时通过在视觉骨干内部增加计算来提升鲁棒性，同时不破坏DINOv3用于保持空间结构的成对patch关系。
AI.method: GramLoop是一个无需训练（training-free）的框架：它在冻结的DINOv3骨干内重放一个短的transformer窗口，每次重放通过最终层的余弦Gram一致性来进行控制。每个候选proposal被传播经过冻结的suffix，与标准DINOv3轨迹对比度量，并在重放窗口端点通过patchwise gate进行接受/拒绝。
AI.result: 在物体检测和语义分割任务上，覆盖腐蚀、扰动和自然分布偏移，GramLoop在全部五个偏移基准上均优于配对的DINOv3基线。在COCO-O上mAP提升+0.252，Effective Robustness提升+0.250，同时保持干净ADE20K的性能不下降。
AI.conclusion: GramLoop证明了在不改变任何模型权重、任务适配器或预测头的情况下，仅通过在视觉骨干内增加受控的推理计算即可有效提升冻结DINOv3模型在分布偏移下的密集预测鲁棒性，并且不会牺牲干净数据上的性能。

title: AI Can Be Easily Persuaded in Clinical Decision Making
summary: As AI becomes increasingly integrated into clinical practice, it is playing a growing role in medical decision making. Medicine, however, is a high stakes and evidence based field, where decisions can directly affect patients' lives. It is therefore important to understand whether AI can maintain objective judgment when others try to persuade it. In this paper, we study how easily AI can be persuaded through controlled experiments. We find that professional authority, national background, institutional affiliation, claimed past performance, multiple physicians, supported clinician views, and repeated pressure can all affect AI decisions. Surprisingly, the same persuasive input changes about 10% more cases when it comes from a senior clinician than from a medical student. Simply claiming a better performance history consistently makes the physician more persuasive. More strikingly, a plausible clinician view can persuade AI away from a correct decision even when it is fabricated to support an incorrect answer. This indicates that AI can be strongly influenced by convincing support without reliably determining whether this view from the clinician is correct. Together, these findings suggest that AI can be easily persuaded by what people say, who says it, and how the opinion is presented. Therefore, it is essential for AI to maintain sound judgment under persuasion, enabling its safe and reliable use in high stakes medical decision making.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控实验研究AI在临床决策中是否容易被说服。研究发现专业权威、国籍背景、机构隶属、声称的过往表现、多位医生、支持的临床观点及重复施压都会影响AI决策。甚至捏造的支持错误答案的临床观点也能说服AI偏离正确决策，表明AI在医疗决策中极易受到说服性输入的影响。
AI.motivation: 医学是高风险、基于证据的领域，决策直接影响患者生命。随着AI越来越多地融入临床实践并参与医疗决策，需要理解AI在被他人说服时能否保持客观判断，这是安全可靠使用AI的前提。
AI.method: 通过受控实验（controlled experiments）系统地测试不同说服因素对AI医疗决策的影响，包括专业权威、国籍、机构归属、声称的过往表现、多名医生的意见、支持的临床观点以及重复施压等多种变量。
AI.result: 研究发现：来自高级临床医生的说服性输入比来自医学生的说服性输入多改变约10%的决策案例；声称更好的过往表现持续增强说服力；即使是为了支持错误答案而捏造的看似合理的临床观点，也能说服AI偏离正确决策。
AI.conclusion: AI容易被说话内容、说话者身份以及观点呈现方式所影响，且无法可靠判断临床观点是否正确。因此，必须确保AI在说服压力下保持稳健判断，以实现其在高风险医疗决策中的安全可靠使用。

title: Acoustically Grounded Cost Learning for Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Semantic Segmentation
summary: Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Semantic Segmentation (OV-AVSS) aims to perform pixel-level segmentation of sound-emitting objects from an open set of categories. The previous method relies on a class-agnostic foreground definition, which groups semantically diverse objects into a heterogeneous positive set, causing the model to learn unstable sounding patterns and produce unreliable proposals. To address this, we reformulate the objective to be category-specific and propose a novel Acoustically Grounded Cost Learning (AGCL) framework to transform the static, audio-agnostic visual-text priors into dynamic, audio-grounded cost representations. For intra-category soundingness discovery, we devise Audio-Modulated Cost Generation (AMCG) and Audio-Guided Temporal Aggregation (AGTA) modules to enable both frame-level sounding region highlighting and video-level temporal refinement with a low-intrusive audio injection mechanism. For inter-category distractor discrimination, we introduce a Synergistic Distractor Mining (SDM) strategy, which selectively penalizes acoustically and semantically confusing negative categories to learn more discriminative decision boundaries. Extensive experiments on the AVSBench-OV dataset demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms previous state-of-the-art approaches, particularly on unseen categories. Code is available at https://github.com/spyflying/AGCL.

AI.tldr: 本文针对开放词汇音视频语义分割（OV-AVSS）任务，提出了一种基于声学接地成本学习（AGCL）框架，通过音频调制的成本生成、时间聚合和协同干扰挖掘策略，将静态的视觉-文本先验转化为动态的音频接地成本表示，在AVSBench-OV数据集上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖类别无关的前景定义，将语义多样的目标归为异质正样本集合，导致模型学习到不稳定的发声模式并产生不可靠的提议，缺乏类别特定的声音感知能力。
AI.method: 提出AGCL框架，包含三个关键模块：(1) 音频调制成本生成（AMCG）和音频引导时间聚合（AGTA），通过低侵入性音频注入机制实现帧级发声区域强调和视频级时间细化；(2) 协同干扰挖掘（SDM）策略，选择性惩罚声学上和语义上易混淆的负类别，学习更具判别性的决策边界。
AI.result: 在AVSBench-OV数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在整体性能上显著优于先前的最先进方法，尤其在未见类别上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 通过将目标重新定义为类别特定并引入声学接地的成本学习框架，有效解决了开放词汇音视频语义分割中异质正样本带来的不稳定学习问题，验证了音频信息在引导视觉-文本先验动态转化中的关键作用。

title: Item-Mean Surrogates: Why Richer Persona Data Fail to Improve LLMs as Human Surrogates
comment: 37 pages, 6 figures, 14 tables. Includes Supporting Information (main text pages 1-9; SI Appendix pages 1-28)
summary: LLMs are increasingly used as human surrogates, often on the premise that richer persona data could make them substitutes or exploratory tools for specific individuals. We test this premise across four datasets covering more than 400,000 participants and more than 6,000 survey items and experimental outcomes. LLMs perform well at the aggregate level: their average responses closely align with average human responses to the same items. But this success largely reflects predicting each item's average human response. Once each item's human mean is removed, LLM predictions explain only 3.05% of the remaining respondent-specific variation, far below the 53.6% human test-retest benchmark. Richer personas, model variants, and fine-tuning do not close this gap. In variance analyses, once item means are removed, the reliable remaining signal is person-by-item. It captures how a respondent departs from the mean on a particular item and is about 8.9x larger than the stable person effect. Persona data encode the respondent, but not this item-specific deviation. LLM responses also compress human response distributions, using less spread, fewer response categories, and distorted distributional shapes. We call this pattern item-mean surrogacy. Current LLM surrogates can approximate item averages, but not the distributions or respondent-specific deviations needed to replace individual humans. We propose four empirical tests for LLM-based human-surrogate claims.

AI.tldr: 本文通过四个数据集、40万+参与者和6000+调查条目，系统检验了LLM作为人类替代品的可行性。发现LLM在聚合层面表现良好，能准确预测条目平均值，但一旦移除条目均值，LLM对个体差异变异的解释力仅为3.05%，远低于人类重测基准的53.6%。LLM响应压缩了人类响应分布，无法捕捉个体在特定条目上的偏差，论文将此现象命名为"条目均值替代效应"（item-mean surrogacy），并提出四项实证检验标准。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被用作人类替代品或探索工具，前提是更丰富的角色数据能让它们仿效特定个体。作者旨在检验这一前提是否成立，即LLM是否真的能替代个体人类而非仅预测群体平均水平。
AI.method: 在四个数据集上覆盖40万+参与者和6000+调查条目/实验结局，将LLM响应与人类响应进行比较。具体包括：移除条目均值后检验LLM对个体变异的解释力；对比人类测试-重测基准；分析方差中个体效应与个体×条目交互效应的大小；检验角色数据、模型变体和微调是否能缩小与人类基准的差距。
AI.result: LLM在聚合层面能很好预测条目平均响应，但移除条目均值后，LLM仅解释3.05%的个体差异变异（人类重测基准为53.6%）。更丰富的角色数据、模型变体和微调均无法弥补这一差距。方差分析显示个体×条目交互效应约为稳定个体效应的8.9倍，而角色数据只能编码个体，无法捕捉个体在特定条目上的偏差。LLM响应还压缩了人类响应分布，使用更少的响应类别和扭曲的分布形态。
AI.conclusion: LLM呈现出"条目均值替代"模式：能近似条目平均值，但无法替代个体人类——无法复现响应分布或个体特定的偏差。作者提出四项实证测试用于评估LLM作为人类替代品的合法性主张。

title: Dancing Stick Figures: An Introductory Dataset for Training Video Generation Models
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Dataset, code, reference models, and Colab notebook are linked from the paper
summary: Training a video-generation model from scratch is hard for reasons that precede model design. The feedback loop is long: a failure that appears only after a training run can make each attempted fix another run. The data are hard to reach: the corpora and recipes behind strong models are large, heterogeneous, and often unreleased. And scoring is blunt: open-ended generation has no single correct output, and an aggregate score does not by itself establish whether a sample succeeds or which property failed. Dancing Stick Figures is a synthetic video dataset built against these three obstacles. For iteration speed, its 64x64, 64-frame reference task is sized for practical repeated training on a single workstation GPU. For accessibility, the release is a 0.79-GB training tier of 4,020 video clips--1,340 six-second source motions, each rendered from three cameras by a deterministic dataset-generation harness--with checkpoints and a Colab workflow that reruns the reference training pipeline at reduced budget on a 16 GB Tesla T4. For scoring, every frame retains its generating state (ARDY cskel27 joint positions, camera, body parameters, and source motion) and per-pixel depth, surface normals, and part labels. These annotations support dataset-specific metrics for visible topology and part-wise motion; corruptions expose their sensitivities and blind spots.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了Dancing Stick Figures，一个合成的视频生成数据集，专门解决视频生成模型训练的三大障碍：训练迭代周期长、数据难以获取、评测指标粗糙。数据集包含4,020个视频片段，并提供丰富标注支持精细化的模型评测。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型从零训练面临三个根本性障碍：(1)反馈循环漫长，一次训练失败需要重新训练才能修复；(2)数据难以获取，大规模异质数据及其配方通常不公开；(3)评分方式粗糙，开放式生成没有唯一正确答案，聚合分数无法定位具体失败属性。
AI.method: 构建一个合成视频数据集Dancing Stick Figures，其设计针对上述三大障碍：任务规模设为64x64、64帧，可在单工作站GPU上重复训练以加速迭代；发布0.79GB训练数据（4,020个视频片段，1,340个六秒源动作从三个相机角度渲染），并附带检查点和可在16GB T4上运行的Colab工作流；每一帧保留生成状态（关节位置、相机、身体参数、源动作）以及逐像素深度、表面法向量和部件标签，以支持可解释的评测指标。
AI.result: 数据集支持可见拓扑和部件级运动的特定评测指标；通过引入数据损坏（corruptions）实验，揭示了这些指标的敏感性与盲区，验证了标注丰富的合成数据在模型诊断中的作用。
AI.conclusion: 通过精心设计的合成视频数据集，可以在加速迭代、开放数据、精细评测三个维度上显著改善视频生成模型的研究工作流，为视频生成领域的可复现研究和模型诊断提供了新基准。

title: Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness of Reasoning Models Varies with Where and How Preference Cues Are Delivered
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring assumes that reasoning traces faithfully record the information that shapes a model's answer. Existing faithfulness tests often place explicit bias cues in the user message, while agents may encounter preferences through tool returns or raw artifacts. We introduce FACE-Eval (Faithful Attribution of Cue Effects Evaluation), a 5,100-sample evaluation that varies cue location (user message or tool return) and explicitness (direct summary or raw artifact). We measure verbalized commitment among cue-following answers and unverbalized adoption among all cued samples. We evaluate 15 open-weight models from eight families, with total parameters ranging from 4B to 1.60T. Every model has lower verbalized commitment for tool-return than user-message cues and for implicit than explicit cues. Unverbalized adoption is higher for tool-return cues on all 15 models and for implicit cues in 28 of 30 model-channel comparisons. A source-attribution prompt narrows the channel gap on seven models, sometimes by increasing user-channel unverbalized adoption, while telling models that their reasoning will be monitored does not reliably close the gap. We also use two transcript monitors (GPT-5.6-Luna and GPT-4o-mini) to detect preference adoption in the largest model of each family. Across 32 model-channel-explicitness cells, higher unverbalized adoption is associated with lower detection ability for both monitors (Pearson r=-0.54 and r=-0.78, respectively). These results suggest that CoT monitoring may be less reliable when preference information arrives through tools or must be inferred from raw artifacts, within the single-call, prefilled-tool setting tested here.

AI.tldr: FACE-Eval是一个包含5100个样本的评估框架，用于测试思维链监控在偏好信息来自工具返回或原始工件时的可靠性。实验涵盖15个开源模型，发现所有模型在工具返回和隐式线索下的言语化承诺更低，未言语化采纳更高，且未言语化采纳与检测能力呈负相关，表明CoT监控在工具和原始工件场景下可能更不可靠。
AI.motivation: 现有CoT监控的忠诚度测试通常将显式偏好线索放在用户消息中，但代理系统可能通过工具返回或原始工件获取偏好信息。作者希望填补这一空白，系统评估偏好信息的位置和明确性如何影响CoT监控的可靠性。
AI.method: 构建FACE-Eval基准，系统地变化线索位置（用户消息vs工具返回）和明确性（直接摘要vs原始工件），测量两类指标：言语化承诺（cue-following答案中的承诺）和未言语化采纳（所有线索样本中的采纳）。评估15个开源模型的4B到1.60T参数范围，并引入源归因提示和监控告知等干预手段，最后使用两个转录监控器评估检测能力。
AI.result: 所有15个模型在工具返回线索下的言语化承诺低于用户消息线索，隐式线索低于显式线索。未言语化采纳在15个模型的工具返回场景全部更高，在30个模型-通道比较中有28个隐式线索更高。源归因提示在7个模型上缩小通道差距，监控告知无效。未言语化采纳与两个监控器的检测能力呈显著负相关（r=-0.54和r=-0.78）。
AI.conclusion: 当偏好信息通过工具或原始工件传达时，CoT监控的可靠性会下降，因为模型会更少地在推理轨迹中言语化这些偏好，同时更高的未言语化采纳反而降低了转录监控器的检测能力。这表明在实际代理场景中，CoT监控需要额外的对策来弥补这一不足。

title: Efficient Language-to-Vision Feature Injection for Referring Single-Object Tracking
summary: Referring single-object tracking enables language-grounded target initialization and subsequent tracking by jointly leveraging semantic cues and visual templates. The core difficulty is to use language differently across stages: it is indispensable for grounding but can induce semantic drift during tracking when overemphasized. Meanwhile, current methods often require costly vision-language alignment training. We present LVTrack, a pure transformer framework that introduces a mode-conditioned Gated Feature Injector to adaptively regulate textual guidance and alleviate semantic drift. Together with targeted adaptations, it directly harnesses a frozen vision-language pretrained model, greatly reducing training cost and preserving strong language understanding. To further improve temporal localization, LVTrack integrates hybrid relative-absolute positional encodings with a lightweight memory mechanism and optimizes autoregressive box prediction using a Gaussian-smoothed KL loss. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that LVTrack achieves strong performance.

AI.tldr: LVTrack是一个纯Transformer框架的指代单目标跟踪方法，通过模式条件门控特征注入器自适应调控文本引导以缓解语义漂移，直接利用冻结的视觉-语言预训练模型降低训练成本，并集成混合位置编码、轻量记忆机制和高斯平滑KL损失提升性能。
AI.motivation: 指代单目标跟踪的核心难点在于语言在不同阶段需要差异化使用：语言对于目标定位不可或缺，但在跟踪过程中过度强调会引发语义漂移；同时现有方法往往需要昂贵的视觉-语言对齐训练。
AI.method: 提出LVTrack纯Transformer框架，包含三个关键设计：(1)模式条件门控特征注入器，自适应调节文本引导以缓解语义漂移；(2)直接利用冻结的视觉-语言预训练模型，降低训练成本并保持语言理解能力；(3)集成混合相对-绝对位置编码、轻量记忆机制，并用高斯平滑KL损失优化自回归框预测。
AI.result: 在多个标准基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，LVTrack取得了强竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: LVTrack通过模式条件门控机制有效解决了跨阶段语义漂移问题，同时利用冻结预训练模型大幅节省了训练开销，验证了纯Transformer架构在指代单目标跟踪任务上的有效性。

title: MUDDLE: Measuring Understanding of Documents under Distractor and Length Effects
comment: 12 pages. Accepted to the Context Beyond the Window (CBW) workshop at COLM 2026 (non-archival). Code and data: https://github.com/luoojason/muddle
summary: Document question-answering systems increasingly answer questions over collections of retrieved documents rather than one clean source, so robustness to distracting context matters as much as reading ability. When such systems fail, it is often unclear whether the context was too long or the distractors were too close to the topic, because prior work tends to conflate these two effects. We present MUDDLE, a controlled benchmark that separates them. MUDDLE uses 270 human-annotated questions, each tied to a single source document, and instantiates every question in five conditions: the source alone, the source with two or four topically similar hard negatives, and the source with two or four random distractors. The random distractors are matched to the hard negatives in length and provenance, so an accuracy gap between the two arms reflects topical similarity rather than length. All five conditions are rendered in markdown, page images, and raw PDF, but the distractor sweep reported here is run in markdown, since a source plus its distractors exceeds current image and PDF input limits. We score answers with an LLM judge across three model families. In the complete markdown sweep, hard negatives lower accuracy more than length-matched random documents at both context sizes for gpt-5-mini, while random documents stay near the no-distractor baseline. The effect is small but directionally consistent, and for gpt-5-mini hard negatives significantly underperform length-matched random distractors when pooled across context sizes. We release the data and evaluation code for a reproducible study of context degradation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MUDDLE基准，用于分离文档问答系统中干扰因素的两个维度——上下文长度和主题相似度。通过每个问题在五种条件下实例化（来源文档、来源+2/4个主题相近的困难负样本、来源+2/4个长度匹配的随机干扰项），系统性评估各模型在此受控设置下的表现。结果显示，困难负样本比长度匹配的随机文档更能降低模型准确率，但效应较小且方向一致。
AI.motivation: 现有文档问答系统常在多文档检索场景下运行，但失败原因难以归因——是上下文过长还是干扰项与主题过于接近？以往工作将这两种效应混为一谈，导致无法精准定位系统失效的根本原因。作者希望通过受控实验将这两个因素分离，从而更清晰地理解上下文退化机制。
AI.method: 构建MUDDLE基准，包含270个人工标注问题，每个问题关联单一来源文档，并在五种条件下实例化：仅来源文档、来源+2/4个主题相似的困难负样本、来源+2/4个长度匹配的随机干扰项。随机干扰项与困难负样本在长度和来源上匹配，因此两臂之间的准确率差异反映的是主题相似度而非长度因素。所有条件以markdown、页面图像和原始PDF三种格式呈现，但本次实验在markdown下运行，因为来源加干扰项超出当前图像和PDF输入限制。使用LLM评判器对三个模型家族进行打分。
AI.result: 在完整markdown扫描中，对gpt-5-mini而言，困难负样本在两种上下文大小下都比长度匹配的随机文档更能降低准确率，而随机文档接近无干扰基线。效应虽小但方向一致；当跨上下文大小合并时，gpt-5-mini下困难负样本显著低于长度匹配随机干扰项。数据和评测代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: MUDDLE成功地将"上下文过长"和"干扰项主题过近"两个效应分离，证明了在长度受控条件下，主题相似度是造成模型性能下降的独立且有效的因素，尽管效应幅度有限。该基准为未来研究上下文退化的可复现性提供了基础。

title: Chat-Edit-3D++: Interactive 3D and 4D Scene Editing via Large Language Models
summary: Recent work on image content manipulation based on vision-language pre-training models has been effectively extended to text-driven 3D scene editing. However, existing schemes for 3D scene editing still have certain shortcomings, hindering their further development as interactive design tools. Such schemes typically adhere to fixed input patterns, limiting flexibility in text input. Furthermore, their editing capabilities are constrained by a single or a few 2D visual models and require intricate pipeline design to integrate these models into 3D reconstruction processes. To address the aforementioned issues, we propose the Hash-Atlas network, which reformulates 3D scene editing as operations on 2D atlas images, thereby achieving a workflow decoupling of the 2D editing and 3D reconstruction processes. Building on this foundation, we introduce a dialogue-based 3D scene editing approach, termed CE3D++, which is centered on a large language model (LLM) that allows arbitrary textual input from users and interprets their intentions, subsequently facilitating the autonomous invocation of the corresponding visual models. Additionally, we extend CE3D++ to monocular 4D scenes by imposing motion constraints on moving objects and further fine-tuning the LLM by creating a trajectory dataset related to editing tasks, which enables the smaller LLM to schedule up to 30 different visual tools accurately. Experimental results demonstrate that CE3D++ effectively integrates multiple visual models to achieve diverse visual editing effects, possessing strong scene comprehension and multi-round dialog capabilities. The source codes and trained models are available at https://github.com/Fangkang515/CE3D.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CE3D++，一种基于对话的3D场景编辑方法。通过Hash-Atlas网络将3D场景编辑转化为2D atlas图像操作，实现2D编辑与3D重建流程解耦，并以大语言模型为核心，支持任意文本输入和自主调用多种视觉模型，同时扩展到4D场景编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景编辑方案存在固定输入模式导致文本输入灵活性差、编辑能力受限于单一或少量2D视觉模型、需要复杂pipeline设计将2D模型集成到3D重建过程等问题，阻碍其发展成交互式设计工具。
AI.method: 提出Hash-Atlas网络重新定义3D场景编辑为2D atlas图像操作，实现2D编辑与3D重建流程解耦；在此基础上构建以LLM为核心的对话式3D场景编辑框架CE3D++，支持任意文本输入和意图理解，自主调用相应视觉模型；通过运动约束扩展至单目4D场景，并创建轨迹数据集微调LLM，使其能精确调度多达30种视觉工具。
AI.result: 实验表明CE3D++能有效集成多种视觉模型实现多样化视觉编辑效果，具备强大的场景理解能力和多轮对话能力。
AI.conclusion: CE3D++通过LLM驱动的对话式交互方式，显著提升了3D场景编辑的灵活性和可扩展性，为交互式3D设计工具提供了新思路，代码和模型已开源。

title: SIC-Agents: Benchmarking and Building an Adaptive Simulator for Pediatric Serious Illness Communication Training
summary: Pediatric serious illness communication (SIC) is critically important, yet scalable communication training for clinicians remains limited. Compared with other dialogue simulation settings, pediatric SIC poses additional challenges, including multi-party interactions, response to parental distress and strong dependence on feedback dynamics. Existing LLM-based simulators optimize generic dialogue quality rather than curriculum-contingent behavior required for effective SIC training. In collaboration with educators and pediatric clinicians, we introduce the first benchmark suite and simulation framework tailored to pediatric SIC training. Our benchmarks, PitfallBench and DialogueBench, evaluate simulators both at the turn-level and across full dialogues. We further propose SIC-Agents, a self-improving framework that generates a clinician-editable skill document to guide simulator behavior. Our experiments show that SIC-Agents outperforms static expert prompting. To support future research, we release our benchmarks for parent simulation in pediatric SIC at https://github.com/Beikewzh/sic-benchmarks

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出针对儿科重症疾病沟通(SIC)训练的基准套件和模拟框架，包含PitfallBench和DialogueBench两个基准，以及一个自改进的模拟框架SIC-Agents，通过生成临床医生可编辑的技能文档来引导模拟器行为，实验证明其优于静态专家提示方法。
AI.motivation: 儿科重症疾病沟通(SIC)至关重要，但缺乏可扩展的临床医生沟通培训。相比其他对话模拟场景，儿科SIC面临多方交互、回应父母痛苦情绪、依赖反馈动力学等额外挑战。现有基于LLM的模拟器优化的是通用对话质量，而非SIC培训所需的课程依从行为。
AI.method: 与教育工作者和儿科临床医生合作，构建了两个基准：PitfallBench（回合级评估）和DialogueBench（全对话级评估）。提出SIC-Agents自改进框架，该框架生成临床医生可编辑的技能文档来引导模拟器行为。
AI.result: 实验表明SIC-Agents在儿科SIC模拟任务上优于静态专家提示方法，同时发布了基准供后续研究使用。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了儿科SIC模拟训练领域的空白，通过专门设计的基准和自改进框架实现了更有效的沟通技能培训，并开源基准以促进该领域进一步发展。

title: STARLINC: Satellite Trail Artifact Removal using Inter-Frame Correlation
summary: The rapid expansion of low Earth orbit satellites such as Starlink is increasingly contaminating astronomical surveys. In practice, contaminated images are often identified through inspection. However, modern surveys generate terabytes of data each night, making manual screening infeasible and necessitating reliable automated methods for satellite trail removal. Unfortunately, existing general-domain line detection methods fail to generalize to astronomical images due to domain mismatch, which are mostly grayscale with sparse bright stars and have a low signal-to-noise ratio. Moreover, training new models from scratch is impractical due to the lack of large-scale annotated astronomical datasets. To address these challenges, we introduce STARLINC, the first ML-based framework for satellite trail removal without requiring tedious pixel-level annotation of astronomical images. STARLINC combines synthetic satellite trail generation for training, inter-frame differential maps from temporally adjacent exposures to highlight transient trails, and heatmaps to provide additional localization cues for pixel-level segmentation. Extensive experiments on real-world data demonstrate substantial improvements over baselines, establishing STARLINC as a scalable solution for next-generation astronomical surveys. Code is available at https://github.com/starioKim/STARLINC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STARLINC，这是首个无需繁琐像素级标注的机器学习框架，用于自动去除天文图像中的卫星轨迹。该方法结合合成轨迹生成训练、帧间差分图突出瞬态轨迹和热图辅助定位分割，在真实数据上显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 低地球轨道卫星（如Starlink）的快速扩张正日益污染天文观测数据。现代巡天每晚产生TB级数据，人工筛查不可行，而现有通用线段检测方法因域不匹配（灰度图像、暗弱恒星、低信噪比）难以泛化；同时缺乏大规模标注天文数据集，无法从头训练新模型。
AI.method: STARLINC框架包含三个关键组件：1）合成卫星轨迹生成用于训练数据增强；2）利用时间相邻曝光帧的差分图突出瞬态轨迹特征；3）使用热图提供额外的定位线索以辅助像素级分割任务。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据上的大量实验表明，STARLINC在卫星轨迹去除效果上相对于基线方法有显著提升，验证了其作为下一代天文巡天可扩展解决方案的有效性。
AI.conclusion: STARLINC规避了像素级人工标注的需求，为大规模天文巡天提供了可靠且可扩展的自动化卫星轨迹去除方案，填补了该领域机器学习方法的空白。

title: CoCoA: Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment for Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 22 pages, 4 figures, 19 tables
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often favor Western-associated entities across cultural contexts. Conventional debiasing methods aim for uniform neutrality, but cultural bias mitigation demands context-conditional behavior, preferring culturally appropriate entities when cultural cues are present and remaining neutral when they are absent. We propose CoCoA (Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment), a framework that learns this behavior through dual-context training on the same entity pairs under contexts with and without cultural cues. CoCoA combines a contrastive alignment objective with calibration and drift regularization, optimized through goal-aware gradient reconciliation. We evaluate CoCoA on CAMeL and Camellia, two entity-centric cultural bias benchmarks, across ten language settings and four LLMs. CoCoA reduces the Cultural Bias Score from 43 to 24 on average while maintaining near-neutral preferences at 50.2, with minimal impact on general performance across five standard benchmarks. These findings highlight that effective cultural alignment requires context-conditional modeling rather than uniform debiasing, and establish a new direction for mitigating entity-centric cultural bias in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoCoA框架，通过双上下文训练（有/无文化线索）使LLM在文化线索存在时偏好文化适切实体，在文化线索缺失时保持中性，将文化偏见分数从43降至24，同时保持近中性偏好50.2，且对通用性能影响极小。
AI.motivation: 传统去偏见方法追求统一中立，但文化偏见缓解需要上下文条件化行为——有文化线索时偏好文化适切实体，无线索时保持中性。现有方法无法满足这一条件化需求。
AI.method: CoCoA框架采用双上下文训练策略，在同一实体对上分别使用有/无文化线索的上下文进行训练，结合对比对齐目标（contrastive alignment objective）与校准和漂移正则化（calibration and drift regularization），通过目标感知梯度调和（goal-aware gradient reconciliation）进行优化。
AI.result: 在CAMeL和Camellia两个实体中心文化偏见基准上，跨10种语言设置和4种LLM评估，CoCoA将文化偏见分数从43平均降至24，保持近中性偏好在50.2，同时在5个标准基准上通用性能影响极小。
AI.conclusion: 有效的文化对齐需要上下文条件化建模而非统一去偏见，这为缓解LLM中实体中心文化偏见确立了新方向。

title: SGRNet: Spatially Guided Radiology Network for Structured Radiological Reporting of Head and Neck Cancer
summary: Automated radiological report generation can alleviate clinical workloads and eliminate observer variability. However, standard free-text generation models pose hallucination risks in dense regions and fail under data scarcity. We address these challenges in Head and Neck Cancer (HNC) from contrast-enhanced CT (CECT) imaging. To enforce factual safety, we reformulate report generation as an anatomically grounded, multi-label, structured reporting task, predicting localized tumor involvement across a hierarchical clinical schema. To bridge the visual gap from missing metabolic imaging (e.g., PET), we introduce SGRNet (Spatially Guided Radiology Network), incorporating two low-cost spatial priors: automated organ segmentations and weakly supervised tumor localization maps modeled via 3D Gaussian heatmaps. These priors are dynamically integrated via spatial feature modulation to guide the network toward subtle tumor-induced structural alterations. Evaluated on a multi-centric dataset of 184 paired HNC CECT volumes and reports, on five clinically salient, densely packed anatomical subsites, SGRNet achieves a mean Average Precision (mAP) of 0.60, an 8.8 percentage-point absolute improvement over strong volume-only 3D baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SGRNet（空间引导放射网络），将头颈癌（HNC）放射报告生成重构为基于解剖结构的、多标签结构化报告任务，利用器官分割和弱监督肿瘤定位图作为低成本空间先验，在184例多中心CECT数据上实现mAP 0.60，较3D基线提升8.8个百分点。
AI.motivation: 传统自由文本放射报告生成存在密集解剖区域的幻觉风险，且在数据稀缺场景下性能不佳；同时头颈癌诊断中缺少代谢成像（如PET）导致视觉信息不足，需要引入额外的空间先验来弥补。
AI.method: 将报告生成重构为解剖学引导的多标签结构化预测任务，在分层临床模式上预测局部肿瘤累及部位；提出SGRNet，融合两个低成本空间先验——自动器官分割结果和通过3D高斯热图建模的弱监督肿瘤定位图，并通过空间特征调制机制动态整合这些先验。
AI.result: 在多中心184对头颈癌CECT影像与报告中，SGRNet在5个临床显著且密集的解剖亚部位上达到mAP 0.60，较强体积仅3D基线的绝对提升达8.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过将自由文本生成转化为结构化多标签预测并引入空间先验引导，可以有效缓解幻觉问题并弥补代谢成像缺失带来的视觉差距，显著提升头颈癌放射报告生成的准确性和临床安全性。

title: LLM Judges as Raters: A Pre-Registered Audit of Severity, Halo, Reliability, and Version Instability in LLM Essay Scoring on Public Corpora
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Under review at the Journal of Learning Analytics (LAK27 research track). Artifact: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/lak-27-A618
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as essay graders in learning analytics, evaluated almost exclusively with agreement statistics. Educational measurement warns that raters also differ in severity, show halo, and drift as instruments. We treat LLM judges as raters and run a pre-registered rater-effects battery (many-facet Rasch severity, residual halo, generalizability/decision studies, cross-version shifts, differential functioning) on public corpora in two languages (ENEM/Essay-BR; ASAP): 2,377 essays, 12 judges, 4 providers, 5 version contrasts, replicated cells, released as a score tensor. Judge severity spans 219 points on ENEM's 0-1000 scale; on ASAP the panel spread is 15-33% of the score range against a between-trained-human gap near 1%. Judge-human correlations sit in an undiscriminating .47-.56 band. All five version contrasts shift severity beyond a family-wise permutation null (up to 133 points), and one judge was deprecated mid-study, caught by identity canaries. Two pre-registered tests returned honest nulls: severity-adjusted leaderboard reversals did not survive a permutation null, and "silent drift" was refuted: agreement moved with severity in four of five contrasts. Replication yields self-consistency (phi>=.80 at k<=2) but not human-level accuracy, and a same-instrument check overturned our own halo comparison: matched on instrument and calibration, we find no credible evidence that judge halo exceeds the trained-human range.

AI.tldr: 本研究将大型语言模型（LLM）视为评分员，在跨语言公共语料库（ENEM/Essay-BR与ASAP，共2,377篇作文、12位评委、4家供应商、5个版本对比）上执行预注册的评分员效应测试套件。主要发现包括：评委严重性跨度在ENEM上达219分，ASAP上面板离散度为评分范围的15-33%（远超训练人类评分员间的约1%）；评委与人类相关性处于判别力较弱的0.47-0.56区间；所有五个版本对比均造成超越置换零假设的严重性漂移（最高达133分）；一位评委在研究中途被弃用。两个预注册测试返回诚实的零结果：严重性调整后的排行榜反转未通过置换检验，"静默漂移"假设被反驳。复制实验显示自一致性良好（phi>=0.80，k<=2）但未达到人类级准确度，且在同一仪器校准条件下未发现评委光环效应超过训练人类范围的可信证据。
AI.motivation: LLM被广泛用作作文评分器，但现有评估几乎只依赖一致性统计。教育测量学科的既有经验表明，评分员作为测量工具还会表现出严重性差异、光环效应和漂移等系统性偏差。本文旨在通过系统的评分员效应检验，揭示LLM评分器在这些维度上的真实表现，弥补仅关注一致性的评估盲区。
AI.method: 采用预注册的评分员效应测试方案，包括：多面Rasch模型测量严重性、残差光环效应分析、概化理论/决策研究、跨版本漂移检验、差异功能分析。数据涵盖两种语言、2,377篇作文、12位LLM评委、4家模型供应商、5个版本对比，并加入复制单元格和身份金丝雀检测，最终发布为评分张量数据集。
AI.result: LLM评委严重性差异远超人类基线（ENEM跨度219分/1000分制，ASAP面板离散为评分范围15-33% vs 人类约1%）；与人类评分相关性仅0.47-0.56；所有版本更新均导致显著严重性漂移，其中一位评委被金丝雀检测捕获后弃用。复制实验显示自一致性良好但未达人类准确性；同一仪器校准后光环效应与人类水平无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: LLM作为评分仪器的系统性偏差（严重性差异和版本漂移）远大于此前仅关注一致性统计所能揭示的程度，这些偏差足以影响评分结果的解释和排行榜的排序。然而，在公允校准和同仪器条件下，LLM的光环效应并未超过人类评分员。评估LLM评分器需从单一的一致性视角转向全面的测量学质量检验框架。

title: Training-Free Hidden-State Refinement for Flow-Matching Image Generators
summary: We aim to improve frozen flow-matching image generators by adding inference computation inside the denoiser, without changing model weights or the outer sampler. Existing generators usually spend extra test-time computation by increasing the number of sampling steps, which repeatedly evaluates the entire denoiser and couples quality gains to sampler cost. A key challenge is how to use extra computation inside a frozen transformer denoiser: the method must decide which tokens, layers, and sampling times receive repeated updates while preserving the original generation pipeline. We introduce a training-free looping framework that repeatedly applies selected transformer layers inside each denoising call. Dense and Sparse Token Loop vary the token scope; Sampling-Progress Gating and the loop layer range specify when and where looping is active; loop count and strength control the repeated updates; and Loop Guidance combines ordinary and looped vector-field predictions. Across two Scale-RAE model scales, loop variants improve primary and auxiliary quality metrics with competitive quality--efficiency trade-offs. Loop Guidance further improves both primary metrics across all three tested models; on Scale-RAE DiT2.4B, it raises GenEval from 0.4471 to 0.5691 and DPG-Bench from 0.7656 to 0.8053. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的循环框架，在冻结的流匹配图像生成器去噪器内部重复应用部分Transformer层来增加推理计算量，不改变模型权重或外部采样器，从而在多种模型上提升生成质量（如GenEval从0.4471提升至0.5691）。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型增加测试时计算通常通过增加采样步数实现，这会反复评估整个去噪器并将质量提升与采样成本耦合。作者希望在不改变模型权重和外部采样器的前提下，通过去噪器内部增加推理计算来提升生成质量，关键在于决定哪些token、层和采样时刻应接受重复更新。
AI.method: 提出一种训练无关的循环框架：Dense/Sparse Token Loop控制循环的token范围；Sampling-Progress Gating和循环层范围决定循环激活的时间和位置；循环次数和强度控制重复更新的幅度；Loop Guidance结合普通和循环化的向量场预测。整个方案不修改模型权重和外部采样流程。
AI.result: 在Scale-RAE两个模型规模上，循环变体显著改善主指标和辅助质量指标，具有竞争力的质量-效率权衡。Loop Guidance在所有三个测试模型上均提升两个主指标；在Scale-RAE DiT2.4B上，GenEval从0.4471提升至0.5691，DPG-Bench从0.7656提升至0.8053。
AI.conclusion: 该训练无关的循环框架为流匹配生成器提供了一种有效的测试时计算扩展手段，在不触碰模型权重和采样器的情况下显著提升生成质量，且代码将开源。

title: Ontology-Guided Multi-Agent Extraction of Evaluation Objects from Academic Review Texts: Evidence from Chinese Library and Information Science
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure; accepted at ASIS&T METSTI
summary: Academic reviews, scholarly commentaries, and book reviews serve as sources of evaluative statements about theories, methods, literature, institutions, and policies, providing valuable evidence for scholarly evaluation. Existing scientific entity extraction methods mainly target research articles and are less effective for evaluation objects, which are often abstract, context-dependent, and characterized by ambiguous type boundaries. This study proposes an ontology-guided multi-agent framework for evaluation object extraction. The framework combines candidate discovery, ontology-constrained classification, and domain review. Experimental results show that it achieves a Precision of 90.33%, Recall of 84.55%, Entity-level F1 of 87.34%, Strict Typed F1 of 79.78%, and Type Accuracy of 91.35%, substantially outperforming rule-based and zero-shot baselines. Ablation results indicate that the multi-agent workflow improves recall and stability, while ontology-based boundary constraints enhance fine-grained classification and reduce category confusion. The framework supports the structured utilization of evaluative scholarly texts and provides methodological support for evidence-based research evaluation and STI mining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种本体引导的多智能体框架，用于从学术评论、书评等评价性文本中提取评价对象实体，在精确率、召回率和F1等指标上显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有科学实体提取方法主要针对研究论文，对评价对象（通常抽象、依赖上下文、类型边界模糊）效果不佳，需要新的方法来实现评价性学术文本的结构化利用。
AI.method: 提出本体引导的多智能体框架，融合候选发现、本体约束分类和领域审查三个环节，通过本体边界约束减少类别混淆，多智能体工作流提升召回率和稳定性。
AI.result: 精确率90.33%、召回率84.55%、实体级F1 87.34%、严格类型F1 79.78%、类型准确率91.35%，大幅优于基于规则和零样本基线；消融实验验证了多智能体工作流和本体约束的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架支持评价性学术文本的结构化利用，为循证研究评价和科学技术创新（STI）挖掘提供方法论支撑。

title: Subtraction-Based Tumor Segmentation and Lesion-Centered pCR Prediction for the MAMA-MIA Challenge
summary:
We describe the submission of team FME to the MAMA-MIA Challenge, which evaluated primary tumor segmentation and prediction of pathological complete response (pCR) from pretreatment dynamic contrast-enhanced breast MRI on an external multi-country cohort. For segmentation, we trained a five-fold residual-encoder nnU-Net ensemble using only the first post-contrast minus pre-contrast image, combined with mirroring test-time augmentation and largest-connected-component filtering. For pCR prediction, we ensembled 25 pretrained 3D video classifiers trained on lesion-centred crops from the pre-contrast and first two post-contrast volumes. FME ranked second in both tasks. The segmentation method achieved a combined performance-fairness score of 0.882, with Dice 0.713 and normalized Hausdorff distance 0.099. The pCR method achieved a combined score of 0.664, balanced accuracy of 0.541, and equalized-odds disparity of 0.212. The results indicate that subtraction-based input and ensembling support robust tumor segmentation under cross-site domain shift, whereas pCR prediction from baseline DCE-MRI alone remains limited.
  For the submission repository, see https://github.com/FraunhoferMEVIS/MAMA-MIA-Challenge-FME

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了FME团队在MAMA-MIA挑战赛中的提交方案，使用残差编码器nnU-Net集成进行乳腺肿瘤分割，以及约25个预训练3D视频分类器集成进行病理完全缓解（pCR）预测，最终在两项任务中均排名第二。
AI.motivation: MAMA-MIA挑战赛旨在评估从治疗前动态增强乳腺MRI中自动进行原发肿瘤分割和pCR预测的性能，且测试数据来自外部多国队列，考验模型的跨中心泛化能力。
AI.method: 分割任务采用五折残差编码器nnU-Net集成，输入仅使用首个增强后减增强前图像，并配合镜像测试时增强和最大连通域滤波；pCR预测集成25个预训练3D视频分类器，输入为病灶中心裁剪的增强前及前两个增强后体积。
AI.result: 分割任务综合性能-公平性得分0.882，Dice为0.713，归一化Hausdorff距离为0.099；pCR任务综合得分0.664，平衡准确率0.541，等几率差异0.212。两项任务均排名第二。
AI.conclusion: 减影输入与集成策略能有效应对跨站点域偏移下的鲁棒肿瘤分割；然而，仅基于基线DCE-MRI的pCR预测仍存在明显局限，预测效果有限。

title: Argument-Aware Semantic Alignment of Normative Texts: A Toulmin-Based Neuro-Symbolic Approach
summary: Semantic alignment between specialized normative texts is challenging when equivalent requirements use different terms, syntax, and levels of abstraction. Lexical overlap, distributional embeddings, and semantic similarity capture topical relatedness but often miss the argumentative structure by which normative claims are supported, qualified, and justified. This paper asks whether explicit argument structure adds information complementary to neural semantics for aligning requirements. We treat cross-standard control mapping as argument-aware semantic alignment and build a neuro-symbolic pipeline that combines neural text representations with Toulmin features. An LLM explicitation step identifies claims, grounds, warrants, qualifiers, and backing and reconstructs enthymemes. These feed an alignment model via argument-aware similarity and structural features. On a NERC-CIP to NIST-CSF mapping benchmark, argument-derived features improve alignment over a neuro-symbolic semantic baseline. Feature selection shows especially strong signal from warrant-related features, indicating that the link between a claim and its supporting reasoning is not captured by conventional similarity alone. A compact claim--grounds--warrant subset remains competitive with the full Toulmin feature set. The results give preliminary evidence that argument structure is a useful intermediate representation for aligning specialized normative texts. Cybersecurity standards are used as a controlled testbed, not as proof of domain-independent generalization. The argument graphs produced by LLM explicitation may also support later work on retrieval, reasoning, and explanation over normative text.

AI.tldr: 本文研究跨标准控制映射中的语义对齐问题，提出一种将神经语义表示与Toulmin论证结构特征相结合的神经符号流水线。使用LLM进行论证要素显式化（主张、依据、理由、限定词和支持），构建论证感知对齐模型。在NERC-CIP到NIST-CSF映射基准上，论证特征显著提升了神经语义基线的对齐效果，其中理由（warrant）相关特征贡献最强，且精简的claim-grounds-warrant子集即可保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 专业规范文本之间的语义对齐具有挑战性，因为等价要求可能使用不同术语、句法和抽象层级。现有的词汇重叠、分布嵌入和语义相似度方法只能捕捉主题相关性，却忽略了规范声明被支持、限定和论证的论辩结构。作者希望探究显式论证结构是否能提供补充于神经语义的额外信息来改善要求对齐。
AI.method: 构建神经符号流水线：1) 使用LLM显式化步骤提取Toulmin论证要素（主张claim、依据grounds、理由warrant、限定词qualifier、支持backing）并重建省略三段论（enthymemes）；2) 将这些论证要素通过论证感知相似度和结构特征输入对齐模型；3) 在NERC-CIP到NIST-CSF映射基准上评估，并进行特征选择分析。
AI.result: 在NERC-CIP到NIST-CSF映射基准上，论证派生的特征相比神经语义基线提升了对齐效果。特征选择显示warrant相关特征信号最强，表明主张与支撑推理之间的联系无法被传统相似度方法捕获。精简的claim-grounds-warrant子集与完整Toulmin特征集性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 论证结构是专业规范文本对齐的有效中间表示。LLM显式化产生的论证图也可支持后续的检索、推理和解释工作。网络安全标准仅作为受控测试平台，不用于证明跨领域的泛化性。

title: Mapping-Based Image Diffusion
summary: In this work, we introduce a novel tensor-based functional for targeted image enhancement and denoising. Via explicit regularization, our formulation incorporates application dependent and contextual information using first principles. Few works in literature treat variational models that describe both application dependent information and contextual knowledge of the denoising problem. We prove the existence of a minimizer and present results on tensor symmetry constraints, convexity, and geometric interpretation of the proposed functional. We show that our framework excels in applications where nonlinear functions are present such as in gamma correction and targeted value range filtering. We also study general denoising performance where we show comparable results to dedicated PDE-based state of the art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的基于张量的函数泛函，用于目标图像增强和去噪。通过显式正则化，该公式利用第一性原理整合了应用相关信息和上下文知识。作者证明了最小化器的存在性，并展示了张量对称约束、凸性和几何解释的结果。该方法在非线性函数应用（如伽马校正和目标值范围滤波）中表现出色，在一般去噪性能上也达到了与专用基于PDE的最先进方法相当的结果。
AI.motivation: 现有文献中很少有变分模型能够同时描述应用相关信息和去噪问题的上下文知识，作者旨在填补这一空白，提出一个统一的框架来兼顾这两方面。
AI.method: 提出一种基于张量的函数泛函，通过显式正则化整合应用依赖和上下文信息；从第一性原理出发构建公式，并证明最小化器的存在性，同时研究张量对称约束、凸性和几何解释。
AI.result: 该框架在包含非线性函数的应用中表现优异，如伽马校正和目标值范围滤波；在一般去噪性能上与专门的基于PDE的最先进方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于张量的变分框架是一种通用的图像增强和去噪工具，能够灵活整合应用上下文信息，在非线性应用中具有显著优势，同时保持与最先进去噪方法相当的性能。

title: The Emergent Symbolic Structure of Artificial Neural Networks
comment: 30 pages, plus 29 pages of references and appendices
summary: Modern systems in artificial intelligence (AI) somehow excel in domains for which they seem poorly suited. Intelligence has traditionally been modeled as operating over structured combinations of symbols, such as logical formulas. However, the strongest modern AI systems are based on neural networks, which instead represent information in continuous vectors. Vectors seem inadequate for capturing the structure of language, logic, and other cognitive domains, yet neural networks achieve impressive performance in these areas. How do they do it? In this work, we propose a potential answer: Despite appearances, perhaps the internal representations of neural networks implicitly realize symbolic structure. In support of this hypothesis, we show that the vector representations of a variety of neural networks can be closely approximated with symbolic structures: we can replace the network's entire representation-generating process with a closed-form equation instantiating a symbolic structure, and the network's behavior remains largely unchanged. This finding holds for both small-scale neural networks trained to manipulate lists as well as large language models (LLMs) operating in four domains that are central in symbolic traditions: arithmetic, logic, computer code, and language. Further, our symbolic approximation allows us to modify an LLM's behavior in targeted ways via precise interventions on its internal representations, showing that the LLM's behavior is reliant on the symbolic structures we have identified. This work provides a potential way to reconcile longstanding symbolic conceptions of intelligence with the vector-based nature of modern AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个假设：尽管现代AI系统基于神经网络以连续向量表示信息，但其内部表征可能隐式地实现了符号结构。作者证明了多种神经网络（从处理列表的小型网络到处理算术、逻辑、代码和语言四个领域的大语言模型）的向量表征都可以用闭合形式的符号结构方程来近似替代，且网络行为基本不变。通过符号近似对LLM内部表征进行精准干预还能有针对性修改其行为，为调和传统符号主义AI与现代向量化神经网络提供了可能路径。
AI.motivation: 传统上智能被认为基于符号结构的组合操作，但现代最强大的AI系统（神经网络）却用连续向量表示信息。向量看似不足以捕捉语言、逻辑等领域的结构，但神经网络却表现出色，这构成了一个悖论，促使作者探索其内部机制。
AI.method: 作者提出一个假设并验证：神经网络内部表征可能隐式实现符号结构。方法包括：1) 用闭合形式方程实例化符号结构来近似替代网络的表征生成过程；2) 在小规模列表操作网络和四个核心符号域（算术、逻辑、代码、语言）的大语言模型上进行验证；3) 通过对内部表征进行精确干预来测试LLM行为对符号结构的依赖程度。
AI.result: 研究发现，多种神经网络的向量表征可以被符号结构紧密近似，替换掉整个表征生成过程后网络行为基本不变。该发现同时适用于小型神经网络和大语言模型在算术、逻辑、代码和语言四个领域。进一步的干预实验揭示LLM的行为确实依赖所识别的符号结构。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为调和长期以来的符号主义智能观与现代AI的向量化本质提供了一种潜在途径，表明神经网络的内部表征可能与符号结构在功能上等价，从而解释了神经网络在看似不适合的符号领域中的卓越表现。

title: Feature-Spectral Fragility in Segmentation: Dataset Dependence, Architecture-Specific Localization, and Spectral Correlates
summary: Robustness of segmentation models is commonly assessed through input-domain perturbations, while dependence on frequency content within learned feature representations remains less understood. We probe this dependence using targeted post-training low-pass interventions on internal representations of three segmentation architectures, ResNet50-UNet (CNN), VM-UNet (SSM), and Swin-UNETR (Transformer), across CVC-ClinicDB and ISIC2018, with headline evaluations performed on untouched held-out test sets. At cutoff rho=0.25, feature-domain low-pass filtering causes severe degradation on CVC: Dice drops by 100%, 73.2%, and 30.9% for CNN, SSM, and Transformer, respectively, compared with 9.4%, 10.3%, and 0.6% on ISIC. The cross-dataset difference is statistically significant for every architecture. Single-stage interventions further show that sensitivity is localized at architecture-specific depths: the CNN peaks at a mid/late encoder block, whereas the SSM peaks in an early encoder stage on both datasets. Native feature-domain spectral measurements show an inverse association between high-frequency energy and fragility on CVC; the relationship is only partial on ISIC and is therefore treated as a candidate correlate rather than a proven mechanism. Finally, Fourier augmentation improves robustness to input-space low-pass filtering but leaves feature-domain degradation essentially unchanged. These results show that feature-spectral robustness is strongly dataset-dependent, architecture-specific, and distinct from input-domain spectral robustness.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了三种分割架构（CNN、SSM、Transformer）在特征表示域对低频滤波的鲁棒性，发现不同数据集和架构间的退化模式差异显著，且特征域脆弱性与输入域鲁棒性是相互独立的现象。
AI.motivation: 分割模型的鲁棒性评估通常聚焦于输入域的扰动，而模型对特征表示中频率内容的依赖程度尚未被充分理解。作者希望填补这一空白，系统性地探究特征域频率内容对分割模型性能的影响。
AI.method: 在训练完成后对三种分割架构（ResNet50-UNet、VM-UNet、Swin-UNETR）的内部表示施加有针对性的低通滤波干预，在CVC-ClinicDB和ISIC2018两个数据集上进行评估。同时进行单阶段干预以定位敏感性集中的网络深度，测量原生特征域的频谱特性，并测试傅里叶增强对鲁棒性的影响。
AI.result: 在cutoff rho=0.25时，CVC数据集上CNN、SSM和Transformer的Dice分别下降100%、73.2%和30.9%，而ISIC上仅下降9.4%、10.3%和0.6%。敏感性在不同架构中位于不同深度（CNN在中晚期编码器，SSM在早期编码器）。特征域高频能量与脆弱性在CVC上呈负相关，但在ISIC上仅有部分关联。傅里叶增强可改善输入域鲁棒性，但无法改善特征域退化。
AI.conclusion: 特征频谱鲁棒性具有强烈的数据集依赖性和架构特异性，且与输入域频谱鲁棒性是两种独立的现象。低频特征信息对分割模型至关重要，但不同架构对其依赖程度和位置各不相同。

title: LoGo: Token-Level Dynamic Local-Global Attention
summary: As context lengths scale, attention increasingly becomes a primary computational bottleneck in large language models. Standard Transformers remain powerful but computationally inefficient, as they allocate the same attention budget to every token regardless of its contextual demand. Existing local-global hybrids provide a more efficient alternative by mixing restricted- and full-context attention, but they typically allocate span statically across layers or heads. To address these limitations, we propose LoGo, a token-level dynamic local-global attention mechanism that uses attention span as a direct proxy for attention budget allocation. Each LoGo layer contains coupled local and global branches: all tokens receive efficient local attention over a restricted context window, while a learned gate activates global attention with full-context access only for tokens requiring long-range information. A threshold-based budget controller maintains a target global ratio without auxiliary losses, and a progressive masking schedule stabilizes training before sparse routing takes effect. We further implement query-sparse Triton kernels that convert reduced global-attention computation into practical speedups. Extensive experiments validate LoGo's effectiveness, showing that it preserves the scaling behavior of full-attention Transformers across model sizes. In controlled comparisons, LoGo improves over the full-attention Transformer and matched-budget static local-global hybrids, with clear gains on long-range retrieval. Analysis further shows that LoGo learns interpretable span allocation patterns. These results suggest that learned token-level span allocation is an effective and scalable way to improve the long-context performance-compute trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LoGo，一种令牌级动态局部-全局注意力机制，通过注意力跨度作为预算分配的代理，让模型仅对需要长距离信息的令牌激活全局注意力，其余令牌使用高效局部注意力，从而在保持全注意力Transformer缩放行为的同时提升长上下文性能-计算权衡。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer为每个令牌分配相同的注意力预算，导致上下文长度增长时注意力成为主要计算瓶颈；而现有局部-全局混合模型虽然更高效，但注意力跨度是静态分配的，无法根据令牌的实际上下文需求进行动态调整。
AI.method: LoGo包含耦合的局部和全局分支：所有令牌接收受限窗口的局部注意力，同时通过学习的门控仅为需要长距离信息的令牌激活全局注意力；采用基于阈值的预算控制器维持目标全局比例（无需辅助损失），并使用渐进式掩码调度稳定稀疏路由前的训练；进一步实现查询稀疏的Triton内核将计算节省转化为实际加速。
AI.result: 实验表明LoGo在多个模型规模上保持全注意力Transformer的缩放行为；在受控对比中优于全注意力Transformer和同等预算的静态局部-全局混合模型，尤其在长距离检索任务上增益明显；分析显示LoGo学到了可解释的跨度分配模式。
AI.conclusion: 学习式的令牌级跨度分配是一种有效且可扩展的方式，能够改善长上下文场景下的性能-计算权衡，为高效长上下文Transformer设计提供了新方向。

title: A Tensor Variational Formulation of Gradient Energy Total Variation
summary: We present a novel variational approach to a tensor-based total variation formulation which is called gradient energy total variation, GETV. We introduce the gradient energy tensor [6] into the GETV and show that the corresponding Euler-Lagrange (E-L) equation is a tensor-based partial differential equation of total variation type. Furthermore, we give a proof which shows that GETV is a convex functional. This approach, in contrast to the commonly used structure tensor, enables a formal derivation of the corresponding E-L equation. Experimental results suggest that GETV compares favourably to other state of the art variational denoising methods such as extended anisotropic diffusion (EAD)[1] and total variation (TV) [18] for gray-scale and colour images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于张量的全变分新变分方法——梯度能量全变分（GETV），将梯度能量张量引入全变分框架，推导出其对应的张量型偏微分方程，并证明了GETV是凸泛函。实验表明该方法在灰度图像和彩色图像去噪方面优于扩展各向异性扩散（EAD）和传统全变分（TV）等方法。
AI.motivation: 传统全变分（TV）方法在图像去噪中存在局限性，而基于结构张量的方法难以形式化推导对应的欧拉-拉格朗日方程。作者希望引入梯度能量张量来解决这一推导难题，从而构建一个既有数学严谨性又具有优良去噪性能的变分模型。
AI.method: 通过将梯度能量张量引入全变分框架构建GETV泛函，推导出对应的张量型全变分偏微分方程（欧拉-拉格朗日方程），并给出GETV为凸泛函的数学证明。该方法不同于常用的结构张量方法，能够实现对欧拉-拉格朗日方程的形式化推导。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，GETV在灰度图像和彩色图像去噪任务上优于扩展各向异性扩散（EAD）和传统全变分（TV）等现有最先进的变分去噪方法。
AI.conclusion: GETV是一种新颖且有效的张量型全变分去噪方法，其凸性保证了全局最优解的存在性，同时能够在去噪性能上超越现有主流变分方法，具有理论上的严谨性和实践中的优越性。

title: Evaluating LLMs on Conversational Text-to-SQL under Chain Ambiguity and Intent Drift
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have established conversational text-to-SQL as a practical interface between users and databases, often involving multiple turns of clarification and revision. However, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate execution accuracy, leaving the unfolding and shifting of user intent across turns largely uncovered. To address this, we introduce TIDE-Bench, a benchmark for conversational text-to-SQL under chain ambiguity and intent drift evaluation, targeting two recurring patterns: chain ambiguity, where an underspecified question triggers layered clarification with conditional dependencies, and intent drift, where the user retracts and replaces a previously committed request element. Built on 514 anchor SQLs from BIRD, TIDE-Bench comprises 1,542 samples and introduces dedicated metrics for chain identification and drift recognition-resolution beyond execution accuracy. Evaluating 12 advanced LLMs reveals a persistent chain identification bottleneck unaffected by clarification frequency, a wide drift recognition-resolution gap, and overlap between failure modes when jointly activated. The corresponding code of TIDE-Bench is released for further research.

AI.tldr: TIDE-Bench是一个面向对话式text-to-SQL的基准测试，专门评估链式歧义和意图漂移两种用户意图演化模式。基于BIRD数据集构建514个锚点SQL、1542个样本，引入链识别和漂移识别-解决等专用指标。评测12个先进LLM发现：链识别瓶颈与澄清频率无关、漂移识别-解决存在大差距、以及联合激活时失败模式重叠。
AI.motivation: 现有对话式text-to-SQL基准主要评估执行准确率，忽略了多轮对话中用户意图的展开和转移，缺乏对链式歧义和意图漂移的专门评测。
AI.method: 基于BIRD数据集的514个锚点SQL构建1,542个样本，设计链式歧义（未充分指定问题触发带条件依赖的分层澄清）和意图漂移（用户撤回并替换已承诺的请求元素）两种模式，并引入链识别、漂移识别-解决等专用评估指标。
AI.result: 评测12个先进LLM发现：1）链识别存在持续瓶颈，且不受澄清频率影响；2）漂移识别-解决之间存在宽泛的性能差距；3）当两种模式联合激活时，失败模式存在重叠。
AI.conclusion: TIDE-Bench揭示了大语言模型在对话式text-to-SQL中处理意图演化（链式歧义与意图漂移）的显著不足，为后续研究提供了公开代码和基准支持。

title: Dynamic-Robust Photometric-Semantic Reconstruction for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding
comment: Accepted to the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
summary: The integration of novel view synthesis (NVS) and open-vocabulary segmentation (OVS) has recently yielded powerful feed-forward 3D foundation models. However, their inherent reliance on static-scene assumptions leads to severe misalignment of spatial features in unconstrained dynamic environments. To bridge this critical gap, we propose SPAR, a novel joint semantic-geometric encoding architecture that explicitly isolates transient dynamic noise prior to latent space aggregation. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic-region-aware end-to-end training paradigm that structurally couples motion estimation with multi-view visual and semantic learning. This unified approach enables the network to inherently resolve motion conflicts and distill multi-view consistent, temporally stable scene representations from dynamic inputs. Extensive experiments on the challenging D-RE10K benchmark demonstrate that SPAR achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our end-to-end approach achieves exceptional novel view synthesis quality, yielding a PSNR of 22.15 dB and 23.33 dB given only 3 and 4 input views respectively. Despite being trained in a self-supervised manner, our model achieves an mIoU of 88.5% for motion mask prediction. Furthermore, our analysis reveals a strong inter-task synergy between photometric scene reconstruction and semantic understanding, where semantic synthesis learning consistently enhances photometric fidelity in novel view rendering. Code will be available at https://github.com/dmucby/SPAR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPAR，一种联合语义-几何编码架构，用于解决动态场景中新型视图合成与开放词汇分割的联合任务。通过显式分离瞬态动态噪声并引入动态区域感知的端到端训练范式，SPAR在D-RE10K基准上取得了最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的前馈3D基础模型将新型视图合成与开放词汇分割结合，但依赖于静态场景假设，导致在非约束动态环境中空间特征严重错配。需要弥合这一关键差距。
AI.method: 提出SPAR联合语义-几何编码架构，在潜空间聚合前显式隔离瞬态动态噪声；引入动态区域感知的端到端训练范式，将运动估计与多视图视觉和语义学习结构耦合，使网络内在地解决运动冲突并从动态输入中蒸馏多视图一致、时间稳定的场景表示。
AI.result: 在D-RE10K基准上取得最优性能。仅用3个和4个输入视图，PSNR分别达22.15 dB和23.33 dB；自监督训练下运动掩码预测mIoU达88.5%。发现语义合成学习能持续增强新型视图渲染的光度保真度，表明两大任务间存在强协同效应。
AI.conclusion: SPAR成功弥合了动态场景下NVS与OVS的联合建模鸿沟，实现了跨任务的协同增益，为动态3D基础模型的发展提供了新的架构范式和训练策略。

title: TACS: Trajectory-Aware Candidate Selection for LLM Jailbreak Suffix Optimization
summary: Gradient-based jailbreak suffix optimization methods typically update the suffix by retaining the candidate with the lowest current loss. We show that this seemingly natural design is fundamentally myopic: candidates that look better under the current-step proxy often fail to produce better jailbreak outcomes later in the search, revealing a form of selection-stage reward hacking. This suggests that candidate selection, rather than candidate generation alone, is a hidden bottleneck in suffix optimization. To address this issue, we propose \OURS{}, a trajectory-aware candidate selection framework for jailbreak suffix optimization. Instead of selecting candidates solely by their immediate loss, \OURS{} augments per-step evaluation with a trajectory-aware proxy and stabilizes selection with reference-policy regularization and a discriminator-estimated chi-squared correction, encouraging choices that remain effective beyond the current step. Experiments on HarmBench show that \OURS{} consistently outperforms strong baselines under the same search budget, substantially improving attack success rates while exhibiting more stable optimization behavior throughout the search. Our findings highlight that mitigating selection-stage reward hacking caused by myopic candidate selection is critical for improving jailbreak suffix optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OURS框架，通过轨迹感知的候选选择机制解决基于梯度的越狱后缀优化中"当前最优候选未必长远最优"的短视问题（即选择阶段的奖励欺骗），并在HarmBench基准上超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有梯度式越狱后缀优化方法在每步更新时仅选择当前损失最低的候选，这种看似自然的设计实际上是短视的——当前步骤表现好的候选在后续搜索中往往不能带来更好的越狱效果，揭示了选择阶段的奖励欺骗问题，说明候选选择而非候选生成才是后缀优化的隐藏瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出OURS轨迹感知候选选择框架：1) 在逐步评估中加入轨迹感知代理指标，替代仅依赖即时损失的候选选择；2) 使用参考策略正则化稳定选择过程；3) 通过判别器估计的卡方校正进一步调节，鼓励选择在当前步之后依然有效的候选。
AI.result: 在HarmBench基准上，OURS在相同搜索预算下持续优于强基线，显著提升攻击成功率，并在整个搜索过程中表现出更稳定的优化行为。
AI.conclusion: 缓解由短视候选选择导致的选择阶段奖励欺骗，是改进越狱后缀优化的关键。本研究强调候选选择环节的重要性，为后续相关工作提供了新视角。

title: Foundational feature fusion for conditional flow matching in 6D pose estimation
summary: Conditional flow matching has enabled a step forward in object 6D pose estimation, achieving state-of-the-art performance by progressively denoising and registering object representations to observed scenes. Existing methods require training task-specific encoders supervised on object-scene overlap and rely on trivial feature fusion strategies to resolve pose ambiguities. We present FunFlow6D, a novel flow matching-based formulation that leverages features from geometric and appearance foundation models for pose estimation, eliminating the need for task-specific encoder training. We also introduce a cross attention-based fusion mechanism that dynamically combines geometric and appearance features to provide richer conditioning for the flow matching module. Experiments on four datasets from the BOP benchmark show that FunFlow6D outperforms the previous state of the art while reducing supervision requirements and memory overhead. Extensive ablations validate the contribution of each proposed component. Project website: https://tev-fbk.github.io/FunFlow6D/.

AI.tldr: FunFlow6D是一种基于条件流匹配的物体6D姿态估计方法，利用几何和外观基础模型的特征，通过交叉注意力融合机制提供更丰富的条件信息，在BOP基准的四个数据集上超越了现有最先进方法，同时降低了监督需求和内存开销。
AI.motivation: 现有基于流匹配的6D姿态估计方法需要训练任务特定的编码器，依赖物体-场景重叠的监督信号，且使用简单的特征融合策略难以解决姿态歧义问题。
AI.method: FunFlow6D利用几何和外观基础模型提取特征，避免训练任务特定编码器；引入基于交叉注意力的融合机制，动态结合几何与外观特征，为流匹配模块提供更丰富的条件信息。
AI.result: 在BOP基准的四个数据集上，FunFlow6D超越了之前的最先进方法，同时减少了监督需求和内存开销；大量消融实验验证了各提出组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用基础模型特征和交叉注意力融合，FunFlow6D在简化训练流程的同时提升了6D姿态估计的精度，验证了该方法的有效性和泛化能力。

title: Which one is banana man? Evaluating vision-language models in multi-turn pragmatic interpretation
summary: Flexible adaptation to context and shared pragmatic intuitions contribute to smooth human conversation. Iterated reference games---in which players repeatedly pick out novel referents using language---present a test case for agents' ability to perform context-sensitive pragmatic reasoning in multi-turn linguistic environments. We tested humans and vision--language models on their ability to identify the intended meaning of descriptions produced in iterated reference games, varying the provided context in terms of amount, order, and relevance. While humans performed well consistently, the models we evaluated could make use of prior context to interpret humans' referring expressions, but they struggled to build up the relevant context to interpret those expressions effectively. Our results suggest that the models we evaluated lack core skills needed for efficient linguistic collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文通过迭代指称游戏测试了人类与视觉-语言模型在上下文敏感的语用推理能力。结果显示，人类表现稳定良好，而模型虽能利用先前上下文解读人类指称表达，但难以有效构建相关上下文，表明其缺乏高效语言协作的核心技能。
AI.motivation: 流畅的人类对话依赖于灵活的上下文适应和共享的语用直觉，而迭代指称游戏为测试智能体在多轮语言环境中进行上下文敏感语用推理的能力提供了理想场景。作者旨在探究视觉-语言模型是否具备这种能力。
AI.method: 在迭代指称游戏中测试人类和视觉-语言模型，通过改变上下文的数量、顺序和相关性来评估它们识别描述意图含义的能力。
AI.result: 人类在所有条件下均表现良好；模型能够利用先前上下文来解读人类的指称表达，但在构建有效解读所需的相关上下文方面存在困难。
AI.conclusion: 当前评估的视觉-语言模型缺乏高效语言协作所需的核心技能，特别是在上下文构建方面与人类存在显著差距。

title: Multi-Scale Temporal Domain Alignment for Federated Video Domain Adaptation
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Open-source will be available
summary: Federated Video Domain Adaptation (FVDA) enables collaborative learning across distributed and non-IID video datasets while preserving privacy, but is under-explored due to challenges in aligning temporal information. We propose Multi-scalE Temporal domAin aLignment (METAL), a novel framework that leverages temporal information at multiple resolutions to improve cross-domain video action recognition with only model parameter transfers. METAL trains per-scale transformer encoders on source-clients, then performs independent knowledge voting at each temporal scale to generate robust pseudo-labels on the target-server. A novel $L_2$ variance penalty enforces cross-scale consistency during scale-based knowledge distillation, preventing a singular dominant scale. The late fusion aggregates features across different scales, where the fusion head is trained via knowledge distillation using confidence-weighted aggregation of scale-wise predictions, enabling the model to effectively exploit complementary temporal information for final predictions. Experiments on Epic-Kitchens-55 and Daily-DA demonstrate state-of-the-art performances, with gains up to 28.47% over current FDA methods. Ablation studies prove that multi-scale distillation and scale coordination are critical for effective temporal knowledge transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出METAL框架，通过多尺度时间域对齐解决联邦视频域适应（FVDA）问题，在保护隐私的前提下仅传输模型参数，利用逐尺度Transformer编码器、独立知识投票、L2方差惩罚和知识蒸馏实现跨域视频动作识别，在Epic-Kitchens-55和Daily-DA数据集上取得了最高达28.47%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: FVDA在联邦学习中处理分布式非独立同分布视频数据时面临时间信息对齐的挑战，而这一领域目前研究不足。现有方法难以有效处理异构视频数据在时间维度上的域差异。
AI.method: METAL框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 在源客户端训练逐尺度Transformer编码器；(2) 在目标服务器端对每个时间尺度进行独立知识投票以生成鲁棒的伪标签；(3) 引入L2方差惩罚项强制跨尺度一致性，防止单一尺度主导；最后通过置信度加权聚合的尺度知识蒸馏训练融合头，利用后期融合整合不同尺度互补的时间信息。
AI.result: 在Epic-Kitchens-55和Daily-DA数据集上取得了最先进性能，相比现有FDA方法最高提升28.47%。消融实验证明多尺度蒸馏和尺度协调对有效的时间知识迁移至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度时间信息建模与跨尺度一致性约束是解决联邦视频域适应的关键，METAL通过模型参数传输即可实现高效的跨域视频动作识别，为FVDA领域提供了新的解决思路。

title: SemTrace: Source-Grounded Semantic Signatures for Tracing LLM Exposure to Protected Documents
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to read documents and produce downstream text, creating a provenance problem when the document owner cannot control or inspect the model that performs the generation. We introduce SemTrace, a source-grounded semantic watermark for detecting whether a generated review was influenced by a known protected manuscript copy. Rather than biasing token probabilities or imposing surface-form patterns, SemTrace constructs a document-specific binary signature from factual propositions that are directly supported by the manuscript itself. A protected PDF invisibly carries a content contract that selects one fact from each binary pair and asks an instruction-following reviewer to express those facts in fixed review slots without changing its independent evaluation. A frozen natural language inference model then decodes the resulting semantic evidence with explicit erasures and scores the recovered bits against the codeword assigned to that copy. This design targets model-agnostic, assigned-copy exposure detection while keeping the watermark semantically tied to the source document.

AI.tldr: SemTrace是一种基于源文档语义水印的溯源检测方法，通过文档特定的二元签名和自然语言推理模型来检测生成评论是否受已知受保护稿件副本的影响，无需干预生成模型。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被广泛用于阅读文档并生成下游文本，但当文档所有者无法控制或检查生成模型时，会产生溯源问题（即无法确认生成内容是否基于受保护文档）。现有方法多依赖偏置token概率或表面形式模式，作者希望实现模型无关且语义绑定源文档的检测方案。
AI.method: SemTrace首先从稿件本身提取事实命题构建文档特定的二元签名；受保护的PDF隐式携带内容契约，从每个二元对中选择一个事实，要求遵循指令的审稿人在固定审稿槽中表达这些事实而不改变其独立评价；随后使用冻结的自然语言推理模型解码语义证据（含显式擦除），并将恢复的比特与分配给该副本的码字进行比对评分。
AI.result: 该方法实现了模型无关的、指定副本暴露检测，水印在语义上与源文档绑定，能够检测生成评论是否受到已知受保护稿件副本的影响。
AI.conclusion: SemTrace通过将水印语义绑定到源文档内容本身，而非操纵生成概率或表面形式，提供了一种有效的溯源检测手段，可适用于无法控制或检查生成模型的场景。

title: OPUS-V2: Bridging the Gap between Sparse Points and Dense Voxels
summary: The point-based occupancy prediction paradigm has achieved an attractive trade-off between accuracy and efficiency by modeling 3D space sparsely. However, its predictions inherently mismatch the dense voxel-based occupancy required by self-driving systems, necessitating hand-crafted heuristics during training and inference that limit final performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose OPUS-V2, a novel framework built upon the pioneering OPUS (occupancy prediction using a sparse set) point-based approach. OPUS-V2 incorporates a lightweight point-voxel transformation (PVT) module behind the decoder to adaptively map sparse predictions into the dense voxel space, eliminating the need for suboptimal operations and improving model accuracy. Furthermore, our architecture decouples feature and occupancy generation processes, allowing OPUS-V2 to adapt to arbitrary occupancy resolutions. OPUS-V2 achieves a state-of-the-art rayIoU of 44.0 on the Occ3D dataset. On the more challenging OpenOccupancy dataset, it attains a competitive 16.4 mIoU while running in real time at 20.6 FPS.

AI.tldr: OPUS-V2是一个基于点式占用预测范式的先进框架，通过引入轻量化的点-体素变换模块，将稀疏预测自适应地映射到稠密体素空间，消除了传统方法中手工设计的启发式操作，并在特征与占用生成过程中实现解耦，支持任意占用分辨率。在Occ3D数据集上达到44.0的rayIoU（SOTA），在OpenOccupancy数据集上取得16.4 mIoU，同时以20.6 FPS实时运行。
AI.motivation: 点式占用预测虽在精度与效率之间取得了良好平衡，但其稀疏预测与自动驾驶系统所需的稠密体素占用存在固有失配，导致训练和推理阶段需要依赖手工设计的启发式操作，这限制了最终性能的进一步提升。
AI.method: OPUS-V2在OPUS点式方法基础上，提出两点关键改进：（1）在解码器后引入轻量化的点-体素变换（PVT）模块，自适应地将稀疏预测映射到稠密体素空间，消除次优的启发式操作；（2）将特征生成与占用生成过程解耦，使框架能够适配任意占用分辨率。
AI.result: 在Occ3D数据集上取得44.0的rayIoU（当前最优）；在更具挑战性的OpenOccupancy数据集上获得16.4 mIoU，并以20.6 FPS的帧率实现实时推理。
AI.conclusion: OPUS-V2通过点-体素变换模块和特征/占用生成解耦设计，有效解决了点式占用预测与稠密体素表示之间的固有失配问题，在提升精度的同时保持了实时推理效率，为3D占用预测提供了一种更优的解决方案。

title: SUP-MIMIC: A Multi-Task Clinical Diagnosis Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs' Robustness to Contradictory Evidence
summary: Current evaluations of large language models (LLMs) primarily focus on factual knowledge retrieval, overlooking the fundamental challenge of navigating the complex, non-bijective mappings between clinical indicators and diagnoses. Existing benchmarks fail to assess whether large language models truly possess the reasoning capability required for diagnostic ambiguity scenarios, where identical clinical presentations may correspond to different etiologies, and diagnostic convergence scenarios, where heterogeneous symptoms ultimately indicate the same disease. To address this issue, we propose SUP-MIMIC, a multi-task framework utilizing MIMIC-IV-v3.1 that comprises Basic Assessment (BA), Diagnostic Divergence Task (DDT), and Diagnostic Convergence Task (DCT). Specifically, DDT is designed to evaluate the model's "one-to-many" disambiguation capability among phenotypically similar cases, while DCT assesses the model's ability to identify "many-to-one" diagnostic patterns across different pathophysiological pathways. Comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs reveals substantial performance degradation on DDT and DCT compared to baseline tasks, exposing a systemic reliance on statistical shortcuts over genuine causal reasoning. Our findings further highlight a conservative bias toward "healthy" predictions, implying non-trivial risks for missed diagnoses in realistic medical settings. This work establishes a rigorous methodology for quantifying clinical reasoning robustness and provides a roadmap for enhancing the safety of language models in clinical medicine.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SUP-MIMIC框架，基于MIMIC-IV-v3.1数据集，通过基础评估（BA）、诊断发散任务（DDT）和诊断收敛任务（DCT）三个子任务，系统评估大语言模型在临床诊断中的推理能力，发现模型在非一一映射的诊断场景下性能显著下降，并存在向"健康"预测偏移的保守偏见。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM评估过于聚焦事实性知识检索，忽略了临床指标与诊断之间复杂的非一一映射关系，无法真正衡量模型在诊断歧义和诊断收敛场景下的推理能力。
AI.method: 构建SUP-MIMIC多任务框架，包含三个任务：基础评估（BA）作为基线，诊断发散任务（DDT）评估"一对多"消歧能力，诊断收敛任务（DCT）评估"多对一"诊断模式识别能力，在MIMIC-IV-v3.1数据上对多个SOTA LLM进行综合评测。
AI.result: 主流LLM在DDT和DCT上的性能相比基线任务显著下降，暴露了模型依赖统计捷径而非真正因果推理的问题；同时发现模型存在偏向"健康"预测的保守偏见，在真实医疗场景中可能带来漏诊风险。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了量化临床推理鲁棒性的严格方法论，并为提升语言模型在临床医学中的安全性提供了改进路线图。

title: RLG-TPV: Radar- and LiDAR-Guided Tri-Perspective View Fusion for Camera-Radar 3D Object Detection
summary: Tri-Perspective View (TPV) representations describe 3D scene structure through top, side, and front feature planes, but existing TPV lifting is primarily camera-based, leaving the depth of sampled image evidence ambiguous along projected camera rays. We propose RLG-TPV, a multimodal TPV framework for camera-radar 3D object detection in which radar and training-time LiDAR provide complementary geometric guidance during representation construction. A ray-guided deformable-attention lift weights sampled image features using LiDAR-supervised camera depth probabilities and radar frustum occupancy, while radar additionally refines the depth distribution before lifting. Because conventional radar provides limited elevation information, LiDAR-derived class-occupancy targets supervise the side and front planes during training; the corresponding heads are removed at inference, so deployment requires only cameras and radar. For temporal aggregation, Doppler-guided temporal fusion aligns past features using a motion field anchored by measured radar radial velocity, with gating that limits warping in regions without supported motion. An RCS-aware radar scatter further allows radar evidence to spread over spatial neighborhoods conditioned on radar cross section. On the nuScenes validation set, RLG-TPV achieves 0.4981 mAP and 0.5959 NDS, reducing orientation and velocity error by 31.9\% and 30.7\% relative to the published CRN baseline. Ablation studies show that ray-level geometric guidance is a major contributor to the final performance.
