AI.tldr: 本文提出RLG-TPV，一个用于相机-雷达3D目标检测的多模态TPV框架。通过雷达和训练时的LiDAR提供几何引导来构建表示：利用LiDAR监督的相机深度概率和雷达视锥占据度进行射线引导的可变形注意力提升，雷达进一步优化深度分布；训练时利用LiDAR类别占据目标监督侧平面和前平面，推理时移除相应头，部署仅需相机和雷达。在nuScenes验证集上达到0.4981 mAP和0.5959 NDS。
AI.motivation: 现有的TPV（三视角视图）表示主要依赖相机进行提升，导致沿投影相机射线的采样图像证据深度存在模糊性，缺乏明确的几何引导，限制了3D目标检测性能。
AI.method: 1) 射线引导的可变形注意力提升：利用LiDAR监督的相机深度概率和雷达视锥占据度加权采样图像特征；2) 雷达在提升前进一步细化深度分布；3) LiDAR导出的类别占据目标在训练时监督侧平面和前平面，推理时移除对应头，实现仅相机和雷达的部署；4) Doppler引导的时间融合：利用雷达径向速度锚定的运动场对齐过去特征，并通过门控限制无支撑运动区域的扭曲；5) RCS感知的雷达散点，使雷达证据根据雷达截面积条件在空间邻域传播。
AI.result: 在nuScenes验证集上，RLG-TPV达到0.4981 mAP和0.5959 NDS，相对已发表的CRN基线，方向误差降低31.9%，速度误差降低30.7%。消融实验表明射线级几何引导是最终性能的主要贡献因素。
AI.conclusion: RLG-TPV验证了多模态几何引导（雷达+训练时LiDAR）能有效解决TPV相机提升中的深度模糊问题，在保持推理时仅需相机和雷达的前提下显著提升3D检测性能，证明了跨模态几何先验在鸟类视图表示学习中的价值。

title: How You Ask Shapes What You Get: A Theory-Seeded Measurement of Articulation in Advice-Seeking LLM Conversations
summary: Users articulate the same advice-seeking request in different ways: some specify detailed constraints, others gesture at a vague need. Prior work treats this variation as noise to be averaged away; we instead treat it as a stable, measurable structure in the input distribution. We ask whether articulation (how people ask) forms latent dimensions separable from topic (what they ask about), and whether it is associated with how language models respond. We extract interpretable features from 16,447 advice-seeking prompts pooled from public chat corpora (WildChat, LMSYS, and ShareChat) and recover a small set of latent articulation factors that replicate across train/test splits and across corpora. Because this structure is largely separable from topic, the populations it defines cut across topics and stay invisible to topic- or task-based evaluation. The factors define a handful of recurring articulation styles, one of which stands out: a long-form but information-poor style, roughly one in six prompts in the largest corpus, where models return shorter, vaguer answers and do not ask for clarification even though under-specification is exactly the condition that warrants it. The contrast holds within every topic group and length quintile, and is not under-specification alone -- a second, equally under-specified style does draw clarifying questions. Two independent human annotators reproduce this contrast. We argue that benchmarks should stratify on articulation, and we offer the extracted structure as a measurement instrument for doing so.

AI.tldr: 本文从16,447条建议寻求类提示中提取出与主题分离的"表述风格"（articulation）潜在维度，发现约六分之一的提示属于"长篇但信息贫乏"风格，该风格下模型给出的回答更短更模糊且不会主动追问澄清，而同等欠规范的另一风格却会触发模型的澄清提问。作者主张基准测试应按表述风格进行分层。
AI.motivation: 过往研究将用户在建议寻求提示中的不同表达方式视为应被平均掉的噪声，但作者认为这种差异是输入分布中稳定、可测量的结构，且可能影响语言模型的响应质量，值得系统性研究。
AI.method: 从WildChat、LMSYS和ShareChat三个公开对话语料库中汇集16,447条建议寻求提示，提取可解释特征，恢复出少量在训练/测试划分及跨语料库中可复现的潜在表述因素，并通过人类标注者复验关键差异。
AI.result: 恢复出与主题大致可分离的表述因素，定义了几种反复出现的表述风格。其中一种"长篇但信息贫乏"风格约占最大语料库中六分之一的提示，该风格下模型返回更短、更模糊的回答且不主动追问澄清；对比组同样欠规范的另一风格却能引发澄清提问，且该对比在每个主题组和长度五分位内均成立。
AI.conclusion: 表述风格是与主题独立的稳定人口结构维度，现有基于主题或任务维度的评估无法覆盖它，基准测试应当按表述风格进行分层，并将提取出的结构作为测量工具。

title: Bayesian-Optimized Superpixel-GrabCut for Traceable Optic Disc Segmentation
comment: Accepted at 15th International Conference on Image Processing Theory, Tools and Applications 2026
summary: Optic disc (OD) segmentation is essential for diagnosing ophthalmic pathologies from retinal fundus images. However, prevailing deep learning approaches operate as opaque black boxes, lacking the inference-stage mathematical traceability--a critical requirement for algorithmic auditing and failure analysis in clinical workflows. This paper presents a fully algorithmically traceable and trainable segmentation pipeline that jointly combines superpixel decomposition, hybrid brightness-proximity superpixel scoring, morphological regularization, iterative GrabCut refinement, and elliptical shape fitting. The hyperparameter optimization is formulated as an objective function and solved via Bayesian optimization to eliminate manual parameter tuning. A quantitative evaluation on the Drishti-GS dataset demonstrates that our method achieves a Dice coefficient of 0.9536, matching state-of-the-art performance. By maintaining explicit mathematical transparency across all processing stages, our framework offers a deterministic, traceable alternative to black-box architectures for medical review and debugging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种完全可算法追溯的视盘分割流水线，结合超像素分解、混合亮度-邻近度评分、形态学正则化、迭代GrabCut细化和椭圆拟合，通过贝叶斯优化自动调整超参数，在Drishti-GS数据集上达到0.9536的Dice系数，匹敌现有最优性能，为临床审查和调试提供了可追踪的替代方案。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习视盘分割方法虽性能优异，但如同黑盒，缺乏推理阶段的可数学追溯性，而这对于临床工作流中的算法审计和故障分析至关重要。
AI.method: 构建了一个完全可追溯且可训练的分割流水线，融合五个核心模块：超像素分解、混合亮度-邻近度超像素评分、形态学正则化、迭代GrabCut细化及椭圆形状拟合；并将超参数优化建模为目标函数，通过贝叶斯优化求解以消除人工调参。
AI.result: 在Drishti-GS数据集上取得了0.9536的Dice系数，与现有最先进方法性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在所有处理阶段保持明确的数学透明度，为医学审查和调试提供了确定性、可追溯的黑盒架构替代方案。

title: Hindsight Memory-PRM: Supervising Memory Management with Auditable Hindsight Credit
summary: Memory operations of long-horizon LLM agents are hard to supervise: an operation's value is unobservable when it is taken. But they are special -- they leave machine-readable evidence in the trajectory: retrieval hits and answer-time citations. Hindsight Memory-PRM exploits this audit trail twice: offline to train an operation-conditioned memory-utility critic, and online, where retrievals, citations, and one controlled deletion-and-reanswer per probe settle an intervention-calibrated entry-level presence credit, propagated along version chains as an action-level proxy reward -- no per-operation human labels, no Monte-Carlo replay of continuations. On held-out LoCoMo a local 8B policy reaches 77.5% under a fixed shared reader, surpassing its API teacher (65.1%) and all reproduced external systems, at one eighth the context of Mem0's official operating point; on LongMemEval, 79.0%. Ablations attribute the gain to causal calibration rather than signal density, and the policy converges to a multi-version memory organization whose gains no tested open-loop baseline reproduces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hindsight Memory-PRM方法，通过利用轨迹中的检索命中与引用等机器可读证据，离线训练记忆效用批评器，在线进行干预校准的信用分配，实现对长视野LLM代理记忆操作的无监督监督，在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上超越API教师模型及所有复现的外部系统。
AI.motivation: 长视野LLM代理的记忆操作难以监督，因为操作的价值在操作发生时不可观测，且逐操作的人工标注成本高昂。
AI.method: 利用轨迹中的检索命中和回答时引用作为机器可读审计轨迹：离线阶段训练操作条件化的记忆效用批评器；在线阶段通过检索、引用以及受控的删除-重答探针来分配干预校准的入场级存在信用，并沿版本链传播作为代理奖励，无需逐操作人工标签，也无需蒙特卡洛重放后续轨迹。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo上本地8B策略达到77.5%，超越API教师模型（65.1%）及所有复现的外部系统，且只需Mem0官方操作点八分之一的上下文；在LongMemEval上达到79.0%。消融实验表明性能提升主要归因于因果校准而非信号密度。
AI.conclusion: 该方法验证了利用审计轨迹实现记忆操作无监督监督的可行性，策略能够收敛到多版本记忆组织，且该组织的收益是开环基线无法复现的。

title: Ground-to-Satellite Localization in Unconstrained Image Collections for 3D Scene Reconstruction
comment: IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS) 2026
summary: Ground image localization with respect to satellite imagery is a key enabler for metrically-accurate, geo-localized 3D scene reconstruction from unconstrained image collections. Existing cross-view localization methods have strict requirements such as panoramic imagery or known initial locations, limiting their applicability for in-the-wild reconstruction settings. We propose a robust hierarchical cross-view localization framework that leverages geometric constraints from Structure-from-Motion (SfM) models derived from unconstrained ground image collections. Our method generates coarse-to-fine pose hypotheses through a cross-view matching approach and aggregates noisy predictions across SfM model(s) using Kernel Density Estimation to recover consensus alignments while filtering outliers. Experiments demonstrate reliable localization performance from challenging image collections. Empirically we found satellite-referenced alignment enables accurate metric scale estimation, doppelgänger detection, and merging of disjoint SfM reconstructions, resulting in more complete, geo-localized site models than are possible with SfM alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种鲁棒的层次化跨视角定位框架，利用从无序地面图像集合中生成的Structure-from-Motion（SfM）模型的几何约束，实现地面图像与卫星图像之间的定位对齐，支持精确的度量尺度估计、重复区域检测以及多个SfM重建的合并。
AI.motivation: 现有的跨视角定位方法对输入有严格要求（如全景图像或已知初始位置），难以适用于野外非约束图像集合的3D场景重建场景，需要一种更鲁棒且无需严格前置条件的跨视角定位方法。
AI.method: 提出层次化跨视角定位框架：1）通过跨视角匹配生成从粗到细的位姿假设；2）利用Kernel Density Estimation聚合SfM模型中多个有噪声的预测，恢复一致性对齐并过滤异常值。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在具有挑战性的图像集合上表现可靠，卫星参考对齐能够实现精确的度量尺度估计、doppelgänger（相似/重复结构）检测，以及合并不相交的SfM重建，生成比仅用SfM更完整的地理定位站点模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了卫星图像参考在非约束地面图像集合的SfM重建中的价值，展示了跨视角定位在提升重建完整性、尺度准确性和多模型融合方面的广泛应用潜力。

title: Agent Zero Memory: Provenance-Aware Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents need durable, faithful memory of everything a user or organization has said and stored, yet most memory systems commit to a single organizing structure (a fact store, a vector index, or a knowledge graph) and inherit its blind spots. We present Agent Zero Memory, a provenance-aware long-term memory system that distils a user's conversations, files, and connected sources into three parallel memory systems, each capturing a different facet of the same history: an episodic Memory Events timeline that makes when and what changed first-class, an associative entity-event knowledge graph that links people and projects across sessions, and a semantic, curated, citation-locked Hierarchical Documentary Memory (HDM) of durable facts. A retrieval turn runs an intent gate (so self-contained turns add no latency), a source router, and three concurrent agentic searches, one per system, each a tool-using loop over hybrid (embedding + lexical) search under agent-controlled filters; their grounded, cited answers are integrated into one answer with a single confidence. We formalize the reading discipline: every learned item is a provenanced item carrying its origin, timestamp, and evidence pointer, and every answer is read under a citation lock, so it may cite only evidence its reader actually opened; fabrication is structurally excluded and the system abstains rather than guesses. On two public benchmarks the system sets a new state of the art: 95.60% on LongMemEval and 93.60% on LoCoMo, improving over the strongest prior systems by +0.73 and +1.10 points. A controlled study across eight backbone LLMs characterizes the accuracy-cost-latency frontier: accuracy varies by only 3.4 points while per-query cost varies by ~30x, with near-state-of-the-art quality at up to 20x lower cost per query, the signature of memory-driven, rather than model-driven, quality.

AI.tldr: 提出Agent Zero Memory，一种来源感知的长期记忆系统，将用户对话、文件和连接源蒸馏为三种并行记忆系统（事件时间线、实体-事件知识图谱、分层文档记忆），通过意图门控、源路由和三路并发智能体检索实现高精度回忆，在LongMemEval和LoCoMo基准上刷新SOTA，并揭示质量由记忆而非模型驱动。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体的记忆系统大多采用单一组织结构（事实存储、向量索引或知识图谱），每种结构都继承了各自的盲点，无法全面捕捉用户和组织的历史信息，缺乏来源感知和可追溯性的长期记忆能力。
AI.method: 1) 构建三种并行记忆系统：Memory Events事件时间线（时间优先）、实体-事件知识图谱（关联人/项目）、分层文档记忆HDM（持久事实）；2) 检索阶段包含意图门控（自包含回合零延迟）、源路由器和三路并发智能体搜索；3) 每个搜索是使用混合嵌入+词汇检索的工具循环，在智能体控制过滤下运行；4) 形式化阅读纪律：每个学习项携带来源、时间戳和证据指针，每个答案受引文锁约束，只能引用实际打开的证据，结构性排除捏造，系统宁可弃答也不猜测。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval上达到95.60%，在LoCoMo上达到93.60%，分别比最强先验系统提升+0.73和+1.10个百分点。在8个骨干LLM上，准确率仅波动3.4个百分点，而单次查询成本波动约30倍，可在降低高达20倍成本的同时保持接近SOTA的质量。
AI.conclusion: 多视角并行记忆架构与严格的来源溯源纪律可显著提升LLM智能体的长期记忆能力；质量主要由记忆系统本身驱动而非底层模型驱动，使模型性价比选择成为可能，为该领域确立了新的性能标杆。

title: SGPDFuse: Semantically-Guided Physics-Disentanglement General Multi-Modal Image Fusion
summary: Multimodal image fusion (MMIF) aims to integrate complementary sensor data into a single representation that preserves intrinsic scene reality while eliminating environmental interferences. Most existing approaches rely on blind feature aggregation, which excels at signal accumulation but fails to distinguish essential content from physical degradations. We propose SGPDFuse, which bridges this gap by mapping inputs into a physics-disentangled structural representation via a Semantic-Physical Parametric Bridge (SPPB) built on pretrained vision foundation models, utilizing the Intrinsic-Variation principle to decouple invariant scene attributes from transient environmental factors. To guide this decomposition, we introduce a Semantic Alignment mechanism: we explicitly anchor the fused representation to salient semantic features in the same foundation model feature space via cosine similarity to preserve critical targets, while enforcing physical texture fidelity through Gram-matrix regularization to strictly eliminate unnatural artifacts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SGPDFuse achieves state-of-the-art performance across infrared-visible, multi-focus, and multi-exposure benchmarks using a single architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SGPDFuse，一种基于物理解耦的多模态图像融合方法。该方法利用预训练视觉基础模型构建语义-物理参数桥（SPPB），通过内在-变化原则将输入解耦为不变场景属性与瞬态环境因素，并通过语义对齐机制（余弦相似度锚定关键目标+Gram矩阵正则化保证物理纹理保真）指导分解过程，在红外-可见光、多聚焦和多曝光三个基准上以单一架构取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有大多数多模态图像融合方法依赖盲特征聚合，擅长信号累积但无法区分本质内容与物理退化信息，导致融合结果可能保留环境干扰或降低关键目标的可辨性。
AI.method: 提出SGPDFuse框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于预训练视觉基础模型的语义-物理参数桥（SPPB），将输入映射到物理解耦的结构化表示；(2) 利用内在-变化（Intrinsic-Variation）原则解耦不变场景属性与瞬态环境因素；(3) 语义对齐机制，通过余弦相似度将融合表示锚定到基础模型特征空间中的显著语义特征以保留关键目标，并通过Gram矩阵正则化强制物理纹理保真、消除不自然伪影。
AI.result: 在红外-可见光、多聚焦和多曝光三类基准数据集上的大量实验表明，SGPDFuse使用单一网络架构即可在所有基准上取得最先进的融合性能。
AI.conclusion: 将物理解耦思想与视觉基础模型的语义先验结合，可以有效克服盲特征聚合的局限，在统一架构下实现多种多模态图像融合任务的最优表现，验证了语义-物理解耦范式在多模态融合领域的通用性和有效性。

title: Beyond Surface Alignment: Grounding the Dynamics of Situational Understanding and Generative Control in LLMs
comment: PhD Thesis submitted to UChicago (https://knowledge.uchicago.edu/records/5jrnc-nvp13). Update Branching Factor, AI Realtor, and BACo to the latest versions
summary:
The current alignment tuning paradigm for Large Language Models (LLMs) prioritizes surface-level behaviors -- fluency, safety, and tonal consistency. While effective for casual chat, this thesis argues that such surface alignment masks a lack of grounding, creating models that are stylistically confident but situationally brittle. We propose a framework of Grounded Alignment, analyzing how models process context (Input) and structure generation (Output), then aligning these grounded behaviors to human needs.
  First, we evaluate failures in Situational Grounding. SitTest shows that despite large context windows, state-of-the-art models struggle to maintain a consistent "mental model" of a changing environment. ReCode further shows that models rely on surface heuristics rather than deep syntactic dependencies: they "read" extensive histories without truly "understanding" the evolving situation.
  Second, we evaluate Generative Grounding. We introduce the Branching Factor (BF) to map LLM generation, finding that standard alignment tuning constricts this landscape into premature stylistic collapse. Hindsight further shows that models often fail to understand their own generations.
  Finally, we propose Dynamic Control for grounded interaction. AI Realtor demonstrates context engineering to compensate for poor situational grounding. Base-Aligned Model Collaboration decouples exploration from stylistic constraints. We also present Annealed Sampling for verifiable reinforcement learning and apply these ideas to Addiction Support, where model-generated rationalization offers a communication interface for high-stakes domains. Collectively, this work moves beyond surface alignment toward agents anchored in both context and generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Grounded Alignment"（接地对齐）框架，指出当前LLM对齐范式过度关注表面行为（流畅性、安全性、语调一致性），导致模型风格自信但情境脆弱。作者从情境接地（Input）和生成接地（Output）两个维度分析模型缺陷，并提出动态控制策略以实现真正锚定于上下文和生成过程的智能体。
AI.motivation: 当前的对齐调优范式优先追求表面行为（流畅性、安全性、语调一致性），对闲聊有效但掩盖了模型缺乏真实情境理解的问题——模型在风格上自信但在情境变化时表现脆弱。作者认为需要超越表面对齐，实现真正锚定于上下文和生成过程的接地行为。
AI.method: 从三个层面展开：(1)情境接地评估：提出SitTest测试模型在环境变化下维持连贯心理模型的能力，用ReCode揭示模型依赖表面启发式而非深层句法依赖；(2)生成接地评估：引入Branching Factor（BF）映射LLM生成空间，发现标准对齐调优导致过早的风格崩溃（premature stylistic collapse），Hindsight揭示模型常无法理解自身生成内容；(3)动态控制：提出AI Realtor进行上下文工程、Base-Aligned Model Collaboration解耦探索与风格约束、Annealed Sampling用于可验证强化学习，并应用于成瘾支持等高危领域。
AI.result: SitTest显示即便拥有大上下文窗口，最先进模型也难以维持对变化环境一致的"心理模型"；ReCode证明模型"阅读"了大量历史却未真正"理解"演化情境；BF图谱表明标准对齐调优将生成空间压缩为过早的风格崩溃；Hindsight显示模型对自身生成缺乏自省能力。提出的动态控制方案在AI Realtor、Base-Aligned Model Collaboration及成瘾支持等场景中展示了弥补这些缺陷的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 本文主张对齐不应停留在表面行为层面，而应深入到模型如何处理上下文（Input）和如何结构化生成（Output）的内在机制中。通过情境接地与生成接地两个维度的系统性评估与改进，研究推动LLM从表面对齐走向真正锚定于上下文与生成过程的智能体，特别是在高风险领域（如成瘾支持）中提供更可靠的人机交互接口。

title: Using Channel Representations in Regularization Terms: A Case Study on Image Diffusion
summary: In this work we propose a novel non-linear diffusion filtering approach for images based on their channel representation. To derive the diffusion update scheme we formulate a novel energy functional using a soft-histogram representation of image pixel neighborhoods obtained from the channel encoding. The resulting Euler-Lagrange equation yields a non-linear robust diffusion scheme with additional weighting terms stemming from the channel representation which steer the diffusion process. We apply this novel energy formulation to image reconstruction problems, showing good performance in the presence of mixtures of Gaussian and impulse-like noise, e.g. missing data. In denoising experiments of common scalar-valued images our approach performs competitive compared to other diffusion schemes as well as state-of-the-art denoising methods for the considered noise types.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于图像通道表示的非线性扩散滤波方法。通过软直方图表示像素邻域并构造新的能量泛函，导出具有通道表示加权项的非线性鲁棒扩散机制，应用于图像重建，在混合高斯噪声和脉冲噪声下表现良好，去噪性能优于或持平现有扩散方案及先进去噪方法。
AI.motivation: 传统非线性扩散滤波在处理混合噪声（如高斯噪声与脉冲噪声并存）以及缺失数据等复杂图像退化场景时性能有限，需要一种更具鲁棒性和适应性的扩散机制。
AI.method: 基于图像的通道表示（channel representation），利用软直方图对像素邻域进行编码，构造新的能量泛函；通过欧拉-拉格朗日方程导出带有通道表示权重的非线性鲁棒扩散更新方案，其中权重项可引导扩散过程。
AI.result: 将所提方法应用于图像重建，在混合高斯噪声与脉冲噪声（如缺失数据）场景下表现良好；在常见标量图像去噪实验中，其性能与现有扩散方案及考虑噪声类型下的最先进去噪方法相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 基于通道表示的扩散框架是处理混合噪声图像重建的有效方案，在鲁棒性和去噪性能上具备竞争力，为图像扩散滤波提供了新的能量泛函设计思路。

title: Cross-lingual Functional Vectors for Emotion Detection in Large Language Models
comment: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Function vectors (FVs) have recently emerged as a promising mechanism for steering the behavior of large language models (LLMs) by injecting task-specific latent direction representations derived from in-context demonstrations. While prior studies have shown that FVs can recover task behavior in structured in-context learning settings, their effectiveness on semantically complex tasks and their ability to generalize across languages remain underexplored. We investigate the cross-lingual transferability of FVs using multilingual multi-label emotion recognition as a challenging semantic classification benchmark. Specifically, we examine whether FVs extracted from a source language can steer task behavior in another language under both standard clean and perturbed zero-shot settings without providing demonstrations during inference. Across diverse cross-lingual settings, applying FVs substantially improves performance, suggesting that FVs capture language-agnostic, task-relevant signals rather than purely language-specific lexical patterns, and highlighting their potential as a lightweight and transferable mechanism for multilingual task adaptation. We observe that each LLM exhibits a relatively stable optimal range of attention heads for constructing effective FVs, and the pattern remains consistent across languages. In addition, FVs can partially replicate the task-steering effects of standard few-shot in-context learning while avoiding the computational overhead of processing multiple demonstrations, making them effective for large-scale practical applications. Our code is available at https://github.com/yingjie7/cross_lingual_fvs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了函数向量（FVs）在跨语言任务迁移中的表现，以多语言多标签情感识别为基准，发现FVs能捕获语言无关的任务信号，在零样本跨语言设置下显著提升LLM的性能，且每个模型在不同语言中保持稳定的最优注意力头范围，可作为轻量级、可迁移的多语言任务适配机制。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有研究证明函数向量在结构化情境学习设置中能恢复任务行为，但其在语义复杂任务上的有效性以及跨语言泛化能力尚未得到充分探索，因此需要系统研究FVs的跨语言可迁移性。
AI.method: 使用多语言多标签情感识别作为语义分类基准，从源语言中提取函数向量，在标准干净和扰动零样本设置下（推理时不提供演示）测试其引导其他语言任务行为的能力，并分析不同LLM中注意力头的选择范围。
AI.result: 跨语言设置下应用FVs能显著提升性能，表明FVs捕获的是语言无关的任务相关信号而非语言特定的词汇模式；每个LLM在不同语言中保持相对稳定的最优注意力头范围；FVs能部分复现少样本情境学习的任务引导效果，同时避免处理多个演示的计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 函数向量是一种轻量且可迁移的多语言任务适配机制，具有大规模实际应用的潜力，代码已公开发布。

title: Compact Snapshot Spectral Imaging with Calibration-Free Aperture Diffraction
comment: Submitted to IEEE TPAMI. Under Review
summary: Snapshot Spectral Imaging (SSI) provides high-dimensional temporal-spatial-spectral observation to uncover intrinsic physical characteristics. However, its complex system and repetitive calibration requirements hinder edge applications. Here, we propose a compact, cost-effective, calibration-free SSI method, Aperture Diffraction Imaging Spectrometer (ADIS), which consists only of a diffractive lens with a binary mask and a Bayer-filtered sensor, requiring no additional physical footprint compared to standard RGB cameras. ADIS disperses and multiplexes wavelengths, mapping energy to distinct sensor locations, enabling full-resolution recovery from superpixel-level encodings. ADIS directly leverages theoretically computed PSFs to enable calibration-free spectral reconstruction, while tolerating lens-dependent variations across different optical configurations and bridging the gap between simulation and reality. To achieve SSI by solving a sparsely-constrained inverse problem, we introduce the Orthogonal Diffraction-Aware Unfolding Framework (ODAUF) with Voxel Shift Transformer (VST) for improved orthogonal diffraction perception. Integrating VST into ODAUF forms the efficient Orthogonal Diffraction-Aware Unfolding Voxel Shift Transformer (ODAUVST), delivering excellent recovery and reduced parameters. By elaborating on theory, systematic and comprehensive comparing, and demonstrating real SSI results, we validate the superiority of ADIS, achieving calibration-free full-resolution SSI within a commercial camera footprint.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种紧凑、低成本、免校准的快照光谱成像（SSI）方法ADIS，仅由带二元掩膜的衍射透镜和Bayer滤光片传感器组成，无需额外物理空间，并设计了ODAUVST框架实现全分辨率光谱重建。
AI.motivation: 快照光谱成像（SSI）能够提供高维时空光谱观测以揭示物体内在物理特性，但现有系统结构复杂、需要重复校准，严重阻碍了其在边缘设备上的应用。
AI.method: ADIS仅由衍射透镜+二元掩膜+Bayer传感器构成，在标准RGB相机体积内实现光谱色散与多路复用；直接利用理论计算PSF实现免校准重建，并提出ODAUF框架（含Voxel Shift Transformer, VST）求解稀疏约束逆问题以提升正交衍射感知能力，最终形成ODAUVST用于高效光谱重建。
AI.result: 通过理论阐述、系统对比实验和真实SSI结果验证，ADIS在商用相机体积内实现了免校准的全分辨率快照光谱成像，且ODAUVST在保证优异重建质量的同时减少了模型参数量。
AI.conclusion: ADIS成功弥合了仿真与真实之间的差距，容忍不同光学配置下透镜相关的变化，在标准商用相机尺寸内实现了免校准的全分辨率SSI，验证了其优越性和实际应用价值。

title: JPO: Juris Policy Optimization for Structured Legal Reasoning in Criminal Judgment Prediction
summary: Criminal judgment prediction requires models to infer statutory articles, charges, and sentencing outcomes from case facts. Unlike standard classification tasks, it involves a structured reasoning process in which statutes should be matched with facts, charges should be justified by statutes, and sentencing outcomes should remain consistent with charges. Existing approaches optimize final labels, and while some have attempted to evaluate reasoning quality, their evaluations are indirect, often relying on LLM-generated rubrics that reflect model-internal preferences rather than the inherent logical structure of legal adjudication. We propose Juris Policy Optimization (JPO), a post-training framework for structured legal reasoning in Chinese criminal judgment prediction. JPO first uses teacher-generated rationales to supervise a standardized four-step reasoning process, and then applies reinforcement learning with a composite reward over legal prediction quality, reasoning structure completeness, and cross-step consistency. JPO further introduces token-level advantage reweighting and adaptive clipping for legally salient reasoning segments. Experiments on multiple open-source language models and three Chinese legal benchmarks show that JPO consistently improves both judgment prediction and reasoning quality over supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Juris Policy Optimization (JPO)，一个用于中文刑事判决预测的结构化法律推理后训练框架。JPO先用教师生成的推理链监督标准四步推理过程，再通过强化学习优化法律预测质量、推理结构完整性和跨步骤一致性，并引入token级优势重加权和自适应裁剪。实验表明JPO在多个开源模型和三个中文法律基准上同时提升了判决预测和推理质量。
AI.motivation: 现有刑事判决预测方法主要优化最终标签，即使有工作尝试评估推理质量，其评估也是间接的，往往依赖LLM生成的评分标准，反映的是模型内部偏好而非法律裁判固有的逻辑结构。因此需要一种能显式建模法律推理结构并优化推理质量的训练框架。
AI.method: JPO包含两个阶段：(1) 使用教师生成的推理链监督一个标准化的四步推理过程；(2) 应用强化学习，综合奖励涵盖法律预测质量、推理结构完整性和跨步骤一致性。此外引入token级优势重加权和自适应裁剪，以强化法律显著性推理片段。整体流程遵循"法条匹配事实—罪名由法条支撑—量刑与罪名一致"的结构化逻辑。
AI.result: 在多个开源语言模型和三个中文法律基准上的实验表明，JPO相较于监督微调和强化学习基线，在判决预测准确性和推理质量两方面都取得了一致的提升。
AI.conclusion: JPO通过显式建模法律裁判的结构化推理过程，并用强化学习加以优化，有效提升了刑事判决预测中预测性能和推理质量，验证了将法律逻辑结构嵌入训练范式的重要性。

title: Background-Free Objectness Learning for Class-Agnostic Detection
comment: Accepted at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026. This arXiv version includes supplementary material
summary: Object detectors are typically trained under closed-set supervision, where unlabeled regions are implicitly treated as background. Under incomplete annotations, this assumption introduces objectness bias: visually valid but unlabeled objects are used as negatives, tying objectness to the annotated taxonomy rather than generic object structure. This limitation is particularly problematic for class-agnostic and open-world detection. This paper proposes Background-Free Objectness Learning (B-FOR), a dense class-agnostic detection framework that learns objectness without explicit background supervision on unlabeled regions. B-FOR formulates detection as the prediction of dense multi-scale object-center and scale fields, from which object hypotheses emerge as local spatial structures. Supervision is confined to reliable annotated regions through spatially structured soft targets, avoiding foreground-background discrimination. To support decoding from emergent local maxima, the paper further introduces displacement-aware scale fields that model object extent as a spatially varying property of the learned objectness field. Experiments on PASCAL VOC, MS-COCO, and Open Images demonstrate strong generalization to unseen categories and cross-dataset object distributions. B-FOR improves recall by more than +10 AR points over prior class-agnostic baselines. Ablation studies show that both localized objectness supervision and displacement-aware scale fields are critical for class-agnostic localization under incomplete annotations. Code available at: https://github.com/Daniaawan/B-FOR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出B-FOR（Background-Free Objectness Learning），一个无需背景监督的密集类别无关检测框架。B-FOR将检测建模为预测多尺度目标中心和尺度场，从局部空间结构中涌现目标假设，仅在可靠标注区域上施加监督，并引入位移感知尺度场来支持解码。在PASCAL VOC、MS-COCO和Open Images上相比基线提升超过+10 AR点，展现了良好的跨类别和跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统目标检测器在封闭集监督下训练，未标注区域被隐式当作背景，这在标注不完整时引入了"物体性偏差"（objectness bias），使物体性判断与标注类别体系绑定而非通用的物体结构。这一问题对类别无关检测和开放世界检测尤为严重。
AI.method: B-FOR将检测问题重新表述为预测密集的多尺度目标中心场和尺度场，从中通过局部空间结构涌现出目标假设。监督仅限可靠标注区域，通过空间结构化的软目标实现，避免前景-背景判别。同时引入位移感知尺度场，将目标范围建模为学习到的物体性场的空间变化属性，以支持从涌现的局部最大值进行解码。
AI.result: 在PASCAL VOC、MS-COCO和Open Images数据集上，B-FOR展现出对未见类别和跨数据集物体分布的强泛化能力，相比先前的类别无关基线提升了超过+10个AR点。消融实验表明，局部化物体性监督和位移感知尺度场对不完整标注下的类别无关定位均至关重要。
AI.conclusion: B-FOR通过消除背景监督依赖，成功解耦了物体性与标注类别体系的绑定，为不完整标注和开放世界场景下的类别无关检测提供了有效方案。代码已开源。

title: Memory-First Fact-Checking: A Knowledge-Graph-Grounded Multi-Agent System for Misinformation Detection
summary: This paper introduces a hybrid fact-checking framework that integrates Knowledge Graph-based semantic memory with adversarial multi-agent reasoning for explainable misinformation detection. The proposed system follows a memory-first, web-fallback architecture, in which input claims are initially evaluated against a dual-index Knowledge Graph through Sentence-BERT-based semantic retrieval and Natural Language Inference. When the evidence retrieved from the graph is insufficient to support a reliable decision, the framework collects information from trusted web sources and assesses it using an adversarial tribunal composed of support, contradiction, and judging agents. A graph-aware confidence mechanism combines semantic similarity, NLI confidence, and structural graph evidence to determine whether internal knowledge is sufficient, thereby reducing unnecessary web retrieval. Following verification, validated information is transformed into structured triples and incorporated into the Knowledge Graph, supporting the incremental expansion of the system's semantic memory. Experimental evaluation on a curated COVID-19 misinformation benchmark demonstrates that the proposed framework achieves an accuracy of 97.4\% and a macro-averaged F1-score of 92.6% on resolved claims, outperforming a Llama~3.3~70B baseline, which obtains an accuracy of 87.7% and a macro-averaged F1-score of 86.3%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合事实核查框架，将基于知识图谱的语义记忆与对抗性多智能体推理相结合，用于可解释的虚假信息检测。系统采用"记忆优先、网络回退"的架构，通过Sentence-BERT语义检索和自然语言推理首先在知识图谱中评估声明，若证据不足则转向可信网络来源，并由支持、反驳和评判三个对抗性智能体进行推理。实验在COVID-19虚假信息基准上达到97.4%准确率和92.6%的宏平均F1分数，优于Llama 3.3 70B基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的虚假信息检测方法在可解释性和知识更新能力方面存在不足，单一模型或检索方式难以兼顾效率和准确性，需要一种能够结合结构化知识与多智能体推理的混合方案。
AI.method: 采用记忆优先、网络回退的两阶段架构：先用Sentence-BERT语义检索和NLI在双索引知识图谱中评估声明；当图谱证据不足时，从可信网络来源收集信息，交由支持、矛盾、评判三个对抗性智能体组成的仲裁庭评估；图感知置信度机制综合语义相似度、NLI置信度和图结构证据决定是否回退到网络检索；验证后的信息转化为三元组并增量更新知识图谱。
AI.result: 在COVID-19虚假信息基准上，框架在已解决声明上达到97.4%准确率和92.6%宏平均F1分数，显著优于Llama 3.3 70B基线的87.7%准确率和86.3%宏平均F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的混合框架通过知识图谱语义记忆与对抗性多智能体推理的有机结合，有效提升了虚假信息检测的准确性和可解释性，同时通过知识图谱的增量扩展实现了系统语义记忆的持续增长。

title: Generalization over Memorization: Generalization-Aware Diffusion Adaptation for Single-Image Multi-View Synthesis
comment: ACM Multimedia 2026 Grand Challenge Track winning paper; presents the 1st-place solution among 293 registered teams. 7 pages, 2 figures
summary: We present the winning solution to the ACM Multimedia 2026 Grand Challenge on Single-Image Guided Multi-Angle Image Synthesis. It ranks first among 293 registered teams; 56 teams obtained at least one scored submission on the public Phase-A leaderboard. With only 40 training scenes, the challenge requires 26 target views from one RGB model and one forward pass per view; it prohibits explicit geometry, external rendering, chained generation, candidate selection, and post-processing. We identify a critical model-selection failure: shared training and validation scenes make memorization appear as transferable view control. We therefore introduce GoM. Short for Generalization over Memorization, the framework combines scene-disjoint validation, exposure-matched selection, and targeted diffusion adaptation. Its synthesis model adapts a 4B rectified-flow DiT using rank-32 LoRA, optimizer restarts, late-checkpoint averaging, and VAE decoder tuning. More than 300 offline experiments and 24 online submissions show that validation design and training-trajectory control can matter as much as architecture scale in small-data generative modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了ACM Multimedia 2026大挑战赛"单图引导多角度图像合成"的冠军解决方案GoM（泛化优于记忆）。在293支参赛队伍中排名第一，该方案通过场景分离验证、曝光匹配选择和定向扩散自适应解决了共享训练/验证场景导致的模型选择失败问题，并验证了在小数据生成建模中验证设计和训练轨迹控制与架构规模同等重要。
AI.motivation: 挑战赛仅提供40个训练场景，要求从单个RGB模型和每视角一次前向传播生成26个目标视角，且禁止显式几何、外部渲染、链式生成、候选选择和后处理。作者发现了关键的模型选择失败问题：共享训练和验证场景使得记忆化被误认为可迁移的视角控制能力，因此需要一种能够区分泛化与记忆的方法。
AI.method: GoM框架包含三个核心组件：1）场景分离验证（scene-disjoint validation）避免验证场景与训练场景重叠；2）曝光匹配选择（exposure-matched selection）确保选择过程中的公平比较；3）定向扩散自适应（targeted diffusion adaptation）。合成模型采用4B整流流扩散Transformer（rectified-flow DiT），使用秩32的LoRA、优化器重启、后期检查点平均和VAE解码器微调技术。
AI.result: 在293支注册队伍中排名第一，56支队伍在Phase-A公开排行榜上获得至少一次评分提交。团队进行了300多次离线实验和24次在线提交，结果表明验证设计和训练轨迹控制在小数据生成建模中的重要性不亚于架构规模。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了在数据稀缺的生成建模场景下，仔细设计的验证策略和训练过程控制可以显著提升模型的实际泛化能力，其影响力可与扩大架构规模相媲美，为小样本生成建模提供了方法论借鉴。

title: MI-Distillation: Selecting from Model-Interpolated Instruct-Reasoning Data Spectrum for Chain-of-Thought Distillation
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Recent advances in large reasoning models (LRMs) have shown strong performance on complex problems through long chain-of-thought (Long CoT) reasoning. However, distilling such trajectories into smaller student models remains challenging: direct Long CoT supervision often provides limited gains and can be less effective than concise Short CoT rationales. In this work, we investigate this phenomenon from a gradient-centric perspective. Our analysis shows that Long CoT induces larger gradient magnitudes and more concentrated update directions than Short CoT, with this effect becoming more pronounced as student model capacity increases. These findings suggest that effective Long CoT distillation requires balancing the reasoning information density of reasoning trajectories with their distributional alignment to the student model. Motivated by this insight, we propose \textbf{M}odel \textbf{I}nterporlation \textbf{Distillation} (\textbf{MI-Distillation}), a framework that constructs a continuous Instruct-Reasoning data spectrum through model interpolation. To select suitable trajectories from this spectrum, we further introduce \textbf{Seq}uential \textbf{L}earnable \textbf{S}urprisal \textbf{S}core (\textbf{SeqLSS}), which favors reasoning paths that are both informative and learnable for the student. Extensive experiments on reasoning benchmarks show that MI-Distillation consistently improves small model CoT distillation over strong Long CoT baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文从梯度视角分析了大推理模型长链思维（Long CoT）蒸馏到小模型效果不佳的原因，发现长CoT会产生更大的梯度幅度和更集中的更新方向，且该效应随学生模型容量增大而加剧。据此提出MI-Distillation框架（通过模型插值构建连续Instruct-Reasoning数据谱系）和SeqLSS评分（选择信息丰富且对学生可学习的推理路径），实验证明该方法在推理基准上优于强Long CoT基线。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型（LRMs）虽在复杂问题上表现优异，但其长链思维轨迹直接蒸馏到小模型时收益有限，甚至不如简洁的短CoT推理。作者希望从梯度角度揭示这一现象背后的机理，并设计更有效的蒸馏方法。
AI.method: 首先通过梯度分析揭示Long CoT与Short CoT在蒸馏过程中的差异（梯度幅度与更新方向集中度）；进而提出MI-Distillation，利用模型插值构建连续的数据谱系；再提出SeqLSS（Sequential Learnable Surprisal Score）来选择既具信息量又对学生可学习的推理轨迹。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准上的大量实验表明，MI-Distillation在蒸馏小模型CoT推理能力方面一致地优于强Long CoT基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 有效的Long CoT蒸馏需要在推理轨迹的信息密度与学生模型的分布对齐之间取得平衡，MI-Distillation与SeqLSS为实现这一平衡提供了系统化的解决方案。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Anti-UAV Detection via Evidential Fusion and Conflict-Discounted Belief Aggregation
summary:
Anti-UAV perception systems must remain reliable when sensor streams degrade under occlusion, fast motion, or modality-specific failure. Existing multimodal anti-UAV systems fuse RGB and thermal streams deterministically, without modeling predictive uncertainty, and cannot express doubt when streams disagree. Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) produces calibrated per-class uncertainty in a single forward pass. EDTC already exploits this for thermal-only perception, yet cross-modal evidential fusion remains unaddressed.
  This paper extends EDTC to multimodal RGB-Thermal perception via Discounted Belief Fusion (DBF), which converts inter-modal conflict into uncertainty mass before aggregating stream opinions. Bounding boxes are resolved by selecting the lower-uncertainty modality. On the Anti-UAV benchmark, multimodal fusion consistently outperforms either single stream (test Acc 0.670 vs. 0.604 IR, 0.598 RGB) at real-time speed (at least 38 FPS). However, DBF is empirically indistinguishable from undiscounted averaging: near-zero inter-modal conflict on this presence-dominated benchmark leaves the discounting step inert. The fused uncertainty is well-calibrated (ECE 0.057) yet expectedly a weaker localization failure detector than spatial variance (AUROC 0.626 vs. 0.739). The null result is structural: the benchmark's near-universal presence and vacuous miss-encoding jointly suppress inter-modal conflict, a diagnosis that delimits where conflict-aware fusion provides measurable benefit.

AI.tldr: 本论文将EDTC扩展到RGB-Thermal多模态反无人机感知，提出基于折扣信念融合（DBF）的方法，将模态间冲突转化为不确定性质量后再聚合。虽然多模态融合在Anti-UAV基准上优于单模态（准确率0.670 vs 0.604/0.598），且达到实时速度，但DBF与简单平均在经验上无法区分——该基准以"存在性"为主导且缺失编码空洞，导致模态间冲突近零，折扣机制无效。融合不确定性校准良好但作为定位失败检测器弱于空间方差。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态反无人机系统采用确定性融合RGB和热成像流，无法建模预测不确定性，在流间不一致时无法表达怀疑。尽管EDTC已利用证据深度学习进行单模态热成像感知，但跨模态证据融合仍未被探索，因此本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 将EDTC扩展到多模态RGB-Thermal感知，采用折扣信念融合（DBF）方法，将模态间冲突转化为不确定性质量后再聚合各流意见。边界框通过选择不确定性较低的模态来解决。
AI.result: 在Anti-UAV基准上，多模态融合优于任一单模态流（测试准确率0.670对比IR 0.604、RGB 0.598），实时速度至少38 FPS。但DBF与无折扣平均在经验上不可区分，模态间冲突接近零。融合不确定性校准良好（ECE 0.057），但作为定位失败检测器弱于空间方差（AUROC 0.626 vs 0.739）。
AI.conclusion: 这是一项无效结果：基准中近乎普遍的"存在性"和空洞的缺失编码共同抑制了模态间冲突，该诊断划定了冲突感知融合能够提供可测量收益的边界条件。

title: PrivBench: A Holistic and Modular Benchmarking Platform for Evaluating Text-to-Text Privatization
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, accepted to EMNLP 2026 System Demonstrations
summary: Natural Language Processing methods have enabled novel solutions and advances in the field of privacy, particularly in the sub-domain of text-to-text privatization, where the goal is to transform a sensitive input text into a privatized output by ideally masking (in)directly identifiable or otherwise private information. The evaluation of text-to-text privatization, however, is not straightforward, and the extant literature has utilized a myriad of techniques and metrics to quantify the privacy-preserving capabilities of privatization methods. Seeking to unify the evaluation of text-to-text privatization, we introduce PrivBench, a holistic and modular benchmarking platform for researchers and practitioners working on text privatization. PrivBench is holistic in that it evaluates privatization on a series of defined desiderata, which are structured into modules. PrivBench is not only modular but also extensible, allowing for future updates and benchmark versions. PrivBench is user-centered and promotes competition via real-time evaluation and a live public leaderboard. The platform is free to use and openly accessible at https://privbench.com/.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了PrivBench，一个面向文本到文本私有化研究的模块化、可扩展的基准测试平台，旨在统一私有化方法的评估标准，提供实时评估和公开排行榜。
AI.motivation: 文本到文本私有化（text-to-text privatization）的评估缺乏统一标准，现有文献使用了各种不同的技术和指标来量化私有化方法的隐私保护能力，导致结果难以比较和复现，因此需要一个统一的评估平台。
AI.method: PrivBench采用整体性（holistic）和模块化（modular）的设计，将私有化评估结构化为一系列定义好的desiderata（期望特性）模块；平台支持可扩展性以便未来更新和版本迭代，并采用用户中心的实时评估机制和公开排行榜来促进竞争。
AI.result: PrivBench作为一个免费且公开访问的平台（https://privbench.com/）被提出，提供实时评估和公共排行榜功能。
AI.conclusion: PrivBench为研究者和从业者提供了一个统一、开放且可持续演进的文本私有化评估基准平台，有助于标准化该领域的评估方法并促进社区竞争与发展。

title: AGRICAM: A Track-Mounted Crop Pollination Monitoring Robot
summary: Insect pollination is critical for global food production, yet monitoring pollinators at commercial farm scale remains a challenge. Recent advances in computer vision and deep learning have enabled detailed analysis of pollinator behaviour, but monitoring must trade-off detail against spatial coverage and human or technological resources. This paper presents the Automated Guided Robot for Insect and Crop Activity Monitoring (AGRICAM), a purpose-built robotic system designed to meet the requirements of large-scale pollination monitoring in protected cropping systems. AGRICAM operates autonomously on low-cost, easily installed track for movement along crop rows, without disrupting farm operations or insect behaviour. The platform integrates two RGB cameras, microclimate sensors, GPS and RFID modules, motion sensors, and 4G cellular network connectivity for data transmission. A web interface enables remote device configuration and scheduling. The system autonomously captures video and image data of insects' locations and local environmental conditions. These are transferred to the cloud and analysed using computer vision models to quantify pollinator visitation and spatio-temporal activity variation. We deployed the system on a commercial blueberry farm to demonstrate and test its capability. It successfully mapped insect pollination patterns across 80 m long industrial polytunnels over 30 hours. This data enabled spatial analyses of insect activity we used to confirm a uniform pollinator distribution within polytunnels, as desired by the farm management team. The data also highlighted variation of insect activity associated with time of day and microclimate. AGRICAM therefore has been shown to be a scalable, automated crop pollination monitor that can support data-driven decisions to enhance pollination management, thereby improving crop productivity and food security.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种名为AGRICAM的自主机器人系统，用于大型保护性作物系统中的传粉昆虫监测。该系统在低成本轨道上自主移动，集成双RGB相机、微气候传感器、GPS、RFID、运动传感器和4G网络，可将数据上传至云端并通过计算机视觉模型分析传粉昆虫活动。在商业蓝莓农场80米长工业隧道中部署30小时，成功绘制了传粉昆虫分布图，验证了隧道内传粉者分布均匀性，并揭示了时间与微气候对昆虫活动的影响。
AI.motivation: 昆虫授粉对全球粮食生产至关重要，但在商业农场规模下监测传粉昆虫仍具挑战性。现有的计算机视觉和深度学习技术虽能进行详细分析，但监测需要在细节、空间覆盖与人力技术资源之间进行权衡，亟需一种大规模自动化监测方案。
AI.method: 开发AGRICAM自主机器人平台，在低成本轨道上沿作物行自动移动，集成双RGB相机、微气候传感器、GPS、RFID、运动传感器及4G网络。系统自动采集昆虫位置与环境的视频图像数据，上传云端后使用计算机视觉模型量化传粉昆虫访问频率和时空活动变化，并提供Web界面进行远程配置与调度。
AI.result: 在商业蓝莓农场的80米长工业塑料隧道中成功部署并运行30小时，绘制出昆虫传粉模式图。空间分析确认了隧道内传粉者分布均匀（符合农场管理期望），同时数据揭示了昆虫活动随时间变化和微气候变化的差异。
AI.conclusion: AGRICAM被证明是一种可扩展、自动化的作物传粉监测系统，能够为数据驱动的传粉管理决策提供支持，从而提升作物生产力和粮食安全。

title: ACTD: Anchor-Based Cross-Tokenizer Distillation with Residual Regularization
summary: Knowledge distillation effectively transfers reasoning capabilities from large language models to lightweight student models. To enable knowledge transfer across disparate model families, researchers increasingly explore cross-tokenizer distillation. However, cross-tokenizer distillation remains challenging due to vocabulary and sequence misalignment, while approximate vocabulary alignment can introduce additional noise into distillation. To address these challenges, we propose Anchor-Based Cross-Tokenizer Distillation with Residual Regularization (ACTD). ACTD bridges structural heterogeneity through vocabulary and sequence alignment, while mitigating alignment noise via a novel anchor loss with residual regularization. We further extend this framework to a multi-teacher setting. Evaluated across five reasoning benchmarks with three distinct teacher models, ACTD achieves state-of-the-art performance. Moreover, its multi-teacher extension outperforms the strongest single-teacher and multi-teacher baselines, further demonstrating the robustness of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ACTD框架，通过词汇与序列对齐解决跨tokenizer蒸馏中的结构异构问题，并引入锚点损失与残差正则化来缓解对齐噪声，在五个推理基准上取得最优性能，多教师扩展进一步超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 跨tokenizer蒸馏因词汇表和序列不对齐而面临挑战，近似词汇对齐会引入额外噪声，影响知识迁移的质量。
AI.method: 提出ACTD框架：通过词汇和序列对齐桥接结构异构性，使用带残差正则化的新颖锚点损失来缓解对齐噪声，并扩展至多教师蒸馏场景。
AI.result: 在五个推理基准上，使用三个不同教师模型，ACTD达到最优性能；多教师扩展优于最强的单教师和多教师基线。
AI.conclusion: ACTD及其多教师扩展有效解决了跨tokenizer蒸馏的结构不对齐和噪声问题，展现出方法的鲁棒性和优越性。

title: DARD: Zero-Shot Degradation-Aware Retinex-Guided Diffusion for Low-Light Image Enhancement
summary: Existing diffusion-based enhancement methods provide strong generative capability for low-light image enhancement (LLIE), yet they either rely on paired supervision or lack reliable scene constraints in zero-shot settings, often leading to structural inconsistency and color drift. Motivated by conventional Retinex models, which offer physically interpretable priors that can serve as reliable scene constraints yet struggle with mixed degradations in real-world scenarios, we propose DARD, a zero-shot Degradation-Aware Retinex-guided Diffusion framework for LLIE. DARD first extracts image-specific physical priors from the degraded input through a test-time degradation-aware Retinex decomposition, thereby providing reliable structural guidance for zero-shot restoration. It then injects these priors into reverse diffusion through a timestep-adaptive frequency fusion strategy to balance structural anchoring and detail generation. Finally, a guided reverse refinement process with physical consistency and Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP)-based semantic guidance is introduced to suppress structural artifacts and semantic drift during sampling. Extensive experiments show that DARD achieves strong distortion and perceptual performance and consistently outperforms existing zero-shot baselines across multiple real-world low-light benchmarks. To further validate the practical utility of our method for downstream applications, we evaluated its impact on semantic segmentation. Experiments demonstrate that images enhanced by DARD achieve a 28.10% relative improvement in mIoU over AGLLDiff.

AI.tldr: DARD是一个零样本、退化感知的基于Retinex引导的扩散框架，用于低光图像增强，通过测试时Retinex分解提取物理先验，注入逆扩散过程并配合CLIP语义引导，在多个真实低光基准上优于现有零样本方法，并显著提升下游语义分割性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的低光增强方法要么依赖成对监督，要么在零样本设置下缺乏可靠的场景约束，导致结构不一致和颜色偏移。而传统Retinex模型虽能提供物理解释的先验作为场景约束，但难以处理真实场景中的混合退化。
AI.method: DARD框架包含三个关键部分：(1) 通过测试时退化感知的Retinex分解从退化输入中提取图像特定的物理先验；(2) 采用时间步自适应的频率融合策略将这些先验注入逆扩散过程，平衡结构锚定与细节生成；(3) 引入带有物理一致性约束和CLIP语义引导的引导式逆向细化过程，抑制采样过程中的结构伪影和语义漂移。
AI.result: 实验表明DARD在失真和感知性能上均表现优异，在多个真实低光基准上一致优于现有零样本方法。在下游语义分割任务中，经DARD增强的图像相比AGLLDiff在mIoU上取得了28.10%的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: DARD通过将物理可解释的Retinex先验与扩散模型的生成能力相结合，有效解决了零样本低光增强中结构不一致和颜色漂移的问题，并验证了其在真实下游应用中的实用价值。

title: A Hub of Short Rows Inflates Intrinsic Dimension Estimation of Token Embeddings
summary: A token-embedding table holds a hub of short rows near its origin, and we show that this cluster biases what nearest-neighbor intrinsic-dimension (ID) estimators report. Because of the concentration of measure, a token is closer to the central cluster than to any other token, so its first two neighbors are both hub rows at nearly the same distance. As a result, the ID estimators such as TwoNN return a dimension far above the real ID. Measured one token at a time, dimension is a heavy-tailed distribution. Measured on the full vocabulary, it grows with the model's parameter count. However, when we remove the hub, the heavy tail disappears and the measured dimension collapses to a narrow range for eleven models, from GPT-2 to models such as K3 and GLM-4.7. The hub acts as a switch: a few hundred rows are enough to fully inflate the estimate. We reproduced an experiment stating that the intrinsic dimension (ID) of Pythia's token-embedding table grows with the parameter count, from $27$ to $122$ between 160M and 12B parameters. We show that this result disappears when the hub is removed: the table then reads $10$ to $17$ at every size. The hub contains a subset of the population that under-trained-token detectors flag, but on Pythia the hub that we detected and removed as a whole was updated during training: what seem to characterize these rows is simply their length, not an absence of updates. Finally, we show that normalizing the rows instead of removing them gives the same lower reading.

AI.tldr: 本文发现词元嵌入表中的"枢纽行"（hub rows）会使最近邻本征维度（ID）估计器产生严重偏差，导致测量维度过高。去除这些枢纽后，11个模型（从GPT-2到GLM-4.7）的嵌入表本征维度从随参数规模增长（Pythia从27到122）坍塌到一个狭窄范围（10-17），表明之前的增长现象是测量伪影而非真实特征。
AI.motivation: 既有的本征维度估计结果（如Pythia嵌入表ID随参数规模从27增长到122）可能与嵌入表结构中的伪影有关，而非反映真实的几何性质。作者希望通过识别和移除枢纽行来获得更真实的本征维度读数。
AI.method: 作者识别出嵌入表中靠近原点的短行聚集形成的"枢纽"（hub），分析了它对TwoNN等最近邻ID估计器的影响机制，并在11个模型中通过移除枢纽行或对行进行归一化处理来重新测量本征维度，同时比较了这些枢纽行与欠训练token检测器的重合度。
AI.result: （1）枢纽行使ID估计远高于真实值，且单独测量时维度呈重尾分布；（2）去除枢纽后，11个模型的ID全部坍塌到10-17的狭窄范围，Pythia从27-122变为10-17；（3）仅需几百行即可完全扭曲估计；（4）枢纽行并非欠训练token，其特点是行长度而非缺乏更新；（5）归一化行向量也可得到相同结果。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入表本征维度随模型规模增长是测量伪影，由靠近原点的枢纽行簇造成。去除或归一化这些行后，所有规模模型的嵌入表本征维度都稳定在10-17之间，表明嵌入表的真实内在维度与模型规模基本无关。

title: QCell: Recombining and Aligning Cell Queries for Overlapping Instance Segmentation
comment: Accepted at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026. Project page/code/models/dataset: https://slavkoprytula.github.io/QCell/
summary: Instance segmentation of overlapping cells in microscopy remains challenging due to semi-transparent structures that produce weak boundaries and mixed visual evidence in overlap regions. Existing methods address this through local regions of interest or shape priors but lack global reasoning across overlapping objects. We present QCell, a novel query-based model that de-overlaps cell instances in microscopy scenes. Our approach combines (i) an instance recombination module that decomposes and recombines query representations in latent space, enabling the model to reason about complete object structure under overlap, and (ii) a contrastive query alignment objective that combines distinctive instance feature learning and separation of overlapping cell queries. We additionally introduce a new Organoid dataset benchmark for overlapping cell segmentation. We show that QCell outperforms state-of-the-art methods across multiple benchmarks, achieving +2.2 AP and +2.7 AJI on ISBI2014. Code is available at https://github.com/SlavkoPrytula/QCell

AI.tldr: 本文提出QCell，一种基于查询的模型，通过实例重组模块和对比查询对齐目标来解决显微镜图像中重叠细胞的实例分割问题，并在多个基准上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 显微镜中重叠细胞的半透明结构导致边界弱、重叠区域视觉证据混杂，现有方法依赖局部感兴趣区域或形状先验，缺乏跨重叠对象的全局推理能力。
AI.method: QCell包含两个核心组件：(i) 实例重组模块，在潜在空间中对查询表示进行分解与重组，使模型能够在重叠情况下推理完整对象结构；(ii) 对比查询对齐目标，结合独特的实例特征学习和重叠细胞查询的分离。此外，提出了新的Organoid数据集基准。
AI.result: QCell在多个基准上优于现有最先进方法，在ISBI2014上实现+2.2 AP和+2.7 AJI的提升。
AI.conclusion: 查询式方法与实例重组及对比对齐策略相结合，能够有效解决显微镜场景中重叠细胞的分割难题，代码已开源。

title: The Depth Flow of Token Representations Is Nonlinear and Does Not Descend Its Own Density
summary:
A token's representation is carried through the network layer by layer. The whole vocabulary carried together forms a flow. We fit this flow's equation of motion as a discrete Langevin model over corpus-mean trajectories of Pythia-160M and Pythia-410M, and score the predicted steps on held-out tokens. Linear maps are often used as cheap surrogates for a layer. The flow they summarize is not linear: a quadratic drift beats the linear linear map at every transition of both models, and the Kramers--Moyal estimator agrees wherever its neighborhoods stay local.
  We then characterize the flow further. First, we show that it does not descend its own log-density. The drift instead descends a potential that is not the density. Second, the rotational component is not negligible, $4$ to $45\%$ of the explainable drift, and the circulation shows in what the flow preserves: a token keeps its angular rank across all thirteen layers while its norm rank is shuffled and its concentration rank is reversed by the last block.

AI.tldr: 本文通过离散Langevin模型拟合Pythia-160M和Pythia-410M中token表示的逐层流动轨迹，发现二次漂移优于线性映射，并进一步刻画了该流动的性质：其漂移不沿自身对数密度下降，且旋转分量占比4%-45%，揭示token在层间保持角秩稳定而范数秩被打乱、浓度秩被反转等特性。
AI.motivation: 理解transformer网络中token表示是如何逐层演化的，以及能否用简单的动力学模型来描述这一流动过程。线性映射虽常被用作层的廉价替代，但实际流动是否线性值得检验。
AI.method: 将token表示的全词汇流动建模为离散Langevin方程，在Pythia-160M和Pythia-410M的语料平均轨迹上拟合，并用Kramers-Moyal估计器验证，对比线性映射与二次漂移模型，同时分析漂移的势函数与旋转分量。
AI.result: 二次漂移在每个层间转换中均优于线性映射；漂移并非沿自身对数密度下降而是沿另一个势函数下降；旋转分量占可解释漂移的4%-45%；token的角秩在全部13层中保持稳定，而范数秩被打乱、浓度秩在最后一层被反转。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型中token表示的层间流动具有显著的非线性动力学特征，包含可观的旋转分量和独立于密度的势能结构，这些特征共同决定了token在不同语义维度上的表示演化规律。

title: Learning to Ground Before Reading: Unified PCB Engineering Drawing Parsing with Compact Vision-Language Models
summary: PCB engineering drawings mix sparse graphics, dense tables, and text whose meaning depends on page position. Localizing the regions and sending crops to specialized recognizers are determined as the methods for most parsers, so missed regions cannot be recovered downstream. We train a compact VLM to read the full page and get a sequence of region classes, normalized boxes, and text or HTML content. Bounding boxes are converted to coordinate tokens for supervision. Inference uses no detector or crop parser. The joint target is difficult to optimize because class and box tokens are sparse relative to the much longer content sequences. Our localization-first curriculum learns the class-box format before adding content targets with content-aware resampling. On the fixed validation split of the Engineering Drawing Dataset (ED dataset), Localization-First improves strict localization F1 by 0.0955 over joint training (paired image-bootstrap 95% interval: [0.0350, 0.1572]). G-Unified has the lowest NED, highest cell F1, and only nonzero exact-match score. It provides a detector-free baseline for full-page PCB drawing parsing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需检测器的紧凑型视觉语言模型（VLM），直接读取整页PCB工程图纸并生成区域类别、归一化框和文本/HTML内容的序列。通过"定位优先"课程学习（先学类别和框格式，再加入内容目标并进行内容感知重采样），在ED数据集验证集上，严格定位F1较联合训练提升0.0955，成为全页面PCB图纸解析的无检测器基线。
AI.motivation: PCB工程图纸混合了稀疏图形、密集表格和依赖页面位置的文本。现有解析器通常先局部化区域再裁剪送专门识别器，这导致漏检区域在下游无法恢复。因此需要一种无需检测器、直接全页读取的解析方法。
AI.method: 训练紧凑型VLM直接读取整页，输出区域类别、归一化框（转换为坐标token）、文本或HTML内容序列。采用"定位优先"课程：先学习类别和框格式，再逐步加入内容目标，并使用内容感知重采样处理类别/框token稀疏与长内容序列之间的优化不平衡问题。推理时无需检测器或裁剪解析器。
AI.result: 在ED数据集验证集上，定位优先课程较联合训练在严格定位F1上提升0.0955（图像配对bootstrap 95%区间[0.0350, 0.1572]）。G-Unified模型取得最低NED、最高单元格F1以及唯一的非零精确匹配分数。
AI.conclusion: 定位优先课程有效解决了联合优化中稀疏定位token与长内容序列的不平衡问题，G-Unified作为无需检测器的全页PCB图纸解析基线，在定位和内容识别上均表现出色。

title: DVBench: Benchmarking MLLMs for Understanding Dynamic Charts and Narratives in Data Videos
summary: While MLLMs have made significant strides in chart comprehension and video understanding, current evaluations largely isolate these capabilities, leaving a critical gap in understanding temporally evolving structured visual information. To address this gap, we introduce DVBench, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on data videos, a storytelling medium that integrates dynamic charts with structured narratives. We decompose data video understanding into five dimensions. DVBench comprises 300 real-world data videos and 1,000 human-verified QA pairs curated through a rigorous semi-automated pipeline. Extensive evaluations of nine MLLMs show that Gemini-3.1-Pro achieves the best overall performance, while Kimi-k2.5 is the strongest open-source model. We further identify two notable phenomena: open-source model performance does not scale strictly with parameter size, and narrative proficiency does not guarantee visual capability. Fine-grained analyses and ablation studies further reveal dimension-specific weaknesses and the effects of frame configurations and subtitle inputs, informing future MLLM development. DVBench is publicly available at https://bomiaowang.github.io/DVBench/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DVBench基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在数据视频理解上的能力。DVBench包含300个真实数据视频和1000个人工验证的QA对，将数据视频理解分解为五个维度。评测结果显示Gemini-3.1-Pro表现最佳，Kimi-k2.5是最强开源模型，并发现开源模型性能与参数规模不完全正相关、叙事能力不等于视觉能力等有趣现象。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs在图表理解和视频理解上的评估彼此分离，缺乏对随时间演化的结构化视觉信息（数据视频）的理解评估，存在关键空白。
AI.method: 构建DVBench基准，将数据视频理解分解为五个维度，通过严格的半自动流程整理300个真实世界数据视频和1000个人工验证的QA对，并对九个MLLMs进行系统评测。
AI.result: Gemini-3.1-Pro在整体性能上最佳，Kimi-k2.5为最强的开源模型。同时发现两个现象：开源模型性能不随参数规模严格增长；叙事能力强不保证视觉理解能力好。细粒度分析和消融实验揭示了维度特定的弱点及帧配置、字幕输入的影响。
AI.conclusion: DVBench填补了MLLMs在数据视频理解评估上的空白，为未来MLLM开发指出了方向和关键短板。

title: LightFuse: Relightable Interactive Gaussian Scene Reconstruction via Multi-Scan Fusion and 2D Gaussian Ray Tracing
summary: Relightable interactive scene reconstruction aims to build an editable 3D model from scans of different object arrangements and render new layouts under novel illumination. Existing methods either bake lighting into appearance or recover material and illumination only for fixed scenes, leaving edited layouts with inconsistent shadows and indirect lighting. We present LightFuse, a 2D Gaussian framework that extends interactive scene reconstruction with explicit material-illumination decomposition and physically based relighting. LightFuse first fuses observations across states to reconstruct a shared background and movable objects. It then conducts ray-tracing-oriented geometry refinement to produce more complete and consistent surfaces. On the refined geometry, staged training with differentiable one-bounce ray tracing separates shared metallic--roughness material from state-specific environment lighting. The resulting scene supports object rearrangement, material editing, and relighting, while ray tracing recomputes appearance after each interaction. Experiments across synthetic scenes demonstrate state-of-the-art relighting quality, outperforming the strongest baseline by +9.74\,dB PSNR and +0.121 SSIM on average. Project page: https://zhn202.github.io/LightFuse/

AI.tldr: LightFuse是一个基于2D高斯的交互式场景重建框架，通过显式的材质-光照分解和基于物理的光线追踪重光照，实现了对扫描场景中可移动物体重排后的真实光照效果，平均比最强基线提升9.74dB PSNR和0.121 SSIM。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式场景重建方法要么将光照直接烘焙进外观，要么只能在固定场景下恢复材质与光照，无法处理编辑后布局中阴影和间接光照不一致的问题。
AI.method: LightFuse首先融合不同状态下的观测来重建共享背景和可移动物体；然后通过面向光线追踪的几何细化生成更完整一致的表面；最后在细化几何上进行分阶段训练，利用可微分的单次弹射光线追踪分离共享的金属-粗糙度材质与状态特定的环境光照。
AI.result: 在合成场景实验中展现出最先进的重光照质量，平均比最强基线提升9.74dB PSNR和0.121 SSIM。
AI.conclusion: LightFuse成功支持物体重排、材质编辑和重光照，并在每次交互后通过光线追踪重新计算外观，为交互式场景重建提供了更真实的光照一致性与编辑能力。

title: Evaluating the Capabilities of LLMs for Persuasive Dialogue
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate apparently highly persuasive text, but does sounding persuasive mean arguing well? We introduce \textsc{Persuasio}, a multi-agent dialogue platform grounded in a formal argumentation-based theory of persuasion dialogues that adjudicates logical winners during free-text debates. Using this system, we generated 192 debates on a UK political topic between humans and LLMs, and evaluated 22 interlocutors through both automated adjudication and 9,702 crowdsourced pairwise judgements across 1{,}386 annotation instances. We observed a consistent decoupling between subjective and formal persuasiveness: LLMs dominated the subjective ranking yet performed substantially worse under argumentation-theoretic adjudication, where humans remained competitive. Multi-agent and retrieval-augmented variants further widened this divergence. These findings reveal a systematic gap between rhetorical fluency and formal argumentative strength in LLM-based persuasive dialogues.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了Persuasio——一个基于形式论证理论的多智能体对话平台，用于裁决自由文本辩论中的逻辑胜者。通过生成192场英国政治话题的辩论，并利用自动裁决和9,702个人类众包成对判断进行评估，发现LLM在主观说服力排名上占据主导，但在形式论证裁决下表现显著较差，揭示了口才流畅性与形式论证强度之间的系统性差距。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的文本听起来很有说服力，但"听起来有说服力"并不等于"论证得好"。作者希望探究LLM在人类主观感知到的说服力与实际形式论证质量之间是否存在系统性差异。
AI.method: 构建Persuasio多智能体对话平台，基于形式论证理论对辩论的"逻辑胜者"进行自动裁决；生成了192场人类与LLM之间的自由文本辩论，通过自动裁决和9,702个众包成对判断（覆盖1,386个标注实例）来评估22个对话者。
AI.result: LLM在主观说服力排名中占据主导地位，但在形式论证理论裁决下表现显著较差，人类保持竞争力；多智能体和检索增强变体进一步拉大了这一差距。
AI.conclusion: LLM在辩论中存在系统性的"修辞流畅度与形式论证强度"之间的脱钩现象，即LLM擅长呈现说服力强的语言表达，但在严格的形式逻辑论证层面并不占优。

title: RAGDiffusion++: From Macro-Retrieval to Micro-Fidelity Alignment for Garment Generation
summary: Standard clothing asset generation---restoring forward-facing flat-lay garment images from diverse real-world contexts---holds immense commercial value yet demands both macroscopic topological accuracy and microscopic physical fidelity. Although our previous work RAGDiffusion effectively eradicated large-scale structural hallucinations via retrieval-augmented macro-constraints, achieving industrial-grade micro-texture realism remains an unsolved bottleneck. We formally identify this limitation as High-Frequency Trajectory Collapse: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) converges to the conditional mean of the training distribution, which is dominated by smooth, low-frequency textures, causing high-frequency patterns (e.g., fabric weaves, intricate logos) to become nearly un-sampleable. Naively applying Reinforcement Learning (RL) post-training further triggers Artifact Hacking, where models exploit semantic biases in generic reward models by generating deceptive checkerboard noise. Our key insight is that RL can fundamentally reshape the sampling distribution of flow models---elevating the probability of high-fidelity trajectories under accurate reward guidance---while adversarial regularization prevents exploitation of reward blind spots. Realizing this principle requires three prerequisites: (i)inherent capacity, established through a 27,725-pair high-complexity garment dataset (STGarment-Plus) and a Dual-Image-Stream FLUX architecture upgrade; (ii)perceptive reward, provided by a novel attribute-aware reward model (Garment-RM) trained on 500K images via fine-grained contrastive learning, achieving 84.67% human preference accuracy; and (iii)hacking prevention, enforced by our Adversarial-Regularized GRPO (AR-GRPO) strategy that integrates a dynamic discriminator into the RL sampling trajectory to penalize artifacts while enriching authentic high-frequency details.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AR-GRPO策略解决服装生成中高分辨率纹理细节丢失的问题。该方法通过构建27,725对高复杂度服装数据集（STGarment-Plus）、升级Dual-Image-Stream FLUX架构、训练属性感知奖励模型（Garment-RM）以及引入对抗正则化的GRPO策略，成功克服了SFT导致的"高频轨迹坍缩"和RL导致的"伪影黑客"问题，实现了工业级微观纹理保真。
AI.motivation: 标准服装资产生成任务（将正面平铺服装图像从多样化真实场景还原）具有巨大商业价值，但需要在宏观拓扑准确性和微观物理保真度两方面同时达标。先前工作RAGDiffusion已解决大规模结构幻觉问题，但工业级微观纹理真实感仍是未解决的瓶颈。核心挑战在于：SFT收敛于训练分布的条件均值导致高频纹理几乎不可采样（高频轨迹坍缩），而简单应用RL后训练又会触发奖励模型漏洞利用（伪影黑客）。
AI.method: 本文提出三管齐下的解决方案：(i)能力基础：构建27,725对高复杂度服装数据集STGarment-Plus，并升级为Dual-Image-Stream FLUX架构以增强模型容量；(ii)感知奖励：训练属性感知奖励模型Garment-RM，基于50万张图像通过细粒度对比学习，达到84.67%的人类偏好准确率；(iii)破解防御：提出Adversarial-Regularized GRPO（AR-GRPO）策略，将动态判别器集成到RL采样轨迹中，既惩罚伪影又强化真实高频细节的生成。
AI.result: Garment-RM在50万图像上训练后达到84.67%的人类偏好准确率；AR-GRPO策略有效防止了奖励盲区的利用，在提升高频细节真实性的同时避免了棋盘噪声等伪影的产生。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心洞见是：在精确奖励引导下，RL能够从根本上重塑流模型的采样分布，提升高保真轨迹的概率；而对抗正则化则能防止奖励盲区的被利用。这一原则的落地需要内在容量、感知奖励和破解防御三大前提，三者缺一不可。

title: ReTrace: Rejected-Trajectory Conditioning for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language model inference by having a lightweight draft model propose multiple candidate tokens, which are then verified in parallel by a larger target model. However, after the first rejection, standard prefix-based verification discards the remaining draft suffix, so the computation spent generating and verifying those positions does not contribute to decoding progress. Focusing on DFlash, we show that rejected positions in a rejected suffix may still align with the target continuation, indicating that the draft model can retain useful semantic and structural information despite local token-level errors. Motivated by this observation and inspired by conditional diffusion, we introduce~\textbf{ReTrace}, a rejected-trajectory conditioning method that conditions each draft block on the rejected suffix from the previous round rather than generating it from fresh mask placeholders alone. ReTrace retains the hidden representations of the rejected suffixes, aligns them with the next draft block, refines them using target-aware correction signals from the same verification pass, and admits them into the drafter's input embeddings through gated residual fusion. Because rejected tokens are never committed and target-side verification remains unchanged, ReTrace preserves the lossless property of speculative decoding without requiring an additional model forward pass. Experiments with Qwen3 models across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and open-ended dialogue demonstrate that ReTrace consistently improves average acceptance length and end-to-end decoding speed over its DFlash backbone. By introducing cross-round conditioning without modifying within-round proposal generation, ReTrace is largely orthogonal to existing drafting improvements and might be combined with them for further gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReTrace，一种基于拒绝轨迹条件化的投机解码加速方法。该方法不再丢弃被拒绝的草稿后缀，而是将其保留并用于条件化下一轮草稿生成，从而在不增加额外模型前向传播、保持无损性的前提下提升接受长度和解码速度。
AI.motivation: 投机解码中，标准前缀验证在第一次拒绝后就丢弃剩余草稿后缀，导致这些位置的计算（生成和验证）完全浪费。然而，作者观察发现被拒绝的后缀中仍可能包含与目标模型延续对齐的有用语义和结构信息，因此希望利用这些被拒绝的轨迹来提升解码效率。
AI.method: ReTrace受条件扩散启发，在每个草稿块上以"上一轮被拒绝的后缀"为条件进行生成，而非仅从全新的掩码占位符出发。具体包括：保留被拒绝后缀的隐藏表示，将其与下一草稿块对齐，使用同一验证过程中的目标感知校正信号进行精炼，并通过门控残差融合将其引入草稿模型的输入嵌入。只改变跨轮条件化，不修改轮内提议生成，也不改动目标侧验证。
AI.result: 在Qwen3模型上针对数学推理、代码生成和开放式对话的实验表明，ReTrace相比其DFlash骨干一致地提升了平均接受长度和端到端解码速度。
AI.conclusion: ReTrace通过跨轮条件化利用被拒绝轨迹的潜在信息来提升投机解码效率，且因其与现有草稿改进方法正交，可与其结合获得更大收益。该方法保持了投机解码的无损特性，且无需额外的模型前向传播。

title: Elastic Token Compression for Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers
summary: Natural images concentrate their detail in a small fraction of the frame, yet diffusion models spend a full token on every patch, in every layer and at every timestep. The waste is largest in pixel-space models, with no autoencoder to absorb low-level redundancy first. Probing a pretrained pixel text-to-image transformer, we find its middle-block tokens redundant wherever the image is flat. The redundancy occupies connected, content-shaped regions, and exploiting it requires tokens with the same geometry. Cutting a Hilbert ordering of the patches provides them. Consecutive positions are always image neighbours, so any contiguous run is a connected region whose size and shape follow the content, and grouping in two dimensions becomes a cut in one. Existing reductions each lose part of this. Similarity merging scatters its groups, latent bottlenecks discard position, and skipping deletes what it should summarize. We cut where the model's features change most and pool each run into one region token. Our Region Token Interface (\method{}) adapts a diffusion model to these tokens, with the region count drawn at random during fine-tuning so one checkpoint serves every budget. \method{} leads prior reduction methods at matched budgets, matches dense quality at $2.0\times$ the speed, and stays close at $2.6\times$. The code and models are open-sourced at https://eduardzamfir.github.io/rti

AI.tldr: 本文提出Region Token Interface (RTI)，通过基于Hilbert序的连续区域token化来减少扩散模型在像素空间中的冗余计算，在2.0×加速下保持密集质量，在2.6×加速下仍接近最优性能。
AI.motivation: 自然图像的细节集中在画面的一小部分，但扩散模型在每个patch、每层、每个时间步上都花费完整token，导致大量计算浪费，尤其在像素空间模型中冗余最为严重。
AI.method: 通过探针发现中间层token在平坦区域冗余，利用Hilbert序的连续位置确保图像邻接性，通过在一维切点处对特征变化最大处进行区域切分，将每个连续run池化为一个区域token，并在微调期间随机采样区域数量以实现单检查点多预算适配。
AI.result: 在匹配的预算下优于先前的削减方法，在2.0×加速时保持密集质量，在2.6×加速时仍接近密集性能。
AI.conclusion: 现有方法（相似性合并、潜在瓶颈、跳过）各丢失部分信息，而RTI通过几何感知的区域tokenization在保持质量的同时实现显著加速，且代码和模型已开源。

title: HiVe: Beyond Static Prompts for Multitask Learning via Hierarchy-based Vertical Mixture-of-Experts
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: As large language models (LLMs) continue to scale, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has become a practical alternative to full-parameter adaptation. Prompt tuning is effective, but existing approaches either use flat prompt structures or hierarchical structures with fixed prompt composition, limiting adaptive prompt specialization. To address this limitation, we propose HiVe, a prompt tuning framework that models prompts at multiple levels and enables input-dependent specialization. HiVe constructs a prompt hierarchy by leveraging inter-task relationships during training, and employs a vertical mixture-of-experts (V-MoE) mechanism at inference time to compose prompts up to the level of specialization required for each input. Experiments show that HiVe consistently outperforms strong prompt tuning baselines across diverse tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HiVe，一种分层提示微调框架，通过利用任务间关系构建提示层级，并在推理时使用垂直混合专家机制实现输入自适应的提示组合，在多样任务上优于强基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有提示微调方法要么使用扁平提示结构，要么使用固定组合的分层结构，限制了提示的适应性专化能力，无法根据输入动态调整提示组合。
AI.method: HiVe框架包含两个核心组件：1）训练阶段利用任务间关系构建多层级提示层级结构；2）推理阶段采用垂直混合专家（V-MoE）机制，根据每个输入动态组合不同层级的提示，实现自适应的专化程度调整。
AI.result: 在多样化的任务上，HiVe持续优于强提示微调基线方法，验证了分层动态提示组合的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将静态的层级提示结构升级为输入自适应的动态组合机制，HiVe有效解决了提示微调中提示专化受限的问题，为参数高效微调提供了新的思路。

title: 3D-MRL: Nested Multimodal 3D Representations via Matryoshka Representation Learning
comment: Accepted at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026. Project page: https://usmarcv.github.io/3DMRL_page/
summary: Vision-Language Models align point clouds with image and text embeddings, enabling zero-shot recognition, retrieval, and open-vocabulary understanding of 3D shapes. Existing multimodal 3D pre-training methods produce fixed-dimensional embeddings, requiring separate models for different computational budgets. We propose 3D Matryoshka Representation Learning (3D-MRL), a multimodal 3D pre-training framework based on Matryoshka Representation Learning. 3D-MRL learns nested 3D representations by aligning point clouds with frozen CLIP image and text embeddings while applying contrastive supervision across multiple embedding dimensions. The Matryoshka objective is applied only to the 3D encoder, allowing a single model to produce representations at different dimensionalities without retraining. Experiments on the Objaverse-LVIS, ModelNet40, and ScanNet datasets show that 3D-MRL achieves competitive performance on zero-shot and few-shot 3D recognition tasks. In addition, the learned representations support retrieval across different embedding dimensions within a single model. On Objaverse-LVIS, 3D-MRL improves Top-1 accuracy from 46.8% to 50.9%. Retrieval experiments further show that different embedding dimensions yield varying levels of semantic and geometric specificity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出3D-MRL（3D Matryoshka Representation Learning），一种基于套娃表示学习的多模态3D预训练框架，通过对齐点云与冻结的CLIP图像/文本嵌入，并在多个嵌入维度上施加对比监督，使单一模型能够产生不同维度的3D表示，无需重新训练即可适配不同计算预算。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模态3D预训练方法产生固定维度嵌入，需要为不同计算预算训练不同的模型，缺乏灵活性，无法在单一模型中支持多种嵌入维度。
AI.method: 基于Matryoshka表示学习，将套娃目标仅应用于3D编码器，通过将点云与冻结的CLIP图像和文本嵌入对齐，并在多个嵌入维度上施加对比监督，学习嵌套的3D表示。
AI.result: 在Objaverse-LVIS、ModelNet40和ScanNet数据集上，3D-MRL在零样本和少样本3D识别任务上达到有竞争力的性能；在Objaverse-LVIS上Top-1准确率从46.8%提升至50.9%；检索实验表明不同嵌入维度具有不同层次的语义和几何特异性。
AI.conclusion: 3D-MRL验证了单一3D模型可通过套娃表示学习支持多维度嵌入，在保持竞争力的同时大幅提升推理灵活性，且不同维度嵌入在检索任务中展现出不同的语义与几何粒度。

title: R$^2$A: Learning Persona Policies Through Persona Representation Learning and Runtime Alignment
summary: The same Persona behavior can be beneficial in one context but harmful in another, causing static Persona elicitation to perform inconsistently across tasks. We introduce the Persona Selection--Realization Framework, which models behavior generation through a latent Persona state and decomposes it into Persona Selection and Persona Realization. The discrepancies between static Persona elicitation and an ideal Persona policy in these two components define the Selection Gap and Realization Gap, respectively. Building on this framework, we propose R$^2$A, a two-stage approach for learning Persona policies. Persona Representation Learning uses structured Who--How--What presentations to encode the target Persona's objective, conditional behavioral principles, and trajectory-level manifestations. Persona Runtime Alignment then removes the explicit Persona specification and jointly calibrates behavior selection and trajectory realization using task feedback. Across 12 evaluation settings covering the four principles of the Accountable-Professional Persona studied in this work, R$^2$A overall outperforms both the base model and static Persona elicitation. Ablation results further show that Persona Representation Learning is critical for preventing Runtime Alignment from producing behaviorally imbalanced policies and for achieving more stable Persona policy learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Persona选择-实现框架，将行为生成分解为潜在Persona状态下的选择与实现两个环节，并据此提出R²A两阶段方法（Persona表示学习+运行时对齐），在12个评估设置中优于基线模型和静态Persona引导。
AI.motivation: 静态Persona引导在不同任务上表现不一致，因为同一Persona行为在某些情境下有益、在另一些情境下有害，需要动态的Persona策略而非固定提示。
AI.method: 提出Persona Selection--Realization Framework，通过潜在Persona状态分解行为生成，定义选择差距和实现差距；在此基础上提出R²A两阶段方法：第一阶段Persona表示学习，使用Who--How--What结构化表示编码目标Persona的目标、条件行为原则和轨迹级表现；第二阶段Persona运行时对齐，移除显式Persona规格说明，利用任务反馈联合校准行为选择和轨迹实现。
AI.result: 在覆盖Accountable-Professional Persona四项原则的12个评估设置中，R²A整体优于基座模型和静态Persona引导；消融实验表明Persona表示学习对防止运行时对齐产生行为失衡策略、实现更稳定的Persona策略学习至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 动态Persona策略比静态引导更有效，将Persona选择与实现分离建模能够获得更稳定且平衡的Persona行为策略。

title: PERSIST: Persistent-State Discrimination for Shot Boundary Detection
comment: Accepted at BMVC 2026. Main paper: 18 pages, 5 figures. Supplementary material: 16 pages, 4 figures
summary: Shot boundary detection (SBD) is widely treated as the localisation of local visual discontinuities, yet many false positives such as hand-held shake, illumination flicker, motion blur, occlusion, and damaged archival material produce equally sharp local change without introducing a new shot. We reformulate SBD as boundary semantic discrimination: a frame is favoured as a boundary only when its local change evidence is accompanied by a persistent update of the video's latent temporal state, rather than a transient excursion that returns to the surrounding trend. This persistence test is operationalised with a continuous latent state from a FiLM-conditioned sinusoidal representation network and a structured discriminator that combines three semantic cues, local change, transient impulse, and return-to-trend, into a single interpretable per-frame signal over a dual-rate temporal backbone. The resulting framework, PERSIST, turns every decision into an inspectable one: the persistence criterion is trained into the classifier, its per-frame effect stays readable from the gate triple, and its learned latent state is measurably boundary-discriminative. On a 2,727-video per-subtype diagnostic it removes 33-80% of flash, text-overlay, and archival false positives relative to an identically trained cue detector, and at matched true-transition recall it roughly halves TransNetV2's pseudo-event false positives on that diagnostic and cuts its false positives on ClipShots footage by about a quarter, while preserving recall. It does so while reaching parity with the strongest public detector across online, broadcast, short-form, and historical-archive transfer evaluations, under markedly stricter training: it learns from ClipShots real transitions only, whereas the anchor draws on additional corpora whose transitions are 85% synthetic. Code is available at https://github.com/linty5/PERSIST.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PERSIST框架，将镜头边界检测（SBD）从局部视觉不连续性定位重构为边界语义判别，通过连续潜在状态验证局部变化是否伴随持久的状态更新，从而消除手持抖动、光照闪烁、运动模糊、遮挡和档案损坏等造成的误检。
AI.motivation: 传统SBD将镜头边界视为局部视觉不连续性，但许多干扰因素（如手持晃动、光照闪烁、运动模糊、遮挡、档案损坏）也会产生同样尖锐的局部变化却并不构成新镜头，导致大量误检。
AI.method: 将SBD重构为边界语义判别，使用FiLM条件化正弦表示网络构建连续潜在状态，通过持久性测试判断局部变化证据是否伴随视频潜在时间状态的持续更新。采用结构化判别器结合三个语义线索（局部变化、瞬态脉冲、回归趋势），在双速率时间骨干网络上生成单一可解释的逐帧信号。
AI.result: 在2,727视频的按子类型诊断中，相比同等训练的线索检测器减少了33-80%的闪光、文字叠加和档案误检；在匹配真实转换召回率下，相较TransNetV2在诊断集上伪事件误检约减半，在ClipShots素材上误检减少约四分之一且保持召回率。在在线、广播、短视频和历史档案迁移评估中与其他最强公开检测器持平，但训练数据更严格（仅使用ClipShots真实转换，而基准使用85%合成转换的额外语料）。
AI.conclusion: PERSIST通过将持久性准则训练进分类器，使每个决策可检查：逐帧效应可从门控三元组读取，学到的潜在状态在边界判别上可测量，在显著减少误检的同时保持检测性能。

title: A^2Agent: Action-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Repository-Level Code Localization Agents
summary: Localizing issue-relevant code regions is a critical step in automated software engineering. However, due to their reliance on sparse trajectory-level signals, existing methods cannot identify which per-turn actions are effective and often discover correct code regions during exploration but fail to commit them. To address these limitations, we propose an action-aware reinforcement learning method that combines a per-turn reward sequence rewarding both the discovery and commitment of gold code regions with an action-level advantage estimation scheme that isolates each action's credit by grouping turns sharing the same exploration context. Extensive evaluations show that our method improves the average F1 over the state-of-the-art (SOTA) by 1.58% on SWE-Bench Verified and 8.55% on SWE-Bench Pro, with our 4B model outperforming baselines up to 8x larger. Our code is available at https://github.com/donian00/A2Agent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种动作感知的强化学习方法（A2Agent），通过每回合奖励序列和动作级优势估计，解决现有方法无法识别有效回合动作、探索到正确代码区域但未能提交的问题，在SWE-Bench基准上超越现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化软件工程中的问题相关代码区域定位方法依赖于稀疏的轨迹级信号，无法识别哪些逐回合动作是有效的，且经常在探索中发现了正确的代码区域但未能最终提交。
AI.method: 提出动作感知强化学习方法，包含两部分：(1) 每回合奖励序列，同时奖励黄金代码区域的发现和提交；(2) 动作级优势估计方案，通过分组共享相同探索上下文的回合来隔离每个动作的贡献。
AI.result: 在SWE-Bench Verified上平均F1比现有最优方法提升1.58%，在SWE-Bench Pro上提升8.55%，且4B参数的模型性能优于最高8倍规模参数的基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 动作感知的奖励与优势估计机制能有效提升问题相关代码区域的定位精度，且小模型也能达到甚至超越大模型的性能。

title: AOI-Net: Structural Face AOI-Guided Eye-Gaze Track Representation Learning for Autism Spectrum Disorder Detection
summary: Eye-movement tracking has emerged as a promising non-invasive approach to Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) screening, with systematic differences in attentional allocation and revisit behaviors observed during socially interactive tasks. Existing computational methods typically characterize eye-movements using discrete gaze trajectories and fixation events, yielding representations dominated by short-range temporal dynamics and limiting models that primarily emphasize long-range dependencies. Meanwhile, gaze behavior is naturally organized across semantically meaningful Areas of Interest (AOIs), whose attention allocation and transitions provide important structural cues, yet their relationships are rarely modeled explicitly. To address these limitations, we propose a structural face AOI-guided Eye-Gaze Track Network (AOI-Net) that jointly models short-term temporal dynamics and AOI-level structural organization. A network gating mechanism adaptively integrates the complementary temporal and structural representations according to their contributions to gaze-behavior characterization. To mitigate the pronounced class imbalance commonly encountered between individuals with ASD and Typically Developing (TD) participants in clinical datasets, class-distribution-aware learning is further employed to facilitate discriminative embedding learning under skewed class distributions. Experiments on a unique and large-scale clinical eye-tracking database comprising eight stimulus subsets and more than 1,300 participants show that AOI-Net consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods. The proposed framework also enables interpretable gaze-behavior modeling and provides a practical basis for scalable AI-driven ASD screening in real-world healthcare. The code is available at https://github.com/Zhanpei-ai/CIM-AOI-Net/tree/main/Code

AI.tldr: 本文提出AOI-Net，一种结合短时时间动态和兴趣区(AOI)级结构组织的面部眼动追踪网络，用于自闭症谱系障碍(ASD)筛查，在超过1300名参与者的大规模临床眼动数据库上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有ASD眼动筛查方法仅基于离散注视轨迹和注视事件，过度强调短时时间动态而忽略长程依赖；同时，眼动行为在语义上有意义的兴趣区(AOI)中自然组织，但其结构关系很少被显式建模，导致无法充分利用注意分配和转移的结构线索。
AI.method: 提出AOI-Net框架：(1)联合建模短时时间动态与AOI级结构组织两种互补表征；(2)采用网络门控机制自适应整合两种表征；(3)使用类分布感知学习(class-distribution-aware learning)缓解ASD与TD之间的类别不平衡问题。
AI.result: 在包含8个刺激子集、超过1300名参与者的大规模临床眼动数据库上，AOI-Net始终优于现有最先进方法，并支持可解释的眼动行为建模。
AI.conclusion: AOI-Net通过显式建模AOI级结构信息并自适应融合时间与结构表征，为可扩展的AI驱动ASD筛查提供了实用基础，代码已开源。

title: You Know What I Mean: A Benchmark for Agentic Conversational Reference Grounding
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Collaborative conversations frequently contain references whose targets are indirect rather than named: resolving "this looks like the fix discussed yesterday" requires combining conversational context with evidence from the surrounding workspace which is accessible through APIs or user interfaces. We formalize this problem as Conversational Reference Grounding (CoRG): using a given set of tools to resolve a reference in conversation to the unique external item intended by the speaker. CoRG is challenging because it combines lexical, semantic, and temporal cues distributed across the conversation and the external workspace. Agents must translate these heterogeneous signals into effective tool use: formulating strategies, discovering plausible candidates, inspecting their metadata and content, and ruling out close alternatives. We study CoRG through RepoRef, a benchmark of 400 developer-chat segments grounded in GitHub issues, pull requests, and commits across 92 repositories. Unlike single-shot retrieval tasks, RepoRef often requires multi-step tool use. Our results show that CoRG remains challenging for current agents, even the best agent reaches only 67.0% success rate, leaving one third of references unresolved. These findings position CoRG as a concrete benchmark for studying how agents search, inspect, and verify information in realistic multi-tool environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"对话引用定位"（CoRG）这一新问题：在协作对话中，引用可能指向外部工作区（如代码库）中的对象，而非直接命名。作者构建了RepoRef基准（包含92个仓库中400个开发者对话片段），实验表明当前最先进的智能体在CoRG上的成功率仅为67.0%，说明该任务仍具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 协作对话中经常出现非显式命名的引用（如"这就像昨天讨论的修复方案"），解析这类引用需要结合对话上下文与外部工作区信息。已有工作主要聚焦单次检索任务，无法应对需要多步工具使用、综合多种线索的复杂引用解析场景。
AI.method: 作者将问题形式化为Conversational Reference Grounding (CoRG)，要求智能体利用给定工具集将对话中的引用解析到唯一的外部目标对象。通过RepoRef基准（400个从92个GitHub仓库提取的开发者对话片段，覆盖issue、PR和commit）进行评估，任务涉及词法、语义和时序线索的综合运用，需要多步工具调用进行候选发现、元数据检查、内容审查和备选排除。
AI.result: 最优智能体在RepoRef上的成功率仅为67.0%，仍有三分之一以上的引用无法正确解析，表明CoRG对当前智能体而言仍然是一个未解决的挑战。
AI.conclusion: CoRG为研究智能体在真实多工具环境中如何搜索、检查和验证信息提供了一个具体基准，揭示了对话引用定位任务的难度，为未来改进多步工具使用和跨模态信息融合的智能体设计指明了方向。

title: Hyper3-CLIP: Hierarchy-Conditioned Hyperbolic Vision-Language Training
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, ECCV 2026 Beyond Euclidean Workshop
