summary: CLIP-like vision-language models (VLMs) trained with contrastive objectives learn strong global image-text representations, but their Euclidean embeddings and global pooling fail to encode relational structure such as part-whole and parent-child relations. Hyperbolic VLMs address this gap with entailment-based objectives, and text-conditioned variants improve fine-grained alignment through sentence- and phrase-level queries. However, these two lines of work remain separate: hyperbolic VLMs use static image and region features, while query-conditioned methods lack hierarchical geometric structure. We present Hyper3-CLIP, a hierarchy-conditioned hyperbolic VLM that combines global, local, and global-local contrastive learning with query-conditioned visual pooling. To train the model, we construct lightweight query hierarchies from text, comprising full captions, sentence fragments, localized part descriptions, and extracted phrases. Each query conditions the pooling of visual patches, and the resulting representations support image-text, whole-part, and parent-child entailment losses. Query-conditioned pooling is active only during training. Hyper3-CLIP improves R@5 and R@10 retrieval on COCO and Flickr, as well as multi-label classification on VOC and COCO, while remaining competitive on hierarchy metrics. We also audit zero-shot prompt sensitivity under fixed prompt regimes and study the effect of the localized GRIT part budget used during training. Code is available at https://github.com/Hyper3Labs/hyper3-clip.

AI.tldr: Hyper3-CLIP是一种将层次条件与双曲几何相结合的视觉-语言模型，通过查询条件化的视觉池化统一了全局、局部及全局-局部对比学习，并利用从文本构建的轻量级查询层次结构支持图像-文本、整体-部分和父子蕴含损失，在COCO和Flickr检索以及多标签分类上取得改进，同时保持层次指标竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有CLIP类视觉-语言模型使用欧几里得嵌入和全局池化，无法编码部分-整体、父子等关系结构。虽然双曲VLM和文本条件化方法分别解决了层次几何和细粒度对齐问题，但这两条研究路线彼此独立：双曲VLM使用静态图像和区域特征，而查询条件化方法缺乏层次几何结构。
AI.method: 提出Hyper3-CLIP，结合全局、局部和全局-局部对比学习与查询条件化视觉池化。从文本构建轻量级查询层次结构（包含完整标题、句子片段、局部部分描述和提取短语），每个查询条件化视觉patch的池化过程，并支持图像-文本、整体-部分和父子蕴含损失。查询条件化池化仅在训练时激活。
AI.result: 在COCO和Flickr上提升了R@5和R@10检索性能，在VOC和COCO上改进了多标签分类，同时保持层次指标竞争力。还审计了固定提示机制下的零样本提示敏感性，并研究了局部GRIT部分预算对训练的影响。
AI.conclusion: Hyper3-CLIP成功地将双曲层次几何与查询条件化细粒度对齐统一在一个框架中，通过训练时查询条件化池化在保持层次能力的同时提升了检索和分类性能，验证了层次结构感知与细粒度查询学习的互补性。

title: EVAR: Evidence-Validated Hypothesis Admission for Budget-Aware Narrative Reasoning
comment: Accepted to the Main Conference of EMNLP 2026. 16 pages, 3 figures
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often produce fluent but weakly grounded conclusions when reasoning over non-interactive, long-form narratives. A central failure mode is that unsupported intermediate hypotheses can enter the reasoning trajectory and contaminate subsequent inference, especially when evidence is scattered across distant parts of the story. To address this problem, we propose EVAR, an evidence-validated hypothesis admission framework for budget-aware narrative reasoning. EVAR first compiles the narrative into an immutable evidence store of source-linked atomic claims and assigns an instance-specific inference budget from unresolved gaps and uncertainty signals. During refinement, EVAR directly proposes candidate hypotheses for unresolved gaps, constructs hypothesis-conditioned validation challenges, and verifies each candidate against the locked store before admission: supported hypotheses enter the answer-supporting state, unverifiable ones are quarantined, and contradictory ones are discarded. A sufficiency-based stopping mechanism further avoids unnecessary refinement. Experiments on NarraCrime and multiple public reasoning benchmarks show that EVAR improves both task performance and evidence faithfulness while maintaining controllable inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EVAR框架，一种针对预算感知的叙事推理的证据验证假设准入机制。EVAR先将叙事编译为不可变的源链接原子证据库，并分配实例特定的推理预算；在推理过程中，对候选假设进行基于证据的验证，只有受支持的假设才能进入推理状态，未验证的被隔离，矛盾的被丢弃，并通过充分性停止机制控制推理成本。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在长文本叙事推理中常产生流畅但证据薄弱结论，主要原因是不受支持的中间假设进入推理轨迹并污染后续推理，尤其当证据分散在故事各处时问题更为严重。现有方法缺乏对中间假设的系统性验证机制。
AI.method: EVAR框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 将叙事编译为不可变的源链接原子证据库；(2) 基于未解决间隙和不确定性信号分配实例特定的推理预算；(3) 在细化过程中提出候选假设、构建假设条件的验证挑战、对照锁定证据库验证候选假设，支持者进入答案支持状态、无法验证者被隔离、矛盾者被丢弃；同时采用充分性停止机制避免不必要的细化。
AI.result: 在NarraCrime和多个公开推理基准上的实验表明，EVAR同时提升了任务性能和证据忠实度，同时保持了可控的推理成本。
AI.conclusion: EVAR通过证据验证的假设准入机制有效解决了叙事推理中假设污染问题，在提升性能的同时兼顾了证据忠实性和推理成本的可控性，为预算感知的叙事推理提供了有效方案。

title: Test-Time Scaling for Video Diffusion Models via Diagnosis-Guided Candidate Recycling
summary: Recent video diffusion models have achieved remarkable generation quality, but high-fidelity results still largely depend on closed-source systems or costly large-scale infrastructure. Test-time scaling (TTS) offers a training-free way to improve lightweight generators by spending additional inference compute, yet existing methods mostly remain within a noise-search paradigm: they sample, select, or perturb denoising trajectories and discard low-scoring candidates after expensive generation. This generate-and-discard process wastes not only computation but also the partial motion, layout, or appearance structure already encoded in recoverable samples. We present \textbf{GEARS} (\textbf{G}uided \textbf{E}diting for \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{R}ecycling \textbf{S}earch), a training-free framework that introduces {diagnosis-guided candidate recycling} into video TTS by turning such candidates into editable priors through a generation-evaluation-editing loop. GEARS consists of two collaborative components. The \textbf{Stage-Aware Scheduler} determines what to repair, when to repair it, and which candidates should be preserved, recycled, or discarded. The \textbf{Candidate Recycler} diagnoses recoverable failures from keyframes and multi-dimensional reward feedback, derives candidate-specific repair prompts, and repairs the corresponding candidates through manifold-aware latent SDEdit. The repaired candidates are recycled into the search pool, creating refinement paths beyond standard noise perturbation while preserving useful structure. Under matched NFE budgets, GEARS consistently outperforms existing video TTS methods on VBench, bringing a 1.3B model to a total score comparable to a 14B counterpart, and ablations verify the necessity of adaptive scheduling, diagnosis-conditioned editing, and manifold-aware re-denoising. Code is available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: GEARS是一个无需训练的测试时扩展（TTS）框架，通过"生成-评估-编辑"循环将低分视频候选样本转化为可编辑先验并回收利用，在相同NFE预算下显著提升轻量级视频扩散模型的生成质量，使1.3B模型达到接近14B模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视频扩散模型的高保真生成依赖闭源系统或大规模基础设施；测试时扩展方法多局限于噪声搜索范式，采用"生成后丢弃"策略，浪费了计算资源以及候选样本中已编码的部分运动、布局或外观结构信息。
AI.method: GEARS包含两个协作组件：(1) Stage-Aware Scheduler用于决定修复什么、何时修复以及哪些候选应被保留、回收或丢弃；(2) Candidate Recycler通过关键帧和多维奖励反馈诊断可恢复的失败，生成候选特定的修复提示，并通过流形感知的潜在SDEdit修复候选样本，将修复后的候选回收进搜索池，形成超越标准噪声扰动的细化路径。
AI.result: 在匹配的NFE预算下，GEARS在VBench上持续优于现有视频TTS方法，将1.3B模型提升到与14B模型相当的总分；消融实验验证了自适应调度、诊断条件编辑和流形感知再降噪的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将低分候选转化为可编辑先验并回收利用，GEARS实现了无需训练的视频生成质量提升，为轻量级生成器提供了一条可行的测试时扩展路径。

title: SkillForge: Compositional Skill Synthesis with Verification-in-the-Loop for Generating Formally Verified Dafny Programs
summary: Generating formally verified programs from natural language remains challenging: existing approaches either produce code in a single pass without recourse when verification fails, or rely on open-ended agentic reasoning that is non-deterministic and opaque. We introduce SKILLFORGE, a framework that decomposes formal code synthesis into a library of atomic, reusable skills, each targeting a specific subtask such as specification inference, body synthesis, invariant generation, error diagnosis, or targeted repair, and defined by a prompt template, tool binding, and decidable success criterion. A verification-driven harness orchestrates these skills: it submits candidates to the Dafny verifier, diagnoses failures into structured categories, deterministically routes to the appropriate repair skill, and iterates until formal correctness is proved or a budget is exhausted. On a curated benchmark of natural language to Dafny specification pairs, SKILLFORGE substantially outperforms both state-of-the-art agentic approaches (including ReAct-style agents, MCTS-based repair, and RL-guided verification) and traditional iterative baselines, while requiring fewer tokens and lower latency. Ablation studies confirm that every skill contributes measurably, and the harness converges rapidly with the majority of programs verified on the first attempt.

AI.tldr: SKILLFORGE 是一个将自然语言到形式化程序生成分解为可复用的原子技能库的框架，通过验证驱动的调度机制（使用 Dafny 验证器）进行确定性路由和迭代修复，在基准测试上显著优于现有方法，且更高效。
AI.motivation: 现有从自然语言生成形式化验证程序的方法存在两大缺陷：要么单次生成无法在验证失败后补救，要么依赖开放式的智能体推理，导致不确定性和不透明性。
AI.method: SKILLFORGE 将形式化代码合成分解为多个原子、可复用的技能（如规范推断、主体合成、不变量生成、错误诊断、定向修复），每个技能由提示模板、工具绑定和可判定的成功标准定义。验证驱动的调度器将 Dafny 验证器的失败诊断为结构化类别，确定性路由到适当的修复技能，迭代直至证明通过或预算耗尽。
AI.result: 在自然语言到 Dafny 规范配对的基准上，SKILLFORGE 大幅优于 SOTA 智能体方法（ReAct 风格智能体、基于 MCTS 的修复、RL 引导验证）和传统迭代基线，同时消耗更少的 token 和更低的延迟。消融研究确认每个技能都有可量化的贡献，且调度器收敛快速，大多数程序首次尝试即可验证通过。
AI.conclusion: SKILLFORGE 通过将形式化代码合成模块化为可组合的技能库，并采用确定性的验证驱动调度，实现了比开放式智能体方法更高的性能、更低的成本以及更好的可解释性和可确定性。

title: Neural video codecs quality assessment dataset and benchmark
summary: Video traffic constitutes a significant share of global web traffic. To reduce its volume, video codecs have been developed and continuously improved. While the industry has achieved substantial progress in traditional video coding, neural video codecs (NVCs) have recently emerged as a new approach that applies deep learning to video compression. This creates new challenges for compression quality assessment, which is essential for the further development and improvement of such codecs. In particular, it is important to evaluate the novel temporal compression paradigms introduced by NVCs. In this work, we present a large-scale subjective dataset of videos compressed with both neural and traditional video codecs. The subjective scores were collected through crowd-sourced pairwise comparisons. The proposed dataset provides a valuable resource for the development and benchmarking of video quality metrics tailored to neural video codecs. The dataset is available at the following link: https://videoprocessing.github.io/nvc-dataset-benchmark

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个大规模主观视频质量数据集，包含神经视频编码器（NVCs）和传统视频编码器压缩的视频，通过众包成对比较收集主观评分，为评估和开发针对NVCs的视频质量指标提供了宝贵资源。
AI.motivation: 视频流量占全球网络流量很大比重，神经视频编码器作为新兴技术引入了全新的时间压缩范式，对传统的压缩质量评估方法提出了新挑战，亟需针对NVCs的质量评估数据集和基准。
AI.method: 构建了包含神经和传统视频编码器压缩视频的大规模主观数据集，采用众包成对比较方式收集主观评分。
AI.result: 成功创建了大规模主观数据集，为神经视频编码器的视频质量指标开发与基准测试提供了丰富资源，数据集已公开提供。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集填补了针对神经视频编码器质量评估的资源空白，能够支持和改进NVCs压缩质量评估指标的研发，推动神经视频编码器的进一步发展。

title: Influence-Directed Distillation: Solving the Diversity Bottleneck in Sampled-Token On-Policy Distillation
summary: Sampled-token on-policy distillation (OPD) efficiently transfers capabilities from teacher to student using student-generated tokens, requiring teacher probabilities only for sampled tokens. Yet it frequently suffers from diversity distillation failure: the student's pass@1 improves while its pass@$k$ plateaus, failing to inherit the teacher's diversity. To explain this, we introduce First-Order Local Entropy Influence, a signed first-order proxy that decouples each update's entropy effect into the teacher--student log-probability gap and the student's local probability structure, and empirically links entropy contraction to negative-influence positions. Motivated by this, we propose Influence-Directed Adaptive On-Policy Distillation (IDA-OPD): rather than relying on costly full-vocabulary Forward-KL objectives, it preserves entropy-expanding updates while replacing entropy-contracting ones with divergence-adaptive advantage shrinkage, using only the teacher's sampled-token log-probability. Experiments on reasoning-oriented distillation show IDA-OPD consistently improves pass@$k$, inheriting the teacher's diversity through distillation, matches the strongest teacher-informed methods at strictly lower cost, and broadly maintains vanilla OPD's pass@1, all without full-vocabulary teacher information.

AI.tldr: 本文针对采样token在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中存在的多样性蒸馏失败问题，提出了一种新的方法IDA-OPD，通过引入一阶局部熵影响代理指标来识别并保留熵扩张更新、替换熵收缩更新，从而在不使用全词表教师信息的情况下，有效继承教师模型的多样性并提升pass@k性能。
AI.motivation: OPD虽然高效，但经常出现多样性蒸馏失败：学生的pass@1提升而pass@k停滞不前，无法继承教师的多样性。作者希望从理论上解释这一现象，并提出一种低成本的解决方案。
AI.method: 首先提出一阶局部熵影响（First-Order Local Entropy Influence），将每次更新的熵效应分解为教师-学生对数概率差距和学生局部概率结构两部分，并经验性地将熵收缩与负影响位置联系起来。基于此提出IDA-OPD方法：保留熵扩张更新，同时用发散自适应优势收缩（divergence-adaptive advantage shrinkage）替换熵收缩更新，仅使用教师采样token的对数概率。
AI.result: 在推理导向的蒸馏实验中，IDA-OPD持续提升pass@k，通过蒸馏继承了教师模型的多样性；以更低成本匹配最强教师感知方法的效果；同时广泛保持原始OPD的pass@1性能，全程无需全词表教师信息。
AI.conclusion: IDA-OPD有效解决了OPD的多样性蒸馏失败问题，在保持高效性和pass@1优势的同时，成功继承了教师模型的多样性，为在线策略蒸馏提供了一种低成本、高质量的替代方案。

title: GenFirst: Generation Before Reconstruction for Stable End-to-End Latent Generative Modeling
summary: Latent generative models typically follow a two-stage pipeline, training a variational autoencoder for reconstruction and then a generative model on the frozen latent space. Since reconstruction-optimized latents are not necessarily generation-friendly, jointly training both models is an appealing alternative. However, direct end-to-end training remains challenging, as it is prone to latent collapse and faces a generation-reconstruction conflict. We revisit this problem by analyzing how different objectives shape the latent space and identify two key insights. First, the entropy term in the Kullback-Leibler divergence objective is essential for preventing collapse: reconstruction and prior fitting tend to shrink the posterior, while entropy preserves non-degenerate latent uncertainty. Second, reconstruction and generation exhibit asymmetric learning dynamics: reconstruction is fast and strongly supervised, whereas generation is slower and harder to optimize. Based on these insights, we achieve the first direct end-to-end training without latent collapse and propose GenFirst, a simple generation-before-reconstruction strategy. The generative objective first shapes the latent space under weak reconstruction pressure, after which reconstruction is progressively strengthened to recover visual details. We validate GenFirst with continuous autoregressive priors with exact likelihoods and SiT priors with implicit likelihoods. With our end-to-end objective and GenFirst, SiT achieves a gFID of 0.97 with CFG and 1.45 without CFG on ImageNet-256, while MMDiT reaches a GenEval score of 0.90 on text-to-image generation. Beyond image generation, we extend the framework to shared visual latents for generation and representation learning, and to continuous unified text-image generation. These results demonstrate the generality of stable end-to-end latent learning across generative priors and modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GenFirst，一种生成优先于重建的端到端策略，首次实现无潜在坍塌的直接端到端训练，在ImageNet-256上SiT达到gFID 0.97（带CFG）和1.45（无CFG），MMDiT在文本到图像生成上达到GenEval 0.90。
AI.motivation: 传统潜在生成模型采用两阶段管道（先训练VAE重建，再在冻结潜在空间上训练生成模型），但重建优化的潜在空间不一定是生成友好的。直接端到端训练虽然吸引人，却容易发生潜在坍塌并面临生成-重建冲突。作者希望通过分析不同目标如何塑造潜在空间，解决端到端联合训练中的这些难题。
AI.method: 论文通过分析不同目标函数对潜在空间的影响，发现两个关键洞察：(1) KL散度目标中的熵项对防止坍塌至关重要（重建和先验拟合倾向于收缩后验，而熵保持非退化的潜在不确定性）；(2) 重建和生成存在不对称的学习动态（重建快速且强监督，生成缓慢且更难优化）。基于这些洞察，作者提出GenFirst策略：先生成目标在弱重建压力下塑造潜在空间，然后逐步加强重建以恢复视觉细节。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-256上，SiT实现gFID 0.97（带CFG）和1.45（无CFG）；MMDiT在文本到图像生成上达到GenEval 0.90。此外，还扩展到共享视觉潜在空间的生成与表示学习，以及连续统一文本-图像生成。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，稳定的端到端潜在学习在多种生成先验和模态上具有通用性，证明了生成优先策略是解决潜在坍塌和生成-重建冲突的有效方案。

title: GenRubric: Self-Evolving Rubric Generation for Scalable LLM Evaluation
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as scalable evaluators for open-ended tasks. However, many LLM judges derive query-specific criteria during scoring, leaving the evaluation requirements insufficiently specified and their coverage difficult to audit. Query-specific rubrics make these requirements explicit, but expert-written rubrics are costly to construct, while existing automatic methods typically rely on inference-time refinement or external supervision. We introduce GenRubric, a self-evolving framework that improves rubric generation from unlabeled queries without requiring additional human annotations during self-evolution. Our approach is based on rubric-induced self-consistency: independently sampled rubrics for the same query provide partial views of its latent evaluation requirements, and a comprehensive rubric should induce a response that generalizes across these complementary evaluation views. We implement this principle through reinforcement learning, combining a cross-rubric comprehensiveness signal with group-level and criterion-level rewards for rubric quality. We train GenRubric models at 4B, 8B, and 14B scales across multiple domains. Experiments on human-annotated rubric benchmarks show that self-evolution improves the agreement between evaluations induced by generated rubrics and those induced by expert-written rubrics. The improvements further generalize to held-out domains, demonstrating the potential of self-evolving rubric generation for scalable and query-specific LLM evaluation. Code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/foggpoy/GenRubric.

AI.tldr: GenRubric是一个自进化框架，通过无标注查询自动生成查询特定的评估标准（rubrics），无需额外人工标注。其核心思想是基于"rubric诱导的自一致性"原理，利用强化学习训练模型，在4B/8B/14B三个规模上验证了生成的rubric与专家编写的rubric在评估一致性上的提升，并能泛化到未见领域。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型作为开放任务评估器时，许多LLM judge在打分过程中自行推导查询特定标准，导致评估要求说明不充分、覆盖范围难以审计。虽然查询特定的rubrics可以明确这些要求，但专家编写的rubrics成本高昂，而现有的自动化方法通常依赖推理时细化或外部监督，缺乏无需人工标注的自进化方案。
AI.method: GenRubric提出自进化框架，基于rubric诱导自一致性原理：同一查询独立采样的多个rubrics提供潜在评估要求的不同视角，全面的rubric应能诱导出跨互补评估视角泛化的响应。通过强化学习实现，结合跨rubric全面性信号与组级和标准级奖励来优化rubric质量。模型在4B、8B、14B规模上跨多个领域训练。
AI.result: 在人工标注的rubric基准测试上，自进化显著提升了生成rubric所诱导的评估与专家编写rubric所诱导的评估之间的一致性。改进效果还能泛化到未见领域，证明该方法具有可扩展性和通用性。
AI.conclusion: GenRubric展示了自进化rubric生成在可扩展、查询特定的LLM评估方面的潜力，无需额外人工标注即可持续改进rubric质量，并具有良好的跨领域泛化能力。代码和模型已公开。

title: FISICA: A Deployed Service for Plantar-Pressure and Posture Assessment with Ontology-Grounded Recommendation
summary: FISICA is a body-assessment and recommendation service running in production. One standing session with two photographs returns foot-loading measures, posture coordinates, a driven 3D avatar, a visual report, and ranked shoe and exercise candidates. Measurement comes from a purpose-built scale carrying 634 force-sensitive elements on a 1 cm grid and four load cells, and a rule-based evaluator controls every recommendation while a language model only explains the stored result. The method contribution is the avatar. Instead of mapping a measured angle onto a rig through a tuned gain, we measure the avatar with the same function used on the subject and solve until the two agree, on a sampling-invariant spinal metric that separated a normal from a kyphotic record by 7.2 degrees against 0.9 degrees for a single-joint formulation. In production, general APIs respond at a 0.023 s median, plantar-pressure analysis at 0.45 s, and recommendation at 2.16 s to 2.26 s with the rule-based portion under one second in every trial. The served keypoint graph reaches 0.960 PCK@0.2 on public data, and the catalog holds 699 shoes with 10,500 typed facts. An approved study supplies the radiographic reference for the validation still ahead.

AI.tldr: FISICA是一个已投产的体态评估与推荐服务，通过一张带有634个力敏元件和4个称重传感器的专用量秤，结合两张站立照片，即可输出足底压力、姿态坐标、3D虚拟人、视觉报告以及鞋履和运动推荐。其方法核心在于虚拟人生成：用与受试者相同的测量函数来测量虚拟人，并通过迭代求解使两侧一致，在采样不变脊柱度量上实现了7.2度与单关节0.9度的区分度对比。系统在产环境中各API响应时间分别为0.023秒、0.45秒和2.16-2.26秒，关键点图在公开数据上达到0.960 PCK@0.2，目录包含699双鞋和10,500条类型化事实。
AI.motivation: 现有姿态评估与鞋履推荐系统通常依赖人工观测或单一关节角度映射，缺乏从足底压力到全身姿态再到个性化推荐的完整自动化链路，且虚拟人生成中调参增益的方法精度有限，难以在个体间保持一致性。
AI.method: 系统由专用测量硬件（634个力敏元件+4个称重传感器的量秤）和双相机照片采集构成；推荐由规则引擎全权控制，语言模型仅负责解释存储结果。方法创新在于虚拟人生成：不使用调好的增益将测量角度映射到骨骼，而是用测量受试者的同一函数去测量虚拟人，通过迭代求解使两者在采样不变的脊柱度量上达成一致。
AI.result: 采样不变脊柱度量上，正常与脊柱后凸记录的区分度为7.2度，远优于单关节公式的0.9度。产环境中通用API中位响应0.023秒，足底压力分析0.45秒，推荐2.16-2.26秒且规则部分每次均在1秒以内。关键点图在公开数据上达0.960 PCK@0.2，目录含699双鞋和10,500条类型化事实。
AI.conclusion: FISICA展示了从硬件测量到端到端推荐服务的完整工业化落地，其"用同一函数测量虚拟人与受试者"的思路显著提升了脊柱姿态的区分精度，系统性能满足生产要求。已批准的影像学研究将为后续正式验证提供金标准参照。

title: ManGo: Manga Active Narrative Grounding Optimization
comment: 16 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables. Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Manga visual question answering requires models to answer questions over panel-based visual narratives, where relevant evidence is distributed across ordered panels, embedded text, recurring characters, and implicit event transitions. This structure makes passive page encoding insufficient, as the model must identify which panels to inspect, what clues to retain, and when the accumulated evidence is sufficient for answering. We propose ManGo (Manga Active Narrative Grounding Optimization), an unsupervised framework for active manga visual question answering. ManGo introduces Active Narrative Sketching (ANS), which iteratively selects panels, extracts concise grounded clues, and decides when to stop, forming a compact question-directed evidence sketch before answer generation. To optimize this behavior without human-annotated answers or rationale paths, ManGo samples multiple ANS rollouts and applies group-relative training with two rewards: answer preference from listwise self-ranking and path consistency from stable ordered panel trajectories. The combined reward is optimized with group-relative policy training, encouraging the model to improve both final answers and the panel-level evidence paths that support them. Experiments on standard manga understanding benchmarks show that ManGo achieves state-of-the-art performance across different settings.

AI.tldr: 提出ManGo框架，通过Active Narrative Sketching主动选择漫画面板、提取线索并决定停止时机，结合无监督的组相对策略训练优化答案质量与证据路径，在漫画VQA基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 漫画VQA需要跨有序面板、嵌入文本、重复角色和隐含事件转换来定位证据，被动页面编码不足，模型需识别看哪些面板、保留什么线索、何时证据充分。
AI.method: ManGo包含两个核心组件：(1) Active Narrative Sketching (ANS)迭代选择面板、提取精简线索、决定停止时机；(2) 无监督训练采用组相对策略优化，通过采样多个ANS轨迹，用列表式自排序的答案偏好奖励和稳定有序面板轨迹的路径一致性奖励共同优化。
AI.result: 在标准漫画理解基准上，ManGo在不同设置下均取得最先进（SOTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过主动证据采集与无监督训练策略，ManGo有效解决了漫画VQA中证据分布复杂的问题，验证了主动叙事定位在提升漫画问答性能方面的有效性。

title: GSPotential: Camera Potential Field for Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting
comment: 10 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to Pacific Graphics 2026 Conference Track
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting has achieved remarkable success in photorealistic rendering, yet it suffers from severe overfitting and geometric artifacts in sparse-view scenarios due to the inherent deficiency of photometric supervision. Recent advances have attempted to regularize optimization by incorporating external priors, such as depth, point clouds, or diffusion models. However, these methods typically overlook the non-uniform distribution of supervision across the viewing space, resulting in limited specificity in prior use and primitive control. In this paper, we propose GSPotential, a framework that quantifies view-space supervision imbalance using a Camera Potential Field. Our key insight is to identify supervision valleys where photometric constraints are most deficient, and use the potential field to guide reconstruction from two complementary aspects. First, we devise a probabilistic spherical sampling strategy that places informative virtual cameras in low-potential regions. Point-cloud renderings from these views then provide targeted geometric guidance. Second, the same field provides a directional coverage cue for conservative Gaussian updates in weakly covered spatial sectors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GSPotential achieves high reconstruction fidelity while maintaining competitive training efficiency.

AI.tldr: GSPotential框架通过相机势场（Camera Potential Field）量化视图空间监督不平衡，识别监督薄弱区域，并利用该势场引导稀疏视角下的3D高斯溅射重建，实现高保真重建和高效训练。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯溅射在稀疏视角场景下存在严重的过拟合和几何伪影问题。现有方法虽然引入外部先验（深度、点云、扩散模型）进行正则化，但忽视了监督在视图空间中的不均匀分布，导致先验使用和原始控制缺乏针对性。
AI.method: 提出GSPotential框架：1) 利用Camera Potential Field量化视图空间监督不平衡，识别"监督谷"区域；2) 设计概率球形采样策略，在低势能区域放置信息量丰富的虚拟相机，利用点云渲染提供定向几何引导；3) 利用同一势场提供方向覆盖线索，对弱覆盖空间扇区中的高斯进行保守更新。
AI.result: 大量实验表明GSPotential在实现高重建保真度的同时保持了具有竞争力的训练效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模和监督利用视图空间的不均匀监督分布，GSPotential有效缓解了稀疏视角下3D高斯溅射的过拟合和几何伪影问题，为高斯原始控制提供了更精细的指导。

title: Improving Argument Saliency Coverage in Small LLMs for Long Legal Opinion Summarization via Sequence-Level Distillation
summary: We show that sequence-level distillation from a capable long-context teacher model is a simple, annotation-free, and data-efficient strategy for improving argument saliency coverage in long legal opinion summarization, where small LLMs often struggle to retain the most salient argumentative content. Across student model sizes, distillation consistently surpasses tuning on expert-written summaries in our legal-opinion setting. We further demonstrate that most gains are achieved with as few as ~10 training summaries, highlighting the strong data efficiency of teacher-generated supervision. Finally, we find that summary distillation is sufficient for improvements: reasoning-chain distillation remains competitive with summary-only distillation, but provides marginal benefit when combined with summary supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出从长上下文教师模型中通过序列级蒸馏来改进小型LLM在法律意见摘要中的论点显著性覆盖，该方法无需标注、数据高效，且少量样本即可带来显著提升。
AI.motivation: 小型LLM在长法律意见摘要任务中常常难以保留最具显著性的论证内容，影响摘要质量。
AI.method: 从具备长上下文能力的教师模型中提取摘要，采用序列级蒸馏策略，将教师生成的摘要作为学生模型的训练监督信号（而非专家人工撰写的摘要），并与推理链蒸馏进行了对比。
AI.result: 蒸馏策略在不同学生模型规模上均持续超越基于专家摘要的微调；约10条训练摘要即可获得大部分性能增益；摘要蒸馏与推理链蒸馏效果相当，组合时推理链仅带来边际提升。
AI.conclusion: 序列级摘要蒸馏是一种简单、免标注且数据高效的方法，能够有效提升小型LLM在法律意见摘要中的论点显著性覆盖，且摘要蒸馏本身已足够，无需额外依赖推理链蒸馏。

title: Sketch2Inspire: Structure-Sensitive Evaluation for Product Retrieval
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures. PRICAI 2026 version. The paper presents Sketch2Inspire, a structure-sensitive evaluation resource for multimodal product retrieval
summary: Early-stage product design retrieval often requires more than category recognition: designers may need reference examples that match both a short semantic intent and a rough structural cue. Existing product-image resources and generic image--text retrieval benchmarks rarely separate category retrieval from within-category structural fit. We present Sketch2Inspire, built from a curated subset of Amazon Berkeley Objects with aligned text queries, edge-based sketch-proxy queries, and fused text--sketch queries. The resource separates broad category-level retrieval from structure-sensitive within-category retrieval and includes a human-graded reference protocol for calibration. We evaluate a lightweight reference system based on pretrained CLIP-family encoders, comparing text-only retrieval, sketch-only retrieval, weighted late fusion, and text-first reranking without updating model weights. Under broad relevance, late fusion obtains the highest score (nDCG = 0.9962). Under automatic structure-sensitive relevance, late fusion again obtains the highest score (nDCG = 0.7015), exceeding text-only retrieval (nDCG = 0.5912). In the human-graded results, late fusion obtains the highest nDCG@10 (0.9133), while text-only retrieval ranks second (0.9030). These results show that the retrieval gain from multimodal input depends on how relevance is defined. Sketch2Inspire therefore provides a diagnostic resource for evaluating modality contribution and supports the development of structure-aware product-retrieval protocols with independent human annotation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sketch2Inspire，一个基于Amazon Berkeley Objects构建的多模态产品检索基准资源，包含文本查询、基于边缘的草图查询及融合查询。实验评估了多种CLIP家族的检索策略，发现晚期融合在多种相关性定义下均取得最佳性能（nDCG最高达0.9962），证明多模态输入的检索增益取决于相关性的定义方式。
AI.motivation: 早期产品设计检索不仅需要类别识别，还需要匹配语义意图和粗略结构线索。现有产品图像资源和通用图像-文本检索基准很少将类别检索与类别内结构匹配分开，缺乏能够诊断多模态输入对结构敏感检索贡献的资源。
AI.method: 从Amazon Berkeley Objects中构建细分数据集，设计文本、边缘草图代理、融合三种查询类型，区分宽泛类别检索与结构敏感类别内检索，并引入人工分级参考协议。评估基于预训练CLIP系列编码器的轻量级系统，比较纯文本检索、纯草图检索、加权晚期融合和文本优先重排序四种策略（不更新模型权重）。
AI.result: 在宽泛相关性下晚期融合nDCG=0.9962为最高；在自动结构敏感相关性下晚期融合nDCG=0.7015最高，超过纯文本检索的0.5912；人工分级结果中晚期融合nDCG@10=0.9133最高，纯文本检索以0.9030次之。
AI.conclusion: 多模态输入的检索增益取决于相关性定义方式。Sketch2Inspire作为诊断性资源，能够评估各模态的贡献，并支持带独立人工标注的结构感知产品检索协议开发。

title: Check The Scoreboard: An Analysis of Scoring Schemes on Multiple-Choice Evaluation
summary: Multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) benchmarks in NLP use number-right scoring (accuracy), but in educational testing, the scoring scheme, the combination of the response mode models follow and the rule for grading responses, is a key design choice that dictates which abilities to reward. We examine how alternatives to number right change what MCQA measures with six education-inspired schemes that assess abilities beyond accuracy: distractor elimination, abstention, confidence calibration, and self-correction. On LLM benchmarks, these schemes: 1) shift rankings of 31 LLMs beyond rephrased number right prompts; 2) better predict the LLMs users prefer in LLM Arena; and 3) reveal distinct model capabilities, like that GPT-5 rarely abstains and readily self-corrects, while weaker open-weight models often abstain and hesitate to eliminate choices. Given the benefits of alternative scoring schemes, we discuss ways to extend them to tasks beyond MCQA.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在多选题问答（MCQA）基准测试中，除传统的正确率评分外，六种源自教育测试的替代评分方案（如干扰项排除、弃权、置信度校准和自我修正）如何改变评估内容。实验表明，这些方案能显著改变31个LLM的排名，更好地预测用户在LLM Arena中的偏好，并揭示不同模型的独特能力特征。
AI.motivation: 当前MCQA基准普遍使用正确率（number-right）评分，但教育测试领域中评分方案是衡量能力的关键设计选择。仅依赖正确率可能无法全面反映模型能力，需要探索替代评分方案以更全面地评估LLM。
AI.method: 提出六种教育启发的评分方案，涵盖干扰项排除、弃权、置信度校准和自我修正等能力维度。在31个LLM基准上进行系统评估，将其与重新措辞的正确率提示进行对比，并利用LLM Arena用户偏好数据进行验证。
AI.result: 替代评分方案：1）对31个LLM的排名变化超过重新措辞的正确率提示；2）更好地预测用户在LLM Arena中的偏好；3）揭示不同模型的能力差异，如GPT-5很少弃权且易于自我修正，而较弱的开放权重模型往往弃权且犹豫排除选项。
AI.conclusion: 替代评分方案相比传统正确率能提供更丰富的模型能力评估，并讨论了将这些方案扩展到MCQA以外任务的可能性，暗示教育启发的评分设计对LLM评估领域具有普遍价值。

title: Think, Look, and Revise: Inconsistency-Aware Visual Self-Correction in MLLMs
summary: Tool-augmented multimodal reasoning integrates external tools (e.g., object detection, depth estimation) into multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to address perceptual bottlenecks in complex visual tasks. However, existing approaches rarely verify tool outputs, limiting their ability to detect and recover from tool failures. We propose ReVISE, a framework that equips MLLMs with verification and dynamic error recovery for tool-augmented reasoning. ReVISE introduces (1) a curated training dataset that supervises reflective behaviors, enabling models to validate tool-derived evidence, reformulate queries when visual mismatches arise, and fall back to intrinsic grounding when external tools are unreliable; and (2) a reinforcement learning based targeted rewards that encourage internal reflection and penalize spatial misalignment. Experiments on several benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing methods, highlighting the importance of error detection and correction in tool-augmented multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出了ReVISE框架，为多模态大模型（MLLMs）配备工具输出验证和动态错误恢复能力，通过训练数据监督反思行为和基于强化学习的目标奖励，显著提升了工具增强多模态推理的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的工具增强多模态推理方法很少验证工具输出，无法检测和恢复工具失败，导致在复杂视觉任务中面临感知瓶颈时可靠性不足。
AI.method: ReVISE包含两个核心组件：(1) 一个精心策划的训练数据集，监督反思行为，使模型能够验证工具证据、在视觉不匹配时重新表述查询、在外部工具不可靠时回退到内在接地；(2) 基于强化学习的目标奖励机制，鼓励内部反思并对空间错位进行惩罚。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上的实验表明，ReVISE相比现有方法取得了一致的性能提升，证明了在工具增强多模态推理中错误检测和纠正的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 对工具输出的验证和动态错误恢复是多模态推理中关键但常被忽视的环节，ReVISE有效解决了这一问题并展示了显著优势。

title: VibeJam: A User Study Platform for Web Development with Agents
summary: Programming with AI is increasingly agentic, users prompt LLMs to directly edit their code and review the changes, with adoption growing especially for web development tasks. Despite this growth, most NLP work uses offline evaluation and lacks support for online studies, losing insights into how programmers truly use coding agents. We release VibeJam, a browser-based user study platform for users to collaborate with AI agents to develop websites. VibeJam enables agent customization and uses the open-source Aider agent by default, and to mirror downstream use, we add diff review, chat and plan modes, and live website previews. In a pilot study with 55 released, game-based website creation tasks, five experienced AI programmers rate our system as fun, simple, and resembling commercial tools, while 13 junior students use VibeJam to make websites of higher quality than agents in the same task. We open-source VibeJam to spur extensions and support studies on how coding agents can help users.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了VibeJam，一个基于浏览器的用户研究平台，用于研究程序员如何与AI编程代理协作开发网站。平台支持代理定制、差异审查、聊天和计划模式以及实时网站预览。通过初步研究验证了平台的有效性。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI编程助手在网页开发中日益普及，但大多数NLP研究依赖离线评估，缺乏对在线用户研究的支持，无法深入了解程序员真实使用编码代理的方式。
AI.method: VibeJam平台默认使用开源Aider代理，支持代理定制，并添加了差异审查、聊天/计划模式和实时网站预览功能。通过55个游戏化网站创建任务的试点研究进行验证。
AI.result: 5位经验丰富的AI程序员认为系统有趣、简单且接近商业工具；13位初级学生使用VibeJam制作出比代理单独完成更高质量的网站。
AI.conclusion: VibeJam作为开源平台，可促进编码代理对用户帮助的扩展研究和探索。

title: FiLM-GPNet: Geometry-Aware Pseudo-Supervised Phase Restoration with Zero-Shot Generalization for Large Temporal InSAR Stacks
comment: Its IEEE Geoscience And Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS) 2026 Data Fusion Contest Winner Paper. reference https://www.grss-ieee.org/community/technical-committees/winners-of-the-2026-ieee-grss-data-fusion-contest-sar-temporal-storytelling/
summary: The growing availability of dense commercial Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) time series enables temporal Interferometric SAR (InSAR) analysis, but fixed classical filters fail under heterogeneous acquisition geometries, degrading phase quality and temporal consistency. We propose FiLM-GPNet, a geometry-conditioned network for wrapped-phase restoration that explicitly adapts to acquisition differences using Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) and a 7D per-pair geometry descriptor. The model is trained with pseudo-supervision from Goldstein-filtered interferograms and regularized by interferometric physics via triplet-closure consistency, while also estimating per-pixel aleatoric uncertainty. Experiments on three Capella Spotlight stacks from the IEEE GRSS 2026 Data Fusion Contest show that FiLM-GPNet reduces temporal residual by 68% (Hawaii) and 66% (Western Australia) relative to the Goldstein baseline, alongside closure error reductions of 10% and 13%, respectively. In Western Australia, it further improves unwrapping success rate by 7.7 percentage points and Digital Elevation Model (DEM) Normalized Median Absolute Deviation (NMAD) by 31%. The model also shows strong zero-shot generalization to a geographically and geometrically distinct third stack (Los Angeles) without retraining, supporting geometry-conditioned restoration as an effective alternative to fixed classical filtering across heterogeneous stacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FiLM-GPNet，一种基于几何条件（geometry-conditioned）的缠绕相位恢复网络，利用特征线性调制（FiLM）和7D几何描述符自适应处理异构SAR采集几何下的InSAR数据，在三个Capella Spotlight数据集上显著优于Goldstein基线。
AI.motivation: 随着密集商业SAR时间序列的普及，时序InSAR分析成为可能，但传统固定滤波器在异构采集几何下表现不佳，导致相位质量和时间一致性退化。因此需要一种能够显式适应采集差异的相位恢复方法。
AI.method: 提出FiLM-GPNet，通过Feature-wise Linear Modulation（FiLM）机制结合7D逐对几何描述符，使网络自适应于采集几何差异。训练采用Goldstein滤波干涉图的伪监督，并利用三重组闭一致性（triplet-closure consistency）进行干涉物理正则化，同时估计逐像素偶然不确定性。
AI.result: 在IEEE GRSS 2026数据融合竞赛的Capella Spotlight数据上，FiLM-GPNet在夏威夷和西澳大利亚数据集上分别将时间残差降低68%和66%（相对Goldstein基线），闭误差分别降低10%和13%；在西澳大利亚将解缠成功率提升7.7个百分点，DEM NMAD改善31%。此外，模型在洛杉矶数据集上展现了无需重训练的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: FiLM-GPNet验证了几何条件化相位恢复作为异构数据堆栈下固定经典滤波的有效替代方案，展示了良好的跨地域和跨几何泛化能力，为商业SAR时序InSAR分析提供了更稳健的解决方案。

title: En-ViMedNER: An English-Vietnamese Parallel Biomedical Corpus with UMLS Semantic Type Annotations
comment: To appear in Proceedings of EMNLP2026
summary: Biomedical Named Entity Recognition (NER) is fundamental to healthcare AI applications, including clinical decision support and medical information extraction. While corpora with Unified Medical Language System (UMLS) annotations, such as MedMentions, have driven progress in English biomedical NER, no comparable resource exists for Vietnamese. This paper presents En-ViMedNER, the first English-Vietnamese parallel biomedical NER corpus annotated with UMLS semantic types, which are language-neutral codes providing a shared cross-lingual label space and ensuring direct comparability with existing UMLS-based resources. The corpus contains 4,392 PubMed abstract pairs, 44,892 English-Vietnamese sentence pairs, and 202,949 aligned entity-mention pairs across 21 semantic types adapted from the MedMentions ST21pv dataset. To balance quality and scalability, we have constructed the corpus through automatic translation, expert post-editing, LLM-assisted label projection, and human verification and adjudication. We characterize En-ViMedNER as a large-scale silver-standard corpus with a human-audited and consensus-corrected mini-test subset. We evaluate En-ViMedNER in two settings: (i) Vietnamese-input/Vietnamese-output biomedical NER and (ii) English-input/Vietnamese-output cross-lingual NER. For Vietnamese NER, we benchmark Vietnamese-supervised encoder models, English-supervised multilingual encoder models, and prompt-based LLMs. The best model achieves an F1 score of 52.70 on the test set and 53.78 on the mini-test set. For cross-lingual NER, we benchmark encoder-decoder models and prompt-based LLMs. The best model achieves an F1 score of 45.44 on the mini-test set. We publicly release our corpus, corpus construction pipeline, and baseline models to facilitate future Vietnamese biomedical NLP research.

AI.tldr: 本文首次构建了英越平行生物医学命名实体识别（NER）语料库En-ViMedNER，包含4,392对PubMed摘要、44,892对句子和202,949个对齐实体提及对，跨越21个UMLS语义类型。通过自动翻译、专家后编辑、LLM辅助标签投影和人工验证构建。最佳越南语NER模型F1为52.70，跨语言NER模型F1为45.44。
AI.motivation: 虽然存在基于UMLS注释的英文生物医学NER语料库（如MedMentions），但越南语缺乏类似资源，阻碍了越南语生物医学NLP研究。本文旨在填补这一空白，构建首个英越平行生物医学NER语料库。
AI.method: 构建流程包括：自动翻译、专家后编辑、LLM辅助标签投影以及人工验证和仲裁。语料库标注采用UMLS语义类型，作为跨语言共享标签空间，确保与现有UMLS资源直接可比。评估设置包括（i）越南语输入/越南语输出NER和（ii）英语输入/越南语输出跨语言NER。
AI.result: 越南语NER任务中，最佳模型（越南语监督编码器模型、英语监督多语言编码器模型和基于提示的LLM中）在测试集上F1为52.70，在mini-test集上为53.78。跨语言NER任务中，最佳编码器-解码器模型和基于提示的LLM在mini-test集上F1为45.44。
AI.conclusion: En-ViMedNER作为大型银标准语料库，配备人工审核并共识纠正的mini-test子集，为越南语生物医学NER研究提供了基础资源。作者公开了语料库、构建流水线和基准模型，以促进未来越南语生物医学NLP研究。

title: GATE: Reliability-Gated Gaussian Evidence Fusion for Training-Free Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted to the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026)
summary: Vision-language models such as CLIP and SigLIP provide strong zero-shot recognition, but their predictions can degrade when deployed on target data that differ from the pretraining distribution. Test-time adaptation offers a practical way to improve robustness without source data or target labels, yet existing methods often rely on either prompt-side adaptation or image-side target evidence alone. In this work, we introduce GATE, a training-free two-pass transductive test-time adaptation framework that uses the unlabeled target set while keeping the image encoder, text encoder, and prompt parameters fully frozen. Instead of representing each class with a single prototype, GATE builds two complementary Gaussian sources of evidence in the shared vision-language feature space: a text Gaussian estimated from multiple language descriptions and an image Gaussian estimated from reliable unlabeled target samples. A class-wise reliability gate controls the influence of image-derived pseudo-evidence, and a score-level generalized Product-of-Experts fusion produces a normalized residual correction to the original zero-shot logits. Across fine-grained recognition datasets, ImageNet-family distribution shifts, multiple CLIP backbones, and SigLIP-B/16, GATE achieves the best average accuracy in every benchmark/backbone group. It improves zero-shot performance by an average of 5.41 points and outperforms the strongest non-GATE baseline by 1.94 points, demonstrating the benefit of reliability-gated distributional evidence for frozen VLM adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GATE，一种无需训练的两次遍历转导式测试时自适应框架，通过构建文本高斯和图像高斯两类互补证据源，并利用类级可靠性门控与广义Product-of-Experts融合，在完全冻结视觉语言模型参数的条件下提升零样本识别性能，平均提升5.41个点。
AI.motivation: CLIP和SigLIP等视觉语言模型在零样本识别上表现优异，但当目标数据与预训练分布存在差异时，预测性能会下降。现有的测试时自适应方法要么仅利用提示侧适应，要么仅依赖图像侧证据，未能同时利用两类互补信息，且部分方法需要训练或更新模型参数。
AI.method: GATE框架包含三大核心组件：(1) 文本高斯——从多个语言描述中估计类别的文本分布；(2) 图像高斯——从可靠的无标注目标样本中估计图像分布；(3) 类级可靠性门控——控制图像派生伪证据的影响程度；最终通过得分级广义Product-of-Experts融合，对原始零样本logits产生归一化残差校正。
AI.result: 在细粒度识别数据集、ImageNet系列分布偏移、多个CLIP骨干网络及SigLIP-B/16上，GATE在每个基准/骨干分组中均取得最佳平均精度。相比零样本基线平均提升5.41个点，相比最强的非GATE基线提升1.94个点。
AI.conclusion: GATE通过引入可靠性门控的分布证据，在完全冻结的视觉语言模型上进行测试时自适应是有效且实用的，证明了无需任何参数更新的转导式方法也能显著提升模型在分布偏移下的鲁棒性。

title: When History Is Multimodal: Rethinking Context Management for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon agents need a context manager to compress growing interaction histories into a bounded working context, via passive strategies or active strategies that decide how memory is accessed and reorganized. Meanwhile, prior optical-memory work mainly treats pixels as a dense codec for textualized histories, often presupposing that rendering context into optical memory incurs a significant performance drop relative to text, thus coupling this representation with SFT, self-distillation, or reinforcement learning to close this gap, leaving unresolved (i) how visual rendering performs as a context manager under a fair, controlled comparison, and (ii) whether this carrier offers a native advantage when history is inherently multimodal. In this paper, we formulate context management as a budget-constrained history transformation and introduce Visual Rendering (VR) as a representational context manager. Under a shared harness, policy model, trigger, and task domain, we evaluate VR on four text-centric and three multimodal benchmarks against four baselines (No Compression, Discard-All, Sliding Window, Summarization), finding visual memory is a natural carrier of native visual evidence. Building on this finding, we propose VERA (Visual Evidence-Retaining strategy for long-horizon Agents), a training-free context manager built on deterministic rendering with no exposed memory operations: on text-centric benchmarks it renders textual history as VR does, while on multimodal benchmarks it retains native visual observations instead of translating them into text. Across nearly all benchmarks, VERA cuts cumulative non-cache tokens by 31.5%-63.1% versus No Compression, matches existing managers on text-centric tasks, and achieves the highest accuracy among all baselines on multimodal tasks, supporting a modality-preserving view of long-horizon context management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VERA，一种基于视觉渲染的训练无关上下文管理器。通过系统对比发现视觉记忆是原生多模态证据的自然载体，VERA在保持与现有方法相当的文本任务性能的同时，大幅减少非缓存token（31.5%-63.1%），并在多模态任务上取得最佳准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有光学记忆工作通常假设视觉渲染相比文本存在性能下降，需借助SFT、自蒸馏或强化学习来弥补，且缺乏公平受控的对比实验来检验视觉渲染作为上下文管理器的效果，也未探究视觉载体在原生多模态历史中的优势。
AI.method: 将上下文管理形式化为预算受限的历史变换问题；提出VR（视觉渲染）作为表征性上下文管理器，在共享框架下与四个基线公平对比；基于发现提出VERA策略，在文本任务上渲染文本历史，在多模态任务上保留原生视觉观察而非转为文本，全程无需训练且不暴露显式记忆操作。
AI.result: 在四个文本中心化和三个多模态基准上，VERA相对No Compression削减31.5%-63.1%的累积非缓存token；文本任务上与现有管理器持平；多模态任务上取得所有基线中最高的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 视觉证据保留策略（VERA）支持"模态保持"的长时程上下文管理视角：视觉记忆不仅可行，而且在原生多模态历史中具有天然优势，无需额外训练即可实现高效且准确的上下文管理。

title: A Visual Question Answering Model to Automate Nondestructive Evaluation Image Analysis
summary: This study introduces a Visual Question Answering model designed specifically for nondestructive evaluation applications. VQA models allow inspectors to interactively query NDE images, asking targeted questions like, Is there a crack or Where is the defect located and receive precise answers from the model. Leveraging deep learning and natural language processing, the developed system integrates image feature extraction (via a ResNet-50 model) and language generation capabilities (via GPT-2) to provide accurate, informative feedback. By enabling direct question-and-answer interactions, this VQA model significantly improves inspection efficiency, reduces potential errors, and enhances usability in practical field scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个专为无损检测（NDE）应用设计的视觉问答（VQA）模型，该模型结合ResNet-50图像特征提取与GPT-2语言生成，使检验人员能够通过自然语言直接查询NDE图像（如"是否有裂纹"、"缺陷位于何处"），从而提高检测效率、减少错误并增强现场实用性。
AI.motivation: 传统无损检测依赖人工判读图像，效率低且易出错，缺乏交互式智能查询手段。作者希望通过VQA技术实现检测人员与NDE图像之间的直接问答交互，以提升检测效率和准确性。
AI.method: 该模型采用双模块架构：使用ResNet-50进行图像特征提取，使用GPT-2进行自然语言生成，两者结合实现图像内容理解与语言回答生成，支持用户对NDE图像提出针对性问题并获得精确回答。
AI.result: 该VQA系统通过直接问答交互方式，显著提升了检测效率，减少了潜在错误，并增强了在实际现场场景中的可用性。
AI.conclusion: VQA模型为无损检测领域提供了一种创新的交互式诊断工具，可有效支持检测人员更快速、更准确地分析NDE图像，具有实际工程应用价值。

title: REIGN: Refurbished Embeddings with Integrated Guidance Networks for Efficient Context-Length Scaling
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. URL: https://devrimcavusoglu.github.io/reign/
summary: Dense retrieval over long documents is expensive. Token-level encoders scale quadratically in sequence length, and most long-context embedding models reach 32K tokens only through architectural workarounds or by stretching billion-parameter LLMs. We propose REIGN (Refurbished Embeddings with Integrated Guidance Networks), a contrastively trained bi-encoder that operates on sequences of contextualised chunk embeddings from a frozen Guidance Network (GN) rather than on raw tokens. REIGN targets multi-chunk inputs, primarily for document-to-document retrieval; single-chunk inputs stay with the GN. Decoupling token-level processing from document-level reasoning, and caching the GN embeddings to disk, cuts per-document training cost by roughly four orders of magnitude relative to chunked Transformer fine-tuning. We also release a synthetic long-document retrieval benchmark for contrastive training and evaluation at long context lengths. Across an in-distribution Wikipedia benchmark, the LoCo out-of-distribution suite, and a real-world patent retrieval case study, REIGN matches dense long-context retrievers at smaller parameter budgets in each regime. A paired significance test puts it on par with models 1.6-4.3x larger on the patent task, and it stays within 0.65 nDCG@10 of a 20x-larger model on LoCo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REIGN模型，一种基于冻结引导网络（GN）的上下文块嵌入序列的对比训练双编码器，用于长文档检索。通过将token级处理与文档级推理解耦，并缓存GN嵌入到磁盘，训练成本降低了约4个数量级。在多个基准测试中，REIGN以更小的参数规模匹配甚至超越更大规模的密集长上下文检索器。
AI.motivation: 长文档的密集检索成本高昂——token级编码器在序列长度上呈二次方扩展，大多数长上下文嵌入模型需要架构上的变通或拉伸数十亿参数的LLM才能达到32K token。现有方法在效率和可扩展性上存在瓶颈。
AI.method: REIGN是一个对比训练的bi-encoder，它不直接处理原始token，而是操作来自冻结引导网络（GN）的上下文块嵌入序列。文档级推理与token级处理解耦，支持多块输入（主要用于文档到文档检索），单块输入则由GN处理。GN嵌入可缓存到磁盘，大幅降低训练成本。
AI.result: 在维基百科分布内基准、LoCo分布外测试套件和真实专利检索案例研究中，REIGN以更小的参数预算匹配了密集长上下文检索器的性能。在专利任务上，配对显著性检验表明其性能与1.6-4.3倍大的模型相当；在LoCo上，与20倍大的模型差距在0.65 nDCG@10以内。
AI.conclusion: REIGN通过将token级处理与文档级推理解耦，在显著降低训练成本的同时，以较小参数规模实现了与更大规模长上下文检索器相当的性能，为长文档密集检索提供了一种高效且可扩展的解决方案。同时发布了用于对比训练和评估的长文档检索合成基准。

title: Polis: 3D Self-Supervision at City Scale
summary: Reliable semantic representations derived from city-scale 3D models are increasingly important for urban analysis, infrastructure monitoring, autonomous systems, and heritage conservation. However, urban scenes of large spatial extent captured through aerial surveying differ substantially from the indoor, object-level, and self-driving LiDAR data used to pretrain most 3D self-supervised models. We introduce Polis, to our knowledge the first application of Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization (SIGReg) as an objective for a native point cloud encoder, and evaluate it through a frozen-feature benchmark spanning fourteen city- and building-scale corpora. Polis combines geometrically matched cosine invariance, SIGReg, and VICReg-style anti-collapse terms with a 12.8k-scene outdoor pretraining mixture and gravity-preserving spatial view sampling. Controlled ablations show that this objective outperforms student--teacher architecture alternatives, as well as Polis versions without anti-collapse terms, on the same representative outdoor corpus. On three pretraining-disjoint city datasets, Polis reaches $23.8\%$ mean mIoU versus $16.3\%$ for the next-best encoder under high-capacity frozen probing, and $17.3\%$ versus $16.1\%$ at a matched point and voxel budget. The same city-scale lead holds on datasets whose training sets were seen in pretraining. On localized terrestrial captures with fine-grained facade and streetscape labels, the ranking reverses. Our results show that distributionally-regularized joint embedding architectures can be successful on challenging city-scale 3D scenes, and that transfer improves when self-supervision is designed for the capture geometry and spatial context of this domain while also revealing the limits of this specialization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Polis，首次将Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization (SIGReg)应用于原生点云编码器的自监督学习目标。Polis结合几何匹配的余弦不变性、SIGReg和VICReg风格的反坍缩项，在12.8k场景的室外预训练混合数据和重力保持的空间视图采样下训练。在14个城市与建筑尺度数据集上的冻结特征基准测试中，Polis在城市数据集上达到23.8%的平均mIoU（次优方法仅16.3%），但在细粒度的地面采集数据上排名反转，揭示了领域特化自监督的局限。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D自监督模型大多在内室、物体级和自动驾驶LiDAR数据上预训练，与城市场景中通过航空测量获取的大范围3D模型存在显著领域差异。作者希望设计一种针对城市尺度3D场景的分布正则化自监督方法，以提升城市场景的语义表示质量。
AI.method: Polis采用联合嵌入架构，结合三个核心组件：(1)几何匹配的余弦不变性损失；(2)SIGReg（Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization）作为正则化目标；(3)VICReg风格的反坍缩项。预训练使用12.8k场景的室外数据混合，并采用重力保持的空间视图采样策略。
AI.result: 在三个预训练不相交的城市数据集上，Polis达到23.8%的平均mIoU，远超次优编码器的16.3%；在匹配点数和体素预算下为17.3%对16.1%。在城市尺度的数据集上均保持领先，但在地面采集的细粒度立面与街景标注数据上排名反转。消融实验表明该目标优于师生架构替代方案和无反坍缩项的版本。
AI.conclusion: 分布正则化的联合嵌入架构能够在具有挑战性的城市尺度3D场景中取得成功。当自监督设计针对该领域的采集几何和空间上下文时，迁移性能会提升，但也揭示了这种领域特化的局限——在对地面局部采集的细粒度数据上，其优势不再保持。

title: When Less is More: Understanding When Token Filtering Helps and Fails in AI-generated Text Detection
summary: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has made AI-generated text detection increasingly critical. Existing zero-shot detectors assume that more token-level evidence leads to more reliable detection. However, our empirical study challenges this consensus: fewer tokens sometimes work better, retaining only 40% can yield optimal performance, yet this benefit is not universal. Using the Entropy Gap Score (EGS), we introduce top-$k$ cumulative probability filtering as a diagnostic probe. Across three representative settings, filtering exhibits strikingly different behaviors. We analyze EGS via typical set theory and quantify its dynamics through entropy calibration and distribution analysis. We find that filtering helps for weak source LMs, where low-entropy tokens are harmful, but fails for strong source LMs, where they are not notably harmful. Our work provides the first systematic analysis showing that some tokens are not merely uninformative but systematically harmful due to entropy miscalibration, revealing a two-sided trade-off in token-level detection.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了"更多token证据带来更可靠检测"的共识，发现保留40%的token反而可能达到最优性能。通过熵差距分数（EGS）和top-k累积概率过滤，作者发现过滤对弱源语言模型有帮助，但对强源语言模型无效，揭示了低熵token因熵校准问题而系统性有害的现象。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本AI文本检测器假设token级别的证据越多，检测越可靠。但作者通过实证研究发现这一共识存在问题：更少的token有时效果更好，且这种好处并非普遍适用，因此需要系统分析token过滤在不同条件下的行为差异及其背后的原因。
AI.method: 使用熵差距分数（EGS）作为检测指标，引入top-k累积概率过滤作为诊断探针，在三种代表性设置下进行实验。通过典型集理论分析EGS，并通过熵校准和分布分析来量化过滤动态。
AI.result: 保留40%的token可以取得最优性能，但此优势并非普遍存在。过滤对弱源语言模型有效，因为低熵token是有害的；但对强源语言模型无效，因为低熵token并未造成显著危害。过滤在不同设置下表现出截然不同的行为。
AI.conclusion: 首次系统性地证明：某些token不仅是没有信息量的，而且由于熵校准问题会系统地损害检测性能，揭示了token级检测中存在的双向权衡。

title: Calibration and Comparative Analysis of Forward-Looking Sonar and 3D Sonar for Enhanced Underwater Object Recognition
summary: Sonars generate a significant amount of noise. With the advent of new technology capable of producing full 3D point clouds, the noise is amplified in sparse point clouds, making it challenging to recognize features for navigation, recognition, or reconstruction. To address this challenge, we propose using two different sonar modalities: one that produces a 2D intensity image and another that generates a 3D point cloud. By implementing auto-calibration, we can filter out noisy features between the modalities to enhance feature extraction. Experiments demonstrate that auto-calibration improves performance over manual calibration by 5% and that filtering enhances feature extraction by more than 40% relative to the raw point cloud. Code and datasets are given at https://theaprilab.org/fls-3d-calibrator

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用2D声呐强度图像与3D声呐点云两种模态，通过自动校准（auto-calibration）过滤噪声特征以增强特征提取，实验表明自动校准相比手动校准提升5%性能，过滤后特征提取相比原始点云提升超过40%。
AI.motivation: 声呐产生大量噪声，尤其在生成完整3D点云的新技术下，稀疏点云中的噪声被放大，使得导航、识别或重建任务中的特征识别变得困难。
AI.method: 采用两种声呐模态：一种产生2D强度图像，另一种生成3D点云；通过实施自动校准在两种模态之间过滤噪声特征，从而增强特征提取。
AI.result: 实验证明自动校准相比手动校准性能提升5%，过滤操作使特征提取相对原始点云提升超过40%。
AI.conclusion: 自动校准与跨模态过滤能有效提升声呐点云的特征提取质量，代码与数据集已公开。

title: IndicDetect: Evaluating Cross-Lingual LLM-Generated Text Detection for Hindi, Telugu, and Tamil
summary: The rapid proliferation of LLMs has further heightened the need to develop dependable AI-generated text detection, especially beyond English. Nevertheless, current benchmarks pay little attention to Indic languages and test detectors in idealized settings that do not represent the real world. We present a generalized benchmark for AI-generated text detection in Hindi, Telugu, and Tamil, which we call IndicDetect, designed to assess the robustness of detectors under realistic distribution shifts. IndicDetect comprises highly curated human-written texts matched with LLM-generated counterparts across various domains and generators, and systematically evaluates detectors in the presence of domain shift, generator shift, and adversarial perturbation. Using a single and repeatable evaluation scheme, we evaluate a wide range of statistical and neural detectors. We find substantial robustness failures: supervised neural detectors perform well in-distribution, while training-free methods degrade considerably under unseen generators and adversarial attacks. The severity of these failures varies across languages, with Hindi exhibiting the largest overall degradation under adversarial perturbations. These results highlight that the primary weakness of existing detectors in Indic settings lies in their robustness, not in their peak accuracy. IndicDetect provides standard data splits, an evaluation protocol, and baselines to establish a robust, language-aware foundation for AI-generated text detection in Indic scripts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了IndicDetect基准，用于评估印地语、泰卢固语和泰米尔语中AI生成文本检测器的鲁棒性，涵盖领域迁移、生成器迁移和对抗扰动三种现实分布偏移场景。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成文本检测基准主要关注英语，对印度语言关注不足，且测试环境过于理想化，不能反映真实世界的分布偏移情况。
AI.method: 构建包含多领域、多生成器的人类书面文本与LLM生成文本配对数据集，系统评估统计和神经检测器在领域迁移、生成器迁移和对抗扰动下的表现，并提供标准数据划分、评估协议和基线。
AI.result: 有监督神经检测器在分布内表现良好，但无训练方法在未见生成器和对抗攻击下显著退化；鲁棒性失败程度因语言而异，印地语在对抗扰动下退化最大。现有检测器的主要弱点在于鲁棒性而非峰值准确率。
AI.conclusion: IndicDetect为印度文字的AI生成文本检测建立了语言感知的鲁棒评估基础，揭示了现有检测器在印度语言环境中的关键短板是鲁棒性不足。

title: Text-Guided Diffusion-Based Adversarial Attacks on Chest X-Ray Images
summary: As artificial intelligence is increasingly integrated into chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation, triage, and clinical decision support, understanding its vulnerability to adversarial manipulation is critical for safe deployment. Existing robustness evaluations, however, predominantly rely on pixel-space attacks that introduce numerically constrained perturbations but may not represent plausible radiographic variation. This limitation is particularly important in multi-disease CXR classification, where models simultaneously evaluate multiple overlapping pathologies and adversarial failures may alter several diagnostic predictions. We propose a text-guided diffusion-based adversarial framework that optimizes learnable text conditioning while keeping the diffusion generator and target classifier frozen, enabling adversarial generation through a learned image prior rather than direct pixel manipulation. We evaluate the framework across multiple classifier architectures in both binary atelectasis and multi-disease CXR classification and compare it with FGSM, PGD, and Carlini-Wagner attacks. Our approach consistently produced the greatest degradation in classifier performance, reducing AUROC to 0.3885-0.5646 in binary classification and 0.4441-0.4878 in the multi-disease setting, while achieving superior image fidelity (SSIM 0.9080, LPIPS 0.1670, FID 51.23). Importantly, clinician interpretation remained unchanged for 95.9% of binary and 73.8% of multi-disease adversarial images despite substantial changes in model predictions. These findings reveal a clinically important discrepancy between human and machine interpretation and demonstrate the need to extend medical AI robustness evaluation beyond conventional pixel-space attacks toward generative threat models that can expose failures under visually and clinically plausible image variations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于文本引导扩散模型的对抗性攻击框架，用于胸部X光多疾病分类的鲁棒性评估。与传统像素空间攻击不同，该方法通过优化可学习的文本条件生成对抗样本，在保持图像高度真实性的同时（SSIM 0.9080），显著降低各分类器性能（AUROC降至0.3885-0.5646），且大部分（95.9%二分类、73.8%多疾病）对抗图像在临床医生眼中与原始图像无异，揭示人类与机器解读之间存在关键差异。
AI.motivation: 现有CXR鲁棒性评估主要依赖像素空间攻击（如FGSM、PGD、CW），其数值扰动模式不代表真实的影像学变异，尤其在多疾病分类场景中，像素扰动可能无法反映实际临床中病理重叠和影像学变化的情况。需要探索更具临床合理性的生成式威胁模型。
AI.method: 提出文本引导的扩散模型对抗框架：冻结扩散生成器和目标分类器参数，仅优化可学习的文本嵌入条件，利用学习的图像先验而非直接像素操作来生成对抗性CXR图像。在二分类（肺不张）和多疾病分类任务中，对多个分类器架构进行评估，并与FGSM、PGD和CW攻击进行对比。
AI.result: 该框架在所有评估场景中产生最大的分类器性能下降：二分类AUROC降至0.3885-0.5646，多疾病设置降至0.4441-0.4878。图像保真度优于其他攻击方法（SSIM 0.9080, LPIPS 0.1670, FID 51.23）。临床解读在95.9%（二分类）和73.8%（多疾病）的对抗图像上保持不变，尽管模型预测发生显著变化。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了人类放射科医师与机器学习模型在对看似相同图像解读上的关键差异，表明医学AI鲁棒性评估需要超越传统像素攻击，向基于生成模型的威胁建模延伸，以暴露在视觉和临床上合理的图像变异下可能发生的AI失败模式。

title: Sleight of Word Benchmark: Can Language Models Notice If Their Own Output Was Tampered With?
summary: The output of a Language Model can be tampered with \emph{while} the model is writing it. A simple test can thus be constructed by evaluating the model's perception of this external perturbation. In this spirit, a simple benchmark is built in which a single word is consistently substituted with another in the generation process. We call this method \emph{Sleight of Word}. Two distinct axes are measured: metrics that relate to the model's surprise, as well as an evaluation of the textual reaction for 19 different open-weight language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Sleight of Word"基准测试方法，通过在语言模型生成文本过程中持续将某个词替换为另一个词，来评估模型对外部扰动的感知能力。该方法从模型惊讶度指标和文本反应两个维度评估了19个开源权重语言模型。
AI.motivation: 语言模型的输出可能在生成过程中被篡改，现有研究缺乏对这一问题的系统性评估。作者希望通过构造一个简单的测试来检测模型是否能够感知到生成过程中的外部扰动，从而更好地理解模型的鲁棒性和自我感知能力。
AI.method: 提出Sleight of Word方法：在模型生成过程中，将一个词一致性地替换为另一个词。构建简单基准测试，从两个维度进行评估：（1）与模型惊讶度相关的指标；（2）对19个不同开源权重语言模型的文本反应进行定性评估。
AI.result: 对19个开源权重语言模型进行了系统评估，从惊讶度指标和文本反应两个维度分析了模型对单词语义替换扰动的感知和反应情况。
AI.conclusion: 通过Sleight of Word基准，可以评估语言模型在生成过程中感知外部篡改的能力，为理解模型鲁棒性和开发更可靠的语言模型提供基准。

title: Co-Evolutionary Prompt Optimization with Cross-Category Transfer for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
comment: 25 pages, 25 figures. Camera-ready version. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD) has gained significant attention for its practical value in industrial inspection. Recently, CLIP-based approaches have been widely adopted in ZSAD due to their strong vision-language generalization capabilities. However, existing methods commonly employ continuous prompt embeddings for prompt optimization and encode semantics in latent vectors, which lack interpretability and scalability. To this end, we propose CoEvoAD, a co-evolutionary framework for discrete prompt selection. CoEvoAD performs prompt search in the discrete natural-language space using an evolutionary algorithm. Candidate prompts are iteratively generated, evaluated, and selected throughout population evolution, thus preserving the interpretability and composability of natural language. Furthermore, we introduce a Cross-Category Transfer Objective (CCTO), which treats held-out source categories as proxies for unseen categories and scores prompt rules based on their estimated cross-category transferability, effectively improving cross-category generalization. Extensive experiments are conducted to validate the effectiveness of CoEvoAD, and the results show that it achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple anomaly detection datasets. The code is available at https://github.com/rstao-bjtu/CoEvoAD.

AI.tldr: 提出CoEvoAD框架，利用进化算法在离散自然语言空间中搜索提示词用于零样本异常检测，并引入跨类别迁移目标（CCTO）提升跨类别泛化能力，在多个数据集上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有CLIP-based零样本异常检测方法通常使用连续提示嵌入进行优化，将语义编码在潜在向量中，缺乏可解释性和可扩展性。
AI.method: 采用共进化框架，通过进化算法在离散自然语言空间中进行提示搜索，迭代生成、评估和选择候选提示；同时引入跨类别迁移目标（CCTO），利用持有源类别作为未见类别的代理，根据估计的跨类别可迁移性对提示规则进行评分。
AI.result: 在多个异常检测数据集上达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: CoEvoAD通过离散自然语言空间的进化搜索保住了提示的可解释性和可组合性，并通过CCTO有效提升了跨类别泛化能力，验证了进化方法在零样本异常检测中的有效性。

title: Token Counts Are Not Model Lineage: A Frozen-Threshold Holdout Study of Black-Box LLM API Fingerprinting
summary: Black-box model attribution is increasingly relevant when large language models (LLMs) are served through relay and reseller APIs. A tempting low-cost signal is the prompt-token count returned by an OpenAI-compatible endpoint: two models that share a tokenizer and chat template may produce the same count sequence up to a fixed offset. Yet the validity of this signal for broader \emph{model-family} attribution has received little direct holdout testing. We conduct a frozen-threshold study over 24 labeled endpoint pairs, split evenly into a development set and an untouched holdout set, with three temporal repeats and 30 controlled texts per pair. We introduce a validity-gated result contract that distinguishes an observed dissimilarity from an uninformative measurement caused by missing usage data, rate limits, or endpoint policy. The resulting shift-invariant exact-match score perfectly separates the 12 development pairs, yielding a frozen threshold of 0.725. On holdout, however, only 6 of 12 pairs are eligible under the pre-specified three-repeat rule. Among eligible pairs, balanced accuracy is 0.75, sensitivity is 0.50 (95\% Wilson interval 0.15--0.85), and specificity is 1.00 (0.342--1.00). Two same-family pairs---Qwen 3.8 and DeepSeek V4 variants---fall below the frozen threshold. Across 4,320 formal API calls, every log is replayable, while holdout contains 189 non-200 responses and 157 successful responses without prompt-token usage. The study therefore validates token-count consistency as a fingerprint of a shared \emph{tokenization stack}, but rejects its use as a standalone necessary test for model-family lineage.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于提示词token计数的黑盒模型归属判定方法。通过24组端点对、冻结阈值0.725的严格实验设计，发现该方法能完美区分开发集的12组端点，但在12组保留验证中仅6组符合评估条件，平衡准确率仅0.75，且Qwen和DeepSeek的同族变体无法被正确识别。结论是token计数一致性只能作为共享tokenization栈的指纹，不能作为模型族归属的独立必要条件。
AI.motivation: LLMs通过中转API服务时，黑盒模型归属判定日益重要。OpenAI兼容端点返回的提示词token计数是一个低成本信号，但该信号能否用于更广泛的"模型族"归属判定缺乏直接的留出测试验证。
AI.method: 在24组标注端点对上开展冻结阈值研究，均分为开发集和未触碰的保留集；每组三个时间重复、30个受控文本；引入"有效性门控"结果契约，区分真实不相似与因缺失usage数据、限流或端点策略导致的无信息测量；采用平移不变的精确匹配分数。
AI.result: 开发集12对完全分离，冻结阈值0.725。保留集中仅6对符合预定义的重复规则，平衡准确率0.75、灵敏度0.50、特异度1.00。两组同族对（Qwen和DeepSeek变体）低于冻结阈值。4320次API调用均可回放，保留集含189个非200响应和157个无token计数的成功响应。
AI.conclusion: token计数一致性可作为共享tokenization栈的指纹，但拒绝将其作为模型族谱系的独立充分必要测试。该方法在真实API环境中受限于usage数据缺失和端点策略等因素，实际判定能力有限。

title: Seeing Through Extreme Visual Sparsity: Surface Understanding from a Single Random Visual Patch
summary: Surface material recognition from incomplete visual observations remains a challenging problem in robotic perception and environmental understanding. This paper discusses Sparse Surface Understanding Framework (SSUF), a unified dual-task learning framework that adapts four pretrained architectures-Convolutional Autoencoder (ConvAE), Vision Transformer (ViT), Swin Transformer, and Masked Autoencoder (MAE) for si-multaneous surface reconstruction and material classification. Experiments were conducted on the Touch-and-Go dataset using a sparse observation protocol in which only 10% of the original image remained visible while the remaining regions were masked. To enable a fair comparison, reconstruction-oriented models were extended with classification heads, whereas classification- oriented models were augmented with reconstruction decoders. The resulting architectures were assessed using reconstruction quality, classification performance, model complexity, and in-ference efficiency metrics. Experimental results revealed distinct strengths across the models. Swin Transformer achieved the best classification performance with an accuracy of 89.21%, an F1-score of 0.8922, and a ROC-AUC of 0.9813. In contrast, MAE produced the highest reconstruction scores among evaluated models, with a PSNR of 16.06 dB and an SSIM of 0.4501, while ViT provided the best overall balance between reconstruction and classification performance. Furthermore, all models achieved real-time inference, requiring less than 5 ms per image. Over-all, the results show that pretrained architectures can support material recognition under severe visual sparsity, while accurate image reconstruction remains challenging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了稀疏表面理解框架（SSUF），一个统一的双任务学习框架，将四种预训练架构（ConvAE、ViT、Swin Transformer和MAE）适配到表面重建和材料分类任务中。在Touch-and-Go数据集上仅使用10%可见像素的稀疏观测协议下进行实验，结果显示Swin Transformer在分类上表现最佳（准确率89.21%），MAE在重建上表现最佳（PSNR 16.06 dB），ViT在两者之间取得最佳平衡，所有模型均实现实时推理。
AI.motivation: 在不完整的视觉观测条件下进行表面材料识别是机器人感知和环境理解中的一个挑战性问题，现有研究缺乏针对稀疏视觉输入的统一双任务学习框架。
AI.method: 提出SSUF统一双任务学习框架，适配四种预训练架构（ConvAE、ViT、Swin Transformer和MAE），同时进行表面重建和材料分类。采用稀疏观测协议仅保留10%可见像素，并为重建导向模型扩展分类头、为分类导向模型增加重建解码器以实现公平对比。
AI.result: Swin Transformer在分类任务中表现最佳（准确率89.21%、F1值0.8922、ROC-AUC 0.9813）；MAE重建质量最高（PSNR 16.06 dB、SSIM 0.4501）；ViT在重建与分类之间达到最佳平衡；所有模型推理时间均小于5毫秒/图，实现实时推理。
AI.conclusion: 预训练架构能够在严重视觉稀疏条件下支持材料识别，但精确的图像重建仍然具有挑战性，不同架构在重建和分类任务上表现出互补的优势。

title: Compression-Aware Abstention: Teaching LLMs to Refuse When KV-Compression Masks Remove Answer Evidence
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to the GroundLM workshop at EMNLP 2026. Code, adapters, and datasets: https://github.com/mali-kh/compression-aware-abstention
summary: KV-cache compression reduces LLM inference memory by evicting context tokens, but when the evicted tokens contain answer-bearing evidence, the model may hallucinate instead of recognizing that the compressed context is insufficient. We address this failure from a behavioral perspective: to our knowledge, this is the first work to formulate compression-aware abstention as a learning problem, in which a model learns to answer when supporting evidence survives compression and abstain when it does not. We construct supervision from compressor survival masks and tight answer-bearing spans, labeling examples as Confident when evidence survives and Abstain when it is removed. A 10.1M-parameter LoRA adapter trained on ~2.6K MuSiQue 2-hop QA examples reduces base-model hallucinations by 97% under prompt-style truncation while preserving correct answering on evidence-retaining examples. Unlike prompt-only abstention baselines, which over-abstain on many answerable high-retention examples, the trained adapter learns a conditional policy. We also evaluate the method under actual compressed-cache decoding, where multi-compressor training yields a 6-22x relative lift over the unaided base on evidence-retaining examples. Controlled-deletion experiments show that the learned behavior is driven by evidence content rather than input length alone.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将"压缩感知式弃答"（compression-aware abstention）形式化为学习问题：训练模型在压缩保留支持证据时作答、在证据被清除时弃答，通过压缩器生存掩码和答案承载跨度构建监督信号，10.1M参数的LoRA适配器将幻觉降低97%。
AI.motivation: KV缓存压缩通过驱逐上下文token来减少推理内存，但当被驱逐的token包含答案支撑证据时，模型会产生幻觉而非识别到压缩后的上下文信息不足。现有方法缺乏让模型感知压缩损失并主动选择弃答的机制。
AI.method: 1）将压缩感知弃答形式化为学习问题；2）利用压缩器生存掩码与紧密答案承载跨度构建监督标签（证据存活→Confident，证据被移除→Abstain）；3）在~2.6K MuSiQue 2-hop QA样本上训练10.1M参数的LoRA适配器；4）在多种压缩场景（提示截断、实际压缩缓存解码、多压缩器训练）下评估。
AI.result: 1）在提示式截断下，基础模型幻觉减少97%，且保持证据保留样本的正确作答；2）相比仅提示式弃答基线，适配器学习到条件策略而不会过度弃答；3）在实际压缩缓存解码下，多压缩器训练在证据保留样本上相对未辅助基础模型获得6-22倍提升；4）受控删除实验证明学习行为由证据内容驱动而非输入长度。
AI.conclusion: 通过行为层面的学习训练，模型可以学会区分"证据存活可作答"与"证据丢失应弃答"两种情境，从而在压缩场景下有效抑制幻觉，同时避免过度弃答影响正常回答能力。

title: GeoAgent: Evaluating VLM Geolocalization Through Embodied Navigation
summary: Modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well above the human baseline in image geolocalization, a task critically important in disaster response, OSINT verification, and location privacy. However, most efforts to study AI behavior on the task remain limited to static image-based retrieval, classification, and predictions. We argue that faithful recreation of the task should involve embodied navigation, where a multimodal agent autonomously explores its surroundings to gather observations before submitting a prediction. To this end, we introduce \textbf{GeoAgent}, an agentic environment-based benchmark that requires agents to navigate Street View environments to refine their geolocalization through sequential reasoning. Our analysis shows that modern VLMs struggle to discern regional patterns while succeeding at country- and continent-level predictions. When compared to static image-based baselines, agentic navigation significantly improves accuracy across established metrics. We also note severe bias in a developed/developing region context across frontier model architectures and poor self-improvement capabilities given incorrect priors. Overall, our work establishes the challenges of embodied navigation and geospatial reasoning. We publicly release our code and the GeoAgent environment: https://geoagent-benchmark.github.io

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GeoAgent，一个基于代理环境的基准测试，要求多模态智能体在街景环境中自主导航以完成图像地理定位任务。研究发现现代VLM在国家和大陆级别预测表现良好，但在区域级别识别困难；与静态图像基线相比，代理式导航显著提高了准确性；同时揭示了模型在发达/发展中地区存在严重偏见，以及在错误先验下自我改进能力不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有图像地理定位研究局限于静态基于图像的检索、分类和预测，未能忠实还原真实任务中需要自主探索环境来收集观测信息的过程。作者主张该任务应包含具身导航，让多模态智能体自主探索周围环境后再做出预测。
AI.method: 构建GeoAgent基准环境，要求智能体在Street View环境中通过顺序推理自主导航来逐步优化地理定位预测，并与静态图像基线进行对比评估。
AI.result: 现代VLM难以辨别区域级模式但在国家和大陆级预测上表现良好；代理式导航相比静态图像基线显著提升了各指标下的准确率；发现前沿模型架构在发达/发展中国家语境下存在严重偏见，且在错误先验下自我改进能力较弱。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了具身导航和地理空间推理的挑战，为未来研究提供了基准和公开代码环境。

title: When Safety Speaks a Language: A Mechanistic Analysis of Safety-Language Identity Entanglement in LLMs
summary: Safety alignment of large language models (LLMs) degrades across languages, yet the internal mechanism driving this asymmetry remains poorly understood. Our work, therefore, presents a systematic mechanistic analysis of multilingual safety using sparse autoencoder (SAE) features, sparse interpretable directions in the residual stream associated with harmful and harmless model behavior across three instruction-tuned LLMs, eight languages, and all model layers. We observe that safety-relevant features are architecture-dependent in terms of where they are located and how they are distributed across layers. Additionally, they are geometrically entangled with language identity and exhibit cross-lingual sharing patterns, i.e., languages share safety features to varying degrees across model depths and architectures. This safety-language entanglement has direct consequences such that ablating safety features impacts not only harmful response rates but also target language, with the degree of intervention predicted by the relationship between safety and language features. Our findings qualify the language-universality of safety alignment as architecture-dependent and offer a mechanistic account of multilingual safety interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征，对三种指令微调LLM、八种语言和所有模型层进行多语言安全性的系统机制分析，发现安全相关特征具有架构依赖性、与语言身份几何纠缠且存在跨语言共享模式，并证明这种安全-语言纠缠直接影响安全干预的效果。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的安全对齐在不同语言间会退化，但导致这种不对称性的内部机制此前尚未被充分理解。作者旨在填补这一空白，从机制层面系统解释多语言安全差异的根源。
AI.method: 采用稀疏自编码器（SAE）提取残差流中的稀疏可解释方向，对三种指令微调LLM、八种语言和所有模型层进行系统性的机制分析，考察安全相关特征的位置、层间分布、与语言身份的几何关系及跨语言共享模式，并通过消融实验验证安全-语言纠缠的实际影响。
AI.result: 研究发现安全相关特征在位置和层间分布上具有架构依赖性；安全特征与语言身份在几何上相互纠缠，且语言间共享安全特征的程度随模型深度和架构而变化；消融安全特征不仅影响有害回应率，还会改变目标语言，且干预程度可由安全与语言特征之间的关系预测。
AI.conclusion: 安全对齐的语言普遍性是架构依赖的，本文为多语言安全干预提供了机制层面的解释框架，表明安全-语言纠缠是理解跨语言安全差异的关键机制。

title: ARMOR: Manifold-Oriented Training for Adversarially Robust Aerial Object Detection under Data Scarcity
summary: Aerial object detection is increasingly deployed in real-world applications, but models remain vulnerable to physical, universal adversarial patches that cause them to miss objects. Furthermore, defenders face the practical constraint of training data scarcity: aerial imagery is costly to collect and label, so a deployment site typically yields hundreds of images rather than the tens of thousands that adversarial robustness benchmarks assume. To tackle model vulnerability and training data scarcity, we propose Adversarial Robustness with Manifold-Oriented Training (ARMOR), a novel defense that realizes the core insights of on-manifold adversarial training (OMAT) in low-data regimes. ARMOR builds on the insight of OMAT to model the data manifold - the compact structure capturing the data's relevant features - to learn and robustify these features during training. While OMAT relies on the data-intensive operations of training large generative models and adversarial training to achieve this, ARMOR adopts a data-efficient approach that reuses labels the detection task already supplies: ARMOR (i) masks image backgrounds to retain object-relevant features, and (ii) injects randomized patches on objects to improve feature robustness. Our low-data experiments with physically-realizable adversarial patches evaluate both query-free transfer attacks and defense-aware attacks. ARMOR maintains strong clean performance of over 0.90 model confidence, while improving adversarial robustness by up to 0.32 in model confidence over state-of-the-art defenses. Physical experiments with printed patches confirm that these gains survive deployment. Overall, ARMOR translates insights from manifold-based training to defend object detectors amidst training data scarcity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ARMOR防御方法，将流形导向对抗训练(OMAT)的核心思想落地到低数据场景中，通过背景掩蔽和对象区域随机补丁注入来增强航拍目标检测器的对抗鲁棒性，在数据稀缺条件下显著提升模型鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 航拍目标检测模型易受物理通用对抗补丁攻击而漏检，同时防御方面临训练数据稀缺的实际约束（航拍图像采集标注成本高，部署场地通常仅有数百张图像），现有对抗鲁棒性基准假设的数万张训练数据在实际中不可得。
AI.method: ARMOR将OMAT的流形建模思想转化为数据高效实现：(i)掩蔽图像背景以保留对象相关特征；(ii)在对象区域注入随机补丁以提升特征鲁棒性。该方法复用检测任务已有的标签，避免训练大型生成模型和数据密集的对抗训练。
AI.result: 在低数据实验中，ARMOR在保持超过0.90模型置信度的强干净性能的同时，对抗鲁棒性相比最先进的防御方法最多提升0.32模型置信度。物理打印补丁实验确认这些鲁棒性提升在真实部署中依然有效。
AI.conclusion: ARMOR成功将基于流形的训练洞见转化为数据稀缺条件下可用的目标检测器防御方案，为低数据对抗鲁棒性研究提供了新路径。

title: XQDT: eXplainable and Quantitative Data-Text Alignment Metric with Feedback Signals
summary: Evaluating data-text alignment remains challenging: existing metrics often provide limited explanations for the scores, while prompt-based LLM-as-Judge methods can be expensive and unreliable. We present an end-to-end explainable evaluation metric that fine-tunes a language model to identify omitted, extra, incorrect, and correct data units in a data-text pair. These local judgements are aggregated into precision, recall, and F1 scores, providing both fine-grained diagnostic feedback and an interpretable measure of alignment quality. Across benchmarks, our fine-tuned models outperform LLM-as-Judge methods in error prediction and achieve competitive precision, recall, and F1 scores, while maintaining strong correlation with human judgements. Beyond evaluation, our verifier outputs also provide useful feedback signals for downstream correction and refinement, supporting alignment-oriented improvement of data-to-text and text-to-data. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/guihuzhang/xqdt.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种端到端可解释评估指标，通过微调语言模型识别数据-文本对中的遗漏、多余、错误和正确数据单元，聚合成精确率、召回率和F1分数，兼顾细粒度诊断反馈与可解释的对齐质量度量。
AI.motivation: 现有数据-文本对齐评估指标解释性有限，而基于提示的LLM-as-Judge方法成本高且不可靠。
AI.method: 微调语言模型，使其识别数据-文本对中的四类数据单元（遗漏、多余、错误、正确），将局部判断聚合成精确率、召回率和F1分数。
AI.result: 微调模型在错误预测上优于LLM-as-Judge方法，在精确率、召回率和F1分数上达到竞争性表现，且与人工判断保持强相关性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法不仅可作为有效评估指标，其输出还能为下游修正和细化提供反馈信号，支持数据到文本及文本到数据的对齐改进。

title: FuncRoom-Agent: Sequential Feed-Forward 3D Functional Indoor Scene Generation
summary: We introduce Function-Room Generation, a new indoor 3D scene generation setting that creates rooms supporting explicit functional goals rather than merely visually plausible layouts. Existing agentic and executable methods improve controllability, but often depend on costly test-time generate--evaluate--revise loops, making functional room generation slow and computationally expensive. We address this challenge with three technical contributions. First, we design a recursive domain-specific language to effectively organize the hierarchical object compositions required by functional rooms, from room structure and major furniture to dense support-surface and nested small objects. It represents rooms as staged executable programs with explicit geometric and functional relations. Second, we propose a sequential feed-forward scene construction framework that distills recursive construction traces into a scene construction expert. At inference time, the expert writes executable DSL code stage by stage, and a deterministic executor directly instantiates each stage without teacher agents, online critics, or iterative repair. Third, we introduce ScenePRM, an execution-grounded process reward framework that improves the expert through reinforcement learning with functional, geometric, relational, and future-constructability feedback. We further establish a function-oriented benchmark and show state-of-the-art performance on both general indoor scene generation and function-room generation, achieving stronger functional completeness, relation correctness, geometric executability, and generation efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出函数房间生成（Function-Room Generation）这一新设置，通过递归领域特定语言（DSL）将房间表示为可执行程序，结合前馈场景构建框架和基于执行接地过程奖励（ScenePRM）的强化学习，在不依赖耗时"生成-评估-修正"循环的前提下，实现高效且功能完整的室内3D场景生成。
AI.motivation: 现有室内3D场景生成方法多关注视觉合理性，虽有一些智能体/可执行方法提升可控性，但依赖昂贵的测试时"生成-评估-修正"循环，导致功能房间生成速度慢、计算开销大。
AI.method: 三项技术贡献：1）设计递归领域特定语言（DSL），将房间组织为从房间结构、主要家具到支撑面与嵌套小物体的分层组合，表示为带几何与功能关系的分阶段可执行程序；2）提出顺序前馈场景构建框架，将递归构建轨迹蒸馏为场景构建专家，推理时专家分阶段生成DSL代码并由确定性执行器直接实例化，无需教师智能体、在线评判或迭代修复；3）引入ScenePRM，一种执行接地的过程奖励框架，通过强化学习利用功能、几何、关系和未来可构建性反馈提升专家性能。
AI.result: 建立了面向功能的基准，在通用室内场景生成和功能房间生成任务上均达到最先进性能，功能完整性、关系正确性、几何可执行性和生成效率均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将房间生成转化为可执行的程序编写任务，并采用前馈预测与执行接地奖励机制，可以在保证功能性和几何正确性的同时大幅提升生成效率，为功能性室内场景生成提供了新范式。

title: How Prolific Sellers Self-Present: Dissecting the Communication Patterns of 1.6 Million Reverb Listings
summary: The current paper draws on self-presentation theory and warranting theory to evaluate how the language patterns in an online marketplace reflect seller status (i.e., a prolific seller versus an everyday seller). Using 1.6 million musical instrument listings from Reverb.com in search of content, style, and structural differences in seller product descriptions, the evidence suggested prolific sellers tend to focus more on objective and functional aspects of a product (e.g., its features and specifications) and less on subjective characteristics like tone, relative to everyday sellers. Prolific sellers also communicated in a more narrative-like style, which was driven by an elevated use of personal pronouns, and they used longer descriptions than everyday sellers. Therefore, what prolific sellers focus on tends to be quite technical, but how they communicate this information is typical of a story that is told to potential buyers. Implications for self-presentation theory and warranting theory are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文基于自我呈现理论与保证理论，分析了在线市场中卖家身份（高产卖家vs普通卖家）如何体现在产品描述的语言模式上。通过分析Reverb.com上160万条乐器列表，发现高产卖家更关注产品的客观功能方面（如特性与规格），较少使用主观特征（如音色）；同时，高产卖家采用更具叙事性的沟通风格（更多使用人称代词）且描述更长。
AI.motivation: 研究在线市场中卖家地位如何通过语言模式反映出来，探讨高产卖家和普通卖家在产品描述中的内容、风格和结构差异，以填补自我呈现理论在数字商务语境下的研究空白。
AI.method: 利用Reverb.com上160万条乐器销售列表的大规模数据，从内容（客观功能vs主观特征）、风格（叙事性、人称代词使用）和结构（描述长度）三个维度对卖家产品描述进行文本分析。
AI.result: 高产卖家更侧重于产品的客观功能方面（如特性、规格），较少提及主观特征（如音色）；沟通风格更具叙事性，表现为人称代词使用频率更高；描述长度明显长于普通卖家。
AI.conclusion: 高产卖家在内容上呈现技术化特征，但在表达方式上采用类似故事叙述的方式传递给潜在买家。研究为自我呈现理论和保证理论在在线市场中的应用提供了新的实证支持。

title: NepScript Genesis: Neural Architecture Search for Handwritten Devanagari Digit Synthesis
summary: This paper introduces NepScript Genesis, a Neural Architecture Search (NAS) framework for automated Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) discovery, applied to conditional Devanagari handwritten digit synthesis. We compare five NAS strategies against a carefully constructed Deep Convolutional GAN (DCGAN) baseline (FID=332.28). Architecture selection utilizes a two-stage pipeline guided by a novel domain-aware evaluation metric (Enhanced Score).
