Results demonstrate that Adaptive Exploration achieves the optimal quality-efficiency trade-off, attaining an FID of 79.12 -- a 76.19% improvement over the baseline -- and the highest mode coverage among the NAS strategies (Recall=0.531) in under one GPU-hour. Furthermore, we demonstrate that incorporating script-specific structural heuristics into the search phase prevents early-stage mode collapse. In a downstream low-resource evaluation, augmenting 250 real training samples per class with GAN-generated digits from the best NAS model improves CNN classification accuracy from 91.0% to 96.5% (+5.5 percentage points), demonstrating that NAS-optimized synthesis produces digits of sufficient quality to benefit practical recognition pipelines when real data is scarce.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NepScript Genesis框架，将神经架构搜索（NAS）应用于条件Devanagari手写数字的GAN自动发现。相比DCGAN基线（FID=332.28），最优的Adaptive Exploration策略在不到1个GPU小时内实现FID=79.12（提升76.19%），并达到最高模式覆盖度（Recall=0.531）。在下游低资源评测中，用NAS最优模型生成的数字扩充250张/类的训练数据，将CNN分类准确率从91.0%提升至96.5%。
AI.motivation: 手写数字合成中，Devanagari文字的结构复杂性与数据稀缺性给GAN架构设计带来挑战，而传统的人工设计耗时费力且难以获得最优架构。作者旨在通过自动化NAS框架减少人工干预，同时引入领域感知的评估指标和脚本特有的结构启发式，以提升合成质量与模式覆盖度。
AI.method: 采用两阶段NAS流水线：首先由五种NAS策略进行架构搜索，其次通过一种新型领域感知评估指标（Enhanced Score）进行架构选择。在搜索阶段，将Devanagari脚本特有的结构启发式准则嵌入其中，以防止早期阶段的模式坍缩。以精心构建的DCGAN作为基线进行对比评估。
AI.result: Adaptive Exploration策略在质量-效率权衡上表现最佳，FID从基线332.28降至79.12（改善76.19%），模式覆盖度最高（Recall=0.531），且耗时不足1个GPU小时。在下游任务中，用NAS最优模型生成的数据增强250张/类真实样本后，CNN准确率从91.0%提升至96.5%（+5.5个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: NAS优化的GAN合成能够生成质量足够高的Devanagari手写数字，在真实数据稀缺时有效提升实际识别管线的性能。脚本特有的结构启发式嵌入搜索阶段能有效防止早期模式坍缩，证明了自动化架构搜索在低资源场景下合成任务的巨大潜力。

title: Detecting Hidden Chain-of-Thought in Large Language Models with Linguistic, Behavioral, and Mechanistic Indicators
summary: Large language models often answer complex reasoning questions without revealing intermediate steps, raising whether they reason latently or complete patterns. We propose the Hidden CoT Detection Score (HCDS), a comparative behavioral and mechanistic signal measuring whether neutral-prompt behavior aligns more closely with explicit CoT or explicit no- CoT. Here, hidden CoT operationally denotes this neutral-prompt CoT-like alignment; HCDS does not directly observe or prove an unexposed reasoning trace. On GSM8K, HCDS is significantly positive for both Qwen3-4B variants (Thinking $+1.87$, $p = 1.2 \times 10^{-7}$; Instruct $+1.41$, $p = 1.9 \times 10^{-4}$), replicates across a different inference stack and quantization within $0.08$ ($+1.80$ and $+1.45$), and is not significantly positive in seven of eight length-adjusted calibration-control cells. The unadjusted score produces large positive scores on single-step arithmetic and numeric factual lookup. The variants also respond differently to no-CoT instructions: Instruct complies from the prompt alone, whereas Thinking continues reasoning and requires intervention. These findings show stronger, less prompt-conditional CoT-like behavior in the reasoning-tuned model, consistent with but not proof of latent reasoning. HCDS thus investigates latent reasoning without relying on models' self-reported traces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出隐藏思维链检测分数（HCDS），通过比较中性提示行为与显式CoT/无CoT行为的一致性来衡量模型是否进行隐藏推理。实验表明推理调优模型（Qwen3-4B Thinking）展现出更强的、更不依赖提示条件的CoT类行为，这与潜在推理一致但并非证明。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在回答复杂推理问题时常常不显示中间步骤，这使得研究者无法确定模型是在进行潜在推理还是仅仅模式匹配。现有的方法依赖模型自我报告，而这可能不可靠。研究者希望开发一种不需要依赖模型自我报告痕迹的检测方法来探究隐藏推理的存在。
AI.method: 提出了HCDS（隐藏CoT检测分数），这是一种比较性的行为和机制信号，测量中性提示行为与显式CoT行为或显式无CoT行为的对齐程度。在GSM8K数据集上对Qwen3-4B的两个变体（Thinking和Instruct）进行测试，并通过不同的推理栈和量化方式验证了可复制性，同时设置了长度调整的校准对照组。
AI.result: GSM8K上，Qwen3-4B两个变体的HCDS均显著为正（Thinking +1.87，p=1.2×10⁻⁷；Instruct +1.41，p=1.9×10⁻⁴），可复制性在0.08范围内。八个长度调整校准对照组中七组无显著正分数。未调整分数在单步算术和数字事实查询上产生大的正分数。两个变体对无CoT指令的反应不同：Instruct仅凭提示即遵从，而Thinking继续推理需要干预。
AI.conclusion: 推理调优模型表现出更强的、更不依赖提示条件的CoT类行为，这与潜在推理一致但并非确凿证据。HCDS提供了一种不依赖模型自我报告轨迹来研究隐藏推理的方法。

title: MotionSync: Non-Causal Refinement of Causal Tracker for Label-Efficient 3D Perception
summary: Three-dimensional box-and-track annotation is the cost bottleneck in autonomous-driving data engines, and the offline systems built to relieve it replace the online perception stack outright, so a team needing both regimes maintains and reconciles two. MotionSync makes the causal/non-causal boundary an explicit architectural seam instead. A strictly causal tracker, built on a strong published baseline and extended with innovation-driven uncertainty calibration, frame-rate-invariant kinematic association gates, and multi-hypothesis motion with learned mode selection, emits a valid online result. A non-causal pass then revises the buffered trajectories with Rauch--Tung--Striebel smoothing applied separately to pose, extent and yaw, physics-validated gap completion, and semantic pruning of ghost tracks against LiDAR point labels. The refiner never writes back, so one system serves both regimes and refinement's effect is a delta over an unaltered causal estimate. Used as an auto-labeller, a fixed 3D detector trained on 25% human labels plus MotionSync pseudo-labels reaches 96.9% of its full-supervision mean average precision (mAP) on Waymo, and at a 10% budget the non-causal pass accounts for +3.3 mAP/L2 over pseudo-labels from the same tracker's causal stage. Re-fitting the online tracker on its own refined output recovers 73% of the benefit of human supervision, while its causal output is worse supervision than no re-fitting at all. As a tracker MotionSync is at parity with the leading published offline entries on the headline metric and ahead of them on error composition, which is where a refinement pass can act at all: it reduces misses and fragmentations together, the signature of gap completion rather than of a tuned detector.

AI.tldr: MotionSync通过将因果/非因果边界作为显式架构接缝，实现了单一系统同时服务于在线追踪和离线标注两大场景。因果追踪器产生在线结果，非因果平滑器仅修订缓冲轨迹且不回写，使得精化效果表现为对未受干扰因果估计的增量。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶数据引擎中3D框和轨迹标注是成本瓶颈，现有离线系统完全替代在线感知栈，导致团队需同时维护和调和两套系统成本高昂。
AI.method: 基于强基线构建纯因果追踪器，扩展了创新驱动的置信度校准、帧率不变的运动学关联门控、多假设运动及学习模式选择；非因果通道采用Rauch-Tung-Striebel平滑分别作用于位姿、尺寸和偏航角，并结合物理验证的间隙填补与基于LiDAR点标签的语义幽灵轨迹修剪。
AI.result: 在Waymo上，25%人工标签+MotionSync伪标签训出的3D检测器达到全监督mAP的96.9%；10%预算下非因果通道比纯因果伪标签提升+3.3 mAP/L2；在线追踪器在其自身精化输出上重新拟合可恢复73%人工监督收益。作为追踪器与领先离线方案在主要指标持平，且在错误组成上领先，同时减少漏检和碎片化。
AI.conclusion: MotionSync证明一个系统可同时服务在线追踪与离线标注两个阶段，精化通道作为增量delta存在且不回写，既避免了双系统维护成本，又显著提升了伪标签质量，且其优势体现在间隙填补带来的错误结构改善上。

title: Generative vs. Encoder Models for Multilingual NER: A Comprehensive Empirical Study on Naamapadam
summary: Language is humanity's most consequential technology, yet for over a billion speakers across India's twenty-two constitutionally recognised languages, its digital layer remains structurally incomplete. Named Entity Recognition (NER), the foundational step in transforming raw text into machine-interpretable knowledge, has been studied exhaustively for English but remains largely unsolved across most Indic languages. This paper presents a rigorous comparative study of generative and encoder-based neural architectures for NER on all eleven languages of the Naamapadam benchmark. We evaluate five classic model families spanning sequence-to-sequence transformers and multilingual encoders; four decoder-only large language models (LLMs) fine-tuned with LoRA and 4-bit NF4 quantisation; and nine generative models in zero-to-5-shot inference. Under strict CoNLL span-level evaluation, encoder-based models (mBERT and XLM-R, both F1=0.675 on Hindi) substantially outperform every generative architecture in ten of eleven languages, with gaps of 7.5-40 percentage points against the strongest competitor (Gemma-2-2B: avg F1=0.427). The best few-shot result reaches only 28% of the encoder baseline. We identify three language clusters--encoder-dominant, partial-coverage, and failure-zone; and provide actionable deployment guidelines grounded in transfer learning and low-resource NLP principles.

AI.tldr: 本文对Naamapadam基准中全部11种印度语言进行了严格的NER对比研究，评估了五类经典编码器模型、四种LoRA微调的仅解码器LLM以及九种生成式模型的零样本到5样本推理。结果显示，编码器模型（mBERT和XLM-R）在11种语言中的10种上显著优于所有生成式架构，最大差距达40个百分点，最佳少样本结果仅为编码器基线的28%。论文还识别出三类语言集群并给出了部署建议。
AI.motivation: 印度拥有22种宪法认可语言，超过十亿使用者，但NER这一文本理解的基础任务在多数印度语言上尚未得到充分解决。现有研究主要集中在英语，生成式模型在低资源印度语言NER上的表现缺乏系统性验证，因此需要全面的比较研究。
AI.method: 在Naamapadam基准的全部11种印度语言上，对三类模型进行严格比较：(1)五类经典模型家族，涵盖序列到序列Transformer和多语言编码器；(2)四种仅解码器LLM，采用LoRA和4-bit NF4量化微调；(3)九种生成式模型的零样本到5样本推理。采用严格的CoNLL跨度级评估，并根据语言表现识别了三种语言集群。
AI.result: 编码器模型显著优于所有生成式架构：mBERT和XLM-R在印地语上均达F1=0.675，在11种语言中的10种上领先最强生成式竞争者Gemma-2-2B（平均F1=0.427）7.5至40个百分点。最佳少样本结果仅达到编码器基线的28%。
AI.conclusion: 在印度语言的NER任务中，基于编码器的多语言模型仍是更可靠的选择，生成式LLM在此场景下表现不佳。论文提供了基于迁移学习和低资源NLP原则的可操作部署指南，并按语言区分了编码器主导、部分覆盖和失败区三类集群。

title: TRINITY: A Multi-Perspective Benchmark for Personal-Style Video Highlight Detection
summary: Traditional video highlight detection relies on a narrow, event-centric definition of saliency, which often fails to generalize to unconstrained personal videos where highlights are heterogeneous and perspective-dependent. To address this, we introduce TRINITY, a multi-perspective benchmark that decomposes highlight saliency into three complementary dimensions, Event, Emotion, and Nature, within a unified temporal framework. Leveraging this multi-faceted view, we propose a shared-backbone multi-branch architecture designed for parallel multi-perspective prediction via view-specific experts. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving gains of +7.15/+3.62 mAP (rho=15%/50%) on Mr. HiSum and +10.82 mAP on YouTube Highlights. These results validate that multi-perspective modeling provides a more robust and comprehensive formulation of video saliency, especially for complex real-world scenarios. The benchmark and relevant codes will be released upon acceptance. The benchmark is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/vanilladucky/TRINITY and the code is available at https://github.com/vanilladucky/TRINITY.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRINITY基准，将视频高光检测的显著性分解为事件、情感和自然三个互补维度，并设计了一个共享主干多分支架构用于并行多视角预测，在多个数据集上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统的视频高光检测依赖于狭窄的、以事件为中心的显著性定义，难以泛化到无约束的个人视频，因为这些视频中的高光具有异质性和视角依赖性。
AI.method: 引入TRINITY多视角基准，将高光显著性分解为事件（Event）、情感（Emotion）和自然（Nature）三个互补维度，统一在时间框架内；并提出共享主干多分支架构，通过视角专属专家进行并行多视角预测。
AI.result: 在Mr. HiSum上取得+7.15/+3.62 mAP（rho=15%/50%）的提升，在YouTube Highlights上取得+10.82 mAP的提升，显著优于最先进基线的表现。
AI.conclusion: 多视角建模为视频显著性提供了更鲁棒和全面的表述，尤其是在复杂的真实世界场景中；基准和代码将公开发布以推动该方向研究。

title: DataFoundry: Evolving Data Preparators via Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Domain adaptation of large language models increasingly depends on constructing high-quality training data, yet existing data-preparation pipelines typically address quality only after generation through post-hoc filtering. This creates a fundamental mismatch: data-quality issues often originate from the construction process itself, while quality control is applied only to its outputs. We introduce \textsc{DataFoundry}, a framework for \textbf{evolving data preparators through recursive self-improvement} before large-scale data production. \textsc{DataFoundry} represents a data preparator as an evolvable runtime specification and instantiates its evolution with a \textsc{Skills-as-Modules} architecture, in which a central \textsc{Controller} orchestrates modular skills to compile executable runtimes, diagnose deficiencies on small pilot sets using domain-appropriate criteria, and translate diagnostic feedback into adapters that revise individual preparation components while preserving stable interfaces. We evaluate \textsc{DataFoundry} on DataPrep-Bench across mathematics, finance, law, and medicine, and find that recursively evolved preparators produce training data with higher downstream utility than baselines. Experiments across different backbones further demonstrate that these improvements are not tied to a particular model, while analyses and case studies further reveal the framework's optimization dynamics and illustrate how its evolution unfolds in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DataFoundry框架，通过递归自我改进来演化数据制备器，在生成大规模数据之前就解决数据质量问题，而非仅依赖事后的过滤。该框架采用Skills-as-Modules架构，由中央控制器编排模块化技能，在小规模试点集上诊断缺陷并生成适配器来修订制备组件，在数学、金融、法律和医学等领域均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有数据制备管线通常在生成之后通过事后过滤来解决质量问题，但数据质量问题往往源于构建过程本身，这种根本性错配导致质量控制无法触及问题源头。
AI.method: DataFoundry将数据制备器表示为可演化的运行时规范，采用Skills-as-Modules架构，由中央控制器（Controller）编排模块化技能以编译可执行运行时，在小规模试点集上使用领域适当的标准诊断缺陷，并将诊断反馈转化为适配器来修订各个制备组件，同时保持稳定接口。
AI.result: 在DataPrep-Bench上覆盖数学、金融、法律和医学领域，递归演化出的制备器生成的数据在下游效用上优于基线；跨不同骨干模型的实验表明改进不依赖特定模型；分析和案例研究揭示了框架的优化动态及实际演化过程。
AI.conclusion: DataFoundry通过将质量控制前置到数据制备过程的构建阶段，实现了数据制备器的递归自我改进，能够生成具有更高下游效用的训练数据，且具有良好的模型无关性和实际可操作性。

title: Guardrail-Agnostic Societal Bias Evaluation in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: We propose a societal bias evaluation method for large vision-language models (LVLMs) in the era of strong safety guardrails. Existing benchmarks rely on prompts that ask models to infer attributes of people in images (e.g., "Is this person a CEO or a secretary?"). However, we find that LVLMs with strong guardrails, such as GPT and Claude, often refuse these prompts, making evaluations unreliable. To address this, we change the prior evaluation paradigm by decoupling the task from the depicted person: instead of inferring person's attributes, we use prompts that do not ask about the person (e.g., "Write a fictional story about an imaginary person.") and attach the image as provisional user information to implicitly provide demographic cues, then compare outputs across user demographics. Instantiated across three tasks --- story generation, term explanation, and exam-style QA --- our method avoids refusals even in guardrailed LVLMs, enabling reliable bias measurement. Applying it to 20 recent LVLMs, both open-source and proprietary, we find that all models undesirably use user demographic information in person-irrelevant tasks; for instance, characters in stories are often portrayed as mechanic for male users and nurse for female users. Although still biased, proprietary models like GPT-5 show lower bias than open-source ones. We analyze potential factors behind this gap, discussing continuous model monitoring and improvement as a possible contributor for reducing bias.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对具有强大安全护栏的大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的社会偏见评估方法。传统基准通过直接询问人物属性来评估偏见，但强护栏模型往往拒绝回答，导致评估不可靠。作者通过解耦任务与图像中的人物，将图像作为隐式的人口统计学线索附加到不涉及人物的任务中（如故事生成、术语解释、考试问答），有效避免了拒答问题。对20个最新LVLMs的评估发现所有模型都会在人物无关任务中使用用户人口统计学信息，产生刻板印象（如男性用户对应机械师、女性用户对应护士），专有模型偏见低于开源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLMs偏见评估基准依赖直接询问人物属性的提示词，但具有强安全护栏的模型（如GPT、Claude）常常拒绝回答这些敏感提示，导致评估结果不可靠，亟需一种能够绕过拒答机制、同时保持评估有效性的新方法。
AI.method: 提出解耦式评估范式：将任务与图像中人物解耦，使用不涉及人物的提示词（如"写一个关于虚构人物的故事"），并附上图像作为临时用户信息以隐式传递人口统计学线索，然后比较不同用户人口统计信息下模型的输出差异。该方法在三个任务上实例化：故事生成、术语解释和考试式问答。
AI.result: 对20个近期的开源和专有LVLMs进行测试，所有模型都在人物无关任务中不理想地使用了用户人口统计学信息，产生了系统性刻板印象（如故事中男性用户配机械师、女性用户配护士）。专有模型（如GPT-5）虽然仍存在偏见，但明显低于开源模型。
AI.conclusion: 强安全护栏并非消除偏见，而是改变了偏见的呈现方式；专有模型偏见较低可能与其持续的模型监控和改进有关，这为降低LVLMs社会偏见提供了可行方向。

title: Evolutionary Soups: Evolving Mixture-of-Experts for Multi-Objective LLM Alignment
summary: Large language models are increasingly required to generate responses that satisfy multiple competing objectives. Since optimal trade-offs depend on both user preferences and input prompts, controllable multi-objective generation must dynamically adapt models at inference time without retraining. To address this, we propose Evolutionary Soups, a mixture-of-experts framework for fine-grained generation control, with gating networks trained via an evolutionary algorithm. The per-layer gating networks dynamically produce expert-merging coefficients from hidden-state representations, while the evolutionary algorithm incorporates greedy hypervolume contribution for effective evolution of these gating networks, achieving consistent improvements on large and noisy training datasets and broader coverage of the non-convex Pareto front. Experiments across three tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of Evolutionary Soups over baselines: it achieves the best hypervolume, linear utility, and Tchebyshev utility (~20% improvement) among controllable methods on all tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出进化汤（Evolutionary Soups），一种基于专家混合框架的多目标可控文本生成方法，通过进化算法训练门控网络在推理时动态调整专家合并系数，无需重新训练即可实现细粒度生成控制，在三个任务上取得了最优的超体积、线性效用和切比雪夫效用（约20%提升）。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型需要同时满足多个相互竞争的目标，而最优的权衡取决于用户偏好和输入提示词。现有的可控多目标生成方法难以在推理时动态适应不同需求，需要一种无需重训练即可进行细粒度控制的方法。
AI.method: 提出进化汤框架，采用专家混合（MoE）架构，通过进化算法训练逐层门控网络。门控网络从隐藏状态表示中动态生成专家合并系数，进化算法结合贪心超体积贡献来有效进化门控网络，实现在大规模噪声训练集上的一致改进以及对非凸Pareto前沿的更广泛覆盖。
AI.result: 在三个任务上的实验表明，进化汤在所有可控方法中取得了最佳的超体积、线性效用和切比雪夫效用（约20%的提升），优于各种基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 进化汤作为一种无需重训练的可控多目标生成框架，能够通过进化算法训练的门控网络动态调整模型参数融合方式，在多个任务上显著优于现有可控方法，有效拓展了非凸Pareto前沿的覆盖范围。

title: SnapBench: Benchmarking Snap-and-Ask Multimodal Retrieval for Mobile Interactions
comment: 37 pages. Yuanbao Technical Report. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Mobile AI acts as a visual oracle, empowering users to snap a picture of something and ask for information. Snap-and-ask retrieval is now one of the most common entry points for mobile AI, yet photos are often blurry, while text questions may be short or mistyped. Existing benchmarks only test on clean inputs or do not isolate paired robustness in snap-and-ask retrieval. Therefore, we introduce SnapBench, the first paired benchmark for robust snap-and-ask multimodal retrieval, spanning 1,145 queries, 9,085 gallery items under 53 controlled corruption conditions with human annotations. We evaluate 16 multimodal retrievers, covering dual-tower encoders and embedding-based VLMs. Results show that image corruptions substantially degrade retrieval, while text corruptions mainly affect text-only retrieval and have limited impact on joint retrieval. Clean image-only retrieval often outperforms joint retrieval, indicating the coarse-text drag and the lack of cross-modal fallback under noisy inputs. SnapBench provides a controlled testbed for evaluating robust retrieval in snap-and-ask scenarios. We further propose MOOR (Modality-anchored, Outlier-aware, Optimal Reweighting), a simple adaptive fusion approach, highlighting the need for reliability-aware modality calibration in snap-and-ask retrieval.

AI.tldr: SnapBench是首个面向移动端"拍照即问"场景的成对鲁棒多模态检索基准，包含1,145个查询、9,085个图库条目和53种受控损坏条件。实验发现图像损坏显著降低检索性能，而文本损坏影响有限；同时提出MOOR自适应融合方法以提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 移动端AI的"拍照即问"检索已成为最常见的入口，但真实场景中照片常模糊、文本常简短或拼写错误。现有基准仅测试干净输入或未能隔离成对鲁棒性，缺乏针对该场景的受控评估平台。
AI.method: 构建SnapBench成对鲁棒基准（1,145查询、9,085图库、53种损坏条件、人工标注），系统评估16种多模态检索器（涵盖双塔编码器和基于嵌入的VLM）。提出MOOR（Modality-anchored, Outlier-aware, Optimal Reweighting）自适应融合方法，通过模态锚定、异常值感知和最优重加权实现可靠性感知的模态校准。
AI.result: 图像损坏显著降低检索性能；文本损坏主要影响纯文本检索，对联合检索影响有限。干净图像单独检索往往优于联合检索，表明存在粗文本拖累问题以及噪声输入下缺乏跨模态回退机制。
AI.conclusion: SnapBench为"拍照即问"场景提供了受控的鲁棒检索测试平台，MOOR突出了可靠性感知模态校准的重要性，为该方向的研究提供了新的评估维度和改进思路。

title: Beyond Fluency: A Rubric-Based Benchmark for Evaluating Saudi Dialect and Cultural Competence in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed in Arabic-speaking markets, yet standard benchmarks overwhelmingly reward Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) fluency while leaving dialectal and culturally grounded competence unmeasured. This gap is consequential: everyday Arabic is largely dialectal, and dialect encodes social meaning that MSA-centric evaluation cannot capture. We present a rubric-based benchmark for the Saudi dialect, comprising 31 expert-authored prompts spanning idiomatic, pragmatic, lexical, and culturally-embedded phenomena, each paired with an expert-established ground truth. Our methodology separates evaluation into a model-agnostic phase, in which atomic, MECE positive criteria are derived solely from the ground truth, and a model-specific phase, in which four state-of-the-art systems -- Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.7, GPT-5.6, and Kimi K3 -- are scored against those criteria and penalised for errors they actively introduce. Across 124 model-prompt evaluations we catalogue 466 error instances under a nine-category taxonomy. The four systems cluster within a narrow macro-average band (42.7%-53.1%), with no model exceeding 55% and every model recording at least one negative-scoring prompt, confirming that Saudi dialectal competence remains broadly unsolved. Notably, Ambiguous Framing is the dominant failure mode (37.3% of errors) while outright Hallucination accounts for only 11.2%, indicating that models fail less by stating falsehoods than by distorting register and flattening pragmatic nuance. We further observe a consistency-versus-ceiling trade-off and model-distinctive error signatures. We release the full prompt set, ground truths, and scored rubrics to support reproducible dialectal evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于评分标准的沙特方言基准测试，包含31个专家编写的提示词和真值标注。对四个前沿模型（Claude Opus 5、Gemini 3.7、GPT-5.6、Kimi K3）的124次评估中，记录466个错误实例。所有模型宏平均分数仅42.7%-53.1%，且每个模型至少有一个负分提示词，表明沙特方言能力总体未解决。最突出的失败模式是"模糊框架"（37.3%），而幻觉仅占11.2%，说明模型主要问题在于扭曲语域和扁平化语用细微差别。
AI.motivation: 现有的阿拉伯语基准测试过度奖励现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）的流畅度，完全忽略了方言和文化嵌入能力。然而日常阿拉伯语主要使用方言，方言编码了MSA评估无法捕捉的社会意义。这种评估空白导致部署在阿拉伯语市场的大语言模型缺乏方言能力的可测量依据。
AI.method: 采用基于评分标准的基准方法：1）由31个专家编写的提示词覆盖习语、语用、词汇和文化嵌入现象，每个配专家确立的真值；2）评估分两阶段——模型无关阶段从真值中推导原子化、MECE的正面标准；模型特定阶段对四个模型按标准评分并惩罚其主动引入的错误。全部评估产生化分类中466个错误实例。
AI.result: 四个系统宏平均分数集中于42.7%-53.1%的狭窄区间，无模型超过55%，每个模型均有至少一个负分提示词。"模糊框架"为主导失败模式（37.3%错误），幻觉仅占11.2%。同时观察到一致性与上限之间的权衡，以及各模型独特的错误特征。
AI.conclusion: 沙特方言能力在所有测试的前沿模型中仍基本未被解决。模型失败并非源于编造事实，而是源于歪曲语域和削弱语用细微之处，这对方言评估和方言感知的模型开发具有重要意义。完整提示集、真值和评分标准已公开以支持可复现的方言评估。

title: nnMNet: Baseline for Martian Terrain Semantic Segmentation
summary: Semantic segmentation is a crucial task for understanding Mars, the most Earth-like planet in our solar system. However, it is challenging because the Martian surface is highly unstructured and complex, making accurate pixel-level prediction and fine-grained annotation difficult. Recent advancements in deep learning have introduced numerous methods and datasets to address these challenges. Nevertheless, the field lacks a robust, publicly available, and reproducible baseline, as well as a unified benchmark to facilitate fair evaluations. In this work, we present nnMNet, a new baseline model designed for Martian terrain semantic segmentation. Building upon nnWNet, we integrate linear attention to better capture global context and employ lightweight convolutions to reduce computational overhead. To bridge the gap between local and global representations, we introduce the Spatially-Aware Fusion Block (SAFB), which augments and combines features with diverse characteristics. Furthermore, we establish a new benchmark by curating and standardizing three high-quality datasets for thorough evaluation. nnMNet achieves new state-of-the-art 86.61%, 83.25%, and 88.24% mIoU on SynMars-TW, SynMars-Air, and MarsScapes, respectively. Our code, models, and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/dereklee0310/nnMNet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出nnMNet，一个用于火星地表语义分割的新基线模型，在三个标准化数据集上取得SOTA性能（86.61%、83.25%、88.24% mIoU），并公开代码、模型和数据集。
AI.motivation: 火星地表高度非结构化且复杂，现有深度学习方法虽多，但缺乏稳健、公开、可复现的基线和统一基准来促进公平评估。
AI.method: 在nnWNet基础上集成线性注意力以捕捉全局上下文，采用轻量卷积降低计算开销，并引入空间感知融合块（SAFB）来桥接局部与全局表示的差距；同时整理并标准化三个高质量数据集建立统一基准。
AI.result: nnMNet在SynMars-TW、SynMars-Air和MarsScapes上分别达到86.61%、83.25%和88.24%的mIoU，均刷新SOTA记录。
AI.conclusion: nnMNet作为新的火星地表语义分割基线，在统一基准下展现了优越性能，其公开的代码、模型和数据集为该领域提供了可复现和公平比较的基础。

title: Generating Clinical Vignettes that Preserve Cognitive Formulations
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/Amit-Oren/FORMA
summary: Large language models can generate fluent clinical case vignettes, but fluency alone does not ensure fidelity to a specifiable clinical structure. We introduce FORMA, a theory-grounded framework that compiles a cognitive model of a disorder into a directed weighted graph, samples a person-specific configuration of that graph, and validates whether the generated vignette preserves the specified components and causal links. We instantiate FORMA on Posttraumatic Stress Disorder using the Ehlers and Clark cognitive model, generating 16,500 vignettes across 500 personas, 11 generation models, and three ablation conditions. Evaluation combines an external edge-recovery probe, two clinical experts, a scaled LLM judge, and a clinician user study with 100 licensed practitioners. The cognitive graph is recoverable from full-condition vignettes (MCC = +0.41, AUC = 0.70) but not from zero-shot generation (MCC = +0.01, AUC = 0.50). Experts rate full vignettes substantially higher than zero-shot alternatives, and clinicians perceive them to be human-written 85% of the time, compared with 22% for zero-shot. FORMA also reduces demographic disparity in perceived quality by 1.5-7x. These results show that cognitive formulation can serve as an auditable specification for scalable synthetic clinical text generation. A repository with the data and code is available online: https://github.com/Amit-Oren/FORMA.

AI.tldr: FORMA是一个理论驱动的框架，将精神障碍的认知模型编译为有向加权图，借此生成临床病例小短文，并验证生成内容是否保留指定的组件和因果链接。在PTSD上实例化后，生成16,500个病例，经多方面评估证明认知公式化可作为可审计的规范，用于大规模合成临床文本生成。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型可以生成流畅的临床病例小短文，但流畅性并不等同于对可明确指定的临床结构的保真度。现有方法缺乏一个理论依据的框架，来确保生成内容的临床结构完整性和因果一致性。
AI.method: FORMA框架包含三个步骤：(1) 将障碍的认知模型编译为有向加权图；(2) 采样个体特定的图配置；(3) 验证生成的小短文是否保留指定组件和因果链接。在PTSD上使用Ehlers和Clark认知模型实例化，生成16,500个病例（500个人物画像×11个生成模型×3个消融条件）。评估综合了外部边恢复探针、两位临床专家、规模化LLM评委，以及100位持证从业者的临床医生用户研究。
AI.result: 全条件生成的病例中认知图可恢复（MCC=+0.41, AUC=0.70），而零样本生成不可恢复（MCC=+0.01, AUC=0.50）。专家对全条件病例的评分显著高于零样本替代方案，临床医生认为全条件病例是人工撰写的比例为85%（零样本仅为22%）。FORMA还将感知质量的群体差异降低了1.5-7倍。
AI.conclusion: 认知公式化（cognitive formulation）可以作为可审计的规范，用于可规模化合成的临床文本生成，在保证临床结构保真度的同时提升生成质量一致性，并减少不同人群间的质量差异。

title: See the Change, Keep the Flow: Unsupervised Action Segmentation via Spectral-Temporal Representation Learning
summary: Unsupervised action segmentation aims to discover latent action categories and their temporal organization without action annotations. Optimal transport-based methods provide structured frame-to-action assignments, however, their pseudo-label quality is fundamentally conditioned on the representation space used to construct the transport cost. We argue that reliable OT pseudo-labeling requires a representation geometry that is simultaneously sensitive to discriminative action changes and coherent along local temporal progressions. Based on this insight, we propose SpecT-OT, a spectral-temporal representation learning framework built upon an unbalanced optimal transport pseudo-labeling concept. SpecT-OT introduces a Spectral Reparameterization Projector (SRP), which parameterizes projector weights with fixed Fourier bases and learnable coefficients to improve the modeling of rapidly varying discriminative features, and Temporal Affinity Regularization (TAR), which imposes distance-aware, label-free constraints on pairwise frame affinities to stabilize local temporal structure. The two components jointly produce more discriminative and temporally stable transport costs, yielding more reliable pseudo-labels for iterative representation learning. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate strong performance compared with state-of-the-art methods. SpecT-OT achieves the best results on 13 of 15 metrics, including 4.1-point MoF and 7.4-point F1 gains over the baseline on Breakfast and Desktop Assembly, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpecT-OT，一种基于频谱-时间表示学习的无监督动作分割框架，通过频谱重参数化投影器和时间亲和正则化来改进最优传输伪标签的质量，在四个基准上取得13/15项指标最优。
AI.motivation: 最优传输（OT）方法在无监督动作分割中依赖表示空间构建传输成本，但现有表示空间难以同时兼顾判别性动作变化和对局部时间进展的连贯性，导致伪标签质量受限。
AI.method: 提出两个核心组件：(1) 频谱重参数化投影器（SRP），用固定傅里叶基和可学习系数参数化投影器权重，以增强快速变化的判别性特征的建模；(2) 时间亲和正则化（TAR），对成对帧亲和度施加距离感知、无标签约束，稳定局部时间结构。两者共同基于非平衡最优传输伪标签概念进行迭代表示学习。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上与SOTA方法对比，15项指标中13项取得最优；在Breakfast和Desktop Assembly上分别比基线提升4.1点MoF和7.4点F1。
AI.conclusion: 同时增强表示的判别性和时间连贯性可以显著提升OT伪标签质量，从而有效改善无监督动作分割性能。

title: Small Language Models as Judges for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning extends RL beyond tasks with exact answers or rule-based verifiers by scoring responses against instance-specific criteria. However, this makes reward computation expensive: training requires repeated rubric judging, often with proprietary APIs or local generative LLM judges with 7B parameters or more. We study whether smaller language models can serve as efficient and reliable rubric-based judges. To make this question measurable, we construct PointRubric and RaR-Science-Static, two pointwise rubric-based evaluation datasets with instance-specific criteria and itemwise satisfaction labels. We compare three ways of extracting criterion-level judgments from small models: Generative verdicts, Yes/No Logprob margins, and Probe judges. Across both datasets, the Qwen3-1.7B Probe judge achieves the strongest criterion-level agreement among these methods, outperforming Generative and Logprob judges. Used as a GRPO reward model, it trains a policy from 0.232 to 0.643 on RaR-Science rubric score, compared with 0.594 for an 8B Generative judge baseline, while the baseline requires 10.7$\times$ more reward-judge time. Task and domain transfer experiments further suggest that Probe judges preserve criterion-level reward structure across settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究小型语言模型能否作为基于评分标准（rubric）的强化学习奖励评判器。作者构建了PointRubric和RaR-Science-Static两个数据集，并对比了生成式判决、Yes/No对数概率边际和探针（Probe）三种从小型模型中提取标准级判断的方法。结果显示Qwen3-1.7B探针评判器在标准级一致性上表现最佳，作为GRPO奖励模型时训练效果优于8B生成式基线，且耗时减少10.7倍，并具有良好的任务和域迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 基于评分标准的强化学习（Rubric-based RL）扩展了RL的应用范围，但奖励计算成本高昂，通常依赖大型专有API或7B以上的本地生成模型进行评判。本文动机是探索小型语言模型是否能在保持可靠性的前提下，作为高效且低成本的rubric评判器，降低奖励计算的资源消耗。
AI.method: 作者构建了两个带实例特定评分标准和逐项满足标签的pointwise式rubric评估数据集（PointRubric和RaR-Science-Static），并比较了从小型模型中提取标准级判断的三种方法：生成式判决（Generative verdicts）、Yes/No对数概率边际（Logprob margins）、以及探针评判器（Probe judges）。探针评判器通过在小型语言模型之上训练轻量分类头来预测每个评分标准的满足情况。
AI.result: 在两个数据集上，Qwen3-1.7B探针评判器的标准级一致性最强，优于生成式和Logprob方法。作为GRPO奖励模型时，它将策略从0.232提升至0.643的rubric分数，超过8B生成式评判器基线（0.594），且奖励评判时间减少10.7倍。任务和域迁移实验表明探针评判器能跨设置保留标准级奖励结构。
AI.conclusion: 小型探针评判器可以作为基于rubric的强化学习中高效且可靠的奖励模型，在保持或超越大型生成式评判器性能的同时大幅降低计算开销，为资源受限场景下的rubric-based RL提供了实用可行的解决方案。

title: CineForge: Self-Improving Agents for Long-Horizon Video Generation
summary: Long-horizon story-driven video generation requires a production agent to coordinate narrative decomposition, state tracking, shot design, prompt construction, rendering, and revision across interdependent scenes. Existing adaptive video systems primarily refine requests or reusable skills, leaving recurring production failures disconnected from persistent, stage-targeted improvements across stories. We introduce CineForge, a self-evolving video-production agent framework that couples CineForge-Produce for video generation with CineForge-Evolve for cross-story policy evolution. CineForge-Produce organizes each source story into typed narrative, character, spatial, and cinematic states, uses them to coordinate asset and clip generation, and records the process as a canonical production trajectory. CineForge-Evolve applies Case-to-Pattern-to-Policy Evolution (CPPE) to review trajectory evidence, consolidate recurrent findings into bounded stage-local patches, and deploy validated updates through structural replay and confidence-controlled paired evaluation. To measure complete story realization, we introduce CineScope, which combines a 100-script CineScope-Data suite with a human-aligned, multiscale CineScope-Metric spanning causal state, directorial orchestration, pacing and resource allocation, and character arc. Across CineScope-Data and two public benchmarks, the evolved CineForge policy improves CineScope-Metric from 4.024 to 4.380, outperforms three long-video baselines with consistent gains under ScriptAgent, and reduces review LLM calls by 37.0% on new stories. These results establish production trajectories as actionable experience for video agents that improve cumulatively across long-form storytelling tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CineForge，一个自进化的视频制作智能体框架，通过CineForge-Produce组织视频生成与CineForge-Evolve进行跨故事策略进化，并引入CineScope评测体系。实验表明该框架在长时程故事视频生成中超越了多个基线，并将审阅LLM调用减少37%。
AI.motivation: 现有的自适应视频系统主要局限于优化请求或可复用技能，无法将反复出现的制作失败与持续性的、针对特定阶段的改进联系起来，缺乏跨故事的累积式能力提升。
AI.method: 提出CineForge双组件框架：CineForge-Produce将源故事分解为叙事、角色、空间和电影状态以协调资产与片段生成，记录为规范化生产轨迹；CineForge-Evolve采用案例到模式到策略的进化（CPPE），通过轨迹证据审查、将反复发现合并为有界阶段局部补丁，并通过结构重放和置信度控制的配对评估部署更新。同时引入CineScope评测体系，包含100个脚本的数据集和覆盖因果状态、导演编排、节奏与资源分配及角色弧的多尺度指标。
AI.result: 在CineScope-Data和两个公开基准上，进化后的CineForge策略将CineScope-Metric从4.024提升至4.380，在ScriptAgent下一致优于三个长视频基线，并将新故事的审阅LLM调用减少37.0%。
AI.conclusion: 生产轨迹可作为视频智能体的可行经验来源，使长时程故事讲述任务能够实现累积式的性能提升。

title: "Act Like a 5th Grader" is Not Enough: Bounding Knowledge in LLM-Based User Simulators
comment: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human behavior but frequently fail to exhibit realistic cognitive constraints, suffering from a "superhuman bias." Using a dataset of over 71,000 reading comprehension responses from 2,359 primary-school students (grades 4--6), we demonstrate that standard persona prompting yields near-perfect, deterministic performance, failing to capture the natural variance of developing readers. To address this, we introduce the Cognitively Bounded User Simulator (CBUS), an architectural framework that explicitly models the restricted working memory of young readers through an episodic bottleneck. Within this framework, we formalize two distinct test-taking strategies to emulate different reading behaviors. Our evaluation shows that explicitly modeling cognitive bounds significantly narrows the simulation gap across multiple LLM backbones, demonstrating that enforcing architectural constraints is more effective for high-fidelity simulation than simply scaling raw model capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出认知有界用户模拟器（CBUS），通过显式建模小学生受限的工作记忆（情景瓶颈）来模拟4-6年级学生的阅读理解行为，在超过71,000条真实作答数据上验证，相比标准人物提示方法显著缩小了模拟差距。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在模拟人类行为时存在"超人偏差"，无法体现儿童读者自然波动的认知能力和答题变异性，标准persona prompting不够真实。
AI.method: 提出CBUS框架，通过情景瓶颈显式建模年轻读者的受限工作记忆，并形式化两种不同的应试策略以模拟不同的阅读行为。
AI.result: 在多种LLM骨干网络上，CBUS显著缩小了模拟差距；实验表明施加架构约束比单纯扩大模型能力更能实现高保真模拟。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模认知边界是提高LLM人类行为模拟保真度的有效途径，架构约束优于能力堆叠。

title: SPLG-Mamba: Structure-Preserving Local-Global Mamba Network for Salient Object Detection in Optical Remote Sensing Images
summary: Salient object detection in optical remote sensing images (ORSI-SOD) requires dense predictions that preserve object completeness and structural continuity under complex backgrounds, scale variation, and irregular object shapes. Existing methods often localize salient regions, but their predictions may still suffer from structural degradation, including fragmented, incomplete, or locally missing foreground responses. This degradation is closely related to hierarchical feature propagation, where shallow details can introduce texture-induced background responses, deep semantics may over-smooth weak structures, and uncontrolled cross-scale fusion can disturb coherent regions. To address this issue, we propose a novel Structure-Preserving Local-Global Mamba Network, SPLG-Mamba, for ORSI-SOD. Specifically, SPLG-Mamba integrates Smooth-Detail Recalibration (SDR), hierarchy-aware Local-Global Mamba, and Gated Cross-Scale Fusion (GCSF). SDR recalibrates smoothed responses and detail residuals before state-space modeling, Local-Global Mamba assigns local modeling to shallow feature levels and global modeling to deep feature levels, and GCSF controls cross-scale detail injection during decoding. Experiments on ORSSD, EORSSD, and ORSI-4199 demonstrate state-of-the-art results and improved structural completeness and continuity. The code is available at https://github.com/yxu9910/SPLG-Mamba

AI.tldr: 提出SPLG-Mamba网络用于光学遥感图像显著目标检测，通过Smooth-Detail重校准、层次感知局部-全局Mamba和门控跨尺度融合，解决预测中的结构退化问题，在三个基准数据集上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有ORSI-SOD方法虽能定位显著区域，但预测结果常出现结构退化（碎片化、不完整或局部缺失），这源于层次特征传播中的问题：浅层细节引入纹理背景响应、深层语义过度平滑弱结构、无约束跨尺度融合扰动一致区域。
AI.method: 提出SPLG-Mamba，包含三个核心组件：Smooth-Detail Recalibration (SDR)在状态空间建模前重校准平滑响应与细节残差；层次感知Local-Global Mamba为浅层特征分配局部建模、深层特征分配全局建模；Gated Cross-Scale Fusion (GCSF)在解码阶段控制跨尺度细节注入。
AI.result: 在ORSSD、EORSSD和ORSI-4199三个数据集上取得最先进结果，改善了结构完整性与连续性。
AI.conclusion: SPLG-Mamba通过精细化的特征重校准、层次化的状态空间建模和门控融合策略，有效缓解了显著目标检测中的结构退化问题，验证了该方法的有效性。

title: Pak3H: Evaluating the Cost of Cultural Mismatch in LLM Alignment with a Human-Contextualized Urdu Benchmark
comment: We introduce Pak3H, a human-validated Urdu benchmark for helpfulness, harmlessness, and honesty. Zero-shot evaluations show LLM performance degrades across all three dimensions in low-resourced contextualized settings
summary: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong Helpfulness, Harmlessness, and Honesty (3H) alignment in English-centric settings, but these gains transfer poorly to low-resource languages due to cultural mismatches. Existing multilingual 3H benchmarks rely predominantly on automated translation or LLM based synthesis, propagating source-language biases while sacrificing local relevance. To address this gap, we introduce Pak3H1, the first human-validated, culturally contextualized Urdu benchmark suite for 3H alignment, comprising PakAlpaca (helpfulness), PakBeaverTails (harmlessness), and PakTruthfulQA (honesty). Our multi-stage pipeline integrates manual cultural adaptation and dictionary-guided post editing to prioritize native speaker judgment, ensuring both semantic fidelity and contextual authenticity. Zero-shot evaluations across multiple open and proprietary LLM architectures reveal systematic cross-lingual alignment gaps: helpfulness win rates decline under localized contexts, harmlessness guardrails break down against regional safety risks, and composite honesty metrics degrade substantially due to localized factual constraints. These findings expose structural limitations in current alignment approaches, underscoring the necessity of human-guided localization for equitable multilingual evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Pak3H1，首个经过人工验证的乌尔都语3H对齐基准套件（含Helpfulness、Harmlessness、Honesty三个维度），通过多阶段人工文化适配流水线构建，零样本评估发现跨语言对齐存在系统性缺失，证明了人类引导的本土化对多语言评估的必要性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在英语环境下的3H对齐表现良好，但在低资源语言中迁移效果差；已有的多语言3H基准过度依赖机器翻译或LLM合成，传播源语言偏见且缺乏本地相关性。需要人类验证的文化本土化基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建Pak3H1乌尔都语基准套件，包含三个子基准：PakAlpaca（帮助性）、PakBeaverTails（无害性）和PakTruthfulQA（诚实性）。采用多阶段流水线，整合人工文化适配与词典引导的后编辑，以母语者判断为核心，确保语义保真与语境真实性。
AI.result: 对多种开源和专有LLM进行零样本评估，发现系统性跨语言对齐差距：本地化语境下帮助性胜率下降；针对区域性安全风险的无害性护栏失效；受本地化事实约束，综合诚实性指标显著退化。
AI.conclusion: 当前对齐方法存在结构性局限，无法在低资源语言中保持3H对齐质量，必须依赖人类引导的本土化策略来推动多语言评估的公平性。

title: Conducting Stylistic Analysis of Paintings through an Art-History Agent
summary: Attributing an artwork to an artist has traditionally relied on detailed visual observations and descriptions, known as stylistic analysis in art history. By contrast, current artificial intelligence (AI) models used in the field offer only unexplained probabilistic classifications. To bridge this methodological gap, we present an AI framework that automates stylistic analysis of paintings, providing a foundation for enhancing evidence collection, discovery, and verification. By training a vision transformer (ViT) on a large corpus of paintings with metadata, our system encodes this art history-specific data as embeddings. These representations are factorized via sparse dictionary learning into a shared set of features that recur across the training set. A large language model (LLM) then interprets each feature by retrieving associated artworks and their accompanying curator-written texts, and synthesizes them into descriptions that reflect their stylistic attributes. Finally, an autonomous coordinator LLM applies a reasoning-and-action (ReAct) framework to weight, test, and refine these features into cohesive descriptions of an artwork, or comparisons of artworks. This approach converts detailed visual features into descriptive terms, addressing a key challenge in art history. It thus connects the use of images as data with the semantic concerns of humanists, establishing vision-based computational art history as an area for future growth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种AI框架，将视觉变换器与稀疏字典学习及大型语言模型相结合，自动对绘画进行风格分析，将视觉特征转化为艺术史学术语描述，弥合了传统风格分析与当前AI概率分类之间的方法论差距。
AI.motivation: 传统艺术史风格分析依赖专家视觉观察与描述，而现有AI模型仅提供无法解释的概率分类结果，两者之间存在方法论鸿沟，缺乏可解释、可验证的自动化分析工具。
AI.method: 该方法包含四个核心步骤：1）使用视觉变换器在大规模绘画语料库上训练并编码艺术史元数据为嵌入；2）通过稀疏字典学习将嵌入分解为训练集中反复出现的共享特征集；3）利用大型语言模型检索相关艺术作品及策展人撰写的文本，综合生成反映风格属性的描述；4）采用自主协调LLM基于ReAct框架对这些特征进行加权、测试和精炼，输出连贯的作品描述或作品对比。
AI.result: 该框架成功将详细的视觉特征转化为可读的描述性术语，有效克服了艺术史领域长期存在的挑战，验证了基于视觉的计算艺术史研究路径的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将图像数据与人文主义者的语义关注相连接，确立了视觉驱动的计算艺术史作为未来可发展的研究领域，为证据收集、发现和验证提供了新基础。

title: Budget-Aware Compression Pipeline for Single-GPU LLM Inference: Methods, Trade-offs, and Coupling Effects
summary: Single-GPU deployment of 70B-parameter language models on an NVIDIA GPU is constrained by device memory, long-context throughput, and engineering integration cost. We cast single-GPU inference as a budget-aware design problem over these three axes and study how pruning, quantization, and KV-cache compression interact under realistic execution. Controlled ablations show that layer-wise pruning makes weight quantization more robust. KV-cache sparsification complements INT8 KV quantization by reducing memory without hurting decoding speed, while static vector quantizers often conflict with dynamic caching. Guided by these coupling results and explicit budget tracking, we assembled a practical pipeline and compressed a 70B model to about 33 GB, sustained about 57 tokens/s on 10k token prompts on a single A40, and kept absolute accuracy within 5% on common and reasoning benchmarks. We contribute design rules and a reproducible evaluation protocol that jointly report quality, memory, and end-to-end speed, and we provide a foundation for automated pipeline search under realistic single-GPU constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在单张GPU上部署70B参数大语言模型时的内存、长上下文吞吐量和工程集成成本三者之间的权衡问题，通过剪枝、量化和KV缓存压缩的组合优化，在单张A40上实现了约33GB的模型体积、57 tokens/s的推理速度和5%以内的精度损失，并提出了可复现的评估协议和设计规则。
AI.motivation: 单张GPU部署70B参数大语言模型受到设备内存限制、长上下文推理吞吐量瓶颈以及工程集成成本高等多重约束，现有的剪枝、量化和KV缓存压缩技术如何相互作用、如何在这些维度上进行预算感知的最优组合缺乏系统性研究。
AI.method: 将单GPU推理建模为预算感知的设计问题，系统性地消融研究剪枝、量化和KV缓存压缩之间的相互作用关系，基于耦合结果和显式预算追踪，组装实际压缩流水线。
AI.result: 将70B模型压缩至约33GB，在单张A40上实现10k token提示下约57 tokens/s的推理速度，在常见和推理基准上保持5%以内的绝对精度损失。
AI.conclusion: 层间剪枝能提升权重量化的鲁棒性，KV缓存稀疏化与INT8 KV量化互补，静态向量量化与动态缓存冲突；提出了联合报告质量、内存和端到端速度的可复现评估协议，为单GPU约束下的自动化流水线搜索奠定基础。

title: PhysVR: Vision-Language Model Guided Interference-aware Temporal Feature Refinement for Remote Physiological Measurement
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables contactless physiological measurement from facial videos, yet its subtle pulse-related variations are easily affected by illumination variation, head motion, facial blur, and region-of-interest instability. Existing methods mainly suppress interference during feature learning, while whether the learned temporal features remain affected by interference and how to further suppress such interference before rPPG estimation are rarely examined. To address this limitation, we propose PhysVR, a vision-language model guided interference-aware temporal feature refinement framework for rPPG estimation. Specifically, a physiological backbone produces global temporal features and a coarse rPPG prediction, from which signal-derived physiological reliability evidence is constructed from local temporal characteristics. In parallel, a frozen vision-language model processes sampled facial frames under an interference-oriented prompt, and an evidence head extracts visual interference evidence from the VLM output. Temporal cross-attention integrates the physiological and visual evidence with the global temporal features to construct interference-aware temporal context. Guided by this context, a shared temporal correction unit performs general refinement, while four interference-specific experts selectively suppress different interference through adaptive routing. The refined temporal features are then used for final rPPG estimation. Extensive experiments on five public benchmarks demonstrate that PhysVR consistently outperforms representative methods under both intra-dataset and cross-dataset evaluation protocols.

AI.tldr: PhysVR是一个由视觉语言模型引导的干扰感知时序特征精炼框架，用于rPPG估计。它通过生理骨干网络生成全局时序特征和粗略rPPG预测，结合冻结的视觉语言模型提取视觉干扰证据，并通过时序交叉注意力整合生理与视觉证据，最终由共享时序校正单元和四个干扰专用专家选择性地抑制不同干扰。在五个公开基准上的实验表明该方法在数据集内和跨数据集评估中均优于代表性方法。
AI.motivation: 现有rPPG方法主要在特征学习过程中抑制干扰，但很少检查学习到的时序特征是否仍受干扰影响，以及如何在rPPG估计前进一步抑制此类干扰。
AI.method: PhysVR框架包含：1) 生理骨干网络生成全局时序特征和粗略rPPG预测；2) 从局部时序特征构建信号派生的生理可靠性证据；3) 冻结的视觉语言模型在干扰导向提示下处理采样面部帧，提取视觉干扰证据；4) 时序交叉注意力整合生理和视觉证据构建干扰感知时序上下文；5) 共享时序校正单元进行通用精炼，四个干扰专用专家通过自适应路由选择性抑制不同干扰。
AI.result: 在五个公开基准上的大量实验表明，PhysVR在数据集内和跨数据集评估协议下均一致优于代表性方法。
AI.conclusion: PhysVR通过引入视觉语言模型获取干扰证据，并在rPPG估计前进行干扰感知的时序特征精炼，有效解决了现有方法忽略特征层面干扰残留的问题。

title: When Does a Classifier Help an LLM? Classifier-Guided Prompting and Hybrid Classifier-LLM Models for Credit-Default Prediction
summary: Credit-default prediction is an important task in financial decision making. Traditional methods use fitted classifiers such as logistic regression and random forests on tabular features. Large language models (LLMs) have recently been applied to this task through prompting. In this work we study how a fitted classifier and an LLM can be combined for credit-default prediction. We distinguish telling the LLM to imitate a classifier from using the classifier to build the prompt. We hypothesize that a fitted classifier can supply the ranking ability that an LLM prompt lacks. We experiment on the Default of Credit Card Clients dataset, and report recall, F1, and the area under the ROC and precision-recall curves, with bootstrap confidence intervals. We observe that a few-shot LLM has the highest recall (0.47) and F1 (0.50) of any single model but ranks worse than a random forest (AUC-ROC 0.72 against 0.79). Instructing the LLM to imitate a classifier gives no significant change. Pruning the prompt to the classifier's eight most important features raises recall by 0.071 and F1 by 0.032. Adding the classifier's predicted probability to the prompt raises the LLM's AUC-ROC from 0.72 to 0.78, matching the random forest, while keeping 0.118 higher recall than it. The reverse composition, and the use of several classifiers, do not help. We thus recommend a simple classifier-guided prompt for LLM-based credit prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何将传统拟合分类器与大语言模型（LLM）结合用于信用违约预测。实验表明，在提示中加入随机森林的预测概率可将LLM的AUC-ROC从0.72提升至0.78（与随机森林持平），同时保持比其高0.118的召回率；而裁剪提示到8个最重要特征可提升召回率0.071和F1值0.032。作者推荐使用简单的分类器引导提示进行LLM信用预测。
AI.motivation: 信用违约预测是金融决策中的关键任务。传统方法依赖逻辑回归、随机森林等拟合分类器，而大语言模型近期被通过提示方式应用于该任务。作者希望探索如何将拟合分类器与LLM有效结合，以弥补LLM在排序能力上的不足。
AI.method: 作者区分了两种组合方式：让LLM模仿分类器，以及利用分类器构建提示。在Default of Credit Card Clients数据集上进行实验，使用召回率、F1、AUC-ROC和AUC-PR等指标，并报告自举置信区间。
AI.result: 少样本LLM在召回率（0.47）和F1（0.50）上优于任何单一模型，但AUC-ROC（0.72）不如随机森林（0.79）。让LLM模仿分类器无显著变化。将提示裁剪到分类器的8个最重要特征可提升召回率0.071和F1 0.032。在提示中加入分类器的预测概率使LLM的AUC-ROC从0.72提升至0.78，达到随机森林水平，同时保持比其高0.118的召回率。反向组合和使用多个分类器均无帮助。
AI.conclusion: 推荐使用简单的分类器引导提示（在提示中嵌入分类器的预测概率）用于LLM信用违约预测，该方案能兼顾LLM的高召回率与分类器的强排序能力。

title: MedSegBenchmarker: A Raw-Count-First Framework for Controlled 2D Medical Image Segmentation Benchmarks
summary: Despite rapid advances in MIS, fair and reproducible comparisons of segmentation models remain challenging due to heterogeneous datasets, inconsistent evaluation protocols, and rapidly evolving architectures. In particular, comparisons often implicitly assume that model rankings are invariant to data partitioning, preprocessing, metric aggregation, uncertainty estimation, and computational constraints. The lack of extensible and unified evaluation frameworks further limits systematic investigation of new models, datasets, and training paradigms. We present MEDSEGBENCHMARKER (MSB), a configuration-driven framework for controlled benchmarking of 2D MIS. It integrates duplicate and near-duplicate image detection, group-aware data splitting, YAML study specifications, resumable training, hyperparameter optimization, cross-validation, and checkpoint-based evaluation. Rather than retaining only aggregate performance measures, MSB exports sample- and class-level pixel counts and predictions together with the evaluation context. These elementary artifacts enable post-hoc analyses without repeated inference. We demonstrate MSB in a case study involving three heterogeneous 2D datasets and multiple MIS and general-purpose vision models evaluated at 256- and 512-pixel input resolutions. Reaggregation of identical predictions changes the top-ranked architecture in three of six dataset-resolution settings, despite high rank correlations between aggregation strategies. Increasing input resolution produces model- and dataset-dependent performance gains and losses that must be considered alongside empirically measured inference complexity. These results show that seemingly minor choices in evaluation and experimental setup can affect benchmark conclusions. MSB, available at GitHub, provides a practical and extensible basis for making benchmark conditions and evaluation choices explicit and reproducible.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍MEDSEGBENCHMARKER (MSB)，一个配置驱动的医学图像分割基准测试框架，通过重复/近重复图像检测、分组数据划分、YAML实验配置、可恢复训练、超参数优化、交叉验证和检查点评估等模块，导出样本级和类别级的像素计数与预测结果，支持无需重新推理的后验分析。案例研究表明，聚合策略和数据划分等看似微小的评估选择会改变排名结论。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割（MIS）模型间的公平可复现比较面临困难，原因包括数据集异质性、评估协议不一致以及架构快速演进。现有比较往往隐含假设模型排名对数据划分、预处理、度量聚合、不确定性估计和计算约束保持不变，且缺乏可扩展统一的评估框架，限制了系统化研究。
AI.method: MSB采用配置驱动设计，集成重复与近重复图像检测、组感知数据划分、YAML研究规格、可恢复训练、超参数优化、交叉验证和基于检查点的评估。与仅保留聚合指标不同，MSB导出样本级和类别级的像素计数、预测及评估上下文，使后验分析无需重复推理即可进行。案例研究采用三个异质2D数据集和多种MIS及通用视觉模型，在256和512像素输入分辨率下进行评估。
AI.result: 重新聚合相同预测在六个数据集-分辨率设置中有三个改变了排名第一的架构，尽管聚合策略间存在高度秩相关。提高输入分辨率产生模型和数据集相关的性能收益和损失，需结合实测推理复杂度综合考量。
AI.conclusion: 评估和实验设置中看似微小的选择可能显著影响基准测试结论。MSB为显式且可复现地制定基准条件和评估选择提供了实用且可扩展的基础，代码已在GitHub开源。

title: Arkios: An Open Bilingual English-Nepali Language Model Trained From Scratch, with a Devanagari-Aware Tokenizer
summary: We present Arkios, a 1.04B-parameter dense transformer pretrained from scratch on 150B tokens of bilingual English-Nepali text, using a custom single-file C/CUDA training stack and a Devanagari-aware byte-level BPE tokenizer built for this project. On ARC-Easy and ARC-Challenge, Arkios exceeds three comparably sized open models (Pythia-1.4B, TinyLlama-1.1B, OLMo-1B) despite an order of magnitude fewer training tokens, likely aided by a match between our educational-web-text pretraining data and ARC's grade-school-science format rather than a general capability advantage. We report full evaluation results under standard protocols, including a correction to an earlier partial-sample estimate, and findings specific to evaluating small models in a low-resource language: the standard multiple-choice-letter prompt format used by common evaluation harnesses places this model at chance on Nepali reading comprehension, and simultaneously at chance on English in the same format, which would lead a naive benchmark run to conclude the model has no Nepali ability when in fact it does. Concretely, both languages score at chance in the letter-choice format (0.240 Nepali, 0.236 English, against a chance baseline of 0.250), while scoring the answer text directly reveals genuine, English-favoring comprehension (0.306 Nepali, 0.387 English). We describe a manifest-conditioned tool-use contract introduced during instruction tuning, where tool calls are permitted only when a tool manifest is declared in context and suppressed otherwise, and report where that contract holds and where it does not. We release both the base and instruction-tuned model weights under Apache-2.0. The training code and a small privately-sourced portion of the Nepali pretraining corpus are not released; everything needed to reproduce the reported numbers from the released weights is included here.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Arkios，一个10.4亿参数的稠密Transformer模型，从头在150B tokens的英尼双语文本上预训练，使用自定义的单文件C/CUDA训练栈和天城文感知的字节级BPE分词器。尽管训练token数量少一个数量级，Arkios在ARC基准上超越了三个同规模开源模型。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在构建一个支持尼泊尔语（低资源语言）的大语言模型，并探索小模型在低资源语言上的评估问题，尤其是标准多选题字母格式评测导致尼泊尔语能力被低估的现象。
AI.method: 使用自定义单文件C/CUDA训练栈从头预训练1.04B稠密Transformer，在150B tokens的英尼双语文本上训练；开发天城文感知的字节级BPE分词器；引入清单条件化的工具使用契约进行指令微调；比较不同评分格式（字母选择vs直接文本评分）对评估结果的影响。
AI.result: Arkios在ARC-Easy和ARC-Challenge上超过Pythia-1.4B、TinyLlama-1.1B和OLMo-1B，尽管训练token少一个数量级。发现标准多选题字母格式使模型在尼泊尔语和英语上均处于随机水平（约0.24 vs 0.25基线），而直接评分答案文本则揭示真实能力（尼泊尔0.306，英语0.387），且英语能力更优。
AI.conclusion: 标准评测格式会严重低估低资源语言模型的能力，需要针对性的评估协议；Arkios在ARC上的优势可能来自预训练数据与测试集格式的匹配而非通用能力优势；工具使用契约在指令微调中部分有效。模型权重以Apache-2.0协议开源。

title: GeoRay: Gauge-Aware Feed-Forward Satellite 3D Reconstruction in the Geodetic Frame
summary: Feed-forward 3D foundation models reconstruct perspective scenes in one pass. Satellite photogrammetry needs a different product, one that domain adaptation alone does not deliver: dense surface height in an absolute geodetic frame under non-central rational polynomial cameras (RPCs). Perspective-pretrained features are not reliably observable along RPC height rays, absolute elevation carries a low-order height--datum gauge exchangeable with sensor bias to first order, and monocular and multi-view cues fail in different regions. \method{} treats all three. Lightweight ray-consistent adapters make a frozen backbone matchable along native RPC rays. An explicit datum mechanism separates relief from absolute level and is equivariant to the vertical origin by construction, so one trained model serves zero-, one-, and sparse-control inference. Calibrated inverse-variance fusion combines the two relief streams. \bench{}, our absolute-frame benchmark of eighteen systems across in-domain, cross-dataset, and cross-city tiers, scores absolute placement without registration or test-reference leakage. On 26 held-out US3D tiles, \method{} attains $2.99$\,m absolute MAE at $91.9\%$ coverage, improves completeness-aware accuracy by $46.4$ points over the strongest compliant feed-forward baseline, remains the most accurate such system under both transfer shifts, and runs in $24$\,s model-forward time per tile. Code and models will be released at https://github.com/HIT-SIRS/GeoRay

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoRay方法，用于卫星摄影测量中绝对大地基准下的稠密地表高度重建。通过轻量级射线一致性适配器、显式垂直基准机制和校准的逆方差融合，在18个系统的绝对框架基准上达到2.99米绝对MAE和91.9%覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D基础模型虽然能一次性重建透视场景，但无法直接用于卫星摄影测量。主要挑战有三：（1）透视预训练特征沿RPC高度射线不可靠观测；（2）绝对高程存在与传感器偏置可交换的低阶基准误差；（3）单目和多视图线索在不同区域各自失效。域适应无法解决这些根本问题。
AI.method: GeoRay包含三个关键组件：（1）轻量级射线一致性适配器，使冻结骨干网络沿原生RPC射线可匹配；（2）显式基准机制，将地形起伏与绝对高程分离，对垂直原点具有构造性等变性，一个模型可服务于零控制、单控制和稀疏控制推理；（3）校准的逆方差融合，结合两个地形起伏流。
AI.result: 在26个US3D测试瓦片上，GeoRay达到2.99米绝对MAE和91.9%覆盖率，完整度感知精度比最强合规前馈基线提升46.4个百分点，在两种迁移场景下仍保持最准确，每瓦片模型前向推理时间24秒。
AI.conclusion: GeoRay证明了通过针对RPC原生几何的显式建模（而非单纯域适应），可以高效地从预训练透视基础模型中迁移能力到卫星摄影测量任务，同时实现绝对框架精度、多控制点场景泛化以及实时性能。

title: AtlasNLP: A Country-Aware Atlas of Dataset Representation in NLP
comment: Proceedings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
summary: Understanding which countries are represented in NLP datasets is essential for identifying gaps, targeting data collection, measuring progress, and informing AI policy. However, geographic metadata is very rarely available, and country-level representation is often hidden behind broad language-level claims. We introduce AtlasNLP, a country-aware atlas of over 13,000 NLP dataset records across normalized NLP task categories, tracking both the populations represented and where datasets are produced. AtlasNLP includes AtlasNLP-Gold, a human-curated reference set, and AtlasNLP-Core, an ACL-derived large-scale collection. Using this resource, we show that (1) dataset coverage is highly uneven across countries and tasks; (2) dataset production and representation are geographically asymmetric; and (3) language coverage does not imply geographic representation. These findings reveal blind spots in current dataset documentation practices and motivate more explicit geographic metadata for country-aware NLP evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AtlasNLP，一个覆盖13000多个NLP数据集记录的国家级地图资源，用于追踪数据集所代表的人群和数据集生产地。研究发现数据集覆盖在不同国家和任务间极不均匀、数据生产与代表存在地理不对称性，且语言覆盖不代表地理覆盖，从而揭示了当前数据集文档实践的盲点。
AI.motivation: NLP数据集中的国家代表性对于识别覆盖缺口、指导数据收集、衡量进展和制定AI政策至关重要，但地理元数据很少可用，国家层面的代表性常被语言层面的宽泛声明所掩盖。
AI.method: 构建AtlasNLP资源，包含两个部分：AtlasNLP-Gold（人工整理的参考集）和AtlasNLP-Core（基于ACL大规模语料库的集合），覆盖超过13,000条NLP数据集记录，按标准化的NLP任务类别进行组织，同时追踪数据集所代表的人群和数据集的生产地点。
AI.result: 研究发现：（1）数据集覆盖在不同国家和任务之间高度不均衡；（2）数据集生产和代表性在地理上不对称；（3）语言覆盖并不等同于地理代表性。
AI.conclusion: 上述发现揭示了当前数据集文档实践中的盲点，并促使NLP评估中需要更明确的地理元数据，以实现国家感知的NLP评估。

title: A Calibration Audit of Confidence in Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models emit a per-pixel confidence that downstream systems read as a reliability signal. It is trained as a loss weight, not as an uncertainty magnitude, and whether it can be used as an error prediction has not been measured. We audit seven released backbones on thirteen datasets and score the confidence on four properties, how well it ranks error, whether its level is right on average, whether it holds across the confidence range, and whether its intervals cover the truth. The confidence ranks error well, but the predicted uncertainty is too low when it is read under conditions that are not exactly those of training. The median case is off by 2.4x across all seven models, and the error prediction is further off the more confident the model is. We show that this phenomenon can appear even though the loss's optimum is reached. A released model resumed under its own loss reaches that optimum on its training data within a few hundred updates and stays overconfident on unseen frames. A power law with two constants per backbone and dataset corrects the overall magnitude of the predicted uncertainty and leaves the ranking untouched. What no rescaling reaches is the scene, which we attribute to the model's missing knowledge of scale across predictions. Every correction we tried is close to right on average and still leaves two thirds of held-out scenes outside a five-point band, because what a scene is missing is a shape rather than a shift. We release the audit protocol, its results, and the fitted constants per model and dataset. Fitted with the target dataset held out, the constants bring the median case from 2.4x off to 1.35x, and a refit on a few labelled scenes of that dataset reaches 1.12x.

AI.tldr: 本文系统审计了七个前馈3D重建模型在十三个数据集上的逐像素置信度，发现其排名误差能力良好，但在训练条件之外预测的不确定性系统性偏低（中位数偏差2.4倍），且置信度越高偏差越大。作者提出每骨干-数据集两常数的幂律修正可将偏差降至1.35倍，对目标数据集少量标注场景重拟合可达1.12倍。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D重建模型输出的逐像素置信度被下游系统当作可靠性信号读取，但其训练时仅作为损失权重而非不确定性度量，其能否作为误差预测从未被系统衡量过。
AI.method: 审计七个已发布骨干模型在十三个数据集上的置信度，从四个属性评分：误差排序质量、平均水平准确性、置信度区间内的稳定性、区间是否覆盖真值。提出每骨干-数据集带两个常数的幂律修正来校准量级，并分析了损失最优达到时仍出现过自信的现象。
AI.result: 置信度排序误差表现良好，但预测不确定性在训练外条件下系统性偏低。中位情况在七个模型上偏差2.4倍，越自信误差预测越差。幂律修正使中位偏差降至1.35倍（目标数据集不参与拟合），用少量标注场景重拟合达1.12倍。但任何缩放都无法修正场景级偏差（表现为形状缺失而非平移），三分之二的留出场景仍偏离五点区间。
AI.conclusion: 前馈3D重建的置信度排名可靠但量级偏差且不可通过简单缩放完全修复；模型缺乏跨预测的尺度知识是场景级校准失败的根本原因。

authors: Shrinidhi Kumbhar Santosh Mashetty Divij Handa Kevin Coutinho
title: COGTRL: Training LLMs for Scientific Discovery Assistance using Cognitive Traces via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) trained on extensive scientific research are increasingly integrated as assistants for scientific discovery. However, most research papers omit the fine-grained cognitive process of examining constraints, failed alternatives, and iterative decisions required to achieve the desired goal. Such cognitive processes are vital for real-world scientists working toward specific goals under constraints. In this paper, we show that LLMs, when trained to produce such cognitive traces, perform better as scientific discovery assistants than when trained solely on scientific literature. We propose COGTRL, a trajectory-level reinforcement learning framework that trains LLMs to emulate cognitively grounded reasoning by jointly optimizing cognitive traces and the scientific steps produced in an interleaved manner. Across two 3B-parameter models and two scientific domains (AI and Materials Science), COGTRL improves method quality by an average of 7.85 points over comparable 3B model baselines and achieves competitive performance relative to 70B parameter models. Moreover, analysis by domain experts shows a preference for methods generated by COGTRL over the baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COGTRL，一种轨迹级强化学习框架，通过让LLM生成并优化认知轨迹（约束检查、失败替代方案、迭代决策），显著提升其作为科学发现助手的性能。在3B参数模型上平均提升7.85分，且性能可与70B参数大模型竞争。
AI.motivation: 现有研究论文大多省略了科学发现过程中的细粒度认知过程（如约束检查、失败替代方案和迭代决策），而这些认知过程对现实世界科学家在约束下达成目标至关重要。仅基于科学文献训练的LLM缺乏这类认知能力，限制了其作为科学发现助手的表现。
AI.method: 提出COGTRL框架，采用轨迹级强化学习，联合优化认知轨迹和科学步骤的生成，使LLM以交错方式模拟具认知依据的推理过程。
AI.result: 在2个3B参数模型和2个科学领域（AI和材料科学）上，COGTRL较同类3B基线模型平均提升7.85分；与70B参数模型相比达到有竞争力的性能；领域专家分析表明COGTRL生成的方法优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 训练LLM生成认知轨迹而非仅学习文献，能显著提升其作为科学发现助手的质量，且较小模型可通过该框架达到接近大模型的性能。

title: XDG: Accelerated Visual Disambiguation
summary: Visual aliasing, also known as the doppelganger problem, remains a key challenge for structure-from-motion (SfM): visually similar but physically distinct surfaces can produce incorrect image matches and degrade reconstruction quality. Previous work mitigates this issue with geometry-aware foundation-model features, but places a heavy transformer classifier on top of the backbone, making large-scale disambiguation expensive. We introduce XDG, an efficient visual disambiguation model designed for scalable SfM. Our key observation is that a 3D foundation model already performs the cross-view geometric reasoning necessary for visual disambiguation, so doppelganger classification should adapt the backbone representation directly rather than relearn pair reasoning in a separate heavy decoder. XDG fine-tunes Depth Anything 3 with lightweight LoRA adapters and repurposes its camera tokens as compact pair-level classification tokens. A compact MLP head predicts whether a candidate image pair observes the same 3D surface. Extensive experiments show that XDG provides a favorable accuracy-efficiency tradeoff: it remains competitive with the state-of-the-art disambiguation method across pairwise and reconstruction benchmarks and delivers more than a 3x inference speedup. On individual LaMAR scenes containing thousands of images, XDG saves more than 10 hours of visual disambiguation processing. Code is available at https://github.com/xtcpete/xdg.

AI.tldr: XDG是一个用于大规模SfM的高效视觉消歧模型，通过轻量LoRA微调3D基础模型Depth Anything 3，并复用其相机token作为成对分类token，在保持与最先进方法竞争性精度的同时实现3倍以上推理加速。
AI.motivation: 视觉别名（doppelganger问题）是SfM的关键挑战，现有方法在基础模型之上堆叠重型transformer分类器，导致大规模消歧计算成本过高。
AI.method: 核心观察是3D基础模型本身已具备跨视角几何推理能力，因此应直接适配骨干网络表示而非用独立重解码器重新学习对推理。XDG使用轻量LoRA适配器微调Depth Anything 3，将其相机token重新用作紧凑的成对分类token，由一个紧凑MLP头预测图像对是否观察同一3D表面。
AI.result: XDG在成对和重建基准上与最先进的消歧方法保持竞争力，同时提供超过3倍的推理加速。在包含数千张图像的单个LaMAR场景中，节省超过10小时的视觉消歧处理时间。
AI.conclusion: XDG验证了在3D基础模型上直接适配表示进行视觉消歧的有效性，实现了精度与效率的优异权衡，为大规模SfM场景提供了实用的消歧方案。

title: Can LLMs Take the Pulse of the Economy? A Real-Time Evaluation of LLM Nowcasts on Macroeconomic Indicators
summary: Nowcasting headline macroeconomic indicators, i.e., estimating an indicator's value for the current reference period before its official release, is critical for monetary policy and financial markets, and central banks devote dedicated teams of expert economists to producing such estimates. Large language model (LLM) agents are a promising candidate for this task, combining broad world knowledge with real-time web search and supporting queries at higher frequency than institutional nowcasts. Evaluating their nowcasting capability is, however, challenging: headline indicators such as GDP and CPI are widely reported and likely memorized during pretraining, so any evaluation on historical releases is vulnerable to data contamination. To address this, we introduce LiveMacroEval, a live, contamination-resistant benchmark in which LLM agents produce hourly nowcasts for sixteen major U.S. macroeconomic indicators over a pre-release window closing at each official release. Nowcast quality is assessed through a LiveMacro Score against announcement-window equity returns and a LiveBetting Score from simulated Polymarket-style trading, with Federal Reserve regional-bank nowcasts, the Bloomberg ECOS professional consensus, and an auto-ARIMA baseline as comparators. Over six months with four state-of-the-art LLM agents configured with web search, aggregate nowcast accuracy is broadly comparable to the institutional and professional benchmarks, with performance varying widely across individual indicators. This highlights LLM agents' potential as real-time estimators of macroeconomic conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了LiveMacroEval，一个抗数据污染的实时基准测试，用于评估LLM智能体对美国十六个主要宏观经济指标（如GDP、CPI）的即时预测（nowcasting）能力。该基准在官方发布前的窗口期内每小时生成预测，通过LiveMacro Score和LiveBetting Score评估预测质量。六个月的实验结果显示，配备网络搜索的四个SOTA LLM智能体的预测精度与美联储区域银行预测、Bloomberg专业共识及auto-ARIMA基线大致相当，但不同指标间表现差异显著。
AI.motivation: 即时预测重要宏观经济指标对货币政策与金融市场至关重要，但当前机构预测依赖专家团队且频率有限。LLM智能体因结合广泛世界知识与实时网络搜索，成为有前景的候选方案。然而，由于GDP、CPI等头条指标在预训练阶段可能被记忆，直接使用历史数据进行评估存在数据污染的严重问题，亟需设计一个抗污染的实时评估框架。
AI.method: 作者构建LiveMacroEval实时基准：1）对十六个美国宏观经济指标，在官方发布前的窗口期内让LLM智能体每小时生成即时预测；2）使用LiveMacro Score（基于公告窗口股票收益）和LiveBetting Score（基于模拟Polymarket风格交易）两个指标综合评估预测质量；3）以美联储区域银行预测、Bloomberg ECOS专业共识和auto-ARIMA基线作为比较对象；4）对配备网络搜索的四个SOTA LLM智能体进行六个月的连续评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，LLM智能体的整体预测精度与机构专业基准（美联储区域银行、Bloomberg共识）及传统统计基线（auto-ARIMA）大致相当，但各指标间的性能差异较大，说明LLM智能体在部分指标上表现突出，在另一些指标上仍有明显不足。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体具备作为宏观经济状况实时估计器的潜力，其预测能力可与专业机构媲美，为高频、低成本的宏观即时预测提供了新的可能。未来研究可进一步探索如何针对不同指标优化智能体性能。

title: Drift Calibration in Geometric Eye Tracking Systems
summary: Geometric eye trackers can provide the spatial accuracy required for gaze-based interaction and multimodal studies, but their measurements remain sensitive to residual session-specific calibration error. Research on correcting this error is difficult to compare because methods are typically evaluated with different devices, target layouts, and error definitions. We present a calibration-focused dataset containing 163 trials from 12 participants, with separate 18-point fitting and 32-point test grids, and use it to evaluate global, local, and composite correction functions under a common spatial-extrapolation protocol. We further introduce a lightweight neural refiner that combines ranked predictions from complementary calibrators. On this controlled dataset, post-vendor correction reduces the mean angular error from $1.53^\circ$ to $1.03^\circ$ with the strongest classical composite and to $0.96^\circ$ with the refiner. In a closed-loop gaze task, lower residual error is associated with higher performance across four online correction conditions. These results provide a reproducible data-quality benchmark for using gaze as a behavioral signal in interactive modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向几何眼动追踪的校准聚焦数据集，包含12名参与者的163次试验，并使用统一的时空外推协议评估了全局、局部和复合校正函数。此外，作者引入了一个轻量级神经精化器，结合互补校准器的排名预测，将平均角度误差从1.53°降低到0.96°。
AI.motivation: 几何眼动追踪器的测量结果对残留的会话级校准误差敏感，而现有校正方法研究由于使用不同设备、目标布局和误差定义而难以比较，缺乏统一的基准来公平评估不同校正方法的性能。
AI.method: 构建包含12名参与者163次试验的数据集，使用18点拟合网格和32点测试网格；在统一的时空外推协议下评估全局、局部和复合校正函数；引入轻量级神经精化器，结合多个互补校准器的排名预测；并通过闭环注视任务验证校正效果。
AI.result: 在控制数据集上，厂商后校正将平均角度误差从1.53°降至1.03°（最强经典复合方法）和0.96°（神经精化器）。在闭环注视任务中，四种在线校正条件下较低的残余误差与较高的任务表现相关。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了可复现的数据质量基准，证明神经精化器在经典校正方法基础上进一步提升精度，为将注视作为交互建模中的行为信号提供了可靠的评估框架。

title: Manacá-1B: An Open, Reproducible Brazilian-Portuguese Language Model and a Tokenizer-Aware, Paired Evaluation
summary: Brazilian Portuguese remains under-served by open language models, and the few that exist are difficult to reproduce and are often compared without measures of uncertainty. We release Manacá-1B, an open decoder-only model of 1.72 billion parameters trained from scratch for Brazilian Portuguese with a fully containerized, reproducible pipeline. The pretraining is stable, with zero skipped or NaN steps and self-recovering loss spikes, and we release its full log and dynamics. We evaluate the model against nine open baselines on four Portuguese benchmarks under a single harness. Every comparison reports a standard error and a paired significance test, and the harness is validated against previously published numbers. On last-word prediction Manacá-1B is the strongest model below the 7B scale, exceeding both Tucano-1b1 and Tucano-2b4 on LAMBADA-PT with large paired margins; it is competitive on commonsense completion and near chance on multiple-choice reasoning, as are all small base models. Along the way we document a concrete evaluation pitfall: converting a SentencePiece tokenizer with case-folding normalization to the HuggingFace fast format silently drops the normalizer, routing every capitalized token to byte-fallback and depressing scores in a way that is invisible in aggregate metrics. The uncorrected tokenizer lowered LAMBADA-PT accuracy from 45.3 to 25.0; we quantify the effect and provide a one-line fix that reproduces the training tokenizer exactly. Code, raw training and evaluation logs, per-example prediction vectors, the model weights, and the corrected tokenizer are released so that every number in this paper can be recomputed.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了Manacá-1B，一个从零训练的17.2亿参数巴西葡萄牙语开源解码器模型，采用完全容器化的可复现训练流程，并提供完整的训练日志、评估框架和逐例预测数据。模型在LAMBADA-PT上优于同规模基线，同时揭示了一个关键的评估陷阱：SentencePiece分词器在转换到HuggingFace格式时会静默丢失大小写归一化，导致分数严重下降。
AI.motivation: 巴西葡萄牙语在开放语言模型领域资源匮乏，现有模型难以复现，且评估通常缺乏不确定性度量。作者旨在提供一个完全可复现的模型和严谨的统计评估框架，并揭示评估过程中被忽视的分词器陷阱。
AI.method: 从零训练一个17.2亿参数的decoder-only模型，使用完全容器化的可复现流水线；在统一评估框架下对四个葡萄牙语基准进行测试，每次比较都报告标准误差和配对显著性检验；并通过对比揭示并修复了SentencePiece分词器在格式转换中静默丢失归一化器的问题。
AI.result: Manacá-1B在LAMBADA-PT上是最强的70亿以下规模模型，大幅超越Tucano-1b1和Tucano-2b4；在常识补全上具有竞争力，在多选推理上接近随机水平（所有小型基础模型皆如此）。分词器缺陷会使LAMBADA-PT准确率从45.3降至25.0，已提供一行修复代码。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了巴西葡萄牙语开源模型的空白，提供了完全可复现的训练和评估流程，并识别出分词器转换中的隐蔽缺陷，为后续研究提供了宝贵的实践指南和标准化评估基础设施。

title: SynCrash: A Multi-Stage Pipeline for Zero-Shot Accident Detection and Localization in Traffic Surveillance Video
comment: Accepted at the CVPR 2026 AUTOPILOT Workshop (non-archival)
summary: We present SynCrash, a multi-stage pipeline for zero-shot accident detection, spatial localization, and collision-type classification in fixed-view CCTV surveillance video. Our approach addresses the ACCIDENT at CVPR 2026 Challenge, which requires predicting when an accident occurs, where in the frame the impact happens, and what type of collision it is, all without access to labeled real-world training data. The pipeline operates in three decoupled stages: (1) Temporal localization via a VideoMAEv2-giant backbone fine-tuned on CARLA-based synthetic clips with metadata-aware embeddings and dense sliding-window inference; (2) Spatial localization using YOLO for object detection combined with a physics-informed hybrid heuristic that leverages bounding-box overlap and trajectory-based reasoning to predict the impact point; and (3) Collision-type classification using a lightweight rule-based strategy derived from the number and configuration of detected vehicles. The key insight is that temporal understanding benefits from supervised fine-tuning on synthetic data, whereas spatial understanding is better served by pretrained object detectors and physics priors that transfer naturally across domains.

AI.tldr: SynCrash是一个三阶段零样本事故检测流水线，用于固定视角CCTV监控视频中的事故时间定位、空间定位和碰撞类型分类，通过合成数据微调与物理先验结合的方式解决CVPR 2026挑战赛。
AI.motivation: 解决零样本（无真实标注数据）条件下的交通事故检测任务，同时预测事故发生的时间、空间位置和碰撞类型，填补现有方法无法在无标注真实数据场景下工作的空白。
AI.method: 采用三阶段解耦流水线：(1) 时间定位使用VideoMAEv2-giant骨干网络，在CARLA合成数据上微调，结合元数据嵌入和密集滑窗推理；(2) 空间定位使用YOLO目标检测结合基于边界框重叠和轨迹推理的物理启发式混合策略；(3) 碰撞类型分类采用基于车辆数量和构型的轻量级规则策略。
AI.result: 论文尚未报告具体实验结果，但核心洞察是：时间理解受益于合成数据的监督微调，而空间理解更适合使用预训练检测器和可跨域迁移的物理先验。
AI.conclusion: 时间与空间理解应分别采用不同的技术路线——合成数据微调用于时间建模，预训练检测器与物理先验用于空间推理，这种解耦设计能够有效地实现零样本事故检测。

title: Verification-Aware Training for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a draft model to generate candidate tokens, which are verified by the target model in a single forward pass. Verification proceeds sequentially and discards every position from the first rejection onward, yet existing draft training relies on token-level imitation of the target with a fixed per-position weighting that reflects neither property. We introduce Verification-Aware Training (VAT), a plug-in framework that simulates verification at every training step and turns the resulting accept and reject patterns into supervision. VAT consists of two components: (i) a verification head, a lightweight jointly trained binary classifier that supervises the draft model on whether each position survives sequential verification; (ii) verification-adaptive weighting, which replaces the fixed weighting schedule by keeping full weight up to each sample's first rejection point and re-anchoring the decay to start there. VAT modifies only the training objective, so it can be layered on top of existing methods without changing the draft architecture, the target model, or the inference procedure. Applied to EAGLE-3 and DFlash on Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and LLaMA-3.1-8B, VAT improves average acceptance length by up to 11.4% and wall-clock speedup by up to 8.7%, with consistent gains across math, code, and chat benchmarks. Code will be available at https://github.com/naver-ai/vat

AI.tldr: 本文提出VAT（验证感知训练），一种即插即用的训练框架，通过模拟验证过程并将接受/拒绝模式转化为监督信号来训练草稿模型，显著提升投机解码的接受长度和推理加速效果。
AI.motivation: 投机解码中验证过程是顺序进行的，且从第一个拒绝位置起就丢弃所有后续token，但现有草稿模型训练仅依赖token级模仿目标模型，使用固定逐位置权重，未反映验证过程的这两个特性，导致训练目标与推理行为不匹配。
AI.method: VAT包含两个组件：(i) 验证头——一个轻量级联合训练的二分类器，监督草稿模型判断每个位置是否能通过顺序验证；(ii) 验证自适应加权——用动态权重策略替换固定权重，在样本第一个拒绝点之前保持满权重，并从该点开始重新锚定衰减。VAT仅修改训练目标，不改变草稿架构、目标模型和推理流程。
AI.result: 在EAGLE-3和DFlash上应用于Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B和LLaMA-3.1-8B，VAT将平均接受长度提升最高11.4%，墙钟加速比提升最高8.7%，在数学、代码和聊天基准上均有稳定提升。
AI.conclusion: VAT通过将验证感知引入训练阶段，有效弥合了草稿模型训练目标与推理时验证过程之间的差距，是一种轻量且通用的改进方案，可叠加在现有投机解码方法之上。

title: InspectorGPT: A Comparative Reasoning Enhanced VLM for Comprehensive Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: Industrial anomaly detection is a critical component of modern manufacturing. Most traditional unsupervised methods rely on modelling normal feature distributions, inherently limiting generalization to unknown categories. To improve generalizability, some recent methods incorporate vision-language models (VLMs) for zero-shot detection via text prompts. However, we observe that reasoning-oriented post-training can cause anomaly discrimination to collapse, with some fine-tuned models performing worse than their base VLMs. Existing methods also provide only textual decisions or coarse boxes, without pixel-level segmentation. A more explicit detection principle comes from human inspection: anomalies are identified by comparing a query image with a defect-free reference. Inspired by this, we propose InspectorGPT, a VLM framework centered on comparative reasoning. Given a normal reference and a query image, InspectorGPT compares them to identify discrepancies and perform multiple inspection tasks with detailed reasoning. We internalize this capability through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) fine-tuning and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with tailored, verifiable rewards. We further introduce InspectorGPT-Seg for pixel-level anomaly masks. Segmentation supervision improves anomaly discrimination but weakens semantic reasoning, while joint training fails to balance them. We therefore train the two branches separately and combine them through task-vector fusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior multi-dimensional performance and generalization to unseen benchmarks, validating comparative reasoning for comprehensive industrial inspection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InspectorGPT，一个基于比较推理的VLM框架，通过将查询图像与无缺陷参考图像进行对比来检测工业异常，利用CoT微调和GRPO强化学习实现多任务检测，并引入InspectorGPT-Seg通过任务向量融合实现像素级分割。
AI.motivation: 传统无监督异常检测方法依赖建模正常特征分布，泛化能力有限；现有VLM零样本方法存在推理后训练导致异常判别能力崩溃的问题，且仅能提供文本决策或粗糙框，缺乏像素级分割能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出InspectorGPT比较推理框架，将无缺陷参考图像与查询图像对比以识别差异；2) 使用CoT微调和GRPO强化学习（带可验证奖励）内部化比较推理能力；3) 引入InspectorGPT-Seg分支进行像素级异常分割；4) 采用分支独立训练加任务向量融合的方式，避免分割监督削弱语义推理或联合训练失衡的问题。
AI.result: 大量实验表明InspectorGPT在多个维度上性能优越，并展现出对未见基准的良好泛化能力，验证了比较推理在综合工业检测中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 比较推理是一种更明确且高效的工业异常检测原则，通过VLM结合CoT与强化学习，并采用分离训练与任务向量融合策略，能够在语义推理和像素级分割之间取得良好平衡，实现全面的工业检测。

title: CAST: Critique-Aware Supervision for Training Reliable Long-Horizon Tool-Calling Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in long-horizon, interactive, and stateful environments. In these settings, a single wrong action, such as refunding the wrong purchase, can cause irreversible task failure and must be intercepted before execution. Such failures may not appear in every single run, but can emerge across repeated trials, making reliability across steps and trials critical. However, ensuring agentic reliability is challenging: even frontier LLMs struggle to explain why an action may be wrong, especially in long, intertwined trajectories governed by domain-specific policies. Much recent work relies on prompt-based critique agents, while optimization-based methods lack a systematic way to produce rich verification rationales for training. We address this gap with CAST, a critique-aware training framework that converts sparse task outcomes into action-level supervision for critique learning and policy optimization. CAST analyzes agent trajectories to synthesize structured rationales explaining action validity under partial observability. The resulting critique model is used to construct critique-aware training data for optimizing the policy model. Fine-tuning Qwen3-family models on dynamic tool-calling benchmarks, CAST improves reliability across domains, outperforming GPT-OSS-120B by over 10% pass^4 on Retail tasks and yielding an additional 9% improvement on Telehealth in an out-of-domain setting. These results demonstrate that critique-aware training improves the robustness of LLM agents in realistic dynamic environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAST框架，一种将稀疏任务结果转化为动作级监督的批判感知训练框架，用于提升LLM智能体在长时程、交互式环境中的可靠性。通过在动态工具调用基准上微调Qwen3模型，CAST在多个领域超越基线模型，显著提升了智能体的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在长时程、交互式环境中，单个错误动作就可能导致不可逆的任务失败，需要在执行前拦截。然而即使是最前沿的LLM也难以为长轨迹中的错误动作提供充分解释，现有基于提示的批判智能体方法缺乏系统性的训练数据生成方式，优化类方法也无法产生丰富的验证推理，因此需要新的训练框架来提升智能体的可靠性。
AI.method: CAST框架包含三个关键步骤：(1) 分析智能体轨迹，在部分可观测性下合成结构化的动作有效性推理；(2) 利用这些推理训练批判模型；(3) 使用批判模型构建批判感知的训练数据来优化策略模型，从而将稀疏的任务级结果转化为细粒度的动作级监督信号。
AI.result: 在动态工具调用基准上微调Qwen3系列模型后，CAST在多个领域提升了智能体可靠性，在Retail任务上比GPT-OSS-120B高出超过10%的pass@4指标，在域外的Telehealth任务上额外提升9%。
AI.conclusion: 批判感知训练能够有效提升LLM智能体在真实动态环境中的鲁棒性，证明了将动作级验证推理融入训练过程的可行性。

title: GridFlow: Structured Latent Flow for Seamless City-Scale 3D Point Cloud Generation
summary: Generating realistic 3D city environments from remote sensing data is important for simulation, urban planning, and mixed reality, yet existing point cloud generation methods are limited to single objects or bounded indoor scenes and cannot handle the scale, seamless tiling, and partial observability challenges of city-scale generation. We present \ours{}, a multi-stage framework that generates dense, colored point clouds ($10^5$ points per $150\text{m}{\times}150\text{m}$ tile) at city scale, conditioned on satellite imagery, semantic segmentation maps, and digital surface models (DSM). A \emph{Grid-Aligned VAE} encodes each tile into a topology-preserving latent grid where tokens correspond to fixed spatial regions, enabling spatially coherent multi-modal conditioning and compact latent-space edge consistency that implicitly aligns thousands of boundary points for seamless cross-tile generation. A conditional rectified flow model synthesizes geometry latents from the fused multi-modal conditions, and an orientation-aware diffusion colorizer separately handles satellite-visible horizontal surfaces and occluded vertical façades. To support standardized evaluation, we build on public 3D data sources to introduce \emph{City3D-MultiGen}, a benchmark of $163$K densely annotated tiles from Melbourne and London with aligned point clouds, satellite images, semantic maps, and elevation data.
