Experiments show that \ours{} outperforms adapted point cloud generation baselines across all geometry metrics and produces visually coherent colored point clouds with seamless boundaries over arbitrarily large urban extents. Our benchmark details are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/e32/City3D-MultiGen

AI.tldr: 本文提出City3D-MultiGen框架，用于从卫星图像、语义分割图和数字表面模型生成城市场景规模的稠密彩色点云。通过Grid-Aligned VAE编码空间拓扑保持的潜网格实现无缝拼接，结合条件整流流模型和方向感知扩散着色器，在Melbourne和London的163K瓦片基准上显著优于现有的点云生成方法。
AI.motivation: 现有3D城市环境生成方法局限于单一物体或室内场景，无法应对城市场景生成中面临的规模庞大、无缝瓦片拼接和部分场景不可观测等核心挑战，需要一种能够生成大规模、高质量城市点云的新方法。
AI.method: 提出多阶段框架：1) Grid-Aligned VAE将每个瓦片编码为保持拓扑结构的潜网格，实现空间一致的多模态条件融合和隐式边缘对齐；2) 条件整流流模型从融合的多模态条件合成几何潜变量；3) 方向感知扩散着色器分别处理卫星可见的水平表面和被遮挡的垂直立面。同时构建了City3D-MultiGen基准数据集。
AI.result: 在Melbourne和London数据集上，所提方法在所有几何指标上均优于适配的点云生成基线，能够生成视觉上一致且边界无缝的彩色点云，可覆盖任意大的城市范围。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效解决了城市场景尺度点云生成的关键挑战，通过潜空间边缘一致性和多模态条件融合实现了高质量的无缝城市级点云生成，为仿真、城市规划和混合现实等应用提供了有力支撑。

title: Reactivating Test-Time Scaling for Plane Geometry Problem Solving
summary: Plane geometry problem (PGP) solving has become a critical benchmark for multimodal reasoning because it requires accurate visual perception and precise multi-step symbolic deduction. Although test-time scaling (TTS) has demonstrated remarkable success in general mathematical reasoning, it fails to scale effectively under the symbolic-program paradigm for plane geometry. We identify two key obstacles: limited reasoning diversity induced by rigid symbolic programs and insufficient explicit visual grounding before symbolic deduction. To address these issues, we propose Multi-Trace Synthesis (MTS), which converts each symbolic program into heterogeneous reasoning traces, including executable Python scripts and CoT-augmented variants. We further propose Perception-Augmented (PA) training, which parses diagrams into structured semantic clauses before deduction, and Consensus-Guided Multi-Trace Ensemble (CG-MTE) for efficient self-adaptive inference. Experiments on three geometry benchmarks show that our method consistently improves PGP-solving across model scales and achieves strong performance against both general-purpose MLLMs and specialized geometry solvers. Under test-time scaling, CG-MTE achieves comparable accuracy to high-budget self-consistency while reducing sampling cost by up to 8x. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/Jason8Kang/ReTTS-PGPS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对平面几何问题（PGP）求解的多轨迹合成与感知增强方法，通过将符号程序转换为异构推理轨迹、在符号推理前进行显式视觉感知训练，以及基于共识引导的多轨迹集成实现高效自适应推理，在三个几何基准上显著提升了跨模型规模的求解性能，并将测试时缩放的采样成本降低至8倍。
AI.motivation: 虽然测试时缩放（TTS）在通用数学推理中表现优异，但在符号程序范式下无法有效扩展到平面几何问题求解。作者识别出两个关键障碍：刚性符号程序导致的推理多样性受限，以及符号推理前缺乏充分的显式视觉基础。
AI.method: 提出三种核心方法：（1）多轨迹合成（MTS），将每个符号程序转换为异构推理轨迹（可执行Python脚本和CoT增强变体）；（2）感知增强（PA）训练，在推理前将图表解析为结构化语义子句；（3）共识引导多轨迹集成（CG-MTE），实现高效的自适应推理。
AI.result: 在三个几何基准上的实验表明，该方法在模型各规模上持续提升PGP求解性能，并优于通用MLLM和专用几何求解器。在测试时缩放下，CG-MTE达到与高预算自洽相当的性能，同时将采样成本降低至8倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过增强推理多样性和显式视觉感知，可以有效解决符号程序范式下PGP求解的测试时缩放失效问题，实现更高效且性能更强的几何推理。

title: Source-Dependent Deference in Medical Imaging Agents Under Falsified Findings: A Pilot Audit
summary: Tool-using agents are being proposed for medical imaging, and their behaviour when a tool returns a false finding is largely unmeasured. We audit whether a ReAct-style tool-calling agent abandons an answer it has already given correctly once a falsified finding arrives, and whether that depends on how the finding is presented. On 20 VQA-RAD closed questions across four vendor-designated model tiers, the agent commits to an answer from the image alone; a negated finding is then delivered either as JSON from an analyze_image tool the agent invokes itself, or as quoted prose attributed to a radiologist. Our outcome is the commission-error rate over cases answered correctly without any tool. Deference is much higher under the prose-attributed claim: at the strongest tier the agent revised its correct answer in 10 of 13 cases against 1 of 13 under the tool (exact McNemar p=0.0039, Holm-adjusted 0.012). We do not claim this isolates the source label. Attribution travels with the delivery channel in our design, and exposure differs because the tool claim reaches the agent only when it calls the tool. The finding is a joint source-and-delivery asymmetry from a small-scale pilot whose pre-specified stopping rule was not met.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了医疗影像工具调用型智能体在面对虚假发现时的行为，发现当虚假发现以放射科医生引述的散文形式呈现时，智能体更倾向于放弃其原本正确的回答，而在JSON工具输出形式下则基本保持原答案，表现出显著的来源与传递渠道联合不对称性。
AI.motivation: 工具调用型智能体正被应用于医学影像领域，但其在工具返回虚假发现时的行为尚未被充分测量。理解智能体是否会放弃原本正确的答案，以及该行为是否依赖虚假发现的呈现方式，对于医疗AI的安全性至关重要。
AI.method: 在20个VQA-RAD封闭式问题上，对四个供应商指定的模型层级进行审计。智能体先仅依据图像给出答案，随后以两种方式传递否定性发现：一种是通过智能体自身调用的analyze_image工具返回JSON，另一种是以引述散文形式归因于放射科医生。通过计算正确回答后发生错误修订的比例（commission-error rate）进行比较分析，并采用配对McNemar检验。
AI.result: 散文归因形式的遵从度显著更高：在最强模型层级中，智能体在13个正确案例中有10个修订了答案，而工具形式下仅1/13修订（精确McNemar p=0.0039，Holm校正后0.012）。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现存在来源与传递渠道的联合不对称性，即散文归因的虚假发现更容易导致智能体放弃正确回答。但研究为小规模试点，预定的停止规则未达到，且设计上无法将来源标签与传递渠道完全分离，结论需谨慎解读。

title: CPR for LLMs: Critical-Point Routing against Catastrophic Forgetting in Domain Adaptation
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the de facto standard for adapting large language models (LLMs) to target domains, but it often degrades the model's general capabilities, a phenomenon known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing approaches typically modify the SFT loss to mitigate forgetting, but they inevitably operate along a domain-generality trade-off. In this work, we step outside this trade-off by decoupling the two capabilities at the model level: we keep the original base model for general capability, and selectively invoke the SFT expert only when domain-specific knowledge is required. Specifically, we propose CPR (Critical-Point Routing), a token-level routing framework between a base model and its expert derivative, based on critical tokens where the base model fails but the expert succeeds. We train a lightweight hierarchical router that estimates the expert-call probability per token, and pair it with a tailored inference procedure that combines momentum smoothing and threshold gating. Across diverse model-domain configurations, CPR achieves state-of-the-art across all settings, surpassing SFT expert by 1.4-5.5% in domain performance while recovering its general-capability drop from 3.4-14.5% to at most 0.5%, with minimal overhead from invoking the expert on only one-third of tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CPR（Critical-Point Routing）框架，通过token级别的路由机制在基础模型与SFT专家模型之间进行选择性切换，仅在对领域特定知识有需求的临界token处调用专家模型，从而在不牺牲通用能力的前提下提升领域性能。
AI.motivation: 监督微调（SFT）在将大语言模型适配到目标领域时会造成灾难性遗忘，即模型通用能力退化。现有方法通过修改SFT损失函数来缓解遗忘，但都不可避免地面临领域能力与通用能力之间此消彼长的权衡问题。
AI.method: CPR采用模型级解耦策略：保留基础模型用于通用能力，仅在需要领域知识时选择性调用SFT专家。具体包含：(1)基于基础模型失败但专家成功的临界token定义；(2)训练轻量级层次路由器估计每个token的专家调用概率；(3)结合动量平滑和阈值门控的定制推理流程。
AI.result: 在多种模型-领域配置下，CPR在所有设置中均达到最先进性能：领域性能超过SFT专家1.4-5.5%，同时将通用能力下降从3.4-14.5%恢复至最多0.5%，且仅需在三分之一的token上调用专家，开销极小。
AI.conclusion: CPR通过打破领域-通用能力之间的权衡，实现了鱼与熊掌兼得的效果，即在保持通用能力几乎不损失的同时提升领域性能，为LLM领域适配提供了一种新的范式。

title: Foundation and Multimodal Large Language Models for Face Presentation and Morph Attack Detection
summary: Face recognition systems are increasingly deployed in security-critical applications, yet they remain vulnerable to presentation and morph attacks. Presentation attack detection (PAD) and morphing attack detection (MAD) are therefore essential components of trustworthy face biometrics. Despite advancements in PAD and MAD methods, existing detectors suffer from limited generalization and degrade in cross-dataset evaluation. In this paper, we systematically investigate whether general-purpose foundation models (FMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) encode PAD-relevant and MAD-relevant information, and how such models can best be deployed for both tasks. We study five approaches with increasing access to the internal information of the model: (i) zero-shot prompting of off-the-shelf MLLMs; (ii) training a shallow model on the next-token logit probabilities at the output of the MLLM; (iii) parameter-efficient fine-tuning on task-specific question-answer data, yielding two specialized MLLMs, called PADLLM and MADLLM, which additionally provide textual reasoning for their decisions; (iv) linear probing of frozen vision encoders; and (v) fine-tuning of vision encoders of FMs and MLLMs. We benchmark 16 open-weight MLLMs and 30 vision encoder backbones on four PAD datasets (MSU-MFSD, CASIA-FASD, Replay-Attack, and OULU-NPU) and four MAD datasets (FFHQ, FRGC, FRLL, and FERET). Our experiments show that FMs and MLLMs can achieve significant performance for PAD and MAD. In addition, the fine-tuned models achieve state-of-the-art detection performance in cross-dataset evaluation, indicating that general-purpose pretrained representations carry substantial attack-relevant information. Source code of all our experiments will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了通用基础模型（FMs）和多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在人脸呈现攻击检测（PAD）和变形攻击检测（MAD）中的能力，提出了五种从浅到深的部署方法，并在8个数据集、16个MLLMs和30个视觉编码器上进行了大规模基准测试，结果表明微调模型在跨数据集评估中达到最先进水平。
AI.motivation: 人脸识别系统在安全关键应用中广泛部署，但现有PAD和MAD检测器泛化能力有限，在跨数据集评估中性能下降严重。作者希望探索通用基础模型是否已编码了攻击相关信息，并找到最佳部署方式以提升检测性能。
AI.method: 研究了五种方法：(i)零样本提示MLLMs；(ii)在MLLM输出的下一个token对数概率上训练浅层模型；(iii)参数高效微调任务特定问答数据，得到PADLLM和MADLLM两个专用模型（可提供文本推理）；(iv)冻结视觉编码器的线性探测；(v)微调FM和MLLM的视觉编码器。在16个开源MLLMs和30个视觉编码器主干上，对4个PAD数据集和4个MAD数据集进行基准测试。
AI.result: 实验表明FMs和MLLMs在PAD和MAD任务上取得了显著性能。微调后的模型在跨数据集评估中达到了最先进的检测性能，证明通用预训练表示携带了丰富的攻击相关信息。
AI.conclusion: 通用基础模型和多模态大语言模型可以有效用于人脸呈现攻击检测和变形攻击检测，通过参数高效微调可获得最优的跨数据集泛化性能，且PADLLM和MADLLM还能提供决策的文本推理解释。

title: GPAgentBench-2K: Benchmarking Large Language Model Agents in Complex Clinical Action Space
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) show great potential as clinical agents, yet existing benchmarks reduce clinical workflows to static predictions or unconstrained Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) with coarse action sets. To address this, we introduce GPAgentBench-2K, the first Constrained MDP (CMDP) LLM-agent benchmark for primary-care clinical decision-making, constructed from expert-validated records of real-world GP encounters. Our environment models a full spectrum of six foundational clinical actions, imposes a topological workflow prior over the action space, and operationalizes safety-informed abstention as a first-class outcome. Evaluating 16 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals a significant performance degradation as the action space scales. Crucially, we uncover a clinical quality-safety gap: even frontier models with the highest diagnosis accuracy violate safety constraints in over half of high-risk cases. Finally, we establish a reference point using Constrained Group Relative Policy Optimization (C-GRPO), and show that while explicitly modeling constraints improves performance over unconstrained RL methods, it remains far from clinically acceptable safety.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GPAgentBench-2K，这是首个面向基层医疗临床决策的约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）LLM智能体基准测试，基于专家验证的真实全科医生诊疗记录构建。环境涵盖六种基础临床动作、拓扑工作流先验，并将安全知情弃权作为一等结果。对16个SOTA LLM的评估发现：随着动作空间扩大，模型性能显著下降；前沿模型在超过半数高风险案例中违反安全约束，存在"临床质量-安全差距"。引入C-GRPO作为参照后，虽然显式建模约束优于无约束RL方法，但仍远未达到临床安全可接受水平。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM临床智能体基准要么将临床工作流简化为静态预测，要么建模为动作集粗糙的无约束MDP，无法真实反映基层医疗决策中有序动作、安全约束和适时弃权的复杂要求，缺乏评估LLM安全临床行为的高保真基准。
AI.method: 构建GPAgentBench-2K基准：基于专家验证的真实全科医生诊疗记录，将临床决策建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），涵盖六种基础临床动作，在动作空间上施加拓扑工作流先验，并将安全知情弃权操作化为一级结果。采用约束群组相对策略优化（C-GRPO）建立参照基线。
AI.result: 对16个SOTA LLM的评估表明：动作空间扩大导致性能显著下降；前沿模型虽然诊断准确率最高，但在超过50%的高风险案例中违反安全约束，暴露出显著的临床质量-安全差距；C-GRPO相比无约束RL方法有所改进，但仍远未达到临床安全标准。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLM在临床决策中的安全约束遵循能力严重不足，单纯的准确率提升并不等同于临床安全；即使在动作空间扩大之前模型就存在质量-安全失衡问题，约束感知的RL训练虽能部分缓解但尚不能达到临床可接受的安全水平，需要进一步的研究和基准建设。

title: Beyond Global Realism: Virtual Try-On Evaluation and Optimization with Dimension-wise Garment Fidelity Assessment
summary: Virtual try-on (VTON) requires not only realistic generation but also faithful preservation of garment characteristics. However, existing evaluation metrics such as PSNR, SSIM, KID and FID struggle to measure the consistency between the generated and reference garments, particularly in capturing the multi-dimensional characteristics of garment fidelity. To address this, we propose DAT: a Dimension-wise Assessment framework for virtual Try-on, which decomposes garment consistency into seven interpretable dimensions: silhouette, color, neckline and sleeve shape, major decoration and structure, material texture, fine-detail fidelity, and logo preservation, each formulated as a discrete attribute-level prediction task. To train this specialized assessment model, we adopt a two-stage learning paradigm comprising large-scale weak supervision on 50K samples, followed by refinement on 10K higher-quality annotations obtained via multi-model voting. Furthermore, we employ weighted cross-entropy loss to mitigate the severe label imbalance inherent across evaluation dimensions. Beyond its role as an evaluation framework, the assessment model can be integrated into reinforcement learning optimization of Qwen-Image-Edit for VTON, where dimension-wise rewards are adaptively aggregated to emphasize under-optimized aspects during training. Experimental results show that our method (8B parameters) achieves state-of-the-art performance in terms of balanced accuracy, SROCC, and PLCC, outperforming strong proprietary models such as Gemini-3.1, Qwen3.7-plus, and GPT-5.5, while also serving as an effective optimization signal for reward-guided VTON generation

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAT框架，将虚拟试穿中的服装一致性拆解为七个可解释维度（轮廓、颜色、领口袖型、装饰结构、材质纹理、细节保真度、logo保留），通过两阶段训练（5万弱监督样本+1万高质量投票样本）构建评估模型，并能作为奖励信号集成到强化学习优化中，在8B参数量下超越多个强模型。
AI.motivation: 现有评估指标（PSNR、SSIM、KID、FID）难以准确衡量虚拟试穿中生成服装与参考服装之间的多维度特征一致性，缺乏对服装保真度的细粒度、可解释性评估。
AI.method: 提出DAT框架，将服装一致性分解为七个可解释维度并转化为离散属性级预测任务；采用两阶段学习范式（5万大规模弱监督+1万高质量标注投票细化）；使用加权交叉熵损失解决标签不平衡问题；将评估模型集成到Qwen-Image-Edit的强化学习优化中，自适应聚合维度奖励以强化薄弱维度。
AI.result: DAT（8B参数）在平衡准确率、SROCC和PLCC指标上达到SOTA性能，超越Gemini-3.1、Qwen3.7-plus和GPT-5.5等强专有模型，同时可作为奖励引导的VTON生成的有效优化信号。
AI.conclusion: 维度化、可解释的服装一致性评估框架能够更精确衡量VTON质量，且评估模型本身可反哺生成模型的强化学习优化，形成评估与生成相互促进的闭环。

title: ALTSTEER: Selective Safety Steering for Moving Beyond Hard Refusals to Constructive Alternatives
summary: Safety alignment is essential for deploying large language models, requiring systems to prevent harmful compliance while preserving helpfulness on benign requests. Activation steering offers a training-free inference-time approach to safety control, but effective safety steering requires addressing two coupled questions: when to intervene and how generation should be shaped after intervention. However, existing safety steering methods remain limited along both dimensions, as their triggering mechanisms can be unstable across domains and refusal-oriented steering often yields rigid refusals rather than constructive safe guidance. To address these limitations, we propose ALTSTEER, an inference-time framework that couples selective intervention with refusal-anchored constructive redirection within a single inference pass. ALTSTEER uses an internal refusal-relevant signal to decide when to steer, and applies staged steering to shift generation from refusal-oriented control toward constructive alternatives. Evaluations on Llama-3.1 and Qwen2.5 show that ALTSTEER preserves benign utility while improving constructive safe-completion behavior, especially on models that otherwise tend to produce short refusals for harmful requests.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ALTSTEER，一个推理时安全对齐框架，通过选择性干预与拒绝锚定的建设性重定向相结合，在单次推理中同时解决何时干预和如何塑造生成两个问题，在Llama-3.1和Qwen2.5上验证了其能在保持良性请求效用的同时提升建设性安全完成行为。
AI.motivation: 现有激活引导的安全控制方法存在两个局限：触发机制在不同领域间不稳定，以及面向拒绝的引导往往产生僵硬拒绝而非建设性的安全指导，难以兼顾安全性与帮助性。
AI.method: ALTSTEER框架包含两个核心组件：一是利用内部拒绝相关信号决定何时进行干预（选择性干预），二是在同一推理过程中应用分段引导，将生成从拒绝导向控制转向建设性替代方案（拒绝锚定的建设性重定向）。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1和Qwen2.5上的评估表明，ALTSTEER能够保持良性请求的效用，同时改善建设性安全完成行为，尤其是在那些对有害请求倾向于产生简短拒绝的模型上效果更为显著。
AI.conclusion: ALTSTEER通过耦合选择性干预与建设性重定向，在单次推理内同时解决了安全引导的方向性和触发稳定性问题，为推理时安全对齐提供了一种无需训练的实用方案。

title: RegionCache: Semantic-Aware Region Reuse for Efficient Multi-Turn Image Generation
summary: Real-world image generation often involves multi-turn editing, where users iteratively modify small regions while most image content remains unchanged. However, existing diffusion transformer (DiT)-based editing pipelines recompute the entire image at every turn, causing substantial redundant computation. Existing DiT acceleration methods further ignore semantic correspondence across prompts, leading to unnecessary recomputation or unsafe reuse that harms editing quality. To address this, we propose RegionCache, a semantic-aware reuse framework for multi-turn image editing that selectively reuses diffusion states from unchanged regions. RegionCache detects reusable regions through semantic overlap between consecutive prompts and cross-attention localization, and adopts an adaptive reuse schedule based on prompt similarity and contextual consistency. Experiments on PixArt-alpha demonstrate that RegionCache achieves 1.43x--2.55x end-to-end speedup while maintaining comparable image quality. Code is available at https://github.com/hebutBryant/RegionCache.

AI.tldr: RegionCache是一个面向多轮图像编辑的语义感知复用框架，通过检测提示词间的语义重叠和交叉注意力定位来选择性复用未变化区域的扩散状态，在PixArt-alpha上实现1.43x–2.55x端到端加速，同时保持图像质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的DiT（扩散变换器）编辑流程在每轮编辑时都会重新计算整个图像，产生大量冗余计算；而现有的DiT加速方法忽略了跨提示词的语义对应关系，导致不必要的重算或不安全的复用，损害编辑质量。
AI.method: RegionCache采用语义感知的复用框架：首先通过连续提示词之间的语义重叠和交叉注意力定位来检测可复用的区域；然后基于提示词相似度和上下文一致性采用自适应的复用调度策略。
AI.result: 在PixArt-alpha上的实验表明，RegionCache实现了1.43x–2.55x的端到端加速，同时保持了可比的图像质量，并且代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: RegionCache通过语义感知的区域级状态复用，有效解决了多轮图像编辑中的冗余计算问题，在加速的同时保证了编辑质量，为DiT编辑加速提供了新的思路。

title: When Errors Become Memories: Causal Pathway Tracing in Multi-Turn Memory-Augmented LLMs
summary: Long-term memory enables large language models (LLMs) to preserve and reuse information across interactions, but it can also turn localized errors into persistent risks. Existing work mainly evaluates whether memory systems store and retrieve information correctly, leaving limited understanding of how errors propagate across responses, memory states, and future interactions. We propose a structural causal model (SCM)-based framework for cross-turn error propagation in memory-augmented LLMs. We model user questions, model responses, and memory states as a dynamic causal process, and identify two entry pathways: internal memory updating and external question feedback. By intervening on these pathways, we construct four counterfactual trajectories and quantify their downstream effects and interaction. Error influence is evaluated at four levels: memory retention, natural responses, targeted diagnostic probing, and probability-level error preference. Experiments show that error influence generally decays with interaction distance, while the memory-update pathway contributes more persistent effects than question feedback; latent errors may remain even after disappearing from natural responses. Propagation patterns also vary across memory categories and memory mechanisms. Pathway-guided restoration further validates this decomposition: Question Repair reduces residual error by 27.5%, Memory Repair by 70.2%, and Joint Repair by 98.3%, nearly eliminating residual propagation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于结构因果模型（SCM）的框架，用于分析记忆增强型大语言模型中跨轮次对话错误的传播机制。通过干预内部记忆更新和外部问题反馈两条路径，构建四种反事实轨迹，在四个层次评估错误影响，并验证了路径引导的修复策略能有效消除错误传播。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要评估记忆系统能否正确存储和检索信息，但对错误如何在响应、记忆状态和未来交互之间传播的理解十分有限。长期记忆虽然能提升LLM的持续性，但也可能将局部错误固化为持久风险，因此亟需系统性的错误传播分析框架。
AI.method: 将用户问题、模型响应和记忆状态建模为动态因果过程，识别两条错误入口路径（内部记忆更新与外部问题反馈）。通过路径干预构造四条反事实轨迹，在记忆保持、自然响应、定向诊断探针和概率级错误偏好四个层面量化错误影响及交互效应。同时分析不同记忆类别和记忆机制下的传播模式差异，并设计基于路径分解的修复策略。
AI.result: 实验发现：错误影响通常随交互距离增加而衰减；记忆更新路径比问题反馈路径产生更持久的错误影响；潜在错误可能在自然响应中消失后仍然存在。传播模式因记忆类别和记忆机制而异。路径引导修复显示：问题修复减少27.5%残余错误，记忆修复减少70.2%，联合修复减少98.3%，几乎完全消除残余传播。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为理解记忆增强型LLM中的错误传播提供了因果视角，分解了不同传播路径的贡献，并展示了路径感知的联合修复策略能近乎彻底地消除错误传播，为构建更可靠的长期记忆系统提供了理论依据和实践指导。

title: PhasorNet: Learning Structure from Frequency for Real-Time Stereo Matching
summary: Accurate stereo matching remains challenging in ill-posed regions such as fine structures, reflective, or transparent objects, where appearance cues are often ambiguous or unreliable. To tackle this, we propose PhasorNet, a lightweight yet powerful framework that boosts geometric discrimination via frequency-domain cues. At its core, the Phase-Augmented Transformer (PAT) injects Fourier-derived phase information into the attention mechanism, yielding photometrically robust, structure-preserving features that prioritize structural consistency in difficult areas. Additionally, we develop a Geometry-Context Fusion Refinement Module (GCFRM) that combines a full-resolution convolutional stream with a lightweight attention-based stream (leveraging WQA and CDGA blocks) to efficiently preserve fine details and object boundaries without excessive overhead. Training is further enhanced by a multi-scale Edge-guided High-Error Region (EHR) loss that adaptively focuses optimization on high-error and edge regions, guiding hierarchical cost volume refinement. With only 5.3M parameters, PhasorNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on the challenging ETH3D benchmark while exhibiting excellent cross-domain generalization on KITTI, delivering an efficient and practical solution for accurate real-time stereo matching.

AI.tldr: PhasorNet是一个轻量级立体匹配框架（仅5.3M参数），通过频域相位信息增强几何判别能力，在ETH3D基准上达到最先进性能，并在KITTI上展现出优秀的跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 在精细结构、反光或透明物体等不适定区域中，外观线索往往模糊或不可靠，传统立体匹配方法在这些区域表现不佳，亟需更鲁棒的几何判别方法。
AI.method: 提出三个核心组件：1) Phase-Augmented Transformer (PAT) 将傅里叶相位信息注入注意力机制，获得光度鲁棒且保结构特征；2) Geometry-Context Fusion Refinement Module (GCFRM) 结合全分辨率卷积流与轻量注意力流（WQA和CDGA块）高效保留细节与边界；3) 多尺度Edge-guided High-Error Region (EHR)损失自适应聚焦高误差和边缘区域的优化。
AI.result: 仅用5.3M参数，在ETH3D基准上取得最先进性能，并在KITTI上展现出优异的跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: PhasorNet证明了频域相位信息与轻量级架构结合可以有效提升立体匹配在困难区域的性能，提供了一种高效实用的实时立体匹配解决方案。

title: When Models Hear What They Expect: Diagnosing Prosodic Heuristics in Multimodal Sarcasm Detection
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) process speech and text jointly, yet whether they exploit prosodic cues for pragmatic inference or rely on surface acoustic patterns has received little systematic investigation. We address this through sarcasm detection, evaluating Qwen2.5-Omni and Qwen3-Omni on Mandarin Chinese and English under five modality conditions that decompose the contributions of lexical content, vocal semantics, and prosodic structure. Adding audio systematically inflates false positives without improving true positive detection. Acoustic error diagnosis reveals that model errors cluster on a shared stereotype of expressive prosody, namely elevated pitch and irregular pausing, that diverges from the actual cues marking sarcasm in both languages. Targeted manipulation of only these two dimensions causally confirms the heuristic, inducing false positive rates of up to 60%. Applying the same manipulation template to Gemini~3 Flash Preview without modification replicates the effect, suggesting that the stereotype extends beyond the Qwen Omni family rather than arising from a single model architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在讽刺检测任务中是否真正利用韵律线索进行语用推理，还是依赖表面的声学模式。通过在中英文上对Qwen2.5-Omni和Qwen3-Omni进行五种模态条件实验，发现加入音频会系统性增加误报率而不会提升正确检出率，且模型错误集中在"高音调+不规律停顿"的刻板韵律特征上，而非真实的讽刺韵律线索。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型声称能联合处理语音和文本，但现有研究未系统考察其是否真正利用韵律线索进行语用推理。作者希望通过讽刺检测这一需要深层语用理解的场景，验证模型是从韵律中提取语义信息，还是仅仅依赖表面声学模式。
AI.method: 在普通话和英语上评估Qwen2.5-Omni和Qwen3-Omni，设计五种模态条件以分解词汇内容、语音语义和韵律结构的贡献；通过声学错误诊断识别模型错误的聚类模式，并对韵律特征（音高和停顿）进行定向操控以因果验证模型启发性假设，同时在不同模型家族（Gemini 3 Flash Preview）上检验该模板的泛化性。
AI.result: 加入音频导致误报率系统性地升高而正确检出率未提升；模型错误集中在刻板化的表达性韵律（高音调和不规律停顿）上，与中英文实际讽刺韵律线索不符。定向操控这两个维度可将误报率提升至60%，且同一操控模板在Gemini 3 Flash Preview上无需修改即可复现该效应。
AI.conclusion: MLLMs在讽刺检测中并未真正利用语言相关的韵律线索进行语用推理，而是依赖一种跨语言、跨模型架构共享的"表达性韵律"刻板启发式。该发现表明当前MLLMs的多模态推理能力存在实质性局限，且该局限具有跨模型家族的普遍性。

title: Null-Space Diffusion Restoration with Adaptive Uncertainty-Guided Fusion for Ultrasound Speckle Reduction
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted for publication in IEEE Access
summary: Ultrasound B-mode imaging commonly suffers from speckle noise and artifacts, requiring a delicate balance between contrast, resolution, and preservation of anatomical structures. Although recently developed despeckling methods have achieved some progress, supervised learning approaches remain fundamentally limited by the ground truth paradox, which arises from the absence of noise-free, ground truth reference images in in vivo scenarios. Existing unsupervised diffusion-based methods typically enforce data consistency directly in the nonlinear log-compressed domain, which can disproportionately amplify background artifacts when mapped back to the envelope domain. To overcome these limitations, we propose an uncertainty-guided null-space diffusion (UGNS) framework, a novel label-free solution that enforces consistency correction on a stabilized positive-envelope proxy obtained via inverse log compression. The proposed UGNS introduces several technical novelties: (a) extraction of a structural prior in the stabilized envelope domain to produce a robust signal envelope that preserves anatomical structure, (b) development of an adaptive range-null reconstruction mechanism that uses an adaptive weight mask to preserve tissue regions via range-space projection, and (c) introduction of uncertainty-guided fusion in an adaptive way to mitigate sampling variability. Extensive and comparative experiments were conducted using the PICMUS benchmark and in vivo datasets. The results demonstrate that UGNS achieves competitive generalized contrast-to-noise ratio (gCNR) values across diverse datasets. In addition, it is successfully validated that UGNS effectively suppresses speckle noise while preserving fine spatial resolution. Code is available at https://github.com/yousirong/UGNS.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为UGNS的无标签超声图像去斑框架，通过不确定性引导的零空间扩散方法，在稳定包络域中进行一致性校正，克服了监督学习的ground truth悖论和现有无监督方法在log压缩域直接约束带来的伪影放大问题。
AI.motivation: 超声B模式成像常受散斑噪声和伪影影响，需在对比度、分辨率和结构保真间取得平衡。现有监督学习方法因缺乏无噪声的真实参考图像而受困于ground truth悖论；现有无监督扩散方法直接在非线性log压缩域施加数据一致性约束，映射回包络域时会不成比例地放大背景伪影。
AI.method: UGNS框架包含三个核心技术：(a)在稳定包络域中提取结构先验以获得保留解剖结构的鲁棒信号包络；(b)设计自适应范围-零空间重建机制，利用自适应权重掩码通过范围空间投影保留组织区域；(c)引入不确定性引导的自适应融合机制以缓解采样变异性。
AI.result: 在PICMUS基准和体内数据集上的大量对比实验表明，UGNS在多样数据集上获得了具有竞争力的广义对比噪声比(gCNR)值，同时有效抑制散斑噪声并保持精细的空间分辨率。
AI.conclusion: UGNS作为一种新型无标签去斑方案，通过逆log压缩获得稳定的正包络代理并施加一致性校正，成功解决了无监督扩散方法在log压缩域直接约束的问题，在抑制散斑与保持分辨率之间实现了良好平衡。

title: Label Semantic Expansion via Label Guided Neural Topic Modeling
summary: Topic models are widely used for content analysis, where users often analyze corpora around predefined labels rather than unordered latent topics. Existing label-aware topic models mainly follow a labels-for-topics perspective, using labels to guide topic learning, while the learned topics are not directly usable for label-centered analysis. We explore the reverse topics-for-labels perspective and instantiate it as Label Semantic Expansion (LSE), which enriches sparse label representations with corpus-grounded descriptive topic words. To exploit topics in LSE effectively, we propose a Label-Guided Neural Topic Model (LGNTM), which learns dedicated label-aligned topics, grounds them in lexical and document semantic spaces, and preserves consistency between topic structures and label structures. Experiments on label-topic alignment, label expansion, topic quality, and downstream classification demonstrate strong overall performance across complementary evaluation dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出从"主题服务于标签"的反向视角（topics-for-labels）来解决标签中心的内容分析问题，通过标签语义扩展（LSE）利用语料库中的描述性主题词来丰富稀疏的标签表示，并设计了标签引导的神经主题模型（LGNTM）来学习对齐标签的主题。
AI.motivation: 现有标签感知主题模型主要采用"标签引导主题"（labels-for-topics）的视角，即用标签指导主题学习，但学到的主题不能直接用于标签中心的分析任务。实际应用中，用户常常希望围绕预定义标签而非无序的潜在主题来分析语料库，因此需要一种能够让主题直接服务于标签分析的建模方法。
AI.method: 提出标签语义扩展（LSE）框架，将主题用于丰富稀疏的标签表示。具体实现为标签引导神经主题模型（LGNTM）：学习专用于对齐标签的主题，在词汇和文档语义空间中对主题进行接地（grounding），并保持主题结构与标签结构之间的一致性。
AI.result: 在标签-主题对齐、标签扩展、主题质量以及下游分类等多个互补的评估维度上，LGNTM展现出强大的整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过反转传统的研究视角，本文证明了主题作为标签语义扩展工具的有效性，所提出的LGNTM在多维度评估中均表现优异，为标签中心的语料库分析提供了新的解决方案。

title: ContextBias: Controlled Evaluation of Bias Persistence Under Context Shift in Text-to-Image Models
summary: Text-to-image models learn associations between concepts - in the case of this paper, people's professions, which we refer to as roles - and visual attributes. These associations can underpin many observed forms of stereotypical bias. A key open question in this area is whether these associations are stable or change when visual representations of people in professional roles are placed in different prompted contexts. We introduce ContextBias, a controlled evaluation framework, and ContextBench, a benchmark spanning 92 roles and 1,656 semantically controlled prompts, designed to isolate the effect of contextual variation on role-linked visual representations. Evaluating four state-of-the-art models on 66,240 generated images, we find that placing a role in a semantically unrelated context does not suppress role-linked attributes; instead, cross-role attribute concentration increases (pooled BI $+0.047$). Demographic cues, characteristic garments, and role-specific tools remain highly prevalent across context-free, related, and unrelated conditions, and are robust to semantic prompt reformulation. Scene composition and camera framing show the greatest context-sensitivity. These findings reveal a form of stereotypical persistence that remains largely invisible to context-free evaluations, highlighting the need for controlled contextual variation in bias benchmarking. Code and dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/shaghayegh/ContextBias , https://github.com/Sina-Emami/ContextBias

AI.tldr: 本文提出ContextBias评估框架和ContextBench基准（覆盖92种职业角色、1656个语义控制提示），系统研究文生图模型在不同提示上下文中的职业刻板关联稳定性。实验发现：将职业置于语义无关上下文中不会抑制角色关联属性，反而使跨角色属性集中度增加（BI +0.047）；人口统计学线索、特征服装和角色工具在各种条件下持续存在，且对语义提示改写具有鲁棒性；场景构图和镜头取景对上下文最敏感。这一"刻板持续性"在无上下文评估中不可见，凸显了偏差基准测试中控制上下文变化的重要性。
AI.motivation: 文生图模型会将人的职业角色与视觉属性关联，从而产生刻板偏见。关键未解问题在于：这些关联在角色被置于不同提示上下文时是稳定存在的还是会发生改变。现有偏差评估通常只关注无上下文（context-free）条件下的表现，忽略了上下文变化对偏见的影响。
AI.method: 提出ContextBias受控评估框架和ContextBench基准（92个角色、1656个语义控制提示），通过隔离上下文变化来研究角色关联视觉表示。对四个先进模型生成66,240张图像进行评估，比较角色在无上下文、相关上下文、无关上下文条件下的属性表现，并衡量跨角色属性集中度（BI）及各类视觉属性（人口学线索、服装、工具、构图、取景）的稳定性。
AI.result: 将职业置于语义无关上下文中并不会抑制角色关联属性，跨角色属性集中度反而增加（BI +0.047）。人口统计学线索、特征服装和角色工具在所有条件下高度持续存在，对语义提示改写鲁棒。场景构图和镜头取景表现出最大的上下文敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现了一种"刻板持续性"现象——模型对职业角色的刻板联想在不同上下文条件下顽固存在，而这一现象在无上下文评估中不可见。因此偏差基准测试需要引入受控上下文变化，才能更全面地揭示和评估模型的刻板偏见。

title: The Differential Reasoning Router: Operationalizing Cost-Aware LLM Annotation in E-commerce
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to annotate structured product data in e-commerce, but early deployment often begins as a cold-start problem: only limited pre-launch labels are available, the value of expensive reasoning is unknown, and human review is needed before the system can be trusted at scale. This challenge is especially common in rule-based annotation workflows, where each item must satisfy multiple business rules and both model errors and ambiguous rule boundaries affect final decisions. We introduce the Differential Reasoning Router (DRR), a cost-aware framework for cold-start LLM annotation that jointly optimizes model selection and human escalation. Rather than treating a reasoning model as a default fallback, DRR estimates separate success probabilities for a direct model and a reasoning model at both the sample and business-rule levels, enabling adaptive routing: easy cases are handled directly, reasoning is reserved for cases where it is expected to improve the decision, and likely double-failure or rule-disagreement cases are escalated to human annotators. The resulting labels provide targeted ground truth for prompt engineering, supervised fine-tuning, calibration, and rule refinement, enabling a gradual shift from human-heavy cold-start annotation toward high-confidence automated routing. In a production e-commerce workflow, DRR reaches accuracy parity with the strongest confidence-based router while achieving more than 60\% reasoning-token cost savings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Differential Reasoning Router (DRR)框架，用于解决电商领域LLM结构化数据标注的冷启动问题，通过联合优化模型选择与人工升级来节省推理成本。
AI.motivation: LLM在电商结构化数据标注中的初期部署面临冷启动问题：预上线标签有限、昂贵推理的价值未知、在系统可被信任之前需要人工审核，尤其在基于规则的标注流程中，模型错误与规则边界模糊都会影响最终决策。
AI.method: DRR框架在样本级和业务规则级分别估计直接模型与推理模型的成功概率，实现自适应路由：简单案例直接处理，推理模型仅用于预期能改善决策的情况，对可能双重失败或规则分歧的案例升级给人工标注者。
AI.result: 在电商生产工作流中，DRR达到与最强基于置信度的路由器相同的精度，同时节省超过60%的推理token成本。
AI.conclusion: DRR产生的标注可作为提示工程、监督微调、校准和规则优化的目标真实标签，实现从人工密集的冷启动标注向高置信度自动化路由的逐步过渡。

title: MariSat: A Maritime Dataset for Instance Segmentation of Objects in Satellite and Aerial Images
summary: Automated maritime surveillance from satellite and aerial imagery requires large, precisely annotated datasets, which remain scarce for the instance-segmentation task, particularly for small vessels in cluttered port environments. We present MariSat, a new benchmark dataset of 1260 aerial and satellite images covering diverse port and coastal scenes, annotated at the pixel level for eight maritime object classes (sailboat, yacht, jet-ski, fishing boat, cruise ship, military vessel, tugboat and cargo ship). The dataset was produced through a semi-automatic annotation pipeline combining the textpromptable segmentation model SAM 3 with a cascade of geometric and colorimetric post-processing filters, followed by a manual correction and quality-control pass performed with the CVAT annotation platform. We describe the image-collection methodology, the annotation and correction process, and the resulting data organization. We also report class-wise statistics for the training, validation, and test splits. MariSat has already been used to fine-tune and benchmark segmentation and detection models (SAM 3 and YOLO11) for real-time maritime monitoring. We report detailed quantitative and per-class results for both tasks. The MariSat dataset is publicly available on GitHub : https://github.com/amirabbes/P2M-Maritime-Segmentation

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了MariSat，一个包含1260张航拍和卫星图像的海上监视基准数据集，针对八类海上目标进行像素级实例分割标注，并通过半自动标注流程（SAM 3结合几何和比色滤波）以及CVAT人工校正生成，已在GitHub上公开。
AI.motivation: 自动海上监视需要大规模、精确标注的数据集，但针对实例分割任务、特别是港口复杂环境中小型船只的标注数据集仍然稀缺，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用半自动标注流水线：首先使用文本提示分割模型SAM 3进行初始分割，再通过级联的几何和比色后处理滤波器进行精炼，最后使用CVAT标注平台进行人工修正和质量控制。数据集包含八类海上目标（帆船、游艇、摩托艇、渔船、邮轮、军用船只、拖船和货船），划分为训练、验证和测试集。
AI.result: 提供了各类别的统计数据，并使用MariSat对SAM 3和YOLO11进行了分割与检测模型的微调和基准测试，给出了详细的定量和每类结果。
AI.conclusion: MariSat为海上监视领域的实例分割任务提供了高质量、公开可用的基准数据集，支持实时海上监控场景下的模型训练与评估。

title: Quantifying and Mitigating Korean Jamo-Level Typographical Vulnerabilities in Large Language Models
summary: Korean introduces an additional typographical perturbation level not captured by ordinary character-level edit models: because syllable blocks are internally composed of sub-character units called jamo, keyboard-level errors can occur within a syllable, either producing a valid but semantically altered character or exposing raw jamo on the surface. Both outcomes disrupt sub-word tokenization and are not reliably corrected by existing grammatical error correction pipelines, leaving LLMs directly exposed to corrupted inputs. To quantify this vulnerability, we apply five jamo-level perturbation types to the KMMLU benchmark and evaluate four language models, finding that accuracy declines monotonically with perturbation intensity and that parameter scaling does not confer robustness against intra-syllabic noise. We further show that typo-corrupted inputs induce a distinct shift in internal representations that is not reducible to ordinary answer incorrectness, and that a simple linear probe trained on these representations detects unseen perturbation types with high AUROC. Motivated by this signal, we propose Typo-Aware Chain-of-Thought (TACoT), which routes inputs to chain-of-thought inference only when the probe detects a likely typo, recovering a substantial portion of the CoT accuracy gain at a fraction of the inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文针对韩语特有的jamo（音节内子字符单元）级别的键盘输入错误，系统性地研究了其对大语言模型的影响。作者在KMMLU基准上引入五种jamo级扰动，发现模型准确率随扰动强度单调下降，且参数规模扩大并不能提高鲁棒性。进一步研究发现，拼写错误输入会引起内部表征的独特偏移，线性探针可高AUROC检测未见过的扰动类型。基于此，作者提出TACoT（Typo-Aware Chain-of-Thought）方法，仅在探针检测到疑似拼写错误时才启用链式思维推理，在保留大部分CoT准确率收益的同时大幅降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 韩语的音节块由更小的子字符单元jamo组成，这引入了传统字符级编辑模型无法捕捉的额外打字错误层面。键盘错误可能在同一音节内发生，产生语义改变的有效字符或暴露原始jamo，这破坏了子词分词，且现有的语法纠错管道无法可靠修复，使LLM直接暴露于被破坏的输入中。作者旨在量化这一漏洞并寻找解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 在KMMLU基准上设计了五种jamo级扰动类型来模拟键盘级输入错误；2) 评估了四个语言模型在不同扰动强度下的表现；3) 分析内部表征，证明拼写错误输入引起的表征偏移不同于普通答案错误；4) 训练线性探针检测扰动输入，具有高AUROC并能泛化到未见过的扰动类型；5) 提出TACoT方法，根据探针检测结果自适应地决定是否启用链式思维推理。
AI.result: 研究发现模型准确率随扰动强度单调下降，参数规模扩展不能抵御音节内噪声。线性探针能有效检测未见的扰动类型（高AUROC）。TACoT方法在检测到拼写错误时才调用链式思维推理，恢复了大部分CoT准确率增益，同时大幅减少了推理计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 韩语jamo级键盘错误是LLM面临的一种独特且未充分研究的脆弱性，但内部表征中蕴含可检测的信号。利用该信号进行自适应的推理路由（TACoT）可以在准确性与推理成本之间取得更优的平衡，为多语言LLM鲁棒性研究提供了新思路。

title: OptiGeo: Efficient Monocular Geometry for Embodied Perception in Optically Challenging Scenes
summary: Monocular depth estimation has achieved strong open-domain generalization, yet reliable robotic deployment remains difficult in transparent, reflective, and specular environments, where depth sensors often produce missing or biased depth. Existing methods often handle such optical failures with scene-specific preprocessing, auxiliary modules, or post-hoc fine-tuning. While effective in constrained settings, these designs increase architectural redundancy and can over-specialize general geometry models to narrow optical scenarios. We revisit this problem as a localized failure mode within base-model training and identify sensor-induced supervision bias as a key bottleneck: models inherit sensor failure patterns from biased real-depth supervision in optically challenging regions. We then introduce OptiGeo, a bias-aware training framework that rehabilitates biased real supervision using a clean-geometry teacher and residual-trimmed alignment. We redefine transparency-targeted rendering as a compact source of clean optical geometry, rather than a large domain-specific fine-tuning set. With only a small targeted rendering set, OptiGeo learns the geometric structure of transparent objects and regions, correcting local geometry distortions that real sensors cannot reliably supervise. Despite only 30M parameters, OptiGeo outperforms substantially larger 300M-scale monocular models and billion-scale multi-view baselines on transparent-scene benchmarks, while remaining competitive on general zero-shot depth and boundary sharpness. Real-world navigation cases further validate its practicality as an efficient perception module in optically challenging scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OptiGeo，一种偏差感知训练框架，用于解决单目深度估计在透明、反射和镜面环境中的可靠部署问题。通过干净几何教师和残差修剪对齐来修复传感器偏差监督，仅用30M参数即可在透明场景基准上超越300M级甚至十亿级模型。
AI.motivation: 现有单目深度估计方法在透明、反射和镜面环境中传感器常产生缺失或偏差深度，而现有处理方法依赖场景特定预处理、辅助模块或事后微调，增加架构冗余且会过度特化通用几何模型到狭窄光学场景。作者将问题重新定义为基模型训练中的局部失效模式，识别出传感器诱导的监督偏差是关键瓶颈。
AI.method: OptiGeo采用偏差感知训练框架，核心包含两个组件：(1) 干净几何教师（clean-geometry teacher）用于修复有偏差的真实监督；(2) 残差修剪对齐（residual-trimmed alignment）进一步处理监督偏差。作者将透明目标渲染重新定义为干净光学几何的紧凑来源，而非大规模领域特定微调集，仅用小型定向渲染集即可学习透明物体的几何结构。
AI.result: OptiGeo仅30M参数，在透明场景基准上超越300M级单目模型和十亿级多视图基线，同时在通用零样本深度和边界锐度方面保持竞争力，真实世界导航案例验证了其在光学挑战场景中的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，将光学失效视为基模型训练中的局部失败模式并通过偏差感知训练来修复，比大规模领域特定微调更高效，无需增加庞大参数或复杂辅助模块即可实现可靠的透明场景深度估计。

title: PaperBanana-Interact: Scientific Diagram Refinement with Multi-Turn Human Feedback
summary: Recent efforts have aimed to automate scientific diagram generation from paper content (Lin et al., 2026; Zhu et al., 2026a). However, fully satisfying an author's visual and communicative preferences in a single turn is challenging: in our formative user study (N = 14), all participants requested further revisions after viewing an initial draft, and 86% of them rated the refined diagrams as more satisfactory. Despite the clear demand, the multi-turn workflow remains largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we present MTPaperBananaBench, a benchmark for multi-turn diagram generation containing 292 images annotated with 3,518 user requirements. To reduce expensive human studies and enable scalable benchmarking, we construct a user simulator that, at each turn, identifies unsatisfied requirements and converts k of them into natural language feedback. Evaluating both requirement satisfaction and overall diagram quality reveals two key failure modes shared across baseline multiturn systems: (1) quality drift, where diagram quality progressively declines over turns, and (2) forgetting, where previously implemented features are lost in subsequent turns. To address these issues, we introduce PaperBanana-Interact, a multi-agent system that refines diagrams via an internal critique-and-refine loop. PaperBanana-Interact consistently improves rather than degrades diagram quality across turns, outperforming baselines by 11.9-18.6 points in quality score and reducing forgetting by 3.7-6.2 points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MTPaperBananaBench基准，用于评测多轮科学图表生成，并引入PaperBanana-Interact多智能体系统，通过内部批判-优化循环解决质量漂移和遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: 自动化科学图表生成虽已有研究，但单轮生成难以满足作者的视觉和沟通偏好。用户研究显示所有参与者都要求多轮修改，而多轮工作流却未被充分探索。
AI.method: 构建包含292张图像和3,518条用户需求的MTPaperBananaBench基准；设计用户模拟器用于将未满足需求转化为自然语言反馈以减少人工成本；提出PaperBanana-Interact多智能体系统，通过内部critique-and-refine循环进行多轮图表优化。
AI.result: PaperBanana-Interact在多轮迭代中持续提升图表质量而非劣化，质量分数比基线高11.9-18.6分，遗忘问题减少3.7-6.2分。
AI.conclusion: 多轮交互式图表生成是满足用户需求的关键路径，PaperBanana-Interact有效解决了多轮系统中的质量漂移和遗忘两大问题。

title: MASQ: Mask-Aware Spatiotemporal Quantization for Unsupervised Skeleton Action Segmentation
summary: Unsupervised skeleton-based temporal action segmentation is a crucial task for understanding human behavior in long untrimmed sequences. Recent approaches often rely on discrete quantization to discover action boundaries from motion representations. However, when spatial masking is introduced for representation learning, it can introduce representation ambiguity, while discrete quantization further amplifies small fluctuations in the latent space. The interaction between these two factors often leads to unstable code switching and severe temporal jitter near action boundaries.To address these limitations, we propose a novel Mask-aware Action Spatiotemporal Quantization (MASQ) framework. Our framework decouples the conflicting tasks of spatial feature inference and temporal smoothing.In the spatial dimension, we introduce a Joint-Level Structured Dropout (JLSD) mechanism that masks the entire temporal trajectory of selected joints, to encourage the model to learn discriminative inter-joint coordination patterns. In the temporal dimension, we design a mask-aware velocity loss that enforces motion consistency only on visible joints, that prevents gradient conflicts caused by masked signals and stabilizing temporal predictions. Extensive experiments on three widely used skeleton datasets, including HuGaDB, LARa, and BABEL, demonstrate that the proposed MASQ framework significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art unsupervised methods. In particular, our model establishes a comprehensive and substantial leading advantage in the Mean over Frames accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种名为MASQ的无监督骨架时间动作分割框架，通过解耦空间特征推理与时间平滑两个冲突任务，引入关节级结构化丢弃机制和遮挡感知速度损失，在三个骨骼数据集上显著超越现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的无监督骨架动作分割方法依赖离散量化来发现动作边界，但空间掩蔽引入的表示模糊性与离散量化对潜在空间中微小波动的放大作用相互交互，导致动作边界附近的代码切换不稳定和严重的时间抖动问题。
AI.method: 提出MASQ框架：空间维度采用关节级结构化丢弃（JLSD）机制，掩蔽所选关节的完整时间轨迹以鼓励学习判别性的关节间协调模式；时间维度设计掩蔽感知速度损失，仅对可见关节强制执行运动一致性，防止掩蔽信号引起的梯度冲突并稳定时间预测。
AI.result: 在HuGaDB、LARa和BABEL三个骨骼数据集上的大量实验表明，MASQ框架显著优于现有最先进的无监督方法，尤其在Mean over Frames准确率指标上建立了全面且实质性的领先优势。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦空间特征推断与时间平滑的冲突目标，MASQ有效缓解了动作边界处的不稳定代码切换和时间抖动问题，为无监督骨架时间动作分割提供了更鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Beyond Surface Forms: Symbolic Edits as a Test for Logical Reasoning with LLMs
summary: Logical reasoning with large language models (LLMs) is a critical capability, as it reflects a system's ability to correctly deduce hypotheses from a given context using faithful deductive processes. However, LLM reasoning has often been shown to be sensitive to small surface-level variations in problem formulation, raising questions about whether models truly follow the underlying logical structure. Studying this behavior is challenging because the symbolic components of logical problems, such as operators and predicates, are difficult to systematically manipulate in natural language. We introduce a tool-driven framework for generating controlled, label-preserving edits to logical reasoning problems. Our method operates on symbolic representations of first-order logic and constraint satisfaction problem tasks, enabling targeted modifications to logical operators and other structural components before translating them back into natural language. Using this framework, we evaluate various LLMs under cumulative and individual operator edits and analyze their behavior in response to these changes. Our quantitative and qualitative analyses show that LLM reasoning behavior under controlled operator edits is inconsistent, regardless of model size or family: models sometimes adapt correctly to structural changes but often fail to track their logical consequences. The results from this automated stress test enable an evaluation of language models across different dimensions and help measure the reliability of their reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于工具驱动的框架，用于生成受控且保持标签不变的逻辑推理问题编辑，通过修改一阶逻辑和约束满足问题中的逻辑算子来压力测试LLM的推理可靠性。实验表明，不同规模和系列的LLM在算子编辑下的推理行为不一致，有时能正确适应结构变化，但常常无法追踪其逻辑后果。
AI.motivation: LLM的逻辑推理能力对表面级问题表述变化高度敏感，这引发了对模型是否真正遵循逻辑结构的质疑。然而，由于自然语言中逻辑算子和谓词等符号成分难以系统性地操控，研究这一行为面临挑战。
AI.method: 引入一个工具驱动的框架，在符号层面（一阶逻辑和约束满足问题）对逻辑推理问题进行受控、标签保持的编辑，将修改后的逻辑表达式翻译回自然语言，并在累积和个体算子编辑条件下评估多种LLM。
AI.result: 定量和定性分析表明，LLM在受控算子编辑下的推理行为不一致，无论模型规模或家族如何：模型有时能正确适应结构变化，但往往无法追踪其逻辑后果。
AI.conclusion: 该自动化压力测试框架能够从不同维度评估语言模型，帮助衡量其推理的可靠性，揭示了当前LLM在逻辑推理鲁棒性方面的系统性不足。

title: Off-Manifold Refinement: Guiding Video Generators with a Frozen World Model
comment: Accepted at BMVC 2026. Project page: https://itruonghai.github.io/omr
summary: Modern video generators routinely fail at physical dynamics: objects float, trajectories violate gravity, contacts vanish. Standard denoising and flow-matching objectives fit visual data distributions but do not explicitly penalize such physical violations. Existing remedies can improve physical consistency, but typically add substantial inference or training cost. Candidate-selection methods generate and score multiple videos, while gradient-based world-model guidance repeatedly decodes and re-encodes intermediate estimates. Generator-internal refinement adds perturbation and re-denoising loops, whereas post-training requires curated data and additional optimization. We propose Off-Manifold Refinement (OMR), an inference-time method that instead injects world-model feedback directly into a single sampling trajectory. During scheduled middle ODE steps, we augment the generator velocity with the gradient of an adapter-space V-JEPA 2.1 surprise energy. This external correction can move the latent away from the uncorrected sampling trajectory and toward regions ranked as more physically plausible by the frozen predictor, after which the generator continues rendering from the corrected state. A small trained latent-to-embedding adapter keeps the gradient tractable at inference, and both the video generator and the world model remain frozen. On our fixed 400-prompt VideoPhy-2 detailed subset, OMR lifts the joint Semantic-Adherence-and-Physical-Commonsense metric from 47.0% to 52.0% (+5.0pp absolute, +10.6% relative) over the base Wan2.2-T2V-A14B sampler. On a separate fixed 50-prompt efficiency subset, it requires $1.71 \times$ the base runtime rather than the multiplicative cost of reward/search alternatives. Project page: https://itruonghai.github.io/omr.

AI.tldr: 提出Off-Manifold Refinement (OMR)，一种推理期方法，通过在单一采样轨迹中注入世界模型（V-JEPA 2.1）的梯度反馈来修正视频生成中的物理违规问题，无需额外训练生成器或世界模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成器经常违反物理规律（物体漂浮、轨迹不合引力、接触消失）。标准去噪和流匹配目标只拟合视觉数据分布，不显式惩罚物理违规。现有解决方案要么增加大量推理/训练成本（候选选择、梯度世界模型引导、生成器内部精炼、后训练），效率低。
AI.method: 在调度中间ODE步骤中，将基于adapter空间的V-JEPA 2.1 surprise能量的梯度直接注入生成器速度。外部修正可将潜在状态从未修正的采样轨迹推向物理上更合理的区域。小型latent-to-embedding adapter保持推理时梯度可计算，视频生成器和世界模型保持冻结。
AI.result: 在400提示词的VideoPhy-2详细子集上，将Semantic-Adherence-and-Physical-Commonsense指标从47.0%提升至52.0%（+5.0pp绝对提升，+10.6%相对提升）。在50提示词效率子集上只需1.71倍基础运行时，远低于奖励/搜索替代方案的成本。
AI.conclusion: OMR证明了在不修改生成器或世界模型的情况下，通过推理期物理反馈注入，能以较低成本有效改善视频生成的物理一致性。

title: Stratified Consistency Distillation for Natural Language Formalization
summary: Neurosymbolic reasoning has shown promising success in addressing complex reasoning tasks by combining large language models (LLMs) and symbolic solvers. While this approach shows promise, a fundamental challenge remains: improving the accuracy of translations from natural language to logical formulas. Current methods predominantly rely on prompt engineering, which is difficult to scale across different domains and input formats. Drawing inspiration from the success of fine-tuning in other model adaptation and alignment applications, we propose a fine-tuning-based Stratified Consistency Distillation approach: (1) We generate K logical translations per input using a frontier LLM and cluster them by semantic equivalence (2) Based on the entropy level, we apply majority voting (low entropy), LLM-as-a-Judge (medium entropy), or unification/abstention (high entropy), and (3) fine-tune a smaller model using the selected pseudo-labels. Our experiments show significant and consistent improvements in both Pass@K and our novel Equivalent Logical Similarity metrics, demonstrating the potential of advancing logical translation through consistency distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于微调的分层一致性蒸馏方法，用于提升神经符号推理中自然语言到逻辑公式的翻译准确性。通过根据熵水平选用多数投票、LLM评审或统一/弃权策略生成伪标签，并微调小模型，实验在Pass@K和新增的等效逻辑相似度指标上均取得显著改进。
AI.motivation: 神经符号推理结合LLM与符号求解器虽取得进展，但自然语言到逻辑公式的翻译准确性仍是核心挑战。现有方法主要依赖提示工程，难以跨领域和输入格式扩展。
AI.method: 提出分层一致性蒸馏方法：(1) 使用前沿LLM为每个输入生成K个逻辑翻译，并按语义等价性聚类；(2) 根据熵水平选择标签策略——低熵用多数投票，中熵用LLM-as-a-Judge，高熵用统一/弃权；(3) 使用选定的伪标签微调较小的模型。
AI.result: 实验在Pass@K和新增的等效逻辑相似度（Equivalent Logical Similarity）指标上均显示出显著且一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过一致性蒸馏可以有效提升逻辑翻译的性能，展示了超越提示工程、通过微调推进逻辑翻译准确性的潜力。

title: OrnaStyler: Ornament-Aware Latent Editing for Content-Preserving 3D Stylization
summary: Text-guided style editing of 3D assets is essential for adapting existing objects to diverse visual aesthetics in digital content creation. Despite rapid progress in 3D shape modeling, faithfully stylizing an existing asset remains challenging when the desired stylization involves fine-grained structural ornamentation, which requires the model to preserve the source geometry and object identity, while coherently integrating new style-specific details. We propose \textbf{OrnaStyler}, a zero-shot framework for text-guided ornament-aware 3D stylization. Built upon rectified flow-based generative modeling, OrnaStyler introduces an inversion-guided editing strategy that recovers content-aware latent representations at both geometry and appearance levels in a staged manner to facilitate faithful editing. Our core idea is to explicitly model the spatial configuration of stylistic elements, thereby mitigating the fundamental tension between content preservation and style expression in the voxel space. Specifically, at the geometry level, we manipulate voxel representations through flow inversion to synthesize ornament-enhanced structures while preserving the spatial identity of the source asset. Then, at the appearance level, we introduce an adjacency-aware feature inpainting mechanism to harmonize newly generated ornaments with the original content, yielding coherent geometry-appearance integration. Our approach operates solely in the inference phase and enables selective editing over geometric augmentation or appearance stylization. Extensive experiments on both generated and real-world 3D assets against prior methods demonstrate that OrnaStyler achieves state-of-the-art editing performance in terms of content preservation, style fidelity, and overall visual realism. Code is available at: https://github.com/tomohiro0427/OrnaStyler

AI.tldr: OrnaStyler是一个零样本的文本引导3D资产风格化框架，基于整流流生成建模，通过反演引导的分阶段编辑策略（几何层面流反演合成装饰增强结构，外观层面邻域感知特征修复实现几何-外观融合），在推理阶段即可实现内容保持与风格表达的平衡，达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D风格化方法在面对细粒度结构性装饰时难以在保持源几何和物体身份的同时整合新的风格细节，内容保持与风格表达之间存在根本性矛盾。
AI.method: 基于整流流生成建模，提出反演引导的编辑策略，分阶段恢复几何和外观层面的内容感知潜表征。几何层通过流反演操纵体素表示合成装饰增强结构；外观层引入邻域感知特征修复机制实现装饰与原始内容的和谐融合。
AI.result: 在生成和真实世界3D资产上均超越先前方法，在内容保持、风格保真度和整体视觉真实感方面达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: OrnaStyler通过显式建模风格元素的空间配置，缓解了体素空间中内容保持与风格表达的张力，且仅在推理阶段运行，支持对几何增强或外观风格化的选择性编辑。

title: Using Prosody to Predict Syntactic Structure
summary: While it is well-established that prosody carries crucial cues for syntactic structure, the degree and nature of correspondence between these two domains remains contested. We investigate the syntax-prosody interface through an information-theoretic lens, quantifying the interaction between prosodic features and syntactic representations as their mutual information. We provide a general-purpose framework for estimating this quantity over large speech-text corpora using multimodal language models. Our framework is structure-agnostic and modular, insofar as it can be used to measure the contributions of individual prosodic features or components of structure. We evaluate the syntax-prosody relationship for two features (word duration and inter-word pauses) across two domains--read audiobooks and spontaneous conversations--both in English. Our results demonstrate that prosody contains measurable syntactic information, with prosodic features reducing syntactic uncertainty in spontaneous conversations by up to 10.2%. Our findings offer new empirical support for several theoretical accounts of the syntax-prosody interface.

AI.tldr: 本文通过信息论视角，利用多模态语言模型量化韵律特征与句法结构之间的互信息，提出一个通用的、与结构无关的框架，在英语有声书和自发对话两个领域中评估词汇时长和词间停顿两个韵律特征。结果表明韵律包含可测量的句法信息，在自发对话中最多可将句法不确定性降低10.2%。
AI.motivation: 韵律与句法结构之间的对应关系程度和性质一直存在争议，作者希望用信息论方法定量刻画两者的交互，为理论争论提供实证依据。
AI.method: 采用信息论框架，计算韵律特征与句法表示之间的互信息；利用多模态语言模型在大规模语音-文本语料上估计该量；框架具有结构无关性和模块化特点，可分别衡量单个韵律特征或句法结构成分的贡献。对词时长和词间停顿两个韵律特征，在朗读有声书和自发对话两个英语领域中进行评估。
AI.result: 韵律包含可测量的句法信息，韵律特征在自发对话中最多可将句法不确定性降低10.2%。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为多个关于韵律-句法界面的理论解释提供了新的实证支持。

title: Matrix-Game 3.5: Enhancing Real-Time Streaming Interactive World Models with Patch Memory
summary: Interactive world models extend video generation from offline clip synthesis toward persistent simulation of interactive virtual worlds, enabling applications in games, robotics, embodied agents, and XR. Achieving stable long-horizon interactive generation, however, remains challenging, as the model must simultaneously preserve scene geometry, dynamic consistency, and camera control while supporting real-time autoregressive generation. Building upon Matrix-Game 3.0, we present Matrix-Game 3.5, as shown in Figure 1, which advances real-time interactive world generation toward geometry-aware and long-horizon consistent simulation through three key improvements. First, we propose a unified geometry-aware memory framework, whose patch-memory and tiled-PRoPE components introduce no additional learnable parameters, combining explicit 3D patch retrieval with projective camera conditioning to enable geometry-consistent camera control and faithful long-horizon scene recall. Second, we introduce a static-dynamic disentangled world representation that separately models static scene geometry and dynamic subjects, preserving both geometric consistency and subject identity throughout long-horizon generation. Third, we develop a two-stage progressive real-time distillation framework that converts a bidirectional diffusion model into a few-step causal generator through Perceptual Flow Matching and curriculum based Self-Rollout DMD, enabling minute-long real-time interactive generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, with a unified training corpus spanning Unreal simulation environments, open-world games, and internet videos, MatrixGame 3.5 achieves strong performance in long-horizon scene recall, precise camera control, subject consistency, prompt-driven world generation, and stable real-time open-world interaction.

AI.tldr: Matrix-Game 3.5 是一个面向实时交互式世界生成的统一框架，通过几何感知记忆框架、静态-动态解耦的世界表示以及两阶段渐进式实时蒸馏框架三大改进，实现了分钟级别的实时、长时程、几何一致的交互式世界模拟。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模型从离线视频片段生成向持久化虚拟世界模拟延伸，但长时程交互生成面临三大挑战：需同时保持场景几何一致性、动态一致性和相机控制，并支持实时自回归生成。现有方法难以兼顾这些要求。
AI.method: 提出三项关键技术改进：(1) 统一几何感知记忆框架，包含patch-memory和tiled-PRoPE组件，不引入额外可学习参数，结合显式3D补丁检索与投影相机条件化实现几何一致的相机控制和长时程场景回忆；(2) 静态-动态解耦世界表示，分别建模静态场景几何和动态主体，保持几何一致性与主体身份；(3) 两阶段渐进式实时蒸馏框架，通过感知流匹配和基于课程的自互动DMD将双向扩散模型转化为少步因果生成器，实现分钟级实时交互生成。
AI.result: 在包含Unreal仿真环境、开放世界游戏和互联网视频的统一训练语料上，Matrix-Game 3.5在长时程场景回忆、精确相机控制、主体一致性、提示驱动的世界生成以及稳定的实时开放世界交互方面均展现出优异性能。
AI.conclusion: Matrix-Game 3.5通过几何感知记忆、静态-动态解耦表示和两阶段蒸馏框架，有效解决了实时交互式世界生成中的几何一致性、长时程稳定性与实时性难题，推动了交互式世界模拟向更逼真、更持久的应用场景发展。

title: Read the Room, Read the Image: Understanding Indirect Speech Acts in Multimodal Visual Contexts
summary: Indirect speech acts (ISAs) require pragmatic reasoning over context, as directive intent can- not be inferred from surface form alone. Prior text-based studies and existing multimodal benchmarks largely overlook this requirement, focusing instead on explicitly encoded context or perceptual recognition, and thus underex- plore context-dependent pragmatic understand- ing, particularly in high-context languages such as Korean. We introduce READI, a multimodal benchmark for evaluating ISA understanding through integrated reasoning over visual con- text and dialogue. READI models graded in- directness grounded in pragmatic theory and formulates the task as vision-based pragmatic question answering (V-PQA), supporting cross- lingual evaluation in English and Korean. Ex- periments show that even state-of-the-art multi- modal models struggle with visually grounded indirect speech acts, with performance declin- ing as indirectness increases, underscoring the need for benchmarks that explicitly target con- textual pragmatic reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出READI，一个多模态基准，用于评估模型对间接言语行为（ISA）的理解能力，该任务需要结合视觉上下文和对话进行语用推理，支持英语和韩语的跨语言评估。
AI.motivation: 现有文本研究和多模态基准大多忽视了间接言语行为所需的上下文依赖的语用推理，主要集中在显式编码的上下文或感知识别上，尤其是在韩语等高语境语言中缺乏相关探索。
AI.method: READI基准基于语用学理论对间接性进行分级建模，将任务形式化为基于视觉的语用问答（V-PQA），支持英语和韩语两种语言的跨语言评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，即使最先进的多模态模型在视觉grounded的间接言语行为理解上仍表现困难，且随着间接性程度增加性能明显下降。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态模型在上下文语用推理方面存在显著不足，需要专门针对情境化语用推理的基准来推动该方向的发展。

title: FoundYou: A Unified Model for Personalized Segmentation and Retrieval
summary: Personalized segmentation and personalized retrieval both aim to identify the same physical object across different images. While the former localizes the object within a target image, the latter retrieves images where it appears. Despite this shared instance-level objective, the two tasks have largely evolved separately and are addressed with distinct solutions. In this work, we introduce FoundYou, a unified framework built on the observation that Segment Anything 2 (SAM 2), trained to preserve object identity across video frames, inherently captures instance-level cues. We leverage this property to match objects across independent images, enabling segmentation and retrieval to emerge as two outcomes of the same instance alignment process. This unified view unlocks new capabilities beyond traditional benchmarks, including few-shot personalized retrieval and promptable personalized segmentation with flexible prompts. Extensive experiments show consistent gains over unified and task-specific methods, including +18.4 mIoU on PerMIS and +17.8 mAP on ILIAS. Performance scales with additional references and remains robust to weaker prompts. Beyond personalization, FoundYou achieves state-of-the-art results on category-level retrieval benchmarks. Notably, our approach keeps the SAM 2-small model entirely frozen and adds only 5.9 M trainable parameters, yielding a 52 M-parameter model that is over 75x faster and 20x smaller than the only prior unified solution. Code is available at https://github.com/ga1i13o/FoundYou .

AI.tldr: 本文提出FoundYou，一个基于SAM 2的统一框架，将个性化分割与个性化检索统一为同一实例对齐过程，仅需5.9M可训练参数（冻结SAM 2-small），在PerMIS上+18.4 mIoU、ILIAS上+17.8 mAP，且比现有唯一统一方案快75倍、小20倍。
AI.motivation: 个性化分割和个性化检索都旨在识别不同图像中的同一物理对象，但两者长期以来被分开研究、使用不同的解决方案。作者观察到这两项任务共享实例级目标，希望构建统一框架来同时解决。
AI.method: 利用SAM 2在视频帧间保持对象身份的能力天然捕获实例级线索，通过将对象跨独立图像匹配，使分割和检索成为同一实例对齐过程的两种输出结果。框架支持少样本个性化检索和灵活提示的可提示个性化分割。
AI.result: 在PerMIS上+18.4 mIoU，ILIAS上+17.8 mAP，超越统一方法和任务特定方法；性能随额外参考图像增加而提升，对弱提示保持鲁棒；在类别级检索基准上达到SOTA；仅增加5.9M参数，模型52M，比现有统一方案快75倍、小20倍。
AI.conclusion: FoundYou证明基于SAM 2的实例对齐可以统一个性化分割与检索，不仅性能领先，还大幅降低了模型规模和计算成本，并解锁了少样本检索和灵活提示分割等新能力。

title: AIA$^{2}$: Attribute-Agnostic Imbalance Augmentation for Subgroup Robustness
summary: Attributes describing data content and context can induce diverse imbalance patterns that go beyond label imbalance alone. However, existing studies primarily address label imbalance while overlooking data attributes, such as topics and demographics, which can induce meaningful subgroup structure while causing model degradation on underrepresented subgroups. We propose Attribute-Agnostic Imbalance Augmentation (AIA$^{2}$), a framework for improving model robustness under varying subgroup imbalances without explicit subgroup annotations. AIA$^{2}$ automatically discovers varying imbalances via latent semantic distributions, obtains slices with both learning difficulty and subgroup imbalance deficits, and deploys a large language model (LLM) for subgroup-aware imbalance augmentation. We have evaluated AIA$^{2}$ on 5 popular corpora with rich domains and their attribute values, covering social issues and diverse topics. Results show improved performance on the lowest-performing subgroups and consistent gains over competitive baselines. Ablation studies confirm complementary contributions from each component, and additional analyses show that AIA$^{2}$ provides a practical and consistent way to improve worst-group robustness under data subgroup imbalance. Code is available at https://github.com/trust-nlp/AIA2-Subgroup-Robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AIA²框架，在无显式子组标注的情况下，通过发现潜在语义分布中的子组不均衡并利用大型语言模型进行子组感知的增强，从而提升模型在最差子组上的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注标签不均衡，忽略了数据属性（如主题、人口统计信息）引发的子组不均衡问题，这些属性会导致模型在代表性不足的子组上性能显著退化，而显式的子组标注往往不可得。
AI.method: AIA²框架包含三个核心步骤：(1) 通过潜在语义分布自动发现不同的不均衡模式；(2) 获取同时具有学习难度和子组不均衡缺陷的数据切片；(3) 使用大型语言模型进行子组感知的不均衡增强。
AI.result: 在5个涵盖社会问题和多元主题的语料库上验证，AIA²在最低性能子组上表现提升，并且持续优于竞争基线。消融实验确认了各组件的互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: AIA²提供了一种实用且一致的方法来改善数据子组不均衡下的最差组鲁棒性，且不依赖于显式的子组标注。

title: Continual Test-Time Adaptation via Entropy Sensitivity-Guidance in Strict Online Setting
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) promises robustness under distribution shift by updating a pretrained model on unlabeled test data, but strict online TTA with batch size one and no access to source data is especially prone to drift or collapse. We introduce Sensitivity-Guided Erasing Adaptation (SEGA), a method for strict online continual TTA (CTTA) on corruption-style streams. SEGA uses a small number of structured erasures to probe how predictive entropy changes as information is removed, and uses the resulting per-sample sensitivity trajectories to coordinate recovery and sample selection rather than relying on raw entropy or batch statistics. This yields a practical feedback signal for long-horizon batch-size-one adaptation without periodic resets or model reservoirs. In experiments on ImageNet-C, CIFAR10/100-C, and corruption-generated aquaculture streams treated as controlled corruption-style proxies, SEGA yields consistent robustness and stability gains over strong CTTA baselines while reducing backward passes through sensitivity-based gating.

AI.tldr: SEGA是一种针对严格在线持续测试时适应（CTTA）的方法，通过结构化擦除来探测预测熵的变化轨迹，利用逐样本敏感性信号来协调模型恢复与样本选择，在批次大小为1且无源数据访问的苛刻条件下，无需周期重置或模型储备即可实现稳健的长时程适应。
AI.motivation: 严格的在线TTA（批次大小为1、无源数据访问）在实际中极易出现模型漂移或崩溃，而现有方法依赖原始熵或批次统计量，缺乏可靠的反馈信号来指导长时程适应。
AI.method: SEGA通过对输入进行少量结构化擦除，观测预测熵随信息移除的变化，生成逐样本的敏感性轨迹，并利用这些轨迹同时驱动模型恢复（recovery）和样本选择（sample selection），替代传统基于原始熵或批次统计的反馈机制。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-C、CIFAR10/100-C以及以腐蚀生成的水产养殖流等实验中，SEGA相较于强CTTA基线在稳健性和稳定性上均取得一致提升，同时通过敏感性门控减少了反向传播次数。
AI.conclusion: 敏感性引导的擦除策略为严格在线CTTA提供了一种实用且有效的反馈信号，能够在无需周期重置或模型储备的情况下维持长时程适应的稳定性。

title: Lazy Grounding: Attacking Search Agents with Factual Evidence
summary: Search agents reduce hallucination by grounding answers in retrieved web evidence. Yet reliance on retrieval also creates an attack surface: poisoned corpora with false or malicious documents can cause agents to reproduce misinformation. We show that falsehood is not necessary -- a search agent can be misled by factual evidence for a nearby question, adopting that nearby answer even when it does not answer the current question. We call this failure lazy grounding. We expose lazy grounding using nearby evidence from answer-changing rewrites of benchmark questions. Each document truthfully supports a neighboring rewritten question, but is surfaced for the original question. Across 12 model-benchmark pairs, nearby evidence reduces accuracy by 5.9 points on average and by up to 17.3 points, while inducing nearby-answer adoption in every setting. The effect is stronger when nearby evidence appears later or is more answer-shaped. Our results show that robust search agents must defend against not only misinformation but also the misapplication of factual evidence. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/frankyzha/lazy-grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文发现并验证了一种新的搜索智能体幻觉来源——"惰性接地"（lazy grounding）：即使检索到的文档是真实正确的，但若它是对相邻问题（而非当前问题）的正确答案，也会误导智能体采用该答案。在12组模型-基准测试中，相邻证据平均使准确率下降5.9个百分点，最高达17.3个百分点，且每种设置下都出现相邻答案采纳现象。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注检索语料中毒（恶意/虚假文档）对搜索智能体的攻击，但作者提出即使证据本身完全真实，也可能因"张冠李戴"而误导智能体，这是一个此前未被系统研究的安全漏洞。
AI.method: 通过对基准问题生成改写（answer-changing rewrites）来构造相邻问题，将这些相邻问题的真实证据作为检索结果呈现给原始问题，从而暴露"惰性接地"失效模式。实验覆盖12个模型-基准测试对，并分析证据位置和"答案形状"对效果的影响。
AI.result: 相邻证据平均降低准确率5.9个百分点，最高降低17.3个百分点；所有12个设置中均出现相邻答案采纳；当相邻证据出现在较后位置或更接近答案形态时，误导效果更强。
AI.conclusion: 稳健的搜索智能体不仅需要防御虚假/恶意信息，还必须防御"真实证据的误用"——即事实正确但回答不相干问题的证据。代码已公开。

title: Towards Continual Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models in Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) relies on vision-language alignment to recognize arbitrary text-defined categories, yet this alignment is fragile under continual test-time distribution shift. Our diagnostic analysis reveals that entropy minimization drives patch-level class collapse, continual updates erode vision-language alignment, and redundant gradients from low-shift samples waste computation. We propose Diversify, Anchor, and Filter (DAF), a stabilization framework that augments entropy-based adaptation with a marginal diversity loss that resists collapse, a cross-modal anchor consistency loss that constrains feature drift relative to a frozen source model, and feature salience filtering that skips low-value backward passes to offset part of the source-anchor overhead. We evaluate on five datasets spanning natural scenes, autonomous driving, underwater imagery, and remote sensing with their corrupted variants. Across the evaluated continual shifts, DAF remains stable where entropy minimization collapses, improving mIoU by over 8 points on Pascal VOC20-C, over 9 points on LoveDA, and over 3 points on Foggy Cityscapes compared to the source model, and is robust to aggressive adaptation and learning rate choices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAF框架解决开放词汇语义分割在持续测试时分布偏移下视觉-语言对齐脆弱的问题，通过边际多样性损失、跨模态锚定一致性和特征显著性过滤三个组件稳定熵最小化自适应过程。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇语义分割依赖视觉-语言对齐来识别任意文本定义的类别，但这种对齐在持续测试时分布偏移下非常脆弱。诊断分析发现熵最小化会导致斑块级类别坍缩、持续更新侵蚀视觉-语言对齐、低偏移样本的冗余梯度浪费计算资源。
AI.method: 提出DAF（Diversify, Anchor, Filter）稳定化框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 边际多样性损失用于抵抗斑块级类别坍缩；(2) 跨模态锚定一致性损失，通过与冻结源模型的约束限制特征漂移；(3) 特征显著性过滤，跳过低价值反向传播以抵消源锚定的计算开销。
AI.result: 在五个数据集（自然场景、自动驾驶、水下影像、遥感及其损坏变体）上评估，DAF在熵最小化崩溃的场景中保持稳定；相比源模型在Pascal VOC20-C上提升超过8个mIoU点，在LoveDA上提升超过9个点，在Foggy Cityscapes上提升超过3个点，且对激进的自适应和学习率选择具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DAF框架有效解决了开放词汇语义分割在持续测试时分布偏移下的稳定性问题，通过多样性约束、锚定约束和计算过滤三者协同，既保持了自适应能力又防止了模型崩溃。

title: Beyond Token-Level Guidance: Inference-Time Alignment of Specialized LLMs via Cross-Family Representation Steering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) finetuned for specialized domains represent crucial high-impact applications. Inference-time alignment improves safety degraded from specialization finetuning without requiring substantial computational resources, complementing finetuning-based methods with an easy-to-use, plug-and-play solution. However, existing inference-time methods fail to reliably improve safety without disrupting domain capability. We identify the root cause as complementary expertise orthogonality: specialized base models and general-domain guidance models have orthogonal competencies, making the guidance signal unreliable for specialized generation. This primarily manifests as stop token interference, where the guidance model's tendency toward continuation overrides the base model's decision to stop, burying correct answers under guidance-induced continuation. To address this problem, we propose CREST, an inference-time alignment method that steers base model hidden representations using safety directions extracted from a guidance model of any family, avoiding token-level structural limitations entirely. CREST improves safety where specialization has weakened it while preserving both domain-specific capability and the safety of already well-aligned models, outperforming baselines by up to 22.2\% on safety benchmarks. Our code is available at: https://github.com/DecayingSeart/CREST.

AI.tldr: 提出CREST，一种推理时对齐方法，通过在隐藏表示层面使用安全方向引导，解决了专门化微调后LLM的安全性退化问题，同时不破坏领域能力。
AI.motivation: 领域微调会降低LLM的安全性，现有推理时对齐方法不可靠地改善安全性，同时会破坏领域能力。根本原因在于专门化基础模型和通用引导模型的互补专长正交性，主要表现为停止标记干扰（stop token interference）。
AI.method: CREST通过从任意家族的引导模型中提取安全方向，在基础模型的隐藏表示层面进行引导，完全避免了token级别的结构限制，从而解决停止标记干扰问题。
AI.result: CREST在安全性基准上比基线方法最高提升22.2%，在改善弱化安全性的同时保持领域特定能力和已良好对齐模型的安全性。
AI.conclusion: 推理时隐藏表示层面的安全引导是解决专门化微调安全性退化的有效方案，优于现有的token级方法。

title: Hallucination Mitigation for Large Vision-Language Models via Implicit Feature Stabilization
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) are prone to hallucinations: they fluently describe objects, attributes, and scenes that are not in the image. We connect part of this failure to a measurable property of their representations, feature instability, where mild semantics-preserving perturbations of the input cause large changes in the learned embeddings; hallucination rates rise together with this variability. Existing stability-motivated remedies are explicit, in the sense that they intervene at inference time through latent steering or constrained decoding, and pay for it on every query. We propose implicit stabilization instead: perturbation-invariance is built into the model weights during fine-tuning, and nothing extra runs at deployment. Our framework, INFUSE, first stabilizes visual and textual representations around perturbation-averaged and ground-truth anchors, then aligns the stabilized representations across modalities with bidirectional contrastive objectives. We prove that the anchor's root-mean-square deviation from the perturbation-mean representation shrinks at rate $1/\sqrt{K}$ in the number of views, and that under a Lipschitz decoder, this bounds how much any perturbation can change the model's hallucination behavior. On LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-1.6, and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, INFUSE reduces AMBER CHAIR by 46-63% relative to each base model, improves ObjHal, MMHal, HallusionBench, and POPE, and preserves VQA-v2 and TextVQA, all with no inference-time overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出INFUSE框架，通过在微调阶段将扰动不变性内置于模型权重中，实现大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的隐式去幻觉稳定化，无需推理时额外开销，在多个基准上显著降低幻觉率。
AI.motivation: LVLMs存在严重的幻觉问题，即流畅地描述图像中不存在的对象、属性和场景。作者发现幻觉与特征不稳定性相关——语义保持的输入扰动会导致嵌入表示发生大幅变化。现有的稳定性解决方案是显式的，需要在推理时进行潜在空间引导或约束解码，每次查询都有额外成本。
AI.method: INFUSE框架包含两步：首先围绕扰动平均锚点和真实标注锚点稳定视觉和文本表示；然后通过双向对比目标函数对齐跨模态的稳定化表示。作者还提供了理论分析，证明锚点与扰动均值表示的均方根偏差以1/√K的速率收敛（K为视图数），并在Lipschitz解码器条件下约束了扰动对幻觉行为的影响。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5、LLaVA-1.6和Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上，INFUSE相对于各基座模型将AMBER CHAIR降低46-63%，在ObjHal、MMHal、HallusionBench和POPE上也均有提升，同时保持VQA-v2和TextVQA的性能，且无推理时额外开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过将扰动不变性直接内置于模型权重（隐式稳定化），可以在不影响下游任务性能的前提下显著降低LVLMs的幻觉率，避免了显式方法在推理时的高昂成本，为LVLM幻觉缓解提供了一种高效且可扩展的新范式。

title: On the Design of Qwen3.8-Next Architecture: Evaluation, Efficiency, and Training Stability
summary: We describe the architecture and ablations of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 125B parameters, 6B activated per token, and additional 51B parameters of n-gram embedding tables held off the accelerator. On fourteen pre-training benchmarks the model leads the 397B-A17B predecessor on eight and trails it on the rest by at most 2.6 points, at 1/3 the activated parameters, 1/3 the training tokens, and roughly 1/9 the training FLOPs. Token mixing uses a layer-wise hybrid of Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and global attention, with one full-attention layer in every four; at continued-pretraining time those full-attention layers are replaced by Qwen Sparse Attention (QSA), which scores context at micro-block granularity with a compressed lightweight indexer. The residual stream is widened to four branches and read through an elementwise gate, a design we call the Gated Residual (GR). Capacity is added outside the backbone by a single n-gram embedding layer whose tables are prefetched from host memory. We evaluate every candidate change along three axes: loss together with downstream benchmarks; the cost of the change in training, prefill and decode; and its effect on the optimal hyperparameters and training stability. Loss and downstream accuracy do not always move together: enlarging the n-gram vocabulary lowers loss monotonically while downstream accuracy saturates. The architecture and the Muon optimizer together shift the optimal learning rate and batch size upwards, render batch-size warmup unnecessary, and substantially improve stability under stress tests. Loss, benchmarks, efficiency and stability form one design problem. Solved jointly, they yield a recipe that is simultaneously more efficient, more capable and more stable.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Qwen3.8-Flash-Next，一个拥有125B总参数、6B激活参数的稀疏混合专家模型。相较于397B-A17B的前代，该模型在14个预训练基准中8个领先，其余差距不超过2.6分，但仅用了前代1/3的激活参数、1/3的训练token和约1/9的训练FLOPs。模型采用了Gated DeltaNet与全局注意力的层间混合、Qwen稀疏注意力、四分支门控残差流以及n-gram嵌入表等创新设计。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在探索如何联合优化损失、下游任务性能、推理效率和训练稳定性这四大设计维度，证明它们构成一个整体设计问题，而非相互独立的优化目标。通过系统性消融实验，寻求同时实现更高效率、更强能力和更高稳定性的模型架构与训练配方。
AI.method: 采用三层混合方法：(1) token混合上，层间混合Gated DeltaNet与全局注意力（每四层一个全注意力层），持续预训练时用Qwen稀疏注意力替换全注意力层；(2) 残差流加宽到四个分支并通过逐元素门控读取（Gated Residual）；(3) 在骨干网络外通过单层n-gram嵌入表（从主机内存预取）增加容量。同时联合评估Muon优化器对超参数的影响。
AI.result: 模型在8/14个基准上超越前代，其余差距不超过2.6分，但训练成本大幅降低。消融实验揭示关键发现：损失与下游准确率并非总是一致移动（n-gram词汇增大持续降低损失但下游准确率饱和）；Muon优化器将最优学习率和批大小上移，消除了批大小预热需求，并显著提升压力测试下的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 损失、基准性能、效率和稳定性必须作为一个联合设计问题来求解。通过联合优化这四者，可以得到一个同时更高效、更强能力且更稳定的训练配方，验证了"联合设计优于逐项独立优化"的核心主张。

title: Dior: Drawing the Light of Image via Material-Decoupled Illumination Representation
summary: Controllable image relighting is an important problem in image editing, and hand-drawn scribbles provide an intuitive interface for specifying the desired illumination. However, existing methods do not establish a consistent and effective mapping between scribble inputs and relighting results, limiting their ability to control illumination intensity, chromaticity, and complex spatial distributions. We address this limitation by introducing a material-decoupled illumination representation, termed the Lumi Map, which establishes an explicit mapping between user scribbles and the resulting illumination, thereby improving both relighting accuracy and controllability. Specifically, we use a renderer to synthesize source image-Lumi Map-relit image triplets and train the model to predict the target relighting result conditioned on the Lumi Map. To mitigate the domain gap introduced by synthetic data, we further perform reconstruction training on real relighting pairs, improving the model's generalization to real-world images. Finally, we present Dior-Light, an image relighting method controlled by hand-drawn strokes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in relighting accuracy and enables effective control over illumination intensity and chromaticity on in-the-wild images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Lumi Map的材质解耦光照表示方法，通过建立用户涂鸦与光照结果之间的显式映射，实现了可控图像重光照。该方法利用渲染器合成"源图像-Lumi Map-重光照图像"三元组训练模型，并通过真实重光照对的重建训练缓解合成数据的域差距，最终提出Dior-Light方法，在手绘笔触控制下实现更准确、更可控的图像重光照效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的可控图像重光照方法未能建立涂鸦输入与重光照结果之间一致且有效的映射关系，导致对照明强度、色度和复杂空间分布的控制能力有限。
AI.method: 首先提出Lumi Map这一材质解耦的光照表示，建立用户涂鸦与光照结果的显式映射；其次利用渲染器合成源图像-Lumi Map-重光照图像三元组来训练模型；最后通过真实重光照对的辅助重建训练来缓解合成数据带来的域差距，提升模型在真实图像上的泛化能力。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提出的Dior-Light方法在重光照准确度上优于现有方法，并能对野外图像实现有效的照明强度和色度控制。
AI.conclusion: 通过Lumi Map表示和结合合成数据与真实数据的训练策略，该方法有效解决了涂鸦驱动的可控重光照中映射不一致的问题，在准确性和可控性方面均取得了显著提升。

title: Sequential Trajectories and Simultaneous Blending: Multi-Emotion Modeling for Instruction-Following TTS
comment: Code is available at https://github.com/ictnlp/HybridEmo. Demo page: https://zhouyan19.github.io/HybridEmo-demo/
summary: Natural-language instructions enable flexible control of synthesized speech, yet emotional TTS systems primarily model a single utterance-level affect, leaving multi-emotion control underexplored. We study two complementary multi-emotion TTS tasks: emotion trajectory, which spans several ordered affective stages, and emotion blending, in which multiple emotions coexist throughout an utterance. These tasks expose a supervision mismatch: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) does not explicitly evaluate emotion features, while single-emotion rewards provide neither structure-aware feedback for trajectory completion nor pair-aware feedback for blending. We introduce HybridEmo, a post-training framework that initializes both tasks with SFT and then aligns the speech-token policy through Group Relative Policy Optimization using a sample-aware hybrid reward. For trajectory samples, segment-aligned consistency combines average and weakest-stage evidence to preserve the correctness and completeness of prescribed stages. For blending samples, a GMM-based reward combines frame-level support from the union of target-emotion anchors in an offline emotion space with an utterance-level weaker-target margin. Both branches share an ASR reward and are routed within a unified policy. On MultiEmo-Test, HybridEmo significantly improves trajectory correctness and blending intensity, without a noticeable degradation in speaker similarity. Human evaluation prefers HybridEmo to CosyVoice 3 and EmoVoice-0.5B, with nearly balanced preferences against Qwen3-TTS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HybridEmo后训练框架，解决情感TTS中多情感控制（情感轨迹和情感混合）的监督不匹配问题，通过SFT初始化+GRPO对齐+混合奖励机制，在轨迹任务中结合分段一致性奖励，在混合任务中使用基于GMM的奖励，显著提升轨迹正确性和混合强度且不损失说话人相似度。
AI.motivation: 现有情感TTS主要建模单一话语级情感，多情感控制（情感轨迹和情感混合）未被充分探索；同时存在监督不匹配问题——SFT不显式评估情感特征，单情感奖励无法提供轨迹完成的结构感知反馈，也无法提供混合任务的成对感知反馈。
AI.method: 提出HybridEmo后训练框架：首先用SFT初始化两类任务，然后通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）对齐语音token策略。采用样本感知混合奖励——轨迹样本使用分段对齐一致性奖励（结合平均与最弱阶段证据）；混合样本使用基于GMM的奖励（结合帧级目标情感锚点支持与话语级弱目标边际）；两分支共享ASR奖励并在统一策略内路由。
AI.result: 在MultiEmo-Test上，HybridEmo显著提升轨迹正确性和混合强度，说话人相似度无明显退化。人类评估中HybridEmo优于CosyVoice 3和EmoVoice-0.5B，与Qwen3-TTS偏好几乎持平。
AI.conclusion: 混合奖励的后训练框架能有效解决多情感TTS任务中的监督不匹配问题，实现情感轨迹与情感混合的双重控制，为多情感语音合成提供了可行方案。

title: Everybody Tracking Every Body
summary: We address the problem of 3D body pose estimation of multiple interacting people from their egocentric views with centralized coordination. Each individual wears a camera recording egocentric video and IMU data. Processing this video with VIO SLAM provides high-quality tracking of each egocentric camera through space. The first-person view from one individual provides third-person observations of other people, although these exocentric observations are sparse, intermittent, and of highly variable reliability as both cameras and subjects move.
