AI.method: 使用单台手持式消费级结构光扫描仪，对9个刚性创面护理模型部位进行23次重复扫描。将重复扫描间所有差异视为纯测量误差，计算95%重复性限、组内相关系数等指标。构建误差预算，分别固定分析区域、保持传感器和重建流程不变，以分解方差来源（操作员捕获表面范围vs仪器本身）。并进行统计异常值剔除对面积系统偏差影响的评估。
AI.result: 重建表面面积95%重复性限为4.8倍（CI: 3.0–7.0）；45个描述符中44个ICC低于0.50，248个描述符-流程组合无一达到0.75。操作员捕获范围方差占比：表面面积75%、壳体面积91%、包围盒对角线95%；仅壳体容积的主要方差来源为仪器（48%）。标准化分析区域后限值降至2.13；统计异常值剔除造成约11%的系统性面积亏空。
AI.conclusion: 该扫描系统的测量误差远超临床可接受水平，且误差主要由操作员捕获表面范围的差异驱动，改进传感器硬件收益有限。未进行创面分割的测量链不具备创面面积可重复性度量能力，现有流程在临床愈合预测阈值面前仅勉强达标。研究者建议标准化分析区域以降低误差，并须警惕统计异常值剔除引入的系统偏差。

title: Hi-Q: Hierarchical Evidence-guided Query Refinement for Multi-Hop Question Answering
summary: A central bottleneck in multi-hop Question Answering (QA) is that the granularity at which a question is expressed often differs from the granularity at which corpus evidence is retrievable. Existing methods address this mismatch by imposing fixed graph structures over the corpus, by iteratively reformulating the query, or by executing a generated program over it, but these strategies do not explicitly decide when a query unit is already supported by evidence and when it should be refined. We formulate this bottleneck as retrievable granularity discovery and introduce Hi-Q, an evidence-conditioned framework for hierarchical query refinement. At each query node, a resolution operator tests whether retrieved evidence supports the current query unit; resolved nodes terminate, while unresolved nodes are expanded by a dependency-preserving binary operator and checked by a semantic coverage verifier. Hi-Q therefore grows a query tree whose topology is determined by corpus support signals rather than by a fixed decomposition template or a pre-built graph. We evaluate Hi-Q on three multi-hop QA benchmarks, primarily under full-corpus retrieval, where dependent evidence must be located among open-domain distractors rather than within a small annotated pool. In this setting Hi-Q reaches 52.3 EM and 64.0 F1 averaged over the three benchmarks, ahead of the iterative retrieval baseline IRCoT by 15.1 EM / 18.2 F1 on that same average, and ahead of the graph-based RAG baseline PropRAG by 11.5 EM / 12.0 F1 on MuSiQue-full, without corpus-wide graph construction. In the restricted supporting/distractor setting used by prior work, Hi-Q likewise attains the best accuracy, with 57.9 EM and 69.3 F1 on average, ahead of PropRAG by 5.6 EM / 3.9 F1 and IRCoT by 13.7 EM / 15.8 F1. The project page is available at https://hi-q-project.github.io/.

AI.tldr: Hi-Q提出了一种证据条件化的层次化查询精化框架，通过解析算子判断检索证据是否支持当前查询单元，解决多跳QA中问题粒度与证据粒度不匹配的核心瓶颈。实验在三个基准上超越IRCoT和PropRAG等基线，无需预构建图结构。
AI.motivation: 多跳问答中的核心瓶颈是问题表达粒度与语料证据可检索粒度不匹配。现有方法依赖固定图结构、迭代改写查询或执行生成程序，但都未显式决定查询单元何时已被证据支持、何时需要精化。
AI.method: Hi-Q提出证据条件化的层次化查询精化框架。在每个查询节点上，解析算子测试检索证据是否支持当前查询单元；已解决的节点终止，未解决的节点通过保持依赖关系的二元算子展开，并由语义覆盖验证器检查。查询树的拓扑结构由语料支持信号决定，而非固定分解模板或预建图。
AI.result: 在全语料检索设置下，Hi-Q在三个基准上平均达到52.3 EM和64.0 F1，超过IRCoT 15.1 EM/18.2 F1；在MuSiQue-full上超过PropRAG 11.5 EM/12.0 F1。在受限支持/干扰设置下平均达到57.9 EM和69.3 F1，超过PropRAG 5.6 EM/3.9 F1和IRCoT 13.7 EM/15.8 F1。
AI.conclusion: Hi-Q通过显式判断查询单元是否被证据支持来动态决定精化时机，避免了固定分解模板和图结构构建的开销，在多种检索设置下均取得显著的性能提升。

title: CedarCypress3D: an annotated UAV-LiDAR dataset of individual trees in planted cedar and cypress forests
summary: Individual tree measurements derived from Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) mounted on Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) provide valuable information for forest inventory, ecosystem monitoring, and sustainable forest management. Recent advancements in machine learning have increased the demand for annotated datasets to develop and evaluate point cloud-based approaches, especially for individual tree segmentation. However, publicly available annotated UAV-LiDAR datasets in temperate forests are limited. In this article, we present CedarCypress3D, a manually annotated UAV-LiDAR dataset collected in Japanese cedar (Cryptomeria japonica) and Japanese cypress (Chamaecyparis obtusa) plantations in Japan. The dataset consists of UAV-LiDAR point clouds and field survey measurements from 34 circular plots across two sites with different topographic characteristics, along with terrestrial LiDAR point clouds available for a subset of 22 plots. A total of 1,627 trees were measured in the census field survey and manually annotated to match the corresponding trees in the UAV-LiDAR point clouds. For the subset of plots with terrestrial LiDAR data, semantic labels (i.e., stem and non-stem) were additionally assigned to tree points in the UAV-LiDAR data. CedarCypress3D provides high-quality annotated UAV-LiDAR data for developing and evaluating individual tree instance segmentation and semantic segmentation methods in temperate planted forests. The dataset can also support research on tree attribute prediction and multi-platform LiDAR analysis. The dataset is publicly available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22168721.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了CedarCypress3D数据集，这是一个在日本柳杉和日本扁柏人工林中采集的、经过人工标注的UAV-LiDAR点云数据集，包含34个圆形样地、1,627棵树的野外调查测量数据，以及22个子集样地的地面LiDAR数据和语义标签，可用于单木实例分割和语义分割方法的开发与评估。
AI.motivation: 温带森林中公开可用的标注UAV-LiDAR数据集非常有限，而机器学习方法的发展需要大量高质量的标注点云数据来开发和评估单木分割算法。
AI.method: 在日本两个不同地形特征的柳杉和扁柏人工林场地中，利用UAV-LiDAR采集点云数据，通过野外调查对1,627棵树进行测量，并在点云中手动标注对应的单木；对22个具有地面LiDAR数据的样地进一步添加干/非干的语义标签。
AI.result: 构建了包含34个样地的CedarCypress3D数据集，提供高质量的人工标注UAV-LiDAR数据，覆盖不同地形条件和树种的温带人工林场景，并公开提供数据集下载。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集填补了温带人工林中标注UAV-LiDAR数据的空白，能够支持单木实例分割、语义分割、树属性预测及多平台LiDAR分析等研究方向。

title: ImageEval 2026: Culturally Grounded Arabic Multimodal Evaluation
comment: Arabic LLMs, Multilingual, Multimodal, Shared Task
summary: We present an overview of the ImageEval 2026 shared task on culturally grounded Arabic multimodal evaluation. It includes two tasks: (i) AynVQA, covering spoken visual question answering and image-grounded hallucination detection in English and Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), and (ii) CRAI-Bench, evaluating the cultural accuracy of text-to-image generation. A total of 14 teams participated in the test phase, with 12 teams submitting system description papers. Participating systems used a range of approaches, including zero-shot prompting, fine-tuning of vision-language models, speech-recognition pipelines, ensembling, and score calibration. We describe the task setup, datasets, evaluation procedure, and participating systems, and summarize the main results across the different tracks. All datasets and evaluation scripts from the shared task are released to the research community. The shared task highlights the challenges of culturally grounded multimodal evaluation, particularly for Arabic speech and image-text reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了ImageEval 2026共享任务，包含两个子任务：AynVQA（涵盖口语视觉问答和图像幻觉检测）和CRAI-Bench（评估文本到图像生成的文化准确性），共14支团队参与测试阶段，12支团队提交了系统描述论文。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语多模态评估中缺乏文化层面的标注评测基准，尤其是口语视觉问答和图像-文本推理方面面临独特挑战，需要建立一个系统性的共享任务来推动该领域发展。
AI.method: 设置两个评测任务：AynVQA涵盖英语和现代标准阿拉伯语的语音视觉问答及图像幻觉检测；CRAI-Bench评估文本到图像生成的文化准确性。参与系统采用零样本提示、视觉语言模型微调、语音识别流水线、集成学习和分数校准等多种方法。
AI.result: 14支团队参与测试阶段，12支团队提交系统描述论文，数据集和评估脚本已向研究社区公开发布，各赛道的主要结果已在文中总结。
AI.conclusion: 共享任务揭示了文化嵌入的多模态评估面临的挑战，特别是在阿拉伯语语音和图像-文本推理方面，并为未来研究提供了公开的数据集和评估工具。

title: AI-enabled Low-Cost 3D Maize Ear Morphometry Platform at Breeding Scale
summary: Maize ear geometry (length, width, curvature, and volume) is closely tied to yield and grain-filling outcomes, but existing high-throughput phenotyping pipelines remain constrained by the cost, labor, and specialized hardware they require. We developed and validated a low-cost pipeline that reconstructs a watertight 3-D mesh of a maize ear from a single 20-second video captured with a consumer-grade DSLR on a motorized turntable under uniform LED illumination. Camera poses from a multi-seed COLMAP procedure initialize a Neural Radiance Field (NeRF), and a cylindrical holder of known diameter, visible in every frame, provides automatic metric scaling with downstream geometric quality control. Applied to 300 ears spanning a diverse maize inbred panel, 250 (83.3%) passed automated processing and quality control. Skeleton length agreed with manual caliper measurements across all 250 ears (R^2 = 0.964, RMSE = 4.68 mm), and convex-hull volume agreed with water-displacement volume on a 15-ear subset spanning the full size range (R^2 = 0.982, RMSE = 5.26 mL). Residual length error grew with ear curvature, whereas bounding-box height, which records the same straight-line chord as calipers, showed no such trend; the discrepancy therefore originates in the measurement definition, since calipers record the chord while skeleton length traces the geodesic arc. The capture hardware costs approximately 607 USD, and operator involvement fell from roughly five minutes to one minute per ear, with all downstream processing running unattended. The platform provides a foundation for breeding-scale 3-D ear phenotyping.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种低成本、自动化的玉米果穗3D表型采集与重建管线，通过单条20秒视频结合NeRF技术重建水密3D网格，在300个果穗样本上实现83.3%的通过率，长度测量与人工卡尺高度一致（R²=0.964），体积测量与排水法高度一致（R²=0.982），硬件成本约607美元。
AI.motivation: 玉米果穗几何性状（长度、宽度、曲率、体积）与产量和籽粒充实密切相关，但现有高通量表型采集管线受限于高成本、劳动密集和专用硬件，缺少低成本高自动化的解决方案。
AI.method: 使用消费级单反相机在电动转盘和均匀LED照明下拍摄20秒视频，通过多种子COLMAP初始化相机位姿并训练NeRF重建水密3D网格；视频中可见的已知直径圆柱夹具提供自动度量标定和质量控制，全流程自动化处理。
AI.result: 300个来自多样化玉米自交系群体的果穗中250个（83.3%）通过自动处理和质量控制。骨架长度与卡尺测量在250个果穗上R²=0.964、RMSE=4.68mm；凸包体积与排水法在15个涵盖全尺寸范围的子集上R²=0.982、RMSE=5.26mL。硬件成本约607美元，操作时间从约5分钟降至1分钟。
AI.conclusion: 该平台为育种规模的三维果穗表型采集提供了低成本、高自动化的基础；长度残差差异源于测量定义（卡尺记录弦长，骨架测量测地弧长），为后续果穗曲率订正提供了方向。

title: Agents in the Large: Perception-Centered Architecture for Persistent Agents
summary: Cognitive language agents have achieved substantial progress by equipping language models with memory, tools, and decision-making procedures, enabling agents to reason and act in interactive environments. Existing frameworks largely cast these agents as systems for solving user-specified, bounded tasks. An increasingly important goal is for language agents to provide persistent assistance in long-lived settings where user needs, context, and service procedures persist and change, and to remain useful across the broad range of tasks that arise over time. Yet we still lack a framework to characterize persistent AI agents, organize existing work, and guide future development. To this end, we propose a Perception-Centered Architecture for Persistent Agents (Pera). Pera describes a persistent agent organized around perception and control components that continually perceive service-relevant signals from episodic task executions, internal context, and changes in the surrounding environment, and use these signals to construct lifecycle tasks. These tasks drive the ongoing operation and adaptation of the agent's service procedures. We use Pera to retrospectively organize recent work, examine a detailed case study, and offer forward-looking insights for building more capable persistent agents. Just as software engineering moved from programming in the small to programming in the large, Pera frames the evolution of language agents as an analogous architectural transition toward long-lived, adaptive intelligence systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Pera（以感知为中心的持久智能体架构）的框架，用于描述和指导持久性AI智能体的设计与开发。Pera围绕感知和控制两大核心组件组织，智能体通过持续感知任务执行、内部上下文和环境变化中的信号来构建生命周期任务，从而实现长期自适应服务。
AI.motivation: 现有语言智能体框架主要针对用户指定的、有边界的任务进行求解，但在真实长期场景中，用户需求、上下文和服务流程会持续存在并不断变化。当前缺乏一个统一的框架来刻画持久性AI智能体、组织已有工作并指导未来发展，这构成了本研究的核心动机。
AI.method: 提出Pera架构，该架构包含感知与控制两大组件：感知组件持续从片段性任务执行、内部上下文和外部环境变化中捕获与服务相关的信号；控制组件利用这些信号构建生命周期任务，驱动服务流程的持续运行与自适应调整。作者还回顾并整理了近期相关工作，并进行了详细案例研究。
AI.result: 使用Pera框架对近期语言智能体相关工作进行了回顾性整理，呈现了一个详细的案例研究，并为构建更强大的持久性智能体提供了前瞻性洞见。
AI.conclusion: 正如软件工程从"小规模编程"演进到"大规模编程"，Pera将语言智能体的演进类比为向长期、自适应的智能系统的一种架构性转变，为持久性AI智能体的研究提供了重要的理论框架和方向指引。

title: ATGS: Anchored Temporal Gaussian Splatting for Long Volumetric Video Representation
summary: Volumetric video enables immersive free viewpoint rendering of dynamic real world scenes, yet existing methods struggle with long sequences and complex motions, often leading to temporal instability and visual artifacts. To address these challenges, we propose \ourname, a Gaussian splatting based framework for volumetric video reconstruction. Our key insight is that explicitly tracking long term complex motion with individual Gaussian primitives is inherently unstable. Instead, we organize Gaussians around time conditioned anchors that localize their spatial and temporal support, thereby reducing long range motion complexity. We further introduce a temporal windowing strategy to activate only anchors relevant to the queried time, which improves scalability and temporal coherence. In addition, to ensure spatial and temporal stability, we design a compact set of multi level anchor features that encode global features, local spatial features, and local temporal features, jointly constraining Gaussian generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \ourname \ consistently outperforms prior methods on long sequence volumetric videos with complex motions. Project page: https://github.com/WuJH2001/ATGS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ATGS，一种基于高斯泼溅的体视频重建框架，通过时间条件锚点组织和时间窗口策略解决长序列复杂运动导致的时序不稳定和视觉伪影问题。
AI.motivation: 现有体视频方法在处理长序列和复杂运动时存在时序不稳定和视觉伪影问题，原因是显式地追踪每个高斯图元的长时复杂运动本质上是不稳定的。
AI.method: 将高斯围绕时间条件锚点组织，锚点定位其空间和时间支持范围以降低长时运动复杂度；引入时间窗口策略仅激活与查询时间相关的锚点，提升可扩展性和时序连贯性；设计紧凑的多层级锚点特征，编码全局特征、局部空间特征和局部时间特征，联合约束高斯生成。
AI.result: 在长序列体视频和复杂运动场景上，ATGS持续优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过锚点化的时间建模和窗口化激活机制，ATGS有效改善了体视频重建在长序列复杂运动下的时序稳定性与视觉质量。

title: Two Centuries of Sexism in British Parliament: A Computational Analysis of Women's Representation in the Hansard Corpus
summary: The language a legislature uses to debate women's rights, even in favour of them, encodes systematic patterns of sexism that persist across two centuries. In this work, we analyse 6,531 speeches over 200 years of UK parliamentary debate (Hansard, 1803-2005) by using large language models to classify a speaker's perspective towards women's suffrage and political representation, as well as analyse sexist speech in parliament from the lens of the Ambivalent Sexism Inventory. We also release this parliamentary dataset, an organized and metadata-enriched version of the publicly available Hansard Corpus optimized for computational social science research, with 6.7 million speeches across 1.2 million debates, with 89% gender-matching for speeches by MPs from the House of Commons. We find that 54% of speeches opposing women's representation contain sexist content, compared to 21% of speeches that are for the cause, and that the two sides use fundamentally different types of sexism: anti-suffrage rhetoric combines hostile and benevolent framing, while pro-suffrage sexism is overwhelmingly benevolent. Female MPs support women's political rights at 93% compared to 70% for male MPs, a gap that closes only after enfranchisement. Our findings are evidence that benevolent and hostile sexism are used in different rhetorical contexts in a manner consistent with the theory of Ambivalent Sexism.

AI.tldr: 本文利用大语言模型分析了英国议会200年间6,531篇关于女性权利的演讲，发现支持与反对女性代表权的演讲中都存在系统性性别歧视模式，且两类演讲使用不同类型的性别歧视（敌对型与善意型），同时发布了包含670万篇演讲的议会数据集。
AI.motivation: 探究立法机构在辩论女性权利时（即使是在支持女性的语境中）是否编码了系统性性别歧视模式，并验证Ambivalent Sexism Theory（矛盾性别歧视理论）在真实政治话语中的适用性。
AI.method: 使用大语言模型对1803-2005年英国议会辩论（Hansard）中的6,531篇演讲进行分类，识别演讲者对女性选举权和政治代表权的立场，并基于Ambivalent Sexism Inventory分析演讲中的性别歧视内容；同时构建并发布了包含670万篇演讲、120万场辩论的元数据增强数据集。
AI.result: 54%反对女性代表权的演讲含性别歧视内容，而支持方仅为21%；反选举权演讲同时使用敌对型和善意型性别歧视，支持方则主要为善意型；女性议员支持女性政治权利的比例为93%，远高于男性议员的70%，该差距在选举权实现后消失。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为矛盾性别歧视理论提供了实证支持：敌对型和善意型性别歧视在不同修辞语境中被差异化使用，且即使在支持女性权利的演讲中，系统性性别偏见依然存在。

title: NoisEasier: Test-Time Noise Optimization for Text-to-Video Generation
summary: Diffusion models have recently advanced text-to-video (T2V) generation, yet they still struggle with fine-grained compositional alignment, such as attribute binding, spatial relations, and object interactions. While reward-based fine-tuning improves alignment, it is susceptible to reward hacking and adapts poorly to new prompt distributions. In this work, we propose NoisEasier, a test-time scaling framework that improves T2V generation through differentiable reward-guided noise optimization without modifying the underlying model. By combining efficient short-step generators with a multi-objective reward formulation, NoisEasier enables stable and practical test-time optimization under realistic inference budgets. Our key insight is that jointly optimizing the entire stochastic trajectory accelerates reward convergence and improves compositional alignment over optimizing only the initial latent, with negligible additional computational and time cost. Experiments on VBench and T2V-CompBench demonstrate consistent improvements across multiple backbones, achieving over 10% average gains on challenging dimensions such as attribute binding, object interaction, and numeracy. Overall, NoisEasier serves as both a flexible alternative and a complementary enhancement to reward-based fine-tuning, establishing test-time scaling as an effective paradigm for controllable text-to-video generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NoisEasier，一种无需修改底层模型的测试时扩展框架，通过可微奖励引导的噪声优化来提升文本到视频生成的组合对齐能力，在VBench和T2V-CompBench上取得了超过10%的平均性能提升。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在文本到视频生成中虽取得进展，但在细粒度组合对齐（如属性绑定、空间关系、物体交互）上仍存在困难。现有的奖励微调方法容易出现奖励黑客问题，且对新的提示分布适应性差。
AI.method: NoisEasier采用测试时扩展策略，结合高效短步生成器与多目标奖励公式化，通过可微奖励引导的噪声优化来改进生成质量。核心洞察是联合优化整个随机轨迹比仅优化初始潜变量能更快收敛并改善组合对齐，且额外计算和时间成本可忽略。
AI.result: 在VBench和T2V-CompBench上跨多个骨干网络实现了持续改进，在属性绑定、物体交互和计数等具有挑战性的维度上平均提升超过10%。
AI.conclusion: NoisEasier既可作为奖励微调方法的灵活替代方案，也可作为其互补增强，确立了测试时扩展作为可控文本到视频生成的有效范式。

title: UTILMEM: Benchmarking Evidence Utilization in Long-Term Conversational Memory
summary: Long-term memory is increasingly important for conversational agents, yet existing benchmarks primarily measure memory through pointwise factual recall: whether a system can recover isolated facts or event-level details from prior interactions. Real-world memory use, however, often requires a more demanding capability: integrating distributed, implicit, and noisy evidence across extended interaction histories into coherent, task-oriented outputs. We call this capability memory utilization. Here, we introduce UtilMem, a diagnostic benchmark comprising 1,717 instances across five domains, designed to evaluate four underexplored aspects of memory utilization: reasoning over dense histories, identifying implicitly relevant memories, synthesizing distributed evidence into summaries, analyses, or plans, and resisting interference from semantically similar distractors. Evaluating a diverse set of retrieval-based and memory-augmented systems, we find that strong performance on conventional factual-memory benchmarks does not reliably translate into effective memory utilization. Moreover, retrieval alone is insufficient: even when relevant evidence is successfully recovered, systems frequently fail to integrate information across sessions or to distinguish useful evidence from plausible distractors. These findings expose a substantial gap between accessing stored information and using it effectively, and suggest that progress in long-term conversational memory will require architectures that explicitly support evidence integration and robustness to retrieval interference. Code is available at https://github.com/peijunallin/UtilMem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UtilMem基准测试，包含1,717个实例、覆盖五个领域，用于评估对话智能体的"记忆利用"能力（而非简单的事实回忆）。实验发现，传统事实记忆基准上的强性能并不能可靠转化为有效的记忆利用，仅靠检索不足以解决跨会话信息整合与干扰项辨别问题。
AI.motivation: 现有对话记忆基准主要衡量点状事实回忆（能否恢复孤立事实或事件细节），但真实世界的记忆使用需要更强的能力——将跨扩展交互历史中分布、隐式且含噪的证据整合为连贯的任务导向输出，这种能力（即记忆利用）尚未得到充分评测。
AI.method: 作者构建UtilMem诊断基准，包含1,717个实例、跨五个领域，评估记忆利用的四个未充分探索的方面：（1）对密集历史的推理；（2）识别隐式相关的记忆；（3）将分布式证据综合为摘要、分析或计划；（4）抵抗语义相似干扰项的干扰。对多种基于检索和记忆增强的系统进行评估。
AI.result: 研究发现：传统事实记忆基准上的强性能不能可靠转化为有效的记忆利用；单纯检索不足——即使相关证据被成功恢复，系统也经常无法跨会话整合信息或区分有用证据与貌似合理的干扰项。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了"存取存储信息"与"有效使用信息"之间存在实质性差距，表明长期对话记忆的进展需要显式支持证据整合与检索干扰鲁棒性的架构设计。

title: DICS: Exploring Data Intrinsic Consistency for Visual Instruction Selection
summary: Visual instruction tuning is crucial for advancing the vision-language alignment and instruction-following capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, identifying optimal subsets under a fixed ratio constraint from rapidly expanding datasets remains a significant bottleneck. While existing methods largely depend on distribution diversity or heuristic filtering, they often overlook the internal coherence within individual samples. To bridge this gap, we propose Data Intrinsic Consistency (DIC), a self-scoring metric designed to quantify the sample-level inter-component consistency. DIC consists of two modules: Visual Information Consistency (VIC), evaluating the alignment between visual content and instructions, and Response Information Consistency (RIC), assessing response coherence relative to the instruction. Building upon DIC, we introduce Data Intrinsic Consistency Selection (DICS), an adaptive data selection method that optimizes the trade-off between high intra-sample consistency and global distributional diversity under varying data budgets. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DICS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across diverse dataset scales and model architectures, surpassing full-dataset fine-tuning while using only 25% of the LLaVA-1.5-665K data. We further curate DICS-6M, a 6M-sample multi-modal instruction corpus that enables the largest-scale visual instruction selection study to date; remarkably, DICS reaches 94.52\% of the official InternVL3-8B-Instruct performance using less than 25\% of its reported training data. Code can be seen at https://github.com/cqu-student/DICS

AI.tldr: 本文提出数据内在一致性（DIC）自评分指标及其数据选择方法（DICS），通过量化视觉内容与指令、响应与指令的一致性，在固定比例约束下优化数据子集选取，仅用25%的训练数据即可超越全量微调效果。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉指令调优的数据选择方法多依赖分布多样性或启发式过滤，忽略了单个样本内部各组件之间的一致性，导致在固定比例约束下难以从快速扩展的数据集中识别最优子集。
AI.method: 提出DIC指标，包含两个模块：视觉信息一致性（VIC）评估视觉内容与指令的对齐程度，响应信息一致性（RIC）评估响应相对指令的连贯性。在此基础上引入DICS自适应数据选择方法，在样本内高一致性与全局分布多样性之间实现权衡优化。
AI.result: DICS在多种数据集规模和模型架构上持续优于现有最优方法；仅用LLaVA-1.5-665K数据集的25%即超越全量微调。构建的DICS-6M包含600万样本的多模态指令语料，实现了迄今最大规模的视觉指令选择研究，用不到25%的训练数据达到官方InternVL3-8B-Instruct性能的94.52%。
AI.conclusion: 样本内部一致性是视觉指令数据选择的关键维度，DICS方法通过平衡样本内一致性与分布多样性，能够以显著更少的数据实现更优或相当的模型性能，为大规模视觉指令数据高效利用提供了有效方案。

title: WebWorld: The Browser as a World Model for Self-Improving Web Code
summary: VLM-driven self-improvement of web code has a structural flaw: the model that proposes the repair is the model that judges it, and visual plausibility under that judge is a poor proxy for whether the page actually works. What the loop is missing is a counterparty the VLM cannot fool, and the browser already is that counterparty: a deterministic, executable simulator of how an HTML artifact behaves under user actions, and in everything but name a world model for web code. We present WebWorld, the interface that lets a VLM prior interact with this browser-as-world-model autonomously and decides which interactions become supervision. Each round, the VLM emits a critique that the planner compiles into a typed interaction contract; the browser re-executes the candidate and issues an acceptance certificate only when both target progress and preservation of every previously verified capability hold; certified transitions accumulate as a quality ratchet that is the only thing the SFT export ever sees. Under matched training, WebWorld-27B improves Raw-27B by 5.3 points on HTMLBench-400 and 14.9 points on MiniAppBench-Val, and reaches the level of strong frontier systems such as Kimi-K2.6 and GPT-5.4 on interactive HTML generation. Equal-size ablations show that browser-backed admission carries the gain: without the certificate, the matched 9B lift nearly disappears.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WebWorld框架，利用浏览器作为确定性可执行的世界模型，为VLM驱动的Web代码自我改进提供不可欺骗的"对手方"，通过接受证书机制确保每次修复仅在被验证功能保持的前提下被采纳。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM驱动的Web代码自我改进存在结构性缺陷：提出修复的模型同时也是评判修复的模型，视觉合理性作为代理指标无法真实反映页面是否实际可用。需要引入VLM无法欺骗的验证方。
AI.method: WebWorld将浏览器作为世界模型。每轮VLM发出批评意见，规划器将其编译为类型化交互契约；浏览器重新执行候选方案，仅在目标进展和所有已验证能力保持不变时才签发接受证书；认证的转换作为质量棘轮累积，仅此部分被导出用于SFT训练。
AI.result: 在匹配训练下，WebWorld-27B相比Raw-27B在HTMLBench-400上提升5.3分，在MiniAppBench-Val上提升14.9分，在交互式HTML生成上达到Kimi-K2.6和GPT-5.4等强前沿系统的水平。等尺寸消融实验显示浏览器支持的准入机制承载了主要增益：没有证书时，匹配的9B提升几乎消失。
AI.conclusion: 浏览器作为确定性执行器是VLM自我改进循环中不可替代的验证对等方，证书机制确保了质量棘轮式累积，显著提升了模型能力并接近前沿系统水平。

title: Towards a Joint Khmer Text Recognition and Word Segmentation
summary: Text recognition, or extracting electronic text from document images, has been indispensable for knowledge retrieval tasks, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). For Khmer, extracted text is subject to an extra word segmentation step, as Khmer does not use any visible word delimiters to denote word boundaries. Thus, a recognition-then-segmentation pipeline for Khmer requires two separate sequential models; this is not only error-prone but also adds significant latency for large-scale document processing. This paper proposes a novel joint Khmer text recognition and word segmentation framework in a unified model. The proposed model, using a connectionist-temporal-classification (CTC) decoder for fast, parallel decoding, can be instructed to recognize Khmer text with ($b=1$) and without ($b=0$) word segmentation. Experimental results on different benchmark datasets of different document modalities (document, scene, and handwritten images) show that the proposed model can not only recognize characters in document images but also locate word boundaries, removing the need for an extra word segmentation step in a conventional sequential pipeline.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种统一的联合高棉语文本识别与分词框架，使用CTC解码器在单一模型中同时完成字符识别和词边界定位，替代了传统的先识别后分词的两阶段流水线，在多种文档模态（文档、场景、手写图像）的基准数据集上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 高棉语不使用可见的词分隔符，传统识别后分词需要两个独立的顺序模型，不仅容易累积错误，而且在大规模文档处理中引入显著延迟。因此需要一个统一的联合框架来消除两阶段流水线的效率和准确性问题。
AI.method: 提出一个统一模型，使用连接主义时序分类（CTC）解码器实现快速并行解码，通过指令控制（b=1表示带分词，b=0表示不带分词）使模型能够灵活地在识别和分词两种模式下工作，在单一模型中同时完成字符识别和词边界定位。
AI.result: 在覆盖文档、场景和手写图像等不同文档模态的多个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，该模型不仅能识别文档图像中的字符，还能同时定位词边界，无需额外的分词步骤，验证了联合框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该联合高棉语文本识别与分词框架有效消除了传统顺序流水线中额外的分词步骤，在降低延迟和减少错误累积的同时，保持了跨不同文档模态的良好性能。

title: Seeing the Unseen: Visual Similarity for Pixel Language Model Adaptation
summary: Pixel-based language models (LMs) replace traditional tokenizers by processing rendered images of text, making cross-lingual transfer heavily dependent on the visual and structural properties of writing systems. However, the dynamics of adapting these models to low-resource languages with complex morphology and written in unique scripts are not yet explored. Using Tibetan as a case study, we analyze how continued pre-training of pixel-based LMs is influenced by data scale, initial script exposure, and cross-lingual transfer from languages written in other Brahmic scripts. We introduce four rendering-level metrics to quantify visual script similarity. We evaluate downstream performance across three tasks. Our results show that higher orthographic proximity enhances semantic transfer, even under severe data constraints. Additionally, we find a performance asymmetry based on the pre-training starting point: while multilingual pre-training PIXEL-M4 has stronger initial performance, its capacity for subsequent adaptation seems to be constrained, whereas adapting a monolingual model PIXEL with mixed scripts yields more gains on sentence-level tasks. Our metrics and case study offer empirical observations that could help inform data selection and script adaptation choices when working with pixel-based models in similar low-resource settings.

AI.tldr: 本文以藏语为案例，研究像素级语言模型在低资源复杂形态语言的持续预训练中，受数据规模、初始脚本暴露和跨语言迁移的影响，提出了四个渲染级视觉脚本相似度指标，并发现正字法邻近度能增强语义迁移，且单语模型适配效果优于多语模型。
AI.motivation: 像素级语言模型用渲染图像替代分词器，其跨语言迁移高度依赖文字系统的视觉和结构特性，但目前尚未探索此类模型适配到使用独特文字系统的低资源复杂形态语言的动态过程，缺乏系统性的实证研究。
AI.method: 以藏语为案例，设计持续预训练实验，考察数据规模、初始脚本暴露和跨语言迁移（来自其他婆罗米系文字）的影响；引入四个渲染级指标量化视觉脚本相似度；在三个下游任务上评估性能。
AI.result: 正字法邻近度越高，语义迁移效果越好（即使在数据严重受限时）；存在基于预训练起点的性能不对称性：多语模型PIXEL-M4初始性能更强但后续适配能力受限，单语模型PIXEL混合脚本适配在句子级任务上获益更多。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的指标和案例研究为像素级模型在类似低资源场景下的数据选择和脚本适配决策提供了实证参考。

title: Amortized Anchor Refinement for Deployable Continuous-Time 4D Gaussian Reconstruction
summary: Continuous-time 4D reconstruction remains impractical on standalone XR headsets. Per-scene optimization demands deployment-infeasible compute, and lower budgets cause collapse rather than degrade gradually. Feed-forward prediction is fast, but struggle to recover scene-specific detail. We present Amortized Anchor Refinement, which uses a frozen backbone to predict an initial Gaussian representation and a short optimization to specialize it under a fixed compute budget, with a capacity floor preserving representational density. A training-free stage then applies a persistent-homology constraint to prune unstable Gaussians while preserving topologically persistent structures, and streams the resulting trajectories directly as scene flow. On the Stage-Capture benchmark, Amortized Anchor Refinement achieves 24.31$\pm$2.22dB, while our deployment experiments demonstrate reconstruction within the target budget on a single consumer GPU and playback on a standalone XR headset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"摊销锚点细化"（Amortized Anchor Refinement）方法，结合冻结骨干网络的快速前馈预测和短时优化，在固定计算预算下实现适用于独立XR头显的连续时间4D重建。通过持久同调约束剪枝不稳定高斯，并直接流式输出轨迹作为场景流，在Stage-Capture基准上达到24.31dB，并成功在单消费级GPU上重建、在XR头显上播放。
AI.motivation: 现有连续时间4D重建在独立XR头显上不可行：逐场景优化需要部署时无法承受的计算量，且降低预算会导致重建崩溃而非温和退化；前馈预测虽然快速但难以恢复场景特有细节。
AI.method: 1) 使用冻结骨干网络预测初始高斯表示；2) 在固定计算预算下进行短时优化以特化该表示，并设置容量下限保持表示密度；3) 训练后阶段应用持久同调约束，剪除不稳定高斯但保留拓扑持久结构；4) 将所得轨迹直接流式传输作为场景流。
AI.result: 在Stage-Capture基准上达到24.31±2.22dB的PSNR；部署实验表明可在单块消费级GPU上于目标预算内完成重建，并能在独立XR头显上实时播放。
AI.conclusion: 该方法证明通过摊销式前馈预测与受约束的轻量优化的结合，可以在固定计算预算下实现高质量4D重建，使独立XR头显上的连续时间重建与播放成为可能。

title: Language Proficiency Assessment from Eye Movements in Naturalistic Passage Reading
summary: Standard language proficiency tests rely on linguistic tasks such as vocabulary, grammar and reading comprehension quizzes. An alternative, cognitively motivated approach, introduced in Berzak et al. (2018), proposed instead to predict language proficiency from behavioral traces of eye movements in reading. In this work, we validate and extend this approach from single sentences to more naturalistic reading of contextualized passages in English as a second language, new proficiency measures, prediction models, and reading in an information seeking regime. We find that the approach is effective in all these evaluations. We further address two key open questions on eye movement based proficiency testing: (1) potential scoring biases that reflect the proximity of the reader's native language to English, which may undermine validity, and (2) its reliability. We find that eye movement based proficiency scores are indeed biased towards L1s that are linguistically closer to English. We propose a score debiasing method which effectively remedies this issue. The reliability analyses suggest that eye movement proficiency scores are more reliable than standard language proficiency scores. Overall, our results strengthen and broaden the empirical foundations for future eye movement based language assessment technologies.

AI.tldr: 本研究验证并扩展了基于眼动追踪的语言能力评估方法，从单句扩展到自然段落阅读情境，涵盖新能力指标、预测模型及信息检索式阅读。研究发现该方法在所有评估中均有效，但存在母语与英语语言距离导致的评分偏差，并提出了有效的去偏方法；可靠性分析表明眼动能力评分优于标准语言能力评分。
AI.motivation: 标准语言能力测试依赖词汇、语法和阅读理解等传统语言学任务，而Berzak等人（2018）提出了一种基于阅读眼动行为痕迹来预测语言能力的认知驱动替代方案。本研究旨在验证并将该方法从单句扩展到更自然的段落阅读情境，同时解决眼动测试中存在的评分偏差和可靠性两个关键开放问题。
AI.method: 将眼动能力评估方法从单句扩展到上下文化段落的自然阅读场景，应用于英语作为第二语言的学习者。引入新的能力测量指标、新的预测模型，并考察信息检索式阅读模式。针对母语接近性导致的评分偏差，提出分数去偏方法，并系统分析眼动能力评分的可靠性。
AI.result: 眼动方法在所有评估场景中均表现有效。但发现眼动能力评分对与英语语言距离较近的母语者存在系统性偏差。提出的去偏方法有效解决了该问题。可靠性分析表明，眼动能力评分比标准语言能力评分更可靠。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果加强并拓宽了未来基于眼动的语言评估技术的实证基础，表明眼动追踪方法在更广泛、更自然的阅读情境中具有实用性和优越性，同时需要关注并处理母语背景带来的评分偏差问题。

title: Semantic-Spatial Discriminability Enhancement for Generalized Visual Grounding
summary: Generalized Visual Grounding (GVG) task aims to localize targets in an image based on referring expressions, extends the classical visual grounding paradigm by integrating multi-target and non-target scenarios. Previous methods typically rely on global semantic matching or coarse-grained region interactions for localization, where the discriminative cues are primarily derived from sentence-level semantics or regional context. In complex multi-target scenarios, such approaches tend to confuse visually similar targets, making it difficult to establish stable instance-level decision boundaries. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel Semantic-Spatial Discriminability Enhancement (SSDE) framework for generalized visual grounding, which aims to enhance the discriminative ability on fine-grained semantics and spatial localization, improving both cross-modal understanding and instance-level grounding. Specifically, to enhance the semantic discriminability of query representations at the fine-grained level, we propose a Semantic Discriminability Enhancement (SeDE) module, which leverages spatially guided cross-attention to disentangle fine-grained target-relevant visual attributes and integrates them with the textual subject semantics. Furthermore, to strengthen the spatial discriminability of the referred targets, we introduce a Spatial Discriminability Enhancement (SpDE) module, which models an instance center density map to characterize the spatial distribution of targets, and explicitly constructs instance separation structures in the spatial domain by employing them as an auxiliary supervision signal. Extensive experiments show that SSDE achieves superior performance on ten datasets across both classic and generalized visual grounding tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的语义-空间判别性增强（SSDE）框架用于广义视觉定位任务，通过语义判别性增强（SeDE）模块和空间判别性增强（SpDE）模块，分别从细粒度语义和空间定位两个维度提升实例级判别能力，在十个数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 广义视觉定位（GVG）任务在复杂多目标场景下，现有方法依赖全局语义匹配或粗粒度区域交互，难以区分视觉相似的目标，缺乏稳定的实例级决策边界。
AI.method: 提出SSDE框架，包含两个核心模块：1）语义判别性增强（SeDE）模块，利用空间引导的交叉注意力解耦细粒度目标相关视觉属性并与文本主语语义融合；2）空间判别性增强（SpDE）模块，建模实例中心密度图以刻画目标空间分布，并将其作为辅助监督信号显式构建空间域中的实例分离结构。
AI.result: SSDE在经典和广义视觉定位任务共十个数据集上均取得了优越的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过在细粒度语义理解和空间定位两个维度增强判别能力，SSDE有效解决了复杂多目标场景下的目标混淆问题，为广义视觉定位提供了新的技术路径。

title: Reading the News: Adapting Large Language Models to Swedish Journalism Through Continued Pre-Training
summary: Large language models are increasingly capable in general, but their utility can remain modest in niche or understudied areas. One approach to address this limitation is to specialise existing models through additional training on target-domain corpora. In this work, we investigate such continued pre-training for adapting large language models to Swedish journalism, using a high-quality dataset that we curate from millions of news articles. To evaluate the adaptation efficacy, we also construct a novel domain-specific benchmark that covers six editorial tasks. Through full and parameter-efficient fine-tuning across two model sizes, we find that continued pre-training yields benefits in the target domain, but only when paired with experience replay to mitigate forgetting. We observe consistent enhancements in the models' generation quality and factual knowledge, but not their proficiency in discriminative tasks. Exploring a training-free method to facilitate instruction following, we see further improvements, but exclusively for models trained with low-rank adaptation. Crucially, we demonstrate the importance of targeted evaluation in the adaptation process, as an existing Swedish benchmark largely fails to capture the models' in-domain performance gains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了通过持续预训练将大语言模型适配到瑞典语新闻领域的有效性，发现该策略仅在配合经验重放时有效，能提升生成质量和事实知识但非判别任务性能，并强调定向评估的重要性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在通用领域能力不断提升，但在小众或研究不足的领域（如瑞典语新闻）效用有限，需要通过额外的领域语料训练来提升其专业能力。
AI.method: 从数百万篇新闻文章中构建高质量的瑞典语新闻语料库，进行持续预训练（包括全量微调和参数高效微调两种模式），同时构建包含六种编辑任务的领域特定基准进行评测，并探索无需训练的方法来促进指令遵循。
AI.result: 持续预训练在目标领域带来收益，但仅在配合经验重放以缓解遗忘时成立；模型在生成质量和事实知识方面有持续提升，但判别任务能力未见改善；低秩适应训练的模型在训练自由方法下获得进一步改进；现有瑞典语基准无法捕捉领域内性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 持续预训练可以有效地将大语言模型适配到特定领域，但需要注意灾难性遗忘的问题；领域特定的定向评估对于准确衡量适配效果至关重要，通用基准可能掩盖真实的性能提升。

title: OPUS: A Simple yet Effective Unified Framework for Open-Vocabulary Detection
summary: Recent unified open-vocabulary detection (OVD) supports heterogeneous prompts, including text queries, visual exemplars, and their combinations, but often rely on increasingly complex designs such as heavy cross-modal fusion, staged training, and iterative annotation pipelines. We revisit whether such complexity is necessary in the era of stronger foundation models. Our finding is that unified OVD can be made substantially simpler with semantic-rich visual representations and scalable grounding supervision. We present OPUS (\textbf{O}pen-vocabulary, \textbf{P}rompt-\textbf{U}nified, \textbf{S}imple), a unified detector supporting text, interactive visual, generic visual, and mixed prompting within one framework. OPUS adopts a simple three-part design. Its model architecture combines a semantic-rich visual encoder, built on a DINOv3-ConvNeXt-B backbone with efficient hybrid encoding, with a prompt-aware decoder that avoids prompt-specific branches for unified prompt reasoning. OPUS is trained with a one-stage text-visual training strategy with Instance-level Contrastive Alignment (ICA), and is supported by a SAM3-based single-pass data engine for heterogeneous grounding supervision. Experiments on COCO, LVIS-minival, and ODinW35 show that OPUS achieves state-of-the-art Visual-I performance, reaching 68.1/69.2/54.7 AP, while maintaining balanced Text and Visual-G accuracy. OPUS also turns mixed prompting from interference into complementarity, improving over text or visual prompt alone. These results show that simplicity and strong unified prompting capability can be achieved together.

AI.tldr: OPUS是一个统一开放词汇检测框架，通过语义丰富的视觉表示和可扩展的接地监督，在支持文本、视觉和混合提示的同时大幅简化了设计复杂度，在COCO、LVIS-minival和ODinW35上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有统一开放词汇检测框架虽然支持异构提示（文本、视觉示例及其组合），但往往依赖复杂的跨模态融合、分阶段训练和迭代标注流程。作者质疑在更强基础模型时代，这些复杂性是否必要，旨在探索更简洁的统一OVD方案。
AI.method: OPUS采用三部分简单设计：(1) 基于DINOv3-ConvNeXt-B骨干的语义丰富视觉编码器；(2) 无提示特定分支的提示感知解码器实现统一提示推理；(3) 单阶段文本-视觉联合训练策略，配合实例级对比对齐（ICA）和基于SAM3的单遍数据引擎生成异构接地监督。
AI.result: 在COCO、LVIS-minival和ODinW35上，OPUS的Visual-I性能达到68.1/69.2/54.7 AP，同时保持均衡的Text和Visual-G准确率。混合提示从干扰变为互补，优于单独使用文本或视觉提示。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证明简单性和强大的统一提示能力可以同时实现，表明在基础模型时代，统一OVD不需要过度复杂的设计。

title: TaxCE : A Framework for Automated Taxonomy Construction and Evaluation at Scale
summary: Organizing unstructured feedback text into hierarchical taxonomy is a fundamental challenge in NLP, particularly in domains where feedback arrives at massive scale in varied forms such as reviews, transcripts, and surveys. Existing approaches either produce shallow hierarchies, neglect long-tail topics, or lack rigorous evaluation frameworks. We present TaxCE, a fully automated framework that constructs multi-level hierarchical taxonomies from raw text through progressive condensation of corpus content into actionable segments, deduplicated semantic units, and granular topics with definitions, which are then organized bottom-up into a hierarchy with corpus-groundedness. We also introduce three corpus-grounded evaluation metrics, Exclusivity, Exhaustivity, and Granularity (EEG), and integrate them into a metrics-in-the-loop iterative refinement mechanism that diagnoses deficiencies and applies targeted corrections until convergence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TaxCE consistently outperforms existing baselines spanning classical topic models, neural methods, and LLM-based approaches, with average improvements of 11.8, 20.5, and 15.7 percentage points in exclusivity, exhaustivity, and granularity respectively over the strongest baseline. Human evaluation further confirms superior taxonomy quality, actionability, and navigability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TaxCE，一个全自动的层级文本分类体系构建框架，通过渐进式浓缩原始文本，将非结构化反馈构建为多层次主题分类体系，并引入三个语料扎根的评价指标（Exclusivity、Exhaustivity、Granularity）及迭代优化机制，在多个基线上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 非结构化反馈文本（如评论、转录、调查）规模庞大且形式多样，将其组织为层级分类体系是NLP中的基础性挑战。现有方法要么产生浅层分类体系，要么忽视长尾主题，且缺乏严格的评价框架。
AI.method: TaxCE框架通过三个步骤构建分类体系：1）将语料渐进式浓缩为可操作的片段；2）去重语义单元；3）自底向上组织为具有语料扎根性的层级主题。同时引入三个语料扎根的评价指标EEG（Exclusivity、Exhaustivity、Granularity），并设计metrics-in-the-loop迭代细化机制，诊断缺陷并针对性修正直至收敛。
AI.result: 在多个基线上（包括经典主题模型、神经方法和LLM方法），TaxCE在Exclusivity、Exhaustivity和Granularity上分别平均提升11.8、20.5和15.7个百分点（相对最强基线）。人工评估进一步证实了其分类体系质量、可操作性和可导航性更优。
AI.conclusion: TaxCE在自动构建层级分类体系方面显著优于现有方法，其引入的语料扎根评价指标和迭代优化机制有效解决了现有方法浅层分类、忽视长尾主题和缺乏严格评价的问题。

title: Centering before Pruning: Lightweight Geometry Correction for Diversity-Based Visual Token Pruning in LVLMs
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) incur substantial inference costs due to their long and highly redundant visual-token sequences. Diversity-based pruning mitigates this cost by selecting token subsets based on pairwise cosine similarity. We find, however, that similarities between raw visual tokens are strongly concentrated in the positive range, limiting their ability to distinguish non-redundant tokens. A natural way to improve this resolution is to center token features before computing cosine similarity. Centering indeed reveals a substantially richer pairwise structure, yet unexpectedly degrades pruning performance when used alone. We show that this apparent contradiction arises because the raw geometry does more than represent pairwise diversity: it also implicitly favors globally distinctive tokens, which tend to contain semantically informative content. Centering better resolves subset diversity but loses this useful token-wise preference, revealing that diversity and distinctiveness are entangled in the raw geometry. Based on this analysis, we propose the \textbf{Cen}tered Geometry \textbf{Prune}r (Cen-Prune), which measures subset diversity using centered cosine similarity while retaining raw-space distinctiveness as a complementary token-wise preference. This lightweight, plug-and-play correction leaves the underlying selection mechanism unchanged and incurs negligible computational overhead. Extensive experiments across multiple image- and video-understanding benchmarks and LVLM architectures demonstrate that Cen-Prune provides robust improvements in overall performance across existing diversity-based pruners.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Cen-Prune方法，通过将中心化余弦相似度（用于衡量子集多样性）与原始空间中的token显著性偏好相结合，解决了大视觉语言模型视觉token剪枝中原始几何无法同时表征多样性和显著性的矛盾，在多个基准和架构上稳定提升现有基于多样性的剪枝器性能。
AI.motivation: 大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）因视觉token序列长且高度冗余导致推理成本高昂。基于多样性的剪枝通过成对余弦相似度选择token子集以降低开销，但原始视觉token间的相似度高度集中在正值区间，难以区分非冗余token。虽然中心化能揭示更丰富的成对结构，但单独使用时反而降低剪枝性能，需要深度剖析这一矛盾并设计改进方案。
AI.method: 作者首先进行分析，发现原始几何不仅表征了token间的成对多样性，还隐式偏好全局显著性token（通常包含语义信息丰富的内容）；中心化虽然更好地分辨子集多样性，却丢失了这种有益的token级偏好。基于此，作者提出Cen-Prune：使用中心化余弦相似度衡量子集多样性，同时保留原始空间中的显著性作为补充的token级偏好，是一种轻量级、即插即用的修正方法，不改变底层选择机制。
AI.result: 在多个图像和视频理解基准以及多种LVLM架构上的大量实验表明，Cen-Prune为现有基于多样性的剪枝器提供了稳健的整体性能提升，且计算开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 多样性和显著性在原始token几何中被纠缠在一起，二者都是有效剪枝所必需的；Cen-Prune通过分离并互补利用这两种信号，实现了轻量且有效的性能改进。

title: Hidden Threat in Synthetic Data: Covert Targeted Bias Injection through Benign Text
summary: Synthetic data is increasingly used to train large language models (LLMs), yet its security implications remain poorly understood. Prior work on subliminal learning suggests that models can inherit behavioral traits from seemingly unrelated training data. In this work, we investigate whether such mechanisms can be exploited to inject targeted social biases into aligned models through semantically benign synthetic data. We construct a pipeline in which a misaligned teacher model generates filtered synthetic datasets across domains such as creative writing and code generation, which are then used to fine-tune aligned student models. Our experiments show that benign-looking synthetic data can act as a covert channel for transmitting targeted biases while largely preserving the student model's general task capabilities. These results reveal a previously underexplored security risk in synthetic data-driven LLM training pipelines and highlight the need for improved safeguards. As one possible step toward this goal, we suggest that log-linearity-based scoring may provide a useful signal for screening seemingly benign synthetic data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了通过语义上看似良性的合成数据，将目标性社会偏见注入对齐大语言模型的隐蔽渠道。实验表明，错位教师模型生成的过滤合成数据可作为隐蔽通道传递定向偏见，同时基本保留模型的一般任务能力，揭示了一个此前未被充分探索的安全风险。
AI.motivation: 合成数据在LLM训练中日益普及，但其安全影响尚未被充分理解。此前关于潜意识学习的研究表明模型可能从看似无关的训练数据中继承行为特征，本文旨在探究这种机制是否可被利用来通过良性合成数据注入目标性社会偏见。
AI.method: 构建了一个流水线：使用错位（misaligned）教师模型生成过滤后的合成数据集，涵盖创意写作和代码生成等多个领域，然后利用这些数据集对已对齐（aligned）的学生模型进行微调。
AI.result: 实验表明，看似良性的合成数据可以充当隐蔽通道，传递目标性偏见，同时基本保留学生模型的一般任务能力。此外，基于对数线性（log-linearity）的评分方法可能为筛选看似良性的合成数据提供有用信号。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了一个此前未被充分探索的、合成数据驱动LLM训练流程中的安全风险，强调了改进防护措施的必要性，并提出了log-linearity评分作为潜在筛查手段。

title: Motion-Saliency Complementary Masked Modeling for Point Cloud Video Understanding
summary: Point cloud video representation learning is crucial for 3D dynamic scene understanding. In this paper, we propose MoSaiC, a novel Motion-Saliency Complementary masked modeling framework for self-supervised point cloud video representation learning. MoSaiC couples three components: Curriculum Motion-Saliency Masking (CMSM), which guides the masking process toward motion-salient tokens under a curriculum schedule; Normal-Flow Motion (NFM) modeling, which supervises the local rigid rotation of each token in the Lie algebra so(3) as an explicit geometric motion target; and Cross-view Token Consistency Prediction (CTCP), which enforces consistency between two complementary masked views at the token level. Together, these components allow MoSaiC to effectively capture both appearance and motion dynamics. Extensive experiments on multiple downstream tasks, including action recognition, temporal action segmentation, and point-level semantic segmentation, demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出MoSaiC框架，通过课程运动显著性掩蔽、法向-流运动建模和跨视图令牌一致性预测三个组件，实现点云视频的自监督表示学习，在动作识别、时序动作分割和点级语义分割等下游任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 点云视频表示学习对3D动态场景理解至关重要，现有方法在捕捉外观和运动动态方面存在不足，需要更有效的自监督学习框架。
AI.method: MoSaiC包含三个核心组件：1) 课程运动显著性掩蔽(CMSM)，在课程调度下引导掩蔽过程聚焦于运动显著性令牌；2) 法向-流运动建模(NFM)，在so(3)李代数中监督每个令牌的局部刚性旋转作为显式几何运动目标；3) 跨视图令牌一致性预测(CTCP)，在令牌级别强制两个互补掩蔽视图之间的一致性。
AI.result: 在动作识别、时序动作分割和点级语义分割等多个下游任务上的大量实验表明，该方法能有效捕捉外观和运动动态，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MoSaiC通过耦合三个互补组件，有效地实现了点云视频的自监督表示学习，能够同时捕捉外观和运动动态信息，并在多个下游任务上表现出优越性能。

title: REER-PT: Reverse-Engineered Reasoning for Perplexity-Guided Pre-training Data Augmentation
summary: As language-model compute continues to scale, high-quality training data is becoming an increasingly important bottleneck. Conventional next-token prediction supervises what follows a context but leaves the intermediate reasoning behind that continuation implicit. We introduce \textbf{REER-PT}, a scalable framework that extends Reverse-Engineered Reasoning (REER) to raw pre-training data. REER-PT identifies continuations that are difficult to predict but can still be inferred from the preceding context, and inserts concise reasoning annotations that reconstruct the missing connection between context and continuation. Candidate annotations are generated and refined offline, with perplexity serving as the optimization signal. Constraints on length and target leakage filter out unhelpful or trivial annotations. This sparse transformation preserves the source text and remains compatible with standard next-token prediction, avoiding online reasoning rollouts during pre-training. We apply REER-PT to transform a source pre-training corpus into an augmented one. Across augmented-data, original-token, and selected-continuation comparisons, perplexity reductions range from 0.42 to 7.29, and only about 0.05\% of annotation 13-grams appear verbatim in the source text. We then train two 680M-parameter models with the same architecture and training configuration on the source and augmented corpora, respectively. The augmented-data model gains up to 2.07 percentage points on several knowledge and reasoning benchmarks. Together, the perplexity analysis indicates improved continuation predictability, while the controlled pre-training experiments suggest that this augmentation can improve model performance without changing the standard pre-training objective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REER-PT框架，将逆向工程推理（REER）扩展到原始预训练数据中，通过识别难以预测但可从上下文推断的续写，插入简洁的推理注释来重建上下文与续写之间的缺失联系。离线生成和优化候选注释，以困惑度作为优化信号，并通过长度约束和泄漏过滤去除非帮助性或琐碎的注释。在困惑度分析中实现0.42到7.29的降低，仅有约0.05%的注释13-gram在源文本中原样出现。在680M参数模型上的对照实验显示，增强数据模型在知识和推理基准上最多提升2.07个百分点，且不改变标准预训练目标。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型计算规模不断扩大，高质量训练数据成为关键瓶颈。传统的下一词预测只监督给定上下文后的续写，但隐含了续写背后的中间推理过程，这限制了模型从预训练数据中学习推理能力的效果。
AI.method: REER-PT框架包括两个核心部分：(1) 离线识别难以预测但可从前文推断的续写，并生成重构上下文与续写之间缺失连接的推理注释；(2) 以困惑度作为优化信号对候选注释进行生成和精炼，通过长度约束和目标泄漏过滤去除无帮助或琐碎的注释。该稀疏变换保留了源文本，与标准下一词预测兼容，避免在预训练期间进行在线推理rollout。
AI.result: 在增强数据、原始token和选定续写对比中，困惑度降低范围从0.42到7.29；只有约0.05%的注释13-gram在源文本中原样出现。训练两个680M参数模型（相同架构和训练配置）分别于源语料和增强语料上，增强数据模型在多个知识和推理基准上提升最多2.07个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 困惑度分析表明续写可预测性得到改善，受控预训练实验表明这种数据增强可以在不改变标准预训练目标的情况下提升模型性能，为规模化的高质量训练数据生成提供了可行路径。

title: SELECT: SELEctive Context Transfer for Class-Incremental Semantic Segmentation
summary: Class-Incremental Semantic Segmentation (CISS) is fundamentally challenged by catastrophic forgetting and background shift, where learning new concepts degrades performance on previously seen classes. While existing methods attempt to balance stability (retaining old knowledge) and plasticity (learning new knowledge), they often fail to leverage prior knowledge effectively. These approaches typically rely on indiscriminate knowledge transfer or ambiguous initializations, which can dilute crucial semantic information. To overcome this limitation, we propose SELECT, a novel approach for Selective Context Transfer, which instead grounds each new class in a small set of semantically similar past classes. Its core is a Context Transfer Attention mechanism that aggregates the learned tokens from similar classes into a structured initialization for the new class. To ensure this transfer does not corrupt the borrowed representations, we add a controlled noise perturbation and a margin-based context-transfer loss that enforces separation between the new class token and its source tokens. Extensive experiments on Pascal VOC and ADE20K show that SELECT consistently outperforms prior work, achieving mIoU of 2.2% on VOC and 2.8% on ADE, providing an effective handle on the stability-plasticity dilemma. Code is available at https://github.com/avigupta2798/SELECT.

AI.tldr: SELECT是一种用于类别增量语义分割（CISS）的新方法，通过选择性上下文转移机制，将每个新类别锚定在一小组语义相似的旧类别上，利用上下文转移注意力机制聚合相似类别的token作为新类别的结构化初始化，并引入噪声扰动和基于边距的上下文转移损失来防止知识损坏，在VOC和ADE20K上分别提升mIoU 2.2%和2.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有的类别增量语义分割方法面临灾难性遗忘和背景偏移两大挑战，虽然已有方法试图平衡稳定性与可塑性，但它们往往无法有效利用先验知识，依赖不加区分的知识转移或模糊初始化，这会稀释关键的语义信息，导致性能下降。
AI.method: 提出SELECT（Selective Context Transfer），核心包括：1) 将每个新类别锚定在少量语义相似的旧类别上，实现选择性而非全量知识转移；2) 设计上下文转移注意力机制（Context Transfer Attention），聚合相似类别的学习token为新类别提供结构化初始化；3) 引入受控噪声扰动防止借用表示被破坏；4) 使用基于边距的上下文转移损失，强化新类别token与其源token之间的分离。
AI.result: 在Pascal VOC和ADE20K上进行了大量实验，SELECT一致优于先前方法，在VOC上mIoU提升2.2%，在ADE上提升2.8%，有效解决了稳定性-可塑性困境。
AI.conclusion: SELECT通过选择性上下文转移机制为CISS问题提供了有效解决方案，验证了"少而精"的知识转移优于"多而杂"的全局转移，为增量学习中的先验知识利用提供了新思路。

title: GMTS: Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection Improves RLVR Training for LLM Reasoning
comment: Findings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL), particularly RL with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), has recently emerged as a central paradigm for enhancing large language models' (LLMs) reasoning abilities, demonstrating remarkable effectiveness across reasoning tasks. Recent studies suggest that high-entropy tokens play an exceptionally important role in model training, since training with only the highest 20% entropy tokens yields significant performance gains. However, why such high-entropy tokens are beneficial remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we find that although high-entropy tokens within one answer tend to correlate with large gradient magnitude, entropy alone fails to consistently reflect token importance across different answers, considering the variations in the answer-level reward signals. Based on this observation, we introduce the Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection (GMTS) method to quantify token importance, which leverages the entropy-gradient connection to approximate gradient-magnitude rankings for token selection. We find that training on the top 20% tokens ranked by GMTS consistently outperforms entropy-based token selection across three reasoning domains and various model sizes, suggesting that GMTS provides a more fine-grained estimate of token contribution for RLVR training.

AI.tldr: 本文发现高熵Token在RLVR训练中的重要性不能通过熵值本身跨答案一致衡量，提出基于梯度幅度的Token选择方法（GMTS），利用熵-梯度连接近似梯度幅度排名来选择Token，在三个推理领域和多种模型规模上优于基于熵的Token选择方法。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明高熵Token对LLM推理能力训练至关重要（仅用最高20%熵Token训练即可获得显著性能提升），但高熵Token为何有益尚未被充分理解，且熵值无法跨答案一致反映Token重要性。
AI.method: 提出GMTS（Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection）方法，利用熵-梯度之间的连接关系来近似Token的梯度幅度排名，从而对Token重要性进行细粒度量化并据此进行Token选择。
AI.result: 在三个推理领域和多种模型规模上，基于GMTS排名前20%的Token进行训练一致优于基于熵的Token选择方法，表明GMTS能提供更细粒度的Token贡献估计。
AI.conclusion: GMTS通过梯度幅度更准确地反映Token在RLVR训练中的真实贡献，为高熵Token选择提供了更好的替代方案，有助于进一步理解Token重要性在推理训练中的作用机制。

title: Dynamic Hub-and-Spoke Memory for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video understanding requires answering questions at arbitrary times over a continuously growing visual stream. The central challenge is to compactly remember long-range history while effectively retrieving question-relevant evidence. We propose Dynamic Hub-and-Spoke Memory (D-HSM), a training-free framework that represents distant history as structured textual memory while preserving the recent frames as visual tokens for fine-grained perception. Specifically, D-HSM turns selected historical video chunks into typed textual observations and stores them in an entity-centered hub-and-spoke memory, with entities as hubs and related evidence as spokes. When answering a question, D-HSM dynamically retrieves a compact question-aware memory subset, expands it through hub-and-spoke links, and combines it with the recent visual window for frozen-VLM answer prediction. Extensive experiments on both streaming and long video benchmarks show that D-HSM consistently and substantially improves VLM backbones and outperforms other state-of-the-art online and offline video understanding baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出动态枢纽-辐条记忆框架(D-HSM)，一种无需训练的流式视频理解方法，通过将远处历史转化为结构化文本记忆并保留近期帧为视觉令牌，实现高效的长时程视频问答。
AI.motivation: 流式视频理解需要在不断增长的视觉流中任意时刻回答问题，核心挑战是紧凑地记忆长时程历史同时有效检索与问题相关的证据。现有方法难以兼顾长期记忆的紧凑性和细粒度感知的准确性。
AI.method: D-HSM将选定的历史视频片段转化为类型化文本观察，存储在以实体为中心的枢纽-辐条记忆结构中（实体为枢纽，相关证据为辐条）。回答问题时，动态检索紧凑的问题感知记忆子集，通过枢纽-辐条链接扩展，并与近期视觉窗口结合，交由冻结的VLM进行答案预测。
AI.result: 在流式和长视频基准测试上的大量实验表明，D-HSM一致且显著地提升了VLM骨干网络的性能，并超越了其他最先进的在线和离线视频理解基线方法。
AI.conclusion: D-HSM通过混合文本记忆与视觉令牌的架构，在无需训练的前提下有效解决了流式视频理解中长时程记忆与细粒度感知之间的权衡问题，展现出较强的通用性和迁移能力。

title: BiG-SURE - Bipartite Graph for Semantic Uncertainty and Reliability Estimation of LLMs
summary: Reliable uncertainty estimation is a crucial requirement for deploying large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) in safety-critical settings, especially when the model parameters are not accessible (black-box). We propose BiG-SURE, an uncertainty estimator based on cross-temperature semantic agreement. The method samples low-temperature responses as stable semantic anchors and high-temperature responses as probes under meaning-preserving input transformations. It then constructs an anchor-probe Bipartite Graph (BiG) using NLI-based entailment scores and defines confidence through the normalized squared spectral energy of this matrix, with uncertainty given by its complement. This bipartite graph-based Semantic Uncertainty and Reliability Estimation (SURE) score measures whether high-temperature probes remain semantically aligned with the model's stable low-temperature belief or not. We evaluate BiG-SURE on text QA, multilingual QA, and multimodal QA tasks across multiple model families. In these experiments, BiG-SURE improves average abstention AUROC over prior black-box uncertainty estimators, while remaining simple, unsupervised, and applicable to black-box model settings.

AI.tldr: BiG-SURE是一种基于跨温度语义一致性的黑盒不确定性估计方法，通过构建锚点-探针二分图并利用NLI蕴含分数计算归一化谱能量来评估LLM/VLM在安全关键场景中的置信度。
AI.motivation: 在安全关键场景中部署LLM和VLM时，可靠的不确定性估计至关重要，尤其是在模型参数不可访问的黑盒场景下，现有的不确定性估计方法难以有效工作。
AI.method: 该方法采样低温响应作为稳定语义锚点，高温响应作为探针，在保持语义的输入变换下，利用NLI蕴含分数构建锚点-探针二分图，通过该矩阵的归一化平方谱能量定义置信度，其补数即为不确定性分数。
AI.result: 在文本问答、多语言问答和多模态问答任务上，跨多个模型家族进行实验，BiG-SURE相比先前的黑盒不确定性估计方法在平均弃权AUROC上取得了改进。
AI.conclusion: BiG-SURE保持简单、无需监督、适用于黑盒模型设置，同时显著提升了不确定性估计的可靠性。

title: Learning to Restore More: Continual Capability Expansion for Pretrained Image Restoration Models
summary: Image restoration models are typically trained with a fixed set of capabilities. When new restoration requirements emerge, existing solutions usually train additional models or jointly retrain the original model with both new and historical data. Instead of designing another restoration backbone, we investigate how a trained restorer can continually acquire new capabilities without forgetting those learned previously. We propose RestoreMore, a continual capability-expansion framework that preserves the pretrained restoration model as a frozen capability anchor and learns residual expansion modules for newly arriving degradations. RestoreMore introduces a capability-oriented bi-level routing mechanism at multiple feature stages. The first routing level identifies restoration capabilities relevant to the current input, while the second selects and combines a sparse set of complementary degradation experts. This design enables newly introduced tasks to selectively reuse historical restoration knowledge and progressively enriches the expert bank available for subsequent restoration tasks. Extensive experiments on a wide range of restoration benchmarks demonstrate that RestoreMore consistently acquires new restoration abilities while preserving and improving previously learned capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RestoreMore框架，通过冻结预训练修复模型作为能力锚点，学习残差扩展模块，并引入能力导向的双层路由机制，使图像修复模型能够持续获取新能力而不遗忘旧能力。
AI.motivation: 传统图像修复模型以固定能力集训练，当出现新的修复需求时需要额外训练模型或联合重训，成本高昂且效率低下。本文旨在探索如何让已训练的修复器持续获取新能力而不遗忘先前学到的能力，避免从头重新设计修复骨干网络。
AI.method: RestoreMore框架包含三个关键设计：(1) 冻结预训练修复模型作为能力锚点，保持历史能力不变；(2) 学习残差扩展模块应对新出现的退化类型；(3) 在多个特征阶段引入能力导向的双层路由机制——第一层识别与当前输入相关的修复能力，第二层选择并组合稀疏的互补退化专家。该设计使新任务能选择性复用历史修复知识，并逐步丰富专家库供后续任务使用。
AI.result: 在广泛的修复基准上进行的大量实验表明，RestoreMore能够持续获取新的修复能力，同时保持甚至提升先前学到的能力。
AI.conclusion: RestoreMore通过能力保留与增量扩展的范式，有效解决了图像修复模型的持续学习问题，实现了新老能力的和谐共存与知识复用。

title: What It Costs to Compose, Rebuild, and Correct Precomputed Memory
summary: Language models can answer from precomputed memory, a model's saved reading of a body of material, reused across requests instead of read again at each. This paper maps where that practice preserves correctness and the conditions under which it fails. Across experiments on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct using both saved key-value caches and trained compressions of them, precomputed memory degrades when assembled from separately prepared parts, stays current only through rebuilds costing a large fraction of full preparation in our measurements, and ignores corrections served beside it conditional on phrasing. If precomputed memories can be served alongside one another, be cost-efficiently rebuilt, and be superseded by new information arriving in real-time, they can serve as a way to avoid re-feeding context to a model over repeated queries. The implication of our results for a deployed system that deals with a variety of queries is that precomputed memories are best rebuilt on the cadence at which new information changes what the memory was originally computed from. Both warm-rebuilding trained compressions of key-value caches and serving specifically-phrased updates beside a memory, as pasted text or injected cache state, show particular promise for keeping precomputed memories current, the latter as an interim measure between rebuilds, and we measure the cost and name the remaining questions associated with each.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了语言模型"预计算记忆"（预先存储模型对材料的读取结果以复用）的适用边界与失效条件，发现其在分块组装时性能退化、需高成本重建才能保持时效、对条件性措辞的更新指令不敏感，并提出重建节奏与热重建等可行性路径。
AI.motivation: 语言模型可通过预计算记忆避免每次请求重复读取上下文，但这种方法何时能保持正确性、何时会失效尚不清楚，需要系统性映射其适用条件。
AI.method: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上开展实验，对比保存的键值缓存与训练压缩版本，测试分块组装、重建成本、实时信息更新等场景下的表现。
AI.result: 预计算记忆在从分离部分组装时性能退化；仅能通过高成本重建维持时效；对依赖措辞的修正信息不敏感。热重建压缩键值缓存和措辞特定的即时更新显示出了保持记忆时效的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 对于处理多样查询的部署系统，预计算记忆应按新信息变化原始记忆来源的节奏来重建；热重建与措辞特定的原位更新可作为可行方案，后者可作为重建之间的过渡措施。

title: ScenePilot: Grow-and-Repair Policy for Text-Driven 3D Indoor Scene Generation
summary: Text-driven 3D indoor scene generation has advanced from dataset-bound layout modeling to open-vocabulary synthesis with large language and vision-language models. Yet existing methods remain limited: one-pass generators often yield geometrically invalid layouts, heavy post-hoc optimization is costly and unstable, and prompt-only planners lack reusable layout priors for functional grouping and object relations. We propose \textbf{ScenePilot}, a retrieval-augmented \textbf{Grow-and-Repair} framework that formulates scene generation as prior-guided incremental growth with learned rectification. Given a prompt, the Hierarchical Retrieval-Augmented Planning (HRAP) module retrieves room-, group-, and anchor-level layout priors to support functional group planning. A text-driven base generator then inserts object groups sequentially, while the Reinforcement Multimodal Repair (RMR) module performs lightweight local correction after each insertion and a final global repair after completion. To train this policy, we construct \textbf{SceneReverse-17k}, a repair-trajectory dataset built by perturbing high-quality 3D scenes in position, rotation, and scale, then using inverse operations as executable rectification targets. The policy predicts structured \emph{move--rotate--scale} actions from rendered views, scene state, retrieved priors, and edit history. By combining HRAP with RMR, ScenePilot offers an efficient alternative to one-shot generation and heavy full-scene optimization, improving physical plausibility, functional coherence, and controllability while preserving diversity.

AI.tldr: ScenePilot是一个检索增强的Grow-and-Repair框架，通过层次化检索增强规划和强化多模态修复，实现文本驱动的3D室内场景生成，提高了物理合理性、功能连贯性和可控性。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动3D室内场景生成方法存在三大局限：一次性生成器常产生几何无效布局、重后验优化成本高且不稳定、仅提示词规划缺乏可复用的布局先验来支持功能分组和物体关系。
AI.method: 提出Grow-and-Repair框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) Hierarchical Retrieval-Augmented Planning (HRAP)模块，从房间、组、锚点三个层级检索布局先验；(2) 文本驱动的基生成器逐个插入物体组；(3) Reinforcement Multimodal Repair (RMR)模块在每次插入后执行轻量级局部修正，完成后进行全局修复。训练数据为构建的SceneReverse-17k修复轨迹数据集，通过扰动高质量3D场景并使用逆操作作为可执行修正目标，策略从渲染视图、场景状态、检索先验和编辑历史中预测move-rotate-scale结构化动作。
AI.result: ScenePilot结合HRAP与RMR，相比一次性生成和重全场景优化方法更具效率，在物理合理性、功能连贯性和可控性方面均有提升，同时保持场景多样性。
AI.conclusion: ScenePilot通过增量生长与学习修正相结合的策略，为3D室内场景生成提供了一种高效且稳定的替代方案，兼顾了生成质量与计算代价的平衡。

title: Where Identity Lives: Localized, Retain-Free Identity Unlearning in Multimodal Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Removing a specific individual's information from multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is often needed after deployment, but existing methods rely on a retain set, which is hardest to obtain at that point, and rebuilding it recreates the privacy exposure that unlearning aims to remove. Forgetting from the forget set alone instead damages the shared visual-language computation, harming perception. We cast retain-free unlearning as a localization problem: causal tracing, weight transplant, and Fisher overlap all point to early-to-mid decoder MLPs as the layers where identity information is stored and, unlike other module families, can be modified without substantially disrupting vision. We turn this into Pathway-Aware Visual-attribute Anchoring (PAVA), which confines updates to these layers and pairs a forget loss with a visual-attribute anchor that preserves image-grounded behavior by distilling the model's own pre-unlearning answers from the forget images alone. On MLLMU-Bench and ReMem, PAVA gives the strongest forget-retain trade-off among forget-set-only methods and remains competitive with retain-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAVA方法，通过将多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的遗忘问题定位到解码器早期到中期的MLP层，仅使用遗忘集即可实现无需保留集的机器遗忘，在保持视觉能力的同时有效移除特定个体信息。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM机器遗忘方法依赖保留集（retain set），但在模型部署后获取保留集十分困难，且重建保留集会重新引入隐私暴露风险。仅使用遗忘集进行遗忘则会破坏共享的视觉-语言计算，损害感知能力。因此需要一种无需保留集的遗忘方案。
AI.method: 将无需保留集的遗忘视为定位问题：通过因果追踪、权重移植和Fisher重叠三种分析手段，识别出解码器早期到中期MLP层是身份信息存储的关键层，且这些层的修改不会显著破坏视觉能力。据此提出Pathway-Aware Visual-attribute Anchoring (PAVA)，将更新限制在这些特定层，并用遗忘损失配合视觉属性锚定（通过蒸馏模型自身在遗忘图像上的遗忘前回答）来保持图像接地行为。
AI.result: 在MLLMU-Bench和ReMem基准上，PAVA在仅使用遗忘集的方法中取得了最强的遗忘-保留权衡，并且与依赖保留集的基线方法表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过精准定位并仅修改保存身份信息的特定解码器MLP层，可以仅凭遗忘集实现有效的MLLM机器遗忘，兼顾隐私移除与视觉能力保持，为部署后的遗忘场景提供了实用且高效的解决方案。

title: Knowing Beyond the Known: Reinforced Knowledge Specification for Multi-Label Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Existing class-incremental learning methods struggle in multi-label scenarios (MLCIL) due to the inherent contradiction of learning objectives arising from co-occurring and incomplete labels. We argue that the core obstacle is the model's ambiguous boundary between known and unknown knowledge, which undermines historical knowledge retention, complicates current task learning, and limits adaptability to future concepts. To address this, we propose KBK (Knowing Beyond the Known), a reinforced knowledge specification framework that explicitly models what is known or not to unify historical, current, and prospective learning. Specifically, to clarify known knowledge, we develop a hierarchical feature purification module that disentangles fine-grained class-specific features from global features, where high-level semantic abstraction is reinforced with low-level visual features. Additionally, an uncertainty-aware recall enhancement strategy suppresses unreliable predictions based on distribution priors, improving the quality of historical recall. For probing the unknown, KBK leverages semantic correlations to synthesize informative unknown features under co-occurring, preserving embedding space for future learning. Furthermore, to mitigate heterogeneous forgetting, we design a category-balanced gradient compensation loss that dynamically reweights gradient backpropagation according to forgetting speeds. Experiments on multiple benchmarks validate the effectiveness and robustness of KBK, which surpasses prior best methods by 2.7% in Avg. Acc on MS-COCO B0-C10 setting even without any replay buffers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KBK（Knowing Beyond the Known）框架，通过显式建模"已知"与"未知"知识来统一多标签类增量学习中的历史、当前和未来学习，解决多标签场景下类增量学习的固有矛盾。
AI.motivation: 多标签类增量学习（MLCIL）中，共现标签和不完整标签导致学习目标存在内在矛盾，现有方法难以应对。核心障碍在于模型对已知和未知知识的边界模糊，这损害了历史知识保持、使当前任务学习复杂化，并限制了未来概念的适应性。
AI.method: KBK包含四个关键组件：(1) 层级特征净化模块，将细粒度类特定特征从全局特征中解耦，并用低层视觉特征增强高层语义抽象；(2) 不确定性感知的回忆增强策略，基于分布先验抑制不可靠预测，提升历史回忆质量；(3) 利用语义相关性合成共现条件下的信息性未知特征，为未来学习保留嵌入空间；(4) 类别均衡梯度补偿损失，根据遗忘速度动态重新加权梯度反向传播以缓解异构遗忘。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上验证了KBK的有效性和鲁棒性，在MS-COCO B0-C10设定下，即使不使用任何回放缓冲区，平均准确率超过此前最优方法2.7%。
AI.conclusion: KBK通过显式区分已知与未知知识，统一了历史、当前和未来三个方向的学习，有效解决了多标签类增量学习中的核心障碍，为无需回放缓冲区的MLCIL提供了一种新的强基线方案。

title: SwarmBench: Can Large Language Models Act as Agent Swarm Orchestrators?
summary: Large language model-based multi-agent systems are evolving from fixed interaction topologies toward dynamically orchestrated Agent Swarms. However, existing benchmarks are still largely based on single-agent or general-purpose agent tasks, making it difficult to systematically evaluate key orchestration capabilities. We propose SwarmBench, a benchmark that evaluates model performance from multiple perspectives, including accuracy, efficiency, cost, and process quality. Experimental results show that current models exhibit substantial differences in orchestration capability. These differences are reflected not only in final accuracy, efficiency, and cost, but also in the overall quality of the orchestration process itself. Based on these findings, we further propose SwarmExp, a simple yet effective method based on experience extraction and experience replay, which consistently improves the orchestration performance of large language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SwarmBench基准测试框架，从准确性、效率、成本和过程质量四个维度评估大语言模型在动态编排的Agent Swarm系统中的编排能力，并提出SwarmExp方法（基于经验提取与经验重放）来显著提升模型的编排性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试主要基于单智能体或通用任务，难以系统评估大规模语言模型多智能体系统从固定交互拓扑向动态编排的Agent Swarm演进中的关键编排能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出SwarmBench，从准确性、效率、成本和过程质量多维度评估模型编排能力；2) 提出SwarmExp方法，通过经验提取和经验重放机制提升大语言模型的编排性能。
AI.result: 实验表明当前模型在编排能力上存在显著差异，这些差异不仅体现在最终的准确性、效率和成本上，还体现在编排过程的整体质量上；SwarmExp方法能一致性地提升大语言模型的编排性能。
AI.conclusion: SwarmBench为Agent Swarm编排能力提供了系统化的评估框架，揭示了现有模型的编排能力差异，同时证明了基于经验重放的SwarmExp方法能有效提升大语言模型在动态多智能体系统中的编排表现。

title: CapFrame: Text-Instructed Viewpoint Grounding in 3D Gaussian Scenes via Geometric Pseudo Labels
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic real-time novel view synthesis, yet placing a virtual camera to capture a desired frame remains largely manual. Existing language-guided approaches in 3D scenes mainly focus on object-centric grounding, determining what to observe but rarely controlling how it should appear in a single frame, such as subject orientation or frame layout. To address this limitation, we introduce a new task, Text-Instructed Viewpoint Grounding (TIVG), which aims to identify a 6-DoF camera pose in a 3D Gaussian scene whose rendered frame aligns with a text instruction. To solve this task, we propose CapFrame, a partially differentiable framework that converts language into geometric pseudo labels for camera pose optimization. CapFrame follows a Retrieve-Translate-Refine pipeline: it retrieves relevant views and ranks them through a Question-Evaluation process with MLLMs, translates the instruction into orientation and layout pseudo labels, and refines the camera pose via differentiable optimization with layout and orientation losses in 3DGS. Experiments on 38 real-world scenes with 135 instructions indicate that CapFrame produces viewpoints better aligned with texts than heuristic viewpoint search and adapted trajectory generation baselines, validated by VLM metrics, MLLM judges, and user studies. Code is available at: https://github.com/jirongli/CapFrame

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个新任务——文本指令视点定位（TIVG），旨在3D高斯场景中根据文本指令找出对应的6自由度相机位姿；并提出CapFrame框架，通过"检索-翻译-精炼"管线将语言指令转化为几何伪标签，实现相机位姿的可微优化。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS中的语言引导方法主要聚焦于物体级定位，只能决定"看什么"，而很少控制"怎么呈现"（如主体朝向或画面构图）；同时手动放置虚拟相机来捕捉理想画面仍然高度依赖人工。
AI.method: CapFrame采用检索-翻译-精炼（Retrieve-Translate-Refine）管线：首先检索相关视图并通过多模态大模型（MLLMs）的问题-评估过程进行排序；然后将文本指令翻译为朝向和构图伪标签；最后在3DGS中通过布局损失和朝向损失进行相机位姿的可微优化。
AI.result: 在38个真实场景和135条指令上的实验表明，CapFrame生成的视点相比启发式视点搜索和改编的轨迹生成基线更符合文本描述，并通过VLM指标、MLLM评判和用户研究进行了验证。
AI.conclusion: CapFrame首次实现了文本指令驱动的3DGS视点精确定位，弥合了自然语言描述与相机位姿之间的鸿沟，为语言引导的3D场景自由视图渲染提供了新路径。

title: MURANO: Design, Run, and Reproduce Mechanistic Interpretability Experiments as Composable Pipelines
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 System Demonstrations Track. 11 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables
summary: This paper presents Murano, an open source framework for designing, running, and reproducing mechanistic interpretability studies of large language models, intended for researchers across disciplines. These studies often combine loading, recording, attribution, intervention, and evaluation, while existing libraries tend to focus on different parts of this workflow. As a result, researchers using several libraries may need to adapt outputs from one for use by another. To bridge this gap, Murano represents operations from these five areas as composable steps. Steps exchange named result artifacts and declare the inputs they require and the outputs they produce. A pipeline executes its steps in the order supplied, and Murano uses canonical addresses when component identities pass between operations. Murano builds on existing interpretability and machine learning libraries. We demonstrate Murano through two reproductions of established interpretability studies and one illustrative sparse autoencoder case study.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Murano，一个用于设计、运行和复现大语言模型机制可解释性研究的开源框架。它通过将加载、记录、归因、干预和评估五个领域的操作表示为可组合步骤，弥合了现有库各自专注于工作流不同部分所造成的衔接问题。
AI.motivation: 机制可解释性研究通常涉及加载、记录、归因、干预和评估等多个环节，但现有库往往只专注于其中某一部分，导致研究者需要在多个库之间手动转换输出格式，降低了研究效率和可复现性。
AI.method: Murano将五个领域（加载、记录、归因、干预、评估）的操作表示为可组合的步骤。每个步骤交换命名结果工件，并声明所需的输入和产生的输出。管道按顺序执行各步骤，组件身份通过规范地址在操作间传递。框架建立在现有的可解释性和机器学习库之上。
AI.result: 作者通过复现两项已有的可解释性研究以及一个稀疏自编码器案例研究，演示了Murano框架的有效性和实用性。
AI.conclusion: Murano作为一个开放源码框架，通过步骤组合和工件交换机制解决了可解释性研究工具碎片化的问题，为跨学科研究者提供了统一的研究与复现平台。

title: Proximity3D: Shape from Capacitive Proximity on Sensing Manifold
summary: Most shape reconstruction methods assume measurements defined over planar sensing domains, such as RGB images or depth maps. In this paper, we use a curved capacitive textile as a shape sensor, treating its surface as a non-planar sensing manifold. Each scan is represented as a capacitive proximity field on this manifold, induced by the interaction between the curved electrode layout and nearby object geometry. We introduce a multi-view feedforward reconstruction model that aggregates these fields across known sensor views and recovers the observed object shape. Simulated and physical experiments demonstrate robust reconstruction from capacitive proximity signals acquired on curved sensing surfaces, pointing toward a new route to robotic near-field geometric awareness via embodied sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用曲面电容织物作为形状传感器，将曲面表面视为非平面感知流形，通过多视角前馈重建模型聚合电容近场信号来恢复物体形状，实验表明该方法在曲面传感上具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有形状重建方法大多假设平面传感域（如RGB图像或深度图），缺乏对非平面曲面传感表面的形状重建研究。
AI.method: 使用曲面电容织物作为形状传感器，将表面建模为非平面感知流形；每次扫描表示为该流形上的电容近场；提出多视角前馈重建模型，聚合已知传感器视角下的场并恢复物体形状。
AI.result: 模拟和物理实验均证明了该方法能从曲面传感表面获取的电容近场信号中稳健地重建物体形状。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为机器人通过具身感知实现近场几何感知开辟了新途径。

title: OCR-MetaReasoning Benchmark: Evaluating the Meta-Reasoning Ability of MLLMs in Text-Rich Image Understanding
summary: Text-rich image understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to organize OCR (Optical Character Recognition)-grounded evidence across words, layout, fields, charts, and visual correspondences. Existing evaluations often conflate extraction with reasoning and rarely test whether models follow the required reasoning direction: applying visible rules, abstracting hidden regularities, or recovering missing premises. We introduce OCR-MetaReasoning, a controlled single-image benchmark that treats deduction, induction, and abduction as distinct directions and separates final-answer correctness from reasoning-process compliance. The benchmark contains 1,500 verified samples in a balanced \(3\times5\) taxonomy crossing three reasoning types with five OCR-object categories, along with reference reasoning steps, automatic answer scoring, the Meta-Reasoning Macro Score (MRMS), and the Reasoning Process Compliance Score (RPCS). Experiments with representative closed-source and open-source MLLMs show that OCR-grounded meta-reasoning remains far from saturated: models struggle with visible-rule application and layout-sensitive inference, while process-compliant rationales can accompany incorrect final answers under exact-match evaluation. The code is available at https://github.com/gengxuli/OCR-MetaReasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OCR-MetaReasoning，一个用于评估多模态大语言模型在OCR文本丰富图像中元推理能力的单图像基准，涵盖演绎、归纳、溯因三种推理方向及五类OCR对象，并通过MRMS和RPCS两种分数分别评估答案正确性与推理过程合规性。
AI.motivation: 现有评估方法往往将OCR提取与推理混为一谈，很少测试模型是否遵循所需的推理方向（应用显式规则、抽象隐藏规律、或恢复缺失前提），缺乏对推理过程合规性的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建包含1,500个验证样本的3×5均衡分类基准，跨越三种推理类型（演绎、归纳、溯因）与五类OCR对象（单词、布局、字段、图表、视觉对应关系）；提供参考推理步骤、自动答案评分、MRMS和RPCS两种评估分数。
AI.result: 对代表性闭源和开源MLLM的实验表明，OCR为基础的元推理远未饱和：模型在显式规则应用和布局敏感推理上表现困难，且过程合规的推理链在精确匹配评估下可能与错误最终答案并存。
AI.conclusion: OCR元推理任务对现有MLLM仍具挑战性，推理过程的合规性与答案正确性需分别评估，MRMS与RPCS的分离设计为未来模型改进提供了更细粒度的诊断方向。

title: Seeing the Unseen: Camouflaged Object Detection Beyond the Visible Spectrum
summary: Recent advances in camouflaged object detection (COD) have led to substantial progress in challenging low-visibility scenarios, with pioneering studies demonstrating notable success in localizing objects in camouflaged scenes. Despite these achievements, existing approaches predominantly rely on conventional three-channel RGB imagery, thereby constraining the available visual information to a limited spectral range. Multispectral images offer a wide range of information about a scene by capturing fine-grained spectral signatures. Hence, by leveraging multispectral images for COD, we introduce a novel approach to detect camouflaged objects from the corresponding multispectral inputs. In particular, we propose an end-to-end framework, \textbf{\textit{MSFormer}}, that takes a multispectral camouflaged image as input and predicts a binary mask for it. Additionally, we also provide empirical justification for integrating multispectral bands for this complex low-vision task. Our extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, which outperforms existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MSFormer，一种端到端的基于多光谱图像的伪装目标检测框架，通过利用多光谱图像中丰富的频谱信息来突破传统RGB三通道的限制，实验证明该方法优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有伪装目标检测方法主要依赖传统的RGB三通道图像，视觉信息被限制在有限的频谱范围内，难以充分利用场景中的细微光谱特征来实现更准确的伪装目标定位。
AI.method: 提出端到端框架MSFormer，以多光谱伪装图像作为输入，预测对应的二值掩码，并给出整合多光谱波段的经验性论证依据。
AI.result: 大量实验证明该方法有效，性能优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 利用多光谱图像进行伪装目标检测是可行且有效的，MSFormer证明了多光谱信息在低可见性复杂任务中的潜力。

title: LCoT-GV: Graph Attention Networks for Verifying Long Reasoning Chains in Large Language Models
comment: 6 pages without references, 2 tables, 1 algorithm, 1 figure
summary: Large Reasoning Models produce Long Chains-of-Thought (LCoTs) which involve breaking down the problem into smaller reasoning steps before reaching the conclusion. However, these steps often contain contradictions, unsupported inferences, or irrelevant steps, even when the final answer is correct. We propose Long Chain-of-Thought Graph Verifier (LCoT-GV), a graph-based framework that represents LCoTs as reasoning graphs. Each node in the graph represents a reasoning step and the edges encode semantic and logical relations. A Graph Attention Network is then trained to predict chain-of-thought correctness from the reasoning graph. We construct a new graph-oriented verification dataset from multiple reasoning benchmarks for question answering in various domains. The results show that our method is competitive with the most similar approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LCoT-GV，一种基于图的验证框架，将大语言模型生成的长思维链表示为推理图，并使用图注意力网络预测其正确性。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型生成长思维链时，即使最终答案正确，中间推理步骤也常包含矛盾、无依据推断或无关步骤，需要有效的验证机制来评估思维链的质量。
AI.method: 将长思维链建模为推理图：节点表示推理步骤，边编码步骤间的语义和逻辑关系；随后训练图注意力网络（GAT）从推理图中预测思维链的正确性；并构建了基于多个推理基准的多领域图导向验证数据集。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，LCoT-GV在与最相似方法的对比中具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 图结构能够有效捕获长思维链中推理步骤之间的复杂关系，基于图的验证方法是评估长思维链正确性的可行途径。

title: MCSeg: Pre-training and Fine-tuning Volumetric Pyramid Transformer for Multi-modal Cardiac Image Segmentation
summary: Automatic cardiac image segmentation is pivotal for diagnosing and treating cardiac diseases. In this work, we introduce MCSeg, a volumetric transformer-based network tailored for multi-modal cardiac segmentation. To overcome the architectural mismatch inherent in existing hybrid networks, we propose a novel Scaling Feature Pyramid (SFP). Unlike conventional skip connections, the SFP effectively bridges the single-scale 3D Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder and the multi-scale CNN decoder by transforming the ViT's output into a hierarchical feature pyramid, ensuring that global contextual information is effectively leveraged. For the training paradigm, the ViT encoder first undergoes self-supervised pre-training via masked image modeling. Subsequently, the network is fine-tuned on downstream tasks, during which a regional mutual information (RMI) loss is integrated to improve boundary segmentation accuracy. In experiments, MCSeg consistently outperforms eleven SOTA methods on CT dataset ImageCHD, multi-modal dataset MM-WHS, MRI dataset HVSMR-2.0 and MSD Heart, highlighting the effectiveness of our MCSeg for multi-modal cardiac segmentation tasks.
