Furthermore, MCSeg's superior performance in few-shot experiment showcases its significant potential in adapting to limited data scenarios. Codes and pre-trained ViT-B weights are open-sourced at https://openi.pcl.ac.cn/OpenMedIA/MCSeg

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MCSeg，一种基于Transformer的体量分割网络，用于多模态心脏图像分割。通过创新的Scaling Feature Pyramid（SFP）桥接单尺度3D ViT编码器与多尺度CNN解码器，并采用掩码图像建模自监督预训练与区域互信息损失，在多个数据集上超越11种SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 自动心脏图像分割对心脏疾病的诊断和治疗至关重要。现有的混合网络在整合Transformer编码器与CNN解码器时存在架构不匹配问题，导致全局上下文信息无法被有效利用。
AI.method: 提出MCSeg网络，包含三个关键创新：(1) 设计Scaling Feature Pyramid (SFP)替代传统跳跃连接，将单尺度3D ViT编码器输出转换为层次化特征金字塔，以匹配多尺度CNN解码器；(2) ViT编码器通过掩码图像建模进行自监督预训练；(3) 在下游微调阶段引入区域互信息（RMI）损失以提升边界分割精度。
AI.result: MCSeg在CT数据集ImageCHD、多模态数据集MM-WHS、MRI数据集HVSMR-2.0和MSD Heart上均一致优于11种SOTA方法。在少样本实验中表现出色，展示了在有限数据场景下的适应潜力。
AI.conclusion: MCSeg在多模态心脏分割任务中展现了有效性和鲁棒性，其SFP设计有效解决了混合网络架构不匹配问题，且具有在小样本场景下的显著应用潜力。代码和预训练权重已开源。

title: WildSEEK: Evaluating Language Models for Information-Seeking
summary: Language models are increasingly mediating information access to end users, urging a systematic evaluation of their responses for a fair and reliable information ecosystem. Existing evaluations, however, are often topic-specific or synthetic, limiting their ability to capture the complexity of "in the wild" information-seeking queries and the risks present in model responses. To address this gap, we introduce WildSEEK, a manually annotated dataset of 3k information-seeking queries from real user interactions, and an evaluation framework for LLM-generated responses. WildSEEK includes annotations for risk-sensitive domains (e.g. health and financial information), and distinguishes factoid queries from analytical queries which seek responses beyond facts. We train classifiers on WildSEEK to analyze more than 1.8M realistic user queries. We find that over a third of information-seeking queries are high-risk and more often analytical. Our findings show that LLM responses fail more often in four criteria: sycophantic behavior, overreliance, a default US-centric perspective, and poor handling of vulnerable populations -- with failure rates being mostly higher for analytical queries. By providing methods to monitor the reliability, safety, and fairness of LLM behavior, our dataset and evaluation framework offer an empirical foundation for the broader question of how these systems should behave as they take on a growing role in information access.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了WildSEEK数据集，包含3k条来自真实用户交互的标注信息寻求查询及评估框架，并分析了180万条真实用户查询，发现超过三分之一的高风险查询中，LLM响应在谄媚行为、过度依赖、美国中心视角和弱势群体处理等方面存在失败。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估多为特定主题或合成数据，难以捕捉真实世界中信息寻求查询的复杂性和模型响应中的风险，亟需基于真实用户交互的系统性评估方法来监测LLM的可靠性、安全性和公平性。
AI.method: 手动标注3k条真实用户信息寻求查询构建WildSEEK数据集，包含风险敏感领域（如健康和金融）标注，区分事实性查询与分析性查询；训练分类器对180万条真实用户查询进行分析。
AI.result: 超过三分之一的信息寻求查询属于高风险且更多为分析性查询；LLM响应在四个标准上失败率更高：谄媚行为、过度依赖、默认美国中心视角、弱势群体处理不佳，且分析性查询的失败率普遍更高。
AI.conclusion: WildSEEK提供了监测LLM行为可靠性、安全性和公平性的方法，为LLM在信息获取中角色日益扩大的背景下如何规范行为提供了实证基础。

title: PRISM: Predictive Recomposition via Semantic Latent Decomposition for View-invariant Video Representation Learning
summary: Cross-view video representation learning aims to capture viewpoint-invariant action semantics despite substantial appearance changes across egocentric and exocentric videos. However, existing methods encode each video as a unified embedding, where view-invariant and view-variant semantics inevitably entangle under co-occurrences - a failure mode we show persists even in cross-view methods explicitly trained for view-invariance. Our key insight is that a view-invariant feature is truly disentangled when it can be sufficiently recomposed with an arbitrary view-variant feature while preserving their independent semantics. Building on this, we propose PRISM, that decomposes video into view-invariant and view-variant latents and recompose them under language supervision encouraging clean decomposition of the two streams. PRISM achieves state-of-the-art results on EgoExo4D, EgoExoLearn, AE2, even surpassing in-domain models under zero-shot setting. Code is available at https://github.com/litcoderr/prism.

AI.tldr: PRISM将跨视角视频分解为视角不变和视角可变两个潜在特征，并通过语言监督重组来强制解耦，在多个跨视角基准上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角视频表征学习方法将视频编码为单一嵌入，导致视角不变语义与视角可变语义在共现情况下不可避免地纠缠在一起，即使是专门训练视角不变性的方法也存在这一失败模式。
AI.method: 提出PRISM框架，将视频分解为视角不变和视角可变两个潜在特征，并在语言监督下将两者重组，确保独立语义被保留，从而实现真正的解耦。
AI.result: 在EgoExo4D、EgoExoLearn和AE2数据集上取得最先进结果，在零样本设置下甚至超越了领域内训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过重组式的解耦策略，PRISM有效解决了跨视角视频中视角不变与视角可变特征的纠缠问题，验证了"可重组即解耦"这一核心思想的有效性。

title: An Agentic Retrobiosynthesis Framework with Learned Frontier Selection
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as agents for multistep retrosynthesis, raising the question of how much their search policy contributes independently of the underlying reaction model. We investigate this question in a biological setting through rule-based retrobiosynthesis: a deterministic biochemical engine generates the same validated transitions for every method, searching for routes that terminate in metabolites available to an \emph{Escherichia coli} chassis, while the policy only selects which frontier molecule to expand next. Prompted and LoRA-tuned Qwen2.5-7B policies use a strict choice-only interface. The fine-tuned policy reaches $65\pm1$\% solve rate at 10 expansions on LASER versus 59\% for MCTS, and at 200 expansions reaches $78\pm1$\% versus 75\% on LASER, $88\pm3$\% versus 80\% on the RetroPath RL Golden benchmark, and $63\pm2$\% versus 45\% on the BioNavi-NP benchmark. Fine-tuning also consistently outperforms direct prompting. These results show that route-supervised frontier selection can improve budgeted search without altering biochemical generation, although performance remains dependent on frontier construction and reaction ranking.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在确定性生化引擎框架下，大语言模型作为逆生物合成搜索策略（仅负责选择前沿分子）的相对贡献。通过对比LoRA微调和提示词驱动的Qwen2.5-7B策略与MCTS基线，发现路线监督的前沿选择能显著提升预算受限搜索的表现，但性能仍依赖前沿构建和反应排序。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被越来越多地用作多步逆合成代理，但尚不清楚其搜索策略在多大程度上独立于底层反应模型做出贡献。作者希望在生物合成设定下，通过规则驱动的确定性生化引擎隔离反应模型因素，单独评估搜索策略的作用。
AI.method: 使用确定性生化引擎为所有方法生成相同的已验证转换，策略仅负责选择下一个要扩展的前沿分子（严格的choice-only接口）。对比了提示词驱动和LoRA微调的Qwen2.5-7B策略与MCTS基线，在LASER、RetroPath RL Golden和BioNavi-NP三个基准上评估。
AI.result: 微调策略在10次扩展时LASER上达到65±1%的求解率（MCTS为59%），200次扩展时LASER上78±1% vs 75%，RetroPath RL Golden上88±3% vs 80%，BioNavi-NP上63±2% vs 45%。微调一致优于直接提示词。
AI.conclusion: 路线监督的前沿选择策略可以在不改变生化生成的情况下提升预算受限搜索的性能，证明了LLM搜索策略的独立贡献价值，但性能上限仍受制于前沿构建和反应排序的质量。

title: Real-Time Scene-Adaptive Tone Mapping for High-Dynamic Range Object Detection
summary: High-dynamic-range (HDR) images, with their rich tone and detail reproduction, hold significant potential to enhance computer vision systems, particularly in autonomous driving. However, most neural networks for embedded systems are trained on low-dynamic-range (LDR) inputs and suffer substantial performance degradation when handling high-bit-depth HDR images due to the challenges posed by extreme dynamic ranges. In this paper, we propose a novel tone mapping method that not only bridges the gap between HDR RAW inputs and the LDR sRGB requirements of detection networks but also achieves end-to-end optimization with downstream tasks. Instead of relying on the traditional image signal processing (ISP) pipeline, we introduce neural photometric calibration to regularize dynamic ranges and a scaling-invariant local tone mapping model to preserve image details. In addition, our architecture also supports performance transfer finetuning, enabling efficient adaptation from the LDR sRGB images to the HDR RAW images with minimal cost. The proposed method outperforms traditional tone mapping algorithms and advanced AI-ISP methods in challenging automotive HDR scenes. Moreover, our pipeline achieves real-time processing of 4K high-bit-depth HDR inputs on NVIDIA Jetson platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出一种端到端可优化的神经色调映射方法，弥合HDR RAW输入与LDR sRGB检测网络之间的域差距，在不依赖传统ISP流水线的情况下，实现自动驾驶场景中4K高比特深度HDR图像的实时处理与下游任务联合优化。
AI.motivation: 大多数嵌入式系统上的神经网络都在LDR图像上训练，处理高比特深度HDR图像时性能严重下降，传统的ISP流水线无法同时满足HDR到LDR的映射和下游检测任务的优化需求。
AI.method: 提出神经光度校准模块来规整动态范围，并引入尺度不变的局部色调映射模型保留图像细节；架构支持性能迁移微调，实现从LDR sRGB图像到HDR RAW图像的低成本高效适配；支持与下游任务端到端联合优化。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的汽车HDR场景中优于传统色调映射算法和先进的AI-ISP方法；在NVIDIA Jetson平台上实现了4K高比特深度HDR输入的真实时处理。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的神经色调映射方法有效弥合了HDR RAW输入与LDR检测网络之间的差距，既保证了端到端优化能力，又达到了嵌入式平台上的实时性能，为自动驾驶系统中的HDR视觉应用提供了可行方案。

title: GUIDE: Guiding Internal Evidence with Language Instructions
summary: Large multimodal models follow instructions about what to generate, but not necessarily about what evidence to rely on. Hence, models may continue to depend on shortcut-associated cues even when instructions suggest otherwise. We introduce GUIDE, a framework for controlling internal evidence usage through language instructions. GUIDE combines grouped parameter-efficient adaptation with instruction-conditioned gating to modulate multimodal evidence pathways during reasoning and generation. We further introduce a pathway-level evaluation framework that characterizes instruction-conditioned evidence modulation through reliance sensitivity, controlled perturbation analysis, pathway modulation, and autoregressive decoding dynamics. Across multimodal reasoning, classification, and generation, GUIDE induces structured and instruction-aligned redistribution of evidence reliance while largely preserving task behavior. Experiments on GQA, TextVQA, MM-IMDb, CREMA-D, RAVDESS, and Flickr30K show that GUIDE improves robustness under targeted evidence perturbations and enables controllable modulation across diverse multimodal settings. This suggests that multimodal instruction following can extend beyond output control toward regulating how different evidence sources contribute to model predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GUIDE框架，通过分组参数高效适配与指令条件门控机制，控制大型多模态模型内部的证据使用路径，使模型不仅遵循指令生成内容，还能按指令调节依赖何种证据来源，提升鲁棒性并支持可控制的证据调制。
AI.motivation: 大型多模态模型虽然能遵循指令决定"生成什么"，但无法控制"依赖哪些证据"。模型在面对与捷径相关的线索时仍会继续依赖它们，即使指令暗示不应如此。现有方法缺乏对模型内部证据使用进行指令化控制的机制。
AI.method: GUIDE框架包含两个核心组件：1) 分组参数高效适配（grouped parameter-efficient adaptation），将模型参数分组进行高效微调；2) 指令条件门控（instruction-conditioned gating），根据语言指令动态调节多模态证据通路。同时提出通路级评估框架，通过依赖敏感性、受控扰动分析、通路调制和自回归解码动力学来刻画指令条件下的证据调制。
AI.result: 在GQA、TextVQA、MM-IMDb、CREMA-D、RAVESS和Flickr30K等数据集上，GUIDE在多种多模态推理、分类和生成任务中实现了结构化且与指令对齐的证据依赖重分配，同时在目标证据扰动下提升了鲁棒性，并实现了跨多样多模态场景的可控调制，且基本保持了任务行为不变。
AI.conclusion: 多模态指令遵循能力可以超越输出控制，延伸到调节不同证据来源如何贡献于模型预测，为更可控、更鲁棒的多模态推理提供了新方向。

title: ImageCAS-X: a dataset and benchmark for coronary artery segmentation and centerline extraction in coronary CT angiography
summary: Accurate segmentation of the coronary vessel lumen is a prerequisite for quantitative assessment of atherosclerotic plaque and perivascular adipose tissue in coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA). Cardiologists rely on semi-automated methods for this task because manual vessel tracing and segmentation are labour-intensive. Although many automated methods have been proposed, their validation remains limited by the lack of large, high-quality publicly available datasets. We provide a new dataset of voxel-wise annotations of the vessel lumen and coronary segments, alongside centerlines, and mesh surfaces for 800 scans from the publicly available ImageCAS dataset. Using this dataset, we benchmark established lumen segmentation methods against inter-observer variability, stratifying performance by disease, image quality, coronary dominance, coronary segment, vessel diameter, and lumen attenuation. These labels allow segmentation accuracy to be described in anatomical and clinical context rather than reported as a single aggregate score. The dataset supports the development and validation of methods for lumen segmentation, plaque and perivascular quantification, and haemodynamic modelling.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了基于公开ImageCAS数据集的800例CCTA扫描的冠状动脉管腔体素级标注数据集（含中心线和网格表面），并对现有管腔分割方法进行了基准测试，按疾病、图像质量、冠状动脉优势型、节段、血管直径和管腔衰减等临床特征分层评估性能。
AI.motivation: 冠状动脉管腔的准确分割是CCTA中动脉粥样硬化斑块和血管周围脂肪组织定量评估的前提。现有自动化方法由于缺乏大规模、高质量、公开可用的标注数据集而难以充分验证，且现有评估通常只报告单一聚合指标，缺乏解剖学和临床语境下的性能描述。
AI.method: 从公开ImageCAS数据集中选取800例扫描，提供管腔和冠状动脉节段的体素级标注、中心线及网格表面。基于该数据集对已有管腔分割方法进行基准测试，并与观察者间变异性进行比较，同时按疾病状态、图像质量、冠状动脉优势型、冠状动脉节段、血管直径和管腔衰减等临床因素进行分层性能评估。
AI.result: 建立了包含800例CCTA扫描的大规模公开标注数据集，并完成了对现有管腔分割方法的系统基准测试，揭示了分割准确度在不同解剖和临床语境下的差异表现，而非仅以单一分数呈现。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集填补了冠状动脉管腔分割验证中大规模高质量公开数据集的空白，支持管腔分割、斑块和血管周围脂肪定量以及血流动力学建模等方法的开发与验证。

title: SocialReasonBench: A Video-QA Benchmark for Social Reasoning with Counterfactual Narrative Videos
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 24 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables
summary: Recent advances in Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have greatly improved video understanding, yet their ability to reason about human-centered social situations remains limited. Existing benchmarks typically rely on videos with a single observed trajectory, making it difficult to determine whether models truly understand social dynamics or merely exploit recurring narrative patterns. We introduce SocialReasonBench, a video multiple-choice QA benchmark for evaluating socially grounded reasoning in scenarios derived from interactive narratives. Built from gameplay videos of Detroit: Become Human, the benchmark leverages branching storylines where player decisions lead to alternative social outcomes that can be checked against the game's own script, flowchart, and recorded branches. We develop a multi-agent curation pipeline that localizes socially meaningful clips, grounds answer labels in game-state signals, and generates theory-guided questions with diagnostic distractors. SocialReasonBench covers seven reasoning dimensions, including intent recognition, emotional empathy, moral dilemma, counterfactual reasoning, and causal antecedent. Experiments on contemporary LMMs show that models perform reasonably well on basic social understanding but struggle with counterfactual and causal reasoning. Further ablation and diagnostic error analyses reveal that models often depend on incomplete modality cues and fall into reasoning traps such as visual shortcuts, highlighting a gap between observable event recognition and deeper reasoning over latent social states.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SocialReasonBench，一个基于《底特律：变人》游戏分支剧情的视频多选题基准，用于评估大型多模态模型在社交场景中的推理能力。实验发现现有模型在基础社交理解上表现尚可，但在反事实和因果推理上存在明显不足，且容易依赖视觉捷径等推理陷阱。
AI.motivation: 现有大型多模态模型在视频理解上虽进步显著，但对以人为中心的社交情境推理能力有限。已有基准依赖单一观测轨迹的视频，难以判断模型是否真正理解社交动态还是仅利用重复出现的叙事模式，需要更严格的评估方案。
AI.method: 构建SocialReasonBench基准：利用《底特律：变人》游戏的分支叙事结构，玩家决策导致不同的社交结果，可通过游戏脚本、流程图和录制分支进行验证。采用多智能体策展流水线定位社交相关片段、基于游戏状态信号确定答案标签，并生成理论引导的问题及诊断性干扰项。覆盖七个推理维度，包括意图识别、情感共情、道德困境、反事实推理和因果前因。
AI.result: 实验表明当代LMM在基础社交理解上表现合理，但在反事实和因果推理上表现不佳。消融和诊断错误分析揭示模型常依赖不完整的模态线索，并陷入视觉捷径等推理陷阱，反映出可观察事件识别与潜在社交状态深层推理之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: SocialReasonBench通过利用可验证的分支叙事场景，为评估社交推理能力提供了更严格的基准。当前模型在识别可观察事件与推理潜在社交状态之间仍存在显著差距，为未来社交智能研究指明方向。

title: SePArate: Segmenting Patterns from Defects in Wafer Manufacturing Using Weak Supervision
comment: 7 pages, 8 figures. Accepted at the 63rd ACM/IEEE Design Automation Conference (DAC 2026)
summary: In semiconductor manufacturing, defect analysis is essential, but manual inspection cannot scale. However, existing automated inspection methods remain insufficient for root-cause analysis and process optimization. To this end, we present SePArate, a weakly supervised wafer defect segmentation method. SePArate enables pixel-level separation of patterns by leveraging only image-level annotations. It consists of a three-phase training: encoder pretraining, knowledge transfer to learn spatial cues, and training on synthetic mixed-defect data for accurate segmentation. Experiments demonstrate that SePArate outperforms the baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SePArate，一种弱监督晶圆缺陷分割方法，仅利用图像级标注实现像素级缺陷模式分离，通过三阶段训练（编码器预训练、知识迁移学习空间线索、合成混合缺陷数据训练）提升分割精度。
AI.motivation: 半导体制造中缺陷分析至关重要，但人工检测无法规模化，现有自动化检测方法在根本原因分析和工艺优化方面仍不够充分。
AI.method: SePArate采用弱监督学习框架，仅需图像级标注即可实现像素级缺陷分割。包含三阶段训练流程：首先是编码器预训练，其次是知识迁移以学习空间线索，最后在合成的混合缺陷数据上进行训练以实现精确分割。
AI.result: 实验表明SePArate在缺陷分割性能上优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SePArate为半导体晶圆缺陷分析提供了一种高效的弱监督分割方案，克服了人工检测的规模瓶颈，同时弥补了现有自动化方法在根本原因分析方面的不足。

title: Mind the Gap: Theory-of-Mind-Grounded Friction for Epistemic Alignment
summary: Productive dialogue alignment requires distinguishing \emph{surface coordination} (acknowledgments and smooth task progression) from \emph{epistemic alignment} (convergence of belief states); standard preference-based methods typically optimize response-level preferences without explicitly modeling the latter. We operationalize Theory-of-Mind (ToM) inference as a control signal within Frictive Policy Optimization by extracting, at each referring expression, a four-part belief structure: the speaker's intended referent, the addressee's interpretation, and each participant's model of the other's belief. This makes friction mechanically computable from epistemic-state comparisons, capturing \emph{silent divergence}, where both participants proceed confidently while grounding to different referents. We evaluate the signal at two levels. At the representation level, ablating the second-order channel reduces misunderstanding recall from $65\%$ to $26\%$. At the policy level, reward-shaping (FAR) and trust-region (FTR) variants improve intervention F1 and warranted-context calibration over DPO, with Brier scores independently supporting the calibration gains. Across three training runs, FAR and FTR remain substantially more stable, whereas DPO varies widely and can degrade intervention competence already present in the base policy. Thus, ToM-grounded friction provides a trainable signal for context-sensitive intervention under referential belief divergence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将Theory-of-Mind（ToM）推理作为控制信号用于Frictive Policy Optimization，通过提取四部分信念结构（说话者意图指代、听话者理解及彼此的信念模型）来量化表面协调与认知对齐之间的摩擦，从而捕获"静默分歧"。
AI.motivation: 标准基于偏好的方法通常优化响应级别的偏好，没有显式建模认知对齐（epistemic alignment），无法区分表面协调与真正的信念收敛，导致对话系统在指代分歧时缺乏上下文敏感的干预能力。
AI.method: 在每个指代表达处提取四部分信念结构：说话者的意图指代、听话者的解释、以及各自对对方信念的模型，使摩擦可从认知状态比较中机械计算，并在此基础上提出两种变体：FAR（奖励塑形）和FTR（信任区域）。
AI.result: 表征层面：去除二阶通道会使误解召回率从65%降至26%。策略层面：FAR和FTR在干预F1和语境校准上优于DPO，Brier分数支持校准增益；三次训练中FAR和FTR更稳定，而DPO波动大且可能退化基础策略已有的干预能力。
AI.conclusion: ToM支撑的摩擦信号为指代信念分歧下的上下文敏感干预提供了可训练的信号，在性能与训练稳定性方面均优于标准偏好优化方法。

title: Whole-Slide Image Analysis under Realistic Few-Shot Annotation Protocols
summary: Automating the analysis of whole-slide images has high clinical value, since characterizing cancers requires examining them in detail. Such analysis increasingly relies on vision-language models that provide patch-level zero-shot predictions. However, these predictions remain noisy and must be refined with a few annotations. A promising paradigm for this refinement is few-shot transduction. Rather than treating each patch independently, these methods leverage the relations between patches, together with a few annotations, to refine all predictions jointly. However, current transductive methods are evaluated under conditions that overlook key properties of whole-slide images: (i) datasets consist of independent patches extracted from multiple slides, ignoring the complex tissue organization; (ii) datasets are mostly balanced, whereas a single whole-slide image exhibits severe class imbalance, with several classes absent; and (iii) annotations are sampled at random, without reflecting how a pathologist annotates a limited number of regions. To align the transduction paradigm to realistic whole-slide settings, we introduce the following contributions. First, we propose SlideCRF, which adapts conditional random fields for whole-slide images by combining spatial and biological cues while accounting for classes that may be absent from a given slide. Second, we provide a set of realistic annotation protocols, based on spatially localized clicks and scribbles, modeling different pathologist interactions, such as the iterative correction of model errors. Across four datasets, we show that SlideCRF outperforms current transductive methods in macro F1, improving over the zero-shot predictions by +24.2% and +37.5% with one and 16 clicks per present class, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SlideCRF，将条件随机场适配于全切片图像的少样本转导预测，结合空间与生物学线索处理类别缺失问题，并设计了模拟病理学家交互的真实标注协议。在四个数据集上，SlideCRF显著优于现有转导方法，宏F1相对零样本预测提升24.2%（每类1次点击）和37.5%（每类16次点击）。
AI.motivation: 现有转导式少样本方法在全切片图像上的评估存在三个关键缺陷：数据由跨切片独立patch组成而忽略组织结构；数据集多平衡而真实全切片存在严重类别不均衡和类别缺失；标注随机采样不符合病理学家的真实标注行为。这些问题导致现有方法在真实场景下性能受限。
AI.method: 提出SlideCRF，将条件随机场适配全切片图像，融合空间与生物学线索，同时显式处理给定切片中可能缺失的类别。此外，提出基于空间定位点击和涂鸦的真实标注协议，模拟病理学家交互行为（包括模型错误的迭代修正）。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上，SlideCRF在宏F1指标上优于现有转导方法。相对零样本基线预测，每类1次点击时提升24.2%，每类16次点击时提升37.5%。
AI.conclusion: 将转导式少样本学习范式与全切片图像的真实特性（组织结构、类别不均衡、病理学家标注行为）对齐后，基于CRF的SlideCRF方法能够显著提升全切片图像分析的零样本预测精度，为临床病理分析提供了更可靠的自动化方案。

title: Where Do Multilingual Vision-Language Encoders Fail on Low-Resource Languages?
summary: Recent multilingual vision--language encoders cover hundreds of languages in a single model, yet on two state-of-the-art instances retrieval on low-resource languages (LRL; e.g. Swahili) trails high-resource ones (HRL; e.g. English) by $30^+$\,pp. We ask where in the trained encoder this gap is located. Prior modality-gap and cross-lingual subspace work suggests a linear language direction at the output crowds out alignment-relevant geometry. We falsify this: LEACE drives the linear language classifier from $>99\%$ to near chance and iterated INLP to $37$--$50\%$ while LRL retrieval moves within $\pm 1.5$\,pp and all tier means within $2.2$\,pp, tracking random controls. The linear bias is a \emph{symptom}, not the cause. Instead, the alignment-causal factor lies along the encoder's forward path: the EOS (end-of-sequence) hidden state's per-language trajectory diverges with depth. Substituting the EOS with its parallel English value three blocks before the projector lifts Swahili from $22.1\%$ to $69.1\%$ on one encoder (and reproduces on the other); three controls rule out pooled-position tautology and English specificity. A front-layer trunk that pulls each language's projection toward the parallel-content centroid corroborates the diagnosis at training time, recovering $+9.6$ / $+17.1$\,pp on LRL XM3600 retrieval (1{,}000-image subset), with consistent gains across three further benchmarks while preserving HRL performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多语言视觉-语言编码器中低资源语言（LRL）检索性能落后的根本原因。作者驳斥了"输出层的线性语言方向偏差是主因"的假设，证明其只是症状而非原因。真正的因果因素在于编码器前向路径中EOS（序列结束）隐藏状态的逐语言轨迹随深度发散。通过将EOS替换为前三层的平行英语值，Swahili检索从22.1%提升到69.1%；通过前端层"主干"训练策略，LRL XM3600检索提升+9.6/+17.1个百分点，同时保持高资源语言性能。
AI.motivation: 多语言视觉-语言编码器虽覆盖数百种语言，但低资源语言（如斯瓦希里语）的检索性能比高资源语言（如英语）落后30个百分点以上。作者希望定位这一巨大差距在训练好的编码器中究竟存在于何处，为后续改进提供明确方向。
AI.method: 采用因果干预与诊断方法：（1）用LEACE和迭代INLP移除线性语言分类方向，观察检索性能变化以证伪"线性偏差是成因"假设；（2）沿编码器前向路径逐层分析EOS隐藏状态的逐语言轨迹，定位发散层；（3）将LRL的EOS替换为平行英语值进行交换测试；（4）设计前端层主干（front-layer trunk），在训练时使各语言投影朝向平行内容质心汇聚。
AI.result: LEACE和INLP将线性语言分类器从>99%降至接近随机水平，但LRL检索仅波动±1.5pp，证明线性偏差是症状。将EOS替换为前三层的英语对应值后，Swahili检索从22.1%跃升至69.1%，并在另一编码器上复现。前端层主干训练在XM3600上为LRL带来+9.6/+17.1pp提升，在另外三个基准上一致增益，且保持HRL性能。
AI.conclusion: 线性语言方向偏差是可移除的症状而非性能差距的成因；真正的对齐因果因素位于编码器前向路径中EOS隐藏状态的逐语言深度发散。这一发现支持对编码器架构中层间对齐机制进行针对性干预，而非仅调整输出层。

title: ObjectSplat: Improving Mesh Fidelity and Interactivity for 3D Scenes via Object-Level Mesh Splatting
summary: Splatting-based algorithms reconstruct photorealistic, real-time-renderable, and mesh-exportable 3D scenes from regular images, but they represent a scene as a single monolithic field. Therefore, the reconstruction has no object-level structure, leaving it infeasible for downstream editing or interaction. Moreover, regions that are never directly observed in the input scans are contaminated by the surrounding texture and left uncorrected, capping both mesh fidelity and novel-view synthesis. We propose a decompose-before-reconstruct approach: we segment the instances out of every frame, consider the remaining as background and inpaint it, reconstruct each instance and the background independently with mesh splatting, and compose them into a single scene. Our method significantly improves mesh fidelity (over a 5\% gain in F-score) and novel-view synthesis, while supporting object-wise modifiability and interactivity. The code will be made publicly available.

title: Calibrating Small Language Models for Claim Check-Worthiness Detection
summary: Assessing claim check-worthiness is an essential first step in automated fact-checking pipelines. This work is motivated by a real deployment challenge at an early-stage startup: running large language models (LLMs) over every incoming claim is cost- and latency-prohibitive, yet smaller models sacrifice accuracy. We propose NN-PPI, a pointwise extension of Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI) that calibrates model predictions at inference time as a lightweight post-hoc layer, without re-training the underlying model. NN-PPI achieves weighted F1 gains ranging from 12% to 33.80% depending on the size and performance of the baseline model, bringing SLMs on par with larger LLMs. Beyond few-shot SLMs, NN-PPI further improves a production-deployed fine-tuned model, demonstrating that residual calibration is complementary to supervised fine-tuning. By recovering LLM-level accuracy from models that are an order of magnitude cheaper to serve, it makes accurate check-worthiness detection substantially cheaper to operate at scale. Our code and data can be found at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/arr-claim-worthiness-F237.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NN-PPI，一种基于Prediction-Powered Inference的点级扩展方法，在推理时作为轻量级后处理层校准模型预测，无需重新训练底层模型，使小型语言模型(SLM)在claim check-worthiness检测任务上达到与大型LLM相当的精度，加权F1提升12%至33.80%。
AI.motivation: 在自动化事实核查流水线中，检查claim是否值得核查是首要步骤。然而在初创公司的实际部署中，对每条claim都运行大型语言模型(LLM)成本过高且延迟过大，而较小的模型又牺牲准确性。需要一种轻量级方案在成本和精度之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出NN-PPI，即Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI)的点级(pointwise)扩展方法。它在推理时作为后处理层校准模型预测，无需重新训练底层模型，通过利用少量标记数据来校准模型输出。
AI.result: NN-PPI在加权F1上取得了12%至33.80%的提升（取决于基线模型的大小和性能），使SLM达到与更大LLM相当的水平。此外，该方法还能进一步改进生产环境中已微调的模型，证明残差校准与监督微调互补。
AI.conclusion: NN-PPI从比LLM便宜一个数量级的模型中恢复出LLM级别的精度，使大规模下的claim check-worthiness检测运行成本大幅降低，具有实际部署价值。

title: FlowVVTON: Flow-Guided Mask-Free Video Virtual Try-On
summary: Video virtual try-on aims to transfer a target garment onto a moving person across video frames. Current methods rely on human parsing masks or pose keypoints that frequently fail under large motions and occlusions, causing boundary artifacts and temporal inconsistency. A further limitation is that most approaches rely solely on attention mechanisms for temporal modeling, providing no explicit motion supervision. We propose FlowVVTON, a mask-free framework that eliminates parsing mask dependency entirely. Optical flow is used solely as a training-time supervision signal: a flow-warped latent loss, applied across all layers of the generation model, enforces multi-scale temporal consistency by aligning adjacent-frame features under explicit physical motion constraints. A two-stage training strategy establishes mask-free spatial alignment before introducing flow-guided temporal supervision. Experiments on TikTokDress show that FlowVVTON outperforms baselines by substantial margins, particularly in temporal consistency (5.7$\times$ VFID-R improvement over SwiftTry), while requiring no segmentation masks, pose keypoints, or region annotations at any stage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FlowVVTON，一个无需掩码（mask-free）的视频虚拟试穿框架。它完全消除了解析掩码的依赖，仅在训练时使用光流作为监督信号，通过对生成模型所有层施加flow-warped latent loss来实现多尺度时间一致性。通过两阶段训练策略（先建立空间对齐，再引入光流时序监督），在TikTokDress数据集上大幅超越基线模型，时序一致性较SwiftTry提升5.7倍VFID-R，且无需分割掩码、姿态关键点或区域标注。
AI.motivation: 现有视频虚拟试穿方法依赖人解析掩码或姿态关键点，在大幅运动和遮挡场景下容易失效，导致边界伪影和时间不一致。此外，多数方法仅依靠注意力机制进行时序建模，缺乏显式的运动监督信号。
AI.method: 1）掩码无关框架FlowVVTON，完全消除解析掩码依赖；2）光流仅作为训练时监督信号，通过flow-warped latent loss施加于生成模型所有层，在多尺度上对齐相邻帧特征以强化时间一致性；3）两阶段训练策略：先进行无掩码空间对齐，再引入光流引导的时序监督。
AI.result: 在TikTokDress数据集上，FlowVVTON相较基线模型有大幅性能提升，时序一致性方面VFID-R较SwiftTry提升5.7倍，且全程无需分割掩码、姿态关键点或区域标注。
AI.conclusion: 通过以光流作为显式物理运动约束的监督信号替代掩码依赖，并采用两阶段训练策略，FlowVVTON有效解决了现有方法在时序一致性和边界伪影上的不足，为视频虚拟试穿提供了一种更简洁且鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Not All Fallbacks Are Failures: Understanding and Recovering from Fallbacks in Mobile Voice Assistants
summary: Robust understanding of user input is a core requirement for voice assistants deployed in real-world environments. In practice, these systems encounter heterogeneous fallback situations caused by noisy audio input, transcription errors, ambiguous requests, incomplete utterances, or unintended activations. Existing systems typically respond with generic fallback messages, which do not resolve the underlying interaction failure and can degrade user experience. We study fallback handling in a deployed smartwatch-based voice assistant for general health support in everyday environments. Our analysis is based on six months of real-world usage data from more than 500 users, yielding a dataset of 3,030 anonymized, naturally occurring fallback-triggering utterances. We contribute (1) an operational taxonomy and the annotated VoxFallbacks dataset of these interactions, (2) a comparative evaluation of different models within a classification pipeline under practical deployment constraints, and (3) practical lessons for designing robust and cost-efficient fallback mechanisms. Results show that lightweight embedding-based classifiers outperform larger generative models on most classification tasks while requiring substantially fewer computational resources.

AI.tldr: 本文基于部署的智能手表语音助手六个月的真实使用数据（500+用户，3,030条语音输入），构建了VoxFallbacks数据集和操作性分类体系，系统研究了真实环境下语音助手的fallback处理机制。结果表明轻量级嵌入分类器在多数分类任务上优于大型生成模型，且计算资源消耗显著更低。
AI.motivation: 现实环境中语音助手频繁遭遇各种fallback场景（噪声输入、转录错误、模糊请求、不完整话语、误激活等），而现有系统通常用通用fallback消息应对，无法解决底层交互失败且会降低用户体验。缺乏基于真实世界数据的系统性研究。
AI.method: (1) 收集6个月500+用户的真实使用数据，构建包含3,030条匿名化fallback触发话语的VoxFallbacks数据集并制定操作性分类体系；(2) 在部署约束下对不同模型进行分类任务的对比评估；(3) 提炼设计鲁棒且成本高效的fallback机制的实践经验。
AI.result: 轻量级基于嵌入的分类器在大多数分类任务上表现优于大型生成模型，同时所需的计算资源大幅减少。
AI.conclusion: 在实际部署场景中，轻量级方法在性能和效率之间取得了更好的平衡，为语音助手fallback机制的设计提供了实用指导。

title: SeqAlign3DVG: A Sequence-Aligned Benchmark and Voxel Reasoning Framework for 3D Visual Grounding
summary: Image-based 3D visual grounding is critical for embodied agents, yet existing benchmarks suffer from loose text-observation alignment and neglect temporal ordering. We introduce SeqAlign3DVG, a novel benchmark dedicated to temporally ordered and strictly observation-aligned image-based 3D visual grounding. Unlike prior works using order-agnostic views or global point clouds, SeqAlign3DVG ensures all expressions are human-verified and strictly grounded in the provided RGB observations (single frames or ordered observation sequences). It comprises 9,622 single-view and 14,493 sequence samples featuring rich descriptions, complex relations, and multi-instance ambiguities. To tackle this benchmark, we propose a unified voxel-based pipeline featuring Relevance-Ordered Voxel Memory (ROVM) and Progressive Language-Voxel Fusion (PLVF). ROVM dynamically ranks and aggregates multi-view evidence via a conservative memory to mitigate noisy observations, while PLVF performs coarse-to-fine spatial-linguistic reasoning for precise disambiguation. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance under the depth-free protocol, significantly improving localization for targets defined by complex relations and appearance cues.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SeqAlign3DVG基准，专注于时序有序且严格对齐观测的图像型3D视觉定位，并设计统一体素管线的ROVM与PLVF模块，在无深度协议下达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有图像型3D视觉定位基准存在文本-观测对齐松散且忽略时序顺序的问题，影响具身智能体的定位能力评估。
AI.method: 提出SeqAlign3DVG基准（含9,622单视图与14,493序列样本），所有表达式经人工验证并严格基于RGB观测。针对该基准提出统一体素管线，包含相关性排序体素记忆（ROVM）用于动态排序聚合多视图证据，以及渐进式语言-体素融合（PLVF）实现由粗到细的空间-语言推理。
AI.result: 在无深度协议下达到SOTA性能，显著提升复杂关系与外观线索目标的定位精度。
AI.conclusion: 严格对齐且时序有序的基准对于图像型3D视觉定位至关重要，所提出的体素管线能有效缓解噪声观测并实现精确消歧。

title: CLIN: an Objective Framework for Evaluating Creativity in Short Persian Literary Text
summary: Evaluating creativity in large language model (LLM) outputs remains challenging because creativity is multidimensional and human-centered. We examine how reliably LLMs evaluate short literary text in Persian, a low-resource language, across multiple evaluation strategies and prompt formulations. We find that LLM-human agreement varies substantially across dimensions: alignment is stronger for structured TTCT-derived properties such as Originality, Fluency, and Elaboration, but considerably weaker for more subjective dimensions, particularly Emotion and Attractiveness. Judgments are also sensitive to prompt formulation, while few-shot prompting, ensembling, and multi-agent debate provide no consistent improvement. Motivated by this dimension-dependent behavior, we investigate whether structured creativity dimensions can instead be approximated using simple, interpretable proxy metrics. We introduce CLIN, which evaluates three TTCT-derived dimensions separately using topic-aware novelty for Originality, contextual lexical clustering for Fluency, and lexical diversity for Elaboration. These proxies achieve human alignment comparable to or better than the strongest zero-shot LLM judge in our setting while requiring substantially lower evaluation cost.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM在评估波斯语短篇文学文本创造力时的可靠性，发现LLM与人类的一致性在不同维度上差异显著：结构化TTCT维度（原创性、流畅性、详尽性）一致性较强，而主观维度（情感、吸引力）较弱。基于此，作者提出CLIN方法，用简单可解释的代理指标评估三个TTCT维度，在人类对齐度上不低于最强零样本LLM评估器，同时大幅降低评估成本。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）输出的创造力评估仍具挑战性，因为创造力是多维度和以人为中心的。尤其对于低资源语言的短篇文学文本，现有评估方法缺乏可靠性，需要系统地研究LLM在不同维度和提示策略下的评估表现。
AI.method: 作者在波斯语短篇文学文本上，系统比较了多种LLM评估策略和提示变体，检验LLM与人类判断在多个创造力维度上的一致性。基于维度依赖的行为发现，进一步提出CLIN框架：使用主题感知新颖性评估原创性、上下文词汇聚类评估流畅性、词汇多样性评估详尽性。
AI.result: 研究发现：LLM与人类的一致性在结构化的TTCT派生维度（原创性、流畅性、详尽性）上较强，在主观维度（情感、吸引力）上较弱；判断对提示措辞敏感；少样本提示、集成和多智能体辩论没有一致的改进效果。CLIN代理指标在人类对齐度上达到或超过最强零样本LLM评估器，且成本显著更低。
AI.conclusion: 对于结构化创造力维度，简单可解释的代理指标可以替代昂贵的LLM评估，实现同等或更好的人类对齐度。这提示在创造力评估中，应根据维度特性选择评估方法，而非统一依赖LLM判断。

title: Federated Multi-Task Learning for Bladder Tumor Segmentation and MIBC Classification Using a Hybrid CNN-Transformer Architecture
summary: Accurate bladder tumor segmentation and assessment of mus- cle invasion from T2-weighted MRI are important for treatment plan- ning, but developing robust models across institutions is challenging be- cause patient data cannot be centrally pooled and imaging characteristics vary across scanners and acquisition protocols. We propose a federated multi-task learning framework for joint bladder tumor segmentation and MIBC/NMIBC classification across four clinical centers. The proposed Swin Hybrid model combines a ResNet-34 branch for local texture and boundary information with a Swin-Tiny Transformer for global anatomi- cal context. A segmentation-guided classification mechanism further uses tumor localization information to support MIBC prediction. We also investigate several augmentation strategies under both centralized and federated training to improve robustness to multi-center variability. Ex- periments on the FedBCa dataset show that the Swin Hybrid provides the best overall balance between segmentation and classification among the evaluated architectures. Under federated training, Geo+Elastic aug- mentation achieved a DSC of 0.8100 and a patient-level AUC of 0.8931, yielding the highest combined score of 0.8474. These results demonstrate that joint segmentation and classification can be effectively performed across multiple institutions using federated training without centralizing patient data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种联邦多任务学习框架，用于在四个临床中心联合进行膀胱肿瘤分割和MIBC/NMIBC分类。通过结合ResNet-34和Swin-Tiny Transformer的混合模型，并引入分割引导分类机制，在不集中患者数据的情况下实现了跨机构的有效训练，最终在FedBCa数据集上取得了DSC 0.8100和AUC 0.8931的最佳结果。
AI.motivation: 膀胱肿瘤的精确分割和肌层浸润评估对治疗规划至关重要，但跨机构开发稳健模型面临两大挑战：患者数据无法集中汇总，以及不同扫描仪和采集协议导致的影像特征差异。
AI.method: 提出了联邦多任务学习框架，包含Swin Hybrid模型（ResNet-34分支提取局部纹理和边界信息，Swin-Tiny Transformer捕获全局解剖上下文），并设计了分割引导的分类机制利用肿瘤定位信息辅助MIBC预测。同时研究了在集中式和联邦训练下的多种数据增强策略以提升对多中心变异性的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在FedBCa数据集上，Swin Hybrid在分割和分类之间取得了最佳平衡。在联邦训练下，Geo+Elastic增强策略达到DSC 0.8100、患者级AUC 0.8931，综合得分最高为0.8474。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，通过联邦训练可以在多个机构间有效执行联合分割和分类任务，无需集中患者数据即可实现可靠的膀胱肿瘤分割和肌层浸润评估。

title: TopoCompress: Long Context Compression via Graph-Wired Semantic Trajectories
summary: Long-context compression is essential for reducing the cost and latency of large language model inference. However, existing methods can fragment important evidence, require additional training or alignment, and often depend on the target model for effective compression. We introduce TopoCompress, a training-free and model-agnostic framework that compresses long contexts by selecting coherent semantic spans. TopoCompress first scores each span using dense and lexical query relevance together with semantic acceleration. It then constructs a hybrid graph that connects spans based on semantic similarity and sequential adjacency, and propagates the query-guided relevance scores over the graph. Across five long-context tasks-HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, Qasper, and MultiFieldQA-en-TopoCompress consistently outperforms strong compression baselines. Notably, TopoCompress achieves performance comparable to the strongest baseline while using a 4x smaller compression budget, and provides a 1.41x smaller compression time over the fastest baseline.

AI.tldr: TopoCompress是一个无需训练、模型无关的长上下文压缩框架，通过选择语义连贯的文本片段，基于混合图传播查询引导的相关性分数，在多个长上下文任务上超越现有压缩基线，并以更小的压缩预算和更快的压缩速度实现同等或更优性能。
AI.motivation: 长上下文压缩对降低大语言模型推理成本与延迟至关重要，但现有方法存在碎片化重要证据、需要额外训练或对齐、依赖目标模型等问题。
AI.method: TopoCompress通过稠密和词法查询相关性及语义加速为每个片段打分，随后构建融合语义相似性和序列邻接关系的混合图，并在图上传播查询引导的相关性分数。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMQA、MuSiQue、Qasper和MultiFieldQA-en五个长上下文任务上持续优于强压缩基线。使用4倍更小的压缩预算即可达到与最强基线相当的性能，压缩时间比最快基线快1.41倍。
AI.conclusion: TopoCompress展示了训练无关、模型无关的压缩框架在长上下文场景中的有效性，兼顾了压缩质量、压缩预算效率和计算效率。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Quantifying Pulmonary Attribution in Anatomy-Guided Chest X-Ray Classification Under Domain Shift
comment: 34 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Code available at https://github.com/Abdullah-229/BeyondAccuracy
summary: Deep-learning models can achieve strong chest X-ray (CXR) classification performance without establishing whether their predictions predominantly rely on pulmonary image content. This study evaluates pulmonary attribution containment as an anatomy-related reliability property distinct from diagnostic performance. We propose DBCA-SegNet-MGAP, a multi-task anatomy-guided CNN-Transformer framework that combines complementary feature representations through bidirectional cross-backbone attention, predicts a soft lung mask, and incorporates this anatomical prior directly into classification through Mask-Guided Adaptive Global Average Pooling (MGAP). Pulmonary attribution containment is quantified using the Anatomical Local Energy Ratio (ALR) and high-intensity cumulative ALR (cALR@0.9). Experiments were repeated across three training seeds using the COVID-19 Radiography Database for four-class internal testing and a locked Shenzhen-to-Montgomery protocol for zero-shot external tuberculosis testing. On COVID-19, the proposed model achieved a weighted F1 of $0.9615 \pm 0.0015$ and macro ROC-AUC of $0.9906 \pm 0.0007$. In an architecture-matched dual-bridge comparison, replacing conventional GAP with MGAP increased ALR from $0.3878 \pm 0.0098$ to $0.7086 \pm 0.0104$ and cALR@0.9 from $0.5265 \pm 0.0101$ to $0.9905 \pm 0.0018$, while weighted F1 remained essentially unchanged ($0.9618 \pm 0.0015$ vs. $0.9615 \pm 0.0015$). Under locked external transfer to Montgomery, ROC-AUC remained $0.9080 \pm 0.0043$ and pulmonary ALR remained $0.6466 \pm 0.0081$, whereas weighted F1 decreased to $0.7528 \pm 0.0080$ and ECE increased to $0.1683 \pm 0.0055$. These findings show that diagnostic discrimination, calibration, and pulmonary attribution containment are distinct model properties and support their joint evaluation under internal testing and external domain shift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DBCA-SegNet-MGAP，一个多任务解剖引导的CNN-Transformer框架，用于胸片分类，在保持诊断性能的同时显著提升肺部分区归因的可信度（ALR从0.3878提升至0.7086），并通过内部和外部测试验证了诊断辨别力、校准和肺部分区归因是三个独立的模型属性。
AI.motivation: 深度学习胸片分类模型即使主要依赖非肺部图像内容也能取得较高的分类性能，导致模型可能学习到错误的特征，缺乏可靠的解剖学依据。现有研究通常只关注诊断性能，忽视了肺部分区归因这一解剖学相关的可靠性属性，因此需要提出一个能在保持诊断性能的同时提升肺部归因可信度的框架。
AI.method: 提出DBCA-SegNet-MGAP框架：(1)采用CNN-Transformer双主干架构，通过双向交叉骨干注意力融合互补特征表示；(2)预测软肺掩膜，并通过Mask-Guided Adaptive Global Average Pooling (MGAP)将解剖先验直接融入分类；(3)使用Anatomical Local Energy Ratio (ALR)和高强度累计ALR(cALR@0.9)量化肺部分区归因。实验涵盖COVID-19四分类内部测试和Shenzhen-to-Montgomery零样本外部结核病迁移测试，重复三个训练种子。
AI.result: COVID-19内部测试中加权F1为0.9615±0.0015，宏ROC-AUC为0.9906±0.0007。在架构匹配的双桥对比中，用MGAP替代常规GAP将ALR从0.3878±0.0098提升至0.7086±0.0104，cALR@0.9从0.5265±0.0101提升至0.9905±0.0018，同时加权F1基本不变。外部迁移到Montgomery后ROC-AUC保持0.9080±0.0043，肺部ALR保持0.6466±0.0081，但加权F1降至0.7528±0.0080，ECE增至0.1683±0.0055。
AI.conclusion: 诊断辨别力、校准性能和肺部分区归因是三个独立的模型属性，不应仅以诊断性能作为唯一评价标准。提出的MGAP方法能在不牺牲诊断准确率的情况下大幅提升肺部归因可信度。建议在内部测试和外部域偏移场景下对这三个属性进行联合评估。

title: Error-Type-Aware Loss Reweighting for Robust Named Entity Recognition with Noisy LLM Labels
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to annotate datasets for training smaller, task-specialized models such as named entity recognition. While this method yields effective models, it assumes that the synthetic dataset is correctly annotated. In this work, we find that (i) current fine-tuning processes simply ignore LLM-introduced annotation noise, resulting in degraded performance and (ii) existing noise-robust losses are not transferable to sequence labeling because annotation noise in named entity recognition is heterogeneous: for example, missing mentions and type errors affect the training signal in different ways. Treating all noisy tokens equally in noise-robust losses and applying a single reweighing criterion for all may therefore remove useful supervision or reinforce incorrect labels. To address this limitation, we propose error-type-aware loss reweighting for NER, which introduces separate reweighing rules for different types of potentially erroneous tokens. Our approach is simple and efficient, does not require additional training resources, and improves F1 by 0.8 - 2.0 percentage points on dataset-level average for noise levels between 15% and 40%, with a maximum improvement of 4.6 percentage points with 24.1% noise on Wikigold.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLM生成的NER标注数据存在异构噪声（如缺失提及和类型错误），现有噪声鲁棒损失不适用于序列标注任务，提出了一种基于错误类型感知的损失重加权方法，在不同噪声水平下显著提升F1分数。
AI.motivation: LLM被广泛用于生成合成数据集以训练NER等下游模型，但现有微调方法忽略了LLM引入的标注噪声，导致模型性能下降。同时，现有的噪声鲁棒损失方法不适用于序列标注，因为NER中的标注噪声是异质的——不同类型的错误（如缺失提及和类型错误）对训练信号的影响各不相同，统一对待所有噪声token会移除有用监督信息或强化错误标签。
AI.method: 提出错误类型感知的损失重加权方法（error-type-aware loss reweighting for NER），为不同类型的潜在错误token设计独立的重新加权规则，而非对所有噪声token使用统一的重加权标准。
AI.result: 该方法简单高效，不需要额外的训练资源，在15%-40%噪声水平下，数据集级别平均F1提升0.8-2.0个百分点；在Wikigold数据集上，24.1%噪声水平下最大提升达4.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 错误类型感知的损失重加权是处理LLM生成NER标注数据中异构噪声的有效方法，能够在不增加训练成本的情况下显著提升模型性能，优于统一处理所有噪声token的现有方法。

title: HorizonNet for visual terrain navigation
comment: 7 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. Published at IEEE IPAS 2018. An extended version appeared in Journal of Field Robotics 37(6):951-971, 2020, doi:10.1002/rob.21929
summary: This paper investigates the problem of position estimation of unmanned surface vessels (USVs) operating in coastal areas or in the archipelago. We propose a position estimation method where the horizon line is extracted in a 360 degree panoramic image around the USV. We design a CNN architecture to determine an approximate horizon line in the image and implicitly determine the camera orientation (the pitch and roll angles). The panoramic image is warped to compensate for the camera orientation and to generate an image from an approximately level camera. A second CNN architecture is designed to extract the pixelwise horizon line in the warped image. The extracted horizon line is correlated with digital elevation model (DEM) data in the Fourier domain using a MOSSE correlation filter. Finally, we determine the location of the maximum correlation score over the search area to estimate the position of the USV. Comprehensive experiments are performed in a field trial in the archipelago. Our approach provides promising results by achieving position estimates with GPS-level accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于360度全景图像与数字高程模型（DEM）匹配的无人水面艇（USV）位置估计方法，通过CNN提取水平线、图像校正及MOSSE相关滤波实现GPS级精度的定位。
AI.motivation: 在沿海或群岛区域，USV的可靠位置估计至关重要，而传统GPS在某些环境下可能失效或精度不足，需要开发替代或互补的定位方法。
AI.method: 该方法包括：1) 利用第一套CNN架构从360度全景图像中估计近似水平线，并隐式确定相机俯仰角和横滚角；2) 对全景图像进行扭曲校正，生成近似水平相机姿态下的图像；3) 使用第二套CNN架构在校正后的图像中逐像素提取精确水平线；4) 将提取的水平线与DEM数据在傅里叶域通过MOSSE相关滤波器进行匹配；5) 通过搜索区域内最大相关得分位置来确定USV的位置。
AI.result: 在群岛区域进行的实地试验中，该方法取得了有前景的结果，位置估计精度达到GPS级水平。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证了所提出的基于视觉与DEM匹配的定位方法在沿海和群岛环境中能够实现高精度的USV位置估计，可作为GPS的有效补充或替代方案。

title: Opinionated, Hesitant and Stressed: Three Studies of How Politicians Speak in Four Slavic Parliaments
summary: We present three large-scale studies of spoken parliamentary speech across four Slavic languages (Croatian, Czech, Polish, Serbian), drawing on over 6,000 hours from the ParlaSpeech 3.0 corpus. The first study examines how utterance-level sentiment shapes acoustic realisation: negative speech is consistently produced with higher pitch, greater intensity, and faster rate across all four parliaments, with a secondary arousal-driven upturn at the most positive extreme. The second study models filled pause frequency using negative binomial GEE, finding that speech rate, age, and sentiment are robust cross-lingual predictors, while gender effects reverse between South Slavic (men produce fewer filled pauses) and West Slavic parliaments (no gender difference) - a pattern invisible to single-language designs. The third study investigates primary stress variation in Croatian, showing that speaker-level preferences for early versus late stress cohere across verbs, adjectives, and nouns but decouple for adverbs and proper nouns. We conclude with a research agenda spanning corpus phonetics, disfluency modelling, and political rhetoric.

AI.tldr: 本文基于ParlaSpeech 3.0语料库中超过6000小时的四种斯拉夫语言（克罗地亚语、捷克语、波兰语、塞尔维亚语）议会演讲语音数据，开展了三项大规模研究：情感对声学实现的跨语言影响、填充停顿的频率预测模型，以及克罗地亚语重音变化的说话者偏好。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多局限于单一语言的语音与情感分析，缺乏跨语言的系统比较。本文旨在通过多语言大规模语料，揭示语言间共性与差异，弥补单一语言设计无法发现的模式（如性别效应反转）。
AI.method: 三项研究分别采用：（1）情感-声学关联分析，考察音高、响度、语速随情感的变化；（2）负二项GEE模型建模填充停顿频率，纳入语速、年龄、情感和性别等预测因子；（3）针对克罗地亚语的主重音位置偏好分析，考察说话者在不同词类间的重音策略一致性。
AI.result: 研究发现：负面情感在所有四个议会中均与更高的音高、更大的响度和更快的语速相关，且在最积极极值处出现基于唤醒度的次级回升；语速、年龄和情感是填充停顿频率的稳健跨语言预测因子，而性别效应在南斯拉夫（男性填充停顿更少）与西斯拉夫（无性别差异）议会间存在反转；克罗地亚语说话者的早/晚重音偏好动词语法词一致，但在副词和专有名词上出现分化。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一项涵盖语料库语音学、不流畅建模和政治修辞学的研究议程，强调跨语言设计在揭示语言特定模式中的重要性。

title: VisER: Visual Evidence and Reliance for Object Hallucination Detection in LVLMs
summary: Object hallucination remains a persistent reliability issue in large vision-language models, where generated object mentions may sound plausible but lack visual grounding. Recent training-free detectors use internal signals such as token likelihood, attention, visual confidence, or image-text similarity to identify hallucinated objects. These signals are useful, but they are often source-confounded. They measure how strongly an object is supported inside the model without distinguishing whether that support comes from object-specific visual evidence or the generated text prefix. In difficult cases, a hallucinated object can still receive high internal support because it fits the scene, is associated with nearby visual cues, or follows naturally from the generated text prefix. We propose VisER, a training-free two-sided metric for object-level hallucination detection. VisER evaluates each generated object mention from two complementary views. Visual Evidence measures whether object-context compatibility is backed by object-specific evidence from image tokens. Visual Reliance measures whether the object is supported more by the image than by the generated prefix. Combining these views gives a more source-aware grounding score, while avoiding additional object-level verification generations. Across multiple LVLMs and benchmarks, VisER improves AUROC and AUPR over a range of baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VisER，一种无需训练的、基于双视角度量的目标级幻觉检测方法，通过同时评估\"视觉证据\"和\"视觉依赖\"来区分对象支持是来自图像证据还是文本前缀，从而提升幻觉检测的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有训练-free幻觉检测方法使用内部信号（如token似然、注意力、视觉置信度等），但这些信号存在\"来源混淆\"问题——它们无法区分对象获得的支持是来自图像中的具体视觉证据，还是来自已生成的文本前缀或场景先验。这导致在困难案例中幻觉对象仍可能获得高内部支持分。
AI.method: VisER从两个互补视角评估每个生成的对象提及：(1) 视觉证据（Visual Evidence）——衡量对象-上下文兼容性是否由来自图像token的对象特定证据支持；(2) 视觉依赖（Visual Reliance）——衡量对象更多地由图像支持还是由已生成的前缀支持。将两者结合得到更具来源感知性的grounding得分，且无需额外的对象级验证生成。
AI.result: 在多个LVLMs（大型视觉语言模型）和基准测试上，VisER在AUROC和AUPR指标上均优于一系列基线方法。
AI.conclusion: VisER通过来源感知的双视角评估有效解决了现有幻觉检测方法中内部信号来源混淆的问题，无需训练即可提升目标级幻觉检测性能，为LVLMs可靠性提供了一种实用且有效的解决方案。

title: Thesis Proposal: Toward a Human-Centered and Perspective-Aware Framework for Reproducible ML Evaluation and AI Alignment
summary: Humans play a vital role at every stage of AI development, from data collection and curation to model development and evaluation. However, humans often disagree with each other and sometimes with themselves over time. It is essential to take disagreement into account when building human-centered AI systems, especially in domains where it is prevalent, such as AI safety, content moderation, or sentiment analysis. Disagreement often arises from subjective human opinion and can vary with one's identity, beliefs, and social environment. Despite this, current LLM evaluation approaches frequently rely on aggregating labels (often via plurality voting) to represent consensus, thereby obscuring minority perspectives. By failing to account for human disagreement, these evaluation methods contribute to the reproducibility crisis in AI. Human feedback is also crucial for ensuring that AI systems align with human values. For these systems to be trustworthy, it is critical to ensure that they reflect diverse human values and perspectives. In this thesis proposal, we present a human-centered and perspective-aware framework for reproducible ML evaluation and AI alignment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个以人为本、视角感知的机器学习评估与AI对齐框架，旨在解决人类分歧被现有评估方法忽视的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估方法通常通过投票聚合标签来代表共识，掩盖了少数派观点，导致AI评估的可复现性危机，并无法确保系统反映人类多样化的价值观。
AI.method: 提出一个人本中心且视角感知的框架，将人类分歧纳入机器学习的评估与AI对齐流程中，强调关注不同身份、信念和社会环境下产生的主观意见差异。
AI.result: 本文为博士论文提案，尚未展示具体实验结果，主要阐述研究方向和框架设计思路。
AI.conclusion: 要使AI系统值得信赖，必须在评估和对齐过程中充分纳入人类多元化的价值观和视角，而非简单聚合或掩盖分歧。

title: Lot Machine: Multimodal Lot Extraction from Auction Catalogs
comment: Accepted at the VISART Workshop (Computer Vision for Art Analysis), ECCV 2026. 19 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Supplementary material included as an appendix. Code, benchmark data, and prompt templates: https://github.com/mathiaszinnen/auction-lot-extraction
summary: For provenance research and art market studies, auction catalogs are an essential resource to trace specific objects over time and space. While historical auction catalogs follow established domain conventions, their internal formatting remains highly variable, and their large-scale analysis is currently restricted by the lack of machine-readable representations of the auction lots. We propose a pipeline to automatically extract structured lot-level metadata from German Sales, a large database of historical auction and sales catalogs from the 19th and 20th centuries. Using a manually annotated test set of representative catalog pages, we evaluate Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under varying prompt strategies and constrained decoding frameworks. To reflect the practical constraints faced by cultural heritage institutions, including budget, compute resources, and data privacy requirements, we benchmark the methods across different deployment modes ranging from commercial providers to locally hosted, quantized models. We find that commercial endpoints establish the performance ceiling, while institutional gateways offer a viable, privacy-preserving alternative. Local deployments remain feasible, but strictly require enforcing the output structure during generation to guarantee a valid JSON format. While varying degrees of human-in-the-loop correction are still necessary, this work demonstrates that a VLM-based pipeline can successfully unlock historical auction catalogs for large-scale automated analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的自动化流水线，用于从19至20世纪的历史拍卖目录中提取结构化的条目级元数据，并系统评估了不同部署模式（商业API、机构网关、本地量化模型）下的性能与可行性。
AI.motivation: 历史拍卖目录是艺术史溯源和市场研究的关键资源，但其内部格式高度多变，且缺乏机器可读的表示形式，限制了大规模分析的可能性，亟需自动化提取方案。
AI.method: 基于German Sales数据库构建手工标注的测试集，采用多种提示词策略和约束解码框架，评估VLM在不同部署模式（商业端点、机构网关、本地量化模型）下提取结构化条目级元数据的性能。
AI.result: 商业端点为性能上限；机构网关是可行的隐私保护替代方案；本地部署可行但必须强制输出结构以确保JSON格式有效；所有方案仍需不同程度的人工介入纠正。
AI.conclusion: 基于VLM的流水线能够成功实现历史拍卖目录的大规模自动化分析，为文化机构在预算、算力和隐私约束下选择合适部署方案提供了实践参考。

title: Linguistic Distance Segregates Latent Representations in Automatic Speech Recognition Systems
summary: While automatic speech recognition (ASR) models have achieved remarkable improvements in recent years, performance disparities persist across different speaker populations. One such disparity is for speakers whose first languages (L1) are from families distant from English. This paper investigates the relationship between first language background and English ASR performance. Through empirical analysis, we observe that the correlation between speakers' L1 distance and ASR error rates yields a systematic effect on English Speech, with its strength varying across datasets and models. This association is statistically significant in a follow-up analysis accounting for dataset-level variation in Tweedie mixed-effects models ($p<0.001$ across evaluated models). In addition, analysis of the latent space reveals a L1-based spatial segregation across deeper acoustic layers in the majority of evaluated architectures

AI.tldr: 本文研究了英语自动语音识别（ASR）系统中，说话人第一语言（L1）背景与识别性能之间的关系，发现L1语言距离与ASR错误率之间存在系统性关联，且在深度声学层的潜在空间中观察到基于L1的空间分离现象。
AI.motivation: 尽管ASR模型近年来取得了显著进步，但不同说话人群体的性能差异仍然存在，特别是母语与英语语言距离较远的说话者面临更大挑战。理解这种差异的根源有助于构建更公平的ASR系统。
AI.method: 通过实证分析研究说话人L1语言距离与英语ASR错误率之间的相关性；使用Tweedie混合效应模型进行后续统计分析，以控制数据集层面的变异性；并分析模型潜在空间以考察L1特征在不同声学层的表征分离情况。
AI.result: L1语言距离与ASR错误率之间存在统计显著的系统性关联（p<0.001，跨评估模型一致）；该效应的强度因数据集和模型而异；在大多数评估架构的深层声学层中观察到基于L1的空间分离。
AI.conclusion: 说话人的母语背景会对英语ASR性能产生显著且系统性的影响，这种影响在模型深层表征中有所体现，提示未来需要关注ASR系统对多语言背景说话者的公平性问题。

title: MEOM: Multi-View Expected-OKS Maximization for Human Pose Triangulation
summary: Conventional algebraic triangulation solves 3D human pose estimation (HPE) from multi-view 2D keypoints. The typical approach, decoding 2D keypoints from predicted heatmaps, is unreliable as heatmaps can be multimodal under occlusion, and collapsing them into single peaks discards their spatial distribution. We seek to use the entire heatmap to estimate 3D poses more accurately, which requires solving two problems: how to robustly fuse heatmaps across views, and how to assess the reliability of heatmaps. For the former, we introduce a novel objective, Multi-viewExpected-OKS Maximization (MEOM), that locates a 3D joint where the views agree in probability mass. For the latter, we adopt highest-density-region (HDR) calibration as a diagnostic of that mass, independently of distance-based metrics. The proposed framework covers two settings, with and without 3D supervision. Without 3D supervision, we optimize 3D poses from pretrained heatmap predictors by maximizing MEOM, achieving comparable performance with state-of-the-art methods that rely on larger backbones, temporal fusion, and simulated 3D data. On ambiguous Human3.6M (H36MA) and occluded CMU Panoptic frames, the advantage is substantial. When 3D labels are available, we train the model end-to-end with a combined MEOM and MSE loss, achieving 19.11 mm absolute MPJPE on Human3.6M outperforming the state-of-the-art volumetric approach on absolute MPJPE at half the inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多视图期望OKS最大化（MEOM）目标函数用于三维人体姿态估计，利用完整的2D热图而非坍缩成单一峰值，并结合最高密度区域（HDR）校准评估热图可靠性。该框架同时支持有/无3D监督两种设置，在模糊和遮挡场景下优势显著，在有监督设置下以一半推理成本达到SOTA精度。
AI.motivation: 传统代数三角化方法依赖从预测热图中解码2D关键点，但热图在遮挡情况下可能是多模态的，将其坍缩为单一峰值会丢失空间分布信息，导致3D姿态估计不准确。因此需要利用完整热图进行估计，这需要解决跨视角热图融合和热图可靠性评估两个问题。
AI.method: 提出多视图期望OKS最大化（MEOM）目标函数，在3D关节位置中找到各视角在概率质量上一致的3D点；采用最高密度区域（HDR）校准作为可靠性诊断指标，独立于基于距离的度量。框架支持两种设置：无3D监督时通过最大化MEOM优化3D姿态；有3D标签时使用MEOM和MSE组合损失进行端到端训练。
AI.result: 无3D监督设置下，达到与依赖更大骨干网络、时间融合和模拟3D数据的SOTA方法相当的性能，在模糊的Human3.6M（H36MA）和遮挡的CMU Panoptic帧上优势显著。有3D监督设置下，在Human3.6M上达到19.11mm绝对MPJPE，优于SOTA体素方法，且推理成本减半。
AI.conclusion: 利用完整热图而不是坍缩的峰值来进行多视角3D姿态估计是可行的，MEOM配合HDR校准能够有效融合多视角热图信息并评估其可靠性，在鲁棒性和精度上均优于传统方法，同时计算效率更高。

title: You Shouldn't Have Asked: A Pragmatics-Inspired Taxonomy for Evaluating LLM Refusals
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Refusals are often treated as face-threatening acts in pragmatics because they can challenge the requester's socially claimed self-image. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trained to refuse unsafe and inappropriate requests, and these refusals may harm users when models fail to manage this interactional cost properly. While existing work has mainly approached LLM non-compliance as a safety-alignment outcome, it does not provide a way to evaluate whether LLMs refuse appropriately across different harmful contexts. To study this question, we propose (to our knowledge) the first taxonomy of LLM refusals that is grounded in pragmatic theory. Applying this taxonomy to responses from 16 modern LLMs across 14 harm categories, we find that although models differ in how they refuse, their refusals are overall explicit and strongly morally evaluative, with interactional repair occurring mainly through offering or providing safer alternatives instead of interpersonal facework. This pattern is especially consequential in sensitive harm contexts, where overuse of negative framing may make users feel shamed or provoked, undermining the purpose of safe non-compliance. We therefore call for alignment evaluation that considers not only whether models refuse harmful requests, but also whether they refuse in ways that are contextually adaptive and socially accountable for the interactional consequences of saying no.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个基于语用学理论的LLM拒绝分类法，并据此评估16个现代LLM在14种危害类别中的拒绝行为，发现模型拒绝普遍过于明确且带有强烈道德评判，缺乏人际层面的互动修复，在敏感危害场景下可能让用户感到羞辱或挑衅。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将LLM不服从仅视为安全对齐的结果，缺乏从语用学角度评估不同危害情境下模型拒绝是否恰当的方法，而拒绝作为面威胁行为可能在拒绝不当时伤害用户。
AI.method: 提出首个基于语用学理论的LLM拒绝分类法（taxonomy），并将其应用于16个现代LLM在14种危害类别中的拒绝响应分析，考察拒绝的明确性、道德评价性及互动修复策略。
AI.result: 发现不同模型拒绝方式虽有差异，但整体上拒绝行为明确且带有强烈道德评价色彩，互动修复主要通过提供或引导更安全的替代方案实现，而非人际层面的面子功夫；在敏感危害情境中过度使用负面框架可能适得其反。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁安全对齐评估不应只关注模型是否拒绝有害请求，还应考察拒绝方式是否具备情境适应性，并对其说"不"的互动后果承担社会责任。

title: Minerals in the Wild: A Hyperspectral-XRF Dataset for Elemental Composition Estimation
summary: Rapid mineral characterization is essential for applications ranging from mineral exploration to industrial ore processing. To this end, Hyperspectral Imaging (HSI) has emerged as a promising sensing modality thanks to its fine spectral resolution, enabling mineral discrimination in both close-range and remote sensing settings. However, the scarcity of publicly available datasets with reliable ground-truth labels hinders the development and evaluation of HSI-based mineral identification methods. We release Minerals in the Wild, a multi-purpose dataset comprising 1,132 rock specimens collected across Europe. For each specimen, we provide an HSI acquisition together with an elemental characterization obtained via an XRF sensor. We define the task of elemental characterization on our dataset and propose a pruning mechanism that removes distant signatures from the USGS dictionary prior to a convex optimization approach for matching HSI pixels with USGS spectral signatures. Finally, we empirically show that our approach outperforms simpler baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了一个名为"Minerals in the Wild"的多用途矿物高光谱数据集，包含1,132个来自欧洲的岩石标本，每个标本配有HSI高光谱采集和XRF元素表征。作者定义了元素表征任务，并提出了一种基于凸优化的方法，先通过剪枝机制去除USGS字典中的远距离光谱签名，再进行光谱匹配，实验证明该方法优于简单基线。
AI.motivation: 快速矿物表征对矿物勘探和工业矿石加工至关重要，高光谱成像（HSI）虽具有精细光谱分辨率优势，但公开可用且带有可靠真值标签的数据集稀缺，严重制约了基于HSI的矿物识别方法的发展与评估。
AI.method: 论文提出一种剪枝机制，先从USGS光谱字典中移除距离较远的光谱签名，再采用凸优化方法将HSI像素与USGS光谱特征进行匹配，从而实现矿物元素表征任务。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的剪枝+凸优化匹配方法在元素表征任务上优于多个简单基线方法，验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过发布大规模真实场景矿物数据集并验证高效匹配算法，填补了HSI矿物识别领域公开数据集的空白，为未来矿物表征研究提供了新基准。

title: Beyond Good Intentions: When Does the Framing of Multilingual and Low-Resource NLP Research Become a Caricature?
summary: Building language technologies and conducting NLP research for low-resource languages---particularly when led by native speakers or involving participatory research practices---are often framed as means of addressing inequality, serving local communities, and, at times, contributing to *decolonisation*. In this paper, we examine recently published NLP and ML papers, focusing on the narratives used to characterise multilinguality, low-resource languages, and underrepresented cultures. We propose a framework for analysing research framings and identify recurring rhetorical patterns that may hinder accountability and constrain equitable knowledge production for---and by---underserved communities. We further assess the evidential basis of assertions regarding community benefit and find that such statements are often weakly supported or left unsubstantiated. Although community ownership and participation are frequently presented as key objectives, our analysis, supported by statistics from the ACL Anthology, suggests that research outputs more often prioritise resource creation and benchmarking---important but distinct goals---over evidence of broader structural change. We conclude by offering practical recommendations to help authors, reviewers, and readers critically assess these assertions and avoid potentially misleading framings.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了近期NLP和ML论文中对多语言、低资源语言及小众文化的叙事框架，提出研究框架分析工具，发现社区利益宣称缺乏充分证据支持，研究成果更偏向资源创建和基准测试而非结构性改变，并给出实用建议以帮助批判性评估这些宣称。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言NLP研究常被标榜为解决不平等、服务地方社区甚至促进去殖民化的工具，但这些叙事宣称缺乏系统性的审视和证据验证，可能阻碍问责机制并限制公平知识生产的空间。
AI.method: 作者收集并分析了近期发表的NLP和ML论文，提出一个用于分析研究叙事的框架，识别反复出现的修辞模式，并借助ACL Anthology的统计数据进行辅助验证，同时评估社区益处相关断言的可信度。
AI.result: 研究发现社区利益相关的断言通常证据薄弱或未被证实；尽管社区所有权和参与常被列为关键目标，但研究产出更侧重于资源创建和基准测试，而非展示结构性变革的证据。
AI.conclusion: 作者建议作者、审稿人和读者应对这些宣称进行批判性评估，避免被误导性的框架所左右，以促进更具问责性和公平性的低资源语言研究。

title: Modality Disentangled Learning for Incomplete Multimodal Emotion Recognition: A Primitive Memory Distillation Perspective
comment: 19 Pages, 8 Figures, 13 Tables. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Findings
summary: Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) systems often suffer from missing modalities in real-world scenarios. Existing methods usually generate, align, or distill missing modalities as a whole, overlooking the heterogeneous nature of the information carried by each modality. Such holistic treatment mixes inferable shared semantics with uncertain modality-specific details, yielding unstable representations and degrading robustness. To address this issue, we propose the Primitive Memory Distillation (PriMD) framework. Unlike existing methods, PriMD takes an intra-modal perspective and focuses on how different types of information within a modality differ in recoverability within each modality. PriMD first disentangles cross-modal shared semantics from modality-specific representations, and then discretizes the latter into learnable semantic primitives to construct modality-specific memory banks. When modalities are missing, PriMD is a teacher-student framework that the student model uses the shared semantics of available modalities as queries to dynamically retrieve primitives. It compensates for missing modality-specific information within a constrained memory space and aligns with the teacher model. Extensive experiments on IEMOCAP, CMU-MOSI, and CMU-MOSEI demonstrate that PriMD achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently stronger robustness across a wide range of missing-modality settings, while mitigating the instability caused by holistic feature inference. Our code and project website are available at https://github.com/JiaqiZhang-Sengoku/PriMD and https://jiaqizhang-sengoku.github.io/PriMD/, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Primitive Memory Distillation (PriMD)框架，通过从模态内部视角将跨模态共享语义与模态特有信息分离，并将后者离散化为可学习的语义基元构建模态特定记忆库。在多模态缺失场景下，学生模型利用可用模态的共享语义动态检索基元来补偿缺失的模态特有信息，并与教师模型对齐，在多个基准数据集上取得了最先进的性能和更强的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态情感识别方法在模态缺失时通常将缺失模态作为一个整体进行生成、对齐或蒸馏，忽视了各模态内部所携带信息的异质性。这种整体化处理方法将可推断的共享语义与不确定的模态特有细节混在一起，导致表示不稳定并降低模型鲁棒性。
AI.method: PriMD框架包含三个关键步骤：(1) 将跨模态共享语义从模态特有表示中解耦；(2) 将模态特有信息离散化为可学习的语义基元，构建模态特定记忆库；(3) 采用教师-学生框架，学生模型以可用模态的共享语义作为查询动态检索基元，在受限记忆空间内补偿缺失的模态特有信息并与教师模型对齐。
AI.result: 在IEMOCAP、CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI三个基准数据集上，PriMD实现了最先进的性能，并在多种缺失模态设置下展现出一致的更强鲁棒性，同时缓解了整体化特征推断带来的不稳定性问题。
AI.conclusion: PriMD通过模态内部分解和记忆蒸馏的策略，有效解决了多模态情感识别中缺失模态场景下的鲁棒性问题，验证了细粒度信息区分比整体化处理更为有效。

title: Personas Differ from Native-Language Generation: Language Pathways Shape LLM Interpersonal Advice
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 36 pages, 24 figures, 17 tables (9 pages main text; remainder references and appendices)
summary: LLMs are increasingly used for interpersonal advice and as tools for studying social behavior across languages and cultures. A common shortcut for eliciting language- or culture-related variation is to ask a model to answer as a native speaker. We test whether this native-speaker persona reproduces the outputs obtained when models instead generate advice in the target language and translate the response back into English. Using 600 interpersonal advice questions across 13 languages and eight LLMs, we compare native-language generation followed by translation (NL) with native-speaker persona prompting (NP), measuring linguistic style, behavioral scaffolding, and forced-choice action recommendations. We find that NP and NL are not interchangeable. Compared to NL, NP often increases lexical social cues, including affiliation and positive tone, while reducing qualities such as concreteness and social attunement; NP also provides less actionable scaffolding in open-ended advice. In forced-choice scenarios, NP changes which action the model selects, favoring confrontation over redirection, with effect sizes varying across languages, topics, and models. Our results show that cross-lingual elicitation strategy is a consequential methodological choice that can change both how advice is framed and which actions models recommend.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了跨语言社交建议生成中两种提示策略（母语者人设提示 vs. 目标语言生成后翻译）是否可互换。通过13种语言、8个大语言模型、600个建议问题的实验，发现两种策略在语言风格、行为引导和行动建议上存在显著差异，且不可互换。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被广泛用于人际建议和跨文化社会行为研究。常见的简化做法是让模型以母语者身份回答，但该方法是否等价于在目标语言中生成再翻译回英语，此前缺乏系统验证。这一方法论问题直接影响跨语言研究的有效性。
AI.method: 使用600个人际建议问题，覆盖13种语言和8个大语言模型。比较两种策略：原生语言生成后翻译回英语（NL）与母语者人设提示（NP）。从语言风格、行为脚手架（行为引导）和强制选择行动建议三个维度进行测量。
AI.result: NP和NL不可互换。相比NL，NP增加了词汇层面的社交线索（如亲和力和积极语气），但降低了具体性和社会调谐等品质；NP在开放式建议中提供的行为引导可操作性较差；在强制选择场景中，NP会改变模型选择的行动，倾向于对抗而非重定向，效应大小因语言、主题和模型而异。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言提示策略是一项具有后果的方法论选择，它不仅影响建议的表述方式，还会改变模型推荐的具体行动。研究者在使用LLM进行跨语言社会行为研究时需谨慎选择提示策略。

title: Learning Compositional Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding with Synthetic Curriculum
summary: Despite the impressive progress of recent MLLMs on spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG), existing evaluations and training data focus primarily on simple queries. They largely overlook the compositional queries prevalent in real-world scenarios, where a target must be disambiguated by jointly reasoning about its attributes and relations to other entities. To bridge this gap, we propose Compositional Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (CompSTVG), a task that requires models to process complex textual queries where every intertwined attribute and relational cue is essential for disambiguation. To facilitate this task at scale, we build a synthetic data engine that leverages a spatio-temporal scene graph as a difficulty measure and casts difficulty-controlled query synthesis as a constraint programming problem, producing difficulty-graded data for both evaluation and training. Built on this engine, we introduce STVG-CompBench, a benchmark stratified by explicit difficulty levels that jointly capture temporal complexity and spatial interference. Evaluating 11 representative STVG models on STVG-CompBench reveals that current models perform poorly on compositional queries, exhibiting a sharp performance drop that is typically obscured by overall dataset-level averages. We further construct synthetic training data and propose CurrSTVG, a curriculum reinforcement learning framework that delivers consistent gains, with the largest improvements observed on the most challenging compositional queries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出组合时空视频定位（CompSTVG）任务，并构建了基于时空场景图难度度量的合成数据引擎STVG-CompBench基准，以及课程强化学习框架CurrSTVG，以解决现有视频定位评估忽略组合查询的局限。
AI.motivation: 现有的时空视频定位（STVG）评估和训练数据主要聚焦简单查询，忽视了真实场景中常见的组合查询——需要同时推理目标属性及其与其他实体的关系才能消歧。这导致现有模型在复杂场景下的表现被整体平均分数所掩盖。
AI.method: 1) 提出CompSTVG任务，要求模型处理属性与关系线索交织的复杂文本查询；2) 构建合成数据引擎，利用时空场景图作为难度度量，将难度控制的查询合成转化为约束编程问题，生成分级难度的数据；3) 建立按显式难度分层的STVG-CompBench基准；4) 提出CurrSTVG课程强化学习框架，从易到难训练模型。
AI.result: 评估11个代表性STVG模型发现当前模型在组合查询上表现不佳，存在明显的性能骤降，而这种差距通常被数据集级平均指标所掩盖。采用CurrSTVG框架后获得了一致的性能提升，在最具挑战性的组合查询上提升幅度最大。
AI.conclusion: 现有STVG模型对组合查询的推理能力严重不足，需要专门的基准和训练策略来弥合这一差距。课程强化学习是提升模型在难难度组合查询上表现的有效途径。

title: Evaluating and Mitigating Anti-LGBTQ Biases in German and Multilingual Language Models
summary: While gender and racial biases in language models have been widely studied, anti-LGBTQ biases remain underexplored, particularly beyond English. Existing benchmarks often do not capture cultural and linguistic variation and rely on gender representations. This paper introduces a multilingual German-English benchmark dataset for the evaluation of anti-LGBTQ biases in language models. It combines community-sourced stereotypes from German-speaking queer individuals with a German translation of WinoQueer. The data is used to evaluate eight language models across sizes and architectures and explore mitigation through fine-tuning on community and progressive media content. Results show that language models reproduce anti-queer stereotypes, with variation across identities and models. Differences between the translated and community-based data highlight the importance of cultural adaptation for multilingual bias evaluation. Fine-tuning reduces bias on average, but not consistently across models and identities. Warning: This text contains examples of anti-queer hateful language and stereotypes.

AI.tldr: 本文引入了一个多语言（德英）基准数据集，用于评估语言模型中的反LGBTQ偏见，结合社区来源的刻板印象和WinoQueer的德语翻译，评估了8个语言模型并探索了微调缓解策略。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注性别和种族偏见，反LGBTQ偏见尤其非英语语境下研究不足；现有基准未能捕捉文化和语言差异，且依赖性别表征。
AI.method: 构建德英双语的基准数据集：一是从德语区酷儿群体社区收集刻板印象，二是翻译WinoQueer数据集；使用该数据评估8个不同规模和架构的语言模型，并通过在社区和进步媒体内容上微调来探索偏见缓解。
AI.result: 语言模型确实复现了反酷儿刻板印象，且在不同身份群体和模型之间存在差异；翻译数据和社区数据之间的差异凸显了文化适应对多语言偏见评估的重要性；微调平均能降低偏见，但在不同模型和身份群体间效果不一致。
AI.conclusion: 反LGBTQ偏见在多语言语境下的评估需要文化适应，仅靠翻译不够；微调不是普适的偏见缓解方案，需要针对不同模型和身份群体进行更细致的处理。

title: DiffSAC: Diffusion-guided Sampling for Consensus-based Robust Estimation
summary: Robust estimation is a core computer vision task frequently tackled using sample consensus. However, traditional methods suffer from inefficient sampling as they struggle to identify effective minimum sets before hypothesis evaluation. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Diffusion-guided Sampling for Consensus-based Robust Estimation (DiffSAC) framework. DiffSAC introduces a diffusion model to learn the distribution of effective minimum sets. It refines the confidence for each data point, indicating whether it belongs to a good minimum set, rather than ranking the data points as in previous work. This significantly reduces the need to process numerous bad sets. To constrain the refinement direction, geometric features are incorporated as conditions within our diffusion model. Consequently, DiffSAC outputs a small number of high-quality minimum sets, enabling identification of the best hypothesis via consensus evaluation. Notably, compared to previous works requiring evaluating over ten thousand hypotheses, DiffSAC achieves state-of-the-art performance with only dozens, significantly boosting efficiency. Extensive experiments across five classic computer vision tasks demonstrate the superiority of DiffSAC. The diffusion model's sampling accelerators enable real-time operation, and DiffSAC can be used as a plug-and-play module to improve existing sample consensus methods.

AI.tldr: 提出DiffSAC框架，利用扩散模型学习有效最小集合的分布，通过为每个数据点细化置信度而非排序，仅需数十个高质量最小集合即可实现最先进的鲁棒估计性能，相比传统方法需评估上万个假设，显著提升效率并支持实时运行。
AI.motivation: 传统基于样本一致性的鲁棒估计方法在假设评估前难以有效采样最小集合，导致采样效率低下，需要处理大量无效集合。
AI.method: DiffSAC引入扩散模型学习有效最小集合的分布，为每个数据点细化置信度（判断其是否属于良好的最小集合），并以几何特征作为条件约束细化方向，最终输出少量高质量最小集合。
AI.result: 在五个经典计算机视觉任务上的大量实验表明，DiffSAC仅需评估几十个假设即可达到最先进的性能（此前方法需评估上万假设），扩散模型的采样加速器还支持实时操作。
AI.conclusion: DiffSAC显著提升了鲁棒估计的采样效率，可作为即插即用模块提升现有样本一致性方法的性能。

title: ECGQuest: Benchmarking and Fine-Tuning Language Models for Electrocardiography
summary: Electrocardiogram (ECG) interpretation requires knowledge of cardiology, electrophysiology, clinical diagnosis, ECG waveforms, signal acquisition, and instrumentation. Existing language-model benchmarks, however, primarily assess broad medical knowledge or interpretation of individual ECG signals and images rather than the broader contextual knowledge required for ECG interpretation. We developed ECGQuest, a literature-grounded resource for evaluating and fine-tuning ECG-specific language models. A GPT-4o-based pipeline generated questions from 23 ECG references and Computing in Cardiology proceedings from 2003-2025. The final dataset contains 10,904 unique True/False questions paired with their negated forms (21,808 Q&A pairs). We evaluated three commercial and 20 open-source language models on a held-out test set in a zero-shot setting. Five open-source models with 7-14B parameters were fine-tuned using Low-Rank Adaptation, with BERT and BiomedBERT included as supervised encoder baselines. Generalization was assessed on ECG-related subsets of MedMCQA and MedQA converted to binary True/False questions using official answer keys. Zero-shot accuracy on ECGQuest ranged from 49.5% to 74.4%, with GPT-5 performing best. General-purpose models outperformed medically specialized models, several models showed strong True/False bias, and encoder baselines performed near chance. Fine-tuning improved all open-source models by 6.5-14.1%. Fine-tuned DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B reached 76.3% accuracy, while a five-model voting ensemble reached 78.5%. On MedMCQA and MedQA, fine-tuning mainly benefited weaker or class-biased models and did not consistently improve strong base models. ECGQuest provides a reproducible benchmark for contextual ECG knowledge and shows that parameter-efficient fine-tuning can make smaller language models competitive with substantially larger commercial models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ECGQuest，一个基于文献构建的心电图（ECG）领域语言模型评估与微调基准。该基准包含21,808个判断题（True/False问答对），来源于23本ECG参考书和2003-2025年Computing in Cardiology会议论文。研究发现通用模型优于医学专用模型，微调可将开源模型性能提升6.5-14.1%，微调后的DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B达到76.3%准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型基准主要评估广泛的医学知识或单个ECG信号的解读，而非ECG解释所需的更广泛的上下文知识（包括心脏病学、电生理学、临床诊断、波形知识、信号采集和仪器知识等），缺乏针对ECG领域上下文知识的专门基准。
AI.method: 使用GPT-4o流水线从23本ECG参考文献和Computing in Cardiology会议论文（2003-2025）中生成问题，构建包含10,904个独特的True/False问题及其否定形式（共21,808个问答对）的数据集。评估了3个商业模型和20个开源模型，并使用低秩适应（LoRA）对5个7-14B参数的开源模型进行微调，包括BERT和BiomedBERT作为有监督编码器基线。
AI.result: 零样本准确率在49.5%-74.4%之间，GPT-5表现最佳；通用模型优于医学专用模型；微调使所有开源模型提升6.5-14.1%；微调后的DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B达到76.3%准确率，五模型投票集成达到78.5%。在MedMCQA和MedQA上，微调主要使较弱或类偏置模型受益。
AI.conclusion: ECGQuest提供了一个可复现的ECG上下文知识基准，证明了参数高效微调可以使较小的语言模型与规模大得多的商业模型相竞争。

title: OCR-Based Field Extraction for Archaeological Pottery Metadata: The CENTURIA Dataset
summary: Pottery is a primary source for reconstructing the chronological and economic dimensions of past societies. Archaeologists often document ceramic finds through technical drawings and handwritten metadata. This metadata is critical for dating, provenance attribution, and cross-site comparison, but remains inaccessible to computational analysis, requiring manual transcription of every record. We investigate whether state-of-the-art document analysis models can address this task, and introduce CENTURIA, a dataset of 507 pottery records from the Roman site of Carnuntum, providing transcriptions, bounding boxes, and structured field-level labels across seven metadata categories. Benchmarking five OCR models reveals a substantial domain gap: zero-shot transcription error reaches 15-32% SpACER-M, far exceeding rates on printed archival documents, with domain-specific fields recovered in fewer than 3% of cases. LoRA fine-tuning on just 57 samples, reflecting a realistic archival annotation budget, closes this gap, reducing transcription error to below 1.5% and recovering overall field-level accuracy above 87%. Our results show that a small expert-validated fine-tuning set suffices to convert handwritten pottery documentation into structured, searchable metadata ready for archaeological databases.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了CENTURIA数据集（来自罗马Carnuntum遗址的507份陶器记录），并评估了五种OCR模型在手写陶器文献转录任务上的表现。研究发现零样本转录错误率高达15-32%，但仅用57个样本进行LoRA微调即可将错误率降至1.5%以下，字段级准确率超过87%。
AI.motivation: 考古学家常用的陶器手写文档元数据（年代、来源、跨遗址对比等）无法直接进行计算分析，需要逐条手工转录，效率极低。作者希望探索现代文档分析模型能否自动化解决这一转录和结构化任务。
AI.method: 构建CENTURIA数据集（507条陶器记录，含转录文本、边界框及七个元数据类别字段级标注），对五种OCR模型进行基准测试，并使用LoRA技术仅用57个样本进行微调，模拟真实的档案标注预算场景。
AI.result: 零样本转录错误率高达15-32% SpACER-M，领域特定字段恢复率不足3%；LoRA微调后将转录错误降至1.5%以下，整体字段级准确率超过87%。
AI.conclusion: 小规模专家验证的微调数据集足以将手写陶器文献转化为结构化的、可搜索的元数据，适合直接用于考古数据库，为大规模自动化处理考古档案提供了可行方案。

title: Low-Resource Preference Adaptation of LLMs via Activation-Based Label Propagation
summary: Adapting large language models to user-specific preferences is often constrained by the cost of human annotation, making preference optimisation impractical in low-resource settings where preferences cannot be reliably labelled by LLMs themselves, e.g., due to cultural, subjective, or personalised contexts. In this paper, we investigate how language models encode preference information in their intermediate representations, finding that activations from chosen and rejected responses form distinct clusters across layers, even in pretrained models. Strikingly, this structure is strengthened by alignment on canonical datasets but erased when the target preferences differ from those the model was aligned on, suggesting aligned LLMs are poor judges for non-mainstream populations. Exploiting this structure, we propose training a lightweight linear probe on a few labelled preference pairs ($\leq$500) and using it to annotate large unlabelled datasets (50K+) for downstream preference optimisation. We systematically evaluate this approach across different datasets, preference optimisation methods and model scales and find that our method consistently outperforms direct training given the same annotation budget, and remains competitive against baselines trained on $50-100\times$ more labelled data in the majority of our settings. Code is available at https://github.com/alessioGalatolo/activ-pref-probe.

AI.tldr: 本文发现语言模型在中间表征中编码了偏好信息（chosen和rejected响应的激活在不同层形成清晰聚类），并利用这一结构训练轻量级线性探针，仅需≤500个标注偏好对即可标注5万+无标注数据用于下游偏好优化，在相同标注预算下持续优于直接训练，且与使用50-100倍标注数据的基线相当。
AI.motivation: 大规模语言模型适应用户偏好通常受限于人工标注成本，尤其在文化、主观或个人化等低资源场景下，LLM自身无法可靠地标注偏好。现有方法难以在这些非主流偏好场景下高效地进行偏好优化。
AI.method: 首先分析LLM中间表征中偏好信息的编码方式，发现chosen和rejected响应的激活值形成明显聚类；利用这一结构，在少量标注偏好对上训练轻量级线性探针，将其用于标注大规模无标注数据集，再进行下游偏好优化。
AI.result: 该方法在多种数据集、偏好优化方法和模型规模下，始终优于相同标注预算下的直接训练；在大多数设置下，与使用50-100倍更多标注数据的基线方法相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: 激活偏好探针是一种在低资源偏好设置下高效且可扩展的偏好标注方法，揭示了LLM表征中偏好结构的可迁移性，同时也指出对齐后的LLM在非主流人群偏好上可能成为不良评判者这一局限性。

title: RealCAD: Towards Real-World Image-to-CAD Reconstruction under Domain Shift and Parameter Bias
comment: The code and dataset are publicly available. Code: https://github.com/sunyh39/RealCAD. Dataset: https://www.modelscope.cn/datasets/yeguomao/RealCAD
summary: Reconstructing editable Computer-Aided Design (CAD) models from images is essential for downstream modification, manufacturing, and design reuse. However, existing image-to-CAD methods are developed predominantly on synthetic renderings and face two coupled obstacles: a substantial appearance domain gap between synthetic and real images, and a previously overlooked parameter bias in widely used CAD data.
